hausa: Bayan wani ɗan lokaci, sai aka faɗa wa Ibrahim cewa, “Ga shi, Milka ita ma ta haifa wa Nahor ɗan’uwanka, ’ya’ya maza;
english: After these things, Abraham was told, “Behold, Milcah, she also has borne children to your brother Nahor:

hausa: Zan yi wannan domin sun yashe ni, suka kuma yi wa Ashtarot, alliyar Sidoniyawa, da Kemosh, allahn Mowabawa, da kuma Molek, allahn Ammonawa sujada, ba su yi tafiya a hanyoyina ba, ba su kuwa yi abin da yake daidai a idanuna ba, ba su kiyaye farillaina da dokokina kamar yadda Dawuda, mahaifin Solomon ya yi ba.
english: because they have forsaken me, and have worshiped Ashtoreth the goddess of the Sidonians, Chemosh the god of Moab, and Milcom the god of the children of Ammon. They have not walked in my ways, to do that which is right in my eyes, and to keep my statutes and my ordinances, as David his father did.

hausa: Sa’ad da hanyoyin mutum sun gamshi Ubangiji, yakan sa abokan gāban mutumin ma su zauna lafiya da shi.
english: When a man’s ways please Yahweh, he makes even his enemies to be at peace with him.

hausa: Da suka kawo shi wajen Yesu, sai suka shimfiɗa rigunarsu a bayansa. Yesu kuwa ya hau ya zauna bisansa.
english: They brought the young donkey to Jesus and threw their garments on it, and Jesus sat on it.

hausa: Umarnanka suna sa in zama mai hikima fiye da abokan gābana, gama kullum suna tare da ni.
english: Your commandments make me wiser than my enemies, for your commandments are always with me.

hausa: Amma bayan na tashi, zan sha gabanku zuwa Galili.”
english: However, after I am raised up, I will go before you into Galilee.”

hausa: Ya ce, “Amin! Ubangiji yă sa yă zama haka! Ubangiji yă cika maganar da ka yi annabci ta wurin komo da kayayyakin gidan Ubangiji da kuma dukan masu zaman bauta zuwa wannan wuri daga Babilon.
english: even the prophet Jeremiah said, “Amen! May Yahweh do so. May Yahweh perform your words which you have prophesied, to bring again the vessels of Yahweh’s house, and all those who are captives, from Babylon to this place.

hausa: sai ku kai dukan abin da na umarce ku ku kai, wato, hadayu na ƙonawa, da sadakokinku, da zakkarku, da hadayunku na ɗagawa, da hadayunku na alkawarin da kuka yi wa Ubangiji a wurin da Ubangiji Allahnku ya zaɓa yă sa sunansa.
english: then it shall happen that to the place which Yahweh your God shall choose, to cause his name to dwell there, there you shall bring all that I command you: your burnt offerings, your sacrifices, your tithes, the wave offering of your hand, and all your choice vows which you vow to Yahweh.

hausa: Nan da nan, da Laban ya sami labari game da Yaƙub, ɗan ’yar’uwarsa, ya gaggauta yă sadu da shi. Sai ya rungume shi ya sumbace shi, ya kuma kawo shi gidansa, a can kuwa Yaƙub ya faɗa masa dukan waɗannan abubuwa.
english: When Laban heard the news of Jacob, his sister’s son, he ran to meet Jacob, and embraced him, and kissed him, and brought him to his house. Jacob told Laban all these things.

hausa: Ya saki walƙiyarsa, a ƙarƙashin dukan sammai ya kuma aika ta ko’ina a cikin duniya.
english: He sends it out under the whole sky, and his lightning to the ends of the earth.

hausa: In mai alkawarin matalauci ne da ba zai iya biyan ƙayyadadden abin da aka tsara ba, sai yă tafi wurin firist, shi firist kuma yă duba yadda mutumin da ya yi alkawarin zai iya biya. Sa’an nan mutumin zai biya abin da firist ya faɗa.
english: But if he is poorer than your valuation, then he shall be set before the priest, and the priest shall assign a value to him. The priest shall assign a value according to his ability to pay.

hausa: amma Isra’ila da suka yi ƙwazo wajen bin Dokar adalci, ba su same shi ba.
english: but Israel, following after a law of righteousness, didn’t arrive at the law of righteousness.

hausa: “Haruna zai rasu. Ba zai shiga ƙasar da na ba Isra’ilawa ba, domin ku biyu, kun ƙi ku bi umarnina a ruwan Meriba.
english: “Aaron shall be gathered to his people; for he shall not enter into the land which I have given to the children of Israel, because you rebelled against my word at the waters of Meribah.

hausa: Ba shakka ka sani, gama an riga an haife ka a lokacin! Ka yi shekaru da yawa kana rayuwa.
english: Surely you know, for you were born then, and the number of your days is great!

hausa: “Ku yi hankali kada ku nuna ‘ayyukanku na adalci’ a gaban mutane, don su gani. In kuka yi haka, ba za ku sami lada daga wurin Ubanku da yake cikin sama ba.
english: “Be careful that you don’t do your charitable giving before men, to be seen by them, or else you have no reward from your Father who is in heaven.

hausa: Sai ya tambaye, su ya ce, “Mene ne kuke tattaunawa da juna a cikin tafiyarku?” Suka tsaya shiru, da damuwa a fuskarsu.
english: He said to them, “What are you talking about as you walk, and are sad?”

hausa: Sai Yoshuwa ɗan Nun ya aika ’yan leƙen asiri guda biyu a ɓoye daga Shittim ya ce, “Ku je ku duba, ku ga yadda wurin yake, musamman Yeriko.” Sai suka je suka shiga gidan wata karuwa mai suna Rahab, suka sauka a can.
english: Joshua the son of Nun secretly sent two men out of Shittim as spies, saying, “Go, view the land, including Jericho.” They went and came into the house of a prostitute whose name was Rahab, and slept there.

hausa: A wannan lokaci zan jijji wa waɗanda suka danne ku; zan kuɓutar da guragu in kuma tattara waɗanda suke a warwatse. Zan sa a yabe su a kuma girmama su a kowace ƙasar da aka kunyatar da su.
english: Behold, at that time I will deal with all those who afflict you; and I will save those who are lame and gather those who were driven away. I will give them praise and honor, whose shame has been in all the earth.

hausa: “Ku faɗa wa Hezekiya sarkin Yahuda cewa kada ka bar allahn da ka dogara a kai ya ruɗe ka sa’ad da ya ce, ‘Ba za a ba da Urushalima ga sarkin Assuriya ba.’
english: “Thus you shall speak to Hezekiah king of Judah, saying, ‘Don’t let your God in whom you trust deceive you, saying, “Jerusalem won’t be given into the hand of the king of Assyria.”

hausa: Kai ne ka kafa dukan iyakokin duniya; ka yi rani da damina.
english: You have set all the boundaries of the earth. You have made summer and winter.

hausa: Gama in na yi addu’a da wani harshe, ruhuna ne yake addu’a, amma tunanina bai amfana kome ba.
english: For if I pray in another language, my spirit prays, but my understanding is unfruitful.

hausa: Ko wani zai ce ga laifin da na yi? In an same ni da laifi, zan yi shiru in mutu.
english: Who is he who will contend with me? For then I would hold my peace and give up the spirit.

hausa: Saboda haka sarki ya tambaye ni ya ce, “Me ya sa fuskarka ta ɓaci, ga shi, ba ciwo kake ba? Ba abin da ya kawo wannan, in ba dai kana baƙin ciki ba.” Sai na ji tsoro ƙwarai,
english: The king said to me, “Why is your face sad, since you are not sick? This is nothing else but sorrow of heart.” Then I was very much afraid.

hausa: Amma don kada in ƙara gajiyar da kai, ina roƙonka ka yi haƙuri ka saurari ɗan taƙaitaccen jawabinmu.
english: But that I don’t delay you, I entreat you to bear with us and hear a few words.

hausa: Ya bi da su lafiya ƙalau, don kada su ji tsoro; amma teku ya cinye abokan gābansu.
english: He led them safely, so that they weren’t afraid, but the sea overwhelmed their enemies.

hausa: Ya kuwa ɗauke ni cikin Ruhu zuwa wani babban dutse mai tsayi, ya kuma nuna mini Birni Mai Tsarki, Urushalima, tana saukowa daga sama, daga Allah.
english: He carried me away in the Spirit to a great and high mountain, and showed me the holy city, Jerusalem, coming down out of heaven from God,

hausa: “Yanzu fa, kai kanka ka san abin da Yowab ɗan Zeruhiya ya yi mini. Abin da ya yi wa shugabanni biyun nan na mayaƙan Isra’ila, wato, Abner ɗan Ner, da Amasa ɗan Yeter. Ya kashe su, ya kuma zub da jininsu a lokacin salama sai ka ce a fage yaƙi, da wannan jini ya yi ɗamara a gindinsa, ya kuma sa takalma a ƙafafunsa.
english: “Moreover you know also what Joab the son of Zeruiah did to me, even what he did to the two captains of the armies of Israel, to Abner the son of Ner and to Amasa the son of Jether, whom he killed, and shed the blood of war in peace, and put the blood of war on his sash that was around his waist and in his sandals that were on his feet.

hausa: Shi wanda ya miƙa hadayun godiya yakan girmama ni, ya kuma shirya hanya saboda in nuna masa ceton Allah.”
english: Whoever offers the sacrifice of thanksgiving glorifies me, and prepares his way so that I will show God’s salvation to him.”

hausa: Za a la’anta ku sa’ad da kuka shiga da sa’ad da kuka fita.
english: You will be cursed when you come in, and you will be cursed when you go out.

hausa: “Don me kuke ce da ni, ‘Ubangiji, Ubangiji,’ amma ba kwa yin abin da na faɗa?
english: “Why do you call me, ‘Lord, Lord,’ and don’t do the things which I say?

hausa: Sai mutanen suka yi gunaguni a kan Musa, suna cewa, “Me za mu sha?”
english: The people murmured against Moses, saying, “What shall we drink?”

hausa: Da yake za a hallaka dukan abubuwa ta haka, waɗanne irin mutane ne ya kamata ku zama? Ya kamata ku yi rayuwar tsarki da ta tsoron Allah,
english: Therefore, since all these things will be destroyed like this, what kind of people ought you to be in holy living and godliness,

hausa: da Anatot, da Nob, da Ananiya,
english: at Anathoth, Nob, Ananiah,

hausa: Ka bi da sawuna bisa ga maganarka; kada ka bar zunubi yă mallake ni.
english: Establish my footsteps in your word. Don’t let any iniquity have dominion over me.

hausa: Sai dukansu suka yi kuka suka rungume shi, suka kuma yi masa sumba.
english: They all wept freely, and fell on Paul’s neck and kissed him,

hausa: Yanzu haka, fadawa sun zo suna wa ranka yă daɗe, Sarki Dawuda, sam barka, suna cewa, ‘Bari Allahnka yă sa sunan Solomon yă zama sananne fiye da naka, bari kuma sarautarsa tă fi taka girma!’ Sarki kuwa ya rusuna, ya yi sujada a kan gadonsa
english: Moreover the king’s servants came to bless our lord King David, saying, ‘May your God make the name of Solomon better than your name, and make his throne greater than your throne;’ and the king bowed himself on the bed.

hausa: Sai ya ci gaba da gaya wa mutanen wannan misali ya ce, “Wani mutum ya yi gonar inabi, sai ya ba da hayarta ga waɗansu manoma, sa’an nan ya yi wata doguwar tafiya.
english: He began to tell the people this parable: “A man planted a vineyard and rented it out to some farmers, and went into another country for a long time.

hausa: Sai matar ta ce wa Iliya, “Yanzu na san cewa kai mutumin Allah ne, Ubangiji kuma yana magana ta wurinka.”
english: The woman said to Elijah, “Now I know that you are a man of God, and that Yahweh’s word in your mouth is truth.”

hausa: Ya aikata abin da yake daidai a gaban Ubangiji yadda kakansa Dawuda ya yi.
english: He did that which was right in Yahweh’s eyes, according to all that David his father had done.

hausa: Ibrahim ya amsa ya ce, “Ka karɓi waɗannan ’yan tumaki bakwai daga hannuna a matsayin shaida cewa ni ne na haƙa wannan rijiya.”
english: He said, “You shall take these seven ewe lambs from my hand, that it may be a witness to me, that I have dug this well.”

hausa: ’Ya’yan Shemida maza su ne, Ahiyan, Shekem, Liki da Aniyam.
english: The sons of Shemida were Ahian, Shechem, Likhi, and Aniam.

hausa: Amma Abiya ya ƙara ƙarfi. Ya auri mata goma sha huɗu, ya kuma kasance da ’ya’ya maza ashirin da biyu da kuma ’ya’ya mata goma sha shida.
english: But Abijah grew mighty and took for himself fourteen wives, and became the father of twenty-two sons and sixteen daughters.

hausa: Gedaliya ɗan Ahikam, ɗan Shafan, ya yi rantsuwa don yă tabbatar musu da mutanensu. Ya ce, “Kada ku ji tsoron bauta wa Babiloniyawa. Ku zauna a ƙasar ku bauta wa sarkin Babilon, zai kuma yi muku amfani.
english: Gedaliah the son of Ahikam the son of Shaphan swore to them and to their men, saying, “Don’t be afraid to serve the Chaldeans. Dwell in the land, and serve the king of Babylon, and it will be well with you.

hausa: na ashirin da ɗaya wa Yakin, na ashirin da biyu a kan Gamul,
english: the twenty-first to Jachin, the twenty-second to Gamul,

hausa: suka kashe harshen wuta, suka kuma tsere wa kaifin takobi; waɗanda aka mai da rashin ƙarfinsu ya zama ƙarfi; waɗanda suka yi jaruntaka wajen yaƙi suka kuma fatattaki mayaƙan waɗansu ƙasashe.
english: quenched the power of fire, escaped the edge of the sword, from weakness were made strong, grew mighty in war, and caused foreign armies to flee.

hausa: Zan kuma taurare zuciyar Fir’auna, zai kuwa bi su. Na shirya wannan domin in nuna ɗaukakata a bisa Fir’auna da ƙungiyar sojansa. Bayan wannan, mutanen Masar za su sani ni ne Ubangiji.” Sai Isra’ilawa suka yi haka.
english: I will harden Pharaoh’s heart, and he will follow after them; and I will get honor over Pharaoh, and over all his armies; and the Egyptians shall know that I am Yahweh.” They did so.

hausa: Akwai siffofin rumman tasa’in da shida da ake gani a gefen. Dukan siffofin rumman da suke a kan ragar kewaye, guda ɗari ne.
english: There were ninety-six pomegranates on the sides; all the pomegranates were one hundred on the network all around.

hausa: Kin ƙara yawan masu kasuwancinki har sai da suka fi taurarin sama. Amma kamar fāra sun cinye ƙasar sa’an nan suka tashi, suka tafi.
english: You have increased your merchants more than the stars of the skies. The grasshopper strips and flees away.

hausa: Sai Bilatus ya tambayi Yesu ya ce, “Kai ne sarkin Yahudawa?” Yesu ya amsa ya ce, “I, haka yake, kamar yadda ka faɗa.”
english: Pilate asked him, “Are you the King of the Jews?” He answered him, “So you say.”

hausa: “Yanzu na kafa alkawarina da ku da zuriyarku a bayanku,
english: “As for me, behold, I establish my covenant with you, and with your offspring after you,

hausa: Kada ka zalunci matalauta a kan suna matalauta kada kuma ka ƙwari wanda ba shi da mai taimako a gaban shari’a,
english: Don’t exploit the poor because he is poor; and don’t crush the needy in court;

hausa: Zai zama mai girma, za a kuma kira shi Ɗan Maɗaukaki. Ubangiji Allah zai ba shi gadon sarautar kakansa Dawuda,
english: He will be great and will be called the Son of the Most High. The Lord God will give him the throne of his father David,

hausa: Ko da na yi kira gare shi ya amsa mini, ban yarda cewa zai saurare ni ba.
english: If I had called, and he had answered me, yet I wouldn’t believe that he listened to my voice.

hausa: Na ɗaukaka ka a duniya ta wurin gama aikin da ka ba ni.
english: I glorified you on the earth. I have accomplished the work which you have given me to do.

hausa: Da na ga ba za ku taimake ni ba, sai na yi kasai da raina na kuwa haye don in yaƙi Ammonawa, Ubangiji kuwa ya ba ni nasara a kansu. To, don me kuka zo yau don ku yaƙe ni?”
english: When I saw that you didn’t save me, I put my life in my hand, and passed over against the children of Ammon, and Yahweh delivered them into my hand. Why then have you come up to me today, to fight against me?”

hausa: Ka san dokokin sammai? Ko za ka iya faɗar dangantakar Allah da duniya?
english: Do you know the laws of the heavens? Can you establish its dominion over the earth?

hausa: Sa’an nan mutumin ya fitar da ni ta ƙofar shiga a gefen ƙofar zuwa tsarkakakkun ɗakuna waɗanda suke fuskantar arewa, waɗanda suke na firistoci, ya kuma nuna mini wani wuri daga can ƙurewar yamma.
english: Then he brought me through the entry, which was at the side of the gate, into the holy rooms for the priests, which looked toward the north. Behold, there was a place on the back part westward.

hausa: Uzziya wanda yake da farantin wuta a hannunsa a shirye don ƙone turare, ya husata. Yayinda yake fushi da firistocin a gabansu a gaban bagaden turare a haikalin Ubangiji, sai kuturta ta faso a goshinsa.
english: Then Uzziah was angry. He had a censer in his hand to burn incense, and while he was angry with the priests, the leprosy broke out on his forehead before the priests in Yahweh’s house, beside the altar of incense.

hausa: Suka iso Kafarnahum. Da yana cikin gida, sai ya tambaye su ya ce, “Gardamar me kuke yi a hanya?”
english: He came to Capernaum, and when he was in the house he asked them, “What were you arguing among yourselves on the way?”

hausa: “ ‘Duk sa’ad da mutumin Isra’ila ko baƙo mai zama a Isra’ila ya rabu da ni ya kuma kafa gumaka a cikin zuciyarsa ya kuna sa mugun abin tuntuɓe a gabansa sa’an nan ya tafi wurin annabi don yă neme ni, Ni Ubangiji zan amsa masa da kaina.
english: “‘“For everyone of the house of Israel, or of the strangers who live in Israel, who separates himself from me and takes his idols into his heart, and puts the stumbling block of his iniquity before his face, and comes to the prophet to inquire for himself of me, I Yahweh will answer him by myself.

hausa: “ ‘Kada ku rantse bisa ƙarya da sunana, ta haka har ku ƙasƙantar da sunan Allahnku. Ni ne Ubangiji.
english: “‘You shall not swear by my name falsely, and profane the name of your God. I am Yahweh.

hausa: Sai suka kama shi suka kashe, suka jefa shi bayan gonar inabin.
english: They took him, killed him, and cast him out of the vineyard.

hausa: Don me ka bar zuciyarka ta kwashe ka, kuma don me idanunka suke haske,
english: Why does your heart carry you away? Why do your eyes flash,

hausa: Allah ya yi magana daga wurinsa mai tsarki, “Ciki nasara zan raba Shekem in kuma auna Kwarin Sukkot.
english: God has spoken from his sanctuary: “In triumph, I will divide Shechem, and measure out the valley of Succoth.

hausa: Zan kuma mayar wa Dawuda sarautar gidan Shawulu, in kafa kursiyin Dawuda a kan Isra’ila, da kan Yahuda tun daga Dan har zuwa Beyersheba.”
english: to transfer the kingdom from Saul’s house, and to set up David’s throne over Israel and over Judah, from Dan even to Beersheba.”

hausa: Kowane ɗa namiji cikin zuriyar Haruna zai iya cinsa. Wannan rabonsa ne na kullum na hadayar da aka yi ga Ubangiji da wuta. Wannan madawwamiyar doka ce cikin zamananku duka. Duk abin da ya taɓa hadayun zai tsarkaka.’ ”
english: Every male among the children of Aaron shall eat of it, as their portion forever throughout your generations, from the offerings of Yahweh made by fire. Whoever touches them shall be holy.’”

hausa: Da Yesu ya zauna, sai ya kira Sha Biyun ya ce, “In wani yana so yă zama na fari, dole yă zama na ƙarshe duka, da kuma bawan kowa.”
english: He sat down and called the twelve; and he said to them, “If any man wants to be first, he shall be last of all, and servant of all.”

hausa: ’Yan’uwa, ba ma so ku zama da rashin sani, a kan wahalolin da muka sha a lardin Asiya. Mun sha wahaloli sosai, har abin ya fi ƙarfinmu, ya sa muka fid da tsammanin rayuwa.
english: For we don’t desire to have you uninformed, brothers, concerning our affliction which happened to us in Asia: that we were weighed down exceedingly, beyond our power, so much that we despaired even of life.

hausa: Almajiran suka ce, “Duba Ubangiji, ga takuba biyu.” Yesu ya ce, “Ya isa.”
english: They said, “Lord, behold, here are two swords.” He said to them, “That is enough.”

hausa: Na yi da su gwargwadon rashin tsabtarsu da laifofinsu, na kuma kawar da fuskata daga gare su.
english: I did to them according to their uncleanness and according to their transgressions. I hid my face from them.

hausa: Da ya iso gidan Yayirus, sai ya hana kowa yă bi shi cikin ɗakin, sai dai Bitrus, da Yohanna, da Yaƙub, da kuma mahaifin da mahaifiyar.
english: When he came to the house, he didn’t allow anyone to enter in, except Peter, John, James, the father of the child, and her mother.

hausa: Daga yanzu zuwa gaba, kada Isra’ilawa su yi kusa da Tentin Sujada, in ba haka ba kuwa su sha hukuncin zunubinsu, su kuma mutu.
english: Henceforth the children of Israel shall not come near the Tent of Meeting, lest they bear sin, and die.

hausa: Sa’an nan yakan ce, ‘Zan koma gidan da na bari.’ Sa’ad da ya iso, ya tarar da gidan ba kowa a ciki, shararre, kuma a kintse.
english: Then he says, ‘I will return into my house from which I came;’ and when he has come back, he finds it empty, swept, and put in order.

hausa: Ni ne mutumin da ya ga azaba ta wurin bulalar fushin Ubangiji.
english: I am the man who has seen affliction by the rod of his wrath.

hausa: Tun mai bawan yana riƙe da Bitrus da Yohanna, dukan mutanen suka yi mamaki, suka zo wurinsu a guje a inda ake kira Shirayin Solomon.
english: As the lame man who was healed held on to Peter and John, all the people ran together to them in the porch that is called Solomon’s, greatly wondering.

hausa: Yayinda suke ƙoƙari su kashe shi, sai labari ya kai ga shugaban ƙungiyar sojan Roma cewa birnin Urushalima duk ta hargitse.
english: As they were trying to kill him, news came up to the commanding officer of the regiment that all Jerusalem was in an uproar.

hausa: Sai ya fāɗi a ƙasa ya kuma ji wata murya ta ce masa, “Shawulu, Shawulu, don me kake tsananta mini?”
english: He fell on the earth, and heard a voice saying to him, “Saul, Saul, why do you persecute me?”

hausa: A rana ta bakwai ɗin firist zai dawo don yă dudduba gidan. In cutar fatar jiki da take a riga ta yaɗu a bangayen,
english: The priest shall come again on the seventh day, and look. If the plague has spread in the walls of the house,

hausa: Sukan jira ni kamar yadda ake jiran ruwan sama. Sukan sha daga cikin maganganuna kamar mai shan ruwan bazara.
english: They waited for me as for the rain. Their mouths drank as with the spring rain.

hausa: Yana riƙe da matankaɗinsa, zai tankaɗe hatsinsa, yă kuma tattara alkamarsa a cikin rumbu, amma zai ƙone yayin da wutar da ba a iya kashewa.”
english: His winnowing fork is in his hand, and he will thoroughly cleanse his threshing floor. He will gather his wheat into the barn, but the chaff he will burn up with unquenchable fire.”

hausa: Gama na zo ne in sa, “ ‘gāba tsakanin mutum da mahaifinsa, ’ya da mahaifiyarta, matar ɗa da surukarta,
english: For I came to set a man at odds against his father, and a daughter against her mother, and a daughter-in-law against her mother-in-law.

hausa: Kamar yadda yake a rubuce cewa, “Babu wani mai adalci, babu ko ɗaya;
english: As it is written, “There is no one righteous; no, not one.

hausa: Suna rera da kayan kiɗa na ganga da garaya; suna jin daɗin busar sarewa.
english: They sing to the tambourine and harp, and rejoice at the sound of the pipe.

hausa: Duk wanda ya mai da hankali ga horo kan nuna hanyar rai, amma duk wanda ya ƙyale gyara kan sa waɗansu su kauce.
english: He is in the way of life who heeds correction, but he who forsakes reproof leads others astray.

hausa: “Ka yi taguwar efod da shuɗi duka,
english: “You shall make the robe of the ephod all of blue.

hausa: To, me ya sa za ka Masar don shan ruwa daga Shihor? Kuma me ya sa za ka Assuriya don shan ruwa daga Kogi?
english: Now what do you gain by going to Egypt, to drink the waters of the Shihor? Or why do you go on the way to Assyria, to drink the waters of the River?

hausa: da Bunni, da Azgad, da Bebai,
english: Bunni, Azgad, Bebai,

hausa: Da ya yi gaba kaɗan, sai ya ga Yaƙub ɗan Zebedi, da ɗan’uwansa Yohanna a cikin jirgin ruwa, suna gyaran abin kamun kifinsu.
english: Going on a little further from there, he saw James the son of Zebedee, and John his brother, who were also in the boat mending the nets.

hausa: Sai Yoshuwa ya karkashe waɗannan sarakuna guda biyar, ya kuma rataye kowannensu a bisa itace inda jikunansu suka kasance har yamma.
english: Afterward Joshua struck them, put them to death, and hanged them on five trees. They were hanging on the trees until the evening.

hausa: Sai Ubangiji ya ce wa Kayinu, “Ina ɗan’uwanka Habila?” Sai Kayinu ya ce, “Ban sani ba, ni mai gadin ɗan’uwana ne?”
english: Yahweh said to Cain, “Where is Abel, your brother?” He said, “I don’t know. Am I my brother’s keeper?”

hausa: suka fitar da dutsen tsafi daga haikalin Ba’al, suka kuma ƙone shi.
english: They brought out the pillars that were in the house of Baal and burned them.

hausa: Mu ba kamar Musa ba ne, wanda ya rufe fuskarsa da lulluɓi, don kada Isra’ilawa su ga ƙarewar ɗaukakan nan mai shuɗewa.
english: and not as Moses, who put a veil on his face so that the children of Israel wouldn’t look steadfastly on the end of that which was passing away.

hausa: “Gaskiya ce, ya Ubangiji, cewa sarakunan Assuriyawa sun mai da dukan waɗannan mutane da ƙasashensu kango.
english: Truly, Yahweh, the kings of Assyria have destroyed all the countries and their land,

hausa: A ƙasarku, mace ba za tă yi ɓari ba, ba kuma za a sami marar haihuwa ba. Zan ba ku tsawon rai.
english: No one will miscarry or be barren in your land. I will fulfill the number of your days.

hausa: Ina so ku san cewa ba na yi wannan saboda ku, in ji Ubangiji Mai Iko Duka. Ku ji kunya ku kuma giggita saboda halinku, ya gidan Isra’ila!
english: I don’t do this for your sake,” says the Lord Yahweh. “Let it be known to you. Be ashamed and confounded for your ways, house of Israel.”

hausa: Sa’ad da Husham ya rasu, Hadad ɗan Bedad, wanda ya ci Midiyan da yaƙi a ƙasar Mowab, ya gāje shi. Sunan birninsa shi ne Awit.
english: Husham died, and Hadad, the son of Bedad, who struck Midian in the field of Moab, reigned in his place. The name of his city was Avith.

hausa: Ku kuma san wannan ƙauna wadda ta fi gaban sani, domin a cika ku da dukan cikar Allah.
english: and to know Christ’s love which surpasses knowledge, that you may be filled with all the fullness of God.

hausa: Ka hori ɗanka, zai kuwa ba ka salama; zai ba ka farin cikin da kake so.
english: Correct your son, and he will give you peace; yes, he will bring delight to your soul.

hausa: Gaskiya nake gaya muku, in wani ya ce wa dutsen nan, ‘Je ka, ka fāɗa cikin teku,’ bai kuwa yi shakka a zuciyarsa ba, amma ya gaskata cewa, abin da ya faɗa zai faru, haka kuwa za a yi masa.
english: For most certainly I tell you, whoever may tell this mountain, ‘Be taken up and cast into the sea,’ and doesn’t doubt in his heart, but believes that what he says is happening, he shall have whatever he says.

hausa: daga kabilar Asher, Fagiyel ɗan Okran;
english: Of Asher: Pagiel the son of Ochran.

hausa: In Ubangiji ya ji daɗin hanyar da mutum yake bi, zai sa sawu su kahu;
english: A man’s steps are established by Yahweh. He delights in his way.

hausa: Bayan rasuwar Ibrahim, Allah ya albarkaci ɗansa Ishaku wanda a lokacin yana zama kusa da Beyer-Lahai-Royi.
english: After the death of Abraham, God blessed Isaac, his son. Isaac lived by Beer Lahai Roi.

hausa: Ubangiji ya ce mini, “Daga arewa za a zubo masifa a kan dukan mazaunan ƙasar.
english: Then Yahweh said to me, “Out of the north, evil will break out on all the inhabitants of the land.

hausa: Maganar Ubangiji ta zo mini cewa,
english: Yahweh’s word came to me, saying,

hausa: Saboda haka a ranan nan Musa ya rantse mini cewa, ‘Ƙasar da ka taka za tă zama ƙasarka ta gādo kai da ’ya’yanka har abada, domin ka bi Ubangiji Allahna da dukan zuciyarka.’
english: Moses swore on that day, saying, ‘Surely the land where you walked shall be an inheritance to you and to your children forever, because you have wholly followed Yahweh my God.’

hausa: Sai matuƙan jirgin suka tsorata ƙwarai, suka ce masa, “Wane irin mugun abu ne ka aikata haka?” (Sun gane cewa yana gudu ne daga wurin Ubangiji, domin ya riga ya faɗa musu.)
english: Then the men were exceedingly afraid, and said to him, “What have you done?” For the men knew that he was fleeing from the presence of Yahweh, because he had told them.

hausa: “Ku shirya ɗamara don hidima. Ku bar fitilunku suna ci,
english: “Let your waist be dressed and your lamps burning.

hausa: Ta wurinka mun tura abokan gābanmu baya; ta wurin sunanka muka tattake maƙiyanmu.
english: Through you, we will push down our adversaries. Through your name, we will tread down those who rise up against us.

hausa: Ka umarce su game da waɗannan abubuwa, don su kasance marasa abin zargi.
english: Also command these things, that they may be without reproach.

hausa: wato, zuriyarsu da suka ragu a ƙasar, wadda Isra’ilawa ba su hallaka ba, waɗannan ne Solomon ya mai da su bayinsa na aikin dole, kamar yadda yake har wa yau.
english: of their children who were left after them in the land, whom the children of Israel didn’t consume—of them Solomon conscripted forced labor to this day.

hausa: Za a tara dukan al’ummai a gabansa, zai kuma raba mutane dabam-dabam yadda makiyayi yakan ware tumaki daga awaki.
english: Before him all the nations will be gathered, and he will separate them one from another, as a shepherd separates the sheep from the goats.

hausa: Ya fito da ni, ya kai ni wuri mafi fāɗi; ya kuɓutar da ni gama yana jin daɗina.
english: He also brought me out into a large place. He delivered me, because he delighted in me.

hausa: “Ina faɗa muku yanzu tun kafin yă faru, domin in ya faru, ku gaskata cewa ni ne Shi.
english: From now on, I tell you before it happens, that when it happens, you may believe that I am he.

hausa: Yesu ya ce, “Saboda taurin kanku ne, Musa ya rubuta muku wannan doka.
english: But Jesus said to them, “For your hardness of heart, he wrote you this commandment.

hausa: Sai Abner ya ce masa, “Yi dama ko hagu ka runtumi ɗaya daga cikin samarin, ka ƙwace makamansa.” Amma Asahel bai bar fafararsa ba.
english: Abner said to him, “Turn away to your right hand or to your left, and grab one of the young men, and take his armor.” But Asahel would not turn away from following him.

hausa: Amma domin Kaleb bawana ya kasance da ruhu dabam, ya kuma bi ni da zuciya ɗaya, zan kai shi cikin ƙasar da ya je, zuriyarsa kuwa za su gāje ta.
english: But my servant Caleb, because he had another spirit with him, and has followed me fully, him I will bring into the land into which he went. His offspring shall possess it.

hausa: Mace mai fitina kamar ɗiɗɗigar ruwa take ba ƙaƙƙautawa;
english: A continual dropping on a rainy day and a contentious wife are alike:

hausa: kuma kamar yadda wani Nassi ya ce, “Za su dubi wanda suka soka.”
english: Again another Scripture says, “They will look on him whom they pierced.”

hausa: Ku ji maganar Ubangiji, ku Isra’ilawa, gama Ubangiji yana da tuhumar da zai kawo a kan ku waɗanda suke zama a ƙasar. “Babu aminci, babu ƙauna, babu yarda da Allah a cikin ƙasar.
english: Hear Yahweh’s word, you children of Israel, for Yahweh has a charge against the inhabitants of the land: “Indeed there is no truth, nor goodness, nor knowledge of God in the land.

hausa: Gama ka halicci ciki-cikina; ka gina ni gaba ɗaya a cikin mahaifar mahaifiyata.
english: For you formed my inmost being. You knit me together in my mother’s womb.

hausa: To, fa, akwai wani tsohon annabi yana zama a Betel, wanda ’ya’yansa suka zo suka faɗa masa dukan abin da mutumin Allah ya yi a can, a ranar. Suka kuma faɗa wa mahaifinsu abin da ya faɗa wa sarki.
english: Now an old prophet lived in Bethel, and one of his sons came and told him all the works that the man of God had done that day in Bethel. They also told their father the words which he had spoken to the king.

hausa: inda ya zauna har sai da Hiridus ya mutu. Ta haka kuwa aka cika abin da Ubangiji ya faɗa ta bakin annabin cewa, “Daga Masar na kira ɗana.”
english: and was there until the death of Herod, that it might be fulfilled which was spoken by the Lord through the prophet, saying, “Out of Egypt I called my son.”

hausa: na ce, “Ba zan zama makiyayinku ba. Bari masu mutuwa su mutu, masu hallaka kuma su hallaka. Bari waɗanda suka ragu su ci naman juna.”
english: Then I said, “I will not feed you. That which dies, let it die; and that which is to be cut off, let it be cut off; and let those who are left eat each other’s flesh.”

hausa: Mawaƙan nan Heman, Asaf da Etan, ne za su buga kugen tagulla.
english: So the singers, Heman, Asaph, and Ethan, were given cymbals of bronze to sound aloud;

hausa: Ga abin da Ubangiji yana cewa, “Game da dukan mugayen maƙwabtana waɗanda suka ƙwace gādon da na ba wa mutanena Isra’ila kuwa, zan tumɓuke su daga ƙasashensu zan kuma tumɓuke gidan Yahuda daga cikinsu.
english: Yahweh says, “Concerning all my evil neighbors, who touch the inheritance which I have caused my people Israel to inherit: Behold, I will pluck them up from off their land, and will pluck up the house of Judah from among them.

hausa: Duk wannan kuwa daga Allah ne, wanda ya sulhunta mu da kansa ta wurin Kiristi, ya kuma ba mu hidimar sulhu,
english: But all things are of God, who reconciled us to himself through Jesus Christ, and gave to us the ministry of reconciliation;

hausa: “Ka kintsa kanka! Ka tashi tsaye ka faɗa musu abin da na umarce ka. Kada su firgita ka, in ba haka ba zan firgita ka a gabansu.
english: “You therefore put your belt on your waist, arise, and say to them all that I command you. Don’t be dismayed at them, lest I dismay you before them.

hausa: Da ruwan inabi ya ƙare, sai mahaifiyar Yesu ta ce masa, “Ba su da sauran ruwan inabi.”
english: When the wine ran out, Jesus’ mother said to him, “They have no wine.”

hausa: A yanzun fa, akwai waɗansu da suka kasance a lokacin can, suka ba Yesu labarin Galiliyawa da Bilatus ya gauraye jininsu tare da jinin hadayunsu.
english: Now there were some present at the same time who told him about the Galileans whose blood Pilate had mixed with their sacrifices.

hausa: Ubangiji zai fita ya yi yaƙi kamar mai ƙarfi, kamar jarumi zai yi himma; da ihu zai tā da kirarin yaƙi zai kuma yi nasara a kan abokan gābansa.
english: Yahweh will go out like a mighty man. He will stir up zeal like a man of war. He will raise a war cry. Yes, he will shout aloud. He will triumph over his enemies.

hausa: Don mai bi da kaɗe-kaɗe. Ta ’Ya’yan Kora maza. Bisa ga alamot Waƙa ce. Allah ne mafakarmu da ƙarfinmu, kullum yana a shirye yă taimaka a lokacin wahala.
english: For the Chief Musician. By the sons of Korah. According to Alamoth. God is our refuge and strength, a very present help in trouble.

hausa: Yosiya fa, bai juya daga gare shi ba, amma ya ɓad da kama don yă yi yaƙin. Bai saurari abin da Neko ya faɗa bisa ga umarnin Allah ba, amma ya tafi ya yaƙe shi a filin Megiddo.
english: Nevertheless Josiah would not turn his face from him, but disguised himself, that he might fight with him, and didn’t listen to the words of Neco from the mouth of God, and came to fight in the valley of Megiddo.

hausa: Wannan shi ne na fari cikin abubuwan banmamakin da Yesu ya yi a Kana ta Galili. Ta haka ya bayyana ɗaukakarsa, almajiransa kuwa suka ba da gaskiya gare shi.
english: This beginning of his signs Jesus did in Cana of Galilee, and revealed his glory; and his disciples believed in him.

hausa: Saboda ku ci, ku sha a teburina a cikin mulkina. Kuma ku zauna a kan gadon sarauta, ku yi wa kabilu goma sha biyu na Isra’ila shari’a.
english: that you may eat and drink at my table in my Kingdom. You will sit on thrones, judging the twelve tribes of Israel.”

hausa: Sau bakwai zai yayyafa wa mutumin da za a tsabtacce daga cutar mai yaɗuwa ya kuma furta shi tsarkakakke. Sa’an nan ya saki tsuntsu mai rai ɗin ya tafi.
english: He shall sprinkle on him who is to be cleansed from the leprosy seven times, and shall pronounce him clean, and shall let the living bird go into the open field.

hausa: Fir’auna ya ji daɗin Hadad har ya ba shi ’yar’uwar matarsa, Sarauniya Tafenes, aure.
english: Hadad found great favor in the sight of Pharaoh, so that he gave him as wife the sister of his own wife, the sister of Tahpenes the queen.

hausa: Gaba ɗaya dai, Set ya yi shekaru 912, sa’an nan ya mutu.
english: All of the days of Seth were nine hundred twelve years, then he died.

hausa: ta Bezai 324
english: The children of Bezai: three hundred twenty-four.

hausa: A shekara ta talatin da shida ta mulkin Asa, Ba’asha sarkin Isra’ila ya haura don yă yaƙi Yahuda da Rama mai katanga, don kuma yă hana wani daga fita ko shiga yankin Asa sarkin Yahuda.
english: In the thirty-sixth year of Asa’s reign, Baasha king of Israel went up against Judah, and built Ramah, that he might not allow anyone to go out or come in to Asa king of Judah.

hausa: Waɗannan kabilu biyu da rabi, sun sami gādonsu a wancan hayin Urdun a gabashin Yeriko wajen fitowar rana.”
english: The two tribes and the half-tribe have received their inheritance beyond the Jordan at Jericho eastward, toward the sunrise.”

hausa: Ya ce, “Ku kawo mini su a nan.”
english: He said, “Bring them here to me.”

hausa: Ubangiji ya ce wa Musa, “Kada ka ji tsoronsa, gama na ba da shi a gare ka, da dukan sojojinsa da kuma ƙasarsa. Ka yi da shi yadda ka yi da Sihon sarkin Amoriyawa, wanda ya yi mulki a Heshbon.”
english: Yahweh said to Moses, “Don’t fear him, for I have delivered him into your hand, with all his people, and his land. You shall do to him as you did to Sihon king of the Amorites, who lived at Heshbon.”

hausa: Ya fafare su ya kuma yi tafiyarsa lafiya ƙalau, a hanyar da ƙafafunsa ba su taɓa bi ba.
english: He pursues them and passes by safely, even by a way that he had not gone with his feet.

hausa: Gama na lura kana cike da ɗacin rai kana kuma daure cikin zunubi.”
english: For I see that you are in the poison of bitterness and in the bondage of iniquity.”

hausa: Haruna yana da shekara ɗari da ashirin da uku, sa’ad da ya mutu a Dutsen Hor.
english: Aaron was one hundred twenty-three years old when he died in Mount Hor.

hausa: bari Ubangiji mai shari’ar mutane. Ka shari’anta ni Ya Ubangiji, bisa ga adalcina, bisa ga mutuncina, ya Mafi Ɗaukaka.
english: Yahweh administers judgment to the peoples. Judge me, Yahweh, according to my righteousness, and to my integrity that is in me.

hausa: Da Bitrus ya shiga gidan, Korneliyus ya sadu da shi ya kuma fāɗi a gabansa cikin bangirma.
english: When Peter entered, Cornelius met him, fell down at his feet, and worshiped him.

hausa: Waɗansu Yahudawa suka amince suka kuma bi Bulus da Sila, haka ma Hellenawa da yawa masu tsoron Allah da kuma manyan mata ba kaɗan ba.
english: Some of them were persuaded and joined Paul and Silas: of the devout Greeks a great multitude, and not a few of the chief women.

hausa: Ƙuri’a ta bakwai ta fāɗa a kan kabilar Dan, bisa ga iyalansu.
english: The seventh lot came out for the tribe of the children of Dan according to their families.

hausa: Saboda haka muka ci gaba, muka wuce ’yan’uwanmu, zuriyar Isuwa, wanda yake zama a Seyir. Muka bar hanyar Araba, wadda ta haura daga Elat da Eziyon Geber, muka nufi wajen hamadar Mowab.
english: So we passed by from our brothers, the children of Esau, who dwell in Seir, from the way of the Arabah from Elath and from Ezion Geber. We turned and passed by the way of the wilderness of Moab.

hausa: Asa ya yi abin da yake da kyau da kuma daidai a gaban Ubangiji Allahnsa.
english: Asa did that which was good and right in Yahweh his God’s eyes,

hausa: Suka kuma ɗauki dabbobinsu da mallakarsu, da suka samu a Kan’ana, Yaƙub kuwa da dukan zuriyarsa suka tafi Masar.
english: They took their livestock, and their goods, which they had gotten in the land of Canaan, and came into Egypt—Jacob, and all his offspring with him,

hausa: Gama waɗansu bābānni ne domin haka aka haife su; waɗansu kuwa mutane ne suka mai da su haka; waɗansu kuma sun ƙi aure ne saboda mulkin sama. Duk mai iya ɗaukar wannan yă ɗauka.”
english: For there are eunuchs who were born that way from their mother’s womb, and there are eunuchs who were made eunuchs by men; and there are eunuchs who made themselves eunuchs for the Kingdom of Heaven’s sake. He who is able to receive it, let him receive it.”

hausa: Girmankai da fariya, su ne fitilar mugaye, wannan kuwa zunubi ne!
english: A high look and a proud heart, the lamp of the wicked, is sin.

hausa: sai ya ce wa fadawansa, “Wannan Yohanna Mai Baftisma ne; ya tashi daga matattu! Shi ya sa abubuwan banmamakin nan suke faruwa ta wurinsa.”
english: and said to his servants, “This is John the Baptizer. He is risen from the dead. That is why these powers work in him.”

hausa: Amma Ubangiji ya nuna musu alheri, ya ji tausayinsu, ya kuma damu da su saboda alkawarinsa da Ibrahim, Ishaku da Yaƙub. Har yă zuwa yau bai yarda yă hallaka su ko yă shafe su daga gabansa ba.
english: But Yahweh was gracious to them, and had compassion on them, and favored them because of his covenant with Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob, and would not destroy them and he didn’t cast them from his presence as yet.

hausa: Isra’ilawa suka sāke yin mugayen ayyuka a gaban Ubangiji, sai ya ba da su ga Midiyawa shekara bakwai.
english: The children of Israel did that which was evil in Yahweh’s sight, so Yahweh delivered them into the hand of Midian seven years.

hausa: Da Sarki Dawuda ya ji dukan abin da ya faru, sai ya husata ƙwarai.
english: But when King David heard of all these things, he was very angry.

hausa: Dukan duniya ta nemi su zo wurin Solomon don su ji hikimar da Allah ya sa a zuciyarsa.
english: All the earth sought the presence of Solomon to hear his wisdom which God had put in his heart.

hausa: Abiya da mutanensa suka kashe su sosai, har mutum dubu ɗari biyar suka mutu a cikin jarumawan Isra’ila.
english: Abijah and his people killed them with a great slaughter, so five hundred thousand chosen men of Israel fell down slain.

hausa: Ya naɗa sha biyu, ya kira su manzanni don su kasance tare da shi, domin kuma yă aike su yin wa’azi,
english: He appointed twelve, that they might be with him, and that he might send them out to preach

hausa: Sarakunan nan huɗu suka washe dukan kayayyakin Sodom da Gomorra, da kuma dukan abincinsu, sa’an nan suka tafi.
english: They took all the goods of Sodom and Gomorrah, and all their food, and went their way.

hausa: Daga ƙuruciyarmu allolin kunya sun cinye mu amfanin wahalar kakanninmu garkunan tumakinsu da na awakinsu, yaransu maza da mata.
english: But the shameful thing has devoured the labor of our fathers from our youth, their flocks and their herds, their sons and their daughters.

hausa: Idon da ya gan shi ba zai ƙara ganinsa ba; wurin zamansa ba zai sāke ganinsa ba.
english: The eye which saw him will see him no more, neither will his place see him any more.

hausa: amma ba za a hukunta shi ba, in bawan ko baiwar ta tashi, bayan kwana ɗaya ko biyu, tun da bawan ko baiwar mallakarsa ne.
english: Notwithstanding, if his servant gets up after a day or two, he shall not be punished, for the servant is his property.

hausa: “ ‘Sa’ad mace take al’adarta ta ƙa’ida, rashin tsabtarta ta al’adar zai ɗauki kwana bakwai, kuma duk wanda ya taɓa ta, zai ƙazantu har yamma.
english: “‘If a woman has a discharge, and her discharge in her flesh is blood, she shall be in her impurity seven days. Whoever touches her shall be unclean until the evening.

hausa: Za ki zama abin dariya da abin ba’a, kashedi da abin banrazana ga al’ummai kewaye da ke sa’ad da na hukunta ki cikin fushi da cikin hasala da kuma tsawatawa mai zafi. Ni Ubangiji na faɗa.
english: So it will be a reproach and a taunt, an instruction and an astonishment, to the nations that are around you, when I execute judgments on you in anger and in wrath, and in wrathful rebukes—I, Yahweh, have spoken it—

hausa: Kuna cin kitsensu, kuna yi wa kanku tufafi da gashinsu, kukan yanka turkakkun, amma ba ku yi kiwon tumakin ba.
english: You eat the fat. You clothe yourself with the wool. You kill the fatlings, but you don’t feed the sheep.

hausa: Waɗansu mutanen Manasse suka haɗa kai da Dawuda sa’ad da ya tafi tare da Filistiyawa don yă yaƙi Shawulu (Shi da mutanensa ba su taimaki Filistiyawa ba domin bayan shawarwari, shugabanninsu suka salame shi. Sun ce, “Za mu biya da kawunanmu in ya koma ga maigidansa Shawulu.”)
english: Some of Manasseh also joined David when he came with the Philistines against Saul to battle, but they didn’t help them, for the lords of the Philistines sent him away after consultation, saying, “He will desert to his master Saul to the jeopardy of our heads.”

hausa: “Ranaku suna zuwa, in ji Ubangiji, “sa’ad da mai huɗa zai sha gaban mai girbi mai shuki kuma yă bi bayan mai matsin inabi. Sabon ruwan inabi zai ɗiga daga duwatsu yă kuma kwararo daga tuddai.
english: “Behold, the days come,” says Yahweh, “that the plowman shall overtake the reaper, and the one treading grapes him who sows seed; and sweet wine will drip from the mountains, and flow from the hills.

hausa: Sai wani ya tambaye shi ya ce, “Ya Ubangiji, shin, wai mutane kima ne kawai za su sami ceto?” Ya ce musu,
english: One said to him, “Lord, are they few who are saved?” He said to them,

hausa: Sai Ezra ya buɗe littafin. Dukan mutane kuwa suka gan shi domin yana tsaye a bisa fiye da inda mutane suke tsaye; yayinda ya buɗe littafin kuwa, dukan mutane suka miƙe tsaye.
english: Ezra opened the book in the sight of all the people (for he was above all the people), and when he opened it, all the people stood up.

hausa: Da zarar kun shiga garin, za ku same shi kafin yă tafi cin abinci a wurin yin sadakar, can kan tudu. Gama jama’a ba za su ci ba, sai ya kai can ya sa albarka a sadakar, sa’an nan waɗanda aka gayyata su ci. Ku haura da sauri, za ku same.”
english: As soon as you have come into the city, you will immediately find him before he goes up to the high place to eat; for the people will not eat until he comes, because he blesses the sacrifice. Afterwards those who are invited eat. Now therefore go up; for at this time you will find him.”

hausa: Ya Ubangiji, ka buɗe leɓunana, bakina kuwa zai furta yabonka.
english: Lord, open my lips. My mouth will declare your praise.

hausa: Yaya za ka ƙi hafsan mafi ƙanƙanci na hafsoshin maigidana, ko da yake kana dogara ga Masar don kekunan yaƙi da mahayan dawakai?
english: How then can you turn away the face of one captain of the least of my master’s servants, and put your trust in Egypt for chariots and for horsemen?

hausa: “Har wa yau dai, mulkin sama yana kama da ɗan kasuwa mai neman lu’ulu’ai masu kyau.
english: “Again, the Kingdom of Heaven is like a man who is a merchant seeking fine pearls,

hausa: Gama bai rena ko yă ƙyale wahalar masu shan wuya ba; bai ɓoye fuskarsa daga gare shi ba amma ya saurari kukansa na neman taimako.
english: For he has not despised nor abhorred the affliction of the afflicted, neither has he hidden his face from him; but when he cried to him, he heard.

hausa: Wane ne a cikinku ta wurin damuwarsa, zai iya ƙara ko sa’a ɗaya ga rayuwarsa?
english: Which of you by being anxious can add a cubit to his height?

hausa: Da Yesu ya sauka ya kuma ga taro mai yawa, sai ya ji tausayinsu ya kuma warkar da marasa lafiyarsu.
english: Jesus went out, and he saw a great multitude. He had compassion on them and healed their sick.

hausa: Saboda haka Ubangiji kansa zai ba ku alama. Ga shi budurwa za tă yi ciki, za tă haifi ɗa, za tă kuwa kira shi Immanuwel.
english: Therefore the Lord himself will give you a sign. Behold, the virgin will conceive, and bear a son, and shall call his name Immanuel.

hausa: Sai mutumin ya ce, “Cabɗi, yau ga abin mamaki! Ba ku san inda ya fito ba, ga shi kuwa ya buɗe idanuna.
english: The man answered them, “How amazing! You don’t know where he comes from, yet he opened my eyes.

hausa: Gama Ubangiji yana da kyau kuma ƙaunarsa madawwamiya ce har abada; amincinsa na cin gaba a dukan zamanai.
english: For Yahweh is good. His loving kindness endures forever, his faithfulness to all generations.

hausa: “An ɗaukaka Allah cikin ikonsa. Wane ne malami kamar sa?
english: Behold, God is exalted in his power. Who is a teacher like him?

hausa: Zai yi kira gare ni yă ce, ‘Kai ne Mahaifina, Allahna, Dutse mai cetona.’
english: He will call to me, ‘You are my Father, my God, and the rock of my salvation!’

hausa: Sai Ishaya annabi ya tafi wurin Sarki Hezekiya ya kuma tambaye shi ya ce, “Mene ne waɗannan mutane suka faɗa, kuma daga ina suka fito?” Hezekiya ya amsa ya ce, “Daga ƙasa mai nisa. Sun zo ne daga Babilon.”
english: Then Isaiah the prophet came to King Hezekiah, and asked him, “What did these men say? From where did they come to you?” Hezekiah said, “They have come from a country far from me, even from Babylon.”

hausa: Saboda haka, kamar yadda sakamakon laifin mutum guda ya jawo hallaka ga dukan mutane, haka ma sakamakon aikin adalci guda ya sa Allah ya same mu marasa laifi, wannan kuwa kawo rai ga dukan mutane.
english: So then as through one trespass, all men were condemned; even so through one act of righteousness, all men were justified to life.

hausa: Sa’ad da mutane suka ga wannan, sai suka rusuna, suka sunkuyar da kai suka ce, “Ubangiji, shi ne Allah! Ubangiji, shi ne Allah!”
english: When all the people saw it, they fell on their faces. They said, “Yahweh, he is God! Yahweh, he is God!”

hausa: Suka kuma naɗa firistoci a gundumominsu da kuma Lawiyawa a ƙungiyoyinsu don hidimar Allah a Urushalima, bisa ga abin da aka rubuta a Littafin Musa.
english: They set the priests in their divisions and the Levites in their courses, for the service of God which is at Jerusalem, as it is written in the book of Moses.

hausa: Ni kaina zan lura da tumakina in kuma sa su kwanta, in ji Ubangiji Mai Iko Duka.
english: I myself will be the shepherd of my sheep, and I will cause them to lie down,” says the Lord Yahweh.

hausa: Za a kuma bayyana ɗaukakar Ubangiji, dukan mutane kuwa za su gan ta. Gama Ubangiji da kansa ne ya yi magana.”
english: Yahweh’s glory shall be revealed, and all flesh shall see it together; for the mouth of Yahweh has spoken it.”

hausa: A Horeb suka yi ɗan maraƙi suka yi wa gunkin zubi daga ƙarfe sujada.
english: They made a calf in Horeb, and worshiped a molten image.

hausa: Mugayen mutane sukan kuta tawaye da Allah; za a aika manzo mutuwa a kansu.
english: An evil man seeks only rebellion; therefore a cruel messenger shall be sent against him.

hausa: Mugaye za su koma kabari, dukan al’umman da suka manta da Allah.
english: The wicked shall be turned back to Sheol, even all the nations that forget God.

hausa: Kai ne kake aika walƙiya da tsawa zuwa inda suke zuwa? Ko suna zuwa wurinka su ce, ‘Ga mu nan mun zo?’
english: Can you send out lightnings, that they may go? Do they report to you, ‘Here we are’?

hausa: Edom, Mowab da Ammon;
english: Edom, Moab, and the children of Ammon;

hausa: Musa kuwa ya ce masa, “In ba za tă tafi tare da mu ba, to, kada ka ɗaga mu daga nan.
english: Moses said to him, “If your presence doesn’t go with me, don’t carry us up from here.

hausa: Matalauta za su ci su ƙoshi; su da suke neman Ubangiji za su yabe shi, bari zukatanku su rayu har abada!
english: The humble shall eat and be satisfied. They shall praise Yahweh who seek after him. Let your hearts live forever.

hausa: Amma Yoshuwa ya bar Rahab karuwan nan bai kashe ta ba, ita da iyalinta da duk abin da yake nata, domin ita ta ɓoye mutanen da Yoshuwa ya aika Yeriko don su leƙo asirin ƙasar kuma ta zauna tare da Isra’ilawa har wa yau.
english: But Rahab the prostitute, her father’s household, and all that she had, Joshua saved alive. She lives in the middle of Israel to this day, because she hid the messengers whom Joshua sent to spy out Jericho.

hausa: sarkin Makkeda, ɗaya sarkin Betel, ɗaya
english: the king of Makkedah, one; the king of Bethel, one;

hausa: Sai na yi tambaya na ce, “Mene ne waɗannan ranka yă daɗe?” Mala’ikan da yake magana da ni ya amsa ya ce, “Zan nuna maka mene ne su.”
english: Then I asked, ‘My lord, what are these?’” The angel who talked with me said to me, “I will show you what these are.”

hausa: bai kuwa nemi nufin Ubangiji ba. Saboda haka Ubangiji ya kashe shi, ya miƙa mulkin ga Dawuda ɗan Yesse.
english: and didn’t inquire of Yahweh. Therefore he killed him, and turned the kingdom over to David the son of Jesse.

hausa: “Mutum yana iya zama da amfani a wurin Allah? Mai hikima ma zai iya zama da amfani a wurin shi?
english: “Can a man be profitable to God? Surely he who is wise is profitable to himself.

hausa: Duk da haka Allah ya same ni da laifi; ya ɗauke ni maƙiyinsa,
english: Behold, he finds occasions against me. He counts me for his enemy.

hausa: domin an buɗe mini wata hanya mai fāɗi don aiki mai amfani, ko da yake akwai mutane da yawa masu gāba da ni.
english: for a great and effective door has opened to me, and there are many adversaries.

hausa: Ada ta haifi Yabal, shi ne mahaifi waɗanda suke zama a tentuna, suna kuma kiwon dabbobi.
english: Adah gave birth to Jabal, who was the father of those who dwell in tents and have livestock.

hausa: Saboda haka Fir’auna ya tambaye su, “Za mu iya samun wani kamar wannan mutum, wannan wanda Ruhun Allah yake cikinsa?”
english: Pharaoh said to his servants, “Can we find such a one as this, a man in whom is the Spirit of God?”

hausa: Irin koyarwan nan tana zuwa ne daga waɗansu munafukai maƙaryata, waɗanda aka yi wa lamirinsu kaca-kaca.
english: through the hypocrisy of men who speak lies, branded in their own conscience as with a hot iron,

hausa: tare da yadda mulkinsa da ikonsa da yanayin da suka kewaye shi da Isra’ila da kuma dukan masarautai na dukan sauran ƙasashe.
english: with all his reign and his might, and the events that involved him, Israel, and all the kingdoms of the lands.

hausa: suka shimfiɗa waɗannan a kan ƙirjin, sa’an nan Haruna ya ƙone kitsen a kan bagade.
english: and they put the fat upon the breasts, and he burned the fat on the altar.

hausa: Don me yanzu kike kuka da ƙarfi, ba ki da sarki ne? Masu shawararki sun hallaka ne, da zafi ya cika ki kamar mace mai naƙuda?
english: Now why do you cry out aloud? Is there no king in you? Has your counselor perished, that pains have taken hold of you as of a woman in travail?

hausa: Ƙasa kuwa ta buɗe ta haɗiye su tare da Kora, wanda ƙungiyarsa ta mutu sa’ad da wuta ta cinye mutum 250. Wannan kuwa ya zama alamar faɗakarwa.
english: and the earth opened its mouth, and swallowed them up together with Korah when that company died; at the time the fire devoured two hundred fifty men, and they became a sign.

hausa: Suka kawar da bagadai a Urushalima suka fid da bagadan turare suka zubar da su a Kwarin Kidron.
english: They arose and took away the altars that were in Jerusalem, and they took away all the altars for incense and threw them into the brook Kidron.

hausa: Kowannensu ya jefa sandansa ƙasa, ya kuwa zama maciji. Amma sandan Haruna ya haɗiye sandunansu.
english: For they each cast down their rods, and they became serpents; but Aaron’s rod swallowed up their rods.

hausa: Ubangiji ya kawo muku barci mai nauyi, Ya rufe idanunku (annabawa); ya rufe kawunanku (masu duba).
english: For Yahweh has poured out on you a spirit of deep sleep, and has closed your eyes, the prophets; and he has covered your heads, the seers.

hausa: Ka faɗa musu cewa ga abin da Ubangiji, Allah na Isra’ila yana cewa, ‘La’ananne ne wanda bai kula da zancen alkawarin nan ba,
english: and say to them, Yahweh, the God of Israel says: ‘Cursed is the man who doesn’t hear the words of this covenant,

hausa: Ba da takobinsu ba ne suka ci ƙasar, ba kuwa ƙarfin hannunsu ne ya ba su nasara ba; hannun damanka ne, ƙarfin hannunka, da kuma hasken fuskarka, gama ka ƙaunace su.
english: For they didn’t get the land in possession by their own sword, neither did their own arm save them; but your right hand, your arm, and the light of your face, because you were favorable to them.

hausa: A kwanaki masu zuwa za a kafa dutsen haikalin Ubangiji a matsayin babba cikin duwatsu; za a daga shi bisa tuddai, kuma dukan al’ummai za su bumbunto zuwa gare shi.
english: It shall happen in the latter days, that the mountain of Yahweh’s house shall be established on the top of the mountains, and shall be raised above the hills; and all nations shall flow to it.

hausa: Sukan ruga cikin birni, suna gudu a kan katanga. Sukan hau gidaje, sukan shiga ta tagogi kamar ɓarayi.
english: They rush on the city. They run on the wall. They climb up into the houses. They enter in at the windows like thieves.

hausa: Abokaina da maƙwabtana sun guje ni saboda miyakuna; maƙwabtana ba sa zuwa kusa.
english: My lovers and my friends stand aloof from my plague. My kinsmen stand far away.

hausa: Rabin katakon yakan ƙone a wuta; a kansa yakan dafa abincinsa, yă gasa namansa yă kuma ci sai ya ƙoshi. Yakan ji ɗumi yă kuma ce, “Aha! Na ji ɗumi; na gan wutar.”
english: He burns part of it in the fire. With part of it, he eats meat. He roasts a roast and is satisfied. Yes, he warms himself and says, “Aha! I am warm. I have seen the fire.”

hausa: Yesse ya sa ’ya’yansa maza bakwai suka wuce gaban Sama’ila, amma Sama’ila ya ce masa, “Ubangiji bai zaɓi waɗannan ba.”
english: Jesse made seven of his sons to pass before Samuel. Samuel said to Jesse, “Yahweh has not chosen these.”

hausa: Bunsurun kuwa ya ƙasaita, amma a ƙwanƙolin ikonsa sai aka karye babban ƙahonsa, kuma a wurin da ƙahon nan ya kasance waɗansu sanannun ƙahoni huɗu suka tsiro suna fuskantar kusurwoyin nan huɗu.
english: The male goat magnified himself exceedingly. When he was strong, the great horn was broken; and instead of it there came up four notable horns toward the four winds of the sky.

hausa: “Yanzu fa, bari Fir’auna yă nemi mutum mai basira da kuma hikima, yă sa shi yă shugabanci ƙasar Masar.
english: “Now therefore let Pharaoh look for a discreet and wise man, and set him over the land of Egypt.

hausa: Sai mutanen birnin suka amsa, “Ba mu wuri! Wannan mutum ya zo nan kamar baƙo, ga shi yanzu yana so yă zama alƙali! Za mu wulaƙanta ka fiye da su.” Suka ci gaba da matsa wa Lot lamba, suka matsa kusa domin su fasa ƙofar.
english: They said, “Stand back!” Then they said, “This one fellow came in to live as a foreigner, and he appoints himself a judge. Now we will deal worse with you than with them!” They pressed hard on the man Lot, and came near to break the door.

hausa: Suka yi tangaɗi suna tuntuɓe kamar bugaggu; suka kuma kai ga ƙarshen dabararsu.
english: They reel back and forth, and stagger like a drunken man, and are at their wits’ end.

hausa: Kamar yadda zafi da fări suke shanye ƙanƙarar da ta narke, haka kabari zai ƙwace waɗanda suka yi zunubi.
english: Drought and heat consume the snow waters, so does Sheol those who have sinned.

hausa: Rundunarka za su so yin yaƙi a ranarka ta yaƙi. Saye cikin ɗaukaka mai tsarki, daga cikin ciki na safiya za ka karɓi raɓar ƙuruciyarka.
english: Your people offer themselves willingly in the day of your power, in holy array. Out of the womb of the morning, you have the dew of your youth.

hausa: “Na ji abin da annabawa suna cewa su da suke annabcin ƙarya a sunana. Suna cewa, ‘Na yi mafarki! Na yi mafarki!’
english: “I have heard what the prophets have said, who prophesy lies in my name, saying, ‘I had a dream! I had a dream!’

hausa: Amma Ubangiji ya ce wa Ahiya, “Matar Yerobowam tana zuwa tă tambaye ka game da ɗanta, gama yana ciwo, za ka kuwa ba ta amsa kaza da kaza. Sa’ad da ta iso za tă yi kamar wata ce dabam.”
english: Yahweh said to Ahijah, “Behold, Jeroboam’s wife is coming to inquire of you concerning her son, for he is sick. Tell her such and such; for it will be, when she comes in, that she will pretend to be another woman.”

hausa: Kada ka bar abin da ka ɗauka a matsayi kyakkyawa yă zama abin zargi ga waɗansu.
english: Then don’t let your good be slandered,

hausa: kamar yadda yake a rubuce cewa, “Allah ya ba su ruhun ruɗewa, idanu don su kāsa gani, da kuma kunnuwa don su kāsa ji, har yă zuwa yau.”
english: According as it is written, “God gave them a spirit of stupor, eyes that they should not see, and ears that they should not hear, to this very day.”

hausa: Dole kowannenku yă kawo kyauta daidai yadda Ubangiji Allahnku ya albarkace shi.
english: Every man shall give as he is able, according to Yahweh your God’s blessing which he has given you.

hausa: “Ɗan mutum, mene ne wannan karin magana da kuke da shi a ƙasar Isra’ila mai cewa, ‘Kwanaki suna ta wucewa, wahayi bai gudana ba’?
english: “Son of man, what is this proverb that you have in the land of Israel, saying, ‘The days are prolonged, and every vision fails’?

hausa: ’Ya’yan sarautar Issakar suna tare da Debora; I, Issakar yana tare da Barak, yana binsa a guje zuwa kwari. A yankunan Ruben aka kuma bincike zuciya sosai.
english: The princes of Issachar were with Deborah. As was Issachar, so was Barak. They rushed into the valley at his feet. By the watercourses of Reuben, there were great resolves of heart.

hausa: da ’yan’uwansa, Shemahiya, Azarel, Milalai, Gilalai, Ma’ai, Netanel, Yahuda da Hanani, tare da kayan kiɗi da Dawuda mutumin Allah ya umarta. Ezra malamin Doka ya jagoranci jerin gwanon.
english: and his brothers, Shemaiah, Azarel, Milalai, Gilalai, Maai, Nethanel, Judah, and Hanani, with the musical instruments of David the man of God; and Ezra the scribe was before them.

hausa: Amma in ba ku yi biyayya ga Ubangiji ba, in kuma kuka ƙi bin umarnansa, fushinsa zai zauna a kanku.
english: But if you will not listen to Yahweh’s voice, but rebel against the commandment of Yahweh, then Yahweh’s hand will be against you, as it was against your fathers.

hausa: Yowab ya rusuna har ƙasa don bangirma, ya kuma yi wa sarki kyakkyawar fata. Yowab ya ce, “Yau, bawanka ya sani ya sami tagomashi a gare ka, ranka yă daɗe sarki, gama sarki ya ji roƙon bawansa.”
english: Joab fell to the ground on his face, showed respect, and blessed the king. Joab said, “Today your servant knows that I have found favor in your sight, my lord, O king, in that the king has performed the request of his servant.”

hausa: Amma in ba haka ba, bari wuta ta fito daga Abimelek ya cinye ku, ’yan ƙasar Shekem da Bet Millo, bari wuta kuma daga wurinku ’yan ƙasar Shekem da Bet Millo ta cinye Abimelek!”
english: but if not, let fire come out from Abimelech and devour the men of Shechem and the house of Millo; and let fire come out from the men of Shechem and from the house of Millo and devour Abimelech.”

hausa: Sa’an nan za ki duba ki kuma haskaka zuciyarki zai motsa ya kuma cika da farin ciki; za a kawo miki wadata daga tekuna, za a kawo miki arzikin al’ummai.
english: Then you shall see and be radiant, and your heart will thrill and be enlarged; because the abundance of the sea will be turned to you. The wealth of the nations will come to you.

hausa: Gama ga abin da Ubangiji yana cewa game da Shallum ɗan Yosiya, wanda ya gāji mahaifinsa a matsayin sarkin Yahuda amma bai bar wurin nan ba, “Ba zai ƙara dawowa ba.
english: For Yahweh says touching Shallum the son of Josiah, king of Judah, who reigned instead of Josiah his father, and who went out of this place: “He won’t return there any more.

hausa: Sai Elisha ya ce, “Ku ji maganar Ubangiji. Ga abin da Ubangiji ya ce, gobe war haka, za a sayar da mudun gari mai laushi a farashin shekel guda, mudu biyu na sha’ir kuma a shekel ɗaya a ƙofar birnin Samariya.”
english: Elisha said, “Hear Yahweh’s word. Yahweh says, ‘Tomorrow about this time a seah of fine flour will be sold for a shekel, and two seahs of barley for a shekel, in the gate of Samaria.’”

hausa: “Yi wa Isra’ilawa magana, ka ce musu, ‘Sa’ad da kuka shiga ƙasar da zan ba ku, dole ƙasar kanta ta kiyaye Asabbaci ga Ubangiji.
english: “Speak to the children of Israel, and tell them, ‘When you come into the land which I give you, then the land shall keep a Sabbath to Yahweh.

english: The sons of Kohath: Amram, Izhar, Hebron, and Uzziel, four.

hausa: Shi da yake tafiya tare da masu hikima yakan ƙaru da hikima, amma abokin wawaye zai yi fama da lahani.
english: One who walks with wise men grows wise, but a companion of fools suffers harm.

english: Out of the tribe of Asher, Mishal with its pasture lands, Abdon with its pasture lands,

english: “If now you have understanding, hear this. Listen to the voice of my words.

english: He was buried in his tomb in the garden of Uzza, and Josiah his son reigned in his place.

english: They lived from Havilah to Shur that is before Egypt, as you go toward Assyria. He lived opposite all his relatives.

english: You shall make proclamation on the same day that there shall be a holy convocation to you. You shall do no regular work. This is a statute forever in all your dwellings throughout your generations.

english: While they were greatly perplexed about this, behold, two men stood by them in dazzling clothing.

english: I fast twice a week. I give tithes of all that I get.’

english: Go to them of the captivity, to the children of your people, and speak to them, and tell them, ‘This is what the Lord Yahweh says,’ whether they will hear, or whether they will refuse.”

english: He took it into his hands, and went on, eating as he went. He came to his father and mother and gave to them, and they ate, but he didn’t tell them that he had taken the honey out of the lion’s body.

english: how he met you by the way, and struck the rearmost of you, all who were feeble behind you, when you were faint and weary; and he didn’t fear God.

english: The whole law and the prophets depend on these two commandments.”

english: The Pharisees, who were lovers of money, also heard all these things, and they scoffed at him.

english: They will eat, and not have enough. They will play the prostitute, and will not increase; because they have abandoned listening to Yahweh.

english: These are those who were counted of the children of Israel by their fathers’ houses. All who were counted of the camps according to their armies were six hundred three thousand five hundred fifty.

english: The second day after he had killed Gedaliah, and no man knew it,

english: “Take again another scroll, and write in it all the former words that were in the first scroll, which Jehoiakim the king of Judah has burned.

hausa: Saboda haka ba wani daga cikin itatuwan da suke kusa da ruwan da zai taɓa yin fariyar tsawonsa, har kawunansu su kai cikin gizagizai. Ba wani daga cikin itatuwan da ya sha ruwa sosai da zai taɓa yi wannan tsayi; duk an bashe su ga mutuwa, zuwa can ƙasa, a cikin matattu, tare da waɗanda suka gangara zuwa rami.
english: to the end that none of all the trees by the waters exalt themselves in their stature, and don’t set their top among the thick boughs. Their mighty ones don’t stand up on their height, even all who drink water; for they are all delivered to death, to the lower parts of the earth, among the children of men, with those who go down to the pit.’

hausa: Ya Ubangiji na sani, cewa dokokinka masu adalci ne, kuma cikin aminci ka hore ni.
english: Yahweh, I know that your judgments are righteous, that in faithfulness you have afflicted me.

hausa: Maza, ku ƙaunaci matanku kada ku nuna musu hali marar tausayi.
english: Husbands, love your wives, and don’t be bitter against them.

hausa: Na yi magana sau ɗaya amma ba ni da amsa, sau biyu, amma ba zan ƙara cewa kome ba.”
english: I have spoken once, and I will not answer; Yes, twice, but I will proceed no further.”

hausa: kamar yadda Ɗan Mutum bai zo don a bauta masa ba, sai dai don yă yi bauta, yă kuma ba da ransa fansa saboda mutane da yawa.”
english: even as the Son of Man came not to be served, but to serve, and to give his life as a ransom for many.”

hausa: Wataƙila abin da ya sa aka raba ka da shi na ɗan lokaci ƙanƙani shi ne don ka same shi da amfani
english: For perhaps he was therefore separated from you for a while that you would have him forever,

hausa: Kada a faɗe shi a Gat; kada ma a yi kuka. A maimako haka, a yi birgima a cikin ƙura a Bet-Leyafra.
english: Don’t tell it in Gath. Don’t weep at all. At Beth Ophrah I have rolled myself in the dust.

hausa: Domin kun ƙone turare kuka kuma yi wa Ubangiji zunubi ba ku kuma yi masa biyayya ko ku kiyaye dokarsa ko ƙa’idodinsa ko farillansa ba, wannan masifa ta aukar muku, yadda yanzu kuka gani.”
english: Because you have burned incense and because you have sinned against Yahweh, and have not obeyed Yahweh’s voice, nor walked in his law, nor in his statutes, nor in his testimonies; therefore this evil has happened to you, as it is today.”

hausa: Yaron kuwa ya yi girma ya yi ƙarfi; ya cika da hikima, alherin Allah kuwa yana bisansa.
english: The child was growing, and was becoming strong in spirit, being filled with wisdom, and the grace of God was upon him.

hausa: Mutane da yawa kuma da al’ummai masu ƙarfi za su zo Urushalima su nemi Ubangiji Maɗaukaki su kuma roƙe shi.”
english: Yes, many peoples and strong nations will come to seek Yahweh of Armies in Jerusalem and to entreat the favor of Yahweh.”

hausa: “Ka ɗaukar wa Isra’ilawa fansa, a kan Midiyawa. Bayan wannan za ka mutu, a kuwa tara ka ga mutanenka.”
english: “Avenge the children of Israel on the Midianites. Afterward you shall be gathered to your people.”

hausa: Sa’an nan Ubangiji ya ce, “Sa hannunka cikin rigarka.” Sai Musa ya sa hannunsa cikin rigarsa, sa’ad da ya fitar da shi, sai hannun ya a kuturce fari fat, kamar ƙanƙara.
english: Yahweh said furthermore to him, “Now put your hand inside your cloak.” He put his hand inside his cloak, and when he took it out, behold, his hand was leprous, as white as snow.

hausa: Ku warkar da marasa lafiya da suke wurin. Ku kuma faɗa musu cewa, ‘Mulkin Allah yana kusa da ku.’
english: Heal the sick who are there and tell them, ‘God’s Kingdom has come near to you.’

hausa: Amma yanzu, don me za mu mutu? Wannan wuta mai girma za tă cinye mu, za mu kuwa mutu in muka ci gaba da jin muryar Ubangiji Allahnmu.
english: Now therefore, why should we die? For this great fire will consume us. If we hear Yahweh our God’s voice any more, then we shall die.

hausa: Mutum mai abokai masu yawa kan lalace, amma akwai abokin da yakan manne kurkusa fiye da ɗan’uwa.
english: A man of many companions may be ruined, but there is a friend who sticks closer than a brother.

hausa: Ba na faɗin haka domin ina cikin bukata, gama na koya yadda zan gamsu a cikin kowane hali.
english: Not that I speak because of lack, for I have learned in whatever state I am, to be content in it.

hausa: Zai zama alama da kuma shaida ga Ubangiji Maɗaukaki a ƙasar Masar. Sa’ad da suka yi kuka ga Ubangiji saboda masu zaluntarsu, zai aiko musu mai ceto da mai kāriya, zai kuma cece su.
english: It will be for a sign and for a witness to Yahweh of Armies in the land of Egypt; for they will cry to Yahweh because of oppressors, and he will send them a savior and a defender, and he will deliver them.

hausa: “Masu fashi za su fāɗa wa Gad, amma zai runtume su.
english: “A troop will press on Gad, but he will press on their heel.

hausa: Yehohiyada firist ya fito da shugabanni waɗanda suke shugabancin rundunar sojoji, ya ce musu, “Ku fitar da ita tsakanin sojoji ku kuma kashe duk wanda ya bi ta da takobi.” Gama firist ya ce, “Kada ku kashe ta a haikalin Ubangiji.”
english: Jehoiada the priest brought out the captains of hundreds who were set over the army, and said to them, “Bring her out between the ranks; and whoever follows her, let him be slain with the sword.” For the priest said, “Don’t kill her in Yahweh’s house.”

hausa: Amma mutane ɗari shida suka juya suka tsere wajajen hamada zuwa dutsen Rimmon, inda suka zauna wata huɗu.
english: But six hundred men turned and fled toward the wilderness to the rock of Rimmon, and stayed in the rock of Rimmon four months.

hausa: Yayinda suke cikin farin ciki, sai suka yi ihu, suka ce, “Fito mana da Samson yă yi mana wasa.” Saboda haka aka zo da Samson daga kurkuku, shi kuwa ya yi wasa a gabansu. Sa’ad da suka tsai da shi a tsakanin ginshiƙai,
english: When their hearts were merry, they said, “Call for Samson, that he may entertain us.” They called for Samson out of the prison; and he performed before them. They set him between the pillars;

hausa: Allah Uban Ubangiji Yesu Kiristi, wanda yabo ta tabbata a gare shi har abada, ya san cewa ba ƙarya nake yi ba.
english: The God and Father of the Lord Jesus Christ, he who is blessed forever more, knows that I don’t lie.

hausa: Makafi kawai! Wanne ya fi girma, bayarwar, ko kuwa bagaden da yake tsarkake bayarwar?
english: You blind fools! For which is greater, the gift, or the altar that sanctifies the gift?

hausa: Gama Yohanna Mai Baftisma ya zo, ba ya cin burodi, ba ya shan ruwan inabi, sai kuka ce, ‘Ai, yana da aljani.’
english: For John the Baptizer came neither eating bread nor drinking wine, and you say, ‘He has a demon.’

hausa: Waɗannnan abubuwa sun same su ne, domin su zama abubuwan koyi, aka kuma rubuta su domin a gargaɗe mu, mu da ƙarshen zamani ya zo mana.
english: Now all these things happened to them by way of example, and they were written for our admonition, on whom the ends of the ages have come.

hausa: Daga cikin gādon mutanen Yahuda ne aka fitar da gādon kabilar Simeyon, bisa ga iyalansu, domin rabon da kabilar Yahuda suka samu ya fi ƙarfin abin da suke bukata. Saboda haka kabilar gādon Simeyon yana cikin harabar Yahuda.
english: Out of the part of the children of Judah was the inheritance of the children of Simeon; for the portion of the children of Judah was too much for them. Therefore the children of Simeon had inheritance in the middle of their inheritance.

hausa: Shelemiya, Natan, Adahiya,
english: Shelemiah, Nathan, Adaiah,

hausa: Sa’ad da Allah ya sa na tashi daga gidan mahaifina na ce mata, ‘Wannan shi ne yadda za ki nuna mini ƙaunarki. Duk inda muka tafi, ki ce game da ni, “Shi ɗan’uwana ne.” ’ ”
english: When God caused me to wander from my father’s house, I said to her, ‘This is your kindness which you shall show to me. Everywhere that we go, say of me, “He is my brother.”’”

hausa: Amsa da take ta gaskiya tana kamar sumba a leɓuna.
english: An honest answer is like a kiss on the lips.

hausa: Wane ne kuma yake kamar da mutanenka Isra’ila, al’umma guda a duniya wadda Allah ya fita don yă kuɓutar wa kansa, ya kuma yi suna wa kansa, ya kuma aikata manyan abubuwa da kuma al’amuran banmamaki ta wurin korin al’ummai da allolinsu daga gaban mutanenka, waɗanda ka kuɓutar daga Masar?
english: What one nation on the earth is like your people, even like Israel, whom God went to redeem to himself for a people, and to make himself a name, and to do great things for you, and awesome things for your land, before your people, whom you redeemed to yourself out of Egypt, from the nations and their gods?

hausa: Ka zama mai hikima, ɗana, ka kuma faranta mini zuciya; zan iya amsa kowace irin suƙar da wani zai yi mini.
english: Be wise, my son, and bring joy to my heart, then I can answer my tormentor.

hausa: Dukan yini ina cikin wulaƙanci, fuskata kuma ta rufu da kunya
english: All day long my dishonor is before me, and shame covers my face,

hausa: Jaki yakan yi kuka sa’ad da ya sami ciyawar ci, ko saniya takan yi kuka in ta sami abincinta?
english: Does the wild donkey bray when he has grass? Or does the ox low over his fodder?

hausa: Sa’an nan Delila ta ce, “Har yanzu, ka mai da shashasha, kana mai da ni wawiya kana kuma yin mini ƙarya. Ka gaya mini yadda za a daure ka mana.” Ya ce mata, “In kin yi kitson gashin kaina guda bakwai kika ɗaura su da zare kika buga su da akwasha, zan rasa ƙarfi in zama kamar kowa.” Saboda haka yayinda yake barci, sai Delila ta yi kitson gashin kansa guda bakwai ta ɗinka su da zare,
english: Delilah said to Samson, “Until now, you have mocked me and told me lies. Tell me with what you might be bound.” He said to her, “If you weave the seven locks of my head with the fabric on the loom.”

hausa: Yesu ya amsa ya ce, “Kowa ya sha wannan ruwa, zai sāke jin ƙishirwa,
english: Jesus answered her, “Everyone who drinks of this water will thirst again,

hausa: Ya ƙara jira kwana bakwai, sai ya sāke aiken kurciyar, amma a wannan ƙaro ba tă komo wurinsa ba.
english: He waited yet another seven days, and sent out the dove; and she didn’t return to him any more.

hausa: Amma kai, mutumin Allah, ka guji duk wannan, ka kuma nemi adalci, tsoron Allah, bangaskiya, ƙauna, jimrewa da kuma hankali.
english: But you, man of God, flee these things, and follow after righteousness, godliness, faith, love, perseverance, and gentleness.

hausa: Da ya isa can, sai ya tarar da hafsoshin soji zaune a wuri guda. Sai ya ce, “Ina da saƙo dominka komanda.” Sai Yehu ya ce, “Wanne a cikinmu?” Sai ce, “Dominka, komanda.”
english: When he came, behold, the captains of the army were sitting. Then he said, “I have a message for you, captain.” Jehu said, “To which one of us?” He said, “To you, O captain.”

hausa: Saurara! Ƙaunataccena! Duba! Ga shi ya iso, yana tsalle a duwatsu, yana rawa a bisa tuddai.
english: The voice of my beloved! Behold, he comes, leaping on the mountains, skipping on the hills.

hausa: Da jin Yesu ya ƙure Sadukiyawa, sai Farisiyawa suka tattaru.
english: But the Pharisees, when they heard that he had silenced the Sadducees, gathered themselves together.

hausa: Yawan mutanen sashensa 59,300 ne.
english: His division, and those who were counted of them, were fifty-nine thousand three hundred.

hausa: Yabo ya tabbata ga Allah, da Uban Ubangijinmu Yesu Kiristi, Uba mai tausayi, da kuma Allah na dukan ta’aziyya,
english: Blessed be the God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, the Father of mercies and God of all comfort,

hausa: Sa’an nan Yehohiyada ya sa aikin lura da haikalin Ubangiji a hannuwan firistoci, waɗanda suke Lawiyawan da Dawuda ya ba su aikin haikali don su miƙa hadayun ƙonawa na Ubangiji kamar yadda yake a rubuce a Dokar Musa, da farin ciki da kuma rerawa, kamar yadda Dawuda ya umarta.
english: Jehoiada appointed the officers of Yahweh’s house under the hand of the Levitical priests, whom David had distributed in Yahweh’s house, to offer the burnt offerings of Yahweh, as it is written in the law of Moses, with rejoicing and with singing, as David had ordered.

hausa: Amma in ka koma birni, ka gaya wa Absalom, ‘Zan zama bawanka, ya sarki; dā ni bawan mahaifinka ne, amma yanzu zan zama bawanka,’ ta haka za ka watsar da shawarar Ahitofel.
english: but if you return to the city, and tell Absalom, ‘I will be your servant, O king. As I have been your father’s servant in time past, so I will now be your servant; then you will defeat for me the counsel of Ahithophel.’

hausa: “ ‘In shafaffen firist ya yi zunubi, ya jawo wa jama’a laifi, dole yă kawo wa Ubangiji ɗan bijimi marar lahani a matsayin hadaya don zunubi saboda zunubin da ya yi.
english: if the anointed priest sins so as to bring guilt on the people, then let him offer for his sin which he has sinned a young bull without defect to Yahweh for a sin offering.

hausa: Da a ce suna tunanin ƙasar da suka bari a baya, da sun riga sun sami damar komawa.
english: If indeed they had been thinking of that country from which they went out, they would have had enough time to return.

hausa: Saboda haka ’yan’uwa, sai ku yi haƙuri har dawowar Ubangiji. Ku dubi yadda manomi yakan jira gona ta ba da amfaninta mai kyau, da kuma yadda yake haƙurin jiran ruwan sama na damina da na kaka.
english: Be patient therefore, brothers, until the coming of the Lord. Behold, the farmer waits for the precious fruit of the earth, being patient over it, until it receives the early and late rain.

hausa: “Kun ce, ‘Ba amfani a bauta wa Allah. Wanda amfani muka samu ta wurin kiyaye umarnansa muna yawo kamar masu makoki a gaban Ubangiji Maɗaukaki?
english: You have said, ‘It is vain to serve God,’ and ‘What profit is it that we have followed his instructions and that we have walked mournfully before Yahweh of Armies?

hausa: Ishaku ya shuka hatsi a wannan ƙasa, a shekaran nan ya yi girbi ninki ɗari, domin Ubangiji ya albarkace shi.
english: Isaac sowed in that land, and reaped in the same year one hundred times what he planted. Yahweh blessed him.

hausa: Yi tafiyarka, ka ci abincinka da farin ciki, ka sha ruwan inabinka da farin zuciya, gama abin da ka yi duka daidai ne a wurin Allah.
english: Go your way—eat your bread with joy, and drink your wine with a merry heart; for God has already accepted your works.

hausa: Kasance da wawa kamar ɗa yakan kawo baƙin ciki babu farin ciki ga mahaifin wawa.
