english: He who becomes the father of a fool grieves. The father of a fool has no joy.

hausa: Amma Er, ɗan farin Yahuda mugu ne a fuskar Ubangiji, saboda haka Ubangiji ya kashe shi.
english: Er, Judah’s firstborn, was wicked in Yahweh’s sight. So Yahweh killed him.

hausa: Bari yă yi mulki a gaban Allah har abada; ka sa ƙaunarka da amincinka su tsare shi.
english: He shall be enthroned in God’s presence forever. Appoint your loving kindness and truth, that they may preserve him.

hausa: Sarki Yowash bai tuna da alherin da Yehohiyada mahaifin Zakariya ya nuna masa ba, sai ya kashe ɗansa, wanda ya ce yayinda yake mutuwa, “Bari Ubangiji yă dubi wannan yă kuma sāka maka.”
english: Thus Joash the king didn’t remember the kindness which Jehoiada his father had done to him, but killed his son. When he died, he said, “May Yahweh look at it, and repay it.”

hausa: Allah mai adalci ne, Zai sāka wa masu ba ku wahala da wahala
english: For it is a righteous thing with God to repay affliction to those who afflict you,

hausa: Sai Musa da Haruna suka tashi daga taron, suka tafi ƙofar Tentin Sujada, suka fāɗi rubda ciki, sai ɗaukakar Ubangiji ta bayyana musu.
english: Moses and Aaron went from the presence of the assembly to the door of the Tent of Meeting, and fell on their faces. Yahweh’s glory appeared to them.

hausa: Sai na yi tunani, “Zan yi roƙo saboda wannan, shekarun da Mafi Ɗaukaka ya miƙa hannunsa na dama.”
english: Then I thought, “I will appeal to this: the years of the right hand of the Most High.”

hausa: Wa zai goyi bayanku a kan wannan al’amari? Wanda ya tafi wurin yaƙi da wanda ya zauna wurin kaya, rabonsu zai zama daidai.”
english: Who will listen to you in this matter? For as his share is who goes down to the battle, so shall his share be who stays with the baggage. They shall share alike.”

hausa: suka ce, “Yi mana annabci, Kiristi. Wa ya buge ka?”
english: saying, “Prophesy to us, you Christ! Who hit you?”

hausa: Lokacin kisa da lokacin warkarwa, lokacin rushewa da lokacin ginawa.
english: a time to kill, and a time to heal; a time to break down, and a time to build up;

hausa: A ranar Yoshuwa ya sa Gibeyonawa suka zama masu yankan itace da ɗebo ruwa wa jama’ar Isra’ila da kuma domin haikalin Ubangiji a inda Ubangiji zai zaɓa. Abin da suke ke nan har wa yau.
english: That day Joshua made them wood cutters and drawers of water for the congregation and for Yahweh’s altar to this day, in the place which he should choose.

hausa: Amma halittun hamada za su kwanta a can, diloli za su cika gidajenta; a can mujiyoyi za su zauna, a can kuma awakin jeji za su yi ta tsalle.
english: But wild animals of the desert will lie there, and their houses will be full of jackals. Ostriches will dwell there, and wild goats will frolic there.

hausa: Sa’an nan ya ce musu, “Ku ƙazantar da haikalin ku kuma cika filayen da kisassu. Ku tafi!” Saboda haka suka fita suka kuma fara kisa a duk birnin.
english: He said to them, “Defile the house, and fill the courts with the slain. Go out!” They went out, and struck in the city.

hausa: Gama a kan dutsena mai tsarki, dutse mai tsayi na Isra’ila, in ji Ubangiji Mai Iko Duka, a can a ƙasar gidan Isra’ila gaba ɗaya za su bauta mini, a can kuwa zan karɓe su. A can zan bukaci hadayunku da sadake sadakenku mafi kyau, tare da dukan tsarkakan hadayunku.
english: For in my holy mountain, in the mountain of the height of Israel,” says the Lord Yahweh, “there all the house of Israel, all of them, shall serve me in the land. There I will accept them, and there I will require your offerings and the first fruits of your offerings, with all your holy things.

hausa: Ubangiji ya rantse wa Dawuda tabbataccen rantsuwa cewa ba zai janye ba cewa, “Ɗaya daga cikin zuriyarka zan sa a kan kursiyinka,
english: Yahweh has sworn to David in truth. He will not turn from it: “I will set the fruit of your body on your throne.

hausa: Sauran hadaya ta garin za tă zama ta Haruna da ’ya’yansa; sashe mafi tsarki ne na hadayun da aka yi ga Ubangiji ta wuta.
english: That which is left of the meal offering shall be Aaron’s and his sons’. It is a most holy part of the offerings of Yahweh made by fire.

hausa: Ina gaya muku, a daren nan, mutane biyu za su kasance a gado ɗaya, za a ɗauki ɗaya, a bar ɗayan.
english: I tell you, in that night there will be two people in one bed. One will be taken and the other will be left.

hausa: Ku yi iya ƙoƙarinku, in zai yiwu, ku yi zaman lafiya da kowa.
english: If it is possible, as much as it is up to you, be at peace with all men.

hausa: Waɗanda kuwa ya ƙaddara, su ne ya kira; waɗanda ya kira kuwa, su ne ya kuɓutar; waɗanda ya kuɓutar kuwa, su ne ya ɗaukaka.
english: Whom he predestined, those he also called. Whom he called, those he also justified. Whom he justified, those he also glorified.

hausa: Sarki ya mai da azurfa barkatai a cikin Urushalima kamar duwatsu, al’ul kuma da yawa kamar itatuwan fir na jumaiza a gindin tuddai.
english: The king made silver as common as stones in Jerusalem, and cedars as common as the sycamore trees that are in the lowland.

hausa: da ta Bazlit, da ta Mehida, da ta Harsha,
english: the children of Bazlith, the children of Mehida, the children of Harsha,

hausa: Da jin wannan, Filistiyawa suka yi tambaya suka ce, “Me ke kawo wannan ihu mai ƙarfi haka a sansanin Isra’ilawa?” Da suka gane cewa akwatin alkawarin Ubangiji ne ya shiga sansanin,
english: When the Philistines heard the noise of the shout, they said, “What does the noise of this great shout in the camp of the Hebrews mean?” They understood that Yahweh’s ark had come into the camp.

hausa: Ya gina garuruwa a tuddan Yahuda, ya giggina katanga da gine-gine masu tsawo a wuraren da suke a kurmi.
english: Moreover he built cities in the hill country of Judah, and in the forests he built fortresses and towers.

hausa: “Ka yi hanzari ka shirya al’amura da maƙiyinka wanda yake ƙararka a kotu. Ka yi haka, tun kana tare da shi a kan hanya, in ba haka ba, zai miƙa ka ga alƙali, alƙali kuma yă miƙa ka ga ɗan sanda, mai yiwuwa kuwa a jefa ka a kurkuku.
english: Agree with your adversary quickly while you are with him on the way; lest perhaps the prosecutor deliver you to the judge, and the judge deliver you to the officer, and you be cast into prison.

hausa: gama duk wanda ya shiga hutun Allah, shi ma yakan huta daga nasa aiki, kamar yadda Allah ya huta daga nasa.
english: For he who has entered into his rest has himself also rested from his works, as God did from his.

hausa: Ya shirya burodin a kai a gaban Ubangiji, yadda Ubangiji ya umarce shi.
english: He set the bread in order on it before Yahweh, as Yahweh commanded Moses.

hausa: Ba ya nan, ya tashi! Ku tuna yadda ya gaya muku tun yana tare da ku a Galili cewa,
english: He isn’t here, but is risen. Remember what he told you when he was still in Galilee,

hausa: ta Immer 1,052
english: The children of Immer, one thousand fifty-two.

hausa: Issakar, Zebulun da Benyamin;
english: Issachar, Zebulun, and Benjamin,

hausa: Ba ku san cewa za mu yi wa mala’iku shari’a ba? Balle al’amuran da suka shafi duniyan nan!
english: Don’t you know that we will judge angels? How much more, things that pertain to this life?

hausa: “Ya ba wa sarkinsa kyakkyawan nasara; ya nuna madawwamiyar ƙauna ga shafaffensa, ga Dawuda da zuriyarsa har abada.”
english: He gives great deliverance to his king, and shows loving kindness to his anointed, to David and to his offspring, forever more.”

hausa: don kowannenku yă koya yadda zai ƙame kansa a hanyar da take mai tsarki, mai mutunci kuma,
english: that each one of you know how to control his own body in sanctification and honor,

hausa: Ya kwashe dukiyar haikalin Ubangiji da kuma dukiyar fadan sarki. Ya ɗauki kome, har da dukan garkuwoyi na zinariya da Solomon ya yi.
english: and he took away the treasures of Yahweh’s house and the treasures of the king’s house. He even took away all of it, including all the gold shields which Solomon had made.

hausa: Na yi tunani kwanakin da suka wuce, shekarun da suka wuce da daɗewa;
english: I have considered the days of old, the years of ancient times.

hausa: Sai ku sani fa a cikin zuciyarku cewa kamar yadda mutum kan horar da ɗansa, haka Ubangiji Allahnku ke horar da ku.
english: You shall consider in your heart that as a man disciplines his son, so Yahweh your God disciplines you.

hausa: Toho ɗaya zai kasance a ƙarƙashin rassa biyu na farkon da suka miƙe daga wurin ajiye fitilan, toho na biyu a ƙarƙashin rassa biyu na biye, toho na uku a ƙarƙashin rassa na uku, rassa shida ke nan duka.
english: and a bud under two branches of one piece with it, and a bud under two branches of one piece with it, and a bud under two branches of one piece with it, for the six branches going out of the lamp stand.

hausa: to, bari abokin gābana yă bi yă kuma cim mini; bari yă tattake raina a ƙasa ya sa in kwana a ƙura. Sela
english: let the enemy pursue my soul, and overtake it; yes, let him tread my life down to the earth, and lay my glory in the dust. Selah.

hausa: sai ya ce, “Ba wannan ita ce Babilon babba da na gina domin wurin zaman sarautar Babilon, da ikona kuma domin ɗaukakar darajata ba?”
english: The king spoke and said, “Is not this great Babylon, which I have built for the royal dwelling place by the might of my power and for the glory of my majesty?”

hausa: yana da izini samun fansa, bayan ya sayar da kansa. Ɗaya daga cikin danginsa zai iya fansarsa.
english: after he is sold he may be redeemed. One of his brothers may redeem him;

hausa: A cikin hamada ya same shi, a jeji marar amfani, inda namomi suke kuka. Ya tsare shi, ya kuma lura da shi; ya bi da shi kamar ƙwayar idonsa,
english: He found him in a desert land, in the waste howling wilderness. He surrounded him. He cared for him. He kept him as the apple of his eye.

hausa: Maƙasudin wannan umarnin dai ƙauna ce, wadda take zuwa daga zuciya mai tsabta da lamiri mai kyau da kuma sahihiyar bangaskiya.
english: But the goal of this command is love from a pure heart, a good conscience, and sincere faith,

hausa: Yesu ya ce musu, “Ba ku san abin da kuke roƙo ba. Za ku iya sha daga kwaf da zan sha?” Suka amsa, “Za mu iya.”
english: But Jesus answered, “You don’t know what you are asking. Are you able to drink the cup that I am about to drink, and be baptized with the baptism that I am baptized with?” They said to him, “We are able.”

hausa: Zakoki sun yi ruri sa’ad da suke farauta suna kuma neman abincinsu daga Allah.
english: The young lions roar after their prey, and seek their food from God.

hausa: Wannan yana bukata haƙuri, a gefen tsarkakan da suke biyayya da umarnan Allah suka kuma kasance da aminci ga Yesu.
english: Here is the perseverance of the saints, those who keep the commandments of God and the faith of Jesus.”

hausa: Ya ba da wasiƙar ta hannun Eleyasa ɗan Shafan da Gemariya ɗan Hilkiya, waɗanda Zedekiya sarkin Yahuda ya aika wurin Sarki Nebukadnezzar a Babilon. Wasiƙar ta ce,
english: by the hand of Elasah the son of Shaphan and Gemariah the son of Hilkiah, (whom Zedekiah king of Judah sent to Babylon to Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon). It said:

hausa: Da Shawulu ya sami labari cewa Dawuda ya gudu zuwa Gat, bai ƙara fita nemansa ba.
english: Saul was told that David had fled to Gath, so he stopped looking for him.

hausa: Domin sun yashe ni suka ƙona turare wa waɗansu alloli, suka tozarta ni da dukan gumakan da hannuwansu suka sassaƙa, fushina zai yi ƙuna a kan wannan wuri, ba kuwa zai huce ba.’
english: Because they have forsaken me and have burned incense to other gods, that they might provoke me to anger with all the work of their hands, therefore my wrath shall be kindled against this place, and it will not be quenched.’”

hausa: Aka kira dukan Isra’ilawa daga Naftali, Asher da dukan Manasse, suka kuwa fatattaki Midiyawa.
english: The men of Israel were gathered together out of Naphtali, out of Asher, and out of all Manasseh, and pursued Midian.

hausa: Sai suka fitar da shi waje, suka kashe shi. “To, me mai gonar inabin zai yi da su?
english: Then they threw him out of the vineyard and killed him. What therefore will the lord of the vineyard do to them?

hausa: Zan yi ta yawo a sake gama na nemi farillanka.
english: I will walk in liberty, for I have sought your precepts.

hausa: Sai Solomon ya yi magana ga dukan Isra’ila, ga shugabannin mayaƙa dubu-dubu da shugabannin mayaƙa ɗari-ɗari, ga alƙalai da kuma ga dukan shugabanni a Isra’ila, kawunan iyalai,
english: Solomon spoke to all Israel, to the captains of thousands and of hundreds, to the judges, and to every prince in all Israel, the heads of the fathers’ households.

hausa: su ce masa, “Ranka yă daɗe, ina maka fatan alheri, kai da gidanka da dukan abin da kake da shi!
english: Tell him, ‘Long life to you! Peace be to you! Peace be to your house! Peace be to all that you have!

hausa: Ina dai gaya muku, ba zan ƙara cinsa ba, sai ya sami cika a mulkin Allah.”
english: for I tell you, I will no longer by any means eat of it until it is fulfilled in God’s Kingdom.”

hausa: na goma sha tara a kan Fetahahiya, na ashirin a kan Ezekiyel,
english: the nineteenth to Pethahiah, the twentieth to Jehezkel,

hausa: mutanen Dan, shiryayyu don yaƙi, su 28,600;
english: Of the Danites who could set the battle in array: twenty-eight thousand six hundred.

hausa: Yayinda yake magana da ni, barci mai nauyi ya kwashe ni, da nake kwance rubda ciki. Sai ya taɓa ni ya kuma tashe ni tsaye.
english: Now as he was speaking with me, I fell into a deep sleep with my face toward the ground; but he touched me and set me upright.

hausa: Akwai haɗin bakin sarakunanki a cikinki kamar rurin zaki mai yayyage ganimarsa; suna cin mutane, suna kwashe dukiya da abubuwa masu daraja suna mai da yawanci gwauraye a cikinki.
english: There is a conspiracy of her prophets within it, like a roaring lion ravening the prey. They have devoured souls. They take treasure and precious things. They have made many widows within it.

hausa: Saboda haka Manowa ya tambaye shi ya ce, “Sa’ad da maganarka ta cika, me za tă zama dokar rayuwar yaron da kuma aikinsa?”
english: Manoah said, “Now let your words happen. What shall the child’s way of life and mission be?”

hausa: Sai Yohanna ya ce, “Ubangiji, mun ga wani mutum yana fitar da aljanu a cikin sunanka, muka yi ƙoƙarin hana shi, don shi ba ɗaya ba ne daga cikinmu.”
english: John answered, “Master, we saw someone casting out demons in your name, and we forbade him, because he doesn’t follow with us.”

hausa: Suka amsa cewa, “Ba mu sami wani wasiƙa daga Yahudiya game da kai ba, kuma ba kowa daga cikin ’yan’uwan da suka zo daga can ya kawo wani labari ko ya faɗi wani mummuna abu game da kai.
english: They said to him, “We neither received letters from Judea concerning you, nor did any of the brothers come here and report or speak any evil of you.

hausa: Sa’ad da Ga’al ya gan su, sai ya ce wa Zebul, “Duba, ga mutane suna gangarowa daga kan duwatsu!” Zebul ya ce, “Kana ɗaukan inuwan duwatsu kana ce mutane.”
english: When Gaal saw the people, he said to Zebul, “Behold, people are coming down from the tops of the mountains.” Zebul said to him, “You see the shadows of the mountains as if they were men.”

hausa: “Wani zai iya koya wa Allah ilimi tun da yana shari’anta har da waɗanda suke manya masu iko?
english: “Shall any teach God knowledge, since he judges those who are high?

hausa: Sun zubar da jini kamar ruwa ko’ina a Urushalima, kuma babu wani da zai binne matattu.
english: They have shed their blood like water around Jerusalem. There was no one to bury them.

hausa: Sun bar miƙaƙƙiyar hanya suka bauɗe suna bin hanyar Bala’am ɗan Beyor, wanda ya yi ƙaunar hakkin mugunta.
english: Forsaking the right way, they went astray, having followed the way of Balaam the son of Beor, who loved the wages of wrongdoing;

hausa: Yanzu fa, ’ya’yana, ku saurare ni; kada ku juye daga abin da nake faɗa.
english: Now therefore, my sons, listen to me. Don’t depart from the words of my mouth.

hausa: Yusuf kuwa ya mai da mutanen bayi, daga wannan iyakar Masar zuwa wancan.
english: As for the people, he moved them to the cities from one end of the border of Egypt even to the other end of it.

hausa: ga mai tsabta ka nuna kanka mai tsabta, amma ga karkatacce, ka nuna kanka mai wayo.
english: With the pure, you will show yourself pure. With the crooked you will show yourself shrewd.

hausa: (Su ne suka miƙa hannuwansu suka nuna sun yarda su kori matansu baƙi, kowannensu kuma ya ba da rago daga cikin garkensa don a miƙa hadaya don zunubi.)
english: They gave their hand that they would put away their wives; and being guilty, they offered a ram of the flock for their guilt.

hausa: “Na amsa na ce, ‘Ubangiji, waɗannan mutane sun san cewa na bi majami’a-majami’a na jefa waɗanda suka gaskata da kai a cikin kurkuku, in kuma yin musu dūka.
english: I said, ‘Lord, they themselves know that I imprisoned and beat in every synagogue those who believed in you.

hausa: sai ga mutane tamanin daga Shekem, Shilo da Samariya suka zo da gemunsu a aske, da tufafinsu a kece, da jikunansu a tsage, suka kawo hadayun gari da turare tare da su a gidan Ubangiji.
english: men came from Shechem, from Shiloh, and from Samaria, even eighty men, having their beards shaved and their clothes torn, and having cut themselves, with meal offerings and frankincense in their hand, to bring them to Yahweh’s house.

hausa: Zai ƙaunace ku, yă albarkace ku, yă kuma ƙara yawanku. Zai albarkaci ’ya’yanku, amfanin gonarku; hatsinku, sabon ruwan inabinku da kuma mai, ƙanana shanunku, da ’yan tumaki na tumakinku, a ƙasar da ya rantse wa kakanninku cewa zai ba ku.
english: He will love you, bless you, and multiply you. He will also bless the fruit of your body and the fruit of your ground, your grain and your new wine and your oil, the increase of your livestock and the young of your flock, in the land which he swore to your fathers to give you.

hausa: “To, yanzu na danƙa ku ga Allah da kuma ga maganar alherinsa, wadda za tă iya gina ku ta kuma ba ku gādo a cikin dukan waɗanda aka tsarkake.
english: Now, brothers, I entrust you to God and to the word of his grace, which is able to build up and to give you the inheritance among all those who are sanctified.

hausa: Zan yabe ka muddin raina, kuma a cikin sunanka zai ɗaga hannuwana.
english: So I will bless you while I live. I will lift up my hands in your name.

hausa: Saboda haka suka gabatar da mutane biyu. Yusuf mai suna Barsabbas (da aka kuma sani da Yustus) da kuma Mattiyas.
english: They put forward two: Joseph called Barsabbas, who was also called Justus, and Matthias.

hausa: Ka zuba hasalarka a kan al’umman da ba su san ka ba, a kan mutanen da ba sa kira bisa sunanka. Gama sun cinye Yaƙub; sun cinye shi gaba ɗaya suka kuma lalace wurin zamansa.
english: Pour out your wrath on the nations that don’t know you, and on the families that don’t call on your name; for they have devoured Jacob. Yes, they have devoured him, consumed him, and have laid waste his habitation.

hausa: Isra’ilawa suka gudu a gaban Yahuda, Allah kuwa ya bashe su a hannuwansu.
english: The children of Israel fled before Judah, and God delivered them into their hand.

hausa: Labarin ’ya’yansa maza, annabce-annabce masu yawa game da shi, da tarihin gyaran haikalin Allah suna a rubuce a rubuce-rubuce a littafin sarakuna. Amaziya ɗansa kuwa ya gāje shi a matsayin sarki.
english: Now concerning his sons, the greatness of the burdens laid on him, and the rebuilding of God’s house, behold, they are written in the commentary of the book of the kings. Amaziah his son reigned in his place.

hausa: Ka faɗa wa mutane cewa dukan maza da mata, su roƙi maƙwabtansu kayan azurfa da na zinariya.”
english: Speak now in the ears of the people, and let every man ask of his neighbor, and every woman of her neighbor, jewels of silver, and jewels of gold.”

hausa: Firistoci fa, suka kāsa sosai don fiɗan dukan dabbobin da za a miƙa don hadayun ƙonawa; saboda haka ’yan’uwansu Lawiyawa suka taimake su har aka gama aiki kafin sauran firistoci su sami damar tsarkake kansu. Gama Lawiyawa sun fi firistoci himma wajen tsarkakewar kansu.
english: But the priests were too few, so that they could not skin all the burnt offerings. Therefore their brothers the Levites helped them until the work was ended, and until the priests had sanctified themselves, for the Levites were more upright in heart to sanctify themselves than the priests.

hausa: “Ka zaɓi mutum goma sha biyu daga cikin mutane, ɗaya daga kowace kabila,
english: “Take twelve men out of the people, a man out of every tribe,

hausa: A banza suke mini sujada, koyarwarsu, dokoki ne kawai da mutane suke koyarwa.’ ”
english: And they worship me in vain, teaching as doctrine rules made by men.’”

hausa: ‘Ubangiji ya naɗa ka firist a wurin Yehohiyada don ka lura da gidan Ubangiji; ya kamata ka sa kowane mahaukaci wanda yake yi kamar annabi cikin turu da kuma a kangi.
english: “Yahweh has made you priest in the place of Jehoiada the priest, that there may be officers in Yahweh’s house, for every man who is crazy and makes himself a prophet, that you should put him in the stocks and in shackles.

hausa: Zora, Aiyalon da Hebron. Waɗannan su ne garuruwan katanga a cikin Yahuda da Benyamin.
english: Zorah, Aijalon, and Hebron, which are fortified cities in Judah and in Benjamin.

hausa: Na ji sai zuciyata ta buga, leɓunana sun yi rawa da jin murya; ƙasusuwana suka ruɓe, ƙafafuna kuma sun yi rawa. Duk da haka zan jira da haƙuri ga ranar bala’i ta zo a kan al’umman nan mai kawo mana hari.
english: I heard, and my body trembled. My lips quivered at the voice. Rottenness enters into my bones, and I tremble in my place because I must wait quietly for the day of trouble, for the coming up of the people who invade us.

hausa: Allah kuwa yana da iko yă ba ku fiye da bukatarku, domin kullum ku wadata da kome ta kowace hanya, kuna ta bayarwa hannu sake, kowane irin kyakkyawan aiki.
english: And God is able to make all grace abound to you, that you, always having all sufficiency in everything, may abound to every good work.

hausa: Waɗannan ƙarin karin maganar Solomon ne waɗanda mutanen Hezekiya sarkin Yahuda suka tara.
english: These also are proverbs of Solomon, which the men of Hezekiah king of Judah copied out.

hausa: ka raba ta tă zama gādo wa kabilu tara da kuma rabin kabilar Manasse.”
english: Now therefore divide this land for an inheritance to the nine tribes and the half-tribe of Manasseh.”

hausa: Kai, ko Mika’ilu babban shugaban mala’iku ma, sa’ad da yake mūsu da Iblis game da gawar Musa, bai yi garajen ɗora masa laifi da baƙar magana ba, sai dai ya ce, “Ubangiji yă tsawata maka!”
english: But Michael, the archangel, when contending with the devil and arguing about the body of Moses, dared not bring against him an abusive condemnation, but said, “May the Lord rebuke you!”

hausa: Suna mai kyau ya fi turare mai ƙanshi, kuma ranar mutuwa ta fi ranar haihuwa.
english: A good name is better than fine perfume; and the day of death better than the day of one’s birth.

hausa: Amma Sarki Zedekiya ya yi wannan rantsuwa a kaɗaice ga Irmiya cewa, “Muddin Ubangiji yana a raye, wanda ya ba mu numfashi, ba zan kashe ka ko in ba da kai ga waɗanda suke neman ranka ba.”
english: So Zedekiah the king swore secretly to Jeremiah, saying, “As Yahweh lives, who made our souls, I will not put you to death, neither will I give you into the hand of these men who seek your life.”

hausa: Ina gaya muku, ku yi amfani da dukiya na wannan duniya, domin ku sami wa kanku abokai. Saboda bayan dukiyar ta ƙare, za a karɓe ku a wuraren zama da sun dawwama.
english: I tell you, make for yourselves friends by means of unrighteous mammon, so that when you fail, they may receive you into the eternal tents.

hausa: Ko da yake a dā ni mai saɓo da mai tsanantawa da kuma mai rikici ne, aka nuna mini jinƙai saboda na yi haka cikin jahilci ne da kuma rashin bangaskiya.
english: although I used to be a blasphemer, a persecutor, and insolent. However, I obtained mercy because I did it ignorantly in unbelief.

hausa: In fa ku ba amintattu ne cikin tafiyar da dukiyar wani ba, wa zai ba ku dukiya naku, na kanku?
english: If you have not been faithful in that which is another’s, who will give you that which is your own?

hausa: Kada mu daina taruwa kamar yadda waɗansu suka saba, sai dai mu ƙarfafa juna, tun ba ma da kuka ga Ranan nan tana kusatowa ba.
english: not forsaking our own assembling together, as the custom of some is, but exhorting one another, and so much the more as you see the Day approaching.

hausa: To, fa, akwai wani firist na Midiyan, yana da ’ya’ya mata bakwai, suka zo su shayar da dabbobin mahaifinsu.
english: Now the priest of Midian had seven daughters. They came and drew water, and filled the troughs to water their father’s flock.

hausa: Sarakuna sukan ji daɗi leɓuna masu yin gaskiya; sukan darjanta mutumin da yake faɗin gaskiya.
english: Righteous lips are the delight of kings. They value one who speaks the truth.

hausa: firist zai bincike tabon, idan kuma gashin a cikinsa ya juya ya zama fari, kuma ya yi zurfi fiye da fatar jikin, cuta ce mai yaɗuwa da ta fasu daga ƙunan. Firist zai furta shi marar tsarki; cuta ce mai yaɗuwa.
english: then the priest shall examine it; and behold, if the hair in the bright spot has turned white, and its appearance is deeper than the skin, it is leprosy. It has broken out in the burning, and the priest shall pronounce him unclean. It is the plague of leprosy.

hausa: Suka shiga jirgin ruwa zuwa yankin Gerasenawa da yake a hayin tafkin, daga wajen Galili.
english: Then they arrived at the country of the Gadarenes, which is opposite Galilee.

hausa: Yana kama da mutumin da zai yi tafiya. Yakan bar gidansa a hannun bayinsa, kowa da nasa aikin da aka sa shi, yă kuma ce wa wanda yake gadin ƙofa, yă yi tsaro.
english: “It is like a man traveling to another country, having left his house and given authority to his servants, and to each one his work, and also commanded the doorkeeper to keep watch.

hausa: Bulus ya amsa ya ce, “Ba na hauka, ya mafifici Festus. Abin da nake faɗi gaskiya ne da kuma mai kyau.
english: But he said, “I am not crazy, most excellent Festus, but boldly declare words of truth and reasonableness.

hausa: Amma yanzu, a kawo mini makaɗin garaya.” Yayinda makaɗin garayan yake kiɗa, ikon Ubangiji ya sauko a kan Elisha
english: But now bring me a musician.” When the musician played, Yahweh’s hand came on him.

hausa: “Me ya sa mutumin nan yake magana haka? Yana saɓo! Wane ne zai iya gafarta zunubai, in ba Allah kaɗai ba?”
english: “Why does this man speak blasphemies like that? Who can forgive sins but God alone?”

hausa: Duk da haka, babu sauran baƙin ciki ga waɗanda suke shan azaba. Dā ya ƙasƙantar da ƙasar kabilan Zebulun da ƙasar Naftali, amma nan gaba zai girmama Galili na Al’ummai, ta hanyar teku wadda take ta Urdun.
english: But there shall be no more gloom for her who was in anguish. In the former time, he brought into contempt the land of Zebulun and the land of Naphtali; but in the latter time he has made it glorious, by the way of the sea, beyond the Jordan, Galilee of the nations.

hausa: Ubangiji zai ware shi daga dukan kabilan Isra’ila don yă hukunta shi bisa ga dukan la’anonin alkawarin da aka rubuta a wannan Littafin Doka.
english: Yahweh will set him apart for evil out of all the tribes of Israel, according to all the curses of the covenant written in this book of the law.

hausa: Lokacin da ya cika cikinsa, Allah zai zuba fushinsa a kansa, zai daddaka shi.
english: When he is about to fill his belly, God will cast the fierceness of his wrath on him. It will rain on him while he is eating.

hausa: abin da muka ji muka kuma sani, abubuwan da kakanninmu suka faɗa mana.
english: which we have heard and known, and our fathers have told us.

hausa: Amma Allah ya ce wa Ibrahim, “Kada hankalinka yă tashi game da yaron nan da kuma baiwarka. Ka saurari duk abin da Saratu ta faɗa maka, saboda ta wurin Ishaku ne za a lissafta zuriyarka.
english: God said to Abraham, “Don’t let it be grievous in your sight because of the boy, and because of your servant. In all that Sarah says to you, listen to her voice. For your offspring will be named through Isaac.

hausa: Duk wanda ya yi ƙoƙarin tserewa daga ƙarar razana zai fāɗa cikin rami; wanda kuma ya tsere daga rami za a kama shi a tarko. An buɗe ƙofofin ambaliyar ruwan sama, harsashen ginin duniya suna rawa.
english: It will happen that he who flees from the noise of the fear will fall into the pit; and he who comes up out of the middle of the pit will be taken in the snare; for the windows on high are opened, and the foundations of the earth tremble.

hausa: “ ‘Ban da abin da kuka yi alkawari, da kuma sadakokinku na yardar rai, a miƙa waɗannan ga Ubangiji a lokacin bukukkuwanku, hadayunku na ƙonawa, hadayu na gari, hadayu na sha da hadayu na salama.’ ”
english: “‘You shall offer these to Yahweh in your set feasts—in addition to your vows and your free will offerings—for your burnt offerings, your meal offerings, your drink offerings, and your peace offerings.’”

hausa: Yotam yana da shekara ashirin da biyar sa’ad da ya zama sarki, ya kuma yi mulki a Urushalima shekara goma sha shida. Sunan mahaifiyarsa Yerusha, ’yar Zadok.
english: Jotham was twenty-five years old when he began to reign, and he reigned sixteen years in Jerusalem. His mother’s name was Jerushah the daughter of Zadok.

hausa: “Duba, zan aika manzona, wanda zai shirya hanya a gabana. Sa’an nan a farat ɗaya Ubangiji wanda kuke nema zai zo haikalinsa. Manzon alkawari, wanda kuke sa zuciya kuwa zai zo,” in ji Ubangiji Maɗaukaki.
english: “Behold, I send my messenger, and he will prepare the way before me! The Lord, whom you seek, will suddenly come to his temple. Behold, the messenger of the covenant, whom you desire, is coming!” says Yahweh of Armies.

hausa: Yerobowam ya gina masujadai da suke kan tuddai, ya kuma naɗa firistoci barkatai daga cikin mutanen da ba na zuriyar Lawi ba.
english: He made houses of high places, and made priests from among all the people, who were not of the sons of Levi.

hausa: da Yoram, da Ahaziya, da Yowash,
english: Joram his son, Ahaziah his son, Joash his son,

hausa: Suka ɗauki abubuwan da Musa ya umarta zuwa gaban Tentin Sujada, sai dukan jama’a suka zo kusa suka tsaya a gaban Ubangiji.
english: They brought what Moses commanded before the Tent of Meeting. All the congregation came near and stood before Yahweh.

hausa: Waɗannan su ne kabilan Shutelawa, daga Eran, kabilar Eranawa.
english: These are the sons of Shuthelah: of Eran, the family of the Eranites.

hausa: Shi kuwa yakan yi marmarin cin abin da yakan fāɗi daga tebur na mai arzikin nan. Har karnuka ma sukan zo su lashe gyambunansa.
english: and desiring to be fed with the crumbs that fell from the rich man’s table. Yes, even the dogs came and licked his sores.

hausa: “Faɗa wa Rehobowam ɗan Solomon, sarkin Yahuda, ka faɗa wa dukan gidan Yahuda da Benyamin, da kuma dukan sauran mutane,
english: “Speak to Rehoboam the son of Solomon, king of Judah, and to all the house of Judah and Benjamin, and to the rest of the people, saying,

hausa: Ubangiji da girma yake ya kuma cancanci yabo girmansa ya fi ƙarfin ganewar mutum.
english: Great is Yahweh, and greatly to be praised! His greatness is unsearchable.

hausa: Mahaifinsu ya tambaye su ya ce, “Wace hanya ce ya bi?” Sai ’ya’yansa suka nuna masa hanyar da mutumin Allah daga Yahuda ya bi.
english: Their father said to them, “Which way did he go?” Now his sons had seen which way the man of God went, who came from Judah.

hausa: “Na kira abokaina amma sun yashe ni. Firistocina da dattawana sun hallaka a cikin birnin yayinda suke neman abinci don kada su mutu da yunwa.
english: “I called for my lovers, but they deceived me. My priests and my elders gave up the spirit in the city, while they sought food for themselves to refresh their souls.

hausa: “Amma ko a cikin waɗancan kwanaki,” in ji Ubangiji, “ba zan hallaka ku gaba ɗaya ba.
english: “But even in those days,” says Yahweh, “I will not make a full end of you.

hausa: Daga ’ya’yan Yusuf. Daga zuriyar Efraim. Aka rubuta sunayen dukan maza ɗaya-ɗaya da suka kai shekara ashirin ko fiye da suka isa shiga soja, bisa ga iyalansu da kabilarsu da take a rubuce.
english: Of the children of Joseph: of the children of Ephraim, their generations, by their families, by their fathers’ houses, according to the number of the names, from twenty years old and upward, all who were able to go out to war:

hausa: Sai Musa ya kira Yoshuwa, ya ce masa a gaban dukan Isra’ila, “Ka ƙarfafa, ka kuma yi ƙarfin hali, gama dole ka tafi tare da mutanen nan zuwa cikin ƙasar da Ubangiji ya rantse cewa za ba wa kakanninku, dole kuma ka raba ta gare su ta zama gādonsu.
english: Moses called to Joshua, and said to him in the sight of all Israel, “Be strong and courageous, for you shall go with this people into the land which Yahweh has sworn to their fathers to give them; and you shall cause them to inherit it.

hausa: “Faɗa wa Haruna da ’ya’yansa maza, su lura da tsarkakakkun abubuwan da Isra’ilawa suka keɓe gare ni da bangirma, saboda ba za su ƙazantar da sunana mai tsarki ba. Ni ne Ubangiji.
english: “Tell Aaron and his sons to separate themselves from the holy things of the children of Israel, which they make holy to me, and that they not profane my holy name. I am Yahweh.

hausa: To, Saira, matar Abram, ba tă haifa masa ’ya’ya ba. Amma tana da wata baiwa mutuniyar Masar mai suna Hagar,
english: Now Sarai, Abram’s wife, bore him no children. She had a servant, an Egyptian, whose name was Hagar.

hausa: Gama babu wanda zai iya kafa wani tushen gini dabam da wanda aka riga aka kafa, wanda yake Yesu Kiristi.
english: For no one can lay any other foundation than that which has been laid, which is Jesus Christ.

hausa: Da dare na tuna da sunanka, ya Ubangiji, zan kuwa kiyaye dokarka.
english: I have remembered your name, Yahweh, in the night, and I obey your law.

hausa: Waɗannan su ne kabilan Zebulun, jimillarsu ta kai 60,500.
english: These are the families of the Zebulunites according to those who were counted of them, sixty thousand five hundred.

hausa: Ikkilisiyoyin da suke cikin Kiristi da suke a Yahudiya ba su san ni ba tukuna.
english: I was still unknown by face to the assemblies of Judea which were in Christ,

hausa: Yaya zan sāka wa Ubangiji saboda dukan alherinsa gare ni?
english: What will I give to Yahweh for all his benefits toward me?

hausa: Ahimawaz ɗan Zadok ya ce, “Bari in ruga in kai wa sarki labari cewa Ubangiji ya cece shi daga hannun abokan gābansa.”
english: Then Ahimaaz the son of Zadok said, “Let me now run and carry the king news, how Yahweh has avenged him of his enemies.”

hausa: Ya Ubangiji Maɗaukaki, kai da kake gwada adali kana bincika zuciya duk da tunani, bari in ga sakayyarka a kansu, gama a gare ka na miƙa damuwata.
english: But Yahweh of Armies, who tests the righteous, who sees the heart and the mind, let me see your vengeance on them, for I have revealed my cause to you.

hausa: don duk mai gaskata da shi ya sami rai madawwami.”
english: that whoever believes in him should not perish, but have eternal life.

hausa: Ubangiji ya ce wa Musa da Haruna,
english: Yahweh spoke to Moses and to Aaron, saying,

hausa: Sa’ad da Yahuda, wanda ya bashe Yesu, ya ga an yanke wa Yesu hukuncin kisa, sai ya yi “da na sani.” Ya je mayar wa manyan firistoci da dattawan kuɗin azurfa talatin ɗin.
english: Then Judas, who betrayed him, when he saw that Jesus was condemned, felt remorse, and brought back the thirty pieces of silver to the chief priests and elders,

hausa: Dukan masu bi kuwa zuciyarsu ɗaya ne, nufinsu kuwa ɗaya. Babu wani da ya ce abin da ya mallaka nasa ne, amma sun raba kome da suke da shi.
english: The multitude of those who believed were of one heart and soul. Not one of them claimed that anything of the things which he possessed was his own, but they had all things in common.

hausa: Na roƙi Titus ya zo wurinku. Na kuma aiki ɗan’uwanmu tare da shi. Ko Titus ya cuce ku ne? Ba ruhu ɗaya yake bi da mu ba? Ba kuma hanya guda muka bi ba?
english: I exhorted Titus, and I sent the brother with him. Did Titus take any advantage of you? Didn’t we walk in the same spirit? Didn’t we walk in the same steps?

hausa: “Kaitonku, malaman dokoki da Farisiyawa, munafukai! Kukan yi tafiye-tafiye zuwa ƙasashe, ku ƙetare teku don ku sami mai tuba ɗaya, sa’ad da ya tuba kuwa, sai ku mai da shi ɗan wuta fiye da ku, har sau biyu.
english: Woe to you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! For you travel around by sea and land to make one proselyte; and when he becomes one, you make him twice as much a son of Gehenna as yourselves.

hausa: Gama fushin Allah zai sauko a kan masu aikata waɗannan.
english: For these things’ sake the wrath of God comes on the children of disobedience.

hausa: An biya ni duka, biyan da ya wuce misali. Bukatata ta biya, da yake na karɓi kyautarku da kuka aiko ta hannun Afaforiditus. Baiwa mai ƙanshi, hadaya abar karɓa, mai faranta wa Allah rai.
english: But I have all things and abound. I am filled, having received from Epaphroditus the things that came from you, a sweet-smelling fragrance, an acceptable and well-pleasing sacrifice to God.

hausa: ’Ya’yan Hebron maza su ne, Kora, Taffuwa, Rekem da Shema.
english: The sons of Hebron: Korah, Tappuah, Rekem, and Shema.

hausa: Sai Balak ya aika waɗansu dattawa masu yawa, masu daraja kuma fiye da na dā.
english: Balak again sent princes, more, and more honorable than they.

hausa: Dawuda kuwa ya aika wa Tamar a fada, ya ce, “Ki je gidan Amnon ɗan’uwanki, ki yi masa abinci.”
english: Then David sent home to Tamar, saying, “Go now to your brother Amnon’s house, and prepare food for him.”

hausa: Ya fada musu duk abin da ya faru sa’an nan ya aike su Yoffa.
english: Having explained everything to them, he sent them to Joppa.

hausa: “Har yaushe ku da kuke marasa azanci za ku ci gaba a hanyoyinku marasa azanci? Har yaushe ku masu ba’a za ku yi ta murna cikin ba’arku wawaye kuma ku ƙi ilimi?
english: “How long, you simple ones, will you love simplicity? How long will mockers delight themselves in mockery, and fools hate knowledge?

hausa: Sairus sarkin Farisa ya sa Mitredat ma’aji ya ƙirga su a gaban Sheshbazzar ɗan sarkin Yahuda.
english: even those, Cyrus king of Persia brought out by the hand of Mithredath the treasurer, and counted them out to Sheshbazzar the prince of Judah.

hausa: Sai dai kana da wannan abu mai kyau. Ka ƙi ayyukan Nikolaitawa da ni ma nake ƙi.
english: But this you have, that you hate the works of the Nicolaitans, which I also hate.

hausa: Zan cece ku daga dukan rashin tsabtarku. Zan sa hatsi ya yi yalwa ba zan kawo yunwa a kanku ba.
english: I will save you from all your uncleanness. I will call for the grain and will multiply it, and lay no famine on you.

hausa: Saboda haka, da yake ta wurin jinƙan Allah ne muke da wannan hidima, ba za mu fid da zuciya ba.
english: Therefore, seeing we have this ministry, even as we obtained mercy, we don’t faint.

hausa: Waɗansu suka fāɗi a kan dutse, da suka tsira sai suka yanƙwane don babu ruwa a wurin.
english: Some seed fell on the rock, and as soon as it grew, it withered away, because it had no moisture.

hausa: “Ayyukansu ba su ba su dama su koma ga Allahnsu ba. Halin karuwanci yana cikin zuciyarsu; ba su yarda da Ubangiji ba.
english: Their deeds won’t allow them to turn to their God, for the spirit of prostitution is within them, and they don’t know Yahweh.

hausa: Zan ƙarfafa hannuwan sarkin Babilon in kuma sa takobina a hannunsa, amma zan karya hannuwan Fir’auna, zai kuwa yi nishi a gabansa kamar mutumin da aka yi wa raunin mutuwa.
english: I will strengthen the arms of the king of Babylon, and put my sword in his hand; but I will break the arms of Pharaoh, and he will groan before the king of Babylon with the groaning of a mortally wounded man.

hausa: Azariya ɗan Hoshahiya da Yohanan ɗan Kareya da dukan masu ɗaga kai suka ce wa Irmiya, “Kana ƙarya ne! Ubangiji Allahnmu bai aike ka ka ce, ‘Kada ku tafi Masar don ku zauna a can.’
english: then Azariah the son of Hoshaiah, Johanan the son of Kareah, and all the proud men spoke, saying to Jeremiah, “You speak falsely. Yahweh our God has not sent you to say, ‘You shall not go into Egypt to live there;’

hausa: A nan ne fa waɗansu mutane daga Urushalima suka fara tambaya suna cewa, “Ashe, ba wannan mutum ne suke nema su kashe ba?
english: Therefore some of them of Jerusalem said, “Isn’t this he whom they seek to kill?

hausa: Irmiya ya ce wa Zedekiya, “In na ba ka amsa, ba za ka kashe ni ba? Ko da na ba ka shawara, ba za ka saurare ni ba.”
english: Then Jeremiah said to Zedekiah, “If I declare it to you, will you not surely put me to death? If I give you counsel, you will not listen to me.”

hausa: Ta haka alhakin jinin masu adalcin da aka zubar a duniya, tun daga jinin Habila mai adalci, zuwa jinin Zakariya ɗan Berekiya, wanda kuka kashe tsakanin haikali da bagade zai koma kanku.
english: that on you may come all the righteous blood shed on the earth, from the blood of righteous Abel to the blood of Zachariah son of Barachiah, whom you killed between the sanctuary and the altar.

hausa: Ba da jimawa ba bayan an shuka su, ba da jimawa ba bayan an dasa su, ba da jimawa ba bayan sun yi saiwa a ƙasa, sai yă hura musu iska su yanƙwane, guguwa kuma ta kwashe su kamar yayi.
english: They are planted scarcely. They are sown scarcely. Their stock has scarcely taken root in the ground. He merely blows on them, and they wither, and the whirlwind takes them away as stubble.

hausa: amma rana ta bakwai Asabbaci ne ga Ubangiji, Allahnka. A ranar ba za ka yi wani aiki ba, ko kai, ko ɗanka, ko ’yarka, ko bawa, ko baiwa, ko dabbarka, ko baƙon da yake zama tare da kai.
english: but the seventh day is a Sabbath to Yahweh your God. You shall not do any work in it, you, nor your son, nor your daughter, your male servant, nor your female servant, nor your livestock, nor your stranger who is within your gates;

hausa: bisa ga haihuwarsu, sunaye shida a kan dutse ɗaya, saura shida kuma a kan ɗaya dutsen.
english: Six of their names on the one stone, and the names of the six that remain on the other stone, in the order of their birth.

hausa: ya kuma aiki mutum a gabansu, Yusuf, da aka sayar a matsayin bawa.
english: He sent a man before them. Joseph was sold for a slave.

hausa: Shirayin da yake a gaban ainihin zauren haikalin, ya ƙara faɗin haikalin da kamu ashirin, ya kuma nausa daga gaban haikalin kamu goma.
english: The porch in front of the temple of the house had a length of twenty cubits, which was along the width of the house. Ten cubits was its width in front of the house.

hausa: A ƙarshen shekara huɗu, Absalom ya ce wa sarki, “Bari in tafi Hebron in cika alkawarin da na yi wa Ubangiji.
english: At the end of forty years, Absalom said to the king, “Please let me go and pay my vow, which I have vowed to Yahweh, in Hebron.

hausa: nakan nuna ƙauna wa dubbai, nakan kuma gafarta mugunta, tawaye da zunubi. Amma ba na barin mai laifi, ba tare da na hore shi ba; nakan hukunta ’ya’ya da jikoki har tsara ta uku da ta huɗu saboda laifin iyaye.”
english: keeping loving kindness for thousands, forgiving iniquity and disobedience and sin; and who will by no means clear the guilty, visiting the iniquity of the fathers on the children, and on the children’s children, on the third and on the fourth generation.”

hausa: Sai almajirin da Yesu yake ƙauna ya ce wa Bitrus, “Ai, Ubangiji ne!” Nan da nan da Siman Bitrus ya ji ya ce, “Ai, Ubangiji ne,” sai ya yafa mayafinsa (don dā ma ya tuɓe shi), ya fāɗa cikin ruwan.
english: That disciple therefore whom Jesus loved said to Peter, “It’s the Lord!” So when Simon Peter heard that it was the Lord, he wrapped his coat around himself (for he was naked), and threw himself into the sea.

hausa: Sai maganar Ubangiji ta zo mini cewa,
english: Then Yahweh’s word came to me, saying,

hausa: Mai adalci ne kai, ya Ubangiji, dokokinka kuma daidai ne.
english: You are righteous, Yahweh. Your judgments are upright.

hausa: Gama duk abin da Allah ya halitta yana da kyau, kada kuma a ƙi kome in dai an karɓe shi da godiya,
english: For every creature of God is good, and nothing is to be rejected if it is received with thanksgiving.

hausa: Shekara, shekara, duk wanda ya zo wurinsa yakan kawo kyauta, kayayyakin azurfa da na zinariya, da riguna, makamai da kayan yaji, da dawakai da kuma alfadarai.
english: They each brought tribute: vessels of silver, vessels of gold, clothing, armor, spices, horses, and mules every year.

hausa: Allah ya ce, “Kada ka zo kusa, tuɓe takalmanka, gama inda kake tsaye, wuri ne mai tsarki.”
english: He said, “Don’t come close. Take off your sandals, for the place you are standing on is holy ground.”

hausa: “ ‘Ga abin da Ubangiji Mai Iko Duka yana cewa ba kai ba ne na yi magana da kai a kwanakin dā ta wurin bayina annabawan Isra’ila? A lokacin sun yi annabci shekaru masu yawa cewa zan kawo ka, ka yaƙe su.
english: “‘The Lord Yahweh says: “Are you he of whom I spoke in old time by my servants the prophets of Israel, who prophesied in those days for years that I would bring you against them?

hausa: Yesu ya ce, “Ashe, ba a cikin kuskure kuke ba saboda rashin sanin Nassi, ko ikon Allah?
english: Jesus answered them, “Isn’t this because you are mistaken, not knowing the Scriptures nor the power of God?

hausa: “A ƙayyadadden lokaci zai sāke kai wa Kudu hari, amma a wannan karo abin da zai faru zai sha bamban daga abin da ya faru can baya.
english: “He will return at the appointed time and come into the south; but it won’t be in the latter time as it was in the former.

hausa: Sai dattawan garinsa su kira shi, su kuma yi masa magana. In ya nace yana cewa, “Ba na so in aure ta,”
english: Then the elders of his city shall call him, and speak to him. If he stands and says, “I don’t want to take her,”

hausa: A wannan irin Biki, gwamna yana da wata al’ada, ta sakin ɗan kurkuku guda wanda taron suka zaɓa.
english: Now at the feast the governor was accustomed to release to the multitude one prisoner whom they desired.

hausa: Waɗanda a dā sukan ci abinci mai daɗi yanzu su ne masu bara a tituna. Waɗanda a dā suke sa kaya masu kyau yanzu suna kwance a kan tarin toka.
english: Those who ate delicacies are desolate in the streets. Those who were brought up in purple embrace dunghills.

hausa: Ya ce musu, “Ku ne kawunan iyalan Lawiyawa; ku da ’yan’uwanku Lawiyawa, sai ku tsarkake kanku ku hauro da akwatin alkawarin Ubangiji, Allah na Isra’ila, zuwa wurin da na shirya dominsa.
english: and said to them, “You are the heads of the fathers’ households of the Levites. Sanctify yourselves, both you and your brothers, that you may bring the ark of Yahweh, the God of Israel, up to the place that I have prepared for it.

hausa: Sai suka ci gaba da zama a cikin haikalin, suna yabon Allah.
english: and were continually in the temple, praising and blessing God. Amen.

hausa: Duk waɗanda suke da duwatsu masu daraja suka ba da su ga Yehiyel mutumin Gershon ma’ajin haikalin Ubangiji.
english: People with whom precious stones were found gave them to the treasure of Yahweh’s house, under the hand of Jehiel the Gershonite.

hausa: Sa’an nan mutanen suka nemi a ba su sarki, Allah kuwa ya ba su Shawulu ɗan Kish, na kabilar Benyamin, wanda ya yi mulki shekaru arba’in.
english: Afterward they asked for a king, and God gave to them Saul the son of Kish, a man of the tribe of Benjamin, for forty years.

hausa: Fări a kan ruwanta! Za su bushe ƙaf. Gama ƙasa ce ta gumaka, gumakan da za su haukace da tsoro.
english: A drought is on her waters, and they will be dried up; for it is a land of engraved images, and they are mad over idols.

hausa: ta Zakkai 760
english: The children of Zaccai: seven hundred sixty.

hausa: Za ka ta’azantu sa’ad da ka ga halinsu da kuma ayyukansu, gama za ka san cewa ban aikata wani abu a cikinta ba dalili ba, in ji Ubangiji Mai Iko Duka.”
english: They will comfort you, when you see their way and their doings; then you will know that I have not done all that I have done in it without cause,” says the Lord Yahweh.

hausa: Ina farin ciki da alkawarinka kamar yadda wani kan sami ganima mai girma.
english: I rejoice at your word, as one who finds great plunder.

hausa: Saboda haka Abram ya tashi yadda Ubangiji ya faɗa masa; Lot ma ya tafi tare da shi. Abram yana da shekaru 75, sa’ad da ya tashi daga Haran.
english: So Abram went, as Yahweh had told him. Lot went with him. Abram was seventy-five years old when he departed from Haran.

hausa: Yaushe kuma muka gan ka baƙo muka karɓe ka, ko cikin bukatar tufafi muka yi maka sutura?
english: When did we see you as a stranger and take you in, or naked and clothe you?

hausa: “Yanzu kuma Ruhu ya tilasta ni, za ni Urushalima, ba tare da sanin abin da zai faru da ni a can ba.
english: Now, behold, I go bound by the Spirit to Jerusalem, not knowing what will happen to me there;

hausa: Sarki Zedekiya ya aikata abin da yake mugu a gaban Ubangiji kamar yadda Sarki Yehohiyakim ya yi.
english: He did that which was evil in Yahweh’s sight, according to all that Jehoiakim had done.

hausa: Na yi shiru, ban ce kome ba, Ko a kan abin da yake da kyau! Amma duk da haka wahalata sai ƙaruwa take yi;
english: I was mute with silence. I held my peace, even from good. My sorrow was stirred.

hausa: Sai dukan Isra’ila suka kawo akwatin alkawarin Ubangiji da sowa, da ƙarar ƙahonin raguna da busan ƙahoni, da na ganguna, suna kuma kaɗa molaye da garayu.
english: Thus all Israel brought the ark of Yahweh’s covenant up with shouting, with sound of the cornet, with trumpets, and with cymbals, sounding aloud with stringed instruments and harps.

hausa: Don haka mutumin ya tafi gidan, aka kuma saukar da kaya kan raƙuman. Aka kawo wa raƙuman ciyawa da abincin dabbobi, aka kuma kawo ruwa dominsa da mutanensa su wanke ƙafafunsu.
english: The man came into the house, and he unloaded the camels. He gave straw and feed for the camels, and water to wash his feet and the feet of the men who were with him.

hausa: A maimakon haka, ya kamata ku ce, “In Ubangiji ya yarda, muna kuma a raye, za mu yi wannan ko wancan.”
english: For you ought to say, “If the Lord wills, we will both live, and do this or that.”

hausa: Shi ya sa alkawari na farko bai fara aiki ba sai da aka zub da jini.
english: Therefore even the first covenant has not been dedicated without blood.

hausa: “ ‘A rana ta uku za a miƙa bijimai goma sha ɗaya, raguna biyu, da kuma ’yan raguna goma sha huɗu, bana ɗaya-ɗaya, dukansu marasa lahani.
english: “‘On the third day: eleven bulls, two rams, fourteen male lambs a year old without defect;

hausa: Dukiyar masu hikima ita ce rawaninsu, amma wautar wawaye kan haifar da wauta ne kawai.
english: The crown of the wise is their riches, but the folly of fools crowns them with folly.

hausa: A rana ta takwas dole yă ɗauki kurciyoyi biyu ko tattabarai biyu, yă zo gaban Ubangiji a ƙofar Tentin Sujada, yă ba da su ga firist.
english: “‘On the eighth day he shall take two turtledoves, or two young pigeons, and come before Yahweh to the door of the Tent of Meeting, and give them to the priest.

hausa: Girmankan Isra’ila yana ba da shaida a kansu; Isra’ilawa, har ma Efraim, sun yi tuntuɓe a cikin zunubinsu; Yahuda ma ya yi tuntuɓe tare da su.
english: The pride of Israel testifies to his face. Therefore Israel and Ephraim will stumble in their iniquity. Judah also will stumble with them.

hausa: Ka sha zuma, ɗana, ka sha zuma gama tana da kyau; zuma daga kaki yana da zaƙi a harshenka.
english: My son, eat honey, for it is good, the droppings of the honeycomb, which are sweet to your taste;

hausa: Gama waɗansu suna cewa, “Wasiƙunsa suna da nauyi da kuma ƙarfi, amma kuwa in ka gan shi, ba shi da wani kwarjini, maganarsa kuma ba kome ba ce.”
english: For, “His letters”, they say, “are weighty and strong, but his bodily presence is weak, and his speech is despised.”

hausa: Ki yi nazari a kai, ki ga ko za ki iya yin wani abu, domin masifa yana nan rataye a wuyan maigidanmu da dukan iyalin gidansa. Shi mugun mutum ne wanda ba wani da zai iya yin masa magana.”
english: Now therefore know and consider what you will do; for evil is determined against our master and against all his house, for he is such a worthless fellow that one can’t speak to him.”

hausa: Ku ga yadda ƙasar take, ku ga ko mutanen da suke zama a can ƙarfafa ne, ko raunannu, ko su kima ne, ko kuma suna da yawa.
english: See the land, what it is; and the people who dwell therein, whether they are strong or weak, whether they are few or many;

hausa: Saboda haka ina gaya muku cewa ba zan kore su a gabanku ba; za su zama muku ƙaya, gumakansu kuma za su zama muku tarko.”
english: Therefore I also said, ‘I will not drive them out from before you; but they shall be in your sides, and their gods will be a snare to you.’”

hausa: Sai Elisha ya kira wani daga cikin ƙungiyar annabawa, ya ce masa, “Ka sha ɗamara, ka ɗauki wannan kwalabar mai ka je Ramot Gileyad.
english: Elisha the prophet called one of the sons of the prophets, and said to him, “Put your belt on your waist, take this vial of oil in your hand, and go to Ramoth Gilead.

hausa: In ka kashe dukan mutanen nan gaba ɗaya, al’ummai da suka ji wannan labari game da kai za su ce,
english: Now if you killed this people as one man, then the nations which have heard the fame of you will speak, saying,

hausa: In fa muka ƙyale shi ya ci gaba da haka, kowa zai gaskata da shi, Romawa kuma su zo su karɓe wurinmu su kuma ƙwace ƙasarmu.”
english: If we leave him alone like this, everyone will believe in him, and the Romans will come and take away both our place and our nation.”

hausa: Hushai ya ce wa Absalom, “Shawarar da Ahitofel ya bayar a wannan lokaci kam, ba ta da kyau.
english: Hushai said to Absalom, “The counsel that Ahithophel has given this time is not good.”

hausa: Na gan ka a wuri mai tsarki na kuma dubi ikonka da ɗaukakarka.
english: So I have seen you in the sanctuary, watching your power and your glory.

hausa: Fagiyel ɗan Okran ne shugaban ɓangaren kabilan Asher,
english: Pagiel the son of Ochran was over the army of the tribe of the children of Asher.

hausa: Suka dinga sayar da ƙaddarorinsu da kayayyakinsu, suka ba wa kowa gwargwadon bukatarsa.
english: They sold their possessions and goods, and distributed them to all, according as anyone had need.

hausa: Ina addu’a cewa daga yalwar ɗaukakarsa zai ƙarfafa ku da iko daga ciki ta wurin Ruhunsa.
english: that he would grant you, according to the riches of his glory, that you may be strengthened with power through his Spirit in the inner person,

hausa: wanda yakan cece ni daga abokan gābana. Ana girmama ka bisa abokan gābana; daga masu tā-da-na-zaune-tsaye ka kuɓutar da ni.
english: He rescues me from my enemies. Yes, you lift me up above those who rise up against me. You deliver me from the violent man.

hausa: Dawuda ya tattara dukan Isra’ila a Urushalima don su haura da akwatin alkawarin Ubangiji zuwa wurin da aka shirya dominsa.
english: David assembled all Israel at Jerusalem, to bring up Yahweh’s ark to its place, which he had prepared for it.

hausa: Yayinda bawanka yana fama, yana kai da kawowa, sai mutumin ya ɓace.” Sai sarkin Isra’ila ya ce, “Hukuncinka ke nan, ka furta shi da kanka.”
english: As your servant was busy here and there, he was gone.” The king of Israel said to him, “So shall your judgment be. You yourself have decided it.”

hausa: Zai ɗibi jinin bijimin da yatsarsa yă yayyafa a gaban murfin kafarar; sa’an nan yă yayyafa jinin da yatsarsa sau bakwai a gaban murfin kafarar.
english: He shall take some of the blood of the bull, and sprinkle it with his finger on the mercy seat on the east; and before the mercy seat he shall sprinkle some of the blood with his finger seven times.

hausa: Kada ka ce, “Zan yi masa kamar yadda ya yi mini; zan rama abin da wannan mutum ya yi mini.”
english: Don’t say, “I will do to him as he has done to me; I will repay the man according to his work.”

hausa: Ish-Boshet ɗan Shawulu yana da shekaru arba’in sa’ad da ya zama sarkin Isra’ila, ya kuma yi sarauta shekara biyu. Amma fa, gidan Yahuda, suka bi Dawuda.
english: Ishbosheth, Saul’s son, was forty years old when he began to reign over Israel, and he reigned two years. But the house of Judah followed David.

hausa: Muddin yana da cutar zai ci gaba da kasance marar tsarki. Dole yă yi zama shi kaɗai; dole yă yi zama waje da sansani.
english: All the days in which the plague is in him he shall be unclean. He is unclean. He shall dwell alone. His dwelling shall be outside of the camp.

hausa: Ta gajiyar da dukan ƙoƙari; ba a fid da tsatsarta nan mai yawa ba, kai, ko a wuta ma.
english: She is weary with toil; yet her great rust, rust by fire, doesn’t leave her.

hausa: Mutanen Benyamin suka fito su same su aka kuma jawo su nesa da birnin. Suka fara karkashe Isra’ilawa kamar dā, har aka kashe wajen mutum talatin a filaye da kuma a hanyoyi, wadda take zuwa Betel da kuma wadda take zuwa Gibeya.
english: The children of Benjamin went out against the people, and were drawn away from the city; and they began to strike and kill of the people as at other times, in the highways, of which one goes up to Bethel and the other to Gibeah, in the field, about thirty men of Israel.

hausa: Ya sa hannu a jakarsa ya ɗauki dutse, ya sa cikin majajjawa ya wurga, dutsen kuwa ya bugi Bafilistin a goshi, dutsen ya shiga cikin goshinsa, sai Bafilistin ya fāɗi rubda ciki.
english: David put his hand in his bag, took a stone and slung it, and struck the Philistine in his forehead. The stone sank into his forehead, and he fell on his face to the earth.

hausa: Suka kawo akwatin alkawarin Ubangiji, aka ajiye shi a inda aka shirya masa a cikin tentin da Dawuda ya shirya dominsa. Dawuda kuma ya miƙa hadaya ta ƙonawa da hadaya ta salama a gaban Ubangiji.
english: They brought in Yahweh’s ark, and set it in its place in the middle of the tent that David had pitched for it; and David offered burnt offerings and peace offerings before Yahweh.

hausa: Gonar kuwa ita ce duniya, irin nan mai kyau kuwa suna a matsayin ’ya’yan mulkin. Ciyayin nan kuma su ne ’ya’yan mugun nan,
english: the field is the world, the good seeds are the children of the Kingdom, and the darnel weeds are the children of the evil one.

hausa: Amma bokayen Masar ma suka yi abubuwan nan da sihirinsu, sai zuciyar Fir’auna ta taurare; bai saurari Musa da Haruna ba, kamar dai yadda Ubangiji ya riga ya faɗa.
english: The magicians of Egypt did the same thing with their enchantments. So Pharaoh’s heart was hardened, and he didn’t listen to them, as Yahweh had spoken.

hausa: Ya miƙa hadaya, ya kuma ƙona turare a masujadan tudu, da kan tuddai, da kuma a ƙarƙashin kowane babban itace.
english: He sacrificed and burned incense in the high places, on the hills, and under every green tree.

hausa: Sai ɗaya daga cikin dattawan ya ce mini, “Kada ka yi kuka! Duba, Zakin kabilar Yahuda, da kuma Tushen Dawuda ya ci nasara. Ya iya buɗe naɗaɗɗen littafin da hatimansa bakwai.”
english: One of the elders said to me, “Don’t weep. Behold, the Lion who is of the tribe of Judah, the Root of David, has overcome: he who opens the book and its seven seals.”

hausa: Ba za ka ɗan daina kallo na ba ko ka rabu da ni na ɗan lokaci?
english: How long will you not look away from me, nor leave me alone until I swallow down my spittle?

hausa: Sa’an nan Yaƙub ya bar Beyersheba, ’ya’yan Isra’ila maza, suka ɗauki mahaifinsu Yaƙub da ’ya’yansu da matansu a cikin wagonun da Fir’auna ya aika don a kawo shi.
english: Jacob rose up from Beersheba, and the sons of Israel carried Jacob, their father, their little ones, and their wives, in the wagons which Pharaoh had sent to carry him.

hausa: Zan kuma sa Ruhuna a cikinku in kuma motsa ku ku bi ƙa’idodina ku kuma kiyaye dokokina.
english: I will put my Spirit within you, and cause you to walk in my statutes. You will keep my ordinances and do them.

hausa: Da dai ya ƙi rarrasuwa, muka yi shiru, muka ce, “Bari Ubangiji yă yi nufinsa.”
english: When he would not be persuaded, we ceased, saying, “The Lord’s will be done.”

hausa: Muna ƙaunarku saboda gaskiyan nan, wadda take cikinmu za tă kuma kasance tare da mu har abada.
english: for the truth’s sake, which remains in us, and it will be with us forever:

hausa: Yadda Ubangiji ya faɗa, Nebukadnezzar ya kwashe dukan dukiyar haikalin Ubangiji, da ta fadan sarki, ya kuma kwashe dukan kayan zinariyar da Solomon sarkin Isra’ila ya ƙera domin haikalin Ubangiji.
english: He carried out from there all the treasures of Yahweh’s house and the treasures of the king’s house, and cut in pieces all the vessels of gold which Solomon king of Israel had made in Yahweh’s temple, as Yahweh had said.

hausa: Da waɗannan duwatsun ya gina bagade cikin sunan Ubangiji, ya kuma haƙa wuriya kewaye da shi, isashe da zai ci garwa biyu na irin ƙwayar gyada.
english: With the stones he built an altar in Yahweh’s name. He made a trench around the altar large enough to contain two seahs of seed.

hausa: Sa’an nan Yusuf ya umarci masu maganin da suke yin masa hidima, su shafe mahaifinsa Isra’ila da maganin hana ruɓa. Saboda haka masu maganin suka shafe shi da maganin hana ruɓa.
english: Joseph commanded his servants, the physicians, to embalm his father; and the physicians embalmed Israel.

hausa: Bakinsa ya cika da zage-zage da ƙarairayi da kuma barazana; wahala da mugunta suna a ƙarƙashin harshensa.
english: His mouth is full of cursing, deceit, and oppression. Under his tongue is mischief and iniquity.

hausa: Me kike yi, ya wadda aka ragargaza? Me ya sa kika sanya mulufi kika sa kayan adon zinariya? Me ya sa kika sa wa idanunki tozali? Kin yi kwalliyarki a banza. Masoyanki sun bar ki; suna neman ranki.
english: You, when you are made desolate, what will you do? Though you clothe yourself with scarlet, though you deck yourself with ornaments of gold, though you enlarge your eyes with makeup, you make yourself beautiful in vain. Your lovers despise you. They seek your life.

hausa: Betuwel ya haifi Rebeka. Milka ta haifa wa Nahor ɗan’uwan Ibrahim waɗannan ’ya’ya maza takwas.
english: Bethuel became the father of Rebekah. These eight Milcah bore to Nahor, Abraham’s brother.

hausa: Bugu da ƙari, aljanu suka fiffita daga cikin mutane da yawa suna ihu suna cewa, “Kai Ɗan Allah ne!” Amma ya kwaɓe su, ya hana su magana, don sun san cewa shi ne Kiristi.
english: Demons also came out of many, crying out and saying, “You are the Christ, the Son of God!” Rebuking them, he didn’t allow them to speak, because they knew that he was the Christ.

hausa: Ya umarci mutanen da suke zama a Urushalima su ba da rabon da yake na firistoci da Lawiyawa, don su ƙwallafa ransu ga Dokar Ubangiji.
english: Moreover he commanded the people who lived in Jerusalem to give the portion of the priests and the Levites, that they might give themselves to Yahweh’s law.

hausa: Kamar tsuntsun da ya ɓace daga sheƙarsa haka yake da mutumin da ya bar gidansa.
english: As a bird that wanders from her nest, so is a man who wanders from his home.

hausa: Sai ya fito da su waje ya kuma tambaye su ya ce, “Ranku yă daɗe, me zan yi domin in sami ceto?”
english: brought them out, and said, “Sirs, what must I do to be saved?”

hausa: Haka nan ma, Ruhu yana taimakonmu cikin rashin ƙarfinmu. Ba mu san abin da ya kamata mu roƙa cikin addu’a ba, amma Ruhu kansa yana roƙo a madadinmu da nishe-nishen da kalmomi ba sa iya bayyanawa.
english: In the same way, the Spirit also helps our weaknesses, for we don’t know how to pray as we ought. But the Spirit himself makes intercession for us with groanings which can’t be uttered.

hausa: Ku nuna ladabin da ya dace ga kowa. Ku ƙaunaci ’yan’uwantakar masu bi, ku ji tsoron Allah, ku girmama sarki.
english: Honor all men. Love the brotherhood. Fear God. Honor the king.

hausa: To, in na yi abin da ba na so in yi, ba ni ba ne nake yinsa, sai dai zunubin nan da yake zaune a cikina.
english: But if what I don’t desire, that I do, it is no more I that do it, but sin which dwells in me.

hausa: Filibus ya ce, “Ubangiji, ka nuna mana Uban, wannan kuwa zai biya bukatarmu.”
english: Philip said to him, “Lord, show us the Father, and that will be enough for us.”

hausa: Bitrus ya sāke yin mūsu, nan take kuwa zakara ya yi cara.
english: Peter therefore denied it again, and immediately the rooster crowed.

hausa: Amma za a miƙa akuyar da aka zaɓa ta wurin ƙuri’a a matsayi ta azazel da rai a gaban Ubangiji don a yi amfani da ita don kafara ta wurin korinta zuwa cikin jeji kamar azazel.
english: But the goat on which the lot fell for the scapegoat shall be presented alive before Yahweh, to make atonement for him, to send him away as the scapegoat into the wilderness.

hausa: Sai Ahab ya aika a duk fāɗin Isra’ila, ya kuma tattara annabawan a kan Dutsen Karmel.
english: So Ahab sent to all the children of Israel, and gathered the prophets together to Mount Carmel.

hausa: Gama ranar ɗaukan fansa tana a cikin zuciyata, kuma shekarar fansata ta zo.
english: For the day of vengeance was in my heart, and the year of my redeemed has come.

hausa: Hezekiya da dukan mutane suka yi farin ciki game da abin da Allah ya yi wa mutanensa, domin ya faru farat ɗaya.
english: Hezekiah and all the people rejoiced because of that which God had prepared for the people; for the thing was done suddenly.

hausa: Ga abin da Ubangiji Mai Iko Duka yana cewa, Allahnki, wanda ya kāre mutanensa, “Duba, na ƙwace daga hannunki kwaf da ya sa ki tangaɗi; daga wannan kwaf, kwaf na fushina, ba za ki ƙara sha ba.
english: Your Lord Yahweh, your God who pleads the cause of his people, says, “Behold, I have taken out of your hand the cup of staggering, even the bowl of the cup of my wrath. You will not drink it any more.

hausa: In kun kasa kunne sosai ga abin da yake faɗi, kuka kuma yi abin da na faɗa, zan zama magabci ga abokan gābanku, zan kuma yi hamayya da abokan hamayyanku.
english: But if you indeed listen to his voice, and do all that I speak, then I will be an enemy to your enemies, and an adversary to your adversaries.

hausa: Ya zo wurin abin da yake nasa, amma nasa ɗin ba su karɓe shi ba.
english: He came to his own, and those who were his own didn’t receive him.

hausa: Ku sani, ku kuma riƙe a zuciya a wannan rana, cewa Ubangiji shi ne Allah a sama da kuma a ƙasa. Babu wani kuma.
english: Know therefore today, and take it to heart, that Yahweh himself is God in heaven above and on the earth beneath. There is no one else.

hausa: To, a lokacin, yaren mutanen duniya ɗaya ne, maganarsu kuma ɗaya ce.
english: The whole earth was of one language and of one speech.

hausa: Sa’ad da ta ci gaba da yin karuwancinta a fili ta kuma nuna tsiraicinta, sai na ji ƙyamarta, na rabu da ita, kamar dai yadda na rabu da ’yar’uwarta.
english: So she uncovered her prostitution and uncovered her nakedness. Then my soul was alienated from her, just like my soul was alienated from her sister.

hausa: Tun daga lokacin nan yana jira a mai da abokan gābansa matashin ƙafafunsa,
english: from that time waiting until his enemies are made the footstool of his feet.

hausa: Musa ya ce wa dukan jama’ar Isra’ilawa, “Ga abin da Ubangiji ya umarta.
english: Moses spoke to all the congregation of the children of Israel, saying, “This is the thing which Yahweh commanded, saying,

hausa: Wanda ya fasa ƙofa ya buɗe, shi zai haura yă yi musu jagora, za su fashe bangon su fita. Sarkinsu zai wuce gabansu, Ubangiji kuma zai kasance a gaba.”
english: He who breaks open the way goes up before them. They break through the gate, and go out. Their king passes on before them, with Yahweh at their head.

hausa: Kun mutu tare da Kiristi. Yanzu ƙa’idodin wannan duniya ba su da iko a kanku. Don me kuke zama har yanzu kamar ku nasu ne? Kuna biyayya da umarnansu cewa,
english: If you died with Christ from the elemental spirits of the world, why, as though living in the world, do you subject yourselves to ordinances,

hausa: Sai maganar Ubangiji Maɗaukaki ta zo mini ta ce,
english: Then the word of Yahweh of Armies came to me, saying,

hausa: wanda ta wurinsa muka sami fansa da kuma gafarar zunubai.
english: in whom we have our redemption, the forgiveness of our sins.

hausa: Dawuda ya ce wa Abner, “Wane irin mutum ne kai? Ba kai ne soja mafi iya yaƙi a Isra’ila ba? Don me ba ka yi gadin ranka yă daɗe, sarki da kyau ba? Ɗazu wani ya shiga tsakiyarku don yă kashe ranka yă daɗe, sarki.
english: David said to Abner, “Aren’t you a man? Who is like you in Israel? Why then have you not kept watch over your lord the king? For one of the people came in to destroy your lord the king.

hausa: Yesu ya amsa ya ce, “Wani mutum ya tashi daga Urushalima za shi Yeriko, sai ya fāɗi a hannun mafasa, wato, ’yan fashi. Suka ƙwace tufafinsa, suka yi masa dūka, suka bar shi nan bakin rai da mutuwa.
english: Jesus answered, “A certain man was going down from Jerusalem to Jericho, and he fell among robbers, who both stripped him and beat him, and departed, leaving him half dead.

hausa: Za ka yi mutuwar marar kaciya a hannuwan baƙi. Na faɗa, in ji Ubangiji Mai Iko Duka.’ ”
english: You will die the death of the uncircumcised by the hand of strangers; for I have spoken it,” says the Lord Yahweh.’”

hausa: wanda yake ƙyifce da ido, yana yi alama da ƙafafunsa yana kuma nuni da yatsotsinsa,
english: who winks with his eyes, who signals with his feet, who motions with his fingers,

hausa: Kada ka gajiyar da kanka don ka yi arziki; ka kasance da hikimar dainawa.
english: Don’t weary yourself to be rich. In your wisdom, show restraint.

hausa: Saboda haka sai Musa ya yi kuka ga Ubangiji ya ce, “Ya Allah, ina roƙonka ka warkar da ita!”
english: Moses cried to Yahweh, saying, “Heal her, God, I beg you!”

hausa: Ya ƙara tawaye a kan zunubansa; ya tafa hannuwansa na reni a cikinmu ya kuma ƙara yawan maganganunsa ga Allah.”
english: For he adds rebellion to his sin. He claps his hands among us, and multiplies his words against God.”

hausa: Saboda haka suka kama shi, suka jefar da shi bayan katangar gonar inabin, suka kashe shi.
english: So they took him and threw him out of the vineyard, then killed him.

hausa: Da kowane bijimi, za a kasance da hadaya ta sha, na rabin kwalabar ruwan inabi; da rago kuwa, a kasance da kashi ɗaya bisa uku; da kowace tunkiya kuma, a kasance da kashi ɗaya bisa huɗu. Wannan ita ce hadaya ta ƙonawa don tsayawar kowane sabon wata na shekara.
english: Their drink offerings shall be half a hin of wine for a bull, the third part of a hin for the ram, and the fourth part of a hin for a lamb. This is the burnt offering of every month throughout the months of the year.

hausa: “Ba duk mai ce mini, ‘Ubangiji, Ubangiji,’ ne zai shiga mulkin sama ba, sai dai wanda yake aikata nufin Ubana da yake sama.
english: “Not everyone who says to me, ‘Lord, Lord,’ will enter into the Kingdom of Heaven, but he who does the will of my Father who is in heaven.

hausa: Solomon ya kawo ’yar Fir’auna daga Birnin Dawuda zuwa fadan da ya gina mata, gama ya ce, “Matata ba za tă zauna a fadan Dawuda sarkin Isra’ila ba, domin wuraren da akwatin alkawarin Ubangiji ya shiga masu tsarki ne.”
english: Solomon brought up Pharaoh’s daughter out of David’s city to the house that he had built for her; for he said, “My wife shall not dwell in the house of David king of Israel, because the places where Yahweh’s ark has come are holy.”

hausa: Haikalinmu mai tsarki da kuma mai daraja, inda kakanninmu suka yabe ka, an ƙone da wuta, kuma dukan abubuwan da muke ƙauna sun lalace.
english: Our holy and our beautiful house where our fathers praised you is burned with fire. All our pleasant places are laid waste.

hausa: Mai basira kan hango hatsari ya kuma kauce, marar azanci zai yi ta kutsa kai ciki, daga baya ya yi da na sani.
english: A prudent man sees danger and takes refuge; but the simple pass on, and suffer for it.

hausa: Ku ɗaga kawunanku, ya ku ƙofofi; ku ɗagu, ku daɗaɗɗun ƙofofi, don Sarkin ɗaukaka yă shiga.
english: Lift up your heads, you gates; yes, lift them up, you everlasting doors, and the King of glory will come in.

hausa: sai ya ce wa annabi Natan, “Ga ni, ina zama a fadar katakon al’ul, amma akwatin alkawarin Allah yana zaune a tenti.”
english: the king said to Nathan the prophet, “See now, I dwell in a house of cedar, but God’s ark dwells within curtains.”

hausa: Wane ne ya ba shi iko yă lura da duniya? Wane ne ya ba shi iko kan dukan duniya?
english: Who put him in charge of the earth? Or who has appointed him over the whole world?

hausa: Sa’ad da mugaye suke cin nasara, haka zunubi zai yi ta ƙaruwa, amma masu adalci za su ga fāɗuwar waɗannan mutane.
english: When the wicked increase, sin increases; but the righteous will see their downfall.

hausa: Masu albarka ne waɗanda suke zama a gidanka; kullum suna ta yabonka. Sela
english: Blessed are those who dwell in your house. They are always praising you. Selah.

hausa: Ɗan da ya gāje shi a matsayin firist, shi ne zai sa su har kwana bakwai, lokacin da ya shiga Tentin Sujada, don yă yi aiki a Wuri Mai Tsarki.
english: Seven days shall the son who is priest in his place put them on, when he comes into the Tent of Meeting to minister in the holy place.

hausa: Yabi Ubangiji, gama Ubangiji nagari ne; rera yabo ga sunansa, gama wannan yana da kyau.
english: Praise Yah, for Yahweh is good. Sing praises to his name, for that is pleasant.

hausa: Baniya, Meremot, Eliyashib,
english: Vaniah, Meremoth, Eliashib,

hausa: Ɗan Mutum zai mutu kamar yadda aka ƙaddara, amma kaiton mutumin da zai bashe shi.”
english: The Son of Man indeed goes as it has been determined, but woe to that man through whom he is betrayed!”

hausa: In waninku ya rasa hikima, ya kamata yă roƙi Allah, mai bayarwa hannu sake ga kowa ba tare da gori ba, za a kuwa ba shi.
english: But if any of you lacks wisdom, let him ask of God, who gives to all liberally and without reproach, and it will be given to him.

hausa: Zai feɗe hadaya ta ƙonawar, yă yayyanka shi gunduwa-gunduwa.
english: He shall skin the burnt offering and cut it into pieces.

hausa: Saboda haka ga abin Ubangiji Allah Maɗaukaki yana cewa, “Domin mutanen sun yi waɗannan maganganu, zan mai da maganata a bakinku wuta waɗannan mutane kuwa su zama itacen da za tă ci.
english: Therefore Yahweh, the God of Armies says, “Because you speak this word, behold, I will make my words in your mouth fire, and this people wood, and it will devour them.

hausa: A wurin kuwa, akwai wata mace wadda tana da ciwon zubar da jini, har na shekara goma sha biyu, amma babu wanda ya iya warkar da ita.
english: A woman who had a flow of blood for twelve years, who had spent all her living on physicians and could not be healed by any,

hausa: Shi ne kuma kan ikkilisiya, wadda take jikinsa. Shi ne mafari da kuma na farko da ya tashi daga matattu, domin a cikin kowane abu yă zama mafifici.
english: He is the head of the body, the assembly, who is the beginning, the firstborn from the dead, that in all things he might have the preeminence.

hausa: Firist zai kaɗa su a gaban Ubangiji, hadaya ce ta kaɗawa; mai tsarki ne kuma, zai zama na firist, tare da ƙirjin da aka kaɗa da kuma cinyar da aka kawo. Bayan haka, Banazaren zai iya shan ruwan inabi.
english: and the priest shall wave them for a wave offering before Yahweh. They are holy for the priest, together with the breast that is waved and the thigh that is offered. After that the Nazirite may drink wine.

hausa: Wannan, ita ce doka ta fari da kuma mafi girma.
english: This is the first and great commandment.

hausa: Ga abin da Ubangiji Mai Iko Duka yana cewa na ɗaga hannuna sama na rantse cewa al’ummai da suke kewaye da ku za su sha ba’a.
english: Therefore the Lord Yahweh says: “I have sworn, ‘Surely the nations that are around you will bear their shame.’

hausa: Sa’ad da Barnabas da Shawulu suka kammala aikinsu, sai suka komo daga Urushalima, tare da Yohanna, wanda ake kira Markus.
english: Barnabas and Saul returned to Jerusalem when they had fulfilled their service, also taking with them John who was called Mark.

hausa: Dukan mazan da aka ba su aiki a sansanin Yahuda bisa ga sashensu sun kai 186,400. Su ne za su ja gaba.
english: “All who were counted of the camp of Judah were one hundred eighty-six thousand four hundred, according to their divisions. They shall set out first.

hausa: Ya ɗaga kai sama, ya ja numfashi mai zurfi, sa’an nan ya ce masa, “Effata!” (Wato, “Buɗe!”).
english: Looking up to heaven, he sighed, and said to him, “Ephphatha!” that is, “Be opened!”

hausa: Sai Siman Bitrus, wanda yake da takobi, ya zāre, ya kai wa bawan babban firist sara, ya ɗauke masa kunnensa na dama (Sunan bawan kuwa Malkus ne.)
english: Simon Peter therefore, having a sword, drew it, struck the high priest’s servant, and cut off his right ear. The servant’s name was Malchus.

hausa: Kun san cewa iyalin gidan Istifanas ne suka fara tuba a Akayya. Sun kuma ba da kansu ga yi wa tsarkaka hidima. Ina roƙonku ’yan’uwa,
english: Now I beg you, brothers—you know the house of Stephanas, that it is the first fruits of Achaia, and that they have set themselves to serve the saints—

hausa: A waɗancan kwanaki, Yohanna Mai Baftisma ya zo, yana wa’azi a Hamadan Yahudiya
english: In those days, John the Baptizer came, preaching in the wilderness of Judea, saying,

hausa: Zuriyarka za tă zama kamar ƙurar ƙasa, za ka kuma bazu zuwa yamma da kuma gabas, zuwa arewa da kuma kudu. Dukan mutanen duniya za su sami albarka ta wurinka da kuma ta wurin ’ya’yanka.
english: Your offspring will be as the dust of the earth, and you will spread abroad to the west, and to the east, and to the north, and to the south. In you and in your offspring, all the families of the earth will be blessed.

hausa: Amma dole ku kawo ƙaramin ɗan’uwanku gare ni, saboda a tabbatar da maganarku har ba za ku mutu ba.” Suka kuwa yi haka.
english: Bring your youngest brother to me; so will your words be verified, and you won’t die.” They did so.

hausa: Domin ka washe al’ummai masu yawa, mutanen da suka rage za su washe ka. Domin ka zub da jinin mutane; ka hallaka ƙasashe, da birane, da kuma kowa da yake cikinsu.
english: Because you have plundered many nations, all the remnant of the peoples will plunder you because of men’s blood, and for the violence done to the land, to the city and to all who dwell in it.

hausa: A wannan lokaci muka kwashe dukan biranensa. Babu ɗaya daga birane sittin da ba mu ɗauke daga gare su ba, dukan yankin Argob, masarautar Og a Bashan.
english: We took all his cities at that time. There was not a city which we didn’t take from them: sixty cities, all the region of Argob, the kingdom of Og in Bashan.

hausa: Can, a bisa murfin da yake tsakanin kerubobi biyu da suke bisa akwatin alkawari na Shaida, zan sadu da kai, in kuma ba ka dukan umarnai domin Isra’ilawa.
english: There I will meet with you, and I will tell you from above the mercy seat, from between the two cherubim which are on the ark of the covenant, all that I command you for the children of Israel.

hausa: Zabura ta Dawuda. Na yi kira gare ka, ya Ubangiji; ka zo da sauri. Ka ji muryata sa’ad da na yi kira.
english: A Psalm by David. Yahweh, I have called on you. Come to me quickly! Listen to my voice when I call to you.

hausa: “Sa’ad da mutum mai ƙarfi, wanda yake da makamai yana gadin gidan kansa, an tsare lafiyar dukiyarsa ke nan.
english: “When the strong man, fully armed, guards his own dwelling, his goods are safe.

hausa: ’Yarsa ita ce Sheyera, wadda ta gina Bet-Horon na kwari da na tudu da kuma Uzzen-Sheyera. Zuriyarsa ita ce,
english: His daughter was Sheerah, who built Beth Horon the lower and the upper, and Uzzen Sheerah.
