hausa: wadda ta ce, “Rubuta a cikin naɗaɗɗen littafi abin da ka gani ka kuma aika ta zuwa ga ikkilisiyoyi bakwai, zuwa Afisa, Simirna, Fergamum, Tiyatira, Sardis, Filadelfiya, da kuma Lawodiseya.”
english: saying, “What you see, write in a book and send to the seven assemblies: to Ephesus, Smyrna, Pergamum, Thyatira, Sardis, Philadelphia, and to Laodicea.”

hausa: Ka mai da mu abin faɗa ga maƙwabtanmu, kuma abokan gābanmu suna mana ba’a.
english: You make us a source of contention to our neighbors. Our enemies laugh among themselves.

hausa: Amma ya ce, “Dole in yi wa’azin bisharar mulkin Allah ga sauran garuruwa, saboda wannan ne aka aiko ni.”
english: But he said to them, “I must preach the good news of God’s Kingdom to the other cities also. For this reason I have been sent.”

hausa: Ka sa abokan gābana suka juya suka gudu, na kuma hallaka abokan gābana.
english: You have also made my enemies turn their backs to me, that I might cut off those who hate me.

hausa: “In wani ya gayyace ka bikin aure, kada ka zaɓi wurin zama mai bangirma, don wataƙila akwai wani da ya fi ka girma, da aka gayyata.
english: “When you are invited by anyone to a wedding feast, don’t sit in the best seat, since perhaps someone more honorable than you might be invited by him,

hausa: Bayansu, sai ga waɗansu kawuna bakwai na dawa, suka fito sirara waɗanda iskar gabas ta sa suka yanƙwane.
english: Behold, seven heads of grain, thin and blasted with the east wind, sprung up after them.

hausa: Duk mai kunnen ji, yă ji abin da Ruhu yake faɗa wa ikkilisiyoyi. Duk wanda ya ci nasara zan ba shi kaɗan daga cikin ɓoyayyiyar Manna. Zan kuma ba shi farin dutse tare da sabon suna a rubuce a bisansa, sananne kawai ga mai karɓan dutsen.
english: He who has an ear, let him hear what the Spirit says to the assemblies. To him who overcomes, to him I will give of the hidden manna, and I will give him a white stone, and on the stone a new name written which no one knows but he who receives it.

hausa: Solomon ya amsa ya ce, “In ya nuna kansa mai biyayya, ba gashin kansa da zai fāɗi ƙasa; amma in aka same mugunta a cikinsa, zai mutu.”
english: Solomon said, “If he shows himself a worthy man, not a hair of his shall fall to the earth; but if wickedness is found in him, he shall die.”

hausa: Ya haskaka da ɗaukakar Allah, haskensa kuwa ya yi kamar lu’ulu’u mai daraja sosai, kamar yasfa, yana ƙyalƙyali kamar madubi.
english: having the glory of God. Her light was like a most precious stone, like a jasper stone, clear as crystal;

hausa: Bari kwanakinsa su zama kaɗan; bari wani yă ɗauki wurinsa na shugabanci.
english: Let his days be few. Let another take his office.

hausa: Amma daga baya suka canja ra’ayoyinsu suka maido bayinsu suka kuma sāke bautar da su.
english: but afterwards they turned, and caused the servants and the handmaids whom they had let go free to return, and brought them into subjection for servants and for handmaids.

hausa: Sarkin ya ba da umarnin nan ga dukan mutane, cewa, “Ku yi Bikin Ƙetarewa ga Ubangiji Allahnku, yadda aka rubuta a Littafin Alkawari.”
english: The king commanded all the people, saying, “Keep the Passover to Yahweh your God, as it is written in this book of the covenant.”

hausa: Yana zama tare da Siman, mai aikin fatu, wanda gidansa ke bakin teku.”
english: He is staying with a tanner named Simon, whose house is by the seaside.

hausa: Za a ɗaura zoban ƙyallen maƙalawa a ƙirji a zoban efod da shuɗiyar igiya, domin ƙyallen maƙalawa a ƙirji yă zauna a bisa abin ɗamarar efod, don kada yă kunce.
english: They shall bind the breastplate by its rings to the rings of the ephod with a lace of blue, that it may be on the skillfully woven band of the ephod, and that the breastplate may not swing out from the ephod.

hausa: Firist zai ƙone kitsen a bisa bagade, amma ƙirjin zai zama na Haruna da ’ya’yansa maza.
english: The priest shall burn the fat on the altar, but the breast shall be Aaron’s and his sons’.

hausa: Da shigarku gidan, ku yi gaisuwa.
english: As you enter into the household, greet it.

hausa: “Kaitonku, Farisiyawa, domin kuna ba wa Allah zakka na na’ana’arku, da ƙarƙashinku, da kuma sauran ganyen lambunku iri-iri, amma kun ƙyale adalci da ƙaunar Allah. Ya kamata da kun kiyaye na ƙarshen, ban ba barin na farkon.
english: But woe to you Pharisees! For you tithe mint and rue and every herb, but you bypass justice and God’s love. You ought to have done these, and not to have left the other undone.

hausa: Ba za ka yi amfani da sunan Ubangiji Allahnka a banza ba, gama Ubangiji zai ba wa duk mai yin amfani da sunansa a banza laifi.
english: “You shall not misuse the name of Yahweh your God; for Yahweh will not hold him guiltless who misuses his name.

hausa: Da yake, al’ada ce sarki yă nemi shawara daga sanannu a batun doka da adalci, sai ya yi magana da masu hikima waɗanda suke fahimtar lokuta
english: Then the king said to the wise men, who knew the times (for it was the king’s custom to consult those who knew law and judgment;

hausa: Ka ce musu, ‘Ga abin da Ubangiji Mai Iko Duka yana cewa babbar gaggafa mai manyan fikafikai, dogayen gasusuwa da gasusuwa da yawa masu launi iri-iri ta zo Lebanon. Ta cire kan al’ul,
english: and say, ‘The Lord Yahweh says: “A great eagle with great wings and long feathers, full of feathers which had various colors, came to Lebanon and took the top of the cedar.

hausa: Kada a yanka saniya, ko tunkiya da ɗanta rana ɗaya.
english: Whether it is a cow or ewe, you shall not kill it and its young both in one day.

hausa: Ku kuma iyaye, kada ku tsokane ’ya’yanku. Ku yi musu reno mai kyau. Ku koyar da su, ku kuma gargaɗe su game da Ubangiji.
english: You fathers, don’t provoke your children to wrath, but nurture them in the discipline and instruction of the Lord.

hausa: “ ‘Saboda haka ga abin da Ubangiji Mai Iko Duka yana cewa, “ ‘Domin ka ɗauka kai mai hikima ne, mai hikima kamar allah,
english: “‘therefore the Lord Yahweh says: “Because you have set your heart as the heart of God,

hausa: Ya yi magana a kan rayuwar itatuwa, daga al’ul na Lebanon zuwa hizzob da yake girma a bangaye. Ya kuma yi koyarwa game da dabbobi, da tsuntsaye, da abubuwa masu rarrafe, da kuma kifi.
english: He spoke of trees, from the cedar that is in Lebanon even to the hyssop that grows out of the wall; he also spoke of animals, of birds, of creeping things, and of fish.

hausa: Mahaifinsa da mahaifiyarsa suka ce, “Babu wata karɓaɓɓiyar yarinya a cikin zuriyarku ko cikin dukan mutanenmu ne? Dole ne ka tafi wajen Filistiyawa marasa kaciya ka nemi aure?” Amma Samson ya ce wa mahaifinsa, “A auro mini ita dai. Ita ta dace da ni.”
english: Then his father and his mother said to him, “Isn’t there a woman among your brothers’ daughters, or among all my people, that you go to take a wife of the uncircumcised Philistines?” Samson said to his father, “Get her for me, for she pleases me well.”

hausa: Na kuma ga wani babban mala’ika yana shela da babbar murya cewa, “Wa ya cancanta yă ɓalle hatiman nan yă kuma buɗe naɗaɗɗen littafin?”
english: I saw a mighty angel proclaiming with a loud voice, “Who is worthy to open the book, and to break its seals?”

hausa: A lokacin wahala zan yi kira gare ka, gama za ka amsa mini.
english: In the day of my trouble I will call on you, for you will answer me.

hausa: A jeri na uku, a sa yakin, da idon mage da ametis.
english: and the third row a jacinth, an agate, and an amethyst;

hausa: Musa da Haruna suka aikata dukan waɗannan mu’ujizai a gaban Fir’auna, amma Ubangiji ya taurare zuciyar Fir’auna, bai kuwa bar Isra’ilawa su fita daga ƙasarsa ba.
english: Moses and Aaron did all these wonders before Pharaoh, but Yahweh hardened Pharaoh’s heart, and he didn’t let the children of Israel go out of his land.

hausa: Daga gefen arewa, iyakarsu ta kama ne daga Urdun, ta wuce arewa a gangaren Yeriko, ta nufi yamma cikin ƙasar kan tudu, ta fito a jejin Bet-Awen.
english: Their border on the north quarter was from the Jordan. The border went up to the side of Jericho on the north, and went up through the hill country westward. It ended at the wilderness of Beth Aven.

hausa: Sa’ad da duk suka ci suka ƙoshi, sai ya ce wa almajiransa, “Ku tattara gutsattsarin da suka rage. Kada kome yă lalace.”
english: When they were filled, he said to his disciples, “Gather up the broken pieces which are left over, that nothing be lost.”

hausa: A sa mai da turare a kansa, hadaya ce ta hatsi.
english: You shall put oil on it and lay frankincense on it. It is a meal offering.

hausa: Guguwa tana fitowa daga inda take, sanyi kuma daga iska mai sanyi.
english: Out of its room comes the storm, and cold out of the north.

hausa: Sarkin Sodom ya ce wa Abram, “Ka ba ni mutanena da ka ƙwace daga hannun sarakunan nan kawai, ka riƙe kayayyakin don kanka.”
english: The king of Sodom said to Abram, “Give me the people, and take the goods for yourself.”

hausa: “Sai ya kira kowane ɗaya da maigidansa yake bin bashi. Ya tambayi na farkon ya ce, ‘Nawa ne maigidana yake bin ka?’
english: Calling each one of his lord’s debtors to him, he said to the first, ‘How much do you owe to my lord?’

hausa: Faɗa wa Shemahiya mutumin Nehelam,
english: Concerning Shemaiah the Nehelamite you shall speak, saying,

hausa: Dawuda ya kuma ci Mowabawa, suka zama bayinsa suka kuma biya haraji.
english: He defeated Moab; and the Moabites became servants to David and brought tribute.

hausa: Dole kuma yă kasance da shaida mai kyau ga waɗanda suke na waje, don kada yă zama abin kunya yă kuma fāɗa cikin tarkon Iblis.
english: Moreover he must have good testimony from those who are outside, to avoid falling into reproach and the snare of the devil.

hausa: Nan suka gicciye shi tare da waɗansu mutum biyu, ɗaya a kowane gefe da Yesu a tsakiya.
english: where they crucified him, and with him two others, on either side one, and Jesus in the middle.

hausa: ’Ya’yan Reyuwel maza su ne, Nahat, Zera, Shamma da Mizza. Waɗannan su ne jikokin Basemat matar Isuwa.
english: These are the sons of Reuel: Nahath, Zerah, Shammah, and Mizzah. These were the descendants of Basemath, Esau’s wife.

hausa: Me zan ce miki? Da me zan kwatanta ki, ke Diyar Urushalima? Da me zan misalta ki, yadda zan iya yi miki ta’aziyya, Ke Budurwa Diyar Sihiyona? Ciwonki yana da zurfi kamar teku. Wane ne zai iya warkar da ke?
english: What shall I testify to you? What shall I liken to you, daughter of Jerusalem? What shall I compare to you, that I may comfort you, virgin daughter of Zion? For your breach is as big as the sea. Who can heal you?

hausa: sai ka ce musu cewa, ‘Na roƙi sarki kada yă mai da ni gidan Yonatan in mutu a can.’ ”
english: then you shall tell them, ‘I presented my supplication before the king, that he would not cause me to return to Jonathan’s house, to die there.’”

hausa: Amma Maryamu ta riƙe dukan waɗannan abubuwa ta kuma yi ta tunaninsu a zuciyarta.
english: But Mary kept all these sayings, pondering them in her heart.

hausa: shekel 500 na kashiya, duk bisa ga ma’aunin shekel na tsattsarkan wuri, da moɗa na man zaitun.
english: and of cassia five hundred, according to the shekel of the sanctuary; and a hin of olive oil.

hausa: Kun yi gadonku a dogayen duwatsu masu tsayi da kuma a tudu mai tsawo; a can kuka haura don ku miƙa hadayunku.
english: On a high and lofty mountain you have set your bed. You also went up there to offer sacrifice.

hausa: “Saboda haka, yanzu zan murƙushe ku kamar yadda amalanke yakan murƙushe sa’ad da aka yi masa labtun hatsi.
english: Behold, I will crush you in your place, as a cart crushes that is full of grain.

hausa: Ka sayar da mutanenka a kuɗin da bai taka ƙara ya karye ba babu wata riba daga sayar da su da ka yi.
english: You sell your people for nothing, and have gained nothing from their sale.

hausa: Ta aiki bayinta mata, tana kuma kira daga wurare masu tsayi na birnin.
english: She has sent out her maidens. She cries from the highest places of the city:

hausa: Faɗin ɗakunan da suke gefe kewaye da haikalin ya yi ta ƙaruwa daga hawa zuwa hawa. Ginin da aka yi kewaye da haikalin ya yi ta ƙaruwa daga hawa zuwa hawa, don haka ɗakunan suka yi ta ƙara fāɗi yayinda suka ƙara bisa. Akwai mataki daga ɗaki na ƙasa zuwa ɗaki na bisa ta hanya hawa ɗaki na tsakiya.
english: The side rooms were wider on the higher levels, because the walls were narrower at the higher levels. Therefore the width of the house increased upward; and so one went up from the lowest level to the highest through the middle level.

hausa: Sa’an nan Allah ya ce wa Ibrahim. “Kai fa, sai ka kiyaye alkawarina, kai da zuriyarka bayanka, har tsararraki masu zuwa.
english: God said to Abraham, “As for you, you shall keep my covenant, you and your offspring after you throughout their generations.

hausa: Gama a nan ba mu da dawwammamen birni, sai dai muna zuba ido a kan birnin nan mai zuwa.
english: For we don’t have here an enduring city, but we seek that which is to come.

hausa: Gama miji shi ne kan mace, yadda Kiristi yake kai da kuma Mai Ceton ikkilisiya, wadda take jikinsa.
english: For the husband is the head of the wife, as Christ also is the head of the assembly, being himself the savior of the body.

hausa: Da ya buɗe Abis ɗin, sai hayaƙi ya taso daga cikin kamar hayaƙin matoya mai girma. Hayaƙin nan daga Abis ya duhunta rana da sararin sama.
english: He opened the pit of the abyss, and smoke went up out of the pit, like the smoke from a burning furnace. The sun and the air were darkened because of the smoke from the pit.

hausa: Almajiransa suka amsa suka ce, “Amma a ina, a wannan wurin da ba kowa, wani zai iya samun isashen burodi, don a ciyar da su?”
english: His disciples answered him, “From where could one satisfy these people with bread here in a deserted place?”

hausa: Ke kuma Kafarnahum, za a ɗaga ki sama ne? A’a, za ki gangara zuwa zurfafa ne. Da a ce ayyukan banmamakin da aka yi a cikinki ne a aka yi a Sodom, da tana nan har yă zuwa yau.
english: You, Capernaum, who are exalted to heaven, you will go down to Hades. For if the mighty works had been done in Sodom which were done in you, it would have remained until today.

hausa: Ka shirya da safe, ka hauro kan Dutsen Sinai. Ka gabatar da kanka a gare ni a can kan dutse.
english: Be ready by the morning, and come up in the morning to Mount Sinai, and present yourself there to me on the top of the mountain.

hausa: Daga Taffuwa kuma iyakar ta bi yamma zuwa kwazazzaban Kana, ta ƙarasa a Bahar Rum. Wannan shi ne gādon mutanen Efraim bisa ga iyalansu.
english: From Tappuah the border went along westward to the brook of Kanah; and ended at the sea. This is the inheritance of the tribe of the children of Ephraim according to their families;

hausa: Daraja da ɗaukaka suna a gabansa; ƙarfi da ɗaukaka suna a cikin tsarkakar wurinsa.
english: Honor and majesty are before him. Strength and beauty are in his sanctuary.

hausa: Da yake Allah ya mai da ku zaɓaɓɓu, tsarkaka, ƙaunatattu, sai ku dinga jin tausayin juna, kuna yin alheri, kuna nuna tawali’u da sauƙinkai da jimrewa.
english: Put on therefore, as God’s chosen ones, holy and beloved, a heart of compassion, kindness, lowliness, humility, and perseverance;

hausa: Dukan kwanakin mutumin da ake danniya fama yake yi, amma zuciya mai farin ciki yana yin biki kullum.
english: All the days of the afflicted are wretched, but one who has a cheerful heart enjoys a continual feast.

hausa: Sai na ce, ‘An kore ni daga fuskarka; duk da haka zan sāke duba wajen haikalinka mai tsarki.’
english: I said, ‘I have been banished from your sight; yet I will look again toward your holy temple.’

hausa: Sarki ya ware Mefiboshet ɗan Yonatan jikan Shawulu, saboda rantsuwar da take tsakanin Dawuda da Yonatan, ɗan Shawulu a gaban Ubangiji.
english: But the king spared Mephibosheth the son of Jonathan the son of Saul, because of Yahweh’s oath that was between them, between David and Jonathan the son of Saul.

hausa: Sai ya ɗibiya masa hannuwansa, ya keɓe shi, yadda Ubangiji ya umarta ta wurin Musa.
english: He laid his hands on him and commissioned him, as Yahweh spoke by Moses.

hausa: Solomon ya kasance da gonar inabi a Ba’al-Hamon; ya ba da hayar gonar inabi ga ’yan haya. Kowanne zai biya shekel dubu na azurfa don ’ya’yan inabin.
english: Solomon had a vineyard at Baal Hamon. He leased out the vineyard to keepers. Each was to bring a thousand shekels of silver for its fruit.

hausa: Nemi umarnin Allah da kuma shaidar jan kunne. Duk wanda bai yi magana bisa ga wannan kalma ba, ba su da amfani.
english: Turn to the law and to the covenant! If they don’t speak according to this word, surely there is no morning for them.

hausa: Yetur, Nafish da Kedema. Waɗannan su ne ’ya’yan Ishmayel maza.
english: Jetur, Naphish, and Kedemah. These are the sons of Ishmael.

hausa: Sai ya kalle su duka, sa’an nan ya ce wa mutumin, “Miƙo hannunka.” Sai ya miƙe, hannunsa kuwa ya koma lafiyayye.
english: He looked around at them all, and said to the man, “Stretch out your hand.” He did, and his hand was restored as sound as the other.

hausa: In waɗannan mutane sun mutu kamar yadda mutane suke mutuwa, in abin da yakan sami kowa shi ne ya same su, to, ba Ubangiji ne ya aiko ni ba.
english: If these men die the common death of all men, or if they experience what all men experience, then Yahweh hasn’t sent me.

hausa: Ahihud ɗan Shelomi, shugaba daga kabilar Asher;
english: Of the tribe of the children of Asher a prince, Ahihud the son of Shelomi.

hausa: Dukan abokanku sun manta da ku; ba su ƙara kulawa da ku. Na buge ku kamar yadda abokin gāba zai yi na kuma hukunta ku yadda mai mugunta zai yi, domin laifinku da girma yake zunubanku kuma da yawa suke.
english: All your lovers have forgotten you. They don’t seek you. For I have wounded you with the wound of an enemy, with the chastisement of a cruel one, for the greatness of your iniquity, because your sins were increased.

hausa: Yusuf ya tattara dukan kuɗaɗen da suke a Masar da Kan’ana don biyan hatsin da suke saya, ya kuwa kawo su a fadan Fir’auna.
english: Joseph gathered up all the money that was found in the land of Egypt, and in the land of Canaan, for the grain which they bought: and Joseph brought the money into Pharaoh’s house.

hausa: Wannan shi ne sashen hadayar da aka ba wa Haruna da ’ya’yansa maza, hadayar da aka yi ga Ubangiji da wuta, tun ranar da aka gabatar da su don su yi wa Ubangiji hidima a matsayin firist.
english: This is the consecrated portion of Aaron, and the consecrated portion of his sons, out of the offerings of Yahweh made by fire, in the day when he presented them to minister to Yahweh in the priest’s office;

hausa: Barcin ma’aikaci daɗi gare shi, ko yă ci kaɗan ko da yawa, amma yalwar mai arziki ba ta barinsa yă iya yin barci.
english: The sleep of a laboring man is sweet, whether he eats little or much; but the abundance of the rich will not allow him to sleep.

hausa: Kafin gari ya waye Bulus ya roƙe su duka su ci abinci. Ya ce, “Kwana goma sha huɗu ke nan, kuna zama cikin zulumi kun kuma kasance ba abinci, ba ku ci kome ba.
english: While the day was coming on, Paul begged them all to take some food, saying, “Today is the fourteenth day that you wait and continue fasting, having taken nothing.

hausa: Mahaifin yaron da kuma mahaifiyarsa suka yi mamaki abin da aka faɗa game da shi.
english: Joseph and his mother were marveling at the things which were spoken concerning him.

hausa: Amma mai mulkin masarautar Farisa ya tsare ni har kwana ashirin da ɗaya. Sai da Mika’ilu, ɗaya daga cikin manya shugabanni, ya zo ya taimake ni, saboda an tsare ni a can tare da sarkin Farisa.
english: But the prince of the kingdom of Persia withstood me twenty-one days; but, behold, Michael, one of the chief princes, came to help me because I remained there with the kings of Persia.

hausa: Firist zai ƙone sashe na ɓarzajjen hatsin da kuma mai, tare da turare don tunawa, gama hadaya ce da aka ƙone da wuta ga Ubangiji.
english: The priest shall burn as its memorial part of its crushed grain and part of its oil, along with all its frankincense. It is an offering made by fire to Yahweh.

hausa: Maskil na Asaf. Ya mutanena, ku ji koyarwata; ku saurari kalmomin bakina.
english: A contemplation by Asaph. Hear my teaching, my people. Turn your ears to the words of my mouth.

hausa: “Saboda haka ya bar ƙasar Kaldiyawa ya kuma yi zama a Haran. Bayan mutuwar mahaifinsa, Allah ya aika da shi wannan ƙasar da yanzu kuke zama.
english: Then he came out of the land of the Chaldaeans and lived in Haran. From there, when his father was dead, God moved him into this land where you are now living.

hausa: Sai Ubangiji ya ce wa Musa, “Ka ɗauki Yoshuwa ɗan Nun, mutumin da ruhun shugabanci yake a cikinsa, ka ɗibiya masa hannunka.
english: Yahweh said to Moses, “Take Joshua the son of Nun, a man in whom is the Spirit, and lay your hand on him.

hausa: Wa ya sani? Ko zai juya yă kuma ji tausayi yă sa mana albarka ta wurin hadaya ta gari da hadaya ta sha wa Ubangiji Allahnku.
english: Who knows? He may turn and relent, and leave a blessing behind him, even a meal offering and a drink offering to Yahweh, your God.

hausa: Ka aikata wannan a ɓoye, amma zan aikata wannan da rana tsaka, a gaban dukan Isra’ila.’ ”
english: For you did this secretly, but I will do this thing before all Israel, and before the sun.’”

hausa: waɗanda suke binne gawawwakin ’ya’yan farinsu da Ubangiji ya karkashe; gama Ubangiji ya hukunta allolinsu.
english: while the Egyptians were burying all their firstborn, whom Yahweh had struck among them. Yahweh also executed judgments on their gods.

hausa: Ka sa muka zama abin ba’a a cikin al’ummai; mutanen suna kaɗa mana kai.
english: You make us a byword among the nations, a shaking of the head among the peoples.

hausa: Na firistoci su ne, Yedahiya; Yehoyarib; Yakin;
english: Of the priests: Jedaiah, Jehoiarib, Jachin,

hausa: Ku ci burodi marar yisti cikin kwana bakwai; kada a sami wani abu mai yisti a cikinku, ko a sami yisti a ko’ina a wurinku.
english: Unleavened bread shall be eaten throughout the seven days; and no leavened bread shall be seen with you. No yeast shall be seen with you, within all your borders.

hausa: Ka yi mini jinƙai, ya Ubangiji, gama na yi kira gare ka dukan yini.
english: Be merciful to me, Lord, for I call to you all day long.

hausa: Sunana zai zama mai girma a cikin al’ummai, daga fitowar rana har zuwa fāɗuwarta. A kowane wuri za a miƙa wa sunana turare da tsabtacciyar hadaya domin sunana zai zama mai girma a cikin al’ummai, in ji Ubangiji Maɗaukaki.
english: For from the rising of the sun even to its going down, my name is great among the nations, and in every place incense will be offered to my name, and a pure offering; for my name is great among the nations,” says Yahweh of Armies.

hausa: Waɗannan su ne itatuwan zaitun biyu da kuma alkukai biyu da suke tsaye a gaban Ubangijin duniya.
english: These are the two olive trees and the two lamp stands, standing before the Lord of the earth.

hausa: Isra’ilawa suka yi makoki domin Musa a filayen Mowab kwana talatin, sai da lokacin kuka, da na makoki suka ƙare.
english: The children of Israel wept for Moses in the plains of Moab thirty days, until the days of weeping in the mourning for Moses were ended.

hausa: Ya ɗauke rawanin daga kan sarkinsu, nauyinsa ya kai talenti, na zinariya, an kuma yi masa ado da duwatsu masu daraja, aka aza shi a kan Dawuda. Ya kuma kwashe ganima mai yawa daga garin.
english: He took the crown of their king from off his head; and its weight was a talent of gold, and in it were precious stones; and it was set on David’s head. He brought a great quantity of plunder out of the city.

hausa: “Saboda haka ɗan mutum, ka yi annabci ka ce wa Gog, ‘Ga abin da Ubangiji Mai Iko Duka yana cewa a ranar, sa’ad da mutanena Isra’ila suna zaman lafiya, ba za ka sani ba?
english: “Therefore, son of man, prophesy, and tell Gog, ‘The Lord Yahweh says: “In that day when my people Israel dwells securely, will you not know it?

hausa: sai na ga ɗaukakar Allah na Isra’ila tana tahowa daga gabas. Muryarsa ta yi kamar rurin ruwaye masu gudu, ƙasa kuma ta haskaka da ɗaukakarsa.
english: Behold, the glory of the God of Israel came from the way of the east. His voice was like the sound of many waters; and the earth was illuminated with his glory.

hausa: duniya ta girgiza, sammai suka zuba ruwan sama, a gaban Allah, wanda ya bayyana a Sinai, a gaban Allah, Allah na Isra’ila.
english: The earth trembled. The sky also poured down rain at the presence of the God of Sinai— at the presence of God, the God of Israel.

hausa: Yesu ya ce, “Ka gaskata domin na ce maka na gan ka a gindin itacen ɓaure. Za ka ga abubuwan da suka fi haka.”
english: Jesus answered him, “Because I told you, ‘I saw you underneath the fig tree,’ do you believe? You will see greater things than these!”

hausa: Mun ji haka a Efrata, muka yi ƙaro da shi a filayen Ya’ar,
english: Behold, we heard of it in Ephrathah. We found it in the field of Jaar.

hausa: Sa’an nan mutanen Yahuda suka zo Hebron, a can kuwa suka naɗa Dawuda sarkin Yahuda. Sa’ad da aka gaya wa Dawuda cewa mutanen Yabesh Gileyad ne suka binne Shawulu,
english: The men of Judah came, and there they anointed David king over the house of Judah. They told David, “The men of Jabesh Gilead were those who buried Saul.”

hausa: Ta wurin yaƙi da zaman bauta ka hukunta shi, da tsananin tsawa kuma ka kore shi, kamar a ranar da iskar gabas ta hura.
english: In measure, when you send them away, you contend with them. He has removed them with his rough blast in the day of the east wind.

hausa: “Ka yi magana da Isra’ilawa, ka ce musu, ‘Sa’ad da kuka haye Urdun zuwa Kan’ana,
english: “Speak to the children of Israel, and tell them, ‘When you pass over the Jordan into the land of Canaan,

hausa: Haka mutanen Benyamin suka yi. Yayinda ’yan matan suke rawa, kowane mutum ya kama ɗaya ya yi gaba da ita ta zama matarsa. Sa’an nan suka komo ƙasar gādonsu suka sāke giggina garuruwan suka kuwa zauna a cikinsu.
english: The children of Benjamin did so, and took wives for themselves according to their number, of those who danced, whom they carried off. They went and returned to their inheritance, built the cities, and lived in them.

hausa: “Duk sa’ad da Isra’ilawa suka yi sansani, kowane mutum zai sauka a inda tutar ƙungiyar kabilarsa take. Sansanin zai kasance a kewaye da Tentin Sujada.”
english: “The children of Israel shall encamp every man by his own standard, with the banners of their fathers’ houses. They shall encamp around the Tent of Meeting at a distance from it.

hausa: Kai ne wurin ɓuyata; za ka tsare ni daga wahala ka kewaye ni da waƙoƙin ceto. Sela
english: You are my hiding place. You will preserve me from trouble. You will surround me with songs of deliverance. Selah.

hausa: Saboda haka ’yan’uwana, sa’ad da kuka taru don ci, ku jira juna.
english: Therefore, my brothers, when you come together to eat, wait for one another.

hausa: Duk da haka, labarinsa ya ƙara bazuwa sosai, har taron mutane suka dinga zuwa don jinsa, da kuma neman warkarwa daga cututtukansu.
english: But the report concerning him spread much more, and great multitudes came together to hear and to be healed by him of their infirmities.

hausa: Nebukadnezzar ya kwashe dukan kayayyaki daga haikalin Allah, babba da ƙarami, da ma’ajin haikalin Ubangiji da kuma ma’ajin sarki da na fadawansa zuwa Babilon.
english: All the vessels of God’s house, great and small, and the treasures of Yahweh’s house, and the treasures of the king and of his princes, all these he brought to Babylon.

hausa: “ ‘Duk mutumin Isra’ila ko baƙon da yake zama a cikinsu wanda ya ci wani jini, zan yi gāba da wannan mutum wanda ya ci jinin, za a kuma raba shi da mutanensa.
english: “‘Any man of the house of Israel, or of the strangers who live as foreigners among them, who eats any kind of blood, I will set my face against that soul who eats blood, and will cut him off from among his people.

hausa: To, Debora, ungozomar Rebeka ta rasu aka kuma binne ta a ƙarƙashin itacen oak, ƙasa da Betel. Saboda haka aka kira wurin Allon Bakut.
english: Deborah, Rebekah’s nurse, died, and she was buried below Bethel under the oak; and its name was called Allon Bacuth.

hausa: Na ƙudura in yi wa wannan birni lahani ba alheri ba, in ji Ubangiji. Za a ba da shi a hannuwan sarki Babilon, zai kuwa hallaka shi da wuta.’
english: For I have set my face on this city for evil, and not for good,” says Yahweh. “It will be given into the hand of the king of Babylon, and he will burn it with fire.”’

hausa: haka zai ba al’ummai masu yawa mamaki, sarakuna kuma za su riƙe bakunansu don mamaki. Gama abin da ba a faɗa musu ba, shi za su gani, kuma abin da ba su ji ba, shi za su fahimta.
english: so he will cleanse many nations. Kings will shut their mouths at him; for they will see that which had not been told them, and they will understand that which they had not heard.

hausa: ya kuma ba da ƙasarsa kamar abin gādo, abin gādo ga mutanensa Isra’ila.
english: and gave their land for a heritage, a heritage to Israel, his people.

hausa: Shi wannan da ya sauka ɗin, shi ne kuma ya hau zuwa can sama, kai, gaba da sammai, don mulkinsa yă cika duniya gaba ɗaya.)
english: He who descended is the one who also ascended far above all the heavens, that he might fill all things.

hausa: Mu kuwa muka ci gaba zuwa jirgin ruwan muka tashi muka nufi Assos inda za mu ɗauki Bulus. Ya yi wannan shirin don zai tafi can da ƙafa.
english: But we, going ahead to the ship, set sail for Assos, intending to take Paul aboard there; for he had so arranged, intending himself to go by land.

hausa: Sai mutumin ya tafi, ya yi ta ba da labari a cikin Dekafolis a kan babban alherin da Yesu ya yi masa. Dukan mutane kuwa suka yi mamaki.
english: He went his way, and began to proclaim in Decapolis how Jesus had done great things for him, and everyone marveled.

hausa: Mawaƙa. Zuriyar Asaf mutum 128.
english: The singers: the children of Asaph, one hundred twenty-eight.

hausa: Game da zancen nan na bishara kuwa, su abokan gāba ne saboda ku; amma game da zaɓen kuwa, su ƙaunatattunsa ne, albarkacin kakannin kakanninsu,
english: Concerning the Good News, they are enemies for your sake. But concerning the election, they are beloved for the fathers’ sake.

hausa: “Duk wanda ya yi fushi da kai tabbatacce zai sha kunya da ƙasƙanci; waɗanda suka yi hamayya da kai za su zama kamar ba kome ba su kuma hallaka.
english: Behold, all those who are incensed against you will be disappointed and confounded. Those who strive with you will be like nothing, and shall perish.

hausa: In wani yana tsammani shi annabi ne, ko yana da baiwar ruhaniya, bari yă gane cewa abin da nake rubuta muku umarnin Ubangiji ne.
english: If any man thinks himself to be a prophet or spiritual, let him recognize the things which I write to you, that they are the commandment of the Lord.

hausa: Ku yi biyayya ga Ubangiji Allahnku, ku bi umarnansa da ƙa’idodin da nake ba ku a yau.”
english: You shall therefore obey Yahweh your God’s voice, and do his commandments and his statutes, which I command you today.”

hausa: Mun yi zunubi, kamar yadda kakanninmu suka yi; mun yi ba daidai ba muka kuma aikata mugunta.
english: We have sinned with our fathers. We have committed iniquity. We have done wickedly.

hausa: Da kwana bakwai ɗin suka yi kusan cika, waɗansu Yahudawa daga lardin Asiya suka ga Bulus a haikali. Sai suka zuga taron duka, suka kama shi,
english: When the seven days were almost completed, the Jews from Asia, when they saw him in the temple, stirred up all the multitude and laid hands on him,

hausa: Siman ya bayyana mana yadda Allah da farko ya nuna damuwarsa ta wurin ɗaukan mutane daga cikin Al’ummai su zama nasa.
english: Simeon has reported how God first visited the nations to take out of them a people for his name.

hausa: Dukan dokokinsa suna a gabana; ban ƙi ko ɗaya daga umarnansa ba.
english: For all his ordinances were before me. As for his statutes, I didn’t depart from them.

hausa: A hannun Ubangiji akwai kwaf cike da ruwan inabi mai kumfa gauraye da kayan yaji; yakan zuba shi, dukan mugayen duniya kuwa su sha shi tas.
english: For in Yahweh’s hand there is a cup, full of foaming wine mixed with spices. He pours it out. Indeed the wicked of the earth drink and drink it to its very dregs.

hausa: “Ku koya mini, zan yi shiru; ku nuna mini inda ban yi daidai ba.
english: “Teach me, and I will hold my peace. Cause me to understand my error.

hausa: Saboda haka suka shiga Masar cikin rashin biyayya ga Ubangiji suka tafi har can Tafanes.
english: They came into the land of Egypt, for they didn’t obey Yahweh’s voice; and they came to Tahpanhes.

hausa: A rana ta goma sha biyar ga wannan wata, za a yi biki; kwana bakwai za a ci burodi marar yisti.
english: On the fifteenth day of this month shall be a feast. Unleavened bread shall be eaten for seven days.

hausa: To, ko da yake na rubuta muku, ba musamman a kan wanda ya yi laifin ba ne, ba kuwa a kan wanda aka cutar ba, sai dai domin a bayyana muku a gaban Allah tsananin kula da kuke yi mana.
english: So although I wrote to you, I wrote not for his cause that did the wrong, nor for his cause that suffered the wrong, but that your earnest care for us might be revealed in you in the sight of God.

hausa: Shirin ya yi wa Fir’auna da kuma dukan hafsoshinsa kyau.
english: The thing was good in the eyes of Pharaoh, and in the eyes of all his servants.

hausa: Fushin Ubangiji ba zai kau ba sai ya aikata nufin zuciyarsa. A kwanakin masu zuwa za ku gane sarai.
english: Yahweh’s anger will not return until he has executed and performed the intents of his heart. In the latter days, you will understand it perfectly.

hausa: Suka riƙe wannan zance a ɓoye tsakaninsu, suna tattaunawa ko mece ce ma’anar “tashi daga matattu.”
english: They kept this saying to themselves, questioning what the “rising from the dead” meant.

hausa: akwatin Alkawari da sandunansa da murfin kafara;
english: the ark of the covenant with its poles, the mercy seat,

hausa: A jikin bangayen babban zaure da kuma cikin wuri mai tsarki, ya gina ɗakuna kewaye da ginin, inda akwai ɗakuna a gefe.
english: Against the wall of the house, he built floors all around, against the walls of the house all around, both of the temple and of the inner sanctuary; and he made side rooms all around.

hausa: Farawar faɗa tana kamar ɓarkewa madatsar ruwa ne, saboda haka ka bar batun kafin faɗa ta ɓarke.
english: The beginning of strife is like breaching a dam, therefore stop contention before quarreling breaks out.

hausa: Ka ji muryata bisa ga ƙaunarka; ka kiyaye raina, ya Ubangiji, bisa ga dokokinka.
english: Hear my voice according to your loving kindness. Revive me, Yahweh, according to your ordinances.

hausa: Sa’an nan ku haura tare da shi, zai kuwa zo yă zauna a kujera sarautata, yă yi mulki a maimakona. Na naɗa shi mai mulki a bisa Isra’ila da Yahuda.”
english: Then come up after him, and he shall come and sit on my throne; for he shall be king in my place. I have appointed him to be prince over Israel and over Judah.”

hausa: dukan sauran iyalan kuma da matansu.
english: all the families who remain, every family apart, and their wives apart.

hausa: sowa ta farin ciki da murna, muryoyin amarya da na ango, da muryoyin waɗanda suka kawo hadayun salama a gidan Ubangiji suna cewa, “ ‘ “Ku yi godiya ga Ubangiji Maɗaukaki, gama Ubangiji mai alheri ne; ƙaunarsa za tă dawwama har abada.” Gama zan mayar da wadatar ƙasar kamar yadda suke a dā,’ in ji Ubangiji.
english: the voice of joy and the voice of gladness, the voice of the bridegroom and the voice of the bride, the voice of those who say, ‘Give thanks to Yahweh of Armies, for Yahweh is good, for his loving kindness endures forever;’ who bring thanksgiving into Yahweh’s house. For I will cause the captivity of the land to be reversed as at the first,” says Yahweh.

hausa: Ka aika da alamu masu banmamaki da al’ajabai a kan Fir’auna, a kan dukan shugabanninsa da kuma a kan dukan mutanen ƙasarsa, gama ka ga irin danniyar da suka yi wa mutanenka. Ka samo wa kanka suna, wadda ta dawwama har yă zuwa yau.
english: and showed signs and wonders against Pharaoh, against all his servants, and against all the people of his land, for you knew that they dealt proudly against them, and made a name for yourself, as it is today.

hausa: Saboda haka mutanen Dan suka kama hanyarsu, Mika kuwa da ya ga an fi ƙarfinsa, sai ya juya ya koma gida.
english: The children of Dan went their way; and when Micah saw that they were too strong for him, he turned and went back to his house.

hausa: Da yawa za su ce mini a wannan rana, ‘Ubangiji, Ubangiji, ashe, ba mu yi annabci a cikin sunanka ba, ba kuma a cikin sunanka ne muka fitar da aljanu, muka yi abubuwan banmamaki da yawa ba?’
english: Many will tell me in that day, ‘Lord, Lord, didn’t we prophesy in your name, in your name cast out demons, and in your name do many mighty works?’

hausa: Gama ni baranka na ɗauki lamunin saurayin a wurin mahaifinsa da cewa, ‘In ban komo maka da shi ba, sai alhakinsa yă zauna a kaina a gaban mahaifina, dukan raina!’
english: For your servant became collateral for the boy to my father, saying, ‘If I don’t bring him to you, then I will bear the blame to my father forever.’

hausa: Amma da yawa da suka ji saƙon suka gaskata, yawan mutanen kuwa ya ƙaru ya kai wajen dubu biyar.
english: But many of those who heard the word believed, and the number of the men came to be about five thousand.

hausa: “Na ce, ‘Ku “alloli” ne; dukanku ’ya’yan Mafi Ɗaukaka’ ne.
english: I said, “You are gods, all of you are sons of the Most High.

hausa: Kun san abin da ya faru a dukan Yahudiya, farawa daga Galili bayan baftismar da Yohanna ya yi wa’azi,
english: you yourselves know what happened, which was proclaimed throughout all Judea, beginning from Galilee, after the baptism which John preached;

hausa: Sai Dawuda ya kira sojojin Shawulu da kuma Abner ɗan Ner ya ce, “Abner ba za ka amsa mini ba?” Abner ya ce, “Wane ne yake kira yana damun sarki haka?”
english: and David cried to the people, and to Abner the son of Ner, saying, “Don’t you answer, Abner?” Then Abner answered, “Who are you who calls to the king?”

hausa: Sa’an nan ƙasar za tă ji daɗin hutun shekarun Asabbacinta, a dukan lokutan da take kango, ku kuwa kuna a ƙasar abokan gābanku, sa’an nan ƙasar za tă huta ta ji daɗin asabbatanta.
english: Then the land will enjoy its Sabbaths as long as it lies desolate and you are in your enemies’ land. Even then the land will rest and enjoy its Sabbaths.

hausa: Kana ƙaunar abin da yake daidai kana kuma ƙin mugunta; saboda haka Allah, Allahnka, ya sa ka a bisa abokanka ta wurin shafe ka da man farin ciki.
english: You have loved righteousness, and hated wickedness. Therefore God, your God, has anointed you with the oil of gladness above your fellows.

hausa: Duk sa’ad da na kawo gizagizai a bisa duniya, bakan gizo kuma ya bayyana a ciki gizagizan,
english: When I bring a cloud over the earth, that the rainbow will be seen in the cloud,

hausa: “Nan da nan bayan tsabar wahalan nan “ ‘sai a duhunta rana, wata kuma ba zai ba da haskensa ba; taurari kuma za su fāffāɗi daga sararin sama, za a kuma girgiza abubuwan sararin sama.’
english: “But immediately after the suffering of those days, the sun will be darkened, the moon will not give its light, the stars will fall from the sky, and the powers of the heavens will be shaken;

hausa: Sa’ad da ka yi alkawari ga Allah, kada ka ɓata lokaci wajen cika shi. Ba ya jin daɗin wawaye; ka cika alkawarinka.
english: When you vow a vow to God, don’t defer to pay it; for he has no pleasure in fools. Pay that which you vow.

hausa: Da rana, yayinda suke kallo, ka fid da kayanka da ka tattara don zuwa zaman bauta. Sa’an nan da yamma, yayinda suke kallo, ka fita kamar yadda mutane masu tafiyar zaman bauta sukan yi.
english: You shall bring out your baggage by day in their sight, as baggage for moving. You shall go out yourself at evening in their sight, as when men go out into exile.

hausa: Ubangiji ya ce wa Musa, “Ka ƙera siffar maciji ka rataye shi a bisa doguwar sanda; kowa da maciji ya sare shi, idan ya dubi macijin nan da ka rataye, zai rayu.”
english: Yahweh said to Moses, “Make a venomous snake, and set it on a pole. It shall happen that everyone who is bitten, when he sees it, shall live.”

hausa: Dubi abin da suke tofawa daga bakunansu, suna tofar da takuba daga leɓunansu, suna cewa, “Wa zai ji mu?”
english: Behold, they spew with their mouth. Swords are in their lips, “For”, they say, “who hears us?”

hausa: Ku da kuke zama a Lakish, ku ɗaura wa dawakai kekunan yaƙi. Gama ku kuka fara yin zunubi a Sihiyona, gama an sami laifofin Isra’ila a cikinku.
english: Harness the chariot to the swift steed, inhabitant of Lachish. She was the beginning of sin to the daughter of Zion; for the transgressions of Israel were found in you.

hausa: Waɗansu sun yi ta yawo a jejin hamada, ba su sami hanya zuwa birnin da za su zauna ba.
english: They wandered in the wilderness in a desert way. They found no city to live in.

hausa: Gama dole dukanmu mu bayyana a gaban kujerar shari’ar Kiristi, domin kowannenmu yă karɓi ladan aikin da ya yi a wannan jiki, ko mai kyau ne ko marar kyau.
english: For we must all be revealed before the judgment seat of Christ that each one may receive the things in the body according to what he has done, whether good or bad.

hausa: Sai sarkin fada ya raɗa musu sababbin sunaye, ga Daniyel ya raɗa masa Belteshazar; ga Hananiya ya raɗa masa Shadrak; ga Mishayel ya raɗa masa Meshak; ga Azariya kuma ya raɗa masa Abednego.
english: The prince of the eunuchs gave names to them: to Daniel he gave the name Belteshazzar; to Hananiah, Shadrach; to Mishael, Meshach; and to Azariah, Abednego.

hausa: Muna tunawa da aikinku ba fasawa a gaban Allah da Ubanmu ta wurin bangaskiya, da famar da kuke yi domin ƙauna, da kuma begenku marar gushewa ga Ubangijinmu Yesu Kiristi.
english: remembering without ceasing your work of faith and labor of love and perseverance of hope in our Lord Jesus Christ, before our God and Father.

hausa: Waɗannan duka suna dogara gare ka don ka ba su abincinsu a daidai lokaci.
english: These all wait for you, that you may give them their food in due season.

hausa: Gama irin waɗannan mutane ba sa bautar Ubangijinmu Kiristi, sai dai cikinsu. Ta wurin yaudara da kuma daɗin baki, suna ruɗin marasa wayo.
english: For those who are such don’t serve our Lord Jesus Christ, but their own belly; and by their smooth and flattering speech they deceive the hearts of the innocent.

hausa: Waɗansu suka zo daga Efraim, waɗanda ainihinsu daga Amalek ne; Benyamin yana tare da mutanen da suka bi ka. Daga Makir, shugabannin sojoji suka gangaro, daga Zebulun waɗanda suke riƙe da sandan komanda suka fito.
english: Those whose root is in Amalek came out of Ephraim, after you, Benjamin, among your peoples. Governors come down out of Machir. Those who handle the marshal’s staff came out of Zebulun.

hausa: Ranar da aka shirya domin Yahudawa su yi wannan a dukan lardunan Sarki Zerzes, ita ce ranar goma sha uku ga watan goma sha biyu, wato, watan Adar.
english: on one day in all the provinces of King Ahasuerus, on the thirteenth day of the twelfth month, which is the month Adar.

hausa: Suka yi allo tsattsarka da zinariya tsantsa, suka zāna rubutu irin na hatimi a kansa haka, Mai tsarki ga Ubangiji.
english: They made the plate of the holy crown of pure gold, and wrote on it an inscription, like the engravings of a signet: “HOLY TO YAHWEH”.

hausa: Zai zama alama tsakanina da Isra’ilawa har abada, gama cikin kwana shida Ubangiji ya yi sama da ƙasa, a rana ta bakwai kuma ya daina aiki, ya kuma huta.’ ”
english: It is a sign between me and the children of Israel forever; for in six days Yahweh made heaven and earth, and on the seventh day he rested, and was refreshed.’”

hausa: Zan ƙarfafa hannuwan sarkin Babilon, amma hannuwan Fir’auna za su shanye. Sa’an nan za su san cewa ni ne Ubangiji, sa’ad da na sa takobi a hannun sarkin Babilon na kuma miƙa shi a kan Masar.
english: I will hold up the arms of the king of Babylon, but the arms of Pharaoh will fall down. Then they will know that I am Yahweh when I put my sword into the hand of the king of Babylon, and he stretches it out on the land of Egypt.

hausa: Waɗannan su ne aka haifa wa Dawuda a Hebron, inda ya yi mulki shekaru bakwai da wata shida. Dawuda ya yi mulki a Urushalima shekaru talatin da uku,
english: six were born to him in Hebron; and he reigned there seven years and six months. He reigned thirty-three years in Jerusalem;

hausa: Tera yi shekaru 205, ya kuma mutu a Haran.
english: The days of Terah were two hundred five years. Terah died in Haran.

hausa: Sai Musa ya ba wa mutanen Gad, mutanen Ruben, da rabin mutanen Manasse ɗan Yusuf, masarautar Sihon, sarkin Amoriyawa, da masarautar Og na Bashan, dukan ƙasar, tare da biranenta da kuma yankunan da suke kewaye.
english: Moses gave to them, even to the children of Gad, and to the children of Reuben, and to the half-tribe of Manasseh the son of Joseph, the kingdom of Sihon king of the Amorites, and the kingdom of Og king of Bashan; the land, according to its cities and borders, even the cities of the surrounding land.

hausa: amma akan jarrabce kowane mutum sa’ad da muguwar sha’awarsa ta janye shi ta kuma rinjaye shi.
english: But each one is tempted when he is drawn away by his own lust and enticed.

hausa: Har yanzu zan manta, ya muguwar gida da dukiyarki da kika samu a muguwar hanya zan kuma manta da bugaggen mudun awo wanda ake zargi?
english: Are there yet treasures of wickedness in the house of the wicked, and a short ephah that is accursed?

hausa: Har ma bayan wannan, Yerobowam bai canja daga mugayen hanyoyinsa ba, amma ya ƙara naɗa firistoci domin masujadai da suke kan tuddai daga kowane irin mutane. Duk wanda ya so yă zama firist sai yă naɗa shi don aiki a masujadai da suke kan tuddai.
english: After this thing, Jeroboam didn’t turn from his evil way, but again made priests of the high places from among all the people. Whoever wanted to, he consecrated him, that there might be priests of the high places.

hausa: Amma sa’ad da kuka haye Urdun, kuka zauna a ƙasar da Ubangiji Allahnku yake ba ku ita gādo, zai kuwa ba ku hutu daga dukan abokan gābanku da suke kewaye da ku, kuka sami zaman lafiya,
english: But when you go over the Jordan and dwell in the land which Yahweh your God causes you to inherit, and he gives you rest from all your enemies around you, so that you dwell in safety,

hausa: da ita mai girbi ba ya iya cika hannuwansa, balle wanda yake tarawa yă cika hannuwansa.
english: with which the reaper doesn’t fill his hand, nor he who binds sheaves, his bosom.

hausa: Babiloniyawa da dukan Kaldiyawa, mutanen Fekod da Showa da Kowa, da dukan Assuriyawa, samari masu bansha’awa, dukan gwamnoni da manyan sojoji, hafsoshin keken yaƙin da mutane masu manyan matsayi, dukansu a bisa dawakai.
english: the Babylonians and all the Chaldeans, Pekod, Shoa, Koa, and all the Assyrians with them; all of them desirable young men, governors and rulers, princes and men of renown, all of them riding on horses.

hausa: Ya Ubangiji Allah Maɗaukaki, har yaushe fushinka zai yi ta ƙuna a kan addu’o’in mutanenka?
english: Yahweh God of Armies, how long will you be angry against the prayer of your people?

hausa: Allah zai hukunta waɗanda ba namu ba. “Ku yi waje da irin mugun mutumin nan daga cikinku.”
english: But those who are outside, God judges. “Put away the wicked man from among yourselves.”

hausa: Da mutumin da matarsa suka ji motsin Ubangiji Allah yana takawa a lambun a sanyin yini, sai suka ɓuya daga Ubangiji Allah a cikin itatuwan lambu.
english: They heard Yahweh God’s voice walking in the garden in the cool of the day, and the man and his wife hid themselves from the presence of Yahweh God among the trees of the garden.

hausa: Wani daga cikin malaman dokoki ya zo ya ji suna muhawwara. Da ya lura cewa Yesu ya amsa musu daidai, sai ya tambaye shi ya ce, “A cikin dukan dokoki, wacce ta fi girma duka?”
english: One of the scribes came and heard them questioning together, and knowing that he had answered them well, asked him, “Which commandment is the greatest of all?”

hausa: Sai ya dinga yin wa’azi a majami’un Yahudiya.
english: He was preaching in the synagogues of Galilee.

hausa: Amma Yoshuwa ya ce wa mutanen Yusuf, wa Efraim da Manasse, “Kuna da yawa, kuna kuma da ƙarfi sosai. Ba wuri ɗaya kaɗai za ku samu gādo ba,
english: Joshua spoke to the house of Joseph, that is, to Ephraim and to Manasseh, saying, “You are a numerous people, and have great power. You shall not have one lot only;

hausa: Mutumin ya ce, “Babu ko ɗaya, na dai zo ne a matsayin shugaban rundunar sojojin Ubangiji.” Sai Yoshuwa ya kwanta da fuskarsa har ƙasa, ya girmama shi, ya ce masa, “Ranka yă daɗe, wane saƙo kake da shi domin bawanka?”
english: He said, “No; but I have come now as commander of Yahweh’s army.” Joshua fell on his face to the earth, and worshiped, and asked him, “What does my lord say to his servant?”

hausa: Isra’ila suka nace cikin dukan zunuban Yerobowam, ba su kuwa rabu da su ba
english: The children of Israel walked in all the sins of Jeroboam which he did; they didn’t depart from them

hausa: Siraran kawunan dawan nan suka haɗiye kawuna bakwai nan masu kyau. Na faɗa wannan wa masu duba, amma ba wanda ya iya fassara mini shi.”
english: The thin heads of grain swallowed up the seven good heads of grain. I told it to the magicians, but there was no one who could explain it to me.”

hausa: To, kamar yadda ikkilisiya take biyayya ga Kiristi, haka ma ya kamata mata su yi biyayya ga mazansu cikin kome.
english: But as the assembly is subject to Christ, so let the wives also be to their own husbands in everything.

hausa: Yowab ya ce, “Allah yă sawwaƙe! Allah yă sawwaƙe in hallaka, ko in lalace gādon Ubangiji.
english: Joab answered, “Far be it, far be it from me, that I should swallow up or destroy.

hausa: Ka kiyaye ni daga hanyoyin ruɗu; ka yi mini alheri ta wurin dokokinka.
english: Keep me from the way of deceit. Grant me your law graciously!

hausa: “Ka roƙi Ubangiji Allahnka yă ba ka alama, ko daga zurfafa masu zurfi ko kuwa daga can cikin sama.”
english: “Ask a sign of Yahweh your God; ask it either in the depth, or in the height above.”

hausa: A ranan nan zan sa kowane doki yă tsorata, mai hawan dokin kuma yă haukace,” in ji Ubangiji. “Zan sa idanuna in tsare gidan Yahuda, amma zan makantar da dukan dawakan al’ummai.
english: In that day,” says Yahweh, “I will strike every horse with terror and his rider with madness. I will open my eyes on the house of Judah, and will strike every horse of the peoples with blindness.

hausa: Ku yi makoki kamar budurwa a cikin tsummoki tana baƙin ciki domin mijinta na ƙuruciyarta.
english: Mourn like a virgin dressed in sackcloth for the husband of her youth!

hausa: Surukinsa, mahaifin yarinyar, ya sha kansa, yă dakata; saboda haka ya dakata tare da shi har kwana uku, yana ci yana sha, yana kuma kwanciya a can.
english: His father-in-law, the young lady’s father, kept him there; and he stayed with him three days. So they ate and drank, and stayed there.

hausa: Amma Ubangiji ya amsa ya ce, “Marta, Marta, hankalinki ya tashi, kuma kina damuwa a kan abubuwa da yawa.
english: Jesus answered her, “Martha, Martha, you are anxious and troubled about many things,

hausa: Ku yi murna da masu murna, ku yi kuka da masu kuka.
english: Rejoice with those who rejoice. Weep with those who weep.

hausa: Ku kiyaye umarnan Ubangiji Allahnku, kuna tafiya cikin hanyoyinsa, kuna kuma girmama shi.
english: You shall keep the commandments of Yahweh your God, to walk in his ways, and to fear him.

hausa: Sa’ad da Isra’ila ya ga ’ya’yan Yusuf maza, sai ya yi tambaya, “Su wane ne waɗannan?”
english: Israel saw Joseph’s sons, and said, “Who are these?”

hausa: Sa’an nan al’ummai za su san cewa Ni Ubangiji na mai da Isra’ila mai tsarki, sa’ad da wuri mai tsarkina yana a cikinsu har abada.’ ”
english: The nations will know that I am Yahweh who sanctifies Israel, when my sanctuary is among them forever more.”’”

hausa: Ba su hallakar da mutanen yadda Ubangiji ya umarce su ba,
english: They didn’t destroy the peoples, as Yahweh commanded them,

hausa: Masarawa, dukan dawakan Fir’auna da kekunan yaƙi da mahaya da sojoji, suka bi Isra’ilawa suka cin musu yayinda suke a sansani kusa da teku kurkusa da Fi Hahirot, wanda ya fuskanci Ba’al-Zafon.
english: The Egyptians pursued them. All the horses and chariots of Pharaoh, his horsemen, and his army overtook them encamping by the sea, beside Pihahiroth, before Baal Zephon.

hausa: “Iri zai yi girma da kyau, kuringa za tă ba da ’ya’yanta, ƙasa za tă ba da hatsi, sama kuma za tă ba da raɓa. Zan ba da duk waɗannan abubuwa su zama gādo ga raguwar mutanen nan.
english: “For the seed of peace and the vine will yield its fruit, and the ground will give its increase, and the heavens will give their dew. I will cause the remnant of this people to inherit all these things.

hausa: ’Ya’yan nan mata na Zelofehad, ɗan Hefer, ɗan Gileyad, ɗan Makir, ɗan Manasse, suna cikin kabilan Manasse ɗan Yusuf, suka tafi ƙofar shiga Tentin Sujada. Sunayensu kuwa su ne Mala, Nowa, Hogla, Milka da kuma Tirza.
english: Then the daughters of Zelophehad, the son of Hepher, the son of Gilead, the son of Machir, the son of Manasseh, of the families of Manasseh the son of Joseph came near. These are the names of his daughters: Mahlah, Noah, Hoglah, Milcah, and Tirzah.

hausa: Lokacin da na yi wa gizagizai riga na kuma naɗe su a cikin duhu sosai,
english: when I made clouds its garment, and wrapped it in thick darkness,

hausa: Duk sa’ad da sarki ya tafi haikalin Ubangiji, masu tsaron sukan tafi tare da shi, suna riƙe da garkuwoyi, daga baya kuma su mai da su a ɗakin tsaro.
english: As often as the king entered into Yahweh’s house, the guard came and bore them, then brought them back into the guard room.

hausa: Zan yabe ka da zuciya ta gaskiya yayinda nake koyon dokokinka masu adalci.
english: I will give thanks to you with uprightness of heart, when I learn your righteous judgments.

hausa: Waɗannan su ne mutanen yankin da suka dawo daga zaman bautar da Nebukadnezzar sarkin Babilon ya kame (sun dawo Urushalima da Yahuda, kowanne zuwa garinsa.
english: These are the children of the province who went up out of the captivity of those who had been carried away, whom Nebuchadnezzar the king of Babylon had carried away, and who returned to Jerusalem and to Judah, everyone to his city,

hausa: “Uba, ina so waɗanda ka ba ni su kasance tare da ni a inda nake, su kuma ga ɗaukakata, ɗaukakar da ka ba ni domin kana ƙaunata kafin halittar duniya.
english: Father, I desire that they also whom you have given me be with me where I am, that they may see my glory which you have given me, for you loved me before the foundation of the world.

hausa: Sammai kuwa sun yi shelar adalcinsa gama Allah kansa alƙali ne. Sela
english: The heavens shall declare his righteousness, for God himself is judge. Selah.

hausa: Saboda haka na rena kaina na kuma tuba cikin ƙura da toka.”
english: Therefore I abhor myself, and repent in dust and ashes.”

hausa: Saboda haka ga abin da Ubangiji, Allah na Isra’ila ya ce, zan jawo wa Urushalima da kuma Yahuda masifar da duk kunnen da ya ji, sai ya kusa suma.
english: therefore Yahweh the God of Israel says, ‘Behold, I will bring such evil on Jerusalem and Judah that whoever hears of it, both his ears will tingle.

hausa: Sarkin kuma ya lalatar da masujadan kan tuddan da suke gabas da Urushalima, kudu da Tudun Hallaka, waɗanda Solomon sarkin Isra’ila ya gina don Ashtarot, ƙazantacciyar alliyar Sidoniyawa, da Kemosh ƙazantaccen allah na Mowab, da kuma Molek allahn banƙyama na mutanen Ammon.
english: The king defiled the high places that were before Jerusalem, which were on the right hand of the mountain of corruption, which Solomon the king of Israel had built for Ashtoreth the abomination of the Sidonians, and for Chemosh the abomination of Moab, and for Milcom the abomination of the children of Ammon.

hausa: Ku gai da Asinkiritus, Filegon, Hermes, Faturobas, Hermas da kuma ’yan’uwan da suke tare da su.
english: Greet Asyncritus, Phlegon, Hermes, Patrobas, Hermas, and the brothers who are with them.

hausa: Ahaziya yana da shekara ashirin da biyu sa’ad da ya zama sarki, ya kuma yi mulki a Urushalima shekara guda. Sunan mahaifiyarsa Ataliya ce, jikanyar Omri.
english: Ahaziah was forty-two years old when he began to reign, and he reigned one year in Jerusalem. His mother’s name was Athaliah the daughter of Omri.

hausa: Ku haura zuwa kan duwatsu ku sauko da katakai don ku gina gidan, don ni ma in ji daɗinsa, in kuma sami ɗaukaka,” in ji Ubangiji.
english: Go up to the mountain, bring wood, and build the house. I will take pleasure in it, and I will be glorified,” says Yahweh.

hausa: Tare da bijiman, ragunan da kuma ’yan raguna, a miƙa hadayunsu na gari da hadayu na sha bisa ga adadin da aka ƙayyade.
english: their meal offering and their drink offerings for the bulls, for the rams, and for the lambs, according to their number, after the ordinance;

hausa: Sun ga ayyukan Ubangiji, ayyukansa masu banmamaki a cikin zurfin teku.
english: these see Yahweh’s deeds, and his wonders in the deep.

hausa: Suka sauke Ɗaukakarsu saboda siffar bijimi, wanda yake cin ciyawa.
english: Thus they exchanged their glory for an image of a bull that eats grass.

hausa: Sihiyona ta miƙa hannunta, amma ba wani da zai yi mata ta’aziyya. Ubangiji ya umarta cewa maƙwabtansa za su zama maƙiyansa; Urushalima ta zama abar ƙyama a cikinsu.
english: Zion spreads out her hands. There is no one to comfort her. Yahweh has commanded concerning Jacob, that those who are around him should be his adversaries. Jerusalem is among them as an unclean thing.

hausa: Surukar Siman tana kwance da zazzaɓi, sai suka gaya wa Yesu game da ita.
english: Now Simon’s wife’s mother lay sick with a fever, and immediately they told him about her.

hausa: Dubu huɗu su zama matsaran ƙofofi, dubu huɗu kuma su yabi Ubangiji da kayayyakin bushe-bushe da na kaɗe-kaɗe waɗanda na tanada saboda wannan manufa.”
english: four thousand were doorkeepers, and four thousand praised Yahweh with the instruments which I made for giving praise.”

hausa: I, kuma tun fil azal ni ne shi. Babu wani da zai amshi daga hannuna. Sa’ad da na aikata, wa zai iya sauyawa?”
english: Yes, since the day was, I am he. There is no one who can deliver out of my hand. I will work, and who can hinder it?”

hausa: Sa’an nan Sarki Zedekiya ya aika a kawo shi aka kuma kawo shi fada, inda ya tambaye shi a kaɗaice ya ce, “Akwai wata magana daga Ubangiji?” Irmiya ya amsa ya ce, “I, za a ba da kai ga sarkin Babilon.”
english: then Zedekiah the king sent and had him brought out. The king asked him secretly in his house, “Is there any word from Yahweh?” Jeremiah said, “There is.” He also said, “You will be delivered into the hand of the king of Babylon.”

hausa: A koyaushe ku kasance kuna addu’a da roƙo ta wurin ikon Ruhu ba fasawa. A kan wannan manufa ku zauna a faɗake da matuƙar naci, kuna yin wa dukan mutanen Ubangiji addu’a.
english: with all prayer and requests, praying at all times in the Spirit, and being watchful to this end in all perseverance and requests for all the saints.

hausa: Gama ba na jin daɗin mutuwar wani, in ji Ubangiji Mai Iko Duka. Ku tuba don ku rayu!
english: For I have no pleasure in the death of him who dies,” says the Lord Yahweh. “Therefore turn yourselves, and live!

hausa: Zan ƙwace kekunan yaƙi daga Efraim, da kuma dawakan yaƙi daga Urushalima, za a kuma karya bakan yaƙi. Zai yi shelar salama ga al’ummai. Mulkinsa zai yaɗu daga teku zuwa teku, daga Kogi kuma zuwa ƙarshen duniya.
english: I will cut off the chariot from Ephraim and the horse from Jerusalem. The battle bow will be cut off; and he will speak peace to the nations. His dominion will be from sea to sea, and from the River to the ends of the earth.

hausa: Isuwa ya ɗauko matansa daga cikin matan Kan’ana, ya ɗauko Ada ’yar Elon mutumin Hitti, da Oholibama ’yar Ana wadda take jikanyar Zibeyon Bahiwiye
english: Esau took his wives from the daughters of Canaan: Adah the daughter of Elon, the Hittite; and Oholibamah the daughter of Anah, the daughter of Zibeon, the Hivite;

hausa: In takawata ta kauce daga hanya, in zuciyata ta bi abin da idanuna ke so, ko kuma in hannuwana suna da laifi;
english: if my step has turned out of the way, if my heart walked after my eyes, if any defilement has stuck to my hands,

hausa: Saboda haka Ishaku ya kira Yaƙub, ya kuma albarkace shi, sa’an nan ya umarce shi ya ce, “Kada ka auri mace daga Kan’ana.
english: Isaac called Jacob, blessed him, and commanded him, “You shall not take a wife of the daughters of Canaan.

hausa: Shawulu ya sami labari cewa Dawuda ya tafi Keyila, sai ya ce, “Allah ya bashe shi a hannuna, domin Dawuda ya kulle kansa ke nan da ya shiga birnin da yake da ƙofofin da ake kulle da ƙarafa.”
english: Saul was told that David had come to Keilah. Saul said, “God has delivered him into my hand, for he is shut in by entering into a town that has gates and bars.”

hausa: Sarki ya sa aka yi zubi a abin yin tubalin laka a filin Urdun, tsakanin Sukkot da Zaretan.
english: The king cast them in the plain of the Jordan, in the clay ground between Succoth and Zarethan.

hausa: Kamar yadda kuka zama abin la’ana a ƙasashe, ya Yahuda da Isra’ila, haka zan cece ku, za ku kuma zama albarka. Kada ku ji tsoro, sai dai ku bar hannuwanku su zama da ƙarfi.”
english: It shall come to pass that, as you were a curse among the nations, house of Judah and house of Israel, so I will save you, and you shall be a blessing. Don’t be afraid. Let your hands be strong.”

hausa: Zan ba su zuciya ɗaya in kuma sa sabon ruhu a cikinsu; zan fid da zuciyar dutse daga gare su in kuma ba su zuciya ta nama.
english: I will give them one heart, and I will put a new spirit within them. I will take the stony heart out of their flesh, and will give them a heart of flesh,

hausa: Game da Dan ya ce, “Dan ɗan zaki ne, yana tsalle daga Bashan.”
english: About Dan he said, “Dan is a lion’s cub that leaps out of Bashan.”

hausa: Don mai bi da kaɗe-kaɗe. Maskil ne na ’Ya’yan Kora maza. Kamar yadda barewa take marmarin ruwan rafuffuka, haka raina yake marmarinka, ya Allah.
english: For the Chief Musician. A contemplation by the sons of Korah. As the deer pants for the water brooks, so my soul pants after you, God.

hausa: Hezekiya ya huta tare da kakanninsa. Manasse ɗansa kuma ya gāje shi.
english: Hezekiah slept with his fathers, and Manasseh his son reigned in his place.

hausa: waɗanda suka dogara ga arzikinsu suna kuma fariya a kan yawan arzikinsu?
english: Those who trust in their wealth, and boast in the multitude of their riches—

hausa: Da jarumin ya ji haka sai ya je wurin shugaban ƙungiyar sojan ya ce masa, “Me kake so yi ne? Wannan mutum ɗan ƙasar Roma ne.”
english: When the centurion heard it, he went to the commanding officer and told him, “Watch what you are about to do, for this man is a Roman!”

hausa: Masussukai da wuraren matsin inabi ba za su ciyar da mutane ba; sabon ruwan inabi zai kāsa musu.
english: The threshing floor and the wine press won’t feed them, and the new wine will fail her.

hausa: Ka yi musu abin da ka yi wa Midiyan, yadda ka yi wa Sisera da Yabin a kogin Kishon,
english: Do to them as you did to Midian, as to Sisera, as to Jabin, at the river Kishon;

hausa: Sama’ila ya ce masa, “Ubangiji ya yage masarautar Isra’ila daga gare ka yau, ya ba wa wani daga cikin maƙwabtanka wanda ya fi ka.
english: Samuel said to him, “Yahweh has torn the kingdom of Israel from you today, and has given it to a neighbor of yours who is better than you.

hausa: Saboda haka, da yake muna karɓar mulkin da ba ya jijjiguwa, sai mu yi godiya, ta haka kuwa mu yi wa Allah sujada yadda ya kamata, tare da bangirma da kuma tsoro,
english: Therefore, receiving a Kingdom that can’t be shaken, let’s have grace, through which we serve God acceptably, with reverence and awe,

hausa: ’Ya’yana ƙaunatattu, waɗannan su ne kwanakin ƙarshe; kuma kamar yadda kuka ji cewa magabcin Kiristi yana zuwa, ko yanzu ma abokan gāban Kiristi da yawa sun zo. Ta haka muka san cewa kwanakin ƙarshe sun iso.
english: Little children, these are the end times, and as you heard that the Antichrist is coming, even now many antichrists have arisen. By this we know that it is the final hour.

hausa: Yanzu kuwa, ya Ubangiji, Allah na Isra’ila, bari maganarka da ka yi alkawarta wa bawanka Dawuda yă cika.
english: Now therefore, Yahweh, the God of Israel, let your word be verified, which you spoke to your servant David.

hausa: Da suka gama, sai Yaƙub ya yi magana ya ce, “’Yan’uwa, ku saurare ni.
english: After they were silent, James answered, “Brothers, listen to me.

hausa: Da cikakken sanin matarsa ya ajiye sashi daga cikin kuɗin don kansa, ya kuma kawo sauran ya ajiye a sawun manzanni.
english: and kept back part of the price, his wife also being aware of it, then brought a certain part and laid it at the apostles’ feet.

hausa: Sa’an nan Dawuda ya ce wa Abishai da dukan fadawansa, “Ɗana, na cikina, yana ƙoƙari yă kashe ni. Balle wannan mutumin Benyamin! Ku ƙyale shi, yă yi ta zargi, Ubangiji ne ya ce masa yă yi haka.
english: David said to Abishai and to all his servants, “Behold, my son, who came out of my bowels, seeks my life. How much more this Benjamite, now? Leave him alone, and let him curse; for Yahweh has invited him.

hausa: Amma Abishai ɗan Zeruhiya ya kawo wa Dawuda gudummawa; ya bugi Bafilistin, ya kashe shi. Sa’an nan mutanen Dawuda suka rantse masa suka ce, “Ba za ka ƙara fita tare da mu wurin yaƙi ba, don kada fitilar Isra’ila tă mutu.”
english: But Abishai the son of Zeruiah helped him, and struck the Philistine and killed him. Then the men of David swore to him, saying, “Don’t go out with us to battle any more, so that you don’t quench the lamp of Israel.”

hausa: Numfashinsa kamar raƙuman ruwa masu gudu yana tashi har zuwa wuya. Yakan tankaɗe al’ummai cikin lariyar hallaka; yakan sa a muƙamuƙan mutane linzamin da zai jagorance su su kauce.
english: His breath is as an overflowing stream that reaches even to the neck, to sift the nations with the sieve of destruction. A bridle that leads to ruin will be in the jaws of the peoples.

hausa: ta Harif 112
english: The children of Hariph: one hundred twelve.

hausa: Sa’an nan suka yi magana da ƙarfi cikin Yahudanci wa mutanen Urushalima waɗanda suke kan katanga, don su firgita su, su kuma sa su ji tsoro don su iya cin birnin.
english: They called out with a loud voice in the Jews’ language to the people of Jerusalem who were on the wall, to frighten them and to trouble them, that they might take the city.

hausa: Sai sarki ya aiki kaftin da sojojin hamsin wurin Iliya. Kaftin ya haura wajen Iliya, wanda yake zaune a kan tudu, ya ce masa, “Mutumin Allah, sarki ya ce, ‘Ka sauko, ka zo!’ ”
english: Then the king sent a captain of fifty with his fifty to him. He went up to him; and behold, he was sitting on the top of the hill. He said to him, “Man of God, the king has said, ‘Come down!’”

hausa: Mutanen suka kafa sansaninsu arewa da birnin, sansani na ’yan kwanto kuwa yana yamma da birnin, amma Yoshuwa ya kwana a kwarin.
english: So they set the people, even all the army who was on the north of the city, and their ambush on the west of the city; and Joshua went that night into the middle of the valley.

hausa: “Ya Ubangiji Mai Iko Duka, kamar yadda ka yi alkawari, yanzu ka sallami bawanka lafiya.
english: “Now you are releasing your servant, Master, according to your word, in peace;

hausa: Maganar Ubangiji wadda ta zo wurin Yowel ɗan Fetuwel.
english: Yahweh’s word that came to Joel, the son of Pethuel.

hausa: to, sai a tā da alkawarina da Dawuda bawana da alkawarina da Lawiyawan da suke firistoci masu hidima a gabana, Dawuda kuma ba zai ƙara kasance da zuriyar da za tă yi mulki.
english: then my covenant could also be broken with David my servant, that he won’t have a son to reign on his throne; and with the Levitical priests, my ministers.

hausa: In da akwai wanda zai iya shiga tsakaninmu, ya ɗora hannunsa a kanmu tare,
english: There is no umpire between us, that might lay his hand on us both.

hausa: Ya Ubangiji, sa zuciyar Isra’ila, duk waɗanda suka rabu da kai za su sha kunya. Waɗanda suka juya maka baya za a rubuta su a ƙura domin sun yashe Ubangiji, maɓulɓular ruwan rai.
english: Yahweh, the hope of Israel, all who forsake you will be disappointed. Those who depart from me will be written in the earth, because they have forsaken Yahweh, the spring of living waters.

hausa: cewa ya bayyana ga Bitrus, sa’an nan ga Sha Biyun.
english: and that he appeared to Cephas, then to the twelve.

hausa: Bari kibiyoyinka masu tsini su huda zukatan abokan gāban sarki; bari al’ummai su fāɗi ƙarƙashin ƙafafunka.
english: Your arrows are sharp. The nations fall under you, with arrows in the heart of the king’s enemies.

hausa: Saboda haka a wannan rana Isuwa ya kama hanyar komawa zuwa Seyir.
english: So Esau returned that day on his way to Seir.

hausa: Raina yana marmari, har yana suma, don filayen gidan Ubangiji; zuciyata da namana na tā da murya domin Allah mai rai.
english: My soul longs, and even faints for the courts of Yahweh. My heart and my flesh cry out for the living God.

hausa: da shanu biyu, raguna biyar, bunsurai biyar da kuma ’yan raguna biyar, dukansu bana ɗaya-ɗaya, a miƙa su hadaya ta salama. Wannan ita ce hadayar Fagiyel ɗan Okran.
english: and for the sacrifice of peace offerings, two head of cattle, five rams, five male goats, and five male lambs a year old. This was the offering of Pagiel the son of Ochran.

hausa: Ashe, ba a mai da kakanmu Ibrahim mai adalci saboda abin da ya yi ba ne sa’ad da ya miƙa ɗansa Ishaku a bisa bagade?
english: Wasn’t Abraham our father justified by works, in that he offered up Isaac his son on the altar?

hausa: Zai tabbatar da alkawari da mutane masu yawa har na shekara bakwai. A tsakiyar bakwai ɗin nan ɗaya zai kawo ƙarshen duk wata hadaya da baiko. Kuma a kusurwar haikali zai sa abin ƙyama mai kawo hallaka, har sai ƙarshen da aka ƙaddara ya auko wa wanda ya sa abin ƙyama.”
english: He will make a firm covenant with many for one week. In the middle of the week he will cause the sacrifice and the offering to cease. On the wing of abominations will come one who makes desolate; and even to the decreed full end, wrath will be poured out on the desolate.”

hausa: Dukan yini yana marmari ya sami ƙari, amma mai adalci yakan bayar hannu sake.
english: There are those who covet greedily all day long; but the righteous give and don’t withhold.

hausa: Ka fadada al’umma ka kuma ƙara farin cikinsu; suna farin ciki a gabanka yadda mutane sukan yi murna a lokacin girbi, kamar yadda mutane sukan yi farin ciki sa’ad da suke raba ganima.
english: You have multiplied the nation. You have increased their joy. They rejoice before you according to the joy in harvest, as men rejoice when they divide the plunder.

hausa: Maza kaɗai sun kai kusan dubu biyar. Amma ya ce wa almajiransa, “Ku sa su su zauna a ƙungiya hamsin-hamsin.”
english: For they were about five thousand men. He said to his disciples, “Make them sit down in groups of about fifty each.”

hausa: Za a ba da gidajensu ga waɗansu, tare da gonakinsu da matansu, sa’ad da na miƙa hannuna gāba da waɗanda suke zama a ƙasar,” in ji Ubangiji.
english: Their houses will be turned to others, their fields and their wives together; for I will stretch out my hand on the inhabitants of the land, says Yahweh.”

hausa: Addu’ar annabi Habakkuk. A kan shigiyont.
english: A prayer of Habakkuk, the prophet, set to victorious music.

hausa: suka kuma la’anci Allah na sama saboda zafinsu, da kuma saboda gyambunansu, amma suka ƙi su tuba daga abin da suka riga suka yi.
english: and they blasphemed the God of heaven because of their pains and their sores. They still didn’t repent of their works.

hausa: Sai Ishaku ya ce wa Yaƙub, “Zo kusa don in taɓa ka, ɗana, domin in sani ko tabbatacce kai ne ɗana Isuwa ko babu.”
english: Isaac said to Jacob, “Please come near, that I may feel you, my son, whether you are really my son Esau or not.”

hausa: Sa’ad da aka shafe bagaden da mai, sai shugabannin suka kawo hadayunsu saboda keɓewarsa, suka miƙa su a bagaden.
english: The princes gave offerings for the dedication of the altar in the day that it was anointed. The princes gave their offerings before the altar.

hausa: Sa’ad da na yi musu murmushi da ƙyar sukan yarda; hasken fuskata yana da daraja a gare su.
english: I smiled on them when they had no confidence. They didn’t reject the light of my face.

hausa: Sa’an nan sai ka dubi fuskokinmu da na sauran samarin da suke ci daga abincin sarki; sa’an nan ka yi da bayinka bisa ga abin da ka gani.”
english: Then let our faces be examined before you, and the face of the youths who eat of the king’s delicacies; and as you see, deal with your servants.”

hausa: Gama Allah ya ƙaunaci duniya sosai har ya ba da wanda yake Ɗaya kuma Makaɗaicin Ɗansa domin duk wanda ya gaskata da shi kada yă hallaka sai dai yă sami rai madawwami.
english: For God so loved the world, that he gave his only born Son, that whoever believes in him should not perish, but have eternal life.

hausa: Shekara arba’in na yi fushi da wancan tsara; na ce, ‘Su mutane ne waɗanda zukatansu suka kauce, kuma ba su san hanyoyina ba.’
english: Forty long years I was grieved with that generation, and said, “They are a people who err in their heart. They have not known my ways.”

hausa: Bayan ya haifi Metusela, Enok ya kasance cikin zumunci da Allah shekaru 300, ya kuma haifi waɗansu ’ya’ya maza da mata.
english: After Methuselah’s birth, Enoch walked with God for three hundred years, and became the father of more sons and daughters.

hausa: Ka daure ƙafafuna da sarƙa; kana kallon duk inda na taka ta wurin sa shaida a tafin ƙafafuna.
english: You also put my feet in the stocks, and mark all my paths. You set a bound to the soles of my feet,

hausa: Zan yi alkawarin salama da su; zai zama madawwamin alkawari. Zan kafa su in ƙara yawansu, zan kuma sa wuri mai tsarkina a cikinsu har abada.
english: Moreover I will make a covenant of peace with them. It will be an everlasting covenant with them. I will place them, multiply them, and will set my sanctuary among them forever more.

hausa: Sai suka ce mata, “Ba wani a cikin danginku mai wannan suna.”
english: They said to her, “There is no one among your relatives who is called by this name.”

hausa: Ɗana, in ka shirya tsaya wa maƙwabcinka don yă karɓi bashi, in ka sa hannunka don ɗaukar lamunin wani,
english: My son, if you have become collateral for your neighbor, if you have struck your hands in pledge for a stranger,

hausa: Ka tuna, ya Ubangiji, abin da mutanen Edom suka yi a ranar da Urushalima ta fāɗi. Suka yi ihu suka ce, “A ragargaza ta, A ragargaza ta har tushenta!”
english: Remember, Yahweh, against the children of Edom in the day of Jerusalem, who said, “Raze it! Raze it even to its foundation!”

hausa: Da Elizabet ta ji gaisuwar Maryamu, sai jaririn da yake a cikinta ya yi motsi. Elizabet kuma ta cika da Ruhu Mai Tsarki.
english: When Elizabeth heard Mary’s greeting, the baby leaped in her womb; and Elizabeth was filled with the Holy Spirit.

hausa: Ku yi tsaro, ku kuma yi addu’a, domin kada ku fāɗi cikin jarraba. Ruhu yana so, sai dai jiki raunana ne.”
english: Watch and pray, that you may not enter into temptation. The spirit indeed is willing, but the flesh is weak.”

hausa: Nan da nan sai ga ni cikin Ruhu, a can a gabana kuwa ga kursiyi a cikin sama da wani zaune a kansa.
english: Immediately I was in the Spirit. Behold, there was a throne set in heaven, and one sitting on the throne

hausa: Yehohiyakim ya huta da kakanninsa. Yehohiyacin ɗansa ya gāje shi.
english: So Jehoiakim slept with his fathers, and Jehoiachin his son reigned in his place.

hausa: Sai sarki ya sa Benahiya ɗan Yehohiyada ya zama shugaba a bisa mayaƙa a matsayin Yowab, ya kuma sa Zadok firist a wurin Abiyatar.
english: The king put Benaiah the son of Jehoiada in his place over the army; and the king put Zadok the priest in the place of Abiathar.

hausa: Bari ranan nan ta zama duhu; kada Allah yă kula da ita; kada rana tă yi haske a wannan rana.
english: Let that day be darkness. Don’t let God from above seek for it, neither let the light shine on it.

hausa: In mutum biyu sun kwanta tare, za su ji ɗumin juna. Amma yaya mutum ɗaya zai ji ɗumi yana shi kaɗai?
english: Again, if two lie together, then they have warmth; but how can one keep warm alone?

hausa: “Sarkin Arewa zai koma ƙasarsa da dukiya mai girma, amma zuciyarsa za tă yi gāba da tsattsarkan alkawari. Zai ɗauki mataki a kan wannan abu sa’an nan yă koma ƙasarsa.
english: Then he will return into his land with great wealth. His heart will be against the holy covenant. He will take action, and return to his own land.

hausa: Kada ku kawo abin ƙyama cikin gidajenku, domin kada ku zama kamar su. Gaba ɗaya ku yi ƙyamarsu, ku ƙi su, gama an ware su, sun zama domin a hallaka.
english: You shall not bring an abomination into your house and become a devoted thing like it. You shall utterly detest it. You shall utterly abhor it; for it is a devoted thing.

hausa: “Duba, ni ne wanda na halicci maƙeri wanda yake zuga garwashi ya zama harshen wuta ya kuma ƙera makamin da ya dace da aikinsa. Ni ne kuma na halicci mai hallakarwa ya yi ɓarna;
english: “Behold, I have created the blacksmith who fans the coals into flame, and forges a weapon for his work; and I have created the destroyer to destroy.

hausa: Ubangiji nagari da mai adalci ne; saboda haka yakan koyar da masu zunubi a hanyoyinsa.
english: Good and upright is Yahweh, therefore he will instruct sinners in the way.

hausa: Da kaɗan da kaɗan Ubangiji Allahnku zai kore waɗannan al’ummai a gabanku. Ba a bari ku hallaka su duka gaba ɗaya ba, in ba haka namun jeji za su yaɗu kewaye da ku.
english: Yahweh your God will cast out those nations before you little by little. You may not consume them at once, lest the animals of the field increase on you.

hausa: Ga yadda Allah ya nuna ƙaunarsa a cikinmu, Allah ya aiki makaɗaici Ɗansa zuwa duniya domin mu rayu ta wurinsa.
english: By this God’s love was revealed in us, that God has sent his only born Son into the world that we might live through him.

hausa: Kamar rurin zaki ko sanɗar beyar haka mugun mutum mai mulki a kan mutane marasa ƙarfi yake.
english: As a roaring lion or a charging bear, so is a wicked ruler over helpless people.

hausa: Ka yi iyakacin ƙoƙarinka ka zo wurina da sauri,
english: Be diligent to come to me soon,

hausa: Ina da tabbaci cikin Ubangiji cewa ba za ku bi wani ra’ayi dabam ba. Wannan da yake rikita ku za a hukunta shi, ko shi wane ne.
english: I have confidence toward you in the Lord that you will think no other way. But he who troubles you will bear his judgment, whoever he is.

hausa: tabbatacce zan albarkace ka, zan kuma sa zuriyarka su yi yawa kamar taurari a sararin sama, kamar kuma yashi a bakin teku. Zuriyarka za su mallaki biranen abokan gābansu,
english: that I will bless you greatly, and I will multiply your offspring greatly like the stars of the heavens, and like the sand which is on the seashore. Your offspring will possess the gate of his enemies.

hausa: A tsawatawarka, ya Allah na Yaƙub, doki da keken yaƙi suka kwanta ba motsi.
english: At your rebuke, God of Jacob, both chariot and horse are cast into a dead sleep.

hausa: waɗanda suka bauɗe daga gaskiya. Suna cewa tashin matattu ya riga ya faru, suna kuma ɓata bangaskiyar waɗansu.
