english: men who have erred concerning the truth, saying that the resurrection is already past, and overthrowing the faith of some.

hausa: Sa’ad da Isuwa ya ji kalmomin mahaifinsa, sai ya fashe da kuka mai zafi kuma da ƙarfi, ya ce wa mahaifinsa, “Ka albarkace ni, ni ma, baba!”
english: When Esau heard the words of his father, he cried with an exceedingly great and bitter cry, and said to his father, “Bless me, even me also, my father.”

hausa: Allah ya kai mini hari ya yi kaca-kaca da ni cikin fushinsa yana cizon haƙoransa don fushin da yake yi da ni; ya zura mini ido.
english: He has torn me in his wrath and persecuted me. He has gnashed on me with his teeth. My adversary sharpens his eyes on me.

hausa: A ranar farko za tă zama ta taro mai tsarki, kada ku yi aiki na kullum.
english: On the first day shall be a holy convocation. You shall do no regular work.

hausa: Komandodin Filistiyawa suka ce, “Waɗannan Ibraniyawa kuma fa?” Akish ya ce, “Wannan shi ne Dawuda hafsan Shawulu, sarkin Isra’ila. Yana nan tare da ni shekara guda ke nan. Ban kuwa taɓa samunsa da wani lahani ba tun daga ranar da ya bar Shawulu.”
english: Then the princes of the Philistines said, “What about these Hebrews?” Achish said to the princes of the Philistines, “Isn’t this David, the servant of Saul the king of Israel, who has been with me these days, or rather these years? I have found no fault in him since he fell away until today.”

hausa: “Bayan ka tsarkake Lawiyawa, ka kuma miƙa su kamar hadaya ta kaɗawa, sai su zo su yi aikinsu a Tentin Sujada.
english: “After that, the Levites shall go in to do the service of the Tent of Meeting. You shall cleanse them, and offer them as a wave offering.

hausa: “Amma mahaifin ya ce wa bayinsa, ‘Maza! Ku kawo riga mafi kyau ku sa masa. Ku sa zobe a yatsarsa, da takalma kuma a ƙafafunsa.
english: “But the father said to his servants, ‘Bring out the best robe and put it on him. Put a ring on his hand and sandals on his feet.

hausa: Mala’ikan Ubangiji ya haura daga Gilgal zuwa Bokim ya ce, “Na hauro da ku daga Masar zuwa ƙasar da na rantse zan ba wa kakanninku. Na ce, ‘Ba zan taɓa tā da yarjejjeniyata da ku ba,
english: Yahweh’s angel came up from Gilgal to Bochim. He said, “I brought you out of Egypt, and have brought you to the land which I swore to give your fathers. I said, ‘I will never break my covenant with you.

hausa: Kakan taimaki waɗanda suke murnan yin abin da yake daidai, waɗanda sukan tuna da hanyoyinka. Amma sa’ad da muka ci gaba da yin zunubi, kakan yi fushi. Ta yaya za mu sami ceto ke nan?
english: You meet him who rejoices and does righteousness, those who remember you in your ways. Behold, you were angry, and we sinned. We have been in sin for a long time. Shall we be saved?

hausa: An ware ni tare da matattu, kamar waɗanda aka kashe da suke kwance a kabari, waɗanda ba ka ƙara tunawa, waɗanda aka yanke daga taimakonka.
english: set apart among the dead, like the slain who lie in the grave, whom you remember no more. They are cut off from your hand.

hausa: tumakin da aka ware wa Ubangiji kuwa 657 ne;
english: and Yahweh’s tribute of the sheep was six hundred seventy-five.

hausa: Dukan maza masu fasaha a cikin sauran masu aikin suka yi tabanakul da labule goma na tuƙaƙƙun lallausan lilin na shuɗi, da shunayya, da jan zare, aka yi wa labulen zānen kerubobi na gwaninta.
english: All the wise-hearted men among those who did the work made the tabernacle with ten curtains of fine twined linen, blue, purple, and scarlet. They made them with cherubim, the work of a skillful workman.

hausa: Sarki Uzziya ya kasance da kuturta har ranar mutuwarsa. Ya zauna a gidan da aka ware, da kuturci, aka kuma ware shi daga haikalin Ubangiji. Yotam ɗansa ya lura da fadan ya kuma yi mulkin mutanen ƙasar.
english: Uzziah the king was a leper to the day of his death, and lived in a separate house, being a leper; for he was cut off from Yahweh’s house. Jotham his son was over the king’s house, judging the people of the land.

hausa: Sa’ad da Ɗan Ragon ya buɗe hatimi na uku, sai na ji halitta mai rai na uku ya ce, “Zo!” Na duba, can a gabana kuwa ga wani baƙin doki! Mai hawansa yana riƙe da abubuwan awo guda biyu a hannunsa.
english: When he opened the third seal, I heard the third living creature saying, “Come and see!” And behold, a black horse, and he who sat on it had a balance in his hand.

hausa: sai Shawulu ya ƙara jin tsoron Dawuda har ya zama maƙiyinsa a dukan sauran rayuwarsa.
english: Saul was even more afraid of David; and Saul was David’s enemy continually.

hausa: “Duk wanda ya la’anta mahaifinsa ko mahaifiyarsa, dole a kashe shi.
english: “Anyone who curses his father or his mother shall surely be put to death.

hausa: “Yi magana da Isra’ilawa ka ce musu, ‘Duk sa’ad da waninku ya kawo hadaya ga Ubangiji, ku kawo hadayarku ta dabba daga garkenku ta shanu ko kuwa daga tumakinku.
english: “Speak to the children of Israel, and tell them, ‘When anyone of you offers an offering to Yahweh, you shall offer your offering of the livestock, from the herd and from the flock.

hausa: Sa’an nan mutanen Isra’ila suka ce wa mutanen Yahuda, “Muna da rabo goma a wurin sarki; ban da haka ma, muna da hakki mafi yawa a wurin Dawuda fiye da ku. Don me kuke mana reni? Ba mu ne ma muka fara magana dawowa da sarki ba?” Amma mutanen Yahuda suka ɗauka maganar da zafi fiye da mutanen Isra’ila.
english: The men of Israel answered the men of Judah, and said, “We have ten parts in the king, and we have also more claim to David than you. Why then did you despise us, that our advice should not be first had in bringing back our king?” The words of the men of Judah were fiercer than the words of the men of Israel.

hausa: Ma’auni marar gaskiya da magwajin da ba daidai ba, Ubangiji ya ƙi su duka.
english: Differing weights and differing measures, both of them alike are an abomination to Yahweh.

hausa: Heber shi ne mahaifin Yaflet, Shomer da Hotam da kuma ’yar’uwarsu Shuwa.
english: Heber became the father of Japhlet, Shomer, Hotham, and Shua their sister.

hausa: Ta haka za mu zama kamar sauran ƙasashe, mu kasance da sarkin da zai bi da mu, yă tafi tare da mu zuwa yaƙe-yaƙe.
english: that we also may be like all the nations; and that our king may judge us, and go out before us, and fight our battles.”

hausa: inda ya zauna wata uku. Da yake Yahudawa sun ƙulla masa makirci, a lokacin da yake shirin tashi cikin jirgin ruwa zuwa Suriya, sai ya yanka shawara yă koma ta Makidoniya.
english: When he had spent three months there, and a plot was made against him by Jews as he was about to set sail for Syria, he determined to return through Macedonia.

hausa: Yefta ya ce, “Ni da mutanena mun yi ta jayayya sosai da Ammonawa, ko da yake na kira ku, amma ba ku cece ni daga hannuwansu ba.
english: Jephthah said to them, “I and my people were at great strife with the children of Ammon; and when I called you, you didn’t save me out of their hand.

hausa: Sai mutumin ya ce, “Ubangiji, na gaskata,” ya kuma yi masa sujada.
english: He said, “Lord, I believe!” and he worshiped him.

hausa: Wane ne ya isa yă yi magana kuma ta cika in ba Ubangiji ne ya umarta ba?
english: Who is he who says, and it comes to pass, when the Lord doesn’t command it?

hausa: A cikin jahannama ta wuta, inda yana shan azaba, ya ɗaga kai ya hangi Ibrahim can nesa, da kuma Lazarus a gefensa.
english: In Hades, he lifted up his eyes, being in torment, and saw Abraham far off, and Lazarus at his bosom.

hausa: Ku yi nesa da ƙage. Kada ku kashe marar laifi tare da mai adalci, gama ba zan bar mugun yă tafi haka kawai ba.
english: “Keep far from a false charge, and don’t kill the innocent and righteous; for I will not justify the wicked.

hausa: Daga baya Dawuda ya damu domin ya yanke shafin rigar Shawulu.
english: Afterward, David’s heart struck him because he had cut off Saul’s skirt.

hausa: Gama in aka canja yadda ake zaɓan firist, dole a canja Dokar ita ma.
english: For the priesthood being changed, there is of necessity a change made also in the law.

hausa: A Urushalima, Dawuda ya ƙara auren waɗansu mata, ya kuma zama mahaifin ƙarin ’ya’yan maza da mata.
english: David took more wives in Jerusalem, and David became the father of more sons and daughters.

hausa: Zuriyar bayin Solomon. Zuriyar Sotai, Hassoferet, Feruda,
english: The children of Solomon’s servants: the children of Sotai, the children of Hassophereth, the children of Peruda,

hausa: Sa’an nan wani mala’ika mai ƙarfi ya ɗauki dutse kamar girman babban dutsen niƙa ya jefa cikin teku ya ce, “Da wannan irin giggitawa za a jefar da birnin Babilon mai girma ƙasa, ba za a ƙara ganin ta ba.
english: A mighty angel took up a stone like a great millstone and cast it into the sea, saying, “Thus with violence will Babylon, the great city, be thrown down, and will be found no more at all.

hausa: Mesha, sarkin Mowab yana kiwon tumaki, ya kuma zama tilas yă biya haraji ga sarkin Isra’ila. Saboda haka yakan ba da ’yan tumaki dubu ɗari, da kuma gashin raguna dubu ɗari.
english: Now Mesha king of Moab was a sheep breeder; and he supplied the king of Israel with one hundred thousand lambs and the wool of one hundred thousand rams.

hausa: Amma Barak ya bi keken yaƙin da mayaƙan har Haroshet Haggoyim. Aka karkashe dukan mayaƙan Sisera ba ko ɗayan da ya tsira.
english: But Barak pursued the chariots and the army to Harosheth of the Gentiles; and all the army of Sisera fell by the edge of the sword. There was not a man left.

hausa: Sa’an nan Ayuba ya amsa,
english: Then Job answered,

hausa: Ji yadda dabbobi suke nishi! Garkunan shanu sun ruɗe saboda ba su da ciyawa, har garkunan tumaki ma suna shan wahala.
english: How the animals groan! The herds of livestock are perplexed, because they have no pasture. Yes, the flocks of sheep are made desolate.

hausa: Ban kawo dabbobinka da namun jeji suka yayyaga; na kuma ɗauki hasarar ba? Ka nemi in biya dukan abin da aka sace da rana ko da dare.
english: That which was torn of animals, I didn’t bring to you. I bore its loss. Of my hand you required it, whether stolen by day or stolen by night.

hausa: “Ke kuma, ki koma gida. Sa’ad da kika taka ƙafa a birninki, yaron zai mutu.
english: Arise therefore, and go to your house. When your feet enter into the city, the child will die.

hausa: Suka ce, in za ku komar da akwatin alkawarin Allah na Isra’ila kada ku komar da shi hannu wofi; amma ku tabbata kun aika da hadaya don laifi zuwa wurinsa. Sa’an nan za ku warke ku kuma san dalilin da ya sa bai cire hannunsa a kanku ba.
english: They said, “If you send away the ark of the God of Israel, don’t send it empty; but by all means return a trespass offering to him. Then you will be healed, and it will be known to you why his hand is not removed from you.”

hausa: Waɗanda suke neman raina sun sa tarkonsu, waɗanda suke so su cuce ni suna zance lalatar da ni; yini sukutum suna ƙulla mini maƙarƙashiya.
english: They also who seek after my life lay snares. Those who seek my hurt speak mischievous things, and meditate deceits all day long.

hausa: Sa’an nan ka yi maɗauri hamsin na zinariya don amfanin ɗaura labulen a haɗe, domin tabanakul yă zama ɗaya.
english: You shall make fifty clasps of gold, and couple the curtains to one another with the clasps. The tabernacle shall be a unit.

hausa: don a kafa waɗannan ranakun Furim a keɓaɓɓen lokacinsu, kamar yadda Mordekai mutumin Yahuda da Sarauniya Esta suka dokace su. Yadda kuma suka kafa wa kansu da zuriyarsu, game da lokutansu na azumi da makoki.
english: to confirm these days of Purim in their appointed times, as Mordecai the Jew and Esther the queen had decreed, and as they had imposed upon themselves and their descendants in the matter of the fastings and their mourning.

hausa: Yanzu fa, masu karɓar haraji da “masu zunubi” duka suna taruwa don jin koyarwar Yesu.
english: Now all the tax collectors and sinners were coming close to him to hear him.

hausa: Farkon maganarsa wauta ce, ƙarshenta kuma takan zama muguwar hauka,
english: The beginning of the words of his mouth is foolishness; and the end of his talk is mischievous madness.

hausa: Sai Ayuba ya amsa,
english: Then Job answered,

hausa: Tunawa da mai adalci albarka ne amma sunan mugu zai ruɓe.
english: The memory of the righteous is blessed, but the name of the wicked will rot.

hausa: Yesu ya kalle su ya ce, “Ga mutum kam, wannan ba ya yiwuwa, amma ga Allah kuwa, dukan abubuwa masu yiwuwa ne.”
english: Looking at them, Jesus said, “With men this is impossible, but with God all things are possible.”

hausa: Ka ɗan taɓa lafiyar jikinsa ka gani ba shakka zai la’anta ka kana ji kana gani.”
english: But stretch out your hand now, and touch his bone and his flesh, and he will renounce you to your face.”

hausa: Zan sa waɗanda suke na majami’ar Shaiɗan, waɗanda suke cewa su Yahudawa ne alhali kuwa ba haka ba ne, sai dai maƙaryata, zan sa su zo su fāɗi a ƙasa a gabanka su kuma shaida cewa na ƙaunace ka.
english: Behold, I make some of the synagogue of Satan, of those who say they are Jews, and they are not, but lie—behold, I will make them to come and worship before your feet, and to know that I have loved you.

hausa: Waɗannan su ne sunayen ’ya’yan Isra’ila maza (Yaƙub da zuriyarsa) waɗanda suka tafi Masar, Ruben ɗan farin Yaƙub.
english: These are the names of the children of Israel, who came into Egypt, Jacob and his sons: Reuben, Jacob’s firstborn.

hausa: Bayan ya kama shi, sai ya sa shi a kurkuku, ya danƙa shi a hannun soja hurhuɗu kashi huɗu, don su yi gadinsa. Hiridus ya yi niyyar ya yi masa shari’a a gaban mutane bayan Bikin Ƙetarewa.
english: When he had arrested him, he put him in prison and delivered him to four squads of four soldiers each to guard him, intending to bring him out to the people after the Passover.

hausa: Sarki Agiriffa ka gaskata da annabawa? Na san ka gaskata.”
english: King Agrippa, do you believe the prophets? I know that you believe.”

hausa: “Ƙanuwarta Oholiba kuwa ta ga wannan, duk da haka cikin kai da kawowarta da karuwancinta ta fi ’yar’uwar lalacewa.
english: “Her sister Oholibah saw this, yet she was more corrupt in her lusting than she, and in her prostitution which was more depraved than the prostitution of her sister.

hausa: ko su ba da kansu ga tatsuniyoyi da ƙididdigar asali marar iyaka. Waɗannan suna kawo faɗa a maimakon aikin Allah wanda yake ta wurin bangaskiya.
english: and not to pay attention to myths and endless genealogies, which cause disputes rather than God’s stewardship, which is in faith.

hausa: Sa’ad da Ahab ya ga Iliya, sai ya ce masa, “Kai ne wannan, kai mai tā-da-na-zaune-tsaye a Isra’ila?”
english: When Ahab saw Elijah, Ahab said to him, “Is that you, you troubler of Israel?”

hausa: Saboda haka suka zaɓi kekunan yaƙi biyu tare da dawakansu, sarki kuwa ya aike su su bi bayan sojojin Arameyawa. Ya umarci masu tuƙinsu ya ce, “Ku je ku bincika abin da ya faru.”
english: Therefore they took two chariots with horses; and the king sent them out to the Syrian army, saying, “Go and see.”

hausa: a duka sa’ad da zan warkar da Isra’ila, zunuban Efraim za su tonu za a kuma bayyana laifofin Samariya. Suna ruɗu, ɓarayi sukan fasa su shiga gidaje, ’yan fashi sukan yi fashi a tituna;
english: When I would heal Israel, then the iniquity of Ephraim is uncovered, also the wickedness of Samaria; for they commit falsehood, and the thief enters in, and the gang of robbers ravages outside.

hausa: Yefta, Ashna, Nezib,
english: Iphtah, Ashnah, Nezib,

hausa: Sai sarki ya ce, “In wani ya yi miki magana, ki kawo shi wurina, ba zai kuwa ƙara damunki ba.”
english: The king said, “Whoever says anything to you, bring him to me, and he will not bother you any more.”

hausa: Musa ya ce wa Haruna, “Matsa kusa da bagaden, ka miƙa hadayarka don zunubi, da hadayarka ta ƙonawa, ka yi kafara don kanka da kuma don jama’a. Ka kuma kawo hadayar jama’a, ka yi kafara dominsu kamar yadda Ubangiji ya umarta.”
english: Moses said to Aaron, “Draw near to the altar, and offer your sin offering, and your burnt offering, and make atonement for yourself, and for the people; and offer the offering of the people, and make atonement for them, as Yahweh commanded.”

hausa: “An hallaka ku, ya Isra’ila, domin kun tayar mini, kun tayar wa mai taimakonku.
english: You are destroyed, Israel, because you are against me, against your helper.

hausa: Da ƙafa za tă ce, “Saboda ni ba hannu ba ce, ni ba gaɓar jiki ba ce.” Wannan ba zai hana ta zama gaɓar jikin ba.
english: If the foot would say, “Because I’m not the hand, I’m not part of the body,” it is not therefore not part of the body.

hausa: Sai mutane suka fara roƙon Yesu yă bar yankinsu.
english: They began to beg him to depart from their region.

hausa: Sa’an nan ta ce masa, “Yaya kake cewa kana sona alhali ba ka yarda da ni ba? Wannan shi ne sau na uku kana mai da ni wawiya kuma ba ka nuna mini asirin ƙarfinka ba.”
english: She said to him, “How can you say, ‘I love you,’ when your heart is not with me? You have mocked me these three times, and have not told me where your great strength lies.”

hausa: Sa’ad da Isra’ilawa suka ji cewa sun gina bagade a iyakar Kan’ana, a Gelilot kusa da Urdun wajen gefensu na Isra’ilawa,
english: The children of Israel heard this, “Behold, the children of Reuben and the children of Gad and the half-tribe of Manasseh have built an altar along the border of the land of Canaan, in the region around the Jordan, on the side that belongs to the children of Israel.”

hausa: Amma ya ce musu, “Ni ne; kada ku ji tsoro.”
english: But he said to them, “It is I. Don’t be afraid.”

hausa: Gama ranar ta yi kusa, ranar Ubangiji ta gabato, ranar gizagizai, lokacin hallaka wa al’ummai.
english: For the day is near, even Yahweh’s day is near. It will be a day of clouds, a time of the nations.

hausa: Da yawa ne shirye-shiryen zuciyar mutum, amma manufar Ubangiji ce takan cika.
english: There are many plans in a man’s heart, but Yahweh’s counsel will prevail.

hausa: Zai sha dafin maciji; sarar maciji mai dafi za tă tashe shi.
english: He will suck cobra venom. The viper’s tongue will kill him.

hausa: Hadayar da ya kawo ita ce, faranti guda ɗaya na azurfa, nauyinsa shekel ɗari ɗaya da talatin, da kuma daro na yayyafawa na azurfa, nauyinsa shekel saba’in, dukan biyu, an auna su bisa ga ma’aunin shekel na tsattsarkan wuri, kowannensu cike da lallausan gari, haɗe da mai kamar hadaya ta gari;
english: gave his offering: one silver platter, the weight of which was one hundred thirty shekels, one silver bowl of seventy shekels, according to the shekel of the sanctuary, both of them full of fine flour mixed with oil for a meal offering;

hausa: Bitrus ya furta, “Ko da ma zan mutu ne tare da kai, ba zan taɓa yin mūsun saninka ba.” Dukan sauran almajiran ma suka faɗa haka.
english: Peter said to him, “Even if I must die with you, I will not deny you.” All of the disciples also said likewise.

hausa: Amma ranar Ubangiji za tă zo kamar ɓarawo. Sammai za su ɓace da ruri, abubuwan da suke cikinsu za su ƙone, ƙasa kuma da dukan abin da yake cikinta za su tonu.
english: But the day of the Lord will come as a thief in the night, in which the heavens will pass away with a great noise, and the elements will be dissolved with fervent heat; and the earth and the works that are in it will be burned up.

hausa: Saboda haka bayan Abram ya yi zama a Kan’ana shekaru goma, Saira matarsa ta ɗauki Hagar baiwarta ta ba wa mijinta tă zama matarsa.
english: Sarai, Abram’s wife, took Hagar the Egyptian, her servant, after Abram had lived ten years in the land of Canaan, and gave her to Abram her husband to be his wife.

hausa: Dawuda ya ce, “Me ya haɗa ni da ku, ku ’ya’yan Zeruhiya? Yau ɗin nan kun zama maƙiyana! Ya kamata a kashe wani a Isra’ila a yau? Ban san cewa yau ni sarki ne a bisa Isra’ila ba?”
english: David said, “What have I to do with you, you sons of Zeruiah, that you should be adversaries to me today? Shall any man be put to death today in Israel? For don’t I know that I am king over Israel today?”

hausa: Domin ka yi farin ciki sa’ad da gādon gidan Isra’ila ya zama kufai, haka zan yi da kai, ya Dutsen Seyir, kai da dukan Edom. Sa’an nan za ka san cewa ni ne Ubangiji.’ ”
english: As you rejoiced over the inheritance of the house of Israel because it was desolate, so I will do to you. You will be desolate, Mount Seir, and all Edom, even all of it. Then they will know that I am Yahweh.’”

hausa: Gama kowa na iya ganin masu hikima na mutuwa; wawaye da marasa azanci su ma kan hallaka su bar wa waɗansu arzikinsu.
english: For he sees that wise men die; likewise the fool and the senseless perish, and leave their wealth to others.

hausa: Rehobowam ya amsa, “Ku dawo gare ni cikin kwana uku.” Saboda haka mutanen suka watse.
english: He said to them, “Come again to me after three days.” So the people departed.

hausa: Amma nakan nuna ƙauna ga dubban tsararraki na waɗanda suke ƙaunata, suke kuma kiyaye dokokina.
english: and showing loving kindness to thousands of those who love me and keep my commandments.

hausa: Sa’an nan Ubangiji ya ce wa Musa da Haruna, “Ɗibi tokar matoya cike da tafin hannuwanku, Musa kuwa zai watsa tokar sama a gaban Fir’auna.
english: Yahweh said to Moses and to Aaron, “Take handfuls of ashes of the furnace, and let Moses sprinkle it toward the sky in the sight of Pharaoh.

hausa: Zuriyar Hananiya su ne, Felatiya da Yeshahiya, Refahiya, Arnan, Obadiya da Shekaniya.
english: The sons of Hananiah: Pelatiah and Jeshaiah; the sons of Rephaiah, the sons of Arnan, the sons of Obadiah, the sons of Shecaniah.

hausa: Ba’a ta sa zuciyata ta karai ta bar ni ba mataimaki; Na nemi a ji tausayina, amma ban sami ko ɗaya ba, na nemi masu ta’aziyya, amma ban sami ko ɗaya ba.
english: Reproach has broken my heart, and I am full of heaviness. I looked for some to take pity, but there was none; for comforters, but I found none.

hausa: Amma bisa ga alherin Allah, na zama abin da nake, alherinsa zuwa gare ni kuwa bai zama a banza ba. A’a, na yi aiki fiye da dukansu, duk da haka, ba ni ba ne, sai dai alherin Allah da yake tare da ni ne.
english: But by the grace of God I am what I am. His grace which was given to me was not futile, but I worked more than all of them; yet not I, but the grace of God which was with me.

hausa: Amma yanzu kun ƙi Allahnku wanda ya cece ku daga dukan masifu da wahaloli. Kuka ce, ‘Sam, a naɗa mana sarki.’ Saboda haka yanzu sai ku zo gaban Ubangiji kabila-kabila da iyali-iyali.”
english: But you have today rejected your God, who himself saves you out of all your calamities and your distresses; and you have said to him, ‘No! Set a king over us!’ Now therefore present yourselves before Yahweh by your tribes and by your thousands.”

hausa: Duba a cikin littafin Ubangiji ka kuma karanta. Babu wani a cikin waɗannan da ya ɓace, babu ko ɗaya da ba ta da abokiya. Gama bakinsa ne ya ba da umarni, Ruhunsa kuma zai tara su wuri ɗaya.
english: Search in the book of Yahweh, and read: not one of these will be missing. None will lack her mate. For my mouth has commanded, and his Spirit has gathered them.

hausa: Kuma sa’ad da kuke ci kuke sha, ba kanku kuke yi wa shagali ba?
english: When you eat and when you drink, don’t you eat for yourselves and drink for yourselves?

hausa: Sai aka bar ni ni kaɗai, ina juyayi wannan babban wahayi, ba ni da sauran ƙarfi, fuskata ta yamutse kuma ba ni da sauran ƙarfi.
english: So I was left alone and saw this great vision. No strength remained in me; for my face grew deathly pale, and I retained no strength.

hausa: Duka kuwa suka ci suka ƙoshi. Almajiran suka kwashe ragowar gutsattsarin cike da kwanduna goma sha biyu.
english: They ate and were all filled. They gathered up twelve baskets of broken pieces that were left over.

hausa: da ta Neziya, da kuma ta Hatifa.
english: the children of Neziah, and the children of Hatipha.

hausa: “ ‘In hadayarsa cika wa’adin rantsuwa ce ko kuwa ta yardar rai ce, sai a ci hadayar a ranar da ya miƙa ta, amma za a iya cin duk abin da ya rage kashegari.
english: “‘But if the sacrifice of his offering is a vow, or a free will offering, it shall be eaten on the day that he offers his sacrifice. On the next day what remains of it shall be eaten,

hausa: Gama ba don kaina na yi magana ba, Uban da ya aiko ni shi kansa ne ya ba ni umarni a kan abin da zan faɗa da kuma yadda zan faɗe shi.
english: For I spoke not from myself, but the Father who sent me gave me a commandment, what I should say and what I should speak.

hausa: saboda iyalan kabilar Ruben, kabilar Gad da rabin kabilar Manasse sun riga sun sami gādonsu.
english: for the tribe of the children of Reuben according to their fathers’ houses, the tribe of the children of Gad according to their fathers’ houses, and the half-tribe of Manasseh have received their inheritance.

hausa: Ban yi maka laifi ba, amma kana musguna mini ta wurin kawo mini hari. Bari Ubangiji yă zama Alƙali, yă yanke hukunci tsakani Isra’ilawa da Ammonawa.”
english: Therefore I have not sinned against you, but you do me wrong to war against me. May Yahweh the Judge be judge today between the children of Israel and the children of Ammon.”

hausa: Mun kuma san cewa an yi doka ba domin masu adalci ba sai dai masu tawaye, da marasa biyayya, da marasa bin Allah, da masu zunubi, da marasa tsarkaka, da masu saɓon Allah, da masu kashe iyaye maza da mata, da masu kisankai,
english: as knowing this, that law is not made for a righteous person, but for the lawless and insubordinate, for the ungodly and sinners, for the unholy and profane, for murderers of fathers and murderers of mothers, for manslayers,

hausa: Shi ya sa ake kira rijiyar Beyer-Lahai-Royi tana nan har yanzu, tsakanin Kadesh da Bered.
english: Therefore the well was called Beer Lahai Roi. Behold, it is between Kadesh and Bered.

hausa: sai ku san cewa Allah ya yi mini ba daidai ba ya kewaye ni da ragarsa.
english: know now that God has subverted me, and has surrounded me with his net.

hausa: Efa da garwan su kasance girmansu ɗaya, garwan ya zama kashi ɗaya bisa goma na ganga efa kuma ya zama kashi ɗaya bisa goma na ganga; ganga fitaccen ma’auni na duka biyu.
english: The ephah and the bath shall be of one measure, that the bath may contain one tenth of a homer, and the ephah one tenth of a homer. Its measure shall be the same as the homer.

hausa: Allah ya kira busasshiyar ƙasar “doron ƙasa,” ruwan da ya taru kuma, ya kira “tekuna.” Allah ya ga yana da kyau.
english: God called the dry land “earth”, and the gathering together of the waters he called “seas”. God saw that it was good.

hausa: Duk lokacin da Isra’ilawa suka yi shuka sai Midiyawa da Amalekawa da waɗansu mutane daga gabashi sukan kai musu hari.
english: So it was, when Israel had sown, that the Midianites, the Amalekites, and the children of the east came up against them.

hausa: Gaba ɗaya dai, Enok ya yi shekaru 365.
english: All the days of Enoch were three hundred sixty-five years.

hausa: Matalauci da azzalumi suna da wannan abu ɗaya. Ubangiji ne yake ba dukansu gani.
english: The poor man and the oppressor have this in common: Yahweh gives sight to the eyes of both.

hausa: a ranar ashirin da ɗaya ga watan bakwai, maganar Ubangiji ta zo ta wurin annabi Haggai cewa,
english: In the seventh month, in the twenty-first day of the month, Yahweh’s word came by Haggai the prophet, saying,

hausa: Kuna tsammani ba zan iya kira Ubana, nan take kuwa yă aiko mini fiye da rundunar mala’iku goma sha biyu ba?
english: Or do you think that I couldn’t ask my Father, and he would even now send me more than twelve legions of angels?

hausa: Waɗanda suka gan ka sun zura maka ido, suna tunani abin da zai same ka. “Wannan mutumin ne ya girgiza duniya ya kuma sa mulkoki suka razana,
english: Those who see you will stare at you. They will ponder you, saying, “Is this the man who made the earth to tremble, who shook kingdoms,

hausa: Barorin Ishaku suka haƙa cikin kwarin suka kuwa sami rijiya mai ruwa mai kyau a can.
english: Isaac’s servants dug in the valley, and found there a well of flowing water.

hausa: Sai ya kafa ɗaya a Betel, ɗaya kuma a Dan.
english: He set the one in Bethel, and the other he put in Dan.

hausa: ’ya’yan Hashem mutumin Gizon maza, Yonatan ɗan Shageye mutumin Harar,
english: the sons of Hashem the Gizonite, Jonathan the son of Shagee the Hararite,

hausa: Suna cikin gangarowa daga dutsen ke nan, sai Yesu ya umarce su cewa, “Kada ku faɗa wa kowa abin da kuka gani, sai bayan an tā da Ɗan Mutum daga matattu.”
english: As they were coming down from the mountain, Jesus commanded them, saying, “Don’t tell anyone what you saw, until the Son of Man has risen from the dead.”

hausa: Da Ba’asha ya ji wannan, ya daina ginin Rama ya yashe aikinsa.
english: When Baasha heard of it, he stopped building Ramah, and let his work cease.

hausa: Suka tashi daga Alush, suka yi sansani a Refidim, inda babu ruwan da mutane za su sha.
english: They traveled from Alush, and encamped in Rephidim, where there was no water for the people to drink.

hausa: Ruwan inabinsu dafin macizai ne, mugun dafin gamshaƙa ne.
english: Their wine is the poison of serpents, the cruel venom of asps.

hausa: “ ‘Sa’ad da suka shiga ƙofofin fili na can ciki, dole su sa tufafin lilin; kada su sa wani rigar da aka yi da ulu yayinda suke hidima a ƙofofin fili na can ciki da cikin haikali.
english: “‘“It will be that when they enter in at the gates of the inner court, they shall be clothed with linen garments. No wool shall come on them while they minister in the gates of the inner court, and within.

hausa: ya ce, “Ya Ubangiji, Allah na Isra’ila, babu Allah kamar ka a sama can bisa, ko a ƙasa can ƙarƙashi, kai da kake kiyaye alkawarinka na ƙauna ga bayinka waɗanda suke cin gaba a hanyarka da dukan zuciyarsu.
english: and he said, “Yahweh, the God of Israel, there is no God like you, in heaven above, or on earth beneath; who keeps covenant and loving kindness with your servants who walk before you with all their heart;

hausa: Daga baya, sai suka tura waɗansu Farisiyawa da mutanen Hiridus zuwa wurin Yesu, domin su sa masa tarko a cikin maganarsa.
english: They sent some of the Pharisees and the Herodians to him, that they might trap him with words.

hausa: Amma yanzu, ta wurin mutuwa ga abin da dā ya daure mu, an sake mu daga dokar saboda mu yi hidima a sabuwar hanyar Ruhu, ba a tsohuwar hanyar rubutaccen ƙa’ida ba.
english: But now we have been discharged from the law, having died to that in which we were held; so that we serve in newness of the spirit, and not in oldness of the letter.

hausa: sai suka gane cewa shi ne mutumin nan wanda dā yake zama yana bara a bakin ƙofar haikalin da ake kira Kyakkyawa, suka kuwa cika da mamaki da tsoro a kan abin da ya faru gare shi.
english: They recognized him, that it was he who used to sit begging for gifts for the needy at the Beautiful Gate of the temple. They were filled with wonder and amazement at what had happened to him.

hausa: Bari Ubangiji yă sāka maka saboda abin da ka yi. Bari Ubangiji, Allah na Isra’ila yă sāka maka a yalwace, a ƙarƙashin fikafikan da ka sami mafaka.”
english: May Yahweh repay your work, and a full reward be given to you from Yahweh, the God of Israel, under whose wings you have come to take refuge.”

hausa: Dawuda ya ce, “Ɗana Solomon matashi ne kuma bai gogu ba, kuma gidan da za a gina wa Ubangiji zai zama mai ƙayatarwa ƙwarai, sananne da kuma mai daraja a idon dukan al’ummai. Saboda haka zan yi shirye-shirye saboda shi.” Sai Dawuda ya yi ɗumbun shirye-shirye kafin mutuwarsa.
english: David said, “Solomon my son is young and tender, and the house that is to be built for Yahweh must be exceedingly magnificent, of fame and of glory throughout all countries. I will therefore make preparation for it.” So David prepared abundantly before his death.

hausa: Sa’ad da manomi ya yi noma don shuki, yakan ci gaba da noma ne? Yakan ci gaba da sara yana yin kunyoyi a ƙasa ne?
english: Does he who plows to sow plow continually? Does he keep turning the soil and breaking the clods?

hausa: Ka kasance a Eden, a lambun Allah; aka yi maka ado da kowane dutse mai daraja, yakutu, tofaz, da zumurrudu, kirisolit, onis da yasfa, saffaya, turkuwoyis da beril. Tsare-tsare da shirye-shiryenka an yi su da zinariya ne; a ranar da aka halicce ka an shirya su.
english: You were in Eden, the garden of God. Every precious stone adorned you: ruby, topaz, emerald, chrysolite, onyx, jasper, sapphire, turquoise, and beryl. Gold work of tambourines and of pipes was in you. They were prepared in the day that you were created.

hausa: Ba zai ji tsoron labari marar daɗi ba; zuciyarsa tsayayyiya ce, tana dogara ga Ubangiji.
english: He will not be afraid of evil news. His heart is steadfast, trusting in Yahweh.

hausa: Ta wurin hikima ce ake gina gida, kuma ta wurin fahimi ake kafa ta;
english: Through wisdom a house is built; by understanding it is established;

hausa: Yayinda dukan mutane suna cikin sauraronsa, sai Yesu ya ce wa almajiransa,
english: In the hearing of all the people, he said to his disciples,

hausa: Yesu da almajiransa suka tafi ƙauyukan da suke kewaye da Kaisariya Filibbi. A hanya ya tambaye su ya ce, “Wa, mutane suke ce da ni?”
english: Jesus went out, with his disciples, into the villages of Caesarea Philippi. On the way he asked his disciples, “Who do men say that I am?”

hausa: Bayan kusan kwana goma, Ubangiji ya bugi Nabal, sai ya mutu.
english: About ten days later, Yahweh struck Nabal, so that he died.

hausa: “ ‘Kada ka kusaci mace don ka yi jima’i da ita a lokacin ƙazantar al’adarta.
english: “‘You shall not approach a woman to uncover her nakedness, as long as she is impure by her uncleanness.

hausa: Sa’an nan za mu fāɗa masa duk inda yake, za mu fāɗa masa kamar yadda raɓa takan fāɗo a bisa ƙasa. Da shi da mutanensa babu ko ɗaya da za a bari da rai.
english: So we will come on him in some place where he will be found, and we will light on him as the dew falls on the ground, then we will not leave so much as one of him and of all the men who are with him.

hausa: Wannan birni ba za tă zama muku tukunya ba, ba kuwa za ku zama nama a cikinta ba; zan hukunta ku a iyakokin Isra’ila.
english: This will not be your cauldron, neither will you be the meat in the middle of it. I will judge you in the border of Israel.

hausa: Sa’an nan ya auna nisan da take daga hanyar shiga da take ƙasa-ƙasa daga ciki zuwa waje na filin ciki; ya kai kamu ɗari a gefen gabas haka ma yake a gefen arewa.
english: Then he measured the width from the forefront of the lower gate to the forefront of the inner court outside, one hundred cubits, both on the east and on the north.

hausa: ’Yan matan Urushalima, ku yi mini alkawari. Ba za ku tā da ko ku farka ƙauna ba sai haka ya zama lalle.
english: I adjure you, daughters of Jerusalem, that you not stir up, nor awaken love, until it so desires.

hausa: “Na damu da na naɗa Shawulu sarki, domin ya juya mini baya, bai kuma bi umarnina ba.” Sama’ila ya damu ƙwarai, ya yi kuka ga Ubangiji dukan dare.
english: “It grieves me that I have set up Saul to be king, for he has turned back from following me, and has not performed my commandments.” Samuel was angry; and he cried to Yahweh all night.

hausa: Zan kawar da maitarku, ba za a ƙara yin sihiri ba.
english: I will destroy witchcraft from your hand. You shall have no soothsayers.

hausa: amma saboda mu ma, mu da Allah zai lissafta adalci, mu da muka ba da gaskiya gare shi da ya tashe Yesu Ubangijinmu daga matattu.
english: but for our sake also, to whom it will be accounted, who believe in him who raised Jesus our Lord from the dead,

hausa: Sai dai ba su bar yin zunuban gidan Yerobowam ba, wanda ya sa Isra’ila ta aikata; suka ci gaba da yinsu. Haka ma, ginshiƙin Ashera ta kasance a tsaye a cikin Samariya.
english: Nevertheless they didn’t depart from the sins of the house of Jeroboam, with which he made Israel to sin, but walked in them; and the Asherah also remained in Samaria.)

hausa: Sa’ad da Zebul gwamnar birnin ya ji abin da Ga’al ɗan Ebed ya ce, sai ya fusata.
english: When Zebul the ruler of the city heard the words of Gaal the son of Ebed, his anger burned.

hausa: yana cike da girman kai bai kuma san kome ba. Yana da mugun halin son gardama da muhawwara game da kalmomin da suke kawo kishi, rikici, maganar ƙeta, da mugayen zace-zace
english: he is conceited, knowing nothing, but obsessed with arguments, disputes, and word battles, from which come envy, strife, insulting, evil suspicions,

hausa: Hayaƙi yana fitowa daga hancinta kamar daga tukunya mai tafasa a kan wutar itace.
english: Out of his nostrils a smoke goes, as of a boiling pot over a fire of reeds.

hausa: ko mai ƙusumbi, ko wada, ko wanda yake da lahani a ido, ko mai cuta mai sa ƙaiƙayi, ko mai kirci, ko wanda aka daƙe, ba zai yi kusa domin yă miƙa hadaya ba.
english: or hunchbacked, or a dwarf, or one who has a defect in his eye, or an itching disease, or scabs, or who has damaged testicles.

hausa: Yanzu fa, sai ka ji maganar Ubangiji. Ka ce, “ ‘Kada in yi annabci a kan Isra’ila, kuma in daina yin wa’azi a kan gidan Ishaku.’
english: Now therefore listen to Yahweh’s word: ‘You say, Don’t prophesy against Israel, and don’t preach against the house of Isaac.’

hausa: Bayan mutuwar Musa bawan Ubangiji, sai Ubangiji ya ce wa Yoshuwa ɗan Nun, mataimakin Musa,
english: Now after the death of Moses the servant of Yahweh, Yahweh spoke to Joshua the son of Nun, Moses’ servant, saying,

hausa: Ko’ina a Masar ƙanƙara ta bugi duk abin da yake a gonaki, mutane da dabbobi, ta bugi duk ganyaye da suke a gonaki, ta kuma ragargaza kowane itace.
english: The hail struck throughout all the land of Egypt all that was in the field, both man and animal; and the hail struck every herb of the field, and broke every tree of the field.

hausa: Daga Sihiyona, cikakkiya a kyau, Allah na haskakawa.
english: Out of Zion, the perfection of beauty, God shines out.

hausa: Sa’ad da Arameyawan Damaskus suka zo don su taimaki Hadadezer sarkin Zoba, sai Dawuda ya karkashe dubu ashirin da biyunsu.
english: When the Syrians of Damascus came to help Hadadezer king of Zobah, David struck twenty two thousand men of the Syrians.

hausa: Ban gane abin da nake yi ba. Don abin da nakan so yi, ba shi nakan yi ba, sai dai abin da nake ƙi, shi nake yi.
english: For I don’t understand what I am doing. For I don’t practice what I desire to do; but what I hate, that I do.

hausa: Yana kama masu wayo cikin wayonsu, yana kawar da shirye-shiryensu ba za su yi nasara ba.
english: He takes the wise in their own craftiness; the counsel of the cunning is carried headlong.

hausa: “Ka yi ƙidayan dukan al’umman Isra’ilawa bisa ga iyalansu da kabilarsu, ka rubuta kowa da sunansa bi da bi.
english: “Take a census of all the congregation of the children of Israel, by their families, by their fathers’ houses, according to the number of the names, every male, one by one,

hausa: sai su yi barbara a gaban rassan. Sai kuwa su haifi ƙanana masu zāne dabbare-dabbare, ko babare-babare ko masu zāne-zāne.
english: The flocks conceived before the rods, and the flocks produced streaked, speckled, and spotted.

hausa: Rana za tă duhunta wata kuma yă zama jini kafin isowar babbar ranan nan mai banrazana ta Ubangiji.
english: The sun will be turned into darkness, and the moon into blood, before the great and terrible day of Yahweh comes.

hausa: Duk sa’ad da mugayen ruhohi suka gan shi, sai fāɗi a gabansa, su ɗaga murya, su ce, “Kai Ɗan Allah ne.”
english: The unclean spirits, whenever they saw him, fell down before him and cried, “You are the Son of God!”

hausa: Dawuda zauna a kagarar, ta haka aka kira ta Birnin Dawuda.
english: David lived in the stronghold; therefore they called it David’s city.

hausa: Da Yesu yana zaune a Dutsen Zaitun, almajiran suka zo wurinsa a ɓoye. Suka ce, “Gaya mana, yaushe ne wannan zai faru, mece ce alamar zuwanka da kuma ta ƙarshen zamani?”
english: As he sat on the Mount of Olives, the disciples came to him privately, saying, “Tell us, when will these things be? What is the sign of your coming, and of the end of the age?”

hausa: Ana cikin haka, Abner ɗan Ner, komandan sojojin Shawulu, ya ɗauki Ish-Boshet ɗan Shawulu ya kawo shi Mahanayim.
english: Now Abner the son of Ner, captain of Saul’s army, had taken Ishbosheth the son of Saul and brought him over to Mahanaim.

hausa: Ubangiji yana a hannun damanka; zai murƙushe sarakuna a ranar fushinsa.
english: The Lord is at your right hand. He will crush kings in the day of his wrath.

hausa: “Kada ku kāsa yin adalci ga matalauci a wurin shari’a.
english: “You shall not deny justice to your poor people in their lawsuits.

hausa: Suna kan tafiya a hanya, sai wani mutum ya ce masa, “Zan bi ka, duk inda za ka.”
english: As they went on the way, a certain man said to him, “I want to follow you wherever you go, Lord.”

hausa: Sai sojojin gwamna suka ɗauki Yesu suka kai shi Fadar mai mulki, sa’an nan suka tara dukan kamfanin sojoji kewaye da shi.
english: Then the governor’s soldiers took Jesus into the Praetorium, and gathered the whole garrison together against him.

hausa: Dukan mugayen duniya ka zubar kamar datti; saboda haka nake ƙaunar farillanka.
english: You put away all the wicked of the earth like dross. Therefore I love your testimonies.

hausa: Sai suka sa mahaifinsu ya sha ruwan inabi, a wannan dare ma, ƙanuwar ta shiga ta kwana da shi. Bai kuwa san sa’ad da ta kwanta ko sa’ad da ta tashi ba.
english: They made their father drink wine that night also. The younger went and lay with him. He didn’t know when she lay down, nor when she got up.

hausa: Cikin talatin ɗin kuwa akwai, Asahel, ɗan’uwan Yowab, Elhanan, ɗan Dodo mutumin Betlehem,
english: Asahel the brother of Joab was one of the thirty: Elhanan the son of Dodo of Bethlehem,

hausa: Saboda haka ya tuƙa bulala ta igiyoyi, ya kori duka daga filin haikali, har da tumaki da shanu; ya watsar da kuɗin masu canjin, ya birkice teburansu.
english: He made a whip of cords and drove all out of the temple, both the sheep and the oxen; and he poured out the changers’ money and overthrew their tables.

hausa: Bayan Yesu ya yi wannan magana, sai ya yi gaba zuwa Urushalima.
english: Having said these things, he went on ahead, going up to Jerusalem.

hausa: Kada ku yarda wani yă ɓata ku, cewa shi wani abu ne don yă ga wahayi. Irin mutumin nan yakan nuna ƙasƙancin kai na ƙarya, yă kuma ce yana yi wa mala’iku sujada. Irin mutumin nan yana kumbura kansa ba dalili, sai son zuciya irin na halin mutuntaka.
english: Let no one rob you of your prize by self-abasement and worshiping of the angels, dwelling in the things which he has not seen, vainly puffed up by his fleshly mind,

hausa: Ya ce mini, “Ɗan mutum, ka ga abin da dattawan gidan Isra’ila suke yi a cikin duhu, kowa yana a ɗakin tsafin gunkinsa? Suna cewa, ‘Ubangiji ba ya ganinmu; Ubangiji ya yashe ƙasar.’ ”
english: Then he said to me, “Son of man, have you seen what the elders of the house of Israel do in the dark, every man in his rooms of imagery? For they say, ‘Yahweh doesn’t see us. Yahweh has forsaken the land.’”

hausa: Suka tashi daga Dofka, suka yi sansani a Alush.
english: They traveled from Dophkah, and encamped in Alush.

hausa: Suka aiki shugabanni guda goma su tafi tare da shi, ɗaya daga kowace kabilar Isra’ila, kowannensu shugaba ne a iyalansa.
english: With him were ten princes, one prince of a fathers’ house for each of the tribes of Israel; and they were each head of their fathers’ houses among the thousands of Israel.

hausa: Sa’ad da matattu suka tashi, ba za su yi aure ba, ba kuwa za a ba da su ga aure ba. Za su zama kamar yadda mala’iku suke a cikin sama.
english: For when they will rise from the dead, they neither marry nor are given in marriage, but are like angels in heaven.

hausa: Ina ne hanyar zuwa wurin da ake samun walƙiya, ko kuma inda daga nan ne ake watsa iskar gabas zuwa ko’ina cikin duniya?
english: By what way is the lightning distributed, or the east wind scattered on the earth?

hausa: Kamar yadda mahaifi yake jin tausayin ’ya’yansa, haka Ubangiji yake jin tausayin waɗanda suke tsoronsa;
english: Like a father has compassion on his children, so Yahweh has compassion on those who fear him.

hausa: Ka fadada hanya a ƙarƙashina domin kada idon ƙafana yă juya.
english: You have enlarged my steps under me. My feet have not slipped.

hausa: Amma Musa ya ce, “Wannan ba zai yiwu ba. Hadayun da mukan miƙa wa Ubangiji, Allahnmu haram ne ga Masarawa. In kuwa muka miƙa hadayun da suke haram a idanunsu, ba za su jajjefe mu ba?
english: Moses said, “It isn’t appropriate to do so; for we shall sacrifice the abomination of the Egyptians to Yahweh our God. Behold, if we sacrifice the abomination of the Egyptians before their eyes, won’t they stone us?

hausa: Zai cire dukan kitsen daga bijimin hadaya don zunubi, kitsen da ya rufe kayan cikin, ko kuwa da suka shafe su,
english: He shall take all the fat of the bull of the sin offering from it: the fat that covers the innards, and all the fat that is on the innards,

hausa: Shugabanni dukan kabilan mutane na kabilan Isra’ila suka zazzauna a wurarensu a taron jama’ar Allah, mayaƙa dubu ɗari huɗu masu ɗamara da takuba.
english: The chiefs of all the people, even of all the tribes of Israel, presented themselves in the assembly of the people of God, four hundred thousand footmen who drew sword.

hausa: Ubangiji ya ce wa Musa, “Yi magana da firistoci, ’ya’yan Haruna maza, ka ce musu, ‘Kada firist yă ƙazantar da kansa saboda wani cikin mutanensa da suka mutu,
english: Yahweh said to Moses, “Speak to the priests, the sons of Aaron, and say to them, ‘A priest shall not defile himself for the dead among his people,

hausa: Musa da Haruna da ’ya’yansu za su yi sansani gabas da tabanakul, wajen fitowar rana; a gaban Tentin Sujada. Su ne da hakkin lura da wuri mai tsarki a madadin Isra’ilawa. Duk wani wanda ba ya wannan aiki, ya kuma kusaci wuri mai tsarki, za a kashe shi.
english: Those who encamp before the tabernacle eastward, in front of the Tent of Meeting toward the sunrise, shall be Moses, with Aaron and his sons, keeping the requirements of the sanctuary for the duty of the children of Israel. The outsider who comes near shall be put to death.

hausa: Za a yi babbar hanya saboda raguwa mutanensa da ta rage daga Assuriya, kamar yadda ta kasance wa Isra’ila sa’ad da suka fito daga Masar.
english: There will be a highway for the remnant that is left of his people from Assyria, like there was for Israel in the day that he came up out of the land of Egypt.

hausa: Mutanen Efraim, ko da yake suna da bakkuna, suka juya da baya a ranar yaƙi;
english: The children of Ephraim, being armed and carrying bows, turned back in the day of battle.

hausa: Gama wane ne Allah in ba Ubangiji ba? Wane ne kuwa Dutse in ba Allahnmu ba?
english: For who is God, except Yahweh? Who is a rock, besides our God,

hausa: Ban da wannan kuma, mun aiko da ɗan’uwanmu tare da su, wanda ya sha tabbatar mana da ƙwazonsa ta hanyoyi iri-iri, musamman yanzu, domin ya amince da ku da gaske.
english: We have sent with them our brother whom we have many times proved earnest in many things, but now much more earnest, by reason of the great confidence which he has in you.

hausa: “Saboda haka ga abin da Ubangiji Mai Iko Duka yana cewa kamar yadda na ba da itacen kuringa a cikin itatuwan kurmi ya zama itacen wuta, haka zan sa mazaunan Urushalima su zama.
english: Therefore the Lord Yahweh says: “As the vine wood among the trees of the forest, which I have given to the fire for fuel, so I will give the inhabitants of Jerusalem.

hausa: Sa’an nan suka yi kuka ga Ubangiji cikin wahalarsu, ya kuma cece su daga damuwarsu.
english: Then they cried to Yahweh in their trouble, and he delivered them out of their distresses.

hausa: Zan komo da su daga zaman bauta in mai da su zuwa Masar ta Bisa, ƙasarsu ta ainihi. A can za su zama masarauta marar ƙarfi.
english: I will reverse the captivity of Egypt, and will cause them to return into the land of Pathros, into the land of their birth. There they will be a lowly kingdom.

hausa: Ga wata magana tabbatacciya wadda ta cancanci cikakkiyar karɓa. Kiristi Yesu ya zo duniya domin ceton masu zunubi, wanda nake mafi muni a cikinsu.
english: The saying is faithful and worthy of all acceptance, that Christ Jesus came into the world to save sinners, of whom I am chief.

hausa: suka tambaye shi suka ce, “Don me kake yin baftisma in kai ba Kiristi ba ne, ba kuwa Iliya ba, ba kuma annabin nan ba?”
english: They asked him, “Why then do you baptize if you are not the Christ, nor Elijah, nor the prophet?”

hausa: Kamar yadda sammai suna can bisa duniya kuma tana da zurfi, haka zukatan sarakuna suka wuce a bincika.
english: As the heavens for height, and the earth for depth, so the hearts of kings are unsearchable.

hausa: Raina yana ƙishin Allah, Allah mai rai. Yaushe zan tafi in sadu da Allah ne?
english: My soul thirsts for God, for the living God. When shall I come and appear before God?

hausa: Yesu yana kan shiga cikin jirgin ruwa ke nan, sai mutumin da dā yake da aljanun ya roƙa yă bi shi.
english: As he was entering into the boat, he who had been possessed by demons begged him that he might be with him.

hausa: Abram ya azurta ƙwarai da dabbobi, da azurfa, da kuma zinariya.
english: Abram was very rich in livestock, in silver, and in gold.

hausa: Sai dai ku yi murna cewa kuna tarayya cikin shan wahalolin Kiristi, domin ku kai ga farin ciki mai yawa sa’ad da aka bayyana ɗaukakarsa.
english: But because you are partakers of Christ’s sufferings, rejoice, that at the revelation of his glory you also may rejoice with exceeding joy.

hausa: Da yake Allah yana tare da mu, sai suka aiko mana da Sherebiya, wanda ya iya aiki, shi daga zuriyar Mali ɗan Lawi ne, ɗan Isra’ila. Sai ya zo tare da ’ya’yansa da kuma ’yan’uwansa. Dukansu dai mutum 18 ne.
english: According to the good hand of our God on us they brought us a man of discretion, of the sons of Mahli, the son of Levi, the son of Israel, namely Sherebiah, with his sons and his brothers, eighteen;

hausa: Ga maganar Ubangiji da ta zo wa Irmiya annabi game da Filistiyawa kafin Fir’auna ya yaƙi Gaza.
english: Yahweh’s word that came to Jeremiah the prophet concerning the Philistines, before Pharaoh struck Gaza.

hausa: Ba lalle ba ne ku yi wannan yaƙi. Ku dai, ku ja dāgā, ku tsaya kurum ku ga nasarar da Ubangiji zai ba ku, ya Yahuda da Urushalima. Kada ku ji tsoro; kada ku karai. Ku fito don ku fuskance su gobe, Ubangiji kuwa zai kasance tare ku.’ ”
english: You will not need to fight this battle. Set yourselves, stand still, and see the salvation of Yahweh with you, O Judah and Jerusalem. Don’t be afraid, nor be dismayed. Go out against them tomorrow, for Yahweh is with you.’”

hausa: Saboda haka mutanensu sun juya gare su suna kuma shan ruwa a yalwace.
english: Therefore their people return to them, and they drink up waters of abundance.

hausa: A shekara ta ashirin da bakwai ta mulkin Yerobowam sarkin Isra’ila, Azariya ɗan Amaziya, sarkin Yahuda ya fara mulki.
english: In the twenty-seventh year of Jeroboam king of Israel, Azariah son of Amaziah king of Judah began to reign.

hausa: Ubangiji ya ce wa Musa,
english: Yahweh spoke to Moses, saying,

hausa: Kashegari Yesu ya yanke shawara yă tafi Galili. Da ya sami Filibus sai ya ce masa, “Bi ni.”
english: On the next day, he was determined to go out into Galilee, and he found Philip. Jesus said to him, “Follow me.”

hausa: Lokaci yana zuwa da za a kwashe kome a fadanka da kuma dukan abubuwan da kakanninka suka tara har yă zuwa yau, a kai su Babilon. Ba abin da za a rage, in ji Ubangiji.
english: ‘Behold, the days come that all that is in your house, and that which your fathers have laid up in store to this day, will be carried to Babylon. Nothing will be left,’ says Yahweh.

hausa: Ka mai da mu, ya Allah Maɗaukaki; ka sa fuskarka ta haskaka a kanmu za mu kuwa cetu.
english: Turn us again, God of Armies. Cause your face to shine, and we will be saved.

hausa: A ƙarshe, wani ruhu ya zo gaba, ya tsaya a gaban Ubangiji ya ce, ‘Zan ruɗe shi.’
english: A spirit came out and stood before Yahweh, and said, ‘I will entice him.’

hausa: An gwada alkawuranka sarai, bawanka kuwa yana ƙaunarsu.
english: Your promises have been thoroughly tested, and your servant loves them.

hausa: Dawuda kuma ya tafi tare da dukan mutanen da suke tare da shi, kowa da iyalinsa, suka zauna a Hebron da garuruwansa.
english: David brought up his men who were with him, every man with his household. They lived in the cities of Hebron.

hausa: Ko ka duba zuciyata, ka kuma bincike ni da dare, ko ka gwada ni, ba za ka sami kome ba; na yanke shawara cewa bakina ba zai yi zunubi ba.
english: You have proved my heart. You have visited me in the night. You have tried me, and found nothing. I have resolved that my mouth shall not disobey.

hausa: “ ‘Gama ga abin da Ubangiji Mai Iko Duka yana cewa ni kaina zan nemi tumakina.
english: “‘For the Lord Yahweh says: “Behold, I myself, even I, will search for my sheep, and will seek them out.

hausa: Na yi tafiye-tafiye da yawa, na sha hatsari a koguna, na sha hatsarin ’yan fashi, na sha hatsari a hannun kabilarmu, na sha hatsari a hannun al’ummai, na sha hatsari a birane, na sha hatsari a jeji, na sha hatsari a teku, na kuma sha hatsarin ’yan’uwa na ƙarya.
english: I have been in travels often, perils of rivers, perils of robbers, perils from my countrymen, perils from the Gentiles, perils in the city, perils in the wilderness, perils in the sea, perils among false brothers;

hausa: “Wani mutumin da ake kira Ananiyas ya zo ya gan ni. Shi mai ibada ne wajen kiyaye dokoki wanda dukan Yahudawan da suke zama a can suna girmama shi ƙwarai.
english: “One Ananias, a devout man according to the law, well reported of by all the Jews who lived in Damascus,

hausa: Sa’an nan shugabannin Isra’ila, wato, shugabannin iyalai waɗanda suke shugabancin kabilan da aka ƙidaya, suka miƙa hadayu.
english: the princes of Israel, the heads of their fathers’ houses, gave offerings. These were the princes of the tribes. These are they who were over those who were counted;

hausa: Saboda haka na fito don in sadu da kai; na neme ka na kuma same ka!
english: Therefore I came out to meet you, to diligently seek your face, and I have found you.

hausa: Da a ce na ji daɗin zunubi a zuciyata, da Ubangiji ba zai saurara ba;
english: If I cherished sin in my heart, the Lord wouldn’t have listened.

hausa: Iliya mutum ne kamar mu. Ya yi addu’a da gaske don kada a yi ruwan sama, ba a kuma yi ruwan sama a ƙasar ba har shekaru uku da rabi.
english: Elijah was a man with a nature like ours, and he prayed earnestly that it might not rain, and it didn’t rain on the earth for three years and six months.

hausa: Ku shiga ƙofofinsa da godiya filayen gidansa kuma da yabo; ku gode masa ku kuma yabi sunansa.
english: Enter into his gates with thanksgiving, and into his courts with praise. Give thanks to him, and bless his name.

hausa: Malkiram, Fedahiya, Shenazzar, Yekamiya, Hoshama da Nedabiya.
english: Malchiram, Pedaiah, Shenazzar, Jekamiah, Hoshama, and Nedabiah.

hausa: “Ku ne kaɗai na zaɓa cikin dukan al’umman duniya; saboda haka zan hukunta ku saboda dukan zunubanku.”
english: “I have chosen only you of all the families of the earth. Therefore I will punish you for all of your sins.”

hausa: Sai Ubangiji ya ce, “Ai, wannan kuringa ta tsira dare ɗaya ta kuma ɓace kafin dare na biyu, ba ka yi wata wahala dominta ba, ba kai ne ka sa ta yi girma ba, duk da haka ranka ya ɓace saboda ita.
english: Yahweh said, “You have been concerned for the vine, for which you have not labored, neither made it grow; which came up in a night and perished in a night.

hausa: Sai suka tafi wurin sarki suka yi masa magana game da dokar mulkinsa, suka ce, “Ashe, ba ka yi doka cewa a cikin kwana talatin nan gaba duk wanda aka tarar yana addu’a ga wani allah ko mutum in ba kai ba, ya sarki, za ka jefa shi a cikin ramin zakoki ba?” Sarki ya amsa ya ce, “Dokar tana nan daram bisa ga dokar Medes da Farisa, waɗanda ba a iya sokewa.”
english: Then they came near, and spoke before the king concerning the king’s decree: “Haven’t you signed a decree that every man who makes a petition to any god or man within thirty days, except to you, O king, shall be cast into the den of lions?” The king answered, “This thing is true, according to the law of the Medes and Persians, which doesn’t alter.”

hausa: Wannan ne ƙaddarar waɗanda suke dogara a kansu, da kuma ta mabiyansu, waɗanda suka tabbatar da faɗinsu. Sela
english: This is the destiny of those who are foolish, and of those who approve their sayings. Selah.

hausa: Filistiyawa suka tattara sojojinsu domin su yaƙi Isra’ila. Akish ya ce wa Dawuda, “Sai ka sani fa, kai da mutanenka za ku tafi tare da ni da sojojina.”
english: In those days, the Philistines gathered their armies together for warfare, to fight with Israel. Achish said to David, “Know assuredly that you will go out with me in the army, you and your men.”

hausa: Mutumin da ya yi shuki, da mutumin da ya yi banruwa nufinsu ɗaya ne, kuma kowannensu zai sami lada gwargwadon aikinsa.
english: Now he who plants and he who waters are the same, but each will receive his own reward according to his own labor.

hausa: A lokacin sun kashe mutanen Mowab dubu goma, dukansu jarumawa da masu ji da ƙarfi; ba ko ɗaya da ya tsira.
english: They struck at that time about ten thousand men of Moab, every strong man and every man of valor. No man escaped.

hausa: Benahiya, mutumin Firaton, da Hiddai, daga rafuffukan Ga’ash,
english: Benaiah a Pirathonite, Hiddai of the brooks of Gaash.

hausa: Suka kuma yi tsattsarkan mai na shafewa da kuma zalla turare mai ƙanshi, yadda mai yin turare yakan yi.
english: He made the holy anointing oil and the pure incense of sweet spices, after the art of the perfumer.

hausa: Ubangiji mai tausayi ne da kuma alheri, mai jinkirin fushi, cike da ƙauna.
english: Yahweh is merciful and gracious, slow to anger, and abundant in loving kindness.

hausa: “Ya Ubangiji, sa’ad da ka bar Seyir, sa’ad da ka yi tafiya daga ƙasar Edom, ƙasa ta girgiza, sammai suka zubo, gizagizai sun zubo da ruwa.
english: “Yahweh, when you went out of Seir, when you marched out of the field of Edom, the earth trembled, the sky also dropped. Yes, the clouds dropped water.

hausa: Al’ummai suna hayaniya, mulkoki sun fāɗi; ya ɗaga muryarsa, duniya ta narke.
english: The nations raged. The kingdoms were moved. He lifted his voice and the earth melted.

hausa: Ko kai kake sa shi yă yi tsalle kamar fāra, ba ya jin tsoro sai dai a ji tsoronsa.
english: Have you made him to leap as a locust? The glory of his snorting is awesome.

hausa: A shekara ta hamsin ta mulkin Azariya sarkin Yahuda, Fekahiya ɗan Menahem ya zama sarkin Isra’ila a Samariya, ya kuma yi mulki shekara biyu.
english: In the fiftieth year of Azariah king of Judah, Pekahiah the son of Menahem began to reign over Israel in Samaria for two years.

hausa: Ya bayyana maganarsa ga Yaƙub, dokokinsa da ƙa’idodinsa ga Isra’ila.
english: He shows his word to Jacob, his statutes and his ordinances to Israel.

hausa: Ko da yake yana sa ciwo, shi ne kuma yake warkar da ciwon; ciwon da ya ji maka, shi da kansa zai warkar da shi.
english: For he wounds and binds up. He injures and his hands make whole.

hausa: Zai tanada efa na gari don kowane bijimi da kuma efa don kowane rago, tare da kwalabar mai don kowane efa guda.
english: He shall prepare a meal offering, an ephah for a bull, an ephah for a ram, and a hin of oil to an ephah.

hausa: Yesu kuwa ya warkar da marasa lafiya da yawa da suke da cututtuka iri-iri. Ya kuma fitar da aljanu da yawa, amma bai yarda aljanun suka yi magana ba, don sun san wane ne shi.
english: He healed many who were sick with various diseases and cast out many demons. He didn’t allow the demons to speak, because they knew him.

hausa: Duk abin da yake a ɓoye, dole za a fallasa shi. Duk abin da kuma yake a rufe, dole za a fitar da shi a fili.
english: For there is nothing hidden except that it should be made known, neither was anything made secret but that it should come to light.

hausa: Waɗanda suke mawaƙa, kawunan iyalan Lawiyawa, sukan zauna a ɗakunan haikali kuma ba sa yin waɗansu ayyuka domin su suke da hakkin aiki dare da rana.
english: These are the singers, heads of fathers’ households of the Levites, who lived in the rooms and were free from other service, for they were employed in their work day and night.

hausa: Na aike ku girbin abin da ba ku yi aikinsa ba. Waɗansu sun yi aikin nan mai wahala, ku kuwa kun sami ladan aikinsu.”
english: I sent you to reap that for which you haven’t labored. Others have labored, and you have entered into their labor.”

hausa: Dukan waɗannan sun auri baƙin mata, waɗansunsu suna da ’ya’ya.
english: All these had taken foreign wives. Some of them had wives by whom they had children.

hausa: Nan da nan zakara ya yi cara sau na biyu. Sai Bitrus ya tuna da maganar da Yesu ya yi masa cewa, “Kafin zakara yă yi cara sau biyu,za ka yi mūsun sanina sau uku.” Sai ya fashe da kuka.
english: The rooster crowed the second time. Peter remembered the words that Jesus said to him, “Before the rooster crows twice, you will deny me three times.” When he thought about that, he wept.

hausa: Ku yi murna ku kuma yi farin ciki, domin ladarku mai yawa ne a sama, gama haka suka tsananta wa annabawan da suka riga ku.
english: Rejoice, and be exceedingly glad, for great is your reward in heaven. For that is how they persecuted the prophets who were before you.

hausa: Yanzu, ka ba da umarni a dawo da shanunku da kuma kome da kuke da shi wanda yake a gona zuwa gida, gama ƙanƙarar za tă kashe kowane mutum ko dabba wadda take a gona wadda ba a kawo cikin gida ba, sa’ad da ta fāɗo.’ ”
english: Now therefore command that all of your livestock and all that you have in the field be brought into shelter. The hail will come down on every man and animal that is found in the field, and isn’t brought home, and they will die.”’”

hausa: Yesu ya ce musu, “Ubana yana cikin aikinsa kullum har yă zuwa wannan rana, haka ni ma, ina kan aiki.”
english: But Jesus answered them, “My Father is still working, so I am working, too.”

hausa: To, sai ku ƙaunaci Ubangiji Allahnku, kullum ku kuma kiyaye abubuwan da yake bukata, ku kiyaye ƙa’idodinsa, dokokinsa da kuma umarnansu.
english: Therefore you shall love Yahweh your God, and keep his instructions, his statutes, his ordinances, and his commandments, always.

hausa: Kafin Dawuda yă tashi da safe kashegari, maganar Ubangiji ta riga ta zo wa annabin nan Gad, mai duban nan na Dawuda. Ubangiji ya ce,
english: When David rose up in the morning, Yahweh’s word came to the prophet Gad, David’s seer, saying,

hausa: Gama na kiyaye hanyoyin Ubangiji; ban yi wani mugun abu da zai juyar da ni daga Allahna ba.
english: For I have kept Yahweh’s ways, and have not wickedly departed from my God.

hausa: Ya ce mini, “An gama. Ni ne Alfa da kuma Omega, na Farko da kuma na Ƙarshe. Duk mai jin ƙishirwa zan ba shi abin sha kyauta daga maɓulɓular ruwan rai.
english: He said to me, “I am the Alpha and the Omega, the Beginning and the End. I will give freely to him who is thirsty from the spring of the water of life.

hausa: Sau da yawa ya cece su, amma sun nace su yi tawaye suka kuma lalace cikin zunubinsu.
english: He rescued them many times, but they were rebellious in their counsel, and were brought low in their iniquity.

hausa: Ba na so ku kasance cikin rashin sani game da wannan asirin ’yan’uwa, domin kada ku ɗaga kai. Isra’ila sun ɗanɗana sashe na taurarewa har sai da shigowar Al’ummai masu yawa ya cika.
english: For I don’t desire you to be ignorant, brothers, of this mystery, so that you won’t be wise in your own conceits, that a partial hardening has happened to Israel, until the fullness of the Gentiles has come in,

hausa: “Sau da yawa na ɓata gonakinku da fumfuna da kuma cuta. Fāri suka cinye itatuwanku na inabi da na ɓaure, da na zaitun duk da haka ba ku juyo gare ni ba,” in ji Ubangiji.
english: “I struck you with blight and mildew many times in your gardens and your vineyards, and the swarming locusts have devoured your fig trees and your olive trees; yet you haven’t returned to me,” says Yahweh.

hausa: Sai suka yaɗa labari marar kyau ga Isra’ilawa game da ƙasar da suka binciko. Suka ce, “Ƙasar da muka ratsa cikinta domin mu leƙi asirinta, tana cinye waɗanda suke zama a cikinta. Dukan mutanen da muka gani a wurin, ƙatti ne.
english: They brought up an evil report of the land which they had spied out to the children of Israel, saying, “The land, through which we have gone to spy it out, is a land that eats up its inhabitants; and all the people who we saw in it are men of great stature.

hausa: Ubangiji Maɗaukaki ya ce, ‘Zan aika shi, zai shiga gidan ɓarawo, da gidan mai rantsuwar ƙarya da sunana. Zai kasance a gidansa yă hallaka gidan da katakon da duwatsun.’ ”
english: I will cause it to go out,” says Yahweh of Armies, “and it will enter into the house of the thief, and into the house of him who swears falsely by my name; and it will remain in the middle of his house, and will destroy it with its timber and its stones.”

hausa: Akwai riba ƙwarai ta kowace hanya! Da farko dai, su ne aka danƙa wa kalmomin nan na Allah.
english: Much in every way! Because first of all, they were entrusted with the revelations of God.

hausa: Aka jefar da ƙaton jan macijin ƙasa, tsohon maciji nan da ake kira Iblis, ko Shaiɗan, wanda ya ɓad da dukan duniya. Aka jefar da shi ƙasa, tare da mala’ikunsa a duniya.
english: The great dragon was thrown down, the old serpent, he who is called the devil and Satan, the deceiver of the whole world. He was thrown down to the earth, and his angels were thrown down with him.

hausa: Babiloniyawa kuwa suka farfasa ginshiƙan tagulla, da dakalai, da babbar kwatarniya, waɗanda suke a haikalin Ubangiji. Suka kwashe tagulla duka suka kai Babilon.
english: The Chaldeans broke the pillars of bronze that were in Yahweh’s house and the bases and the bronze sea that were in Yahweh’s house in pieces, and carried all of their bronze to Babylon.

hausa: Akwai wani abin da za a ce, “Duba! Ga wani abu sabo”? Abin yana nan, tun dā can, ya kasance kafin lokacinmu.
english: Is there a thing of which it may be said, “Behold, this is new”? It has been long ago, in the ages which were before us.

hausa: Kada ku miƙa hadayar Bikin Ƙetarewa a wani garin da Ubangiji Allahnku yake ba ku,
english: You may not sacrifice the Passover within any of your gates which Yahweh your God gives you;

hausa: Sai ya gaya musu wannan misali ya ce, “Gonar wani mai arziki ta ba da amfani sosai.
english: He spoke a parable to them, saying, “The ground of a certain rich man produced abundantly.

hausa: Ba za a kashe iyaye a maimakon ’ya’yansu ba, ba kuwa za a kashe ’ya’ya a maimakon iyayensu ba; kowa ya yi zunubi, shi za a kashe.
english: The fathers shall not be put to death for the children, neither shall the children be put to death for the fathers. Every man shall be put to death for his own sin.

hausa: Muna kuma gargaɗe ku, ’yan’uwa, ku gargaɗe waɗanda suke zaman banza, ku ƙarfafa masu raunanar zuciya, ku taimaki marasa ƙarfi, ku yi haƙuri da kowa.
english: We exhort you, brothers: Admonish the disorderly; encourage the faint-hearted; support the weak; be patient toward all.

hausa: za ku sami kyakkyawar marabta cikin madawwamin mulkin Ubangijinmu da Mai Cetonmu Yesu Kiristi.
english: For thus you will be richly supplied with the entrance into the eternal Kingdom of our Lord and Savior, Jesus Christ.

hausa: Aka kawo dutsen aka rufe bakin ramin, sa’an nan sarki ya hatimce shi da zobensa da kuma zoban manyan mutanensa, don kada wani yă canja yanayin Daniyel.
english: A stone was brought, and laid on the mouth of the den; and the king sealed it with his own signet, and with the signet of his lords; that nothing might be changed concerning Daniel.

hausa: Yesu kuwa, sane da duk abin da zai same shi, ya fito ya tambaye, su ya ce, “Wa kuke nema?”
english: Jesus therefore, knowing all the things that were happening to him, went out and said to them, “Who are you looking for?”

hausa: da kashi ɗaya bisa uku na garwan ruwan inabi, a matsayin hadaya ta sha. A miƙa ta abin ƙanshi mai daɗi ga Ubangiji.
english: and for the drink offering you shall offer the third part of a hin of wine, of a pleasant aroma to Yahweh.

hausa: ya ce masa, “Ka ratsa birnin Urushalima ka sa shaida a goshin waɗanda suke baƙin ciki da kuma makoki a kan dukan abubuwan banƙyamar da ake yi a cikinsa.”
english: Yahweh said to him, “Go through the middle of the city, through the middle of Jerusalem, and set a mark on the foreheads of the men that sigh and that cry over all the abominations that are done within it.”

hausa: Azabana, azabana! Ina birgima cikin zafi. Azabana, azabar zuciyata! Zuciyata yana bugu a cikina, Ba zan yi shiru ba. Gama na ji karan ƙaho; na ji kirarin yaƙi.
english: My anguish, my anguish! I am pained at my very heart! My heart trembles within me. I can’t hold my peace, because you have heard, O my soul, the sound of the trumpet, the alarm of war.

hausa: suna cewa, ‘Ku tsaya a can; kada ku yi kusa da ni, gama na fi ku tsarki!’ Irin mutanen nan hayaƙi ne a hancina, wuta kuma da take cin gaba da ci dukan yini.
english: who say, ‘Stay by yourself, don’t come near to me, for I am holier than you.’ These are smoke in my nose, a fire that burns all day.

hausa: Ka ce masa, Ga abin da Ubangiji ya ce, ‘Ba ka kashe mutum ka kuma ƙwace kayansa ba?’ Sa’an nan ka ce masa ga abin da Ubangiji ya ce, ‘A inda karnuka suka lashe jinin Nabot, karnuka za su lashe jininka, I, naka!’ ”
english: You shall speak to him, saying, ‘Yahweh says, “Have you killed and also taken possession?”’ You shall speak to him, saying, ‘Yahweh says, “In the place where dogs licked the blood of Naboth, dogs will lick your blood, even yours.”’”

hausa: Sai sarki ya ba da umarni a yi haka ɗin. Aka ba da doka a Shusha, aka kuma rataye ’ya’ya maza goma na Haman.
english: The king commanded this to be done. A decree was given out in Susa; and they hanged Haman’s ten sons.

hausa: daga Shufam, kabilar Shufamawa; daga Hufam, kabilar Hufamawa.
english: of Shephupham, the family of the Shuphamites; of Hupham, the family of the Huphamites.

hausa: gama “Duniya da duk abin da yake cikinta na Ubangiji ne.”
english: for “the earth is the Lord’s, and its fullness.”

hausa: Ya Ubangiji Allahna, in na yi kuskure aka kuwa sami laifi a hannuwana,
english: Yahweh, my God, if I have done this, if there is iniquity in my hands,

hausa: Akwai wani daga cikin masu mulki ko cikin Farisiyawan da ya gaskata da shi?
english: Have any of the rulers or any of the Pharisees believed in him?

hausa: Jikunansu gaba ɗaya, har da bayansu, hannuwansu da fikafikansu, sun cika gaba ɗaya da idanu, kamar yadda suke a da’irori huɗun.
english: Their whole body, including their backs, their hands, their wings, and the wheels, were full of eyes all around, even the wheels that the four of them had.

hausa: ’Ya’ya uku maza na Benyamin su ne, Bela, Beker da Yediyayel.
english: The sons of Benjamin: Bela, Becher, and Jediael, three.

hausa: Da zarar ka ji tafiya kamar na takawar sojoji tana a bisan itatuwan balsam, sai ka yi maza, gama wannan alama ce cewa Ubangiji ya sha gabanka don yă karkashe sojojin Filistiyawa.”
english: When you hear the sound of marching in the tops of the mulberry trees, then stir yourself up; for then Yahweh has gone out before you to strike the army of the Philistines.”

hausa: Dukan waɗannan na gwada su ta wurin hikima na kuma ce, “Na ƙudurta in zama mai hikima,” amma abin ya fi ƙarfina.
english: All this I have proved in wisdom. I said, “I will be wise;” but it was far from me.

hausa: Kashegari da sassafe, sai Yaƙub ya ɗauki dutsen da ya yi matashin kai da shi, ya kafa shi al’amudi, ya kuma zuba mai a kansa.
english: Jacob rose up early in the morning, and took the stone that he had put under his head, and set it up for a pillar, and poured oil on its top.

hausa: Ya shimfiɗa girgije kamar mayafi, da kuma wuta don ta ba su haske da dare.
english: He spread a cloud for a covering, fire to give light in the night.

hausa: Kada ku fitar da kayan gidajenku ko ku yi wani aiki a ranar Asabbaci mai tsarki, yadda na umarci kakanni-kakanninku.
english: Don’t carry a burden out of your houses on the Sabbath day. Don’t do any work, but make the Sabbath day holy, as I commanded your fathers.

hausa: Shirye-shiryen mai aiki tuƙuru kan kai ga riba in kuwa ka cika gaggawa zai kai ga talauci.
english: The plans of the diligent surely lead to profit; and everyone who is hasty surely rushes to poverty.

hausa: Na duba, sai ga jijiyoyi da nama suka bayyana a kansu fata kuma ta rufe su, amma ba numfashi a cikinsu.
english: I saw, and, behold, there were sinews on them, and flesh came up, and skin covered them above; but there was no breath in them.

hausa: Ya gaya musu abin da Mika ya faɗa masa ya ce, “Ya ɗauke ni aiki ya kuma sa in zama masa firist.”
english: He said to them, “Thus and thus has Micah dealt with me, and he has hired me, and I have become his priest.”

hausa: “ ‘A rana ta biyu, a miƙa bijimai goma sha biyu, raguna biyu, da ’yan raguna goma sha huɗu, bana ɗaya-ɗaya, dukansu marasa lahani.
english: “‘On the second day you shall offer twelve young bulls, two rams, and fourteen male lambs a year old without defect;

hausa: “Allah ya sa na zama abin da kowa yake magana a kai wanda kowa yake tofa wa miyau a fuska.
english: “But he has made me a byword of the people. They spit in my face.

hausa: Ya hallaka birane ashirin tun daga Arower zuwa yankin Minnit, har zuwa Abel-Keramim. Haka Isra’ila ta cinye Ammonawa ƙaf.
english: He struck them from Aroer until you come to Minnith, even twenty cities, and to Abelcheramim, with a very great slaughter. So the children of Ammon were subdued before the children of Israel.

hausa: Duk inda akwai mutumin Yahuda da ya rage, sai mutanen da suke zama kusa da shi, su taimake shi da azurfa, da zinariya, da kaya, da kuma dabbobi, tare da kyautai na yardar rai saboda Gidan Allah wanda yake a Urushalima.’ ”
english: Whoever is left, in any place where he lives, let the men of his place help him with silver, with gold, with goods, and with animals, in addition to the free will offering for God’s house which is in Jerusalem.’”

hausa: Ubangiji mai rai ne! Yabo ya tabbata ga Dutsena! Girma ya tabbata ga Allah Mai cetona!
english: Yahweh lives! Blessed be my rock. Exalted be the God of my salvation,

hausa: Tare da bijiman, ragunan da kuma ’yan raguna, a miƙa hadayunsu ta gari da hadayu na sha bisa adadin da a ƙayyade.
english: and their meal offering and their drink offerings for the bulls, for the rams, and for the lambs, according to their number, after the ordinance,

hausa: Wadata da arziki suna a cikin gidansa, adalcinsa zai dawwama har abada.
english: Wealth and riches are in his house. His righteousness endures forever.

hausa: kuma gidan marubuta waɗanda suke zama a Yabez su ne, Tiratiyawa, Shimeyatiyawa da Sukatiyawa. Waɗannan su ne Keniyawa waɗanda suka zo daga Hammat, mahaifin gidan Rekab.
english: The families of scribes who lived at Jabez: the Tirathites, the Shimeathites, and the Sucathites. These are the Kenites who came from Hammath, the father of the house of Rechab.

hausa: Amma in mutumin da aka yi wa laifin ba shi da ɗan’uwa na kusa da za a biya diyya saboda laifin, sai diyyar tă zama ta Ubangiji, dole kuma a ba wa firist, haɗe da ragon da za a yi kafara da shi.
english: But if the man has no kinsman to whom restitution may be made for the guilt, the restitution for guilt which is made to Yahweh shall be the priest’s, in addition to the ram of the atonement, by which atonement shall be made for him.

hausa: Duk mai ƙaunar hikima kan kawo wa mahaifinsa farin ciki, amma wanda yake ma’amala da karuwai kan lalatar da dukiyarsa.
english: Whoever loves wisdom brings joy to his father; but a companion of prostitutes squanders his wealth.

hausa: “Sa’ad da namiji ko ta mace tana da farare wurare a fatar jiki,
english: “When a man or a woman has bright spots in the skin of the body, even white bright spots,

hausa: Ubangiji kuwa ya furta a wannan rana cewa ku mutanensa ne, mallakarsa kamar yadda ya yi alkawari, da kuma cewa za ku kiyaye dukan umarnansa.
english: Yahweh has declared today that you are a people for his own possession, as he has promised you, and that you should keep all his commandments.

hausa: “Masar kyakkyawar karsana ce, amma bobuwa tana zuwa a kanta daga arewa.
english: “Egypt is a very beautiful heifer; but destruction out of the north has come. It has come.

hausa: Duk wanda ya yi wa maƙwabcinsa rauni, sai a yi masa abin da ya yi;
english: If anyone injures his neighbor, it shall be done to him as he has done:

hausa: Ƙa’idodinka su ne kan waƙata a duk inda na sauka.
english: Your statutes have been my songs in the house where I live.

hausa: Gama yana tsaya a hannun damar mai bukata, don yă cece ransa daga waɗanda suke hukunta shi.
english: For he will stand at the right hand of the needy, to save him from those who judge his soul.

hausa: Duk wanda ya ɓoye ƙiyayyarsa yana da ƙarya a leɓunansa, duk kuma wanda yake baza ƙarairayi wawa ne.
english: He who hides hatred has lying lips. He who utters a slander is a fool.

hausa: Sa’an nan ya tambaye ta ya ce, “Ke ’yar wace ce? Ina roƙonki ki faɗa mini, akwai wuri a gidan mahaifinki da za mu kwana?”
english: and said, “Whose daughter are you? Please tell me. Is there room in your father’s house for us to stay?”

hausa: Sarki ya ce, “Wa yake a haraba?” Daidai lokacin kuwa Haman ya shigo harabar waje na fada don yă yi magana da sarki a kan a rataye Mordekai a wurin rataye mai laifin da ya shirya.
english: The king said, “Who is in the court?” Now Haman had come into the outer court of the king’s house, to speak to the king about hanging Mordecai on the gallows that he had prepared for him.

hausa: Daga baya Dawuda ya fita daga kogon sai ya kira Shawulu ya ce, “Ranka yă daɗe, sarki!” Da Shawulu ya waiwaya, sai Dawuda ya rusuna da fuskarsa har ƙasa.
english: David also arose afterward, and went out of the cave and cried after Saul, saying, “My lord the king!” When Saul looked behind him, David bowed with his face to the earth, and showed respect.

hausa: Yanzu ina da roƙo guda da zan yi gare ki. Kada ki hana mini.” Ta ce, “Sai ka faɗa.”
english: Now I ask one petition of you. Don’t deny me.” She said to him, “Say on.”

hausa: Takan zaɓi ulu da lilin ta yi ta saƙa da hannuwanta da farin ciki.
english: She seeks wool and flax, and works eagerly with her hands.

hausa: Sukan samu cin nasara na ɗan lokaci, amma kuma za su ɓace; za su fāɗi a tattara su kamar sauran; za a datse su kamar kan hatsi.
english: They are exalted; yet a little while, and they are gone. Yes, they are brought low, they are taken out of the way as all others, and are cut off as the tops of the ears of grain.

hausa: Ubangiji ya ce, “Me ke nan ka yi? Saurara! Ga jinin ɗan’uwanka yana mini kuka daga ƙasa.
english: Yahweh said, “What have you done? The voice of your brother’s blood cries to me from the ground.

hausa: In kuma suka koyi al’amuran mutanena sosai suka kuma yi rantsuwa da sunana, suna cewa, ‘Muddin Ubangiji yana raye’ kamar yadda sun taɓa koya wa jama’ata yin rantsuwa da Ba’al, sa’an nan za su kahu a cikin jama’ata.
english: It will happen, if they will diligently learn the ways of my people, to swear by my name, ‘As Yahweh lives;’ even as they taught my people to swear by Baal, then they will be built up in the middle of my people.

hausa: daga kiwon tumaki ya kawo shi don yă kuma zama makiyayin mutanensa Yaƙub, na Isra’ila gādonsa.
