english: from following the ewes that have their young, he brought him to be the shepherd of Jacob, his people, and Israel, his inheritance.

hausa: Da a ce mun manta da sunan Allahnmu ko mun miƙa hannuwanmu ga baƙin alloli,
english: If we have forgotten the name of our God, or spread out our hands to a strange god,

hausa: a gangara da ita kwarin da ba a taɓa nome, ko shuki a ciki ba, inda kuma akwai rafi mai gudu, a can cikin kwarin za su karye wuyanta.
english: The elders of that city shall bring the heifer down to a valley with running water, which is neither plowed nor sown, and shall break the heifer’s neck there in the valley.

hausa: Saboda haka sa’ad da mutanen suka tashi don su ƙetare Urdun, firistocin da suke ɗauke da akwatin alkawarin suka sha gaba.
english: When the people moved from their tents to pass over the Jordan, the priests who bore the ark of the covenant being before the people,

hausa: Ka sa firistoci guda bakwai su riƙe ƙahoni raguna su kasance a gaban akwatin alkawari. A rana ta bakwai sai ku zaga birnin sau bakwai, firistocin suna busa ƙahoni.
english: Seven priests shall bear seven trumpets of rams’ horns before the ark. On the seventh day, you shall march around the city seven times, and the priests shall blow the trumpets.

hausa: Kamar rafi mai laka ko rijiyar da ta gurɓace haka yake da mai adalci wanda ya miƙa wuya ga mugaye.
english: Like a muddied spring and a polluted well, so is a righteous man who gives way before the wicked.

hausa: Kamar yadda mutumin turɓaya yake, haka ma waɗanda suke na turɓaya. Kuma kamar yadda mutumin sama yake, haka ma waɗanda suke na sama.
english: As is the one made of dust, such are those who are also made of dust; and as is the heavenly, such are they also that are heavenly.

hausa: Game da sauran ayyukan mulkin Amon, da abubuwan da ya aikata, duk a rubuce suke a cikin littafin tarihin sarakunan Yahuda.
english: Now the rest of the acts of Amon which he did, aren’t they written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Judah?

hausa: Ko kuma bari su zo wurina don mafaka; bari su yi sulhu da ni, I, bari su yi sulhu da ni.”
english: Or else let him take hold of my strength, that he may make peace with me. Let him make peace with me.”

hausa: Sai ya amsa wa sarki cewa, “Saboda mutumin da sarki yake jin daɗi yă girmama,
english: Haman said to the king, “For the man whom the king delights to honor,

hausa: Ku yi nesa da ayyukan duhun da mutane suke yi, a maimakon haka, ku tona su.
english: Have no fellowship with the unfruitful deeds of darkness, but rather even reprove them.

hausa: Sa’an nan wata murya ta ce masa, “Bitrus, ka tashi. Ka yanka ka ci.”
english: A voice came to him, “Rise, Peter, kill and eat!”

hausa: “Ku mutane masu taurinkai, da zukata da kuma kunnuwa marasa kaciya! Kuna kama da kakanninku. Kullum kuna tsayayya da Ruhu Mai Tsarki!
english: “You stiff-necked and uncircumcised in heart and ears, you always resist the Holy Spirit! As your fathers did, so you do.

hausa: Gad zai sami rabo; zai yi iyaka da yankin Zebulun daga gabas zuwa yamma.
english: “By the border of Zebulun, from the east side to the west side, Gad, one portion.

hausa: Har yanzu yaƙi ya sāke ɓarke tsakanin Filistiyawa da Isra’ila. Sai Dawuda ya gangara tare da mutanensa don su yaƙi Filistiyawa, gajiya ta kama shi.
english: The Philistines had war again with Israel; and David went down, and his servants with him, and fought against the Philistines. David grew faint;

hausa: Da yake babban firist ɗin mai kāsawa ne, yana iya bin da jahilai da kuma waɗanda suka kauce hanya, a hankali.
english: The high priest can deal gently with those who are ignorant and going astray, because he himself is also surrounded with weakness.

hausa: Ɗalibi bai fi malaminsa ba, sai dai kowane ɗalibi wanda ya sami cikakkiyar koyarwa, zai zama kamar malaminsa.
english: A disciple is not above his teacher, but everyone when he is fully trained will be like his teacher.

hausa: Hanyar rai na yin jagora ya haura wa masu hikima don ta kiyaye shi daga gangarawa zuwa kabari.
english: The path of life leads upward for the wise, to keep him from going downward to Sheol.

hausa: Saboda haka, duk abin da kuke yi, ko ci ko sha, ku yi shi duka saboda ɗaukakar Allah.
english: Whether therefore you eat or drink, or whatever you do, do all to the glory of God.

hausa: Ina aike shi yă koma gare ka, shi da yake zuciyata.
english: I am sending him back. Therefore receive him, that is, my own heart,

hausa: Amma Isuwa ya ruga a guje ya sadu da Yaƙub ya rungume shi; ya faɗa a wuyansa ya sumbace shi. Suka kuma yi kuka.
english: Esau ran to meet him, embraced him, fell on his neck, kissed him, and they wept.

hausa: Sai ya bar su, ya fita daga birnin ya tafi Betani, inda ya kwana.
english: He left them and went out of the city to Bethany, and camped there.

hausa: Akwai la’ana ce kawai, yin ƙarya da kisa, yin sata da zina; sun wuce gona da iri, kisankai a kan kisankai.
english: There is cursing, lying, murder, stealing, and committing adultery; they break boundaries, and bloodshed causes bloodshed.

hausa: Ku gai da dukan tsarkaka cikin Kiristi Yesu. ’Yan’uwan da suke tare da ni suna gaishe ku.
english: Greet every saint in Christ Jesus. The brothers who are with me greet you.

hausa: Hushai ya ce wa Zadok da Abiyatar, firistoci, “Ahitofel ya ba wa Absalom da dattawan Isra’ila shawara su yi kaza da kaza, amma na ba su shawara su yi haka, su yi haka.
english: Then Hushai said to Zadok and to Abiathar the priests, “Ahithophel counseled Absalom and the elders of Israel that way; and I have counseled this way.

hausa: Ko da yake bai cire masujadai da suke kan tuddai ba, zuciyar Asa ta kasance da aminci ɗungum ga Ubangiji dukan kwanakinsa.
english: But the high places were not taken away. Nevertheless the heart of Asa was perfect with Yahweh all his days.

hausa: “Ki dai ci gaba, da sihirinki da kuma makarunki masu yawa, waɗanda kika yi ta wahala tun kina jaririya. Mai yiwuwa ki yi nasara, mai yiwuwa ki jawo fargaba.
english: “Stand now with your enchantments and with the multitude of your sorceries, in which you have labored from your youth, as if you might profit, as if you might prevail.

hausa: Waɗannan masu gāba da Kiristi suna cikinmu a dā, amma sun bar mu, don tun dā ma su ba namu ba ne. Ai, da su namu ne, da har yanzu suna tare da mu. Amma sun bar mu, wannan ya nuna a fili cewa su ba namu ba ne.
english: They went out from us, but they didn’t belong to us; for if they had belonged to us, they would have continued with us. But they left, that they might be revealed that none of them belong to us.

hausa: Ka amsa mini da sauri, ya Ubangiji; ƙarfina ya ƙare. Kada ka ɓoye fuskarka daga gare ni in ba haka ba zan zama kamar waɗanda suka gangara zuwa rami.
english: Hurry to answer me, Yahweh. My spirit fails. Don’t hide your face from me, so that I don’t become like those who go down into the pit.

hausa: Zan nuna fushin kishina a kanki, za su kuwa wulaƙanta ki da fushi. Za su yanke hancinki da kunnuwanki, waɗanda suka rage miki kuma za a kashe su da takobi. Za su kama ’ya’yanki maza da mata, waɗanda suka rage miki kuwa za a ƙone su da wuta.
english: I will set my jealousy against you, and they will deal with you in fury. They will take away your nose and your ears. Your remnant will fall by the sword. They will take your sons and your daughters; and the rest of you will be devoured by the fire.

hausa: Na zaɓi mahaifinka daga cikin dukan kabilar Isra’ila yă zama firist nawa don yă yi hidima a bagade, don yă ƙona turare mai ƙanshi, don kuma yă sanya doguwar riga a gabana. Na kuma ba wa iyalin mahaifinka dukan hadaya ta ƙonawa da Isra’ila suka miƙa.
english: Didn’t I choose him out of all the tribes of Israel to be my priest, to go up to my altar, to burn incense, to wear an ephod before me? Didn’t I give to the house of your father all the offerings of the children of Israel made by fire?

hausa: Dukan kwaf na Sarki Solomon zinariya ne, kuma dukan kayayyakin gida a Fadan da ake kira Kurmin Lebanon zinariya ne zalla. Ba a yi wani abu da azurfa ba, domin ba a ɗauki azurfa a zamanin Solomon a bakin kome ba.
english: All King Solomon’s drinking vessels were of gold, and all the vessels of the House of the Forest of Lebanon were of pure gold. Silver was not considered valuable in the days of Solomon.

hausa: An rurrushe kāriyar Yahuda, a ranan nan kuwa kun yi la’akari da makamai a cikin Fadan Kurmi;
english: He took away the covering of Judah; and you looked in that day to the armor in the house of the forest.

hausa: Masussukanku za su ci gaba har lokacin girbin inabi, girbin inabi kuma zai ci gaba har lokacin shuki, za ku kuma ci duk abincin da kuke so cikin salama a ƙasarku.
english: Your threshing shall continue until the vintage, and the vintage shall continue until the sowing time. You shall eat your bread to the full, and dwell in your land safely.

hausa: Yahudawa suka tura Alekzanda gaba, sai waɗansu a taron suka riƙa yin masa ihu. Sai ya ɗaga hannu don a yi shiru don yă kāre kansa a gaban mutane.
english: They brought Alexander out of the multitude, the Jews putting him forward. Alexander beckoned with his hand, and would have made a defense to the people.

hausa: Ina niyya in gina haikali domin Sunan Ubangiji Allahna, yadda Ubangiji ya faɗa wa mahaifina Dawuda, sa’ad da ya ce, ‘Ɗanka wanda zai gāje ka, shi zai gina haikali domin Sunana.’
english: Behold, I intend to build a house for the name of Yahweh my God, as Yahweh spoke to David my father, saying, ‘Your son, whom I will set on your throne in your place shall build the house for my name.’

hausa: Yowel shi ne babba, sai Shafan na biyu, sa’an nan Yanai da Shafat, su ne tushen Bashan.
english: Joel the chief, Shapham the second, Janai, and Shaphat in Bashan.

hausa: Dukan mutane suka ce wa Sama’ila, “Ka yi addu’a ga Ubangiji Allahnka saboda bayinka, domin kada mu mutu, gama mun ƙara wa kanmu zunubi da muka roƙa a yi mana sarki.”
english: All the people said to Samuel, “Pray for your servants to Yahweh your God, that we not die; for we have added to all our sins this evil, to ask for a king.”

hausa: Sai kuma na ba wa rabin kabilar Manasse sauran rabin ƙasar tudu ta Gileyad da kuma dukan Bashan, masarautar Og (Wato, dukan yankin ƙasan nan na Argob a Bashan da dā ake kira ƙasar Refahiyawa.
english: and the rest of Gilead, and all Bashan, the kingdom of Og, I gave to the half-tribe of Manasseh—all the region of Argob, even all Bashan. (The same is called the land of Rephaim.

hausa: Wannan duk ya faru ne a Betani a ƙetaren Urdun, inda Yohanna yake yin baftisma.
english: These things were done in Bethany beyond the Jordan, where John was baptizing.

hausa: “Yanzu ina zuwa wurinka, sai dai na faɗi waɗannan abubuwa ne tun ina a duniya domin farin ciki yă zama cikakke a cikinsu.
english: But now I come to you, and I say these things in the world, that they may have my joy made full in themselves.

hausa: Yonatan kuwa ya sa Dawuda ya sāke tabbatar masa rantsuwansa game da abokantakarsa da shi, gama yana ƙaunar Dawuda kamar ransa.
english: Jonathan caused David to swear again, for the love that he had for him; for he loved him as he loved his own soul.

hausa: Sa’an nan a busa ƙaho a ko’ina, a rana ta goma ga wata na bakwai; a Ranar Kafara, a busa ƙaho a dukan ƙasarku.
english: Then you shall sound the loud trumpet on the tenth day of the seventh month. On the Day of Atonement you shall sound the trumpet throughout all your land.

hausa: “Sa’ad da wani yana da ƙuna a fatar jikinsa, wurin kuwa ya yi ja-ja, ko fari-fari, ko kuwa farin tabo ya bayyana a sabon miki na ƙunan,
english: “Or when the body has a burn from fire on its skin, and the raw flesh of the burn becomes a bright spot, reddish-white, or white,

hausa: domin diyarsa ɗaya tak, wadda ta kai shekara goma sha biyu, tana bakin mutuwa. Da Yesu yake kan hanyarsa, taron mutane masu yawa suka yi ta matsa shi a kowane gefe.
english: for he had an only born daughter, about twelve years of age, and she was dying. But as he went, the multitudes pressed against him.

hausa: Bayan Tera ya yi shekaru 70, sai ya haifi Abram, Nahor da Haran.
english: Terah lived seventy years, and became the father of Abram, Nahor, and Haran.

hausa: Da kawai za ka kashe mugaye, ya Allah! Ku rabu da ni, ku masu kisankai!
english: If only you, God, would kill the wicked. Get away from me, you bloodthirsty men!

hausa: Bulus ya shiga majami’a ya yi magana gabagadi a can na watanni uku, yana muhawwara yana kuma rinjayarsu game da mulkin Allah.
english: He entered into the synagogue and spoke boldly for a period of three months, reasoning and persuading about the things concerning God’s Kingdom.

hausa: Da umarnin Ubangiji sukan kafa sansani, da umarninsa kuma sukan tashi. Sukan bi umarnin Ubangiji, bisa ga umarninsa ta wurin Musa.
english: At the commandment of Yahweh they encamped, and at the commandment of Yahweh they traveled. They kept Yahweh’s command, at the commandment of Yahweh by Moses.

hausa: Kiristi shi ne surar da ake gani na Allah wanda ba a iya gani, ɗan fari a kan dukan halitta.
english: He is the image of the invisible God, the firstborn of all creation.

hausa: A haɗa da bunsuru guda don yin muku kafara.
english: and one male goat, to make atonement for you.

hausa: Sa’an nan sarki ya aika aka kawo Shimeyi, ya kuma ce masa, “Ka gina wa kanka gida a nan a Urushalima, ka zauna a ciki, kada ka kuskura ka tafi wani wuri.
english: The king sent and called for Shimei, and said to him, “Build yourself a house in Jerusalem, and live there, and don’t go anywhere else.

hausa: ’Ya’yan Merari maza su ne, Mali da Mushi. ’Ya’yan Mali maza su ne, Eleyazar da Kish.
english: The sons of Merari: Mahli and Mushi. The sons of Mahli: Eleazar and Kish.

hausa: Ya yi abin da yake mugu a gaban Ubangiji kamar yadda mahaifinsa Manasse ya yi. Amon ya bauta ya kuma miƙa hadayu ga dukan gumakan da Manasse ya yi.
english: He did that which was evil in Yahweh’s sight, as did Manasseh his father; and Amon sacrificed to all the engraved images which Manasseh his father had made, and served them.

hausa: Ya kawo Isra’ila ta tsakiyarsa, Ƙaunarsa madawwamiya ce.
english: and made Israel to pass through the middle of it, for his loving kindness endures forever;

hausa: Lokacin da za a tashi daga sansani, Haruna da ’ya’yansa za su shiga ciki su kunce labulen kāriya, su rufe Akwatin Alkawari da shi.
english: When the camp moves forward, Aaron shall go in with his sons; and they shall take down the veil of the screen, cover the ark of the Testimony with it,

hausa: Bayan wannan sai na duba, a can kuma a gabana ga ƙofa a buɗe a sama. Sai muryar da na ji da fari da take magana da ni mai kama da busar ƙaho ta ce, “Hauro nan, zan kuma nuna maka abin da lalle zai faru bayan wannan.”
english: After these things I looked and saw a door opened in heaven; and the first voice that I heard, like a trumpet speaking with me, was one saying, “Come up here, and I will show you the things which must happen after this.”

hausa: Gwamma riƙaƙƙen wawa da mutum mai ganin kansa mai hikima ne.
english: Do you see a man wise in his own eyes? There is more hope for a fool than for him.

hausa: Da ya ambaci akwatin alkawarin Allah, sai Eli ya fāɗi da baya daga kujeransa kusa da ƙofa, wuyarsa ta karye, ya kuma mutu domin ya tsufa ƙwarai. Ya yi shugabancin Isra’ila shekaru arba’in.
english: When he made mention of God’s ark, Eli fell from off his seat backward by the side of the gate; and his neck broke, and he died, for he was an old man and heavy. He had judged Israel forty years.

hausa: “La’ananne ne mutumin da ya yi jima’i da dabba.” Sai dukan mutane su ce, “Amin!”
english: ‘Cursed is he who lies with any kind of animal.’ All the people shall say, ‘Amen.’

hausa: “Amma in na je gabas, ba ya wurin; in na je yamma, ba zan same shi ba.
english: “If I go east, he is not there. If I go west, I can’t find him.

hausa: “Ina gāba da ke,” in ji Ubangiji Maɗaukaki. “Zan kware fatarinki a idonki. Zan nuna wa al’ummai tsiraicinki, masarautai kuma kunyarki.
english: “Behold, I am against you,” says Yahweh of Armies, “and I will lift your skirts over your face. I will show the nations your nakedness, and the kingdoms your shame.

hausa: in mutanen gidana ba su taɓa cewa, ‘Wane ne bai ƙoshi da naman Ayuba ba?’
english: if the men of my tent have not said, ‘Who can find one who has not been filled with his meat?’

hausa: Ina allolin Hamat da na Arfad? Ina allolin Sefarfayim? Sun fanshi Samariya daga hannuna?
english: Where are the gods of Hamath and Arpad? Where are the gods of Sepharvaim? Have they delivered Samaria from my hand?

hausa: Sa’an nan aka jefar da mutuwa da kuma Hades cikin tafkin wuta. Tafkin wutar nan kuwa shi ne mutuwa ta biyu.
english: Death and Hades were thrown into the lake of fire. This is the second death, the lake of fire.

hausa: Tabbatacce, Allah ya shirya gaɓoɓin jiki, kowannensu, kamar yadda yake so su zama.
english: But now God has set the members, each one of them, in the body, just as he desired.

hausa: ga masu tsarki, kakan nuna musu tsarki. Amma ga masu karkataccen hali, kakan nuna kanka mai wayo.
english: With the pure you will show yourself pure. With the crooked you will show yourself shrewd.

hausa: Ubangiji zai watsar da ku a cikin mutane, ɗan kaɗan ne kaɗai za su ragu a cikin al’umman da Ubangiji zai kai ku.
english: Yahweh will scatter you among the peoples, and you will be left few in number among the nations where Yahweh will lead you away.

hausa: Ka faɗa wa dukan gwanayen da na ba su hikima a irin abubuwan nan, cewa su yi tufafi saboda Haruna, don a tsarkakewarsa, domin yă yi mini hidima a matsayin firist.
english: You shall speak to all who are wise-hearted, whom I have filled with the spirit of wisdom, that they make Aaron’s garments to sanctify him, that he may minister to me in the priest’s office.

hausa: duk kuwa waɗanda suka ji wannan, suka yi mamaki a kan abin da makiyayan suka faɗa.
english: All who heard it wondered at the things which were spoken to them by the shepherds.

hausa: Sa’ad da mutumin Allah ya gama ci da sha, sai annabin da ya dawo da shi ya yi wa jakin mutumin Allah shimfiɗa.
english: After he had eaten bread and after he drank, he saddled the donkey for the prophet whom he had brought back.

hausa: “Ga abin da Ubangiji, Allah na Isra’ila, yana cewa, ‘Ka rubuta a cikin littafi dukan maganganun da na yi maka.
english: “Yahweh, the God of Israel, says, ‘Write all the words that I have spoken to you in a book.

hausa: Sa’an nan Allah ya tashi sama daga gare shi a wurin da ya yi magana da shi.
english: God went up from him in the place where he spoke with him.

hausa: Za a ragargaza bagadanku a kuma farfasa bagadanku na ƙone turare; zan kuma kashe mutanenku a gaban gumakanku.
english: Your altars will become desolate, and your incense altars will be broken. I will cast down your slain men before your idols.

hausa: Idan aka kama wani yana satar ɗan’uwansa mutumin Isra’ila domin yă sa ya zama bawansa, ko yă sayar da shi, sai a kashe ɓarawon nan. Haka za ku kawar da mugunta daga cikinku.
english: If a man is found stealing any of his brothers of the children of Israel, and he deals with him as a slave, or sells him, then that thief shall die. So you shall remove the evil from among you.

hausa: Duk wanda ya ƙi marabtarku ko ya ƙi sauraron kalmominku, sai ku karkaɗe ƙurar ƙafafunku sa’ad da kuka fita gidan ko garin.
english: Whoever doesn’t receive you or hear your words, as you go out of that house or that city, shake the dust off your feet.

hausa: Akwai hanyar da ta yi kamar daidai ga mutum, amma a ƙarshe takan kai ga mutuwa.
english: There is a way which seems right to a man, but in the end it leads to death.

hausa: Matalauta za su gani su kuma yi murna, ku da kuke neman Allah, bari zukatanku su rayu!
english: The humble have seen it, and are glad. You who seek after God, let your heart live.

hausa: Na kuma ɗaga hannu na rantse musu a hamada cewa ba zan kawo su ƙasar da na ba su ba, ƙasa mai zub da madara da zuma, ƙasa mafi kyau cikin dukan ƙasashe,
english: Moreover also I swore to them in the wilderness that I would not bring them into the land which I had given them, flowing with milk and honey, which is the glory of all lands,

hausa: Uba ga marayu, mai kāre gwauraye, shi ne Allah a mazauninsa mai tsarki.
english: A father of the fatherless, and a defender of the widows, is God in his holy habitation.

hausa: Ya kamata miji yă cika hakkinsa na aure ga matarsa. Haka kuma matar ta yi ga mijinta.
english: Let the husband give his wife the affection owed her, and likewise also the wife her husband.

hausa: A lokacin nan Yoshuwa ya koma da baya ya ci Hazor da yaƙi, ya kuma kashe sarkinta da takobi. (Hazor ce babbar masarautan ƙasashen nan.)
english: Joshua turned back at that time, and took Hazor, and struck its king with the sword; for Hazor used to be the head of all those kingdoms.

hausa: Sai kowa ya yashe shi ya gudu.
english: They all left him, and fled.

hausa: Sai ɗaya a cikin masu mulkin majami’a, wanda ake kira Yayirus ya zo wurin. Da ganin Yesu, sai ya durƙusa a gabansa,
english: Behold, one of the rulers of the synagogue, Jairus by name, came; and seeing him, he fell at his feet

hausa: Ubangiji kuwa ya bugi mutanen da annoba, saboda abin da suka yi da ɗan maraƙin da Haruna ya yi.
english: Yahweh struck the people, because of what they did with the calf, which Aaron made.

hausa: Mutanen kuma suka fito don su ga abin da ya faru. Da suka iso wurin Yesu, sai suka tarar da mutumin da aljanun suka fita daga cikinsa, yana zaune kusa da Yesu sanye da tufafi, kuma cikin hankalinsa, sai tsoro ya kama su.
english: People went out to see what had happened. They came to Jesus and found the man from whom the demons had gone out, sitting at Jesus’ feet, clothed and in his right mind; and they were afraid.

hausa: Sai ya zuba wa Hazayel ido har sai da Hazayel ya ji kunya. Sa’an nan mutumin Allah ya fara kuka.
english: He settled his gaze steadfastly on him, until he was ashamed. Then the man of God wept.

hausa: Ya ce, “Yaya kamanninsa yake?” Ta ce, “Wani tsoho sanye da taguwa ne yake haurawa.” Shawulu ya gane cewa Sama’ila ne, sai ya rusuna da fuskarsa har ƙasa.
english: He said to her, “What does he look like?” She said, “An old man comes up. He is covered with a robe.” Saul perceived that it was Samuel, and he bowed with his face to the ground, and showed respect.

hausa: Sun fara yin haka a wata na uku, suka kuma gama a wata na bakwai.
english: In the third month, they began to lay the foundation of the heaps, and finished them in the seventh month.

hausa: Ba domin adalci ko mutuncinku ba ne ya sa za ku mallaki ƙasarsu; sai dai saboda muguntar al’umman nan ne ya sa Ubangiji Allahnku yana korinsu a gabanku don yă cika abin da ya rantse wa kakanninku, wato, Ibrahim, Ishaku da Yaƙub.
english: Not for your righteousness or for the uprightness of your heart do you go in to possess their land; but for the wickedness of these nations Yahweh your God does drive them out from before you, and that he may establish the word which Yahweh swore to your fathers, to Abraham, to Isaac, and to Jacob.

hausa: “Ku kasa kunne gare ni, ku da kuna neman adalci kuke kuma neman Ubangiji. Dubi dutse daga inda aka yanke ku da kuma mahaƙar duwatsu inda aka fafe ku;
english: “Listen to me, you who follow after righteousness, you who seek Yahweh. Look to the rock you were cut from, and to the quarry you were dug from.

hausa: Sai Musa ya ba da umarni, suka aika ko’ina a cikin sansani cewa, “Kada namiji ko ta mace yă sāke kawo kyauta don wuri mai tsarki.” Ta haka mutane suka daina kawowa.
english: Moses gave a commandment, and they caused it to be proclaimed throughout the camp, saying, “Let neither man nor woman make anything else for the offering for the sanctuary.” So the people were restrained from bringing.

hausa: Yadda muka ji, haka muka gani a cikin birnin Ubangiji Maɗaukaki, a cikin birnin Allahnmu. Allah ya sa ta zauna lafiya har abada. Sela
english: As we have heard, so we have seen, in the city of Yahweh of Armies, in the city of our God. God will establish it forever. Selah.

hausa: Mutanen tsibirin kuwa suka nuna mana babban alheri. Suka hura wuta suka marabce mu duka saboda ana ruwan sama da kuma sanyi.
english: The natives showed us uncommon kindness; for they kindled a fire and received us all, because of the present rain and because of the cold.

hausa: Sa’an nan a ƙone dukan karsanar, haɗe da fatarta, naman, jinin da kayan cikin, yayinda Eleyazar yake kallo.
english: One shall burn the heifer in his sight; her skin, and her meat, and her blood, with her dung, shall he burn.

hausa: Yanzu bari mu yi alkawari da Allahnmu, mu kori matan da yaransu bisa ga abin da ranka yă daɗe da sauran shugabannin da kuke girmama umarnin Allah kuka shawarce mu, bari mu yi haka bisa ga doka.
english: Now therefore let’s make a covenant with our God to put away all the wives and those who are born of them, according to the counsel of my lord and of those who tremble at the commandment of our God. Let it be done according to the law.

hausa: Kada ku fita zuwa gonaki ko ku yi tafiya a hanyoyi, gama abokin gāba yana da takobi, kuma akwai razana ko’ina.
english: Don’t go out into the field or walk by the way; for the sword of the enemy and terror are on every side.

hausa: Amma da masu mulkin Babilon suka aika da jakadu su tambaye shi game alamar da ta faru a ƙasar, Allah ya rabu da shi don yă gwada shi don yă kuma san kome da yake cikin zuciyarsa.
english: However, concerning the ambassadors of the princes of Babylon, who sent to him to inquire of the wonder that was done in the land, God left him to test him, that he might know all that was in his heart.

hausa: Sa’an nan mai hidimar ya fara bincike, farawa daga babba, ya ƙare a ƙaramin. Aka kuwa sami kwaf ɗin a buhun Benyamin.
english: He searched, beginning with the oldest, and ending at the youngest. The cup was found in Benjamin’s sack.

hausa: Musa da Haruna suka tattara dukan dattawan Isra’ilawa,
english: Moses and Aaron went and gathered together all the elders of the children of Israel.

hausa: waɗannan ne zan kai tsattsarkan dutsena in sa su yi farin ciki a gidana na addu’a. Hadayunsu na ƙonawa da sadakokinsu za su zama abin karɓa a bagadena; gama za a ce da gidana gidan addu’a domin dukan al’ummai.”
english: I will bring these to my holy mountain, and make them joyful in my house of prayer. Their burnt offerings and their sacrifices will be accepted on my altar; for my house will be called a house of prayer for all peoples.”

hausa: Gara a zauna a kusurwar rufin ɗaki da a zauna a gida ɗaya da mace mai fitina.
english: It is better to dwell in the corner of the housetop than to share a house with a contentious woman.

hausa: Absalom ya umarci mutanensa ya ce, “Ku saurara! Sa’ad da Amnon ya bugu sosai da giya na kuma ce muku, ‘Ku bugi Amnon,’ sai ku kashe shi. Kada ku ji tsoro. Ashe, ba ni ne na ba ku wannan umarni ba? Ku yi ƙarfin hali, ku kuma yi jaruntaka.”
english: Absalom commanded his servants, saying, “Mark now, when Amnon’s heart is merry with wine; and when I tell you, ‘Strike Amnon,’ then kill him. Don’t be afraid. Haven’t I commanded you? Be courageous, and be valiant!”

hausa: Gama Rehobowam ya ƙasƙantar da kansa, fushin Ubangiji ya bar shi, ba a kuwa hallaka shi ƙaƙaf ba. Tabbatacce an yi ’yan abubuwa masu kyau a Yahuda.
english: When he humbled himself, Yahweh’s wrath turned from him, so as not to destroy him altogether. Moreover, there were good things found in Judah.

hausa: Sai Elisha ya ce, “Ka sauka lafiya.” Bayan Na’aman ya yi ɗan nisa,
english: He said to him, “Go in peace.” So he departed from him a little way.

hausa: Sarki ya ce masa, “Sau nawa zan sa ka rantse don ka faɗa gaskiya a cikin sunan Ubangiji?”
english: The king said to him, “How many times shall I adjure you that you speak to me nothing but the truth in Yahweh’s name?”

hausa: Sai suka ce wa juna, “Kada mu yage ta, sai dai mu jefa ƙuri’a a kanta mu ga wanda zai ci.” Wannan ya faru ne don a cika nassin da ya ce, “Suka rarraba tufafina a junansu, suka kuma jefa ƙuri’a a kan rigata.” Abin da sojojin suka yi ke nan.
english: Then they said to one another, “Let’s not tear it, but cast lots for it to decide whose it will be,” that the Scripture might be fulfilled, which says, “They parted my garments among them. They cast lots for my clothing.” Therefore the soldiers did these things.

hausa: “Wannan ita ce ƙa’ida wadda Ubangiji ya umarta. Faɗa wa Isra’ilawa su kawo maka jan karsana marar lahani, ko marar aibi wadda ba a taɓa sa ta tă yi noma ba.
english: “This is the statute of the law which Yahweh has commanded. Tell the children of Israel to bring you a red heifer without spot, in which is no defect, and which was never yoked.

hausa: Ka danƙa masa ikonka don dukan jama’a Isra’ilawa su yi masa biyayya.
english: You shall give authority to him, that all the congregation of the children of Israel may obey.

hausa: Da hannunta take riƙe abin kaɗi ta kuma kama abin saƙa da yatsotsinta.
english: She lays her hands to the distaff, and her hands hold the spindle.

hausa: Sai shugaban ƙungiyar sojan ya sallami saurayin ya kwaɓe shi ya ce, “Kada ka gaya wa kowa cewa ka faɗa mini wannan.”
english: So the commanding officer let the young man go, charging him, “Tell no one that you have revealed these things to me.”

hausa: Sama’ila ya ce wa Isra’ilawa duka, “Na saurari abubuwan da kuka faɗa mini, na kuma naɗa muku sarki.
english: Samuel said to all Israel, “Behold, I have listened to your voice in all that you said to me, and have made a king over you.

hausa: Sai na matsa kusa da ɗaya daga cikin waɗanda suke tsaye a can, na tambaye shi gaskiya ma’anar waɗannan al’amura. “Don haka sai ya faɗa mini, ya kuma ba ni fassarar waɗannan al’amura.
english: I came near to one of those who stood by, and asked him the truth concerning all this. “So he told me, and made me know the interpretation of the things.

hausa: Nufinsa ke nan, idan lokaci ya cika, yă harhaɗa dukan abubuwa a ƙarƙashin ikon Kiristi, wato, dukan abubuwan da suke sama da abubuwan da suke ƙasa.
english: to an administration of the fullness of the times, to sum up all things in Christ, the things in the heavens and the things on the earth, in him.

hausa: Sai Hezekiya ya yi addu’a ga Ubangiji ya ce,
english: Hezekiah prayed to Yahweh, saying,

hausa: Waɗansu daga cikin dattawan Fir’auna suka cika da tsoro saboda abin da Ubangiji ya faɗa, nan da nan suka shigo da dabbobinsu da bayinsu da sauri daga gona zuwa cikin gida.
english: Those who feared Yahweh’s word among the servants of Pharaoh made their servants and their livestock flee into the houses.

hausa: Ba ya cin zalin wani, amma yakan mayar wa wanda ya ba shi jingina abin da ya jinginar masa. Ba ya yi fashi amma yakan ba wa mayunwata abinci ya kuma tanada wa marasa tufafi riga.
english: and has not wronged any, but has restored to the debtor his pledge, has taken nothing by robbery, has given his bread to the hungry, and has covered the naked with a garment;

hausa: Shi ya sa ake kiran filin, Filin Jini har yă zuwa yau.
english: Therefore that field has been called “The Field of Blood” to this day.

hausa: Ta haka Yohanna ya zo, yana baftisma a yankin hamada, yana kuma wa’azin baftismar tuba don gafarar zunubai.
english: John came baptizing in the wilderness and preaching the baptism of repentance for forgiveness of sins.

hausa: Ku yi godiya ga Ubangiji, gama nagari ne shi. Ƙaunarsa madawwamiya ce.
english: Give thanks to Yahweh, for he is good, for his loving kindness endures forever.

hausa: Ku sa waɗannan mutane su yi aiki mai tsanani sosai, don kada su sami zarafin kasa kunne ga maganganun ƙarya.”
english: Let heavier work be laid on the men, that they may labor in it. Don’t let them pay any attention to lying words.”

hausa: Wace al’umma ce mai girma haka wadda allolinta take kusa da su yadda Ubangiji Allahnmu yake kusa da mu a duk sa’ad da muka yi addu’a gare shi?
english: For what great nation is there that has a god so near to them as Yahweh our God is whenever we call on him?

hausa: “Duk wanda ya bugi mutum har ya kashe shi, lalle a kashe shi.
english: “One who strikes a man so that he dies shall surely be put to death,

hausa: Ku yi hankali, kada a ruɗe ku har ku bauta wa alloli, ku kuma yi musu sujada,
english: Be careful, lest your heart be deceived, and you turn away to serve other gods and worship them;

hausa: Amma aka saukar da ni cikin kwando ta tagar katanga, na kuɓuce masa.
english: I was let down in a basket through a window by the wall, and escaped his hands.

hausa: “Ya kuma tambayi na biyun, ‘Kai fa, nawa ne ake bin ka?’ “Sai ya amsa ya ce, ‘Buhunan alkama dubu.’ “Ya ce, ‘Ga takardarka, ka mai da shi ɗari takwas.’
english: Then he said to another, ‘How much do you owe?’ He said, ‘A hundred cors of wheat.’ He said to him, ‘Take your bill, and write eighty.’

hausa: Su daga Isra’ila ne! Wannan maraƙi, mai aikin hannu ne ya yi shi; gunki ne ba Allah ba. Za a farfashe shi kucu-kucu, waccan maraƙin Samariya.
english: For this is even from Israel! The workman made it, and it is no God; indeed, the calf of Samaria shall be broken in pieces.

hausa: Matarka za tă zama kamar kuringar inabi mai ’ya’ya a cikin gidanka; ’ya’yanka maza za su zama kamar tohon zaitun kewaye da teburinka.
english: Your wife will be as a fruitful vine in the innermost parts of your house, your children like olive shoots around your table.

hausa: Gama za ka zauna lafiya da duwatsu a gonaki, kuma manyan namun jeji za su yi zaman salama da kai.
english: For you will be allied with the stones of the field. The animals of the field will be at peace with you.

hausa: Ba a ba su iko su kashe su ba, sai dai su ba su azaba na watanni biyar. Azabar da suka sha kuwa ya yi kamar ta harbin kunama sa’ad da ta harbi mutum.
english: They were given power, not to kill them, but to torment them for five months. Their torment was like the torment of a scorpion when it strikes a person.

hausa: In kuka ji tsoron Ubangiji, kuka bauta masa, kuka yi masa biyayya, ba ku kuwa ƙi bin umarninsa ba, in kuma ku da sarkin da yake mulkinku kun bi Ubangiji Allahnku, to, za ku zauna lafiya.
english: If you will fear Yahweh, and serve him, and listen to his voice, and not rebel against the commandment of Yahweh, then both you and also the king who reigns over you are followers of Yahweh your God.

hausa: Wannan ya sa har wa yau Isra’ilawa ba sa cin jijiyar ƙashin cinya wadda take a kwarin ƙashin cinya, domin an taɓa kwarin ƙashin cinyar Yaƙub kusa da jijiyar.
english: Therefore the children of Israel don’t eat the sinew of the hip, which is on the hollow of the thigh, to this day, because he touched the hollow of Jacob’s thigh in the sinew of the hip.

hausa: Da ragon hadaya don laifin ne firist zai yi kafara saboda mutumin a gaban Ubangiji saboda zunubin da ya yi, za a kuwa gafarta zunubinsa.
english: The priest shall make atonement for him with the ram of the trespass offering before Yahweh for his sin which he has committed; and the sin which he has committed shall be forgiven him.

hausa: Ubangiji fa, shi ne Ruhu, kuma duk inda Ruhun Ubangiji yake, a nan ’yanci yake.
english: Now the Lord is the Spirit; and where the Spirit of the Lord is, there is liberty.

hausa: Waninku zai iya ce mini, “To, don me har yanzu Allah yake ganin laifinmu? Gama wa zai iya tsayayya da nufinsa?”
english: You will say then to me, “Why does he still find fault? For who withstands his will?”

hausa: Sai shanun suka miƙe zuwa Bet-Shemesh. Suka bi hanya daidai, ba su juya dama ko hagu ba. Shugabannin Filistiyawa suka bi har zuwa iyakar ƙasar Bet-Shemesh.
english: The cows took the straight way by the way to Beth Shemesh. They went along the highway, lowing as they went, and didn’t turn away to the right hand or to the left; and the lords of the Philistines went after them to the border of Beth Shemesh.

hausa: Za su yi muku haka saboda sunana, gama ba su san Wannan da ya aiko ni ba.
english: But they will do all these things to you for my name’s sake, because they don’t know him who sent me.

hausa: Dawuda ya ce, “Gobe fa shi ne Bikin Sabon Wata, ya kamata in ci tare da sarki amma bari in tafi fili in ɓuya har jibi da yamma.
english: David said to Jonathan, “Behold, tomorrow is the new moon, and I should not fail to dine with the king; but let me go, that I may hide myself in the field to the third day at evening.

hausa: Masu tsaronki suna kama da fāri ɗango, shugabanninki sun yi cincirindo kamar fārin ɗango da suka sauka a kan bango a rana mai sanyi, amma da rana ta fito, duk za su tashi su tafi, ba kuma wanda ya san inda suka nufa.
english: Your guards are like the locusts, and your officials like the swarms of locusts, which settle on the walls on a cold day, but when the sun appears, they flee away, and their place is not known where they are.

hausa: Bakin wawa lalatar da kansa yake yi leɓunansa kuma tarko ne ga ransa.
english: A fool’s mouth is his destruction, and his lips are a snare to his soul.

hausa: Sa’an nan suka ce, “Ku zo, mu gina wa kanmu birni da hasumiyar da za tă kai har sammai, domin mu yi wa kanmu suna, don kada mu warwatsu ko’ina a doron ƙasa.”
english: They said, “Come, let’s build ourselves a city, and a tower whose top reaches to the sky, and let’s make a name for ourselves, lest we be scattered abroad on the surface of the whole earth.”

hausa: Yesu ya sallame shi nan take, da gargaɗi mai ƙarfi cewa,
english: He strictly warned him and immediately sent him out,

hausa: Amma Yusuf ya ce musu, “Kada ku ji tsoro. Ni Allah ne?
english: Joseph said to them, “Don’t be afraid, for am I in the place of God?

hausa: Ina annabawanka waɗanda suka yi maka annabci suna cewa, ‘Sarkin Babilon ba zai yaƙe ka ko wannan ƙasa ba’?
english: Now where are your prophets who prophesied to you, saying, ‘The king of Babylon will not come against you, nor against this land’?

hausa: Don haka na ba da umarni a tattaro dukan masu hikima na Babilon su bayyana a gabana domin su fassara mini mafarkin.
english: Therefore I made a decree to bring in all the wise men of Babylon before me, that they might make known to me the interpretation of the dream.

hausa: Ba mai rayuwa a cikinsa da yake cin gaba da yin zunubi. Kowa da yake aikata zunubi, bai taɓa ganinsa ba, bai ma san shi ba.
english: Whoever remains in him doesn’t sin. Whoever sins hasn’t seen him and doesn’t know him.

hausa: Kyautar domin waɗanda suke a Betel, da Ramot ta Negeb, da Yattir,
english: He sent it to those who were in Bethel, to those who were in Ramoth of the South, to those who were in Jattir,

hausa: Sa’an nan Haman ya shigo, sai sarki ya ce masa, “Me ya kamata a yi wa mutumin da sarki yake jin daɗi yă girmama?” Haman dai ya yi tunani a ransa ya ce, “Wane ne sarki zai girmama in ba ni ba?”
english: So Haman came in. The king said to him, “What shall be done to the man whom the king delights to honor?” Now Haman said in his heart, “Who would the king delight to honor more than myself?”

hausa: Ba akan sayar da kanari biyu kobo ɗaya ba? Duk da haka ba ɗayansu da zai fāɗi ƙasa ba da yardar Ubanku.
english: “Aren’t two sparrows sold for an assarion coin? Not one of them falls to the ground apart from your Father’s will.

hausa: Game da sauran ayyukan mulkin Feka da duk abin da ya yi, duk a rubuce suke a cikin littafin tarihin sarakunan Isra’ila.
english: Now the rest of the acts of Pekah, and all that he did, behold, they are written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel.

hausa: Sarkin Aram kuwa ya umarci shugabanni kekunan yaƙinsa talatin da biyu, ya ce, “Kada ku yaƙe kowa, ƙarami ko babba, sai dai sarkin Isra’ila.”
english: Now the king of Syria had commanded the thirty-two captains of his chariots, saying, “Don’t fight with small nor great, except only with the king of Israel.”

hausa: Hannunta ya ɗauki turken tenti, da hannunta na dama ta ɗauko guduma. Ta bugi Sisera, ta ragargaza kansa, ta ragargaza ta huda kunnensa.
english: She put her hand to the tent peg, and her right hand to the workmen’s hammer. With the hammer she struck Sisera. She struck through his head. Yes, she pierced and struck through his temples.

hausa: Muna jiran Ubangiji da bege; shi ne taimakonmu da garkuwarmu.
english: Our soul has waited for Yahweh. He is our help and our shield.

hausa: Ubangiji Allahnku zai kawar muku da al’umman nan da kuke niyyar shiga cikin ƙasarsu don ku kore su, bayan kuka kore su, kuka kuma zauna a ƙasarsu,
english: When Yahweh your God cuts off the nations from before you where you go in to dispossess them, and you dispossess them and dwell in their land,

hausa: Ga abin da Ubangiji yana ce wa mutanen Yahuda da kuma na Urushalima. “Ku nome ƙasarku kuma kada ku yi shuka cikin ƙayayyuwa.
english: For Yahweh says to the men of Judah and to Jerusalem, “Break up your fallow ground, and don’t sow among thorns.

hausa: Yanzu ka tashi, ka tsaya da ƙafafunka. Na bayyana a gare ka don in naɗa ka bawa da kuma mai shaidar abin da ka gani game da ni da kuma abin da zan nuna maka.
english: But arise, and stand on your feet, for I have appeared to you for this purpose: to appoint you a servant and a witness both of the things which you have seen and of the things which I will reveal to you;

hausa: Ta haka za su ajiye wa kansu dukiya a matsayin tushen mai ƙarfi don tsara mai zuwa, don su riƙi rai wanda yake na tabbatacce.
english: laying up in store for themselves a good foundation against the time to come, that they may lay hold of eternal life.

hausa: Na faɗa musu cewa, “In kun ga ya fi kyau, ku biya ni; in kuwa ba haka ba, ku riƙe.” Saboda haka suka biya ni azurfa talatin.
english: I said to them, “If you think it best, give me my wages; and if not, keep them.” So they weighed for my wages thirty pieces of silver.

hausa: Kabari, mahaifar da ba ta haihuwa, ƙasa, wadda ba ta taɓa ƙoshi da ruwa, da kuma wuta, wadda ba ta taɓa cewa ‘Ya isa!’
english: Sheol, the barren womb, the earth that is not satisfied with water, and the fire that doesn’t say, ‘Enough!’

hausa: “Masu albarka ne ku, sa’ad da mutane suke zaginku, suna tsananta muku, suna kuma faɗin kowace irin muguwar magana a kanku saboda ni.
english: “Blessed are you when people reproach you, persecute you, and say all kinds of evil against you falsely, for my sake.

hausa: Aka yi wa kowane namiji a gidan Ibrahim kaciya, da waɗanda aka haifa a gidansa, da waɗanda aka sayo da kuɗi daga baƙo.
english: All the men of his house, those born in the house, and those bought with money from a foreigner, were circumcised with him.

hausa: ka cire mugaye daga gaban sarki, kursiyinsa kuwa zai kahu ta wurin adalci.
english: Take away the wicked from the king’s presence, and his throne will be established in righteousness.

hausa: sai dukan mutane suka taru kamar mutum guda a dandali a gaban Ƙofar Ruwa. Suka faɗa wa Ezra malamin Doka yă fitar da Littafin Dokar Musa, wanda Ubangiji ya umarta domin Isra’ila.
english: All the people gathered themselves together as one man into the wide place that was in front of the water gate; and they spoke to Ezra the scribe to bring the book of the law of Moses, which Yahweh had commanded to Israel.

hausa: Dawuda tare da dukan Isra’ilawa suka taka zuwa Urushalima (wato, Yebus). Yebusiyawan da suke zama a wurin
english: David and all Israel went to Jerusalem (also called Jebus); and the Jebusites, the inhabitants of the land, were there.

hausa: Da tabbacin biyayyarka, ina rubuta maka, da sanin za ka yi fiye da abin da na ce.
english: Having confidence in your obedience, I write to you, knowing that you will do even beyond what I say.

hausa: Mai bayarwa hannu sake shi kansa zai sami albarka, gama yakan raba abincinsa da matalauta.
english: He who has a generous eye will be blessed, for he shares his food with the poor.

hausa: Amma sarki zai yi farin ciki ga Allah; dukan waɗanda suke rantse da sunan Allah za su yabe shi, amma za a rufe bakunan maƙaryata.
english: But the king shall rejoice in God. Everyone who swears by him will praise him, for the mouth of those who speak lies shall be silenced.

hausa: “ ‘Kada ka yi jima’i da ’yar matar mahaifinka wadda aka haifa wa mahaifinka; ita ’yar’uwarka ce.
english: “‘You shall not uncover the nakedness of your father’s wife’s daughter, conceived by your father, since she is your sister.

hausa: Amma gidan Isra’ila ba sa niyya su saurare ka domin ba sa niyya su saurare ni, gama dukan gidan Isra’ila sun taurare suna kuma kin ji.
english: But the house of Israel will not listen to you, for they will not listen to me; for all the house of Israel are obstinate and hard-hearted.

hausa: Ku kuma kun ishe ni da ƙarairayi; ku likitocin wofi ne, dukanku!
english: But you are forgers of lies. You are all physicians of no value.

hausa: Ga yadda mugaye suke, kullum ba su da damuwa, arzikinsu yana ta ƙaruwa.
english: Behold, these are the wicked. Being always at ease, they increase in riches.

hausa: Bukki, Uzzi, Zerahiya,
english: Bukki his son, Uzzi his son, Zerahiah his son,

hausa: amma sa’ad da na huta da kakannina, ka ɗauke ni, ka fid da ni daga Masar, ka binne ni a inda aka binne su.” Yusuf ya ce, “Zan yi yadda ka faɗa.”
english: but when I sleep with my fathers, you shall carry me out of Egypt, and bury me in their burying place.” Joseph said, “I will do as you have said.”

hausa: Zan zama Ubansa, zai kuma zama ɗana. Ba zan taɓa ɗauke ƙaunata daga gare shi, kamar yadda na ɗauke ta daga wanda ya riga ka ba.
english: I will be his father, and he will be my son. I will not take my loving kindness away from him, as I took it from him who was before you;

hausa: Ya kuma rurrushe mazaunan karuwai mazan haikali waɗanda suke a haikalin Ubangiji, da kuma inda mata suke yi wa Ashera saƙa.
english: He broke down the houses of the male shrine prostitutes that were in Yahweh’s house, where the women wove hangings for the Asherah.

hausa: Ko akwai wani da ya shuka inabi, bai kuwa fara jin daɗinsa ba? Bari yă tafi gida, kada yă mutu a yaƙi, wani dabam yă ji daɗinsa.
english: What man is there who has planted a vineyard, and has not used its fruit? Let him go and return to his house, lest he die in the battle, and another man use its fruit.

hausa: da shanu biyu, raguna biyar, bunsurai biyar da kuma ’yan raguna biyar dukansu bana ɗaya-ɗaya, a miƙa su hadaya ta salama. Wannan ita ce hadayar Nashon ɗan Amminadab.
english: and for the sacrifice of peace offerings, two head of cattle, five rams, five male goats, and five male lambs a year old. This was the offering of Nahshon the son of Amminadab.

hausa: Lawiyawan nan, Yeshuwa, Kadmiyel, Bani, Hashabnehiya, Sherebiya, Hodiya, Shebaniya da Fetahahiya, suka ce, “Ku miƙe tsaye ku yabi Ubangiji Allahnku, wanda yake har abada abadin.” “Albarka ta tabbata ga sunanka mai ɗaukaka, bari kuma a ɗaukaka shi bisa dukan albarka da yabo.
english: Then the Levites, Jeshua, and Kadmiel, Bani, Hashabneiah, Sherebiah, Hodiah, Shebaniah, and Pethahiah, said, “Stand up and bless Yahweh your God from everlasting to everlasting! Blessed be your glorious name, which is exalted above all blessing and praise!

hausa: Ya sa maɓulɓulai suka zuba ruwa cikin kwaruruka; yana gudu tsakanin duwatsu.
english: He sends springs into the valleys. They run among the mountains.

hausa: Suka ce, “Amma ba a lokacin Biki ba, don kada mutane su tā da rikici.”
english: But they said, “Not during the feast, lest a riot occur among the people.”

hausa: Kana kawo mana ra’ayoyin da suke baƙo a gare mu, kuma muna so mu san mene ne suke nufi.”
english: For you bring certain strange things to our ears. We want to know therefore what these things mean.”

hausa: Bala’am amsa ya ce, “Ban faɗa maka zan yi kaɗai abin da Ubangiji ya ce ba?”
english: But Balaam answered Balak, “Didn’t I tell you, saying, ‘All that Yahweh speaks, that I must do’?”

hausa: A Dutsen Hor, kusa da iyakar Edom, Ubangiji ya ce wa Musa da Haruna,
english: Yahweh spoke to Moses and Aaron in Mount Hor, by the border of the land of Edom, saying,

hausa: Abin da faru ke nan. Gideyon ya tashi da sassafe kashegari, ya matse ulun ya kakkaɓe raɓar, ruwan ya cika ƙwarya.
english: It was so; for he rose up early on the next day, and pressed the fleece together, and wrung the dew out of the fleece, a bowl full of water.

hausa: Saboda kalmominsa kuwa da yawa suka gaskata.
english: Many more believed because of his word.

hausa: Allah ya ba ku Ruhunsa yana kuma aikata ayyukan banmamaki a cikinku saboda kuna kiyaye Doka ne, ko kuwa domin kuna gaskatawa abin da kuka ji ne?
english: He therefore who supplies the Spirit to you and does miracles among you, does he do it by the works of the law, or by hearing of faith?

hausa: Ku daga idanunku zuwa sammai ku dubi duniya a ƙasa; sammai za su ɓace kamar hayaƙi, duniya za tă shuɗe kamar riga mazaunanta kuma su mutu kamar ƙudaje. Amma cetona zai dawwama har abada, adalcina ba zai taɓa kāsa ba.
english: Lift up your eyes to the heavens, and look at the earth beneath; for the heavens will vanish away like smoke, and the earth will wear out like a garment. Its inhabitants will die in the same way, but my salvation will be forever, and my righteousness will not be abolished.

hausa: Sa’ad da kuka shiga ƙasar da Ubangiji Allahnku yake ba ku, kada ku kwaikwayi hanyoyin banƙyama na al’ummai da suke can.
english: When you have come into the land which Yahweh your God gives you, you shall not learn to imitate the abominations of those nations.

hausa: Haka ma Sodom da Gomorra da garuruwan da suke kewaye da su, waɗanda su ma suka ba da kansu ga fasikanci da muguwar sha’awar jiki, sun zama misalin waɗanda suke shan hukuncin madawwamiyar wuta.
english: Even as Sodom and Gomorrah and the cities around them, having in the same way as these given themselves over to sexual immorality and gone after strange flesh, are shown as an example, suffering the punishment of eternal fire.

hausa: Ka gafarta mana laifofinmu, kamar yadda mu ma muke gafarta wa masu yin mana laifi.
english: Forgive us our debts, as we also forgive our debtors.

hausa: Saboda haka sai ya tsaya a ƙofar sansani ya ce, “Duk wanda yake na Ubangiji yă zo wurina.” Sai dukan Lawiyawa suka taru wurinsa.
english: then Moses stood in the gate of the camp, and said, “Whoever is on Yahweh’s side, come to me!” All the sons of Levi gathered themselves together to him.

hausa: “Da kai da Eleyazar firist, da shugabannin jama’a, ku ƙidaya dukan mutane da dabbobin da aka ci da yaƙi.
english: “Count the plunder that was taken, both of man and of animal, you, and Eleazar the priest, and the heads of the fathers’ households of the congregation;

hausa: tare da sarakuna da mashawarta a cikin ƙasa, waɗanda suka gina wa kansu wuraren da yanzu duk sun rushe,
english: with kings and counselors of the earth, who built up waste places for themselves;

hausa: “Waɗannan su ne dokokin da za ka sa a gabansu.
english: “Now these are the ordinances which you shall set before them:

hausa: Game da Al’ummai masu bi kuwa, mun yi musu wasiƙa a kan shawararmu cewa su guji abincin da aka miƙa wa gumaka, da jini, da naman dabbar da aka maƙure da kuma fasikanci.”
english: But concerning the Gentiles who believe, we have written our decision that they should observe no such thing, except that they should keep themselves from food offered to idols, from blood, from strangled things, and from sexual immorality.”

hausa: Safe, rana da yamma ina kuka da nishi, yakan kuwa ji muryata.
english: Evening, morning, and at noon, I will cry out in distress. He will hear my voice.

hausa: Saboda haka Hanun ya kama mutanen Dawuda, ya yi musu aski, ya yayyanka rigunansu a daidai ɗuwawunsu, sa’an nan ya sallame su.
english: So Hanun took David’s servants, shaved them, and cut off their garments in the middle at their buttocks, and sent them away.

hausa: don mutane su gani su kuma sani, su lura su kuma fahimci, cewa hannun Ubangiji ne ya aikata haka, cewa Mai Tsarkin nan na Isra’ila ya sa abin ya faru.
english: that they may see, know, consider, and understand together, that Yahweh’s hand has done this, and the Holy One of Israel has created it.

hausa: Hannun mutum ya iya sarrafa ƙanƙarar duwatsu, yă kuma tumɓuke tushen duwatsu.
english: He puts his hand on the flinty rock, and he overturns the mountains by the roots.

hausa: Dawuda ya zauna a jeji cikin kogunan duwatsu da kuma tuddan jejin Zif. Kowace rana Shawulu ya yi ta neman Dawuda amma Allah bai bashe Dawuda a hannunsa ba.
english: David stayed in the wilderness in the strongholds, and remained in the hill country in the wilderness of Ziph. Saul sought him every day, but God didn’t deliver him into his hand.

hausa: Wawan yaro lalacin mahaifinsa ne, mace mai yawan faɗa tana kama da ɗiɗɗigar ruwa.
english: A foolish son is the calamity of his father. A wife’s quarrels are a continual dripping.

hausa: Suka kuma saƙa taguwa ta efod da shuɗi duka, aikin gwani mai saƙa,
english: He made the robe of the ephod of woven work, all of blue.

hausa: Isra’ila fa suka kashe shi da takobi, suka ƙwace ƙasarsa, tun daga kogin Arnon har zuwa kogin Yabbok, zuwa kan iyakar Ammonawa kawai, gama sun yi wa iyakansu katanga.
english: Israel struck him with the edge of the sword, and possessed his land from the Arnon to the Jabbok, even to the children of Ammon; for the border of the children of Ammon was fortified.

hausa: Dole dabbobinmu ma su tafi tare da mu; ko kofato ma, ba za a bari a baya ba. A cikinsu ne za mu ɗibi abin da za mu yi wa Ubangiji Allahnmu sujada. Ba mu kuma san irin abin da za mu miƙa wa Ubangiji ba, sai mun kai can.”
english: Our livestock also shall go with us. Not a hoof shall be left behind, for of it we must take to serve Yahweh our God; and we don’t know with what we must serve Yahweh, until we come there.”

hausa: ba makamin da aka ƙera don yă cuce ki da zai yi nasara, za ki kuma mayar da magana ga duk wanda ya zarge ki. Wannan ne gādon bayin Ubangiji, kuma wannan ita ce nasararsu daga gare ni,” in ji Ubangiji.
english: No weapon that is formed against you will prevail; and you will condemn every tongue that rises against you in judgment. This is the heritage of Yahweh’s servants, and their righteousness is of me,” says Yahweh.

hausa: Bari Ubangiji Allah yă kasance tare da mu kamar yadda ya kasance da kakanninmu; kada yă taɓa rabu da mu, ko yă yashe mu.
english: May Yahweh our God be with us as he was with our fathers. Let him not leave us or forsake us,

hausa: Saboda haka sai ya bar kome a ƙarƙashin kulawar Yusuf, bai dame kansa a wani abu ba sai dai abincin da yake ci. To, fa, Yusuf ƙaƙƙarfa ne, kyakkyawa kuma,
english: He left all that he had in Joseph’s hand. He didn’t concern himself with anything, except for the food which he ate. Joseph was well-built and handsome.

hausa: An yi jigilar dawakan Solomon daga Masar da kuma daga Kuye, ’yan kasuwan fadan sarki sun sayo su daga Kuye.
english: The horses which Solomon had were brought out of Egypt. The king’s merchants received them in droves, each drove at a price.

hausa: Zedekiya sarkin Yahuda fa ya sa shi a kurkuku yana cewa, “Don me kake yin annabci? Ka ce, ‘Ga abin da Ubangiji yana cewa, ina gab da ba da wannan birni ga sarkin Babilon, zai kuwa cinye ta.
english: For Zedekiah king of Judah had shut him up, saying, “Why do you prophesy, and say, ‘Yahweh says, “Behold, I will give this city into the hand of the king of Babylon, and he will take it;

hausa: Saboda haka kada ku bar wani yă shari’anta ku a kan abin da kuke ci ko sha, ko bisa ga abin da ya shafi wani bikin addini, ko Bikin Sabon Wata ko na ranar Asabbaci.
english: Let no one therefore judge you in eating or drinking, or with respect to a feast day or a new moon or a Sabbath day,

hausa: Dukan kabilar Isra’ila suka zo wurin Dawuda a Hebron suka ce, “Mu nama da jininka ne.
english: Then all the tribes of Israel came to David at Hebron and spoke, saying, “Behold, we are your bone and your flesh.

hausa: Sai ta ce masa, “Na rantse da Ubangiji Allahnka, ba ni da wani abinci, sai dai ɗan gari hannu guda a tulu, da kuma ɗan mai a kwalaba. Ina tattara ’yan itacen nan ne don in kai gida in yi abinci wa kaina da ɗana, don mu ci, mu mutu.”
english: She said, “As Yahweh your God lives, I don’t have anything baked, but only a handful of meal in a jar and a little oil in a jar. Behold, I am gathering two sticks, that I may go in and bake it for me and my son, that we may eat it, and die.”

hausa: Da gari ya waye, sai majalisar dattawa na mutane, da manyan firistoci, da malaman dokoki, suka taru wuri ɗaya. Sai aka kawo Yesu a gabansu.
english: As soon as it was day, the assembly of the elders of the people were gathered together, both chief priests and scribes, and they led him away into their council, saying,

hausa: Kamar makwarwar da ta kwanta a kan ƙwan da ba ita ta zuba ba haka yake da mutumin da ya sami arziki a hanyar da ba daidai ba. A tsakiyar rayuwarsa za su rabu da shi, a ƙarshe kuma zai zama wawa.
english: As the partridge that sits on eggs which she has not laid, so is he who gets riches, and not by right. In the middle of his days, they will leave him. At his end, he will be a fool.

hausa: sai Azariya babban firist, daga iyalin Zadok ya amsa, “Tun daga lokacin da mutane suka fara kawo taimakonsu ga haikalin Ubangiji, muna da isashe don abinci da kuma da yawa da za mu rage, domin Ubangiji ya albarkaci mutanensa, saboda haka abin da ya ragu a rumbu yana da yawa.”
english: Azariah the chief priest, of the house of Zadok, answered him and said, “Since people began to bring the offerings into Yahweh’s house, we have eaten and had enough, and have plenty left over, for Yahweh has blessed his people; and that which is left is this great store.”

hausa: Sa’ad da Abram ya isa Masar, Masarawa suka ga cewa Saira kyakkyawa mace ce ƙwarai.
english: When Abram had come into Egypt, some Egyptians saw that the woman was very beautiful.

hausa: Ku fid da zuciya, ku manoma, ku yi ihu, ku masu noma inabi; ku yi baƙin ciki saboda alkama da sha’ir, saboda an lalata girbin filaye.
english: Be confounded, you farmers! Wail, you vineyard keepers, for the wheat and for the barley; for the harvest of the field has perished.

hausa: Amma Sama’ila ya ce, “Ashe, waɗannan ba kukan tumaki ke nan nake ji a kunnena ba? Wane kuka shanu ke nan nake ji?”
english: Samuel said, “Then what does this bleating of the sheep in my ears and the lowing of the cattle which I hear mean?”

hausa: Gama akwai lokaci da hanyoyin da suka dace da yin kowane abu, ko da yake wahalar mutum ta yi masa yawa.
english: For there is a time and procedure for every purpose, although the misery of man is heavy on him.

hausa: Ruhu ya ɗaga ni sama ya kuma kawo ni ga masu zaman bauta a ƙasar Babilon cikin wahayin da Ruhun Allah ya bayar. Sa’an nan wahayin da na gani ya rabu da ni,
english: The Spirit lifted me up, and brought me in the vision by the Spirit of God into Chaldea, to the captives. So the vision that I had seen went up from me.

hausa: Yayinda yake cikin magana, sai wani girgije mai haske ya rufe su, sai wata murya daga cikin girgijen ta ce, “Wannan Ɗana ne, wanda nake ƙauna; wanda kuma nake jin daɗinsa ƙwarai. Ku saurare shi!”
english: While he was still speaking, behold, a bright cloud overshadowed them. Behold, a voice came out of the cloud, saying, “This is my beloved Son, in whom I am well pleased. Listen to him.”

hausa: da kowace irin dabba, da kowane mai rarrafe, da kowane irin tsuntsu, da kowane irin abu da yake tafiya a bisa duniya, suka fito daga jirgi daki-daki bisa ga irinsu.
english: Every animal, every creeping thing, and every bird, whatever moves on the earth, after their families, went out of the ship.

hausa: Ka saurari kukata, gama ina cikin matsananciyar bukata; ka cece ni daga waɗanda suke fafarata, gama sun fi ni ƙarfi sosai.
english: Listen to my cry, for I am in desperate need. Deliver me from my persecutors, for they are too strong for me.

hausa: Yabo ya tabbata ga Ubangiji har abada!
english: Blessed be Yahweh forever more. Amen, and Amen.

hausa: Yesu, wannan da muke kira Yustus, shi ma yana gaisuwa. Waɗannan ne kaɗai Yahudawa masu bi a cikin abokan aikina saboda mulkin Allah. Sun kuma zama da taimako a gare ni.
english: and Jesus who is called Justus. These are my only fellow workers for God’s Kingdom who are of the circumcision, men who have been a comfort to me.

hausa: Saboda haka Ubangiji ya motsa zuciyar Zerubbabel ɗan Sheyaltiyel, wanda yake gwamna a Yahuda, da kuma zuciyar Yoshuwa ɗan Yehozadak, babban firist, da kuma zukatan dukan raguwar jama’ar. Suka zo suka fara aiki a gidan Ubangiji Maɗaukaki, Allahnsu,
english: Yahweh stirred up the spirit of Zerubbabel the son of Shealtiel, governor of Judah, and the spirit of Joshua the son of Jehozadak, the high priest, and the spirit of all the remnant of the people; and they came and worked on the house of Yahweh of Armies, their God,

hausa: Kamar yadda Yunana ya zama alama ga mutanen Ninebe, haka ma Ɗan Mutum zai zama ga zamanin nan.
english: For even as Jonah became a sign to the Ninevites, so the Son of Man will also be to this generation.

hausa: Ubangiji Allahnki yana tare da ke, mai iko ne don ceto. Zai yi matuƙar farin ciki da ke, zai rufe ki da ƙaunarsa, zai yi farin ciki da ke ta wurin rerawa.”
english: Yahweh, your God, is among you, a mighty one who will save. He will rejoice over you with joy. He will calm you in his love. He will rejoice over you with singing.

hausa: Ku macizai, ta yaya ku da kuke mugaye za ku iya magana kirki? Gama daga baki, mutum yakan faɗi abin da yake cikin zuciya.
english: You offspring of vipers, how can you, being evil, speak good things? For out of the abundance of the heart, the mouth speaks.

hausa: Ya kuma ce wa mutum, ‘Tsoron Ubangiji shi ne hikima, kuma guje wa mugunta shi ne fahimi.’ ”
english: To man he said, ‘Behold, the fear of the Lord, that is wisdom. To depart from evil is understanding.’”

hausa: ku ba da kanku ga irin waɗannan, ga kuma kowa da ya haɗa hannu a aikin, yana kuma faman a cikinsa.
english: that you also be in subjection to such, and to everyone who helps in the work and labors.

hausa: Sa’ad da Ish-Boshet ya ji labari cewa Abner ya mutu a Hebron, sai ya karaya, sai dukan hankalin Isra’ila ya tashi.
english: When Saul’s son heard that Abner was dead in Hebron, his hands became feeble, and all the Israelites were troubled.

hausa: Duk da haka, Ubangiji bai huce daga zafin fushinsa wanda ya ƙuna game da Yahuda saboda abin da Manasse ya aikata don yă tozarta shi ba.
english: Notwithstanding, Yahweh didn’t turn from the fierceness of his great wrath, with which his anger burned against Judah, because of all the provocation with which Manasseh had provoked him.

hausa: Ka tuna yadda raina mai wucewa ne. Gama ka halicce dukan mutane ba amfani!
english: Remember how short my time is, for what vanity you have created all the children of men!

hausa: haɗe da duk zinariya da azurfan da za ka iya samu a Babilon, da kuma duk bayarwar yardar rai daga mutane da firistoci, domin haikalin Allahnsu da yake a Urushalima.
english: and all the silver and gold that you will find in all the province of Babylon, with the free will offering of the people and of the priests, offering willingly for the house of their God which is in Jerusalem.

hausa: saboda zunubanku da kuma zunuban kakanninku,” in ji Ubangiji. “Gama sun ƙone turare a kan duwatsu suka kuma ƙazantar da ni a kan tuddai, zan yi musu awo in zuba a cinyoyinsu cikakken ramuwa saboda ayyukansu na dā.”
english: your own iniquities and the iniquities of your fathers together”, says Yahweh, “who have burned incense on the mountains, and blasphemed me on the hills. Therefore I will first measure their work into their bosom.”

hausa: Solomon ya amsa dukan tambayoyinta, ba abin da ya yi wa sarki wuyan bayyanawa mata.
english: Solomon answered all her questions. There wasn’t anything hidden from the king which he didn’t tell her.

hausa: Ku tashi, ku ci gaba zuwa ƙasar tudun Amoriyawa; ku tafi wurin dukan maƙwabta a cikin Araba, a cikin duwatsu, a gindin yammancin tuddai, a Negeb da kuma a ta kwaruruka, da ƙasar Kan’aniyawa da kuma zuwa Lebanon, har zuwa babban kogi, wato, Yuferites.
english: Turn, and take your journey, and go to the hill country of the Amorites and to all the places near there: in the Arabah, in the hill country, in the lowland, in the South, by the seashore, in the land of the Canaanites, and in Lebanon as far as the great river, the river Euphrates.

hausa: da kuma a duk sa’ad da aka miƙa hadayun ƙonawa ga Ubangiji a Asabbatai da bukukkuwan Sabon Wata da kuma a ƙayyadaddun bukukkuwa, za su yi hidima a gaban Ubangiji kullum bisa ga yawan da aka tsara da kuma a hanyar da aka tsara musu.
english: and to offer all burnt offerings to Yahweh on the Sabbaths, on the new moons, and on the set feasts, in number according to the ordinance concerning them, continually before Yahweh;

hausa: Wannan ita ce ƙauna, wato, ba mu ne muka ƙaunaci Allah ba, sai dai shi ne ya ƙaunace mu, ya kuma aiko Ɗansa yă zama hadaya ta kafara saboda zunubanmu.
english: In this is love, not that we loved God, but that he loved us, and sent his Son as the atoning sacrifice for our sins.

hausa: Bari a nuna ayyukanka ga bayinka, darajarka ga ’ya’yansu.
english: Let your work appear to your servants, your glory to their children.

hausa: Ji kukan makiyaya, kururuwan shugabannin garke, gama Ubangiji yana hallaka wurin kiwo.
english: A voice of the cry of the shepherds, and the wailing of the leader of the flock, for Yahweh destroys their pasture.

hausa: Haka ma kowane itace mai kyau yakan ba da ’ya’ya masu kyau, kuma mummunan itace ba ya ba da ’ya’ya masu kyau.
english: Even so, every good tree produces good fruit, but the corrupt tree produces evil fruit.

hausa: Ya ce, “Yabo ya tabbata ga sunan Allah har abada abadin; hikima da iko nasa ne.
english: Daniel answered, “Blessed be the name of God forever and ever; for wisdom and might are his.

hausa: Shi ya sa, “aka lissafta adalci a gare shi.”
english: Therefore it also was “credited to him for righteousness.”

hausa: Za tă haifi ɗa, za ka kuma sa masa suna Yesu, gama shi ne zai ceci mutanensa daga zunubansu.”
english: She shall give birth to a son. You shall name him Jesus, for it is he who shall save his people from their sins.”

hausa: Sa’ad da suna tafiya da Yesu, sai wani da ake kira Siman, mutumin Sairin, yana zuwa daga ƙauye. Suka kama shi, suka aza masa gicciyen, suka tilasta shi ya ɗauki gicciyen, ya bi Yesu a baya.
english: When they led him away, they grabbed one Simon of Cyrene, coming from the country, and laid the cross on him to carry it after Jesus.

hausa: kamar yadda Uba ya san ni, ni kuma na san Uba, ina kuwa ba da raina domin tumakin.
english: even as the Father knows me, and I know the Father. I lay down my life for the sheep.

hausa: Kada ka tsawata wa dattijo, sai dai ka gargaɗe shi a matsayinka. Ka ɗauki samari a matsayin ’yan’uwanka,
english: Don’t rebuke an older man, but exhort him as a father; the younger men as brothers;

hausa: Saboda haka, da yake an same mu marasa laifi ta wurin bangaskiya, muna da salama tare da Allah ta wurin Ubangijinmu Yesu Kiristi,
english: Being therefore justified by faith, we have peace with God through our Lord Jesus Christ;

hausa: Sai Ubangiji ya ce wa Musa, “Yanzu ranar mutuwarka ta yi kusa. Ka kira Yoshuwa, ku shigo Tentin Sujada, inda zan ba shi ragamar aiki.” Saboda haka Musa da Yoshuwa suka zo, suka kuma shiga Tentin Sujada.
english: Yahweh said to Moses, “Behold, your days approach that you must die. Call Joshua, and present yourselves in the Tent of Meeting, that I may commission him.” Moses and Joshua went, and presented themselves in the Tent of Meeting.

hausa: Haka kuwa ya kasance, gama mutane sun tattake shi a hanyar shiga, har ya mutu.
english: It happened like that to him, for the people trampled over him in the gate, and he died.

hausa: Ya fanshe mu domin albarkar da aka yi wa Ibrahim yă zo ga Al’ummai, ta wurin Kiristi Yesu, domin ta wurin bangaskiya mu karɓi alkawarin Ruhu.
english: that the blessing of Abraham might come on the Gentiles through Christ Jesus, that we might receive the promise of the Spirit through faith.

hausa: Saboda haka Hushai abokin Dawuda ya isa Urushalima yayinda Absalom yake shigowa birnin.
english: So Hushai, David’s friend, came into the city; and Absalom came into Jerusalem.

hausa: Tsoro da fargaba suka kama ni har duk ƙasusuwan jikina suka yi ta rawa.
english: fear came on me, and trembling, which made all my bones shake.

hausa: In kuma kuka tambaye kanku “Me ya sa wannan ya faru da mu?” Wannan kuwa saboda yawan zunubanku ne ya sa fatarinku ya yage aka kuma wahalshe jikinku.
english: If you say in your heart, “Why have these things come on me?” Your skirts are uncovered because of the greatness of your iniquity, and your heels suffer violence.

hausa: Yanzu bari in ba ki shawara yadda za ki cece ranki da kuma ran ɗanki Solomon.
english: Now therefore come, please let me give you counsel, that you may save your own life and your son Solomon’s life.

hausa: na Yeriko 345
english: The children of Jericho, three hundred forty-five.

hausa: “Ga abin da Ubangiji Maɗaukaki, Allah na Isra’ila ya ce, ‘Zan karya karkiyar sarkin Babilon.
english: “Yahweh of Armies, the God of Israel, says, ‘I have broken the yoke of the king of Babylon.

hausa: Ƙofofin Sihiyona za su yi makoki su kuma yi kuka; za tă zama wofi, za tă zauna a ƙasa.
english: Her gates shall lament and mourn. She shall be desolate and sit on the ground.

hausa: Sa’ad da ’yan’uwan suka mayar wa ’yan ƙasar Shekem wannan, sai suka goyi bayan Abimelek, gama sun ce, “Shi ɗan’uwanmu ne.”
english: His mother’s brothers spoke of him in the ears of all the men of Shechem all these words. Their hearts inclined to follow Abimelech; for they said, “He is our brother.”

hausa: Saboda haka Shawulu ya tambayi Allah ya ce, “Mu bi bayan Filistiyawa? Za ka bashe su a hannun Isra’ila?” Amma Allah bai ba shi amsa a ranar ba.
english: Saul asked counsel of God: “Shall I go down after the Philistines? Will you deliver them into the hand of Israel?” But he didn’t answer him that day.

hausa: ’Ya’yan Haruna maza, Nadab da Abihu suka ɗauki farantansu, suka sa wuta a ciki, suka zuba turare a kai; suka kuma miƙa haramtacciyar wuta a gaban Ubangiji, ba irin wadda Ubangiji ya umarta ba.
english: Nadab and Abihu, the sons of Aaron, each took his censer, and put fire in it, and laid incense on it, and offered strange fire before Yahweh, which he had not commanded them.

hausa: Sai ya ce wa almajiransa, “Mu koma Yahudiya.”
english: Then after this he said to the disciples, “Let’s go into Judea again.”

hausa: Wannan shi ne wanda aka rubuta game da shi cewa, “ ‘Zan aiki ɗan saƙona yă sha gabanka, wanda zai shirya hanyarka a gabanka.’
english: For this is he, of whom it is written, ‘Behold, I send my messenger before your face, who will prepare your way before you.’

hausa: In kuka mai da hankali ga waɗannan dokoki, kuka kuma yi hankali ga bin su, to, Ubangiji Allahnku zai kiyaye alkawarinsa na ƙauna gare ku, kamar yadda ya rantse wa kakanninku.
english: It shall happen, because you listen to these ordinances and keep and do them, that Yahweh your God will keep with you the covenant and the loving kindness which he swore to your fathers.

hausa: Mutane suka yi ta zuwa daga ƙasashe dabam-dabam don su ji hikimar Solomon. Sarakuna daga ko’ina a duniya, sun ji labarin hikimarsa, suka kuma aika da mutane don su ji shi.
english: People of all nations came to hear the wisdom of Solomon, sent by all kings of the earth who had heard of his wisdom.

hausa: Ko ya gamshe mu ko bai gamshe mu ba, za mu yi biyayya da Ubangiji Allahnmu, ga wanda muke aikan ka, saboda ya zama mana da amfani, gama za mu yi biyayya da Ubangiji Allahnmu.”
english: Whether it is good, or whether it is bad, we will obey the voice of Yahweh our God, to whom we send you; that it may be well with us, when we obey the voice of Yahweh our God.”

hausa: A cikinsa ne kuma aka zaɓe mu mu sami gādo daga Allah, an kuwa ƙaddara mu ga haka bisa ga nufin wannan da yake zartar da dukan abubuwa yadda ya yi nufi yă yi.
english: We were also assigned an inheritance in him, having been foreordained according to the purpose of him who does all things after the counsel of his will,

hausa: Kamar dai yadda aka ƙaddara wa mutum yă mutu sau ɗaya, bayan haka kuma sai shari’a,
english: Inasmuch as it is appointed for men to die once, and after this, judgment,

hausa: A kasuwarki sun yi ciniki da ke suka sayar miki tufafi masu tsada, da na shuɗi, da masu ado, da dardumai masu ƙyalƙyali da kirtani, da igiyoyi waɗanda aka tuƙa da kyau.
english: These were your traders in choice wares, in wrappings of blue and embroidered work, and in cedar chests of rich clothing bound with cords, among your merchandise.

hausa: In wani marar bi ya gayyace ku cin abinci kuka kuwa yarda ku je, sai ku ci ko mene ne da aka sa a gabanku, ba tare da tambaya don kada lamiri yă damu da inda abin ya fito.
english: But if one of those who don’t believe invites you to a meal, and you are inclined to go, eat whatever is set before you, asking no questions for the sake of conscience.

hausa: Daga zuriyar Dan. Aka rubuta sunayen dukan maza ɗaya-ɗaya da suka kai shekara ashirin ko fiye da suka isa shiga soja, bisa ga iyalansu da kabilarsu da take a rubuce.
english: Of the children of Dan, their generations, by their families, by their fathers’ houses, according to the number of the names, from twenty years old and upward, all who were able to go out to war:

hausa: Hiram sarkin Taya ya amsa ta wurin rubuta wasiƙa zuwa ga Solomon. “Domin Ubangiji yana ƙaunar mutanensa, ya naɗa ka sarkinsu.”
english: Then Huram the king of Tyre answered in writing, which he sent to Solomon, “Because Yahweh loves his people, he has made you king over them.”

hausa: Amma Yesu ya yi shiru. Sai babban firist ya ce masa, “Na haɗa ka da Allah mai rai. Faɗa mana in kai ne Kiristi, Ɗan Allah.”
english: But Jesus stayed silent. The high priest answered him, “I adjure you by the living God that you tell us whether you are the Christ, the Son of God.”

hausa: Sai na furta cewa matattu, waɗanda suka riga suka mutu, sun fi waɗanda suke a raye farin ciki, waɗanda har yanzu suke da rai.
english: Therefore I praised the dead who have been long dead more than the living who are yet alive.

hausa: Hadaya ta sha, za tă zama kwalaba ɗaya na ruwan inabi, da ɗan rago guda. Za a kwarara hadaya ta sha ga Ubangiji a wuri mai tsarki.
english: Its drink offering shall be the fourth part of a hin for each lamb. You shall pour out a drink offering of strong drink to Yahweh in the holy place.

hausa: Sai mutane suka yaba wa dukan mutanen da suka ba da kansu da yardar rai su zauna a Urushalima.
english: The people blessed all the men who willingly offered themselves to dwell in Jerusalem.

hausa: Sa’an nan ya ce, “Yabo ya tabbata ga Ubangiji, Allah na Isra’ila, wanda da hannuwansa ya cika abin da ya yi alkawari da bakinsa ga mahaifina Dawuda. Gama ya ce,
english: He said, “Blessed be Yahweh, the God of Israel, who spoke with his mouth to David my father, and has with his hands fulfilled it, saying,

hausa: Bayan ya haifi Eber, Shela ya yi shekara 403, ya kuma haifi waɗansu ’ya’ya maza da mata.
english: Shelah lived four hundred three years after he became the father of Eber, and became the father of more sons and daughters.

hausa: Absalom ya yi ta yin haka ga dukan Isra’ilawan da suka zo wurin sarki don neman adalci, ta haka kuwa ya saci zukatan mutanen Isra’ila.
english: Absalom did this sort of thing to all Israel who came to the king for judgment. So Absalom stole the hearts of the men of Israel.

hausa: Amma saboda ku, Ubangiji ya yi fushi da ni, bai kuwa saurare ni ba. Sai Ubangiji ya ce, “Ya isa haka, kada ka ƙara yin magana da ni game da wannan batu.
english: But Yahweh was angry with me because of you, and didn’t listen to me. Yahweh said to me, “That is enough! Speak no more to me of this matter.

hausa: Gama inda mutum biyu ko uku suka taru cikin sunana, a can ma ina tare da su.”
english: For where two or three are gathered together in my name, there I am in the middle of them.”

hausa: Yawan mutanen sashensa 62,700 ne.
english: His division, and those who were counted of them, were sixty-two thousand seven hundred.

hausa: Yayinda Nebukadnezzar sarkin Babilon da dukan sojojinsa da kuma dukan mulkokinsa da mutanen masarautar da yake mulki suna yaƙi da Urushalima da dukan garuruwan da suke kewaye, sai wannan magana ta zo wa Irmiya daga wurin Ubangiji cewa,
english: The word which came to Jeremiah from Yahweh, when Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon, with all his army, all the kingdoms of the earth that were under his dominion, and all the peoples, were fighting against Jerusalem and against all its cities, saying:

hausa: Sai suka ci gaba, suka dakata a Gerut Kimham kusa da Betlehem a kan hanyarsu zuwa Masar
english: They departed and lived in Geruth Chimham, which is by Bethlehem, to go to enter into Egypt

hausa: Nisan da take daga mashigin hanyar shiga zuwa can ƙarshen shirayin, kamu hamsin ne.
english: From the forefront of the gate at the entrance to the forefront of the inner porch of the gate were fifty cubits.

hausa: Sa’an nan Zebul ya ce masa, “Ina bakin da ka yi ɗin, kai da ka ce, ‘Wane ne Abimelek da za mu bauta masa.’ Ba mutanen ne ka yi musu ba’a ba? Fita, ka yaƙe su mana!”
english: Then Zebul said to him, “Now where is your mouth, that you said, ‘Who is Abimelech, that we should serve him?’ Isn’t this the people that you have despised? Please go out now and fight with them.”

hausa: Amma da ta kai masa don yă ci, sai ya cafke ta ya ce, “Zo in kwana da ke, ’yar’uwata.”
english: When she had brought them near to him to eat, he took hold of her and said to her, “Come, lie with me, my sister!”

hausa: Ya tanada ƙarfe mai yawa don ƙusoshi saboda ƙyamaren hanyoyin shiga da kuma saboda mahaɗai, da ƙarin tagulla fiye da ƙirge.
english: David prepared iron in abundance for the nails for the doors of the gates and for the couplings, and bronze in abundance without weight,

hausa: “Ba mai facin sabon ƙyalle a tsohuwar riga. In ya yi haka, sabon ƙyallen zai yage daga tsohuwar, yagewar kuwa za tă zama da muni.
english: No one sews a piece of unshrunk cloth on an old garment, or else the patch shrinks and the new tears away from the old, and a worse hole is made.

hausa: Na yi kuka ga Allah Mafi Ɗaukaka, ga Allah, wanda yake cika manufarsa gare ni.
english: I cry out to God Most High, to God who accomplishes my requests for me.

hausa: Sai ya ce mata, “Saboda irin wannan amsa, ki tafi, aljanin ya rabu da diyarki.”
english: He said to her, “For this saying, go your way. The demon has gone out of your daughter.”

hausa: na goma sha biyar a kan Bilga, na goma sha shida a kan Immer,
english: the fifteenth to Bilgah, the sixteenth to Immer,

hausa: Hezekiya ya ba da umarni a shirya ɗakunan ajiya a haikalin Ubangiji, aka kuwa yi haka.
english: Then Hezekiah commanded them to prepare rooms in Yahweh’s house, and they prepared them.

hausa: amma ya zaɓi kabilar Yahuda, Dutsen Sihiyona, wanda ya ƙaunaci.
english: But chose the tribe of Judah, Mount Zion which he loved.

hausa: “Ku shiga ta matsattsiyar ƙofa. Gama ƙofar zuwa hallaka faɗaɗɗiya ce mai sauƙin bi kuma, masu shiga ta cikinta kuwa suna da yawa.
english: “Enter in by the narrow gate; for the gate is wide and the way is broad that leads to destruction, and there are many who enter in by it.

hausa: Kuna tsammani na zo domin in kawo salama a duniya ne? A’a! Ina gaya muku, rabuwa ne.
english: Do you think that I have come to give peace on the earth? I tell you, no, but rather division.
