hausa: Da Yesu ya ga taron mutane kewaye da shi, sai ya ba da umarni a ƙetare zuwa ɗayan hayin tafkin.
english: Now when Jesus saw great multitudes around him, he gave the order to depart to the other side.

hausa: Za su fyaɗa ke a ƙasa, ke da ’ya’yan da suke cikin katanganki. Ba za su bar wani dutse a kan wani ba, saboda ba ki gane da lokacin da Allah zai ziyarce ki ba.”
english: and will dash you and your children within you to the ground. They will not leave in you one stone on another, because you didn’t know the time of your visitation.”

hausa: Sawuna sun kama hanyoyinka ƙafafu kuwa ba za su yi santsi ba.
english: My steps have held fast to your paths. My feet have not slipped.

hausa: Saboda haka Yezebel ta aika da ɗan aika wa Iliya yă faɗa masa, “Bari alloli su hukunta ni da tsanani, in war haka gobe ban mai da ranka kamar na ɗaya daga cikin annabawan Ba’al ba.”
english: Then Jezebel sent a messenger to Elijah, saying, “So let the gods do to me, and more also, if I don’t make your life as the life of one of them by tomorrow about this time!”

hausa: domin ’ya’ya mata na kabilar Manasse sun sami gādo tare da ’ya’ya maza. Aka ba wa sauran mutanen kabilar Manasse ƙasar Gileyad.
english: because the daughters of Manasseh had an inheritance among his sons. The land of Gilead belonged to the rest of the sons of Manasseh.

hausa: Amma sai aka ba Kaleb ɗan Yefunne filayen da kuma ƙauyukan da suke kewaye da birnin, su zama nasa.
english: But they gave the fields of the city and its villages to Caleb the son of Jephunneh for his possession.

hausa: Ta hanyar da ya zo da ita zai koma; ba zai shiga wannan birni ba,” in ji Ubangiji.
english: He will return the way that he came, and he won’t come to this city,’ says Yahweh.

hausa: Sauran ayyuka a mulkin Yotam, haɗe da dukan yaƙe-yaƙensa da waɗansu abubuwan da ya yi, suna a rubuce a littafin sarakunan Isra’ila da na Yahuda.
english: Now the rest of the acts of Jotham, and all his wars and his ways, behold, they are written in the book of the kings of Israel and Judah.

hausa: Dukansu mazinata ne suna ƙuna kamar matoya wadda mai gashin burodi ba ya bukata yă tura mata wuta daga cuɗe kullu har kumburinsa.
english: They are all adulterers. They are burning like an oven that the baker stops stirring, from the kneading of the dough, until it is leavened.

hausa: Ka nuna mini girmar ƙaunarka mai banmamaki, kai da kake ceton waɗanda suke neman mafaka daga abokan gābansu da hannunka na dama.
english: Show your marvelous loving kindness, you who save those who take refuge by your right hand from their enemies.

hausa: Gabas da iyakar Mowab, Musa ya fara bayyana wannan doka, yana cewa,
english: Beyond the Jordan, in the land of Moab, Moses began to declare this law, saying,

hausa: Sa’an nan annabin ya tafi ya tsaya a bakin hanya yana jiran sarki. Ya ɓad da kamanni da ƙyalle a kansa. Ƙyallen ya sauka zuwa bisa idanunsa.
english: So the prophet departed and waited for the king by the way, and disguised himself with his headband over his eyes.

hausa: cewa mugaye sun taso a cikinku, suna rikitar da mutane a birni, suna cewa, “Mu je mu yi wa waɗansu alloli sujada” (allolin da ba ku sani ba),
english: certain wicked fellows have gone out from among you and have drawn away the inhabitants of their city, saying, “Let’s go and serve other gods,” which you have not known,

hausa: Haka ma, wannan mai talenti biyu, shi ma ya yi riba biyu.
english: In the same way, he also who got the two gained another two.

hausa: Sa’an nan raina zai cika da farin ciki a cikin Ubangiji in yi kuma murna a cikin cetonsa.
english: My soul shall be joyful in Yahweh. It shall rejoice in his salvation.

hausa: Don haka Bilatus ya sāke tambayarsa ya ce, “Ba za ka amsa ba? Dubi abubuwa da yawa da suke zarginka da su.”
english: Pilate again asked him, “Have you no answer? See how many things they testify against you!”

hausa: Suka sa sandunan a cikin zoban saboda su kasance a gefen bagade don ɗaukarsa, suka yi rami cikinsa.
english: He put the poles into the rings on the sides of the altar, with which to carry it. He made it hollow with planks.

hausa: Ya gina fadarsa mai suna Kurmin Lebanon, tsawonsa kamu ɗari, fāɗinsa kamu hamsin, tsayinsa kuma kamu talatin, a bisa jeri huɗu na ginshiƙan itacen al’ul, aka shimfiɗa katakan itacen al’ul a bisa ginshiƙan.
english: For he built the House of the Forest of Lebanon. Its length was one hundred cubits, its width fifty cubits, and its height thirty cubits, on four rows of cedar pillars, with cedar beams on the pillars.

hausa: Gama shekara ce ta murna, za tă kuma zama mai tsarki a gare ku, ku dai ci abin da aka ɗauka kai tsaye daga gonaki.
english: For it is a jubilee; it shall be holy to you. You shall eat of its increase out of the field.

hausa: Sai suka jawo jiragen ruwansu zuwa gaci, suka bar kome da kome, suka bi shi.
english: When they had brought their boats to land, they left everything, and followed him.

hausa: An lissafta ni cikin waɗanda suka gangara zuwa cikin rami; ni kamar mutumin da ba shi da ƙarfi ne.
english: I am counted among those who go down into the pit. I am like a man who has no help,

hausa: Da shi nake magana fuska da fuska, a fili kuma, ba a kacici-kacici ba; yakan ga siffar Ubangiji. To, me ya sa ba ku ji tsoro ku yi magana a kan bawana Musa ba?”
english: With him, I will speak mouth to mouth, even plainly, and not in riddles; and he shall see Yahweh’s form. Why then were you not afraid to speak against my servant, against Moses?”

hausa: Duk da haka, tun ba a haifi tagwayen nan ba, balle su yi wani abu mai kyau ko marar kyau don nufin Allah bisa ga zaɓensa ya tabbata, ba ga aikin lada ba, sai dai ga kiransa,
english: For being not yet born, neither having done anything good or bad, that the purpose of God according to election might stand, not of works, but of him who calls,

hausa: Da juyewa, sai Yesu ya ga suna bin sa, sai ya tambaye, su ya ce, “Me kuke nema?” Suka ce, “Rabbi” (wato, “Malam”), “ina kake da zama?”
english: Jesus turned and saw them following, and said to them, “What are you looking for?” They said to him, “Rabbi” (which is to say, being interpreted, Teacher), “where are you staying?”

hausa: Sai Liyatu ta ce, “Ni mai farin ciki ce! Mata za su ce da ni mai farin ciki.” Saboda haka ta sa masa suna Asher.
english: Leah said, “Happy am I, for the daughters will call me happy.” She named him Asher.

hausa: Da ƙugiyoyi suka ja shi cikin keji suka kawo shi wurin sarkin Babilon. Suka sa shi cikin kurkuku, saboda haka ba a ƙara jin rurinsa a kan duwatsun Isra’ila ba.
english: They put him in a cage with hooks, and brought him to the king of Babylon. They brought him into strongholds, so that his voice should no more be heard on the mountains of Israel.

hausa: Wannan gidan da ake kira da Sunana ya zama kogon ’yan fashi ne a gare ku? Amma ina kallo! In ji Ubangiji.
english: Has this house, which is called by my name, become a den of robbers in your eyes? Behold, I myself have seen it,” says Yahweh.

hausa: Amma ina fata Ubangiji zai gafarta wa bawanka saboda abu guda. Bari yă gafarta mini sa’ad da na raka sarkina zuwa haikalin Rimmon domin yă yi sujada, bari Ubangiji yă yi wa bawanka gafara saboda wannan.”
english: In this thing may Yahweh pardon your servant: when my master goes into the house of Rimmon to worship there, and he leans on my hand, and I bow myself in the house of Rimmon. When I bow myself in the house of Rimmon, may Yahweh pardon your servant in this thing.”

hausa: Bulus ya amsa ya ce, “’Yan’uwa, ai, ban san cewa shi ne babban firist ba; gama yana a rubuce cewa, ‘Kada ka yi mugun magana game da mai mulkin mutanenka.’”
english: Paul said, “I didn’t know, brothers, that he was high priest. For it is written, ‘You shall not speak evil of a ruler of your people.’”

hausa: Zan fafare su da takobi, yunwa da annoba zan kuma sa su zama abin ƙyama ga dukan mulkokin duniya da kuma abin la’ana da abin bantsoro, abin dariya da abin reni, a cikin dukan al’umman da aka kore su zuwa.
english: I will pursue after them with the sword, with the famine, and with the pestilence, and will deliver them to be tossed back and forth among all the kingdoms of the earth, to be an object of horror, an astonishment, a hissing, and a reproach among all the nations where I have driven them,

hausa: Ku bar hanyoyinku marasa hankali za ku kuwa rayu; yi tafiya a hanyar fahimi.
english: Leave your simple ways, and live. Walk in the way of understanding.”

hausa: Suka yi amfani da shekel 1,775 don yin ƙugiyoyi saboda sanduna, suka dalaye bisan sandunan da maɗauransu.
english: From the one thousand seven hundred seventy-five shekels he made hooks for the pillars, overlaid their capitals, and made fillets for them.

hausa: Duk sa’ad da rana ta kewayo don Elkana yă miƙa hadaya, yakan ba da kashin nama ga matarsa Feninna da dukan ’ya’yanta maza da mata.
english: When the day came that Elkanah sacrificed, he gave portions to Peninnah his wife and to all her sons and her daughters;

hausa: Kowace rana Mordekai yana kai da komowa kusa da harabar filin gidan matan kulle, domin ya san yadda Esta take, da kuma abin da yake faruwa da ita.
english: Mordecai walked every day in front of the court of the women’s house, to find out how Esther was doing, and what would become of her.

hausa: Sai ya ci gaba zuwa Dutsen Karmel, daga can kuma ya koma Samariya.
english: He went from there to Mount Carmel, and from there he returned to Samaria.

hausa: “ ‘Na kawo ku ƙasar Amoriyawa waɗanda suke gabas da Urdun. Suka yi yaƙi da ku, amma na ba da su a hannunku, na hallaka su a gabanku, kuka kuma mallaki ƙasarsu.
english: “‘I brought you into the land of the Amorites, that lived beyond the Jordan. They fought with you, and I gave them into your hand. You possessed their land, and I destroyed them from before you.

hausa: Da ta tashi don tă yi kala, sai Bowaz ya yi umarni wa samarinsa cewa, “Ko ta tara daga cikin dammuna, kada ku wulaƙanta ta.
english: When she had risen up to glean, Boaz commanded his young men, saying, “Let her glean even among the sheaves, and don’t reproach her.

hausa: Amma kafin su juyo daga abincin da suka yi kwaɗayi, kai tun ma yana a bakunansu,
english: They didn’t turn from their cravings. Their food was yet in their mouths,

hausa: Ubangiji ya ce wa Musa,
english: Yahweh spoke to Moses, saying,

hausa: ’Yan Adam sukan yi shirye-shiryensu a zukatansu, amma Ubangiji ne yake da ikon cika matakansa.
english: A man’s heart plans his course, but Yahweh directs his steps.

hausa: Bari zunubansu su kasance a gaban Ubangiji kullum, don yă sa a manta da su daga duniya.
english: Let them be before Yahweh continually, that he may cut off their memory from the earth;

hausa: Da Yesu ya ga bangaskiyarsu, sai ya ce wa shanyayyen, “Saurayi, an gafarta zunubanka.”
english: Jesus, seeing their faith, said to the paralytic, “Son, your sins are forgiven you.”

hausa: Ba ma haka kaɗai ba, ’ya’yan Rifkatu suna da mahaifi guda ne, wato, mahaifinmu Ishaku.
english: Not only so, but Rebekah also conceived by one, by our father Isaac.

hausa: Masu yinsu za su zama kamar su, haka kuma zai kasance da duk wanda ya dogara da su.
english: Those who make them will be like them; yes, everyone who trusts in them.

hausa: Sai Musa ya husata ƙwarai, ya ce wa Ubangiji, “Kada ka karɓi hadayarsu. Ban ƙwace wani jakinsu ba, ban kuwa cuce waninsu ba.”
english: Moses was very angry, and said to Yahweh, “Don’t respect their offering. I have not taken one donkey from them, neither have I hurt one of them.”

hausa: Zan mai da kai katanga ga wannan mutane, katanga mai ƙarfi na tagulla; za su yi yaƙi da kai amma ba za su yi nasara a kanka ba, gama ina tare da kai don in kuɓutar in kuma cece ka,” in ji Ubangiji.
english: I will make you to this people a fortified bronze wall. They will fight against you, but they will not prevail against you; for I am with you to save you and to deliver you,” says Yahweh.

hausa: Sa’ad da Yohanna Mai Baftisma ya ji a kurkuku abin da Kiristi yake yi, sai ya aiki almajiransa
english: Now when John heard in the prison the works of Christ, he sent two of his disciples

hausa: Amma sauran ƙananan ƙwari duka masu fikafikai, suna kuma jan ciki, abin ƙyama ne a gare ku.
english: But all winged creeping things which have four feet are an abomination to you.

hausa: Sa’an nan Miriyam annabiya, ’yar’uwar Haruna ta ɗauki ganga a hannunta, dukan mata kuwa suka bi ta, da ganguna suna rawa.
english: Miriam the prophetess, the sister of Aaron, took a tambourine in her hand; and all the women went out after her with tambourines and with dances.

hausa: Mugun mutum tarko ne ta wurin zunubinsa, amma mai adalci zai iya rera ya kuma yi murna.
english: An evil man is snared by his sin, but the righteous can sing and be glad.

hausa: Sa’ad da Sha’ul ya rasu, Ba’al-Hanan ɗan Akbor ya gāje shi.
english: Shaul died, and Baal Hanan the son of Achbor reigned in his place.

hausa: tă ƙetare Mashigin Kunama a kudu, tă ci gaba zuwa Zin, sa’an nan tă nufi kudu da Kadesh Barneya. Sa’an nan za tă zarce zuwa Hazar Addar, tă nausa zuwa Azmon,
english: Your border shall turn about southward of the ascent of Akrabbim, and pass along to Zin; and it shall pass southward of Kadesh Barnea; and it shall go from there to Hazar Addar, and pass along to Azmon.

hausa: A lokacin Ahaziya ɗan Ahab ya ce wa Yehoshafat, “Bari mutanena su tafi tare da mutanenka,” amma Yehoshafat ya ƙi.
english: Then Ahaziah the son of Ahab said to Jehoshaphat, “Let my servants go with your servants in the ships.” But Jehoshaphat would not.

hausa: Amma in marar bi ɗin ya raba auren, a ƙyale shi. A irin wannan hali, babu tilas a kan wani, ko wata mai bi. Allah ya kira mu ga zaman lafiya ne.
english: Yet if the unbeliever departs, let there be separation. The brother or the sister is not under bondage in such cases, but God has called us in peace.

hausa: a kan hanyarsa ta komawa gida kuwa yana zaune bisan keken yaƙinsa yana karatun littafin annabin Ishaya.
english: He was returning and sitting in his chariot, and was reading the prophet Isaiah.

hausa: ku yi hankali cewa ba ku manta da Ubangiji wanda ya fitar da ku daga Masar, da gidan bauta ba.
english: then beware lest you forget Yahweh, who brought you out of the land of Egypt, out of the house of bondage.

hausa: ta goma sha biyu a kan Hashabiya, ’ya’yansa maza da danginsa, 12
english: the twelfth to Hashabiah, his sons and his brothers, twelve;

hausa: Sa’an nan ya ce, “Ku yabi Ubangiji, Allah na Isra’ila, wanda da hannunsa ya cika abin da ya yi alkawari da bakinsa ga mahaifina Dawuda. Gama ya ce,
english: He said, “Blessed is Yahweh, the God of Israel, who spoke with his mouth to David your father, and has with his hand fulfilled it, saying,

hausa: Da Yamman ranar farko ta mako, sa’ad da almajiran suna tare, ƙofofi kuma suna a kulle saboda tsoron Yahudawa, sai ga Yesu ya zo ya tsaya a tsakiyarsu ya ce, “Salama tă kasance tare da ku!”
english: When therefore it was evening on that day, the first day of the week, and when the doors were locked where the disciples were assembled, for fear of the Jews, Jesus came and stood in the middle and said to them, “Peace be to you.”

hausa: yawan zinariya zalla, don cokula masu yatsu, kwanonin yayyafawa ruwa da kuma tuluna; yawan zinariya don kowane kwanon zinariya; yawan azurfa don kowane kwanon azurfa;
english: and the forks, the basins, and the cups, of pure gold; and for the golden bowls by weight for every bowl; and for the silver bowls by weight for every bowl;

hausa: Ubangiji yana kusa da kowa da ya kira gare shi, ga duk wanda ya kira gare shi cikin gaskiya.
english: Yahweh is near to all those who call on him, to all who call on him in truth.

hausa: Firist zai ɗauki itacen al’ul, da hizzob, da jan ulu, yă jefa su a kan karsanar da ake ƙonewa.
english: The priest shall take cedar wood, hyssop, and scarlet, and cast it into the middle of the burning of the heifer.

hausa: Duk da haka, Ubangiji, kai ne Ubanmu. Mu yumɓu ne, kai kuma mai ginin tukwane; dukanmu aikin hannunka ne.
english: But now, Yahweh, you are our Father. We are the clay and you our potter. We all are the work of your hand.

hausa: Waɗannan su ne waɗanda ba su ƙazantar da kansu da mata ba, gama sun kiyaye kansu da tsarki. Suna bin Ɗan Ragon duk inda ya tafi. Su ne aka saya daga cikin mutane aka kuwa miƙa su kamar ’ya’yan fari ga Allah da kuma Ɗan Ragon.
english: These are those who were not defiled with women, for they are virgins. These are those who follow the Lamb wherever he goes. These were redeemed by Jesus from among men, the first fruits to God and to the Lamb.

hausa: Suka binne ƙasusuwan Shawulu da na ɗansa Yonatan a kabarin Kish, mahaifin Shawulu, a Zela a Benyamin. Suka kuma yi kome da sarki ya umarta. Bayan wannan Allah ya ji addu’arsu a madadin ƙasar.
english: They buried the bones of Saul and Jonathan his son in the country of Benjamin in Zela, in the tomb of Kish his father; and they performed all that the king commanded. After that, God answered prayer for the land.

hausa: “In kana ƙaunar masu ƙaunarka ne kawai, ina ribar wannan? Ko masu zunubi ma suna ƙaunar waɗanda suke ƙaunarsu.
english: “If you love those who love you, what credit is that to you? For even sinners love those who love them.

hausa: Yana cikin magana sai ga wani ɗan aika ya zo ya ce, “Wutar Allah ta sauko daga sama ta ƙona dukan tumaki da masu lura da su, wato, bayinka, ni kaɗai na tsira na zo in gaya maka!”
english: While he was still speaking, another also came and said, “The fire of God has fallen from the sky, and has burned up the sheep and the servants, and consumed them, and I alone have escaped to tell you.”

hausa: A rana ta huɗu muka tafi haikalin Allah, muka auna azurfa, da zinariya, da tsarkakan kwanonin, muka ba Meremot ɗan Uriya firist, da Eleyazar ɗan Finehas yana tare da shi, da kuma Lawiyawan nan, wato, Yozabad ɗan Yeshuwa, da Nowadiya ɗan Binnuyi.
english: On the fourth day the silver and the gold and the vessels were weighed in the house of our God into the hand of Meremoth the son of Uriah the priest; and with him was Eleazar the son of Phinehas; and with them were Jozabad the son of Jeshua, and Noadiah the son of Binnui, the Levites.

hausa: Bari kuma mu yi tunani a kan yadda za mu gargaɗe juna ga ƙauna da kuma ayyuka nagari.
english: Let’s consider how to provoke one another to love and good works,

hausa: Amma ’yan’uwana sun nuna ba zan iya dogara gare su ba, kamar rafin da yakan bushe da rani,
english: My brothers have dealt deceitfully as a brook, as the channel of brooks that pass away;

hausa: Mahaifiyarsa ta ce masa, “Ɗana, bari la’anar tă fāɗo a kaina. Kai dai yi abin da na faɗa, jeka ka kawo mini su.”
english: His mother said to him, “Let your curse be on me, my son. Only obey my voice, and go get them for me.”

hausa: Murna muke sa’ad da ba mu da ƙarfi, ku kuwa kuna da ƙarfi. Addu’armu ita ce, ku zama cikakku.
english: For we rejoice when we are weak and you are strong. We also pray for this: your becoming perfect.

hausa: Kwana bakwai suka wuce bayan da Ubangiji ya bugi kogin.
english: Seven days were fulfilled, after Yahweh had struck the river.

hausa: Gwamna ya umarce su cewa kada su ci wani abinci mai tsarki sai firist ya yi shawara ta wurin Urim da Tummim tukuna.
english: The governor told them that they should not eat of the most holy things until a priest stood up to serve with Urim and with Thummim.

hausa: Gama Dawuda ya ce, “Tun da Ubangiji, Allah na Isra’ila, ya ba da hutu ga mutanensa, ya kuma zo ya zauna a Urushalima har abada,
english: For David said, “Yahweh, the God of Israel, has given rest to his people; and he dwells in Jerusalem forever.

hausa: Amma kwanaki suna zuwa,” in ji Ubangiji, “sa’ad da zan yi kirarin yaƙi a kan Rabba ta Ammonawa; zai zama tarin juji, za a sa wuta a ƙauyukan da suke kewayenta. Sa’an nan Isra’ila zai kori waɗanda suka kore shi,” in ji Ubangiji.
english: Therefore behold, the days come,” says Yahweh, “that I will cause an alarm of war to be heard against Rabbah of the children of Ammon, and it will become a desolate heap, and her daughters will be burned with fire; then Israel will possess those who possessed him,” says Yahweh.

hausa: Ga tsarkaka kuwa, kome mai tsarki ne, amma ga waɗanda suke marasa tsarki da kuma marasa ba da gaskiya, ba abin da yake da tsarki. Gaskiya dai, hankulansu da lamirinsu duk marasa tsarki ne.
english: To the pure, all things are pure, but to those who are defiled and unbelieving, nothing is pure; but both their mind and their conscience are defiled.

hausa: inda suka shiga jirgin ruwa suka tasar wa haye tafkin zuwa Kafarnahum. A lokacin kuwa duhu ya yi, Yesu kuma bai riga ya zo wurinsu ba tukuna.
english: They entered into the boat, and were going over the sea to Capernaum. It was now dark, and Jesus had not come to them.

hausa: “ ‘In hadaya ga Ubangiji ɗin, hadaya ta ƙonawa ta tsuntsaye ce, zai miƙa kurciya ko ’yar tattabara.
english: “‘If his offering to Yahweh is a burnt offering of birds, then he shall offer his offering from turtledoves or of young pigeons.

hausa: Me za ku ce sa’ad da Ubangiji ya naɗa muku waɗanda ku kanku kuka koya musu a matsayi abokai na musamman? Ashe, azaba ba za tă auko muku kamar na mace mai naƙuda ba?
english: What will you say when he sets over you as head those whom you have yourself taught to be friends to you? Won’t sorrows take hold of you, as of a woman in travail?

hausa: kada kuma ku tayar da dutse mai tsarki, gama waɗannan ne Ubangiji Allahnku yana ƙi.
english: Neither shall you set yourself up a sacred stone which Yahweh your God hates.

hausa: Ya kuma sa aka nemi Ahaziya. Aka kamo shi sa’ad da ya ɓuya a Samariya, suka kawo shi wurin Yehu, suka kashe shi, suka binne shi, gama sun ce, “Shi jikan Yehoshafat ne, wanda ya nemi Ubangiji da dukan zuciyarsa.” Ta haka babu wani a gidan Ahaziya da yake da ƙarfin cin gaba da mulkin.
english: He sought Ahaziah, and they caught him (now he was hiding in Samaria), and they brought him to Jehu and killed him; and they buried him, for they said, “He is the son of Jehoshaphat, who sought Yahweh with all his heart.” The house of Ahaziah had no power to hold the kingdom.

hausa: Saboda haka Ishaku ya fita daga can, ya yi sansani a Kwarin Gerar, ya kuma zauna a can.
english: Isaac departed from there, encamped in the valley of Gerar, and lived there.

hausa: Don mai bi da kaɗe-kaɗe. Zabura ta Dawuda. Ka cece ni, ya Ubangiji, daga mugaye; ka tsare ni daga mutane masu rikici,
english: For the Chief Musician. A Psalm by David. Deliver me, Yahweh, from evil men. Preserve me from violent men:

hausa: Suka roƙa, ya kuwa ba su makware ya kuma ƙosar da su da abinci daga sama.
english: They asked, and he brought quails, and satisfied them with the bread of the sky.

hausa: Bisa ga umarnin Ubangiji ta wurin Musa, aka ba kowa aikinsa, aka kuma faɗa musu abin da za su ɗauka. Ta haka aka ƙidaya su, yadda Ubangiji ya umarci Musa.
english: According to the commandment of Yahweh they were counted by Moses, everyone according to his service and according to his burden. Thus they were counted by him, as Yahweh commanded Moses.

hausa: Ka natsu a gaban Ubangiji ka kuma jira da haƙuri gare shi; kada ka tsorata sa’ad da mutane ke nasara a hanyoyinsu, sa’ad da suke aikata mugayen shirye-shiryensu.
english: Rest in Yahweh, and wait patiently for him. Don’t fret because of him who prospers in his way, because of the man who makes wicked plots happen.

hausa: Saboda haka suka raba ƙasar da za su ratsa, Ahab zai tafi gefe ɗaya, Obadiya kuma yă bi gefe ɗaya.
english: So they divided the land between them to pass throughout it. Ahab went one way by himself, and Obadiah went another way by himself.

hausa: Kada yă yi musayarta ko yă yi musaya mai kyau da marar kyau, ko marar kyau da mai kyau; in lalle ne yă yi musayar dabbar da wata, to, duk wannan da kuma wanda zai yi musayar da ita za su zama masu tsarki.
english: He shall not alter it, nor exchange it, a good for a bad, or a bad for a good. If he shall at all exchange animal for animal, then both it and that for which it is exchanged shall be holy.

hausa: Kerubobin su kasance da fikafikansu a buɗe, domin su inuwantar da murfin, za su fuskanci juna, suna duba murfin.
english: The cherubim shall spread out their wings upward, covering the mercy seat with their wings, with their faces toward one another. The faces of the cherubim shall be toward the mercy seat.

hausa: Ta haka mutumin ya zama riƙaƙƙe mai arziki, ya kasance mai manya-manyan garkuna, da bayi mata da maza, da raƙuma da kuma jakuna.
english: The man increased exceedingly, and had large flocks, female servants and male servants, and camels and donkeys.

hausa: A can wuta za tă cinye ki; takobi zai sare ki, kuma kamar fāra, za a cinye ki. Ki riɓaɓɓanya kamar fāra, ki riɓaɓɓanya kamar fārin ɗango!
english: There the fire will devour you. The sword will cut you off. It will devour you like the grasshopper. Multiply like grasshoppers. Multiply like the locust.

hausa: Ka tuna, Ubangiji, yadda aka yi wa bawanka ba’a, yadda na jimre a zuciyata da zage-zagen dukan al’ummai,
english: Remember, Lord, the reproach of your servants, how I bear in my heart the taunts of all the mighty peoples,

hausa: “Ki yi sowa ki yi murna, ya ke Diyar Sihiyona. Gama ina zuwa, zan zauna a cikinki,” in ji Ubangiji.
english: Sing and rejoice, daughter of Zion! For behold, I come and I will dwell within you,’ says Yahweh.

hausa: Ziklag, Madmanna, Sansanna,
english: Ziklag, Madmannah, Sansannah,

hausa: Dokar Ubangiji cikakkiya ce, takan wartsakar da rai. Farillan Ubangiji abin dogara ne, suna mai da hikima da sauƙi.
english: Yahweh’s law is perfect, restoring the soul. Yahweh’s covenant is sure, making wise the simple.

hausa: A nan ne fa Festus ya tsai da kāriyar Bulus. Ya yi ihu ya ce, “Bulus! Kai dai ruɗaɗɗe ne, yawan karatunka yana juya maka kai.”
english: As he thus made his defense, Festus said with a loud voice, “Paul, you are crazy! Your great learning is driving you insane!”

hausa: “Ka yi bagade da itacen ƙirya don ƙona turare.
english: “You shall make an altar to burn incense on. You shall make it of acacia wood.

hausa: “Ina gaya muku, duk wanda ya shaida ni a gaban mutane, Ɗan Mutum ma zai shaida shi a gaban mala’ikun Allah.
english: “I tell you, everyone who confesses me before men, the Son of Man will also confess before the angels of God;

hausa: Dukan waɗannan su ne kawunan iyalai, manya kamar yadda aka lissafta a cikin zuriyarsu, suka zauna a Urushalima.
english: These were heads of fathers’ households throughout their generations, chief men. These lived in Jerusalem.

hausa: Sai Yesu ya tashi daga nan ya tafi yankin Yahudiya, da kuma ƙetaren Urdun. Taron mutane suka sāke zuwa wurinsa, ya kuma koya musu kamar yadda ya saba.
english: He arose from there and came into the borders of Judea and beyond the Jordan. Multitudes came together to him again. As he usually did, he was again teaching them.

hausa: Dukan jimillar mazan Isra’ila ta kai 601,730.
english: These are those who were counted of the children of Israel, six hundred one thousand seven hundred thirty.

hausa: Zabura ta Dawuda. Roƙo ne. Ya Ubangiji, kada ka tsawata mini cikin fushinka ko ka hore ni cikin hasalarka.
english: A Psalm by David, for a memorial. Yahweh, don’t rebuke me in your wrath, neither chasten me in your hot displeasure.

hausa: Goshen, Holon, Gilo, garuruwa goma sha ɗaya ke nan da ƙauyukansu.
english: Goshen, Holon, and Giloh; eleven cities with their villages.

hausa: Ya Isra’ila, sa zuciyarka ga Ubangiji yanzu da har abada kuma.
english: Israel, hope in Yahweh, from this time forward and forever more.

hausa: Ba wanda ya taɓa ji cewa an buɗe idanun wanda aka haifa makaho.
english: Since the world began it has never been heard of that anyone opened the eyes of someone born blind.

hausa: Sai ya amsa, “Ni mutumin Ibraniyawa ne, ina kuma bauta wa Ubangiji Allah na sama, wanda ya yi teku da tuddai.”
english: He said to them, “I am a Hebrew, and I fear Yahweh, the God of heaven, who has made the sea and the dry land.”

hausa: “Na yi tunani cewa, ‘Zan mutu a cikin gidana, kwanakina da yawa kamar turɓayar ƙasa.
english: Then I said, ‘I will die in my own house, I will count my days as the sand.

hausa: Ina magana ne kamar mutane saboda kun raunana a jikinku. Kamar yadda kuka saba miƙa gaɓoɓin jikinku a bautar abubuwan ƙazanta da mugun aiki a kan mugun aiki, saboda haka yanzu sai ku miƙa su bayi ga aikin adalci mai kai ga zaman tsarki.
english: I speak in human terms because of the weakness of your flesh; for as you presented your members as servants to uncleanness and to wickedness upon wickedness, even so now present your members as servants to righteousness for sanctification.

hausa: Game da al’amarin da muka tattauna da ni da kai kuwa, ka tuna fa Ubangiji ne shaida tsakanina da kai har abada.”
english: Concerning the matter which you and I have spoken of, behold, Yahweh is between you and me forever.”

hausa: Duk abin da gonar ta ba da amfani a shekara ta Asabbaci, zai zama abinci gare ku, wa kanku, bayinku maza da mata, da ma’aikatan da kuka ɗauka aiki, da kuma waɗanda ba zama ɗinɗinɗin suke yi tare da ku ba,
english: The Sabbath of the land shall be for food for you; for yourself, for your servant, for your maid, for your hired servant, and for your stranger, who lives as a foreigner with you.

hausa: Sai Memukan ya amsa a gaban sarki da hakimai ya ce, “Sarauniya Bashti ta yi laifi, ba ga sarki kaɗai ba, amma ga dukan hakimai ma, da kuma mutanen dukan lardunan sarki Zerzes.
english: Memucan answered before the king and the princes, “Vashti the queen has not done wrong to just the king, but also to all the princes, and to all the people who are in all the provinces of the King Ahasuerus.

hausa: Kada ku zalunci ɗan ƙodago matalauci da mabukaci, ko da shi ɗan’uwanku ne mutumin Isra’ila, ko baƙon da yake zama a cikin garuruwanku.
english: You shall not oppress a hired servant who is poor and needy, whether he is one of your brothers or one of the foreigners who are in your land within your gates.

hausa: Yowash ya ce wa firistoci, “Ku tattara dukan kuɗin da ake kawo a matsayin hadayu masu tsarki na haikalin Ubangiji, kuɗin da aka tattara a ƙidaya, kuɗin da aka tattara daga wa’adin da mutum ya yi, da kuma kuɗin da aka kawo na yardan rai a haikali.
english: Jehoash said to the priests, “All the money of the holy things that is brought into Yahweh’s house, in current money, the money of the people for whom each man is evaluated, and all the money that it comes into any man’s heart to bring into Yahweh’s house,

hausa: “Ka ƙidaya Lawiyawa bisa ga iyalansu da kabilarsu. Ka ƙidaya kowane ɗan jinjiri mai wata ɗaya ko fiye.”
english: “Count the children of Levi by their fathers’ houses, by their families. You shall count every male from a month old and upward.”

hausa: Ba za a ƙara yin dare ba. Ba za su bukaci hasken fitila ko hasken rana ba, domin Ubangiji Allah zai haskaka su. Za su kuwa yi mulki har abada abadin.
english: There will be no night, and they need no lamp light or sun light; for the Lord God will illuminate them. They will reign forever and ever.

hausa: Sa’an nan akwai labule, kuma a bayan labulen akwai ɗaki na biyu da ake kira Wuri Mafi Tsarki,
english: After the second veil was the tabernacle which is called the Holy of Holies,

hausa: Zabura ta Dawuda. Ubangiji ne yake kiwona, ba zan rasa kome ba,
english: A Psalm by David. Yahweh is my shepherd; I shall lack nothing.

hausa: Sa’an nan bawan ya fito da kayan ado na zinariya da azurfa da kayayyaki na tufafi ya ba wa Rebeka; ya kuma ba wa ɗan’uwanta da mahaifiyarta kyautai masu tsada.
english: The servant brought out jewels of silver, and jewels of gold, and clothing, and gave them to Rebekah. He also gave precious things to her brother and her mother.

hausa: Amma mutumin da ya karɓi talenti ɗaya ɗin, ya tafi, ya tona rami, ya ɓoye kuɗin maigidansa.
english: But he who received the one talent went away and dug in the earth and hid his lord’s money.

hausa: Na kuma ga wani mala’ika tsaye a cikin rana, wanda ya yi kira da babbar murya ga dukan tsuntsaye da suke tashi sama a tsakiyar sararin sama cewa, “Ku zo, ku taru don babban bikin nan na Allah,
english: I saw an angel standing in the sun. He cried with a loud voice, saying to all the birds that fly in the sky, “Come! Be gathered together to the great supper of God,

hausa: Bayan wannan duka, sa’ad da Yosiya ya shirya haikali, Neko sarkin Masar ya haura don yă yi yaƙi a Karkemish a Yuferites, sai Yosiya ya fita don yă fafata da shi a yaƙi.
english: After all this, when Josiah had prepared the temple, Neco king of Egypt went up to fight against Carchemish by the Euphrates, and Josiah went out against him.

hausa: Rabin ’ya’yansu suna yaren Ashdod ko kuwa wani yare na waɗansu mutane, ba su kuwa san yadda za su yi Yahudanci ba.
english: and their children spoke half in the speech of Ashdod, and could not speak in the Jews’ language, but according to the language of each people.

hausa: A shekara ta ashirin da uku ta Yowash ɗan Ahaziya, sarkin Yahuda, Yehoyahaz ɗan Yehu, ya zama sarkin Isra’ila a Samariya, ya kuwa yi mulki shekaru goma sha bakwai.
english: In the twenty-third year of Joash the son of Ahaziah, king of Judah, Jehoahaz the son of Jehu began to reign over Israel in Samaria for seventeen years.

hausa: Wannan wanda ya kira ku mai aminci ne zai kuwa aikata.
english: He who calls you is faithful, who will also do it.

hausa: Ku binciko duk wuraren da yakan ɓuya, sai ku dawo ku gaya mini tabbataccen labari. Sa’an nan zan tafi tare da ku in yana can. Zan nemi shi ko’ina cikin dukan kabilar Yahuda.”
english: See therefore, and take knowledge of all the lurking places where he hides himself; and come again to me with certainty, and I will go with you. It shall happen, if he is in the land, that I will search him out among all the thousands of Judah.”

hausa: A lokacin nan ta yi rashin lafiya ta mutu, aka kuma yi wa gawarta wanka aka ajiye a wani ɗaki a gidan sama.
english: In those days, she became sick and died. When they had washed her, they laid her in an upper room.

hausa: Sun gudu daga takobi, daga takobin da aka janye, daga bakan da aka tanƙware da kuma daga zafin yaƙi.
english: For they fled away from the swords, from the drawn sword, from the bent bow, and from the heat of battle.

hausa: Da Yesu ya ji wannan, sai ya ce wa Yayirus, “Kada ka ji tsoro, ka gaskata, za a kuma warkar da ita.”
english: But Jesus hearing it, answered him, “Don’t be afraid. Only believe, and she will be healed.”

hausa: Lokacin da Balak ɗan Ziffor, sarkin Mowab, ya yi shiri yă yaƙi Isra’ila, ya aiki Bala’am ɗan Beyor don yă la’anta ku.
english: Then Balak the son of Zippor, king of Moab, arose and fought against Israel. He sent and called Balaam the son of Beor to curse you,

hausa: A can aka binne Ibrahim da matarsa Saratu, a can aka binne Ishaku da matarsa Rebeka, a can kuma na binne Liyatu.
english: There they buried Abraham and Sarah, his wife. There they buried Isaac and Rebekah, his wife, and there I buried Leah:

hausa: Babiloniyawan kuma suka sassare ginshiƙan tagulla, da wuraren zama da za a iya matsar da su, da ƙaton kwano mai suna Teku na tagulla da yake a haikalin Ubangiji, suka kwashe tagullan zuwa Babilon.
english: The Chaldeans broke up the pillars of bronze that were in Yahweh’s house and the bases and the bronze sea that were in Yahweh’s house, and carried the bronze pieces to Babylon.

hausa: ’yan’uwansu kuwa su ne, Shebaniya, da Hodiya, da Kelita, da Felahiya, da Hanan,
english: and their brothers, Shebaniah, Hodiah, Kelita, Pelaiah, Hanan,

hausa: Sa’an nan Ubangiji ya yi magana da Haruna ya ce,
english: Then Yahweh said to Aaron,

hausa: Saboda haka Sha Biyun nan suka tara dukan almajirai wuri ɗaya, suka ce, “Bai zai yi kyau mu bar hidimar maganar Allah don mu shiga hidimar abinci ba.
english: The twelve summoned the multitude of the disciples and said, “It is not appropriate for us to forsake the word of God and serve tables.

hausa: Ubangiji ya mai da mutanensa suka yi ta haihuwa; ya sa suka yi yawa suka fi ƙarfin maƙiyansu,
english: He increased his people greatly, and made them stronger than their adversaries.

hausa: “ ‘Sa’ad da kuka rarraba ƙasar gādo, ku miƙa wa Ubangiji rabon ƙasar ya zama yanki mai tsarki, tsawonsa ya zama kamu 25,000 fāɗinsa kuma ya zama 20,000, dukan ƙasar za tă zama mai tsarki.
english: “‘“Moreover, when you divide by lot the land for inheritance, you shall offer an offering to Yahweh, a holy portion of the land. The length shall be the length of twenty-five thousand reeds, and the width shall be ten thousand. It shall be holy in all its border all around.

hausa: Kaiton ƙasar da ake jin ƙarar fikafikai a bakin kogunan Kush,
english: Ah, the land of the rustling of wings, which is beyond the rivers of Ethiopia;

hausa: Amnon ya matsu ƙwarai har abin ya sa shi ciwo saboda ƙanuwarsa Tamar. Ya gane zai zama da wuya yă sadu da Tamar ita kaɗai, gama ba ta taɓa kwana da namiji ba.
english: Amnon was so troubled that he became sick because of his sister Tamar, for she was a virgin, and it seemed hard to Amnon to do anything to her.

hausa: Mene ne amfanin kuɗi a hannun wawa, da yake ba shi da sha’awar samun hikima?
english: Why is there money in the hand of a fool to buy wisdom, since he has no understanding?

hausa: Ƙuri’a ta biyar ta fāɗa a kan kabilar Asher, bisa ga iyalansu.
english: The fifth lot came out for the tribe of the children of Asher according to their families.

hausa: Aka haifa wa Eber ’ya’ya maza biyu. Aka kira ɗaya Feleg domin a lokacinsa ne aka raba duniya; sunan ɗan’uwansa kuwa shi ne Yoktan.
english: To Eber were born two sons: the name of the one was Peleg, for in his days the earth was divided; and his brother’s name was Joktan.

hausa: “Ko ta wurin hikimarka ce shirwa take firiya take kuma baza fikafikanta zuwa kudu?
english: “Is it by your wisdom that the hawk soars, and stretches her wings toward the south?

hausa: Hargowar yaƙi tana a ƙasar, hargowar babbar hallaka!
english: A sound of battle is in the land, and of great destruction.

hausa: “Game da baƙo kuwa wanda shi ba na mutanenka Isra’ila ba, amma ya zo daga ƙasa mai nisa saboda sunanka,
english: “Moreover, concerning the foreigner, who is not of your people Israel, when he comes out of a far country for your name’s sake

hausa: Sai na ce, “Sa masa rawani mai tsabta a kansa.” Aka sa masa rawani mai tsabta a kansa aka kuma sa masa tufafi yayinda mala’ikan Ubangiji yake tsaye a wurin.
english: I said, “Let them set a clean turban on his head.” So they set a clean turban on his head, and clothed him; and Yahweh’s angel was standing by.

hausa: Kamar kaskon da aka dalaye da azurfar da ba a tace ba haka leɓuna masu mugun zuciya.
english: Like silver dross on an earthen vessel are the lips of a fervent one with an evil heart.

hausa: “Rana ta goma ta wata bakwai, za tă zama Ranar Kafara. Sai ku yi taro mai tsarki don ku yi mūsun kanku ku kuma miƙa hadayar da aka yi da wuta ga Ubangiji.
english: “However on the tenth day of this seventh month is the day of atonement. It shall be a holy convocation to you. You shall afflict yourselves and you shall offer an offering made by fire to Yahweh.

hausa: Irin wannan mutum, horon da yawancin mutane suka yi masa ya isa haka.
english: This punishment which was inflicted by the many is sufficient for such a one;

hausa: Mun yi mugunta gare ka. Ba mu yi biyayya da umarnai, ƙa’idodi da kuma dokokin da ka ba wa bawanka Musa ba.
english: We have dealt very corruptly against you, and have not kept the commandments, nor the statutes, nor the ordinances, which you commanded your servant Moses.

hausa: “Ka bari mu ratsa ta ƙasarka. Ba za mu shiga wata gona ba, ba za mu kuma shiga gonar inabi, ko mu sha ruwa daga wata rijiya ba. Za mu bi ta babbar hanyar sarki, har mu fita ƙasarka.”
english: “Let me pass through your land. We will not turn away into field or vineyard. We will not drink of the water of the wells. We will go by the king’s highway, until we have passed your border.”

hausa: Kafin ya gama addu’a, sai Rebeka ta fito da tulu a kafaɗarta. Ita ’yar Betuwel ɗan Milka, matar Nahor, ɗan’uwan Ibrahim.
english: Before he had finished speaking, behold, Rebekah came out, who was born to Bethuel the son of Milcah, the wife of Nahor, Abraham’s brother, with her pitcher on her shoulder.

hausa: Ya kamata kowa yă bayar bisa ga abin da ya yi shawara a zuciyarsa, ba tare da jin nauyi ko don dole ba, gama Allah yana son mai bayarwa da daɗin rai.
english: Let each man give according as he has determined in his heart, not grudgingly or under compulsion, for God loves a cheerful giver.

hausa: Ubangiji yana yin abin da ya ga dama, a sammai da kuma a duniya, cikin tekuna da kuma cikin dukan zurfafansu.
english: Whatever Yahweh pleased, that he has done, in heaven and in earth, in the seas and in all deeps.

hausa: Ku gai da Rufus zaɓaɓɓe cikin Ubangiji, da kuma mahaifiyarsa, wadda ta zama kamar mahaifiya a gare ni.
english: Greet Rufus, the chosen in the Lord, and his mother and mine.

hausa: Ka yi fili kewaye da shi, ka kuma sa labule a ƙofar shiga filin.
english: You shall set up the court around it, and hang up the screen of the gate of the court.

hausa: Kada ka saurari ƙara game da dattijo sai da shaidu biyu ko uku.
english: Don’t receive an accusation against an elder except at the word of two or three witnesses.

hausa: Saboda wannan kuwa muke wahala da kuma fama, domin mun sa begenmu ga Allah mai rai, wanda yake Mai Ceton dukan mutane, musamman na waɗanda suka ba da gaskiya.
english: For to this end we both labor and suffer reproach, because we have set our trust in the living God, who is the Savior of all men, especially of those who believe.

hausa: Sha’awar adalai kan ƙare kawai a aikata alheri, amma sa zuciyar mugaye kan ƙarasa kawai a fushi.
english: The desire of the righteous is only good. The expectation of the wicked is wrath.

hausa: “Sarkin zai amsa ya ce, ‘Gaskiya nake gaya muku, duk abin da kuka yi wa ɗaya daga cikin waɗannan ’yan’uwana mafi ƙanƙanta, ni kuka yi wa.’
english: “The King will answer them, ‘Most certainly I tell you, because you did it to one of the least of these my brothers, you did it to me.’

hausa: Abin da ka yi bai yi kyau ba. Muddin Ubangiji yana a raye kai da mutanenka kun cancanci mutuwa, domin ba ku lura da maigidanku shafaffe na Ubangiji ba. Ka duba kewaye da kai, ina māshi da kuma butar ruwan da suke kusa da kansa?”
english: This thing isn’t good that you have done. As Yahweh lives, you are worthy to die, because you have not kept watch over your lord, Yahweh’s anointed. Now see where the king’s spear is, and the jar of water that was at his head.”

hausa: Ta ƙara da cewa, “Muna da isashen ciyawa da abincin dabbobi, da kuma wuri domin ku kwana.”
english: She said moreover to him, “We have both straw and feed enough, and room to lodge in.”

hausa: Ya, sarki, kai ne sarkin sarakuna. Allah na sama ya ba ka iko da girma da suna;
english: You, O king, are king of kings, to whom the God of heaven has given the kingdom, the power, the strength, and the glory.

hausa: ku waɗanda ta wurin bangaskiya ake kiyayewa ta wurin ikon Allah har yă zuwa ceton da yake a shirye da za a bayyana a ƙarshen lokaci.
english: who by the power of God are guarded through faith for a salvation ready to be revealed in the last time.

hausa: Ku yi baƙin ciki, ku yi makoki ku kuma yi kuka. Ku mai da dariyarku ta zama makoki, farin cikinku kuma yă zama ɓacin zuciya.
english: Lament, mourn, and weep. Let your laughter be turned to mourning and your joy to gloom.

hausa: Saboda na amince da haka, shi ya sa na so zuwa wurinku da fari, domin ku sami albarka riɓi biyu.
english: In this confidence, I was determined to come first to you, that you might have a second benefit,

hausa: Sai ya sāke aikan wani bawa wurinsu, amma suka bugi wannan mutum a kai, suka wulaƙanta shi.
english: Again, he sent another servant to them; and they threw stones at him, wounded him in the head, and sent him away shamefully treated.

hausa: Me kuma zan faɗa? Ba ni da lokacin da zan ba da labari a kan Gideyon, Barak, Samson, Yefta, Dawuda, Sama’ila, da kuma annabawa,
english: What more shall I say? For the time would fail me if I told of Gideon, Barak, Samson, Jephthah, David, Samuel, and the prophets—

hausa: Hezekiya mai arziki da girma ne ƙwarai, ya kuma yi baitulmali domin azurfa da zinariyarsa da kuma domin duwatsu masu daraja, kayan yaji, garkuwoyi da kuma domin dukan kayayyaki masu daraja nasa.
english: Hezekiah had exceedingly great riches and honor. He provided himself with treasuries for silver, for gold, for precious stones, for spices, for shields, and for all kinds of valuable vessels;

hausa: Ya sa na kai na komo a ciki, na kuma ga ƙasusuwa masu girma da yawa a ƙasar kwarin, ƙasusuwan da suka bushe ƙwarai.
english: He caused me to pass by them all around; and behold, there were very many in the open valley, and behold, they were very dry.

hausa: A rana ta fari ta Bikin Burodi Marar Yisti, lokacin da akan yanka ɗan ragon hadayar kafara, bisa ga al’ada ta tunawa da Bikin Ƙetarewa, sai almajiran Yesu suka tambaye shi, suka ce, “Ina kake so mu je mu shirya maka wurin da za ka ci Bikin Ƙetarewa?”
english: On the first day of unleavened bread, when they sacrificed the Passover, his disciples asked him, “Where do you want us to go and prepare that you may eat the Passover?”

hausa: Suka yi hayar kekunan yaƙi da mahayan kekunan yaƙi dubu talatin da biyu, da kuma sarkin Ma’aka tare da mayaƙansa, waɗanda suka zo suka kafa sansani kusa da Medeba, yayinda Ammonawa suka tattaru daga garuruwansu suka fita yaƙi.
english: So they hired for themselves thirty-two thousand chariots, and the king of Maacah with his people, who came and encamped near Medeba. The children of Ammon gathered themselves together from their cities, and came to battle.

hausa: Waɗannan su ne sarakunan da suka yi sarauta a Edom kafin wani sarkin mutumin Isra’ila yă yi sarauta. Bela ɗan Beyor, wanda aka kira birninsa Dinhaba.
english: Now these are the kings who reigned in the land of Edom, before any king reigned over the children of Israel: Bela the son of Beor; and the name of his city was Dinhabah.

hausa: zai haɗiye mutuwa har abada. Ubangiji Mai Iko Duka zai share hawaye daga dukan fuskoki; zai kawar da kunyar mutanensa daga dukan duniya. Ubangiji ne ya faɗa.
english: He has swallowed up death forever! The Lord Yahweh will wipe away tears from off all faces. He will take the reproach of his people away from off all the earth, for Yahweh has spoken it.

hausa: inda kwana arba’in, Iblis ya gwada shi. Bai ci kome ba a cikin kwanakin nan, a ƙarshensu kuwa ya ji yunwa.
english: for forty days, being tempted by the devil. He ate nothing in those days. Afterward, when they were completed, he was hungry.

hausa: Nebukadnezzar sarkin Babilon ya naɗa Zedekiya ɗan Yosiya sarkin Yahuda; ya yi mulki a madadin Yehohiyacin ɗan Yehohiyakim.
english: Zedekiah the son of Josiah reigned as king instead of Coniah the son of Jehoiakim, whom Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon made king in the land of Judah.

hausa: Waɗanda suke ci daga tanadin sarki za su yi ƙoƙari su hallaka shi; za a share mayaƙansa, kuma za a kashe mutane masu yawa a yaƙin.
english: Yes, those who eat of his delicacies will destroy him, and his army will be swept away. Many will fall down slain.

hausa: Bari masu zagina su hallaka da kunya; bari waɗanda suke so su cutar da ni su sha ba’a da kuma kunya.
english: Let my accusers be disappointed and consumed. Let them be covered with disgrace and scorn who want to harm me.

hausa: ɗana, kada ka tafi tare da su, kada ka taka ƙafarka a hanyarsu;
english: my son, don’t walk on the path with them. Keep your foot from their path,

hausa: Shawulu ya amsa ya ce, “Sojoji ne suka kawo su daga Amalekawa. Sun bar tumaki da shanu masu kyau da rai don su yi wa Ubangiji Allahnka hadaya, amma sauran mun hallaka duka.”
english: Saul said, “They have brought them from the Amalekites; for the people spared the best of the sheep and of the cattle, to sacrifice to Yahweh your God. We have utterly destroyed the rest.”

hausa: Amma in kuna cike da mugun kishi da kuma sonkai a cikin zukatanku, kada ku yi taƙama game da wannan, ko ku danne gaskiya.
english: But if you have bitter jealousy and selfish ambition in your heart, don’t boast and don’t lie against the truth.

hausa: A ziyararsu ta biyu, Yusuf ya faɗa wa ’yan’uwansa wane ne shi, Fir’auna kuwa ya sami sani game da iyalin Yusuf.
english: On the second time Joseph was made known to his brothers, and Joseph’s family was revealed to Pharaoh.

hausa: Sibbekai mutumin Husha, Ilai mutumin Aho,
english: Sibbecai the Hushathite, Ilai the Ahohite,

hausa: Saboda haka suka kira ga dukan shugabannin Filistiyawa suka ce, “Ku komar da akwatin alkawarin Allah na Isra’ila inda ya fito; in ba haka ba zai kashe mu da mutanenmu.” Gama mutuwa ta cika garin da tsoro. Hannun Allah ya yi nauyi a kansa.
english: They sent therefore and gathered together all the lords of the Philistines, and they said, “Send the ark of the God of Israel away, and let it go again to its own place, that it not kill us and our people.” For there was a deadly panic throughout all the city. The hand of God was very heavy there.

hausa: “Ku saurara! Wani manomi ya fita don yă shuka irinsa.
english: “Listen! Behold, the farmer went out to sow.

hausa: Tuna fa, ba shi ne Dawuda ɗin da ake girmama da rawa da waƙoƙi ana cewa, “ ‘Shawulu ya kashe dubbai, Dawuda kuwa dubbun dubbai ba’?”
english: Isn’t this David, of whom people sang to one another in dances, saying, ‘Saul has slain his thousands, and David his ten thousands’?”

hausa: “Wanda ba ya tare da ni, yana gāba da ni, wanda kuma ba ya tarawa da ni, watsarwa yake yi.
english: “He who is not with me is against me. He who doesn’t gather with me scatters.

hausa: Sa’ad da na yi shiru, ƙasusuwana sun yi ta mutuwa cikin nishina dukan yini.
english: When I kept silence, my bones wasted away through my groaning all day long.

hausa: “Bayan haka, a cikin wahayina da dare na duba, a gabana kuwa ga dabba ta huɗu, wadda take da bantsoro da banrazana da kuma iko ƙwarai. Tana da manyan haƙoran ƙarfe; ta ragargaje ta cinye abin da ta kama, ta kuma tattaka duk abin da ya rage a ƙarƙashin ƙafafunta. Ta bambanta da dukan sauran dabbobin da suka riga ta, tana kuma da ƙahoni goma.
english: “After this I saw in the night visions, and, behold, there was a fourth animal, awesome, powerful, and exceedingly strong. It had great iron teeth. It devoured and broke in pieces, and stamped the residue with its feet. It was different from all the animals that were before it. It had ten horns.

hausa: Saboda haka muka ci gaba da aiki, rabin mutane suna riƙe da māsu, daga wayewar gari har zuwa fitowar taurari.
english: So we did the work. Half of the people held the spears from the rising of the morning until the stars appeared.

hausa: A ranar farko ta mako, da sassafe, bayan fitowar rana, suna kan hanyarsu zuwa kabarin ke nan,
english: Very early on the first day of the week, they came to the tomb when the sun had risen.

hausa: Suka amsa, “Na Kaisar ne.” Sai ya ce musu, “Ku ba wa Kaisar abin da yake na Kaisar, ku kuma ba wa Allah abin da yake na Allah.”
english: They said to him, “Caesar’s.” Then he said to them, “Give therefore to Caesar the things that are Caesar’s, and to God the things that are God’s.”

hausa: Ku fanshi ɗan farin jaki da na tunkiya, amma in ba ku fanshe shi ba, ku karya wuyansa. Ku fanshi duk ’ya’yan farinku maza. “Kada wani yă zo gabana hannu wofi.
english: You shall redeem the firstborn of a donkey with a lamb. If you will not redeem it, then you shall break its neck. You shall redeem all the firstborn of your sons. No one shall appear before me empty.

hausa: Maƙiyana suna farauta ta ba dalili kamar tsuntsu.
english: They have chased me relentlessly like a bird, those who are my enemies without cause.

hausa: Sa’an nan suka tashi daga Betel. Yayinda suna da ɗan nisa da Efrat, sai Rahila ta fara naƙuda ta kuwa sha wahala sosai.
english: They traveled from Bethel. There was still some distance to come to Ephrath, and Rachel travailed. She had hard labor.

hausa: Sai Omri da dukan Isra’ilawa suka janye daga Gibbeton, suka yi wa Tirza kwanto.
english: Omri went up from Gibbethon, and all Israel with him, and they besieged Tirzah.

hausa: A duk sa’ad da ya aske gashin kansa (yakan aske kansa lokaci-lokaci sa’ad da ya yi masa nauyi) yakan auna shi, nauyin gashin kuwa yakan kai wajen shekel ɗari biyu a ma’aunin da ake awo.
english: When he cut the hair of his head (now it was at every year’s end that he cut it; because it was heavy on him, therefore he cut it), he weighed the hair of his head at two hundred shekels, after the king’s weight.

hausa: Za a ɗebe kitsenta duka kamar yadda akan ɗebe kitsen hadaya ta salama. Firist zai ƙona shi a kan bagaden don ƙanshi mai daɗi ga Ubangiji. Ta haka firist zai yi kafara dominsa, za a kuwa gafarta masa.
english: All its fat he shall take away, like the fat is taken away from the sacrifice of peace offerings; and the priest shall burn it on the altar for a pleasant aroma to Yahweh; and the priest shall make atonement for him, and he will be forgiven.

hausa: Da ya ji taron suna wucewa, sai ya yi tambaya ko mene ne ke faruwa.
english: Hearing a multitude going by, he asked what this meant.

hausa: Sa’ad da Shela ya yi shekaru 30, sai ya haifi Eber.
english: Shelah lived thirty years, and became the father of Eber.

hausa: Amma da mutanen suka shiga sai suka ga gunkin a gadon, a wajen kan kuwa akwai gashin akuya.
english: When the messengers came in, behold, the teraphim was in the bed, with the pillow of goats’ hair at its head.

hausa: Sai na ga wani babban mala’ika yana saukowa daga sama. An lulluɓe shi da girgije, bakan gizo kuma yana kansa; fuskarsa tana kama da rana, ƙafafunsa kuma suna kama da ginshiƙan wuta.
english: I saw a mighty angel coming down out of the sky, clothed with a cloud. A rainbow was on his head. His face was like the sun, and his feet like pillars of fire.

hausa: Ma’aikatan haikali. Zuriyar Ziha, Hasufa, Tabbawot,
english: The temple servants: the children of Ziha, the children of Hasupha, the children of Tabbaoth,

hausa: Kashegari, sai ya ɗauki dinari biyu, ya ba wa mai masauƙin ya ce, ‘Ka lura da shi, bayan na dawo, zan biya ka duk abin da ka ƙara kashewa a kansa.’
english: On the next day, when he departed, he took out two denarii, gave them to the host, and said to him, ‘Take care of him. Whatever you spend beyond that, I will repay you when I return.’

hausa: Dawuda kuwa ya nemi nufin Ubangiji ya ce, “In bi bayan ’yan harin nan? Zan ci musu?” Ubangiji ya ce, “Bi su, gama za ka ci musu, ka ƙwato abin da suka kwashe.”
english: David inquired of Yahweh, saying, “If I pursue after this troop, will I overtake them?” He answered him, “Pursue, for you will surely overtake them, and will without fail recover all.”

hausa: Ya yi haka don yă shirya mutanensa saboda ayyukan hidima, don a gina jikin Kiristi.
english: for the perfecting of the saints, to the work of serving, to the building up of the body of Christ,

hausa: ‘Jiya na ga jinin Nabot da jinin ’ya’yansa, in ji Ubangiji, kuma ba shakka zan ɗauki fansa a wannan fili, in ji Ubangiji.’ Saboda haka, ka ɗauke shi ka jefar da shi a bisa wannan fegi, bisa ga faɗin Ubangiji. Saboda haka, ka ɗauke shi ka jefar a filin, in ji Ubangiji.”
english: ‘Surely I have seen yesterday the blood of Naboth, and the blood of his sons,’ says Yahweh; ‘and I will repay you in this plot of ground,’ says Yahweh. Now therefore take and cast him onto the plot of ground, according to Yahweh’s word.”

hausa: Ku karɓi kuɗin kafara daga hannun Isra’ilawa, ku yi amfani da shi domin hidimar Tentin Sujada. Zai zama abin tunawa ga Isra’ilawa a gaban Ubangiji, don su yi kafarar rayukansu.”
english: You shall take the atonement money from the children of Israel, and shall appoint it for the service of the Tent of Meeting; that it may be a memorial for the children of Israel before Yahweh, to make atonement for your souls.”

hausa: Firist zai ɗiba garin hadayar mai laushin wanda aka zuba masa mai da kuma turare cike da tafin hannu. Zai ƙona wannan a bisa bagaden, hadaya ce mai daɗin ƙanshi ga Ubangiji don tunawa.
english: He shall take from there his handful of the fine flour of the meal offering, and of its oil, and all the frankincense which is on the meal offering, and shall burn it on the altar for a pleasant aroma, as its memorial portion, to Yahweh.

hausa: Muna addu’a ga Allah kada ku aikata wani laifi. Ba don mutane su gani cewa mun ci gwajin ba ne, a’a, sai dai don ku yi abin da yake daidai, ko da yake zai zama kamar mun fāɗi gwajin ne.
english: Now I pray to God that you do no evil; not that we may appear approved, but that you may do that which is honorable, though we may seem to have failed.

hausa: Sai suka tashi suka shiga ƙauye zuwa ƙauye suna wa’azin bishara, suna warkar da marasa lafiya a ko’ina.
english: They departed and went throughout the villages, preaching the Good News and healing everywhere.

hausa: Gardamar kuwa ta yi tsanani har shugaban ƙungiyar sojan ya ji tsoro za su yayyage Bulus. Ya umarci sojoji su tafi su ƙwace shi ƙarfi da yaji daga wurinsu su kawo shi cikin barikin soja.
english: When a great argument arose, the commanding officer, fearing that Paul would be torn in pieces by them, commanded the soldiers to go down and take him by force from among them and bring him into the barracks.

hausa: (gama doka ba tă mai da wani abu cikakke ba), yanzu kuwa bege mafi kyau ya ɗauki matsayinta. Ta haka kuma muka matso kusa da Allah.
english: (for the law made nothing perfect), and a bringing in of a better hope, through which we draw near to God.

hausa: Dawuda ya ji marmarin ruwan sha sai ya ce, “Kash, a ce wani zai sami mini ruwan sha daga rijiya kusa da ƙofar Betlehem mana!”
english: David longed, and said, “Oh, that someone would give me water to drink from the well of Bethlehem, which is by the gate!”

hausa: Kada ka ji tsoro, ya Yaƙub marar ƙarfi, ya ƙaramin Isra’ila, gama ni kaina zan taimake ka,” in ji Ubangiji, Mai Fansarka, Mai Tsarkin nan na Isra’ila.
english: Don’t be afraid, you worm Jacob, and you men of Israel. I will help you,” says Yahweh. “Your Redeemer is the Holy One of Israel.

hausa: Ku yi wanka ku kuma tsabtacce kanku. Ku kawar da mugayen ayyukanku daga gabana; Ku daina aikata mugunta.
english: Wash yourselves. Make yourself clean. Put away the evil of your doings from before my eyes. Cease to do evil.

hausa: Ka tashi, ya Allah, ka shari’anta duniya, gama dukan al’ummai gādonka ne.
english: Arise, God, judge the earth, for you inherit all of the nations.

hausa: Sauran ayyukan mulkin Yehohiyakim, ayyukan banƙyamar da ya aikata da dukan abubuwan da aka same shi da su, suna a rubuce cikin littafin sarakunan Isra’ila da na Yahuda. Sai Yehohiyacin ɗansa ya gāje shi a matsayin sarki.
english: Now the rest of the acts of Jehoiakim, and his abominations which he did, and that which was found in him, behold, they are written in the book of the kings of Israel and Judah; and Jehoiachin his son reigned in his place.

hausa: Shugaban mayaƙa na uku, don wata na uku, shi ne Benahiya ɗan Yehohiyada firist. Shi ne babba kuma akwai mutane 24,000 a sashensa.
english: The third captain of the army for the third month was Benaiah, the son of Jehoiada the chief priest. In his division were twenty-four thousand.

hausa: Bari su kasance cikin kunya da taƙaici; bari su hallaka cikin wulaƙanci.
english: Let them be disappointed and dismayed forever. Yes, let them be confounded and perish;

hausa: Ƙaunatacciyar mariri, barewa mai kyan gani, bari mamanta su ishe ka kullum, bari ƙaunarta ta ɗauke hankalinka kullum.
english: A loving doe and a graceful deer— let her breasts satisfy you at all times. Be captivated always with her love.

hausa: Zinariya ta rasa kyanta, hasken zinariya ya dushe! An warwatsar da tsarkakakkun duwatsu masu daraja a kan tituna.
english: How the gold has become dim! The most pure gold has changed! The stones of the sanctuary are poured out at the head of every street.

hausa: ’Yan’uwa, ba ma so ku kasance cikin jahilci game da waɗanda suka yi barci, ko kuwa ku yi baƙin ciki kamar sauran mutanen da ba su da bege.
english: But we don’t want you to be ignorant, brothers, concerning those who have fallen asleep, so that you don’t grieve like the rest, who have no hope.

hausa: Suka yi jigilar kekunan yaƙi daga Masar a bakin shekel ɗari shida na azurfa, doki ɗaya kuma a kan ɗari da hamsin. Sun kuma yi jigilarsu suna sayarwa ga dukan sarakunan Hittiyawa da na Arameyawa.
english: A chariot was imported from Egypt for six hundred shekels of silver, and a horse for one hundred fifty shekels; and so they exported them to all the kings of the Hittites and to the kings of Syria.

hausa: Suka amsa, “In a yau za ka zama bawan waɗannan mutane, ka kuma yi musu hidima, ka ba su amsa mai kyau, kullum za su kasance bayinka.”
english: They replied, “If you will be a servant to this people today, and will serve them, and answer them with good words, then they will be your servants forever.”

hausa: Sa’an nan Ubangiji ya sauko daga girgije, ya yi magana da shi, ya kuma ɗauke Ruhun da yake kan Musa ya ɗora shi a kan dattawa saba’in nan. Sa’ad da Ruhun ya zauna a kansu, sai suka yi annabci, amma daga wannan ba su ƙara yin haka kuma ba.
english: Yahweh came down in the cloud, and spoke to him, and took of the Spirit that was on him, and put it on the seventy elders. When the Spirit rested on them, they prophesied, but they did so no more.

hausa: Da ya dubi almajiransa, sai ya ce, “Masu albarka ne ku da kuke matalauta, gama mulkin Allah naku ne.
english: He lifted up his eyes to his disciples, and said: “Blessed are you who are poor, for God’s Kingdom is yours.

hausa: “ ‘Bawana Dawuda zai zama sarki a kansu, dukansu kuwa za su kasance da makiyayi guda. Za su bi dokokina su kuma kiyaye ƙa’idodina.
english: “‘“My servant David will be king over them. They all will have one shepherd. They will also walk in my ordinances and observe my statutes, and do them.

hausa: ku kori dukan mazaunan ƙasar a gabanku. Ku rurrushe sassaƙaƙƙun duwatsu, da siffofinsu na zubi, ku kuma rurrushe dukan masujadansu na kan tudu.
english: then you shall drive out all the inhabitants of the land from before you, destroy all their stone idols, destroy all their molten images, and demolish all their high places.

hausa: Duba, ga ’yata da ba tă taɓa sanin namiji ba da kuma ƙwarƙwaransa. Zan fito muku da su a waje yanzu, za ku kuwa iya yin ko mene ne da kuke so da su. Amma wannan mutum, kada ku yi abin kunya.”
english: Behold, here is my virgin daughter and his concubine. I will bring them out now. Humble them, and do with them what seems good to you; but to this man don’t do any such folly.”

hausa: In ka ɗora hannunka sau ɗaya a kanta za ka tuna da yaƙin da ba za ka sāke yi ba!
english: Lay your hand on him. Remember the battle, and do so no more.

hausa: Sai dai ina tsoro kada yă zama, kamar yadda maciji ya yaudari Hawwa’u da makircinsa, ku ma a bauɗar da hankalinku daga sahihiyar biyayya amintacciya ga Kiristi.
english: But I am afraid that somehow, as the serpent deceived Eve in his craftiness, so your minds might be corrupted from the simplicity that is in Christ.

hausa: Gama kai, ya Allah, ka gwada mu; ka tace mu kamar azurfa.
english: For you, God, have tested us. You have refined us, as silver is refined.

hausa: Ko da yake yana guje wa makamin ƙarfe, kibiya mai bakin tagulla za tă huda shi.
english: He will flee from the iron weapon. The bronze arrow will strike him through.

hausa: “Ɗan mutum, na karye hannun Fir’auna sarkin Masar. Ba a daure shi don warkarwa ba ko a sa tsinke saboda kada yă zama da ƙarfi har ya riƙe takobi.
english: “Son of man, I have broken the arm of Pharaoh king of Egypt. Behold, it has not been bound up, to apply medicines, to put a bandage to bind it, that it may become strong to hold the sword.

hausa: Da tsakar dare, sai Ubangiji ya karkashe dukan ’ya’yan fari a ƙasar Masar, tun daga ɗan farin Fir’auna, wato, magājinsa, har zuwa ɗan fari na ɗan sarƙa da yake kurkuku, har da ’ya’yan fari na dabbobi.
english: At midnight, Yahweh struck all the firstborn in the land of Egypt, from the firstborn of Pharaoh who sat on his throne to the firstborn of the captive who was in the dungeon, and all the firstborn of livestock.

hausa: Sunanki ya yaɗu a cikin al’ummai saboda kyanki, domin darajar da na ba ki ya sa kyanki ya zama cikakke, in ji Ubangiji Mai Iko Duka.
english: Your renown went out among the nations for your beauty; for it was perfect, through my majesty which I had put on you,” says the Lord Yahweh.

hausa: In ɗaya ya fāɗi, abokinsa zai taimake shi yă tashi. Amma abin tausayi ne ga mutumin da ya fāɗi ba shi kuma da wanda zai taimake shi yă tashi!
english: For if they fall, the one will lift up his fellow; but woe to him who is alone when he falls, and doesn’t have another to lift him up.

hausa: Gideyon ya ce, “Waɗannan ’yan’uwana ne, ’ya’yan mahaifiyata. Muddin Ubangiji yana a raye, da a ce kun bar su da rai, da ba zan kashe ku ba.”
english: He said, “They were my brothers, the sons of my mother. As Yahweh lives, if you had saved them alive, I would not kill you.”

hausa: Suka kama manzannin suka sa su a kurkukun da ake sa kowa da kowa.
english: and laid hands on the apostles, then put them in public custody.

hausa: Sa’ad da na ga dama, zan hukunta su; al’ummai za su taru su yi gāba da su don su daure su saboda zunubansu da suka riɓanya.
english: When it is my desire, I will chastise them; and the nations will be gathered against them when they are bound to their two transgressions.

hausa: Sarkinta zai je bauta, shi da ma’aikatansa,” in ji Ubangiji.
english: and their king will go into captivity, he and his princes together,” says Yahweh.

hausa: Dishon, Ezer da Dishan. Waɗannan su ne manyan Horiyawa, bisa ga ɓangarorinsu, a ƙasar Seyir.
english: chief Dishon, chief Ezer, and chief Dishan. These are the chiefs who came of the Horites, according to their chiefs in the land of Seir.

hausa: Da aka kama Zedekiya, sai aka kai shi wurin Sarkin Babilon a Ribla a ƙasar Hamat, a nan ne Sarkin Babilon ya yanke masa shari’a.
english: Then they took the king, and carried him up to the king of Babylon to Riblah in the land of Hamath; and he pronounced judgment on him.

hausa: Yana riƙe da nasara a ma’aji don masu yin gaskiya, shi ne mafaka ga waɗanda tafiyarsu ba ta da laifi,
english: He lays up sound wisdom for the upright. He is a shield to those who walk in integrity,

hausa: Geber ɗan Uri, shi ne a Gileyad (ƙasar Sihon sarkin Amoriyawa da kuma Og sarkin Bashan). Shi ne kaɗai gwamna a bisa yankin.
english: Geber the son of Uri, in the land of Gilead, the country of Sihon king of the Amorites and of Og king of Bashan; and he was the only officer who was in the land.

hausa: Dukan sarakuna za su rusuna masa kuma dukan al’ummai za su bauta masa.
english: Yes, all kings shall fall down before him. All nations shall serve him.

hausa: Yesu ya ce, “Ni ne. Za ku kuwa ga Ɗan Mutum yana zaune a hannun dama na Mai Iko, yana kuma zuwa a cikin gizagizan sama.”
english: Jesus said, “I am. You will see the Son of Man sitting at the right hand of Power, and coming with the clouds of the sky.”

hausa: Tabbatacce, zai fi sauƙi raƙumi ya shiga ta kafar allura, da mai arziki ya shiga mulkin Allah.”
english: For it is easier for a camel to enter in through a needle’s eye than for a rich man to enter into God’s Kingdom.”

hausa: Zai yi wanka a tsattsarkan wuri yă sa rigunarsa na kullum. Sa’an nan zai fita yă miƙa hadaya ta ƙonawa domin kansa da hadaya ta ƙonawa domin mutane, don yă yi kafara domin kansa da kuma domin mutane.
english: Then he shall bathe himself in water in a holy place, put on his garments, and come out and offer his burnt offering and the burnt offering of the people, and make atonement for himself and for the people.

hausa: “Duk da haka ba ku kira bisa sunana ba, ya Yaƙub, ba ku gajiyar da kanku saboda ni ba, ya Isra’ila.
english: Yet you have not called on me, Jacob; but you have been weary of me, Israel.

hausa: “Sa’an nan za su tafi cikin madawwamiyar hukunci, amma masu adalci kuwa za su shiga rai madawwami.”
english: These will go away into eternal punishment, but the righteous into eternal life.”

hausa: da Horma, da Bor-Ashan, da Atak,
english: to those who were in Hormah, to those who were in Borashan, to those who were in Athach,

hausa: Waɗanda suka kama Yesu kuwa suka kai shi wurin Kayifas, babban firist, inda malaman dokoki da dattawa suka taru.
english: Those who had taken Jesus led him away to Caiaphas the high priest, where the scribes and the elders were gathered together.

hausa: Bala’am ya ce wa Allah, “Balak ɗan Ziffor, sarkin Mowab ne, ya aiko mini wannan saƙo cewa,
english: Balaam said to God, “Balak the son of Zippor, king of Moab, has said to me,

hausa: da Zadok, matashi jarumi sosai, tare da shugabanni su 22 daga iyalinsa;
english: and Zadok, a young man mighty of valor, and of his father’s house twenty-two captains.

hausa: Amma lokaci na zuwa, har ma ya yi, da za a warwatsa ku, kowa yă koma gidansa. Za ku bar ni ni kaɗai. Duk da haka ba ni kaɗai ba ne, gama Ubana yana tare da ni.
english: Behold, the time is coming, yes, and has now come, that you will be scattered, everyone to his own place, and you will leave me alone. Yet I am not alone, because the Father is with me.

hausa: Sai aka ji murya daga al’arshi a kan kawunansu yayinda suke tsaye da fikafikansu a sauke.
english: There was a voice above the expanse that was over their heads. When they stood, they let down their wings.

hausa: Da suka juya suka juya suka tsere zuwa wajajen hamada zuwa dutsen Rimmon, Isra’ilawa suka kashe mutum dubu biyar a kan hanyoyi. Suka yi ta matsa wa mutanen Benyamin har zuwa Gidom suka kashe mutum dubu biyu kuma.
english: They turned and fled toward the wilderness to the rock of Rimmon. They gleaned five thousand men of them in the highways, and followed hard after them to Gidom, and struck two thousand men of them.

hausa: Mala’ika na biyar ya busa ƙahonsa, sai na ga tauraron da ya fāɗo duniya daga sararin sama. Aka ba wa tauraron mabuɗin ramin Abis.
english: The fifth angel sounded, and I saw a star from the sky which had fallen to the earth. The key to the pit of the abyss was given to him.

hausa: A wancan lokaci, wannan ɗa wanda aka haifa ta wurin ƙa’idar jiki ya tsananta wa wanda aka haifa ta ikon Ruhu. Haka ma yake har yanzu.
english: But as then, he who was born according to the flesh persecuted him who was born according to the Spirit, so also it is now.

hausa: Yesu ya amsa ya ce, “Ka ga dukan manyan gine-ginen nan? Ba wani dutse a nan, da za a bari kan wani da ba za a rushe ba.”
english: Jesus said to him, “Do you see these great buildings? There will not be left here one stone on another, which will not be thrown down.”

hausa: Sa’an nan aka kira magatakardun sarki a rana ta goma sha uku na wata na fari. Suka rubuta dukan umarnin Haman a irin rubutun kowane lardi, kuma cikin harshen kowane mutane, zuwa ga shugabannin mahukuntai na sarki, da gwamnonin larduna dabam-dabam, da kuma hakiman mutane dabam-dabam. Aka rubuta waɗannan a sunan Sarki Zerzes da kansa, aka kuma hatimce da zobensa.
english: Then the king’s scribes were called in on the first month, on the thirteenth day of the month; and all that Haman commanded was written to the king’s local governors, and to the governors who were over every province, and to the princes of every people, to every province according to its writing, and to every people in their language. It was written in the name of King Ahasuerus, and it was sealed with the king’s ring.

hausa: Sauran Isra’ilawa tare da firistoci, da Lawiyawa sun kasance a dukan garuruwan Yahuda, kowanne a mallakar kakansa.
english: The residue of Israel, of the priests, and the Levites were in all the cities of Judah, everyone in his inheritance.

hausa: Ko da yake za a ba da birnin ga Babiloniyawa, kai, ya Ubangiji Mai Iko Duka, ka ce mini, ‘Saye fili da azurfa ka kuma sa a shaida cinikin.’ ”
english: You have said to me, Lord Yahweh, ‘Buy the field for money, and call witnesses;’ whereas the city is given into the hand of the Chaldeans.”

hausa: Ramammun shanun nan munana, suka cinye shanun nan bakwai masu ƙiba da suka fito da fari.
english: The thin and ugly cattle ate up the first seven fat cattle;

hausa: da Rakal, da garuruwan Yerameyelawa, da garuruwan Keniyawa,
english: to those who were in Racal, to those who were in the cities of the Jerahmeelites, to those who were in the cities of the Kenites,

hausa: Ku ci shi a matsayin abu mafi tsarki; kowane namiji zai ci. Dole ku ɗauke shi da tsarki.
english: You shall eat of it like the most holy things. Every male shall eat of it. It shall be holy to you.

hausa: “ ‘Wannan dai, ita ce dokar kishi sa’ad da mace ta kauce, ta kuma ƙazantar da kanta yayinda take aure da mijinta,
english: “‘This is the law of jealousy, when a wife, being under her husband, goes astray, and is defiled,

hausa: Sa’ad da namiji ya kwana da mace ya kuwa zub da maniyyi, dole dukansu biyu su yi wanka, za su kuma ƙazantu har yamma.
english: If a man lies with a woman and there is an emission of semen, they shall both bathe themselves in water, and be unclean until the evening.

hausa: Sama’ila ya ce, “Me ke nan ka yi?” Shawulu ya ce, “Sa’ad da na ga mutane suna watsewa, kai kuwa ba ka zo cikin lokaci ba, ga Filistiyawa kuma suna taruwa a Mikmash,
english: Samuel said, “What have you done?” Saul said, “Because I saw that the people were scattered from me, and that you didn’t come within the days appointed, and that the Philistines assembled themselves together at Michmash,

hausa: Amma sarkin yaƙin ya amsa ya ce, “Kuna tsammani ga maigidanku da ku ne kawai maigidana ya aiko ni in yi waɗannan maganganu, ba ga mutanen da suke zama a kan katanga ba, waɗanda kamar ku, za su ci kashinsu su kuma sha fitsarinsu?”
english: But Rabshakeh said, “Has my master sent me only to your master and to you, to speak these words, and not to the men who sit on the wall, who will eat their own dung and drink their own urine with you?”

hausa: Saboda haka Allah ya ce masa, “Kawo mini karsana, akuya, da kuma rago kowanne yă kasance shi shekara uku ne, da kurciya da kuma ɗan tattabara.”
english: He said to him, “Bring me a heifer three years old, a female goat three years old, a ram three years old, a turtledove, and a young pigeon.”

hausa: Sa’ad da Adamu ya yi shekaru 130, sai ya haifi ɗa wanda ya yi kama da shi, ya kuma kira shi Set.
english: Adam lived one hundred thirty years, and became the father of a son in his own likeness, after his image, and named him Seth.

hausa: Sai Haruna ya amsa wa Musa, “Yau sun miƙa hadayarsu don zunubi da kuma hadayarsu ta ƙonawa a gaban Ubangiji, ga kuma irin waɗannan abubuwa da suka same ni, da a ce na ci hadaya don zunubi yau, da zai yi kyau ke nan a gaban Ubangiji?”
english: Aaron spoke to Moses, “Behold, today they have offered their sin offering and their burnt offering before Yahweh; and such things as these have happened to me. If I had eaten the sin offering today, would it have been pleasing in Yahweh’s sight?”

hausa: Babu ƙarshe ga dukan mutanen da suka riga su. Amma waɗanda suka zo daga baya, ba su gamsu da magājin ba. Wannan ma ba shi da amfani, naushin iska ne kawai.
english: There was no end of all the people, even of all them over whom he was—yet those who come after shall not rejoice in him. Surely this also is vanity and a chasing after wind.

hausa: Ubangiji ya ce wa Musa da Haruna,
english: Yahweh spoke to Moses and to Aaron, saying,

hausa: Yesu ya ce, “An yi wannan muryar saboda amfaninku ne, ba don nawa ba.
english: Jesus answered, “This voice hasn’t come for my sake, but for your sakes.

hausa: Ɗaya daga cikin manyan fadawansa, Feka ɗan Remaliya, ya ƙulla masa maƙarƙashiya. Ɗauke da mutanen Gileyad hamsin, ya kashe Fekahiya tare da Argob da kuma Ariye a fadan sarki a Samariya. Ta haka Feka ya kashe Fekahiya ya kuma gāje shi.
english: Pekah the son of Remaliah, his captain, conspired against him and attacked him in Samaria, in the fortress of the king’s house, with Argob and Arieh; and with him were fifty men of the Gileadites. He killed him, and reigned in his place.

hausa: Saboda haka sai Ubangiji ya fusata da Isra’ila ya ce, “Domin wannan al’umma ta tā da yarjejjeniyar da na yi da kakanninsu ba su kuwa saurare ni ba,
english: Yahweh’s anger burned against Israel; and he said, “Because this nation transgressed my covenant which I commanded their fathers, and has not listened to my voice,

hausa: Saboda haka Laban ya shiga tentin Yaƙub, ya shiga tentin Liyatu da kuma tentuna matan nan biyu bayi, amma bai sami kome ba. Bayan ya fita daga tentin Liyatu, sai ya shiga tentin Rahila.
english: Laban went into Jacob’s tent, into Leah’s tent, and into the tent of the two female servants; but he didn’t find them. He went out of Leah’s tent, and entered into Rachel’s tent.

hausa: Sai ya ce musu, “Don me kuke damuwa, kuke kuma shakka a zuciyarku?
english: He said to them, “Why are you troubled? Why do doubts arise in your hearts?

hausa: A duk lokacin da suka tashi daga sansani, girgijen Ubangiji ya inuwantar da su da rana.
english: The cloud of Yahweh was over them by day, when they set forward from the camp.

hausa: Wa zai iya cewa, “Na kiyaye zuciyata da tsarki; ni mai tsabta ne marar zunubi kuma”?
english: Who can say, “I have made my heart pure. I am clean and without sin”?

hausa: Bari sama da ƙasa su yabe shi, tekuna da dukan abin da yake motsi a cikinsu,
english: Let heaven and earth praise him; the seas, and everything that moves therein!

hausa: gama ba ku ba ne kuke magana, amma Ruhun Ubanku ne yake magana ta wurinku.
english: For it is not you who speak, but the Spirit of your Father who speaks in you.

hausa: Ta wurin manzanninka ka tara wa Ubangiji zagi. Ka kuma ce, “Da yawa kekunan yaƙina na haye kan ƙwanƙolin duwatsu, wurin mafi tsawo na Lebanon. Na sassare itacen al’ul nasa mafi tsawo mafi daraja na itacen fir nasa. Na ratsa har can tsakiyar kurmi, mafi kyau na kurminsa.
english: By your messengers, you have defied the Lord, and have said, “With the multitude of my chariots, I have come up to the height of the mountains, to the innermost parts of Lebanon, and I will cut down its tall cedars and its choice cypress trees; and I will enter into his farthest lodging place, the forest of his fruitful field.

hausa: “La’ananne ne mutumin da ya ƙasƙantar da mahaifinsa ko mahaifiyarsa.” Sai dukan mutane su ce, “Amin!”
english: ‘Cursed is he who dishonors his father or his mother.’ All the people shall say, ‘Amen.’

hausa: Ba shakka, a zuciyarmu mun ji kamar hukuncin kisa ne aka yi mana. Wannan kuwa ya faru ne domin kada mu dogara da kanmu, sai dai ga Allah, wanda yake tā da matattu.
english: Yes, we ourselves have had the sentence of death within ourselves, that we should not trust in ourselves, but in God who raises the dead,

hausa: Mutane suka taru da yawa har ma babu wuri, ko a bakin ƙofa ma, sai ya yi musu wa’azin bishara.
english: Immediately many were gathered together, so that there was no more room, not even around the door; and he spoke the word to them.

hausa: in kuma sun juye gare ka da dukan zuciyarsu da ransu a ƙasar zaman bautarsu inda aka kai su, suka kuma dubi wajen ƙasar da ka ba wa kakanninsu, wajen birnin da ka zaɓa da kuma wajen haikalin da na gina domin Sunanka;
