english: if they return to you with all their heart and with all their soul in the land of their captivity, where they have been taken captive, and pray toward their land which you gave to their fathers, and the city which you have chosen, and toward the house which I have built for your name;

hausa: Saboda haka, in dukan jikinka yana cike da haske, ba inda ke da duhu, jikinka kuwa zai kasance da haske gaba ɗaya, kamar yadda hasken fitila yake haskaka ka.”
english: If therefore your whole body is full of light, having no part dark, it will be wholly full of light, as when the lamp with its bright shining gives you light.”

hausa: Aka rarraba ruwan inabi cikin kwaf na zinariya, kowanne kuwa dabam yake da ɗayan. Ruwan inabin kuwa yana da yawa, bisa ga wadatar sarki.
english: They gave them drinks in golden vessels of various kinds, including royal wine in abundance, according to the bounty of the king.

hausa: Ɗan aikan da ya je yă kawo Mikahiya, ya ce masa, “Duba, sauran annabawa suna maganar nasara wa sarki, sai ka ce mutum guda. Bari maganarka tă yarda da tasu, ka kuma yi maganar alheri.”
english: The messenger who went to call Micaiah spoke to him, saying, “See now, the prophets declare good to the king with one mouth. Please let your word be like the word of one of them, and speak good.”

hausa: Sa’an nan ya ba su waɗannan umarnai ya ce, “Ina gab da a tara ni ga mutanena. Ku binne ni tare da kakannina a kogon da yake cikin filin Efron mutumin Hitti,
english: He instructed them, and said to them, “I am to be gathered to my people. Bury me with my fathers in the cave that is in the field of Ephron the Hittite,

hausa: ba ko ɗaya sai dai Kaleb ɗan Yefunne Bakenizze da Yoshuwa ɗan Nun, don su ne kaɗai suka bi Ubangiji da zuciya ɗaya.’
english: except Caleb the son of Jephunneh the Kenizzite, and Joshua the son of Nun, because they have followed Yahweh completely.’

hausa: Waɗannan su ne shugabannin yankuna waɗanda suka zauna a Urushalima (ko da yake waɗansu Isra’ilawa, da firistoci, da Lawiyawa, da ma’aikatan haikali, da zuriyar bayin Solomon, suka yi zama a cikin garuruwan Yahuda, kowanne a mallakarsa cikin garuruwa dabam-dabam,
english: Now these are the chiefs of the province who lived in Jerusalem; but in the cities of Judah, everyone lived in his possession in their cities—Israel, the priests, the Levites, the temple servants, and the children of Solomon’s servants.

hausa: Baƙin ciki irin na tsoron Allah yana kai ga tuban da yake kawo ceto, ba ya kuma kawo baƙin ciki, amma baƙin ciki irin na duniya yakan kawo mutuwa.
english: For godly sorrow produces repentance leading to salvation, which brings no regret. But the sorrow of the world produces death.

hausa: Sa’an nan suka ɗauki akwatin alkawarin suka kai shi cikin haikalin gunkinsu Dagon, suka ajiye kusa da Dagon.
english: The Philistines took God’s ark, and brought it into the house of Dagon and set it by Dagon.

hausa: ɗan Yaƙub, ɗan Ishaku, ɗan Ibrahim, ɗan Tera, ɗan Nahor,
english: the son of Jacob, the son of Isaac, the son of Abraham, the son of Terah, the son of Nahor,

hausa: A kan wannan na farka na duba kewaye. Barcina ya yi mini daɗi.
english: On this I awakened, and saw; and my sleep was sweet to me.

hausa: Wa ya sani ko zai zama mai hikima ko kuma wawa? Duk da haka zai mallaki dukan aikin da na yi da ƙoƙarina da kuma dabarata a duniya. Wannan ma ba shi da amfani.
english: Who knows whether he will be a wise man or a fool? Yet he will have rule over all of my labor in which I have labored, and in which I have shown myself wise under the sun. This also is vanity.

hausa: Har ma a bisan bayina, maza da mata, zan zuba Ruhuna a kwanakin nan.
english: And also on the servants and on the handmaids in those days, I will pour out my Spirit.

hausa: Yetro ya yi murna da jin duk abubuwa masu kyau da Ubangiji ya yi wa Isra’ila, wajen cetonsu daga hannun Masarawa.
english: Jethro rejoiced for all the goodness which Yahweh had done to Israel, in that he had delivered them out of the hand of the Egyptians.

hausa: In ya zaɓe ta domin ɗansa, dole yă ba ta duk damar da ’ya ta mace take da shi.
english: If he marries her to his son, he shall deal with her as a daughter.

hausa: Sai ya ce wa almajiransa, “Don me kuke tsoro haka? Har yanzu ba ku da bangaskiya ne?”
english: He said to them, “Why are you so afraid? How is it that you have no faith?”

hausa: Zan hukunta ki da hukuncin matan da suke zina da kuma waɗanda suke zub da jini; zan kawo hakkin jini na fushina da kuma fushin kishina.
english: I will judge you as women who break wedlock and shed blood are judged; and I will bring on you the blood of wrath and jealousy.

hausa: Sa’ad da Dawuda ya zo Mahanayim, sai Shobi ɗan Nahash daga Rabba ta Ammonawa, da Makir ɗan Ammiyel daga Lo Debar, da Barzillai mutumin Gileyad daga Rogelim
english: When David had come to Mahanaim, Shobi the son of Nahash of Rabbah of the children of Ammon, and Machir the son of Ammiel of Lodebar, and Barzillai the Gileadite of Rogelim,

hausa: Harshensu kibiya ce mai dafi; yana magana da ruɗu. Da bakinsa kowa yana maganar alheri da maƙwabcinsa, amma a zuciyarsa ya sa masa tarko.
english: Their tongue is a deadly arrow. It speaks deceit. One speaks peaceably to his neighbor with his mouth, but in his heart, he waits to ambush him.

hausa: Ba wanda yake so a san shi da zai yi abu a ɓoye. Da yake kana yin waɗannan abubuwa, sai ka nuna kanka ga duniya.”
english: For no one does anything in secret while he seeks to be known openly. If you do these things, reveal yourself to the world.”

hausa: Shi ya sa Yahudawan ƙauyuka, waɗanda suke zama a karkara, suke kiyaye rana ta goma sha huɗu ta watan Adar a matsayin ranar farin ciki da ta biki, ranar ba da kyautai ga juna.
english: Therefore the Jews of the villages, who live in the unwalled towns, make the fourteenth day of the month Adar a day of gladness and feasting, a holiday, and a day of sending presents of food to one another.

hausa: Ni Ubangiji Maɗaukaki, Allah na Isra’ila na ce, “’Yar Babilon kamar daɓen masussuka a lokacin da ake sussuka, ba da daɗewa ba lokacin girbe ta zai zo.”
english: For Yahweh of Armies, the God of Israel says: “The daughter of Babylon is like a threshing floor at the time when it is trodden. Yet a little while, and the time of harvest comes for her.”

hausa: A ranar da ya shiga fili na can ciki na wuri mai tsarki don hidima a wuri mai tsarki, zai miƙa hadaya don zunubi saboda kansa, in ji Ubangiji Mai Iko Duka.
english: In the day that he goes into the sanctuary, into the inner court, to minister in the sanctuary, he shall offer his sin offering,” says the Lord Yahweh.

hausa: “Har yaushe za ka gama faɗa waɗannan abubuwa? Maganganunka ba su da amfani.
english: “How long will you speak these things? Shall the words of your mouth be a mighty wind?

hausa: Sai sarki ya ce masa, “Sau nawa ne zan sa ka rantse cewa ba za ka faɗa mini kome ba sai dai gaskiya a cikin sunan Ubangiji?”
english: The king said to him, “How many times do I have to adjure you that you speak to me nothing but the truth in Yahweh’s name?”

hausa: Mai hikima a zuciya yakan yarda da umarni amma surutun wawa kan kai ga lalaci.
english: The wise in heart accept commandments, but a chattering fool will fall.

hausa: Daga can kuma muka sāke kama tafiya muka zaga ta bayan tsibirin Saifurus saboda iska tana gāba da mu.
english: Putting to sea from there, we sailed under the lee of Cyprus, because the winds were contrary.

hausa: Ku sumbaci Ɗan, don kada yă yi fushi ku hallaka a abubuwan da kuke yi, gama fushinsa zai iya kuna farat ɗaya. Masu farin ciki ne dukan waɗanda suke neman mafaka daga gare shi.
english: Give sincere homage to the Son, lest he be angry, and you perish on the way, for his wrath will soon be kindled. Blessed are all those who take refuge in him.

hausa: Kashegari muka sauka a Sidon; Juliyos kuwa, cikin alheri ga Bulus, ya bar shi yă je wajen abokansa domin su biya masa bukatunsa.
english: The next day, we touched at Sidon. Julius treated Paul kindly and gave him permission to go to his friends and refresh himself.

hausa: Kashin da aka ba sojoji waɗanda suka tafi yaƙi shi ne, tumaki 337,500,
english: The half, which was the portion of those who went out to war, was in number three hundred thirty-seven thousand five hundred sheep;

hausa: kashi ɗaya za su yi gadin Ƙofar Sur, kashi ɗaya kuma za su yi gadin ƙofar da take bayan ’yan gadin fada. Dukan waɗannan ƙungiyoyi uku za su yi gadin fadan,
english: a third of you shall be at the gate Sur; and a third of you at the gate behind the guard. So you shall keep the watch of the house, and be a barrier.

hausa: Da muka ji labarin, duk sai zuciyar kowa ta narke, kowa ya karaya saboda ku, gama Ubangiji Allahnku shi ne Allah na sama da ƙasa.
english: As soon as we had heard it, our hearts melted, and there wasn’t any more spirit in any man, because of you: for Yahweh your God, he is God in heaven above, and on earth beneath.

hausa: Ana nan sai Absalom ya samo wa kansa wata keken yaƙi da dawakai tare da mutum hamsin da za su sha gabansa.
english: After this, Absalom prepared a chariot and horses for himself, and fifty men to run before him.

hausa: Ku dubi irin girman da Melkizedek mana. Ko kakanmu Ibrahim ma ya ba shi kashi ɗaya bisa goma na ganima!
english: Now consider how great this man was, to whom even Abraham the patriarch gave a tenth out of the best plunder.

hausa: firist zai je ya bincika shi, in kuwa cutar ta bazu a gidan, to, muguwar cuta ce; gidan marar tsarki ne.
english: then the priest shall come in and look; and behold, if the plague has spread in the house, it is a destructive mildew in the house. It is unclean.

hausa: Waɗannan garuruwa da ƙauyukansu su ne rabon da kabilar Issakar ta samu, bisa ga iyalansu.
english: This is the inheritance of the tribe of the children of Issachar according to their families, the cities with their villages.

hausa: In kuma idonka yana sa ka zunubi, ƙwaƙule shi. Ai, gwamma ka shiga mulkin Allah da ido ɗaya, da a jefa ka cikin jahannama ta wuta, da idanu biyu,
english: If your eye causes you to stumble, throw it out. It is better for you to enter into God’s Kingdom with one eye, rather than having two eyes to be cast into the Gehenna of fire,

hausa: Kada firist ya sha ruwan inabi sa’ad da zai shiga fili na can ciki.
english: None of the priests shall drink wine when they enter into the inner court.

hausa: “Kun ajiye abinci mai ƙazanta a kan bagadena. “Sai kuka ce, ‘Yaya muka ƙazantar da kai?’ “Ta wurin cewa teburin Ubangiji abin reni ne.
english: You offer polluted bread on my altar. You say, ‘How have we polluted you?’ In that you say, ‘Yahweh’s table is contemptible.’

hausa: A ƙarshe sai almajirin nan, wanda ya kai kabarin da farko, shi ma ya shiga. Ya gani ya kuma gaskata.
english: So then the other disciple who came first to the tomb also entered in, and he saw and believed.

hausa: Nan da nan suka bar abin kamun kifinsu suka bi shi.
english: They immediately left their nets and followed him.

hausa: Mutumin banza yakan ƙulla mugunta, kuma jawabinsa yana kama da wuta mai ƙuna.
english: A worthless man devises mischief. His speech is like a scorching fire.

hausa: “To, ’yan’uwa, na san cewa, kun aikata wannan cikin jahilci ne, yadda shugabanninku suka yi.
english: “Now, brothers, I know that you did this in ignorance, as did also your rulers.

hausa: saboda kwanakinku da kwanakin ’ya’yanku su yi tsawo a ƙasar da Ubangiji ya rantse zai ba wa kakanninku, muddin sama tana bisa duniya.
english: that your days and your children’s days may be multiplied in the land which Yahweh swore to your fathers to give them, as the days of the heavens above the earth.

hausa: Jikoki rawanin tsofaffi ne, kuma iyaye su ne abin taƙamar ’ya’yansu.
english: Children’s children are the crown of old men; the glory of children is their parents.

hausa: Sai Bala’am ya furta saƙon da aka ba shi ya ce, “Tashi, Balak, ka saurara; ka kasa kunne gare ni, ɗan Ziffor.
english: He took up his parable, and said, “Rise up, Balak, and hear! Listen to me, you son of Zippor.

hausa: Sa’an nan firistoci suka yayyanka awakin suka miƙa jininsu a bagade domin hadaya don zunubi don kafara saboda dukan Isra’ila, domin sarki ya umarta a yi hadaya ta ƙonawa da hadaya don zunubi domin dukan Isra’ila.
english: Then the priests killed them, and they made a sin offering with their blood on the altar, to make atonement for all Israel; for the king commanded that the burnt offering and the sin offering should be made for all Israel.

hausa: Heshbon da Eleyale sun yi kuka da ƙarfi, aka ji muryoyinsu ko’ina har zuwa Yahaz. Saboda haka mayaƙan Mowab suka yi kuka da ƙarfi, har zuciyarsu ta karai.
english: Heshbon cries out with Elealeh. Their voice is heard even to Jahaz. Therefore the armed men of Moab cry aloud. Their souls tremble within them.

hausa: (Abiyatar ɗan Ahimelek ya zo da efod sa’ad da ya gudo zuwa wurin Dawuda a Keyila.)
english: When Abiathar the son of Ahimelech fled to David to Keilah, he came down with an ephod in his hand.

hausa: Sa’an nan ya shiga wuri mai tsarki da yake can ciki ya auna madogarar ƙofar shigar; fāɗin kowanne kamu biyu ne. Faɗin ƙofar shigan kamu shida ne, fāɗin bangayen a kowane gefenta kamu bakwai-bakwai ne.
english: Then he went inward and measured each post of the entrance, two cubits; and the entrance, six cubits; and the width of the entrance, seven cubits.

hausa: Ku ɗaura su su zama alamu a hannuwanku, ku kuma ɗaura su a goshinku.
english: You shall bind them for a sign on your hand, and they shall be for frontlets between your eyes.

hausa: Don mai bi da kaɗe-kaɗe. Ta ’Ya’yan Kora maza. Zabura ce. Ku tafa hannuwanku, dukanku al’ummai; ku yi sowa ga Allah da muryoyin farin ciki.
english: For the Chief Musician. A Psalm by the sons of Korah. Oh clap your hands, all you nations. Shout to God with the voice of triumph!

hausa: Haka yake a gare ku. Da yake kuna marmarin samun baye-bayen ruhaniya, sai ku ba da ƙarfinku ga yin amfani da waɗanda za su gina ikkilisiya.
english: So also you, since you are zealous for spiritual gifts, seek that you may abound to the building up of the assembly.

hausa: haka kuma tsayin labule na wancan gefen, zai zama kamu goma sha biyar, da katakai uku tare da rammukansu uku.
english: For the other side shall be hangings of fifteen cubits; their pillars three, and their sockets three.

hausa: Kada ku yi ƙyamar mutumin Edom, gama mutumin Edom ɗan’uwanku ne. Kada ku yi ƙyamar mutumin Masar, domin kun yi zama baƙunta a ƙasarsa.
english: You shall not abhor an Edomite, for he is your brother. You shall not abhor an Egyptian, because you lived as a foreigner in his land.

hausa: Yahuda, Benyamin, Shemahiya, Irmiya,
english: Judah, Benjamin, Shemaiah, Jeremiah,

hausa: Lokaci ya yi da za ka yi wani abu, ya Ubangiji; ana karya dokarka.
english: It is time to act, Yahweh, for they break your law.

hausa: Sai matan suka bar kabarin da hanzari, da tsoro, sai dai cike da farin ciki, suka tafi a guje don su gaya wa almajiransa.
english: They departed quickly from the tomb with fear and great joy, and ran to bring his disciples word.

hausa: Ruhu a sarari ya faɗa cewa a kwanakin ƙarshe waɗansu za su watsar da bangaskiya su bi ruhohi masu ruɗu da kuma abubuwan da aljanu suke koyarwa.
english: But the Spirit says expressly that in later times some will fall away from the faith, paying attention to seducing spirits and doctrines of demons,

hausa: ina shirin yin haka in na tafi Sifen. Ina fata in ziyarce ku yayinda nake wucewa don ku raka ni can, bayan na ji daɗin zama tare da ku na ɗan lokaci.
english: whenever I travel to Spain, I will come to you. For I hope to see you on my journey, and to be helped on my way there by you, if first I may enjoy your company for a while.

hausa: “Na hallaka mutumin Amoriyawa a gabansu, ko da yake ya yi dogo kamar itacen al’ul kuma mai ƙarfi kamar itacen oak. Na hallaka ’ya’yan itatuwansa daga sama, da kuma jijiyoyinsa daga ƙasa.
english: Yet I destroyed the Amorite before them, whose height was like the height of the cedars, and he was strong as the oaks; yet I destroyed his fruit from above, and his roots from beneath.

hausa: sai Sabenawa suka auka musu suka kwashe su suka tafi, suka karkashe masu yi maka aiki duka, ni kaɗai na tsira na zo in gaya maka!”
english: and the Sabeans attacked, and took them away. Yes, they have killed the servants with the edge of the sword, and I alone have escaped to tell you.”

hausa: Ubangiji ya ce, “Yanzu fa ku zo, bari mu dubi batun nan tare, Ko da zunubanku sun yi ja kamar garura, za su zama fari kamar ƙanƙara; ko da sun yi ja kamar mulufi, za su zama kamar ulu.
english: “Come now, and let’s reason together,” says Yahweh: “Though your sins are as scarlet, they shall be as white as snow. Though they are red like crimson, they shall be as wool.

hausa: Ya tambaye su, “Amma ku fa, wane ne ni a ganinku?”
english: He said to them, “But who do you say that I am?”

hausa: Suna ce, “Ubangiji ba ya gani; Allah na Yaƙub bai kula ba.”
english: They say, “Yah will not see, neither will Jacob’s God consider.”

hausa: Ko da waɗansu ba su ɗauke ni a matsayin manzo ba, tabbatacce, ni manzo ne a gare ku! Gama ku ne hatimin manzancina a gaban Ubangiji.
english: If to others I am not an apostle, yet at least I am to you; for you are the seal of my apostleship in the Lord.

hausa: ta Elam 1,254
english: The children of Elam: one thousand two hundred fifty-four.

hausa: yadda ruwa yakan zaizaye duwatsu ruwa mai ƙarfi kuma yă kwashe turɓayar ƙasa, haka kake barin mutum ba bege.
english: The waters wear the stones. The torrents of it wash away the dust of the earth. So you destroy the hope of man.

hausa: Kamar yadda muka riga muka faɗa, haka yanzu ma ina ƙara cewa in wani yana muku wa’azin wata bishara dabam da wadda kuka karɓa, bari yă zama la’ananne har abada!
english: As we have said before, so I now say again: if any man preaches to you any “good news” other than that which you received, let him be cursed.

hausa: Ba zai tsere wa duhu ba; wuta za tă ƙona rassansa, kuma numfashi daga bakin Allah zai hallaka shi.
english: He will not depart out of darkness. The flame will dry up his branches. He will go away by the breath of God’s mouth.

hausa: Sai Mowabawa suka ce wa dattawan Midiyawa, “Wannan taron zai lashe duk abin da ya kewaye mu kamar yadda saniya takan lashe ciyawa a fili.” Saboda haka Balak ɗan Ziffor, wanda yake sarkin Mowab a lokacin,
english: Moab said to the elders of Midian, “Now this multitude will lick up all that is around us, as the ox licks up the grass of the field.” Balak the son of Zippor was king of Moab at that time.

hausa: Ya yi kowane abu da kyau a lokacinsa. Ya kuma sa matuƙa a zukatan mutane, duk da haka sun kāsa gane abin da Allah ya yi daga farko zuwa ƙarshe.
english: He has made everything beautiful in its time. He has also set eternity in their hearts, yet so that man can’t find out the work that God has done from the beginning even to the end.

hausa: Aka yi umarni a Yahuda da Urushalima cewa ya kamata suka kawo wa Ubangiji harajin da Musa bawan Allah ya bukaci daga Isra’ila a hamada.
english: They made a proclamation through Judah and Jerusalem, to bring in for Yahweh the tax that Moses the servant of God laid on Israel in the wilderness.

hausa: Yabi Ubangiji, dukanku al’umma; ku ɗaukaka shi, dukanku mutane.
english: Praise Yahweh, all you nations! Extol him, all you peoples!

hausa: dukan taron suka yi alkawari da sarki a haikalin Allah. Yehohiyada ya ce musu, “Ɗan sarki zai yi mulki yadda Ubangiji ya yi alkawari game da zuriyar Dawuda.
english: All the assembly made a covenant with the king in God’s house. Jehoiada said to them, “Behold, the king’s son must reign, as Yahweh has spoken concerning the sons of David.

hausa: A ƙarshe yana sara kamar maciji da kuma dafi kamar gamsheƙa.
english: In the end, it bites like a snake, and poisons like a viper.

hausa: Ƙafafuna suna bin ƙafafunsa kurkusa; na bi hanyarsa ba tare da na juya ba.
english: My foot has held fast to his steps. I have kept his way, and not turned away.

hausa: “In ’ya’yansa maza suka yashe dokata ba su kuwa bi ƙa’idodina ba,
english: If his children forsake my law, and don’t walk in my ordinances;

hausa: Ubangiji ya ce wa Musa,
english: Yahweh spoke to Moses, saying,

hausa: Wa zai kawo ni birni mai katanga? Wa zai jagorance ni zuwa Edom?
english: Who will bring me into the fortified city? Who will lead me to Edom?

hausa: Sa’ad da Farisiyawa suka ga haka, sai suka tambayi almajiransa suka ce, “Don me malaminku yake ci tare da masu karɓar haraji, da masu zunubi?”
english: When the Pharisees saw it, they said to his disciples, “Why does your teacher eat with tax collectors and sinners?”

hausa: Ƙirjinta yana da ƙarfi kamar dutse, da ƙarfi kamar dutsen niƙa.
english: His heart is as firm as a stone, yes, firm as the lower millstone.

hausa: Bari hamada da garuruwanta su tā da muryoyinsu; bari wuraren zaman da Kedar ke zama su yi farin ciki. Bari mutanen Sela su rera don farin ciki; bari su yi sowa daga ƙwanƙolin duwatsu.
english: Let the wilderness and its cities raise their voices, with the villages that Kedar inhabits. Let the inhabitants of Sela sing. Let them shout from the top of the mountains!

hausa: Ta haka za a shirya abinci don hadayar da aka yi da wuta, kowace rana, har kwana bakwai don daɗin ƙanshi ga Ubangiji; a shirya shi haɗe da hadaya ta ƙonawa ta kullum, da kuma hadaya ta sha.
english: In this way you shall offer daily, for seven days, the food of the offering made by fire, of a pleasant aroma to Yahweh. It shall be offered in addition to the continual burnt offering and its drink offering.

hausa: Bayan mutanen suka tafi, sai su biyun suka fito daga rijiyar suka je suka gaya wa Sarki Dawuda. Suka ce masa, “Maza ka ƙetare kogi; Ahitofel ya ba wa Absalom shawara a yi maka kaza da kaza.”
english: After they had departed, they came up out of the well and went and told King David; and they said to David, “Arise and pass quickly over the water; for thus has Ahithophel counseled against you.”

hausa: Sa’ad da surukinsa ya lura da duk abin da Musa yake yi saboda mutane, sai ya ce, “Mene ne wannan da kake yi wa mutane? Don me kai kaɗai kake zama kana yin shari’a wa mutane, yayinda mutanen nan suke tsaya kewaye da kai daga safe har yamma?”
english: When Moses’ father-in-law saw all that he did to the people, he said, “What is this thing that you do for the people? Why do you sit alone, and all the people stand around you from morning to evening?”

hausa: “Duba, zan aika macizai masu dafi a cikinku, kāsā, waɗanda ba su da maƙari, za su kuwa sassare ku,” in ji Ubangiji.
english: “For, behold, I will send serpents, adders among you, which will not be charmed; and they will bite you,” says Yahweh.

hausa: Ku zama masu hikima a yadda kuke ma’amala da waɗanda suke ba masu bi ba; ku kuma yi amfani da kowane zarafi.
english: Walk in wisdom toward those who are outside, redeeming the time.

hausa: Shi ya sa aka ce, “Sa’ad da ya hau sama, ya bi da kamammu kamar tawagarsa ya kuma ba da baye-baye ga mutane.”
english: Therefore he says, “When he ascended on high, he led captivity captive, and gave gifts to people.”

hausa: Me za mu ce ke nan ’yan’uwa? Sa’ad da kuka taru, wani yakan yi waƙa, wani koyarwa, wani wahayi, wani yin magana da wani harshe, wani kuma fassara. Dole ne a yi duka don gina ikkilisiya.
english: What is it then, brothers? When you come together, each one of you has a psalm, has a teaching, has a revelation, has another language, or has an interpretation. Let all things be done to build each other up.

hausa: ƙuna don ƙuna, rauni don rauni, ƙujewa don ƙujewa.
english: burning for burning, wound for wound, and bruise for bruise.

hausa: Amma mene ne aka ce? “Maganar tana kusa da kai; tana cikin bakinka da kuma cikin zuciyarka,” wato, maganar bangaskiyan nan da muke shela.
english: But what does it say? “The word is near you, in your mouth and in your heart;” that is, the word of faith which we preach:

hausa: Biye da waɗannan kuma sai ɓangaren sansanin kabilar Efraim suka biyo bisa ga ƙa’ida da aka yi, aka kuma umarta. Elishama ɗan Ammihud ne shugaba.
english: The standard of the camp of the children of Ephraim set forward according to their armies. Elishama the son of Ammihud was over his army.

hausa: ya kawo kwanon zinariya ɗaya, mai nauyin shekel goma, cike da turaren hayaƙi;
english: one golden ladle of ten shekels, full of incense;

hausa: Duk waɗannan aiki ne na wannan Ruhu guda, yana kuma ba da su ga kowane mutum, yadda yake so.
english: But the one and the same Spirit produces all of these, distributing to each one separately as he desires.

hausa: Suna kurkusa da juna yadda da ƙyar iska take iya wucewa tsakani.
english: One is so near to another, that no air can come between them.

hausa: Saboda haka Shawulu ya tafi Nayiwot a Rama, amma Ruhun Allah ya sauko masa, shi ma ya yi tafiya yana annabci har sai da ya isa Nayiwot.
english: He went there to Naioth in Ramah. Then God’s Spirit came on him also, and he went on, and prophesied, until he came to Naioth in Ramah.

hausa: Sarki da dukan mutanen da suke tare da shi suka isa masauƙinsu a gajiye. A can fa ya huta.
english: The king and all the people who were with him arrived weary; and he refreshed himself there.

hausa: Saboda haka suka cewa mutanen Benyamin, “Ku je ku ɓuya a gonakin inabi
english: They commanded the children of Benjamin, saying, “Go and lie in wait in the vineyards,

hausa: Ki ji kunya, ya ke Sidon, da ke kuma, kagarar teku, gama teku ya yi magana ya ce, “Ban taɓa naƙuda ba balle in haifi ’ya’ya; ban taɓa goyon ’ya’ya maza ba balle in reno ’ya’ya mata.”
english: Be ashamed, Sidon; for the sea has spoken, the stronghold of the sea, saying, “I have not travailed, nor given birth, neither have I nourished young men, nor brought up virgins.”

hausa: Amma Yesu ya kama shi a hannu ya ɗaga, ya kuwa tashi tsaye.
english: But Jesus took him by the hand and raised him up; and he arose.

hausa: Mulkinka madawwamin mulki ne, sarautarka kuma za tă dawwama cikin dukan zamanai. Ubangiji mai aminci ne ga dukan alkawuransa mai ƙauna kuma ga dukan abubuwan da ya yi.
english: Your kingdom is an everlasting kingdom. Your dominion endures throughout all generations. Yahweh is faithful in all his words, and loving in all his deeds.

hausa: Ubangiji yana mulki, bari al’ummai su yi rawan jiki; yana zaune a kursiyi tsakanin kerubobi, bari duniya ta girgiza.
english: Yahweh reigns! Let the peoples tremble. He sits enthroned among the cherubim. Let the earth be moved.

hausa: Sai Yesu ya ce masa, “Siman, ina da abin da zan faɗa maka.” Shi kuwa ya ce, “Malam sai ka faɗa.”
english: Jesus answered him, “Simon, I have something to tell you.” He said, “Teacher, say on.”

hausa: Har yaushe abokan gāba za su yi mana ba’a, ya Allah? Maƙiya za su ci gaba da ɓata sunanka har abada ne?
english: How long, God, shall the adversary reproach? Shall the enemy blaspheme your name forever?

hausa: Gideyon ya efod da zinariyar, wanda ya ajiye a Ofra, garinsa. Dukan Isra’ila suka shiga yin karuwanci ta wurin yin sujada a can, ya kuwa zama wa Gideyon da dukan iyalinsa tarko.
english: Gideon made an ephod out of it, and put it in Ophrah, his city. Then all Israel played the prostitute with it there; and it became a snare to Gideon and to his house.

hausa: Naman da fatar kuwa ya ƙone waje da sansanin.
english: The meat and the skin he burned with fire outside the camp.

hausa: Ya Ubangiji, na ce maka, “Kai ne Allahna.” Ka ji kukata ta neman jinƙai, ya Ubangiji.
english: I said to Yahweh, “You are my God.” Listen to the cry of my petitions, Yahweh.

hausa: “Ko ka taɓa ba safiya umarni ko kuma ka sa asuba ta fito,
english: “Have you commanded the morning in your days, and caused the dawn to know its place,

hausa: Ga Rebeka, ɗauke ta ku tafi, bari tă zama matar ɗan maigidanka, yadda Ubangiji ya umarta.”
english: Behold, Rebekah is before you. Take her, and go, and let her be your master’s son’s wife, as Yahweh has spoken.”

hausa: Yi wa Ubangiji sujada da murna; ku zo gabansa da waƙoƙin farin ciki.
english: Serve Yahweh with gladness. Come before his presence with singing.

hausa: Bereyawa kuwa sun fi Tessalonikawa hankali, gama sun karɓi saƙon da marmari ƙwarai, suka kuma yi ta yin bincike Nassosi kowace rana su ga ko abin da Bulus ya faɗa gaskiya ne.
english: Now these were more noble than those in Thessalonica, in that they received the word with all readiness of mind, examining the Scriptures daily to see whether these things were so.

hausa: za su tallafe ka da hannuwansu, don kada ka buga ƙafarka a kan dutse.
english: They will bear you up in their hands, so that you won’t dash your foot against a stone.

hausa: Dare fa ya kusan ƙarewa; gari kuma yana gab da wayewa. Saboda haka bari mu kawar da ayyukan duhu mu kuma yafa kayan yaƙi na haske.
english: The night is far gone, and the day is near. Let’s therefore throw off the deeds of darkness, and let’s put on the armor of light.

hausa: Oholibama, Ela, Finon
english: chief Oholibamah, chief Elah, chief Pinon,

hausa: Dukan kayayyakin zinariya da na azurfa sun kai 5,400. Sheshbazzar ya kawo kayayyakin nan duka tare da shi lokacin da kamammun suka hauro daga Babilon zuwa Urushalima.
english: All the vessels of gold and of silver were five thousand four hundred. Sheshbazzar brought all these up when the captives were brought up from Babylon to Jerusalem.

hausa: Aka ƙone su da zafin wuta mai tsanani suka kuwa la’anci sunan Allah wanda yake da iko a kan waɗannan annoban, amma suka ƙi su tuba su kuma ɗaukaka shi.
english: People were scorched with great heat, and people blasphemed the name of God who has the power over these plagues. They didn’t repent and give him glory.

hausa: Ubangiji ya ce wa Yoshuwa, “Ka tashi! Me kake yi kwance rubda ciki?
english: Yahweh said to Joshua, “Get up! Why have you fallen on your face like that?

hausa: An gudu an bar manyan hanyoyi, babu matafiye a kan hanyoyi. Aka keta yarjejjeniya, an rena shaidunsa ba a kuwa ganin girman kowa.
english: The highways are desolate. The traveling man ceases. The covenant is broken. He has despised the cities. He doesn’t respect man.

hausa: Fir’auna ya ce, “Ku ragwaye ne! Shi ya sa kuke cewa, ‘Bari mu tafi mu yi hadaya wa Ubangiji.’
english: But Pharaoh said, “You are idle! You are idle! Therefore you say, ‘Let’s go and sacrifice to Yahweh.’

hausa: Ya ga sama ya buɗe ana kuwa saukowa wani abu ƙasa kamar babban mayafi zuwa duniya ta kusurwansa huɗu.
english: He saw heaven opened and a certain container descending to him, like a great sheet let down by four corners on the earth,

hausa: Sai mutumin Allah ya yi fushi da shi ya ce, “Da a ce ka caki ƙasar sau biyar ko shida; da za ka yi nasara a kan Aram ka kuma hallaka ta sarai. Amma yanzu za ka yi nasara a kanta sau uku ne kawai.”
english: The man of God was angry with him, and said, “You should have struck five or six times. Then you would have struck Syria until you had consumed it, but now you will strike Syria just three times.”

hausa: Ka kasa kunne gare ni yanzu, zan ba ka shawara, Allah kuma yă kasance tare da kai. Kai za ka zama wakilin mutane a gaban Allah, ka kuma kawo gardamansu gare shi.
english: Listen now to my voice. I will give you counsel, and God be with you. You represent the people before God, and bring the causes to God.

hausa: Ya Ubangiji, shugabanmu, sunanka da girma take a cikin dukan duniya!
english: Yahweh, our Lord, how majestic is your name in all the earth!

hausa: ’Ya’yansu biyu maza, Ahimawaz ɗan Zadok, da kuma Yonatan ɗan Abiyatar, suna can tare da su. Ka aike su wurina da duk abin da ka ji.”
english: Behold, they have there with them their two sons, Ahimaaz, Zadok’s son, and Jonathan, Abiathar’s son. Send to me everything that you shall hear by them.”

hausa: Na zama ɗan’uwan diloli, na zama abokan mujiyoyi.
english: I am a brother to jackals, and a companion to ostriches.

hausa: Amma sarki ya ɗauki Armoni da Mefiboshet, ’ya’ya biyu maza waɗanda Rizfa ’yar Aiya ta haifa wa Shawulu, tare da ’ya’ya maza biyar na Merab ’yar Shawulu, waɗanda ta haifa wa Adriyel ɗan Barzillai, mutumin Mehola.
english: But the king took the two sons of Rizpah the daughter of Aiah, whom she bore to Saul, Armoni and Mephibosheth; and the five sons of Merab the daughter of Saul, whom she bore to Adriel the son of Barzillai the Meholathite.

hausa: Zan kawo takobi a kanku don in yi ramuwa saboda karya alkawarin da kuka yi. Sa’ad da kuka janye zuwa cikin biranenku, zan aika da annoba a cikinku, za a kuwa ba da ku ga hannun abokan gāba.
english: I will bring a sword upon you that will execute the vengeance of the covenant. You will be gathered together within your cities, and I will send the pestilence among you. You will be delivered into the hand of the enemy.

hausa: Za ka zama kamar wanda yake barci a tsakiyar tekuna, kwance a sama itacen jirgin ruwa.
english: Yes, you will be as he who lies down in the middle of the sea, or as he who lies on top of the rigging:

hausa: “ ‘A wancan lokaci, in ji Ubangiji, za a fitar da ƙasusuwan sarakuna da na shugabannin Yahuda, ƙasusuwan firistoci da na annabawa, da kuma ƙasusuwan mutanen Urushalima daga kaburbura.
english: “At that time,” says Yahweh, “they will bring the bones of the kings of Judah, the bones of his princes, the bones of the priests, the bones of the prophets, and the bones of the inhabitants of Jerusalem, out of their graves.

hausa: “ ‘Duk wani mutumin Isra’ila ko baƙon da yake zama a cikinku wanda ya ji wa wani dabba ko tsuntsu wanda ake ci ciwo, dole yă tsiyaye jinin yă rufe shi da ƙasa,
english: “‘Whatever man there is of the children of Israel, or of the strangers who live as foreigners among them, who takes in hunting any animal or bird that may be eaten, he shall pour out its blood, and cover it with dust.

hausa: Faɗa mini, kai da nake ƙauna, ina kake kiwon garkenka kuma ina kake kai tumakinka su huta da tsakar rana. Me ya sa zan kasance kamar macen da aka lulluɓe kusa da garkunan abokanka?
english: Tell me, you whom my soul loves, where you graze your flock, where you rest them at noon; for why should I be as one who is veiled beside the flocks of your companions?

hausa: wanda yake ba da rance ba tare da ruwa ba kuma ba ya karɓan cin hanci don yă kā da marar laifi. Shi wanda yake yin waɗannan abubuwa ba zai taɓa jijjiguwa ba.
english: he who doesn’t lend out his money for usury, nor take a bribe against the innocent. He who does these things shall never be shaken.

hausa: Ba ku zo ga Dutsen Sinai wanda ana iya taɓawa ba, ko ga wuta mai ci sosai, ko ga duhu baƙi ƙirin, ko
english: For you have not come to a mountain that might be touched and that burned with fire, and to blackness, darkness, storm,

hausa: in ta ce, “Ka sha, zan kuma ba wa raƙumanka ma,” bari tă zama wadda Ubangiji ya zaɓar wa ɗan maigidana.’
english: then she tells me, “Drink, and I will also draw for your camels,”—let her be the woman whom Yahweh has appointed for my master’s son.’

hausa: Cewa in ka furta da bakinka, “Yesu Ubangiji ne,” ka kuma gaskata a zuciyarka cewa Allah ya tā da shi daga matattu, za ka sami ceto.
english: that if you will confess with your mouth that Jesus is Lord and believe in your heart that God raised him from the dead, you will be saved.

hausa: Da Yehu ya isa Samariya, sai ya karkashe dukan sauran iyalin Ahab, ya hallaka su, bisa ga maganar da Ubangiji ya faɗa ta bakin Iliya.
english: When he came to Samaria, he struck all who remained to Ahab in Samaria, until he had destroyed them, according to Yahweh’s word which he spoke to Elijah.

hausa: Sa’an nan na dubi sama a gabana kuwa sai ga ƙahoni huɗu!
english: I lifted up my eyes and saw, and behold, four horns.

hausa: Za ka cika da kunya a maimakon ɗaukaka. Yanzu lokacinka ne! Kai ma ka sha, a kuma tone asirinka! Gama kwaf na hannun daman Ubangiji yana zuwa kewaye da kai, abin kunya kuma zai rufe darajarka.
english: You are filled with shame, and not glory. You will also drink and be exposed! The cup of Yahweh’s right hand will come around to you, and disgrace will cover your glory.

hausa: Sa’an nan Yaƙub ya yi alkawari cewa, “In Allah zai kasance tare da ni yă kuma lura da ni a wannan tafiya, yă kuma ba ni abinci in ci da tufafi in sa,
english: Jacob vowed a vow, saying, “If God will be with me, and will keep me in this way that I go, and will give me bread to eat, and clothing to put on,

hausa: Cikin shekaru biyu zan komo da dukan kayayyakin gidan Ubangiji da Nebukadnezzar sarkin Babilon ya kwashe daga wannan wuri ya kai Babilon.
english: Within two full years I will bring again into this place all the vessels of Yahweh’s house that Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon took away from this place and carried to Babylon.

hausa: Game da sauran ayyukan mulkin Yerobowam, da dukan abin da ya yi, da yaƙe-yaƙen da ya yi, haɗe da sāke ƙwato wa Isra’ila Damaskus da Hamat waɗanda suke a hannun Yahuda, duk a rubuce suke a cikin littafin tarihin sarakunan Isra’ila.
english: Now the rest of the acts of Jeroboam, and all that he did, and his might, how he fought, and how he recovered Damascus, and Hamath, which had belonged to Judah, for Israel, aren’t they written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel?

hausa: Na biyun ya auri gwauruwar, sai shi ma ya mutu, babu ’ya’ya. Haka kuma na ukun.
english: The second took her, and died, leaving no children behind him. The third likewise;

hausa: Saboda dukan abokan gābana, Na zama tamƙar abin reni na maƙwabtana; na zama abin tsoro ga abokaina, waɗanda suka gan ni a titi sukan gudu daga gare ni.
english: Because of all my adversaries I have become utterly contemptible to my neighbors, a horror to my acquaintances. Those who saw me on the street fled from me.

hausa: Saboda haka Allah zai aiko musu da babban ruɗu don su gaskata ƙarya
english: Because of this, God sends them a powerful delusion, that they should believe a lie,

hausa: ’Ya’yana maza, kada ku yi sakaci yanzu, gama Ubangiji ya zaɓe ku don ku tsaya a gabansa ku kuma yi masa hidima, don ku yi hidima a gabansa ku kuma ƙone turare.”
english: My sons, don’t be negligent now; for Yahweh has chosen you to stand before him, to minister to him, and that you should be his ministers and burn incense.”

hausa: Sai na ga abin da ya yi kamar tekun gilashi gauraye da wuta kuma tsaye kusa da teku, waɗanda suka ci nasara bisan dabbar da siffarta da bisan lambar sunanta. Suna riƙe da garayu waɗanda Allah ya ba su
english: I saw something like a sea of glass mixed with fire, and those who overcame the beast, his image, and the number of his name, standing on the sea of glass, having harps of God.

hausa: Sa’an nan dukan Isra’ila za su ji su kuma tsorata, babu kuma wani a cikinku da zai ƙara yin irin wannan mugun abu.
english: All Israel shall hear, and fear, and shall not do any more wickedness like this among you.

hausa: Kakanninku ba su yi aminci ba; suka aikata abin da yake mugu a gaban Ubangiji Allahnmu, suka kuma yashe shi. Suka juya fuskokinsu daga mazaunin Ubangiji suka kuma juya masa baya.
english: For our fathers were unfaithful, and have done that which was evil in Yahweh our God’s sight, and have forsaken him, and have turned away their faces from the habitation of Yahweh, and turned their backs.

hausa: Gama a cikin tafiyarsu duka, girgijen Ubangiji yana kan tabanakul da rana, da dare kuwa wuta yake cikinsa domin dukan Isra’ilawa su gani.
english: For the cloud of Yahweh was on the tabernacle by day, and there was fire in the cloud by night, in the sight of all the house of Israel, throughout all their journeys.

hausa: Domin mun san cewa shi da ya tā da Ubangiji Yesu daga matattu, zai tashe mu mu ma tare da Kiristi, yă kuma miƙa mu a gabansa tare da ku.
english: knowing that he who raised the Lord Jesus will raise us also through Jesus, and will present us with you.

hausa: Shaiɗan kuwa ya shiga Yahuda, wanda ake kira Iskariyot, ɗaya daga cikin Sha Biyun.
english: Satan entered into Judas, who was also called Iscariot, who was counted with the twelve.

hausa: (Yaron kuwa bai san kome game da wannan abu ba, sai Yonatan da Dawuda kawai.)
english: But the boy didn’t know anything. Only Jonathan and David knew the matter.

hausa: Ango ne mai amarya. Abokin da yake masa hidima yakan jira ya kuma saurara masa, yakan kuma cika da farin ciki sa’ad da ya ji muryar ango. Wannan farin cikin kuwa nawa ne, ya kuma cika a yanzu.
english: He who has the bride is the bridegroom; but the friend of the bridegroom, who stands and hears him, rejoices greatly because of the bridegroom’s voice. Therefore my joy is made full.

hausa: Sai Yoshuwa ya sa musu albarka, ya sallame su, suka kuwa tafi gidajensu.
english: So Joshua blessed them, and sent them away; and they went to their tents.

hausa: Kowace rana zan yabe ka in kuma ɗaukaka sunanka har abada abadin.
english: Every day I will praise you. I will extol your name forever and ever.

hausa: don ku iya rarrabe abin da yake mafi kyau, ku kuma zama da tsarki, marasa aibi har yă zuwa ranar Kiristi,
english: so that you may approve the things that are excellent, that you may be sincere and without offense to the day of Christ,

hausa: A ƙarshe, ta sami zarafi. A ranar murnar haihuwar Hiridus, ya yi biki domin hakimansa, da shugabannin sojojinsa, da kuma manyan mutanen Galili.
english: Then a convenient day came when Herod on his birthday made a supper for his nobles, the high officers, and the chief men of Galilee.

hausa: Sai dukan majalisa suka tashi, suka kai shi gaban Bilatus.
english: The whole company of them rose up and brought him before Pilate.

hausa: za mu sami dukiya masu daraja iri-iri, mu kuma cika gidajenmu da ganima;
english: We’ll find all valuable wealth. We’ll fill our houses with plunder.

hausa: Saboda haka mutanen Yowab da Keretawa da Feletiyawa da dukan jarumawa suka fita a ƙarƙashin Abishai. Suka fita daga Urushalima don su fafari Sheba ɗan Bikri.
english: Joab’s men went out after him with the Cherethites, the Pelethites, and all the mighty men; and they went out of Jerusalem to pursue Sheba the son of Bichri.

hausa: Da al’umma gaba ɗaya suka ƙetare Urdun, Ubangiji ya ce wa Yoshuwa,
english: When all the nation had completely crossed over the Jordan, Yahweh spoke to Joshua, saying,

hausa: bari su sha su manta da talaucinsu kada kuma su ƙara tunawa da ɓacin ransu.
english: Let him drink, and forget his poverty, and remember his misery no more.

hausa: Sarki zai kasance a cikinsu, zai shiga sa’ad da suke shiga ya kuma fita sa’ad da suka fita.
english: The prince shall go in with them when they go in. When they go out, he shall go out.

hausa: Tsawon kowane ɗakin matsara kamu shida ne, fāɗinsa kuma kamu shida, kaurin bangayen da suka raba ɗaki da ɗaki kamu biyar ne. Zurfin madogarar ƙofar da yake dab da shirayin da yake fuskantar haikalin kamu shida ne.
english: Every lodge was one reed long and one reed wide. Between the lodges was five cubits. The threshold of the gate by the porch of the gate toward the house was one reed.

hausa: Amaziya yana da shekara ashirin da biyar sa’ad da ya zama sarki, ya kuma yi mulki a Urushalima shekara ashirin da tara. Sunan mahaifiyarsa Yehoyaddin ce; ita daga Urushalima ne.
english: Amaziah was twenty-five years old when he began to reign, and he reigned twenty-nine years in Jerusalem. His mother’s name was Jehoaddan, of Jerusalem.

hausa: Shi kansa ba shi ne hasken ba; sai dai ya zo a matsayin shaida ne kaɗai ga hasken.
english: He was not the light, but was sent that he might testify about the light.

hausa: Ba ka ma bari in sumbaci jikokina da ’ya’yana mata in yi musu bankwana ba. Ka yi wauta.
english: and didn’t allow me to kiss my sons and my daughters? Now you have done foolishly.

hausa: da kuma dukan ƙauyukan da suke kewaye da garuruwan nan har zuwa Rama na Negeb (wato, Ba’alat-Beyer). Wannan shi ne gādon kabilar Simeyon bisa ga iyalansu.
english: and all the villages that were around these cities to Baalath Beer, Ramah of the South. This is the inheritance of the tribe of the children of Simeon according to their families.

hausa: Sa’an nan Ishaku ya sallami Yaƙub, ya kuwa tafi Faddan Aram, zuwa wurin Laban ɗan Betuwel mutumin Aram. Laban ne ɗan’uwan Rebeka, wadda take mahaifiyar Yaƙub da Isuwa.
english: Isaac sent Jacob away. He went to Paddan Aram to Laban, son of Bethuel the Syrian, the brother of Rebekah, Jacob’s and Esau’s mother.

hausa: Sai mutanen suka rabu saboda Yesu.
english: So a division arose in the multitude because of him.

hausa: Musa ya amsa ya ce, “In ba su gaskata ni ba, suka kuma ce, ‘Ubangiji bai bayyana gare ka ba fa’?”
english: Moses answered, “But, behold, they will not believe me, nor listen to my voice; for they will say, ‘Yahweh has not appeared to you.’”

hausa: zan yi gāba da wannan mutum da iyalinsa, zan raba shi da kuma duk waɗanda suka bi shi cikin karuwanci ga Molek daga mutanensu.
english: then I will set my face against that man and against his family, and will cut him off, and all who play the prostitute after him to play the prostitute with Molech, from among their people.

hausa: Kaitonki, ya Mowab! Mutanen Kemosh sun hallaka; an kai ’ya’yanki maza daurin talala ’ya’yanki mata zaman bauta.
english: Woe to you, O Moab! The people of Chemosh are undone; for your sons are taken away captive, and your daughters into captivity.

hausa: ba zan ƙara kori wata al’ummar da Yoshuwa ya bari sa’ad da ya rasu ba.
english: I also will no longer drive out any of the nations that Joshua left when he died from before them;

hausa: Gama wannan shi ne lokacin hukunci, saboda a cika duk abin da aka rubuta.
english: For these are days of vengeance, that all things which are written may be fulfilled.

hausa: Ku tabbata kun kiyaye umarnan Ubangiji Allahnku, da farillansa da kuma ƙa’idodinsa da ya ba ku.
english: You shall diligently keep the commandments of Yahweh your God, and his testimonies, and his statutes, which he has commanded you.

hausa: Waɗanda suka haɗa bakin kuwa su ne Zabad ɗan Shimeyat wata mutuniyar Ammon da Yehozabad ɗan Shimrit wata mutuniyar Mowab.
english: These are those who conspired against him: Zabad the son of Shimeath the Ammonitess and Jehozabad the son of Shimrith the Moabitess.

hausa: Wane ne makaho in ba bawana ba, da kuma kurma in ba ɗan aikan da na aika ba? Wane ne makaho kamar wanda ya miƙa kai gare ni, makaho kamar bawan Ubangiji?
english: Who is blind, but my servant? Or who is as deaf as my messenger whom I send? Who is as blind as he who is at peace, and as blind as Yahweh’s servant?

hausa: Waɗansu Yahudawa masu yawo gari-gari suna fitar da mugayen ruhohi suka yi ƙoƙari su yi amfani da sunan Ubangiji Yesu a kan waɗanda suke da aljanu. Suna cewa, “A cikin sunan Yesu wanda Bulus yake wa’azi, na umarce ku, ku fito.”
english: But some of the itinerant Jews, exorcists, took on themselves to invoke over those who had the evil spirits the name of the Lord Jesus, saying, “We adjure you by Jesus whom Paul preaches.”

hausa: Domin ya lura da dukan laifofin da ya yi ya kuma juye daga gare su, tabbatacce zai rayu; ba zai mutu ba.
english: Because he considers, and turns away from all his transgressions that he has committed, he shall surely live. He shall not die.

hausa: Saboda haka kada ku aurar musu da ’yan matanku, kada kuma ku auro wa ’ya’yanku maza ’yan matansu. Kada ku yi wata yarjejjeniya ta abokantaka da su. Idan kun yi biyayya za ku yi ƙarfi, ku kuma ci albarkar ƙasar, har ku bar wa ’ya’yanku gādo na har abada.’
english: Now therefore don’t give your daughters to their sons. Don’t take their daughters to your sons, nor seek their peace or their prosperity forever, that you may be strong and eat the good of the land, and leave it for an inheritance to your children forever.’

hausa: Saboda haka ya kamata mu nuna halin karɓan baƙi ga irin mutanen nan domin mu yi aiki tare saboda gaskiyan nan.
english: We therefore ought to receive such, that we may be fellow workers for the truth.

hausa: Amma ba su saurare ni ba, ba su kula ba. Sai suka taurare zukatansu suka aikata mugun abu fiye da na kakanninsu.’
english: Yet they didn’t listen to me or incline their ear, but made their neck stiff. They did worse than their fathers.

hausa: Da umarnin Ubangiji, Isra’ilawa suke tashi. Da umarninsa kuma suke sauka. Muddin girgijen yana tsaye a bisa tabanakul, sukan yi ta zamansu a sansanoni.
english: At the commandment of Yahweh, the children of Israel traveled, and at the commandment of Yahweh they encamped. As long as the cloud remained on the tabernacle they remained encamped.

hausa: Gama Allah ɗaya ne, matsakanci kuma ɗaya tsakanin Allah da mutane, shi ne kuwa Kiristi Yesu,
english: For there is one God and one mediator between God and men, the man Christ Jesus,

hausa: Ga abin da Ubangiji ya ce, “Zan koma Sihiyona in zauna a Urushalima. Sa’an nan za a kira Urushalima Birnin Gaskiya, a kuma kira dutsen Ubangiji Maɗaukaki Dutse Mai Tsarki.”
english: Yahweh says: “I have returned to Zion, and will dwell in the middle of Jerusalem. Jerusalem shall be called ‘The City of Truth;’ and the mountain of Yahweh of Armies, ‘The Holy Mountain.’”

hausa: Kashegari, da na farka don in shayar da ɗana, sai na tarar ya mutu! Amma sa’ad da na dube shi da kyau da safe, sai na ga ashe ba ɗan da na haifa ba ne.”
english: When I rose in the morning to nurse my child, behold, he was dead; but when I had looked at him in the morning, behold, it was not my son whom I bore.”

hausa: A rana ta biyu, Netanel ɗan Zuwar, shugaban mutanen Issakar, ya kawo hadayarsa.
english: On the second day Nethanel the son of Zuar, prince of Issachar, gave his offering.

hausa: Maganar wawa kan kawo sanda a bayansa, amma leɓunan masu hikima kan tsare su.
english: The fool’s talk brings a rod to his back, but the lips of the wise protect them.

hausa: Yana kama da ƙwayar mustad, wadda ita ce ƙwaya mafi ƙanƙanta da akan shuka a gona.
english: It’s like a grain of mustard seed, which, when it is sown in the earth, though it is less than all the seeds that are on the earth,

hausa: Sau ɗaya ko biyu, ’yan kasuwa da masu sayar da kowane irin kaya suka kwana waje da Urushalima.
english: So the merchants and sellers of all kinds of wares camped outside of Jerusalem once or twice.

hausa: Dukan masu hidimar da suke a ƙofar sarki suka riƙa durƙusa suna ba wa Haman girma, gama sarki ya ba da umarni a yi masa haka. Amma Mordekai bai durƙusa ya ba shi girma ba.
english: All the king’s servants who were in the king’s gate bowed down and paid homage to Haman, for the king had so commanded concerning him. But Mordecai didn’t bow down or pay him homage.

hausa: Sun san ni tun da daɗewa za su kuwa shaida, in suna so, cewa bisa ga ɗarikar addininmu mafi tsanani, na yi rayuwar Bafarisiye ne.
english: having known me from the first, if they are willing to testify, that after the strictest sect of our religion I lived a Pharisee.

hausa: Da membobin Sanhedrin suka ji haka, sai suka yi fushi suka ciji haƙoransu.
english: Now when they heard these things, they were cut to the heart, and they gnashed at him with their teeth.

hausa: ya roƙe shi da gaske ya ce, “Ƙaramar diyata tana bakin mutuwa. In ka yarda, ka zo ka ɗibiya hannunka a kanta, domin ta warke, ta kuma rayu.”
english: and begged him much, saying, “My little daughter is at the point of death. Please come and lay your hands on her, that she may be made healthy, and live.”

hausa: Mattitiya, Elifelehu, Miknehiya, Obed-Edom, Yehiyel da Azaziya, ne za su ja garayu masu murya ƙasa-ƙasa bisa ga sheminit.
english: and Mattithiah, Eliphelehu, Mikneiah, Obed-Edom, Jeiel, and Azaziah, with harps tuned to the eight-stringed lyre, to lead.

hausa: Sa’an nan Yaƙub ya sumbaci Rahila, ya kuma ɗaga murya ya yi kuka.
english: Jacob kissed Rachel, and lifted up his voice, and wept.

hausa: Ta haka Ruhu Mai Tsarki ya nuna cewa ba a riga an bayyana hanyar shiga Wuri Mafi Tsarki ba tukuna, muddin tabanakul na fari yana nan tsaye.
english: The Holy Spirit is indicating this, that the way into the Holy Place wasn’t yet revealed while the first tabernacle was still standing.

hausa: (Almajiransa kuwa sun shiga gari don sayi abinci.)
english: For his disciples had gone away into the city to buy food.

hausa: Kamar tsuntsaye masu shawagi a sama haka Ubangiji Maɗaukaki zai kiyaye Urushalima; zai kāre ta ya kuma fanshe ta, zai ‘ƙetare’ ta ya kuma kuɓutar da ita.”
english: As birds hovering, so Yahweh of Armies will protect Jerusalem. He will protect and deliver it. He will pass over and preserve it.”

hausa: Ta haka maganar Ubangiji ta bazu ko’ina ta kuma yi ƙarfi.
english: So the word of the Lord was growing and becoming mighty.

hausa: “Shi ya sa muka ce, ‘Bari mu yi shiri mu gina bagade, amma ba na ƙona hadayu ko na sadaka ba.’
english: “Therefore we said, ‘Let’s now prepare to build ourselves an altar, not for burnt offering, nor for sacrifice;

hausa: Ya bar Nazaret, ya je ya zauna a Kafarnahum, wadda take a bakin tafki wajen Zebulun da Naftali
english: Leaving Nazareth, he came and lived in Capernaum, which is by the sea, in the region of Zebulun and Naphtali,

hausa: Ashe, so muke mu tsokani Ubangiji ya yi kishi? Mun fi shi ƙarfi ne?
english: Or do we provoke the Lord to jealousy? Are we stronger than he?

hausa: Suka ce, “Waɗannan mutane ba su da damuwa, bari su zauna a cikin ƙasarmu, su kuma yi sana’a a ciki; ƙasar tana da isashen fili dominsu. Za mu iya auro ’ya’yansu mata, su kuma su auri namu.
english: “These men are peaceful with us. Therefore let them live in the land and trade in it. For behold, the land is large enough for them. Let’s take their daughters to us for wives, and let’s give them our daughters.

hausa: A can zan mayar mata da gonakin inabinta, zan kuma sa Kwarin Akor yă zama ƙofar bege. A can za tă rera kamar a kwanakin ƙuruciyarta, kamar a lokacin da ta fita daga Masar.
english: I will give her vineyards from there, and the valley of Achor for a door of hope; and she will respond there as in the days of her youth, and as in the day when she came up out of the land of Egypt.

hausa: Kada ku sa zuciyarku a kan abin da za ku ci, ko abin da za ku sha, kada ku damu a kan su.
english: “Don’t seek what you will eat or what you will drink; neither be anxious.

hausa: Ba za ku miƙa wa Ubangiji dabbar da lunsayinta yake da ƙujewa, ko dandaƙewa, ko yagewa, ko yankewa ba.
english: You must not offer to Yahweh that which has its testicles bruised, crushed, broken, or cut. You must not do this in your land.

hausa: Gama lokaci yana zuwa da mutane ba za su jure da sahihiyar koyarwa ba. A maimako, don cimma burinsu, za su taro wa kansu malamai masu yawa, domin su faɗi abin da kunnuwansu masu ƙaiƙayi suke so su ji.
english: For the time will come when they will not listen to the sound doctrine, but having itching ears, will heap up for themselves teachers after their own lusts,

hausa: An tunashe ni da sahihiyar bangaskiyarka, wadda a farko ta kasance a cikin kakarka Loyis da kuma mahaifiyarka Yunis yanzu kuwa na tabbata tana cikinka.
english: having been reminded of the sincere faith that is in you, which lived first in your grandmother Lois and your mother Eunice and, I am persuaded, in you also.

hausa: Firist zai miƙa su a gaban Ubangiji don yă yi kafara dominta, sa’an nan tă tsabtacce daga zub da jininta. “ ‘Waɗannan su ne ƙa’idodi domin macen da ta haifi ɗa namiji ko ’ya ta mace.
english: He shall offer it before Yahweh, and make atonement for her; then she shall be cleansed from the fountain of her blood. “‘This is the law for her who bears, whether a male or a female.

hausa: Bari mugunta ta shaƙe masu magana marar kyau a kaina; cikin amincinka ka hallaka su.
english: He will repay the evil to my enemies. Destroy them in your truth.

hausa: Ya ba wa Gershonawa, kekunan yaƙi biyu da shanu huɗu bisa ga aikinsu,
english: He gave two wagons and four oxen to the sons of Gershon, according to their service.

hausa: “Ya sarki, Allah Mafi Ɗaukaka ya ba mahaifinka Nebukadnezzar sarauta, da girma, da ɗaukaka, da martaba.
english: “To you, king, the Most High God gave Nebuchadnezzar your father the kingdom, and greatness, and glory, and majesty.

hausa: Ba za su taɓa jin yunwa ko ƙishi ba, ba kuwa zafin hamada ko rana ta buge su ba. Shi da ya yi musu jinƙai zai jagorance su ya kuma bishe su kusa da maɓulɓulan ruwa.
english: They shall not hunger nor thirst; neither shall the heat nor sun strike them, for he who has mercy on them will lead them. He will guide them by springs of water.

hausa: Saboda haka Allah ya sāke sa wata rana, yana kiranta Yau, bayan wani dogon lokaci Allah ya yi magana ta bakin Dawuda, yadda aka riga aka faɗa, “Yau, in kuka ji muryarsa, kada ku taurare zukatanku.”
english: he again defines a certain day, “today”, saying through David so long a time afterward (just as has been said), “Today if you will hear his voice, don’t harden your hearts.”

hausa: “Waɗanda ba su da Allah a zuciyarsu su ne suke riƙe fushi; ko sa’ad da ya ba su horo, ba su neman taimakonsa.
english: “But those who are godless in heart lay up anger. They don’t cry for help when he binds them.

hausa: Kin rena abubuwana masu tsarki kika kuma ƙazantar da Asabbataina.
english: You have despised my holy things, and have profaned my Sabbaths.

hausa: Domin in kuna ƙaruwa a waɗannan halaye, za su kāre ku daga rashin tasiri da rayuwa na rashin amfani cikin saninku na Ubangijinmu Yesu Kiristi.
english: For if these things are yours and abound, they make you to not be idle or unfruitful in the knowledge of our Lord Jesus Christ.

hausa: “Na rantse da Allah mai rai, wanda ya danne mini gaskiyata, Maɗaukaki, wanda ya sa nake cikin ɗacin rai.
english: “As God lives, who has taken away my right, the Almighty, who has made my soul bitter

hausa: “Ka kuɓutar da ni daga harin mutanena; ka kiyaye ni kamar shugaban al’ummai. Mutanen da ban sansu ba za su kasance a ƙarƙashina,
english: You also have delivered me from the strivings of my people. You have kept me to be the head of the nations. A people whom I have not known will serve me.

hausa: tabbatacce zan tattara su daga dukan ƙasashen da na kore su zuwa cikin fushina da hasalata mai girma; zan komo da su wurin nan in sa su zauna lafiya.
english: “Behold, I will gather them out of all the countries where I have driven them in my anger, and in my wrath, and in great indignation; and I will bring them again to this place. I will cause them to dwell safely.

hausa: A shekara ta arba’in, a rana ta fari ga wata na goma sha ɗaya, Musa ya yi shela ga Isra’ilawa game da dukan abin da Ubangiji ya umarta shi game da su.
english: In the fortieth year, in the eleventh month, on the first day of the month, Moses spoke to the children of Israel according to all that Yahweh had given him in commandment to them,

hausa: “To, ga yadda ya kamata ku yi addu’a. “ ‘Ubanmu wanda yake cikin sama, a tsarkake sunanka,
english: Pray like this: “‘Our Father in heaven, may your name be kept holy.

hausa: Amma Absalom ya nace don sarki yă yarda, saboda haka sarki ya bar Amnon da sauran ’ya’yan sarki maza su tafi tare da shi.
english: But Absalom pressed him, and he let Amnon and all the king’s sons go with him.

hausa: Bai kamata ki bi ta ƙofofin mutanena a ranar bala’insu ba, ko ki rena su a cikin masifarsu a ranar bala’insu, ko ki ƙwace dukiyarsu a ranar bala’insu ba.
english: Don’t enter into the gate of my people in the day of their calamity. Don’t look down on their affliction in the day of their calamity, neither seize their wealth on the day of their calamity.

hausa: Sa’ad da suka gan shi, sai suka baza maganar da aka gaya musu game da yaron,
english: When they saw it, they publicized widely the saying which was spoken to them about this child.

hausa: Ba a yi wa bawa gyara ta wurin magana kawai; ko da ya fahimta ma, ba zai kula ba.
english: A servant can’t be corrected by words. Though he understands, yet he will not respond.

hausa: Daga hadaya ta zumuncin da zai kawo, sai a miƙa waɗannan hadayu na ƙonawa ga Ubangiji a wuta; wato, dukan kitsen da ya rufe kayan ciki ko kuwa da sun shafe su,
english: He shall offer of the sacrifice of peace offerings an offering made by fire to Yahweh. The fat that covers the innards, and all the fat that is on the innards,

hausa: Ka bar wani ya yabe ka, ba kai kanka ba; wani dabam, ba leɓunanka ba.
english: Let another man praise you, and not your own mouth; a stranger, and not your own lips.

hausa: Ahitub mahaifin Zadok, Zadok mahaifin Shallum,
english: Ahitub became the father of Zadok. Zadok became the father of Shallum.

hausa: Sai dukan mutanen Yahuda suka ɗauki Uzziya wanda yake da shekara goma sha shida da haihuwa, suka naɗa shi sarki a madadin mahaifinsa Amaziya.
english: All the people of Judah took Uzziah, who was sixteen years old, and made him king in the place of his father Amaziah.

hausa: inda “ ‘tsutsotsinsu ba sa mutuwa, wutar kuma ba a iya kashewa.’
english: ‘where their worm doesn’t die, and the fire is not quenched.’

hausa: Ma’aunai da magwajin gaskiya daga Ubangiji ne; dukan ma’aunai da suke cikin jaka yinsa ne.
english: Honest balances and scales are Yahweh’s; all the weights in the bag are his work.

hausa: Duk wanda ya gaskata da Ɗan Allah, yana da shaidan nan a zuciyarsa. Duk wanda bai gaskata da Allah ba kuwa ya mai da shi maƙaryaci, domin bai gaskata shaidar da Allah ya bayar game da Ɗansa ba.
english: He who believes in the Son of God has the testimony in himself. He who doesn’t believe God has made him a liar, because he has not believed in the testimony that God has given concerning his Son.

hausa: Za su ci abubuwan nan da aka yi kafara da su a lokacin tsarkakewarsu da keɓewarsu. Ba wanda zai ci, sai su kaɗai, gama abubuwan nan tsarkaka ne.
english: They shall eat those things with which atonement was made, to consecrate and sanctify them; but a stranger shall not eat of it, because they are holy.

hausa: Sa’ad da aka gama aikin da Sarki Solomon sa a yi domin haikalin Ubangiji, sai ya kawo kayayyakin da mahaifinsa Dawuda ya keɓe, azurfa da zinariya da kayayyaki, ya sa su a ma’ajin haikalin Ubangiji.
english: Thus all the work that King Solomon did in Yahweh’s house was finished. Solomon brought in the things which David his father had dedicated—the silver, the gold, and the vessels—and put them in the treasuries of Yahweh’s house.

hausa: Kowane daga kerubobin yana da fuskoki huɗu. Fuska ɗaya na kerub ne, na biyun fuskar mutum ne, na ukun fuskar zaki ne, na huɗun kuwa fuskar gaggafa ce.
english: Every one of them had four faces. The first face was the face of the cherub. The second face was the face of a man. The third face was the face of a lion. The fourth was the face of an eagle.

hausa: Yanzu duba, kana dogara ga Masar, wannan ɗan tsinken kyauron dogarawa, wanda zai soki hannun mutum yă kuma ji masa rauni in ya dangana a kansa! Haka Fir’auna sarkin Masar yake ga duk wanda ya dogara da shi.
english: Behold, you trust in the staff of this bruised reed, even in Egypt, which if a man leans on it, it will go into his hand and pierce it. So is Pharaoh king of Egypt to all who trust in him.

hausa: Sai wani cikin waɗanda suke tsattsaye kusa ya zāre takobinsa, ya sare kunnen bawan babban firist.
english: But a certain one of those who stood by drew his sword and struck the servant of the high priest, and cut off his ear.

hausa: Sa’ad da almajiran suka ji wannan, sai suka yi mamaki ƙwarai. Suka yi tambaya suka ce, “To, wa zai sami ceto ke nan?”
english: When the disciples heard it, they were exceedingly astonished, saying, “Who then can be saved?”

hausa: Zan haura can bisa gizagizai; zan mai da kaina kamar Mafi Ɗaukaka.”
english: I will ascend above the heights of the clouds! I will make myself like the Most High!”

hausa: Sama’ila ya ce, “Ni ne mai duban, ka yi gaba zuwa ka tudu, gama yau za ka ci tare da ni, da safe kuma in sallame ka, in gaya muku duk abin da yake a zuciyarku.
english: Samuel answered Saul and said, “I am the seer. Go up before me to the high place, for you are to eat with me today. In the morning I will let you go and will tell you all that is in your heart.

hausa: Amma wani zai ce, “Kai kana da bangaskiya; ni kuma ina da ayyuka.” Ka nuna mini bangaskiyarka ba tare da ayyuka ba, ni kuma zan nuna maka bangaskiyata ta wurin abin da nake yi.
english: Yes, a man will say, “You have faith, and I have works.” Show me your faith without works, and I will show you my faith by my works.

hausa: fuskar ɗaya kamar ta mutum tana fuskantar zānen siffar itacen dabino a wannan gefe, ɗaya fuskar kamar ta zaki tana fuskantar zānen siffar itacen dabino na wancan gefe. Haka aka zāna su dukan a jikin bangon haikalin kewaye.
english: so that there was the face of a man toward the palm tree on the one side, and the face of a young lion toward the palm tree on the other side. It was made like this through all the house all around.

hausa: Sa’an nan ta yi ihu ta ce, “Samson ga Filistiyawa sun zo su kama ka!” Sai ya farka daga barci yana tsammani cewa, “Zan fita kamar dā in miƙe jikina.” Amma bai san cewa Ubangiji ya rabu da shi ba.
english: She said, “The Philistines are upon you, Samson!” He awoke out of his sleep, and said, “I will go out as at other times, and shake myself free.” But he didn’t know that Yahweh had departed from him.

hausa: La’anar Ubangiji tana a gidan mugaye, amma yakan albarkaci gidan adali.
english: Yahweh’s curse is in the house of the wicked, but he blesses the habitation of the righteous.

hausa: Dukanmu a jirgin kuwa mutane 276 ne.
english: In all, we were two hundred seventy-six souls on the ship.

hausa: “Dukanku da kuka kashe mutum, ko kuka taɓa wani da aka kashe, dole ku kasance a bayan sansani har kwana bakwai. A rana ta uku da rana ta bakwai dole ku tsabtacce kanku da kuma bayinku.
english: “Encamp outside of the camp for seven days. Whoever has killed any person, and whoever has touched any slain, purify yourselves on the third day and on the seventh day, you and your captives.

hausa: Gama wane ne a sarari za a iya kwatanta da Ubangiji? Wane ne yake kamar Ubangiji a cikin talikan samaniya?
english: For who in the skies can be compared to Yahweh? Who among the sons of the heavenly beings is like Yahweh,

hausa: saboda haka, ya duwatsun Isra’ila, ku ji maganar Ubangiji Mai Iko Duka, ga abin da Ubangiji Mai Iko Duka yana faɗa wa duwatsu da tuddai, wa kwazazzabai da kwaruruka, wa kufai da garuruwan da suka zama kango waɗanda aka washe aka wulaƙanta suka zama ganimar sauran al’ummai da suke kewaye da ku,
english: therefore, you mountains of Israel, hear the word of the Lord Yahweh: The Lord Yahweh says to the mountains and to the hills, to the watercourses and to the valleys, to the desolate wastes and to the cities that are forsaken, which have become a prey and derision to the residue of the nations that are all around;

hausa: A can mala’ikan Ubangiji ya bayyana a gare shi cikin harshen wuta, a ƙaramin itace. Musa ya lura cewa ko da yake wuta na ci ƙaramin itacen, amma bai ƙone ba.
english: Yahweh’s angel appeared to him in a flame of fire out of the middle of a bush. He looked, and behold, the bush burned with fire, and the bush was not consumed.

hausa: Faɗin ƙofar shiga kamu goma ne, fāɗin bangaye a kowane madogararta kamu biyar-biyar ne. Ya kuma auna wuri mai tsarkin da yake waje; tsawonsa kamu arba’in fāɗinsa kuma kamu ashirin.
english: The width of the entrance was ten cubits, and the sides of the entrance were five cubits on the one side, and five cubits on the other side. He measured its length, forty cubits, and the width, twenty cubits.

hausa: Sai Shallum ɗan Yabesh ya ƙulla wa Zakariya maƙarƙashiya. Ya tasam masa a gaban jama’a, ya kashe shi, ya kuma gāje shi.
english: Shallum the son of Jabesh conspired against him, and struck him before the people and killed him, and reigned in his place.

hausa: “Mutumin da yake da talenti biyu, shi ma ya zo ya ce, ‘Maigida, ka danƙa mini talenti biyu; ga shi, na yi ribar biyu.’
english: “He also who got the two talents came and said, ‘Lord, you delivered to me two talents. Behold, I have gained another two talents in addition to them.’

hausa: Ahaz yana da shekara ashirin sa’ad da ya zama sarki, ya kuma yi mulki a Urushalima shekara goma sha shida. Ba kamar Dawuda kakansa ba, bai yi abin da yake daidai a gaban Ubangiji ba.
english: Ahaz was twenty years old when he began to reign, and he reigned sixteen years in Jerusalem. He didn’t do that which was right in Yahweh’s eyes, like David his father,

hausa: Dukan mutanen da suke cikin wahala, da waɗanda ake binsu bashi, da masu damuwoyi, suka tattaru a wurin Dawuda. Shi kuwa ya zama shugabansu. Yawansu ya kai ɗari huɗu.
english: Everyone who was in distress, everyone who was in debt, and everyone who was discontented gathered themselves to him; and he became captain over them. There were with him about four hundred men.

hausa: Ya ƙara jira kwana bakwai, sai ya sāke aiken kurciyar daga jirgi.
english: He waited yet another seven days; and again he sent the dove out of the ship.

hausa: “Ka yi murfin kafara da zinariya zalla, tsawonsa kamu biyu da rabi, fāɗinsa kuma kamu ɗaya da rabi.
english: You shall make a mercy seat of pure gold. Two and a half cubits shall be its length, and a cubit and a half its width.

hausa: Amma game da Isra’ilawan da suke zama a garuruwan Yahuda kuwa, Rehobowam ya ci gaba da yin mulki a bisansu.
english: But as for the children of Israel who lived in the cities of Judah, Rehoboam reigned over them.

hausa: Da irin wannan fitina ta tsokane shi kwana da kwanaki har sai da ya gaji kamar zai mutu.
english: When she pressed him daily with her words and urged him, his soul was troubled to death.

hausa: Daga rabin kabilar Manasse kuwa, Isra’ilawa suka ba da Aner da Bileyam, tare da wuraren kiwonsu, ga sauran gidajen mutanen Kohat.
english: and out of the half-tribe of Manasseh, Aner with its pasture lands, and Bileam with its pasture lands, for the rest of the family of the sons of Kohath.

hausa: “ ‘Za a ɗauki mutane kullum don tsabtacce ƙasar. Waɗansu za su ratsa ƙasar, ƙari da waɗannan, waɗansu za su binne gawawwakin da suka ragu a ƙasar. A ƙarshen watanni bakwai ɗin za su fara bincikensu.
english: “‘“They will set apart men of continual employment who will pass through the land. Those who pass through will go with those who bury those who remain on the surface of the land, to cleanse it. After the end of seven months they will search.

hausa: Yehohiyacin sarkin Yahuda, da mahaifiyarsa, da masu yi masa hidima, da hakimansa, da kuma fadawansa duk suka miƙa kansu ga Nebukadnezzar. A shekara ta takwas ta mulkin sarkin Babilon, sarkin Babilon ya mai da Yehohiyacin ɗan kurkuku.
english: and Jehoiachin the king of Judah went out to the king of Babylon—he, his mother, his servants, his princes, and his officers; and the king of Babylon captured him in the eighth year of his reign.

hausa: Mazaunan duniya za su ƙyaface su kuma yi biki ta wurin aika kyautai wa juna, domin waɗannan annabawan nan biyu ne suka azabtar da mazaunan duniya.
english: Those who dwell on the earth will rejoice over them, and they will be glad. They will give gifts to one another, because these two prophets tormented those who dwell on the earth.

hausa: Zai juye zukatan iyaye ga ’ya’yansu, zukatan ’ya’ya kuma ga iyayensu; in ba haka ba zan bugi ƙasar da hallaka gaba ɗaya.”
english: He will turn the hearts of the fathers to the children and the hearts of the children to their fathers, lest I come and strike the earth with a curse.”

hausa: Da sassafe, sai ga Yesu tsaye a gaci, amma almajiran ba su gane cewa Yesu ne ba.
english: But when day had already come, Jesus stood on the beach; yet the disciples didn’t know that it was Jesus.

hausa: Yohanna ya ce wa taron da suke zuwa domin yă yi musu baftisma, “Ku macizai! Wa ya gargaɗe ku, ku guje wa fushin nan mai zuwa?
english: He said therefore to the multitudes who went out to be baptized by him, “You offspring of vipers, who warned you to flee from the wrath to come?

hausa: amma da muka yi kuka a gaban Ubangiji, ya kuwa ji mu, sai ya aiko mala’ika, ya fitar da mu daga Masar. “Yanzu ga mu a Kadesh, garin da yake kan iyakar yankinka.
english: When we cried to Yahweh, he heard our voice, sent an angel, and brought us out of Egypt. Behold, we are in Kadesh, a city in the edge of your border.

hausa: Amma yanzu fa, dukanku waɗanda kuke ƙuna wuta kuna kuma tanada wa kanku fitilu masu ci, ku je ku yi tafiya a cikin hasken wutarku da na fitilun da kuka ƙuna. Abin da za ku karɓa ke nan daga hannuna. Za ku kwanta a cikin azaba.
english: Behold, all you who kindle a fire, who adorn yourselves with torches around yourselves, walk in the flame of your fire, and among the torches that you have kindled. You will have this from my hand: you will lie down in sorrow.

hausa: Bayan Rahila ta haifi Yusuf, sai Yaƙub ya ce wa Laban, “Ka sallame ni don in koma ƙasata.
english: When Rachel had borne Joseph, Jacob said to Laban, “Send me away, that I may go to my own place, and to my country.

hausa: ya albarkaci Abram yana cewa, “Allah Mafi Ɗaukaka Mahaliccin sama da ƙasa yă albarkace Abram.
english: He blessed him, and said, “Blessed be Abram of God Most High, possessor of heaven and earth.

hausa: Birni mai katanga ya zama kufai, yasasshen mazauni, an yashe shi kamar hamada; a can ’yan maruƙa suke kiwo, a can suke kwance; sun kakkaɓe rassanta ƙaf.
english: For the fortified city is solitary, a habitation deserted and forsaken, like the wilderness. The calf will feed there, and there he will lie down, and consume its branches.

hausa: Ga abin da Ubangiji Mai Iko Duka ya nuna mini. Ubangiji Mai Iko Duka yana shirin hukunta da wuta; wutar ta ƙone teku ta kuma ƙone ƙasa.
english: Thus the Lord Yahweh showed me: behold, the Lord Yahweh called for judgment by fire; and it dried up the great deep, and would have devoured the land.

hausa: Da isowarsa, Yesu ya tarar Lazarus ya riga ya yi kwana huɗu a kabari.
english: So when Jesus came, he found that he had been in the tomb four days already.

hausa: Barci kuwa ya kama Bitrus da abokan tafiyarsa sosai. Da idanunsu suka warware, sai suka ga ɗaukakarsa da kuma mutum biyun tsaye tare da shi.
english: Now Peter and those who were with him were heavy with sleep, but when they were fully awake, they saw his glory, and the two men who stood with him.

hausa: Ku abokaina ne, in kun yi abin da na umarta.
english: You are my friends if you do whatever I command you.

hausa: Ni kamar ka nake a gaban Allah; ni ma daga ƙasa aka yi ni.
english: Behold, I am toward God even as you are. I am also formed out of the clay.

hausa: Sa’an nan fadawan suka ce wa Baruk, “Kai da Irmiya ku je ku ɓuya. Kada ku bari wani ya san inda kuke.”
english: Then the princes said to Baruch, “You and Jeremiah go hide. Don’t let anyone know where you are.”

hausa: Za su sarƙafe a ƙaya, za su kuma bugu da ruwan inabinsu; za a laƙume su kamar busasshiyar ciyawa.
english: For entangled like thorns, and drunken as with their drink, they are consumed utterly like dry stubble.

hausa: Ga abin da Ubangiji Maɗaukaki, Allah na Isra’ila, yana cewa zan sa karkiyar ƙarfe a wuyan dukan waɗannan al’ummai don in sa su bauta wa Nebukadnezzar sarkin Babilon, za su kuwa bauta masa. Zan ma sa shi ya mallaki namun jeji.’ ”
english: For Yahweh of Armies, the God of Israel says, “I have put a yoke of iron on the neck of all these nations, that they may serve Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon; and they will serve him. I have also given him the animals of the field.”’”

hausa: “Ku ba Isra’ilawa ba ne, daidai gare ni kamar yadda Kushawa suke?” In ji Ubangiji. “Ban fito da Isra’ila daga Masar ba, Filistiyawa kuma daga Kaftor Arameyawa kuma daga Kir ba?
english: Are you not like the children of the Ethiopians to me, children of Israel?” says Yahweh. “Haven’t I brought up Israel out of the land of Egypt, and the Philistines from Caphtor, and the Syrians from Kir?

hausa: Muka kama dukan biranen da suke kan tudu, da dukan Gileyad, da dukan Bashan, har zuwa Saleka da Edireyi, biranen masarautar Og a Bashan.
english: We took all the cities of the plain, and all Gilead, and all Bashan, to Salecah and Edrei, cities of the kingdom of Og in Bashan.

hausa: Ya aiki Musa bawansa, da Haruna, wanda ya zaɓa.
english: He sent Moses, his servant, and Aaron, whom he had chosen.

hausa: Amma Sarki Dawuda ya amsa wa Ornan ya ce, “A’a, na nace zan biya cikakken kuɗinta. Ba zan karɓi abinka kawai don Ubangiji ba, ko in miƙa hadaya ta ƙonawar da ba tă ci mini wani abu ba.”
english: King David said to Ornan, “No, but I will most certainly buy it for the full price. For I will not take that which is yours for Yahweh, nor offer a burnt offering that costs me nothing.”

hausa: Shugabannin Isra’ila da sarki suka ƙasƙantar da kansu suka ce, “Ubangiji mai adalci ne.”
english: Then the princes of Israel and the king humbled themselves; and they said, “Yahweh is righteous.”

hausa: Na yi magana da annabawa, na ba su wahayi da yawa na kuma ba da misalai ta wurinsu.”
english: I have also spoken to the prophets, and I have multiplied visions; and by the ministry of the prophets I have used parables.

hausa: Duk wanda ya ci nasara, zan ba shi ikon zama tare da ni a kursiyina, kamar yadda na ci nasara, kuma ina zaune tare da Ubana a kursiyinsa.
english: He who overcomes, I will give to him to sit down with me on my throne, as I also overcame and sat down with my Father on his throne.

hausa: Za su tuɓe tufafinki su kuma kwashe kayan adonki masu kyau.
english: They will also strip you of your clothes and take away your beautiful jewels.

hausa: Saboda haka na tsarkake firistoci da Lawiyawa daga kowane baƙon abu, na kuma ba su aikinsu, kowa ga aikinsa.
english: Thus I cleansed them from all foreigners and appointed duties for the priests and for the Levites, everyone in his work;

hausa: Sa’ad da Yahuda ya gan ta, ya yi tsammani karuwa ce, gama ta lulluɓe fuskarta.
english: When Judah saw her, he thought that she was a prostitute, for she had covered her face.

hausa: “ ‘Amma babu abin da mutum ya mallaka, ya kuma keɓe ga Ubangiji, ko mutum ne, ko dabba, ko ganar iyali da za a sayar, ko a fansa; kome da aka keɓe a wannan hanya, mafi tsarki ne ga Ubangiji.
english: “‘Notwithstanding, no devoted thing that a man devotes to Yahweh of all that he has, whether of man or animal, or of the field of his possession, shall be sold or redeemed. Everything that is permanently devoted is most holy to Yahweh.

hausa: Da Ruhu ya iza shi, sai ya shiga cikin filin haikali. Sa’ad da iyayen suka kawo jaririn nan Yesu don su yi masa abin da al’adar Doka ta bukaci,
english: He came in the Spirit into the temple. When the parents brought in the child, Jesus, that they might do concerning him according to the custom of the law,

hausa: Zan karya ikonku wanda kuke fariya da shi, in hana ruwan sama, ƙasa kuma tă zama kamar tagulla.
english: I will break the pride of your power, and I will make your sky like iron, and your soil like bronze.

hausa: Yana kartar ƙasa da ƙarfi; ba ya iya tsayawa tsab sa’ad da ya ji busar ƙaho.
english: He eats up the ground with fierceness and rage, neither does he stand still at the sound of the trumpet.

hausa: Babu tsoro cikin ƙauna. Cikakkiyar ƙauna dai takan kawar da tsoro, domin hukunci ne yake kawo tsoro. Mai jin tsoro ba cikakke ba ne a cikin ƙauna.
english: There is no fear in love; but perfect love casts out fear, because fear has punishment. He who fears is not made perfect in love.

hausa: Aiyalon da Gat-Rimmon, tare da wuraren kiwonsu, garuruwa huɗu ke nan.
english: Aijalon with its pasture lands, Gath Rimmon with its pasture lands: four cities.

hausa: Mace kuma za a biya azurfa talatin.
english: If she is a female, then your valuation shall be thirty shekels.
