hausa: Jiya-jiya ka zo. Yau kuma in sa ka yi ta yawo tare da mu, ga shi ban ma san inda za ni ba? Koma, ka tafi da ’yan’uwanka. Bari alheri da amincin Ubangiji su kasance tare da kai.”
english: Whereas you came but yesterday, should I today make you go up and down with us, since I go where I may? Return, and take back your brothers. Mercy and truth be with you.”

hausa: Saboda haka a cikinki ubanni za su ci ’ya’yansu, ’ya’ya kuma za su ci ubanninsu. Zan hukunta ki zan kuma watsar da dukan waɗanda suke tsira da suke naki a iska.
english: Therefore the fathers will eat the sons within you, and the sons will eat their fathers. I will execute judgments on you; and I will scatter the whole remnant of you to all the winds.

hausa: “Me kake so in yi maka?” Sai ya amsa ya ce, “Ubangiji, ina so in sami ganin gari.”
english: “What do you want me to do?” He said, “Lord, that I may see again.”

hausa: Zai zama da albarka ga bayin da maigidansu ya iske su, suna zaman tsaro, a duk lokacin da ya dawo, ko da ya dawo a sa’a ta biyu, ko ta uku na tsakar dare ne.
english: They will be blessed if he comes in the second or third watch and finds them so.

hausa: Game da cututtukan kuturta, sai ku lura, ku yi yadda firistocin da suke Lawiyawa suka umarce ku. Dole ku lura ku bi abin da na umarce su.
english: Be careful in the plague of leprosy, that you observe diligently and do according to all that the Levitical priests teach you. As I commanded them, so you shall observe to do.

hausa: Bari a yabi sunan Ubangiji, yanzu da har abada kuma.
english: Blessed be Yahweh’s name, from this time forward and forever more.

hausa: Mikahiya ya furta ya ce, “Idan har ka dawo lafiya, to, Ubangiji bai yi magana ta wurina ba.” Ya kuma ƙara da cewa, “Dukanku mutane, ku lura da maganata!”
english: Micaiah said, “If you return at all in peace, Yahweh has not spoken by me.” He said, “Listen, you people, all of you!”

hausa: In ya yi na’am, to, bawanka ya tsira. Amma in ka ga ya damu, to, ka tabbata ya yi niyya yă kashe ni.
english: If he says, ‘It is well,’ your servant shall have peace; but if he is angry, then know that evil is determined by him.

hausa: Zai tsaga shi biyu a tsaka, amma ba zai raba shi ba. Firist ɗin zai ɗibiya shi a bisa itacen da yake bisa bagaden, yă ƙone shi. Hadaya ce ta ƙonawa, hadaya ce kuma wadda aka yi da wuta, mai daɗin ƙanshi ga Ubangiji.
english: He shall tear it by its wings, but shall not divide it apart. The priest shall burn it on the altar, on the wood that is on the fire. It is a burnt offering, an offering made by fire, of a pleasant aroma to Yahweh.

hausa: Aka ba ta iko tă yaƙi tsarkaka tă kuma ci nasara a kansu. Aka kuma ba ta iko bisa kowace kabila, jama’a, harshe da kuma al’umma.
english: It was given to him to make war with the saints and to overcome them. Authority over every tribe, people, language, and nation was given to him.

hausa: “Sa’ad da ka faɗa musu wannan duka, ba za su saurare ka ba; sa’ad da ka kira su, ba za su amsa ba.
english: “You shall speak all these words to them, but they will not listen to you. You shall also call to them, but they will not answer you.

hausa: Ɗan’uwan da aka yi wa laifi ya fi birni mai katanga wuyan shiryawa, kuma faɗace-faɗace suna kama da ƙofofin ƙarfe na fada.
english: A brother offended is more difficult than a fortified city. Disputes are like the bars of a fortress.

hausa: Ya shiga gidan Allah a zamanin Abiyatar babban firist, ya ci keɓaɓɓen burodin nan, ya kuma ba wa abokan tafiyarsa abin da firistoci kaɗai sukan ci bisa ga doka?”
english: How he entered into God’s house at the time of Abiathar the high priest, and ate the show bread, which is not lawful to eat except for the priests, and gave also to those who were with him?”

hausa: Ni bawanka ne, ka ba ni fahimi don in gane farillanka.
english: I am your servant. Give me understanding, that I may know your testimonies.

hausa: “Ga shi, ina zuwa kamar ɓarawo! Mai albarka ne wanda yake zama a faɗake yana kuma saye da tufafinsa, don kada yă yi tafiya tsirara a kuma kunyata shi.”
english: “Behold, I come like a thief. Blessed is he who watches, and keeps his clothes, so that he doesn’t walk naked, and they see his shame.”

hausa: Zai ƙarfafa ku har zuwa ƙarshe, domin ku zama marasa aibi a ranar Ubangijinmu Yesu Kiristi.
english: who will also confirm you until the end, blameless in the day of our Lord Jesus Christ.

hausa: “Ina makoki saye da tsummoki na ɓoye fuskata a cikin ƙura.
english: I have sewed sackcloth on my skin, and have thrust my horn in the dust.

hausa: “Ina amfanin gunki da mutum ne ya sassaƙa? Ko siffar da take koyar da ƙarya? Gama wanda ya yi shi yana dogara ne ga halittarsa; ya yi gumakan da ba sa magana.
english: “What value does the engraved image have, that its maker has engraved it; the molten image, even the teacher of lies, that he who fashions its form trusts in it, to make mute idols?

hausa: Sai suka iso Yeriko. Sa’ad da Yesu da almajiransa tare da taro mai yawa suke barin birnin, wani makaho da ake kira Bartimawus kuwa (wato, “ɗan Timawus”), yana zaune a gefen hanya yana bara.
english: They came to Jericho. As he went out from Jericho with his disciples and a great multitude, the son of Timaeus, Bartimaeus, a blind beggar, was sitting by the road.

hausa: Saboda haka, ga abin da Ubangiji Maɗaukaki yana cewa game da annabawa, “Zan sa su ci abinci mai ɗaci su kuma sha ruwa mai dafi, domin daga annabawan Urushalima rashin sani Allah ya bazu ko’ina a ƙasar.”
english: Therefore Yahweh of Armies says concerning the prophets: “Behold, I will feed them with wormwood, and make them drink poisoned water; for from the prophets of Jerusalem ungodliness has gone out into all the land.”

hausa: Sai aka huda katangan birnin, sojojin kuwa suka gudu, suka fita daga cikin birnin da dare ta hanyar ƙofar da take tsakanin bango biyu, kusa da gonar sarki, sa’ad da Babiloniyawa suke kewaye da birnin. Sojojin suka nufi wajen Araba.
english: Then a breach was made in the city, and all the men of war fled, and went out of the city by night by the way of the gate between the two walls, which was by the king’s garden. Now the Chaldeans were against the city all around. The men of war went toward the Arabah,

hausa: Mai gadin ba ya sa kansa game da kome da yake ƙarƙashin kulawar Yusuf, gama Ubangiji yana tare da Yusuf, ya kuma ba shi nasara a cikin dukan abin da ya yi.
english: The keeper of the prison didn’t look after anything that was under his hand, because Yahweh was with him; and that which he did, Yahweh made it prosper.

hausa: Duk abin da nake da shi naka ne, kuma duk abin da kake da shi nawa ne. Na kuwa sami ɗaukaka ta wurinsu.
english: All things that are mine are yours, and yours are mine, and I am glorified in them.

hausa: Matar Gileyad ta haifa masa ’ya’ya maza, kuma sa’ad da suka yi girma, sai suka kore Yefta, suka ce “Ba ka da gādo a cikin iyalinmu, domin kai ɗan wata mace ce.”
english: Gilead’s wife bore him sons. When his wife’s sons grew up, they drove Jephthah out and said to him, “You will not inherit in our father’s house, for you are the son of another woman.”

hausa: Na gaya muku cewa za ku mutu cikin zunubanku; in ba ku gaskata cewa ni ne wanda na ce nake ba, lalle za ku mutu cikin zunubanku.”
english: I said therefore to you that you will die in your sins; for unless you believe that I am he, you will die in your sins.”

hausa: Za ku kuma rera kamar a daren da kuke shagalin biki mai tsarki; zukatanku za su yi farin ciki kamar sa’ad da mutane sukan haura da busa zuwa dutsen Ubangiji, zuwa Dutse na Isra’ila.
english: You will have a song, as in the night when a holy feast is kept, and gladness of heart, as when one goes with a flute to come to Yahweh’s mountain, to Israel’s Rock.

hausa: Shawulu ma ya tafi gidansa a Gibeya tare da waɗansu jarumawan da Allah ya taɓa zuciyarsu.
english: Saul also went to his house in Gibeah; and the army went with him, whose hearts God had touched.

hausa: Me zai faru in akwai mutum hamshin masu adalci a cikin birnin? Ashe, za ka hallaka shi, ba za ka cece wurin saboda mutane hamsin nan masu adalcin da suke a cikinsa ba?
english: What if there are fifty righteous within the city? Will you consume and not spare the place for the fifty righteous who are in it?

hausa: Kemuwel ɗan Shiftan, shugaba daga kabilar Efraim ɗan Yusuf;
english: Of the tribe of the children of Ephraim a prince, Kemuel the son of Shiphtan.

hausa: Dole mutanenmu su koyi ba da kansu ga aikata abin da yake nagari, domin su iya biyan bukatunsu na yau da kullum kada kuma su yi rayuwar marar amfani.
english: Let our people also learn to maintain good works to meet necessary needs, that they may not be unfruitful.

hausa: Yesu ya ba su wani misali. “Mulkin sama yana kama da wani da ya shuka iri mai kyau a cikin gonarsa.
english: He set another parable before them, saying, “The Kingdom of Heaven is like a man who sowed good seed in his field,

hausa: Bayan bawan ya ɗaga shi ya kai wurin mahaifiyarsa, sai yaron ya zauna a cinyarta har tsakar rana, sa’an nan ya mutu.
english: When he had taken him and brought him to his mother, he sat on her knees until noon, and then died.

hausa: Ashe, bai kamata a ’yantar da macen nan, diyar zuriyar Ibrahim, wadda Shaiɗan ya daure, har shekara goma sha takwas, a ranar Asabbaci, daga abin da ya daure ta ba?”
english: Ought not this woman, being a daughter of Abraham whom Satan had bound eighteen long years, be freed from this bondage on the Sabbath day?”

hausa: Sai Musa ya tara dukan Isra’ila, ya ce musu, Idanunku sun ga dukan abin da Ubangiji ya yi a Masar ga Fir’auna, ga kuma dukan shugabanninsa da kuma ga dukan ƙasarsa.
english: Moses called to all Israel, and said to them: Your eyes have seen all that Yahweh did in the land of Egypt to Pharaoh, and to all his servants, and to all his land;

hausa: Duk wanda yake yin waɗannan abubuwa, shi abin ƙyama ne ga Ubangiji, saboda waɗannan abubuwa banƙyama ne kuwa Ubangiji Allahnku ya kori waɗancan al’ummai kafin ku.
english: For whoever does these things is an abomination to Yahweh. Because of these abominations, Yahweh your God drives them out from before you.

hausa: da kuma saƙaƙƙun riguna, tsarkakan riguna don Haruna firist da rigunan ’ya’yansa maza, sa’ad da suke hidima a matsayin firistoci,
english: the finely worked garments—the holy garments for Aaron the priest, the garments of his sons to minister in the priest’s office—

hausa: Ubangiji ya ce wa Musa da Haruna,
english: Yahweh spoke to Moses and to Aaron, saying,

hausa: A shekara ta bakwai sai Yehohiyada ya aika a kira komandodin sojoji ɗari-ɗari, da Keretawa, da matsara, ya sa aka kawo masa su a haikalin Ubangiji. Ya ƙulla yarjejjeniya da rantsuwa da su a haikalin Ubangiji, sa’an nan ya nuna musu ɗan sarki.
english: In the seventh year Jehoiada sent and fetched the captains over hundreds of the Carites and of the guard, and brought them to him into Yahweh’s house; and he made a covenant with them, and made a covenant with them in Yahweh’s house, and showed them the king’s son.

hausa: ya kafa ginshiƙan ɗakin samansa a kan ruwaye. Ya maido da gizagizai suka zama keken yaƙinsa yana hawa a kan fikafikan iska.
english: He lays the beams of his rooms in the waters. He makes the clouds his chariot. He walks on the wings of the wind.

hausa: Wata baiwa ta gan shi zaune kusa da wutar. Ta dube shi sosai sa’an nan, ta ce, “Ai, wannan mutum ma yana tare da shi.”
english: A certain servant girl saw him as he sat in the light, and looking intently at him, said, “This man also was with him.”

hausa: Ku amsa, ‘Bayinka suna kiwon dabbobi ne, tun muna samari har zuwa yanzu, kamar yadda kakanninmu suka yi.’ Ta haka za a bar ku ku zauna a yankin Goshen, gama Masarawa suna ƙyamar makiyaya.”
english: that you shall say, ‘Your servants have been keepers of livestock from our youth even until now, both we, and our fathers:’ that you may dwell in the land of Goshen; for every shepherd is an abomination to the Egyptians.”

hausa: A can zai miƙa hadayunsa ga Ubangiji. Hadayun kuwa su ne, ɗan rago, bana ɗaya marar lahani don hadaya ta ƙonawa, ’yar tunkiya, bana ɗaya marar lahani na hadaya don zunubi, rago marar lahani don hadaya ta salama,
english: and he shall offer his offering to Yahweh: one male lamb a year old without defect for a burnt offering, one ewe lamb a year old without defect for a sin offering, one ram without defect for peace offerings,

hausa: A dukan kwanakin keɓewarsa, an tsarkake shi ga Ubangiji.
english: All the days of his separation he is holy to Yahweh.

hausa: Ba na tsawata muku saboda hadayunku ko kuwa hadayunku na ƙonawa, waɗanda kuka taɓa kawo a gabana.
english: I don’t rebuke you for your sacrifices. Your burnt offerings are continually before me.

hausa: A wannan rana sarki ya tsarkake sashe na tsakiyar fili a gaban haikalin Ubangiji, a can kuma ya miƙa hadaya ta ƙonawa, hadaya ta gari, da kitsen hadaya ta salama, gama bagaden tagulla a gaban Ubangiji ya yi ƙanƙanta sosai da za a miƙa hadayun ƙonawa, hadayun hatsi, da kuma kitsen hadayun salama.
english: The same day the king made the middle of the court holy that was before Yahweh’s house; for there he offered the burnt offering, the meal offering, and the fat of the peace offerings, because the bronze altar that was before Yahweh was too little to receive the burnt offering, the meal offering, and the fat of the peace offerings.

hausa: Saboda haka, suka amsa wa Yesu suka ce, “Ba mu sani ba.” Yesu ya ce, “To, ni ma ba zan gaya muku ko da wane iko nake yin waɗannan abubuwa ba.”
english: They answered Jesus, “We don’t know.” Jesus said to them, “Neither will I tell you by what authority I do these things.”

hausa: Kada ku gina wa bagadena matakala, domin kada yayinda wani yana hawa, mutane su ga tsiraicinsa.’
english: You shall not go up by steps to my altar, that your nakedness may not be exposed to it.’

hausa: kwanon zinariya ɗaya mai nauyin shekel goma, cike da turaren hayaƙi;
english: one golden ladle of ten shekels, full of incense;

hausa: “Zan mai da ita wuri domin mujiyoyi da kuma fadama; zan share ta da tsintsiyar hallaka,” Ni Ubangiji Maɗaukaki na faɗa.
english: “I will also make it a possession for the porcupine, and pools of water. I will sweep it with the broom of destruction,” says Yahweh of Armies.

hausa: Wata rana, Bitrus da Yohanna suna haurawa zuwa haikali a lokacin addu’a da ƙarfe uku na rana.
english: Peter and John were going up into the temple at the hour of prayer, the ninth hour.

hausa: Ya kuma ce musu, “Kuna da hanya mai sauƙi na ajiye umarnan Allah a gefe ɗaya, don ku kiyaye al’adunku!
english: He said to them, “Full well do you reject the commandment of God, that you may keep your tradition.

hausa: Da a ce kawai za ku mai da hankali ga umarnaina, da salamarku ta zama kamar kogi, adalcinku kamar raƙuman teku.
english: Oh that you had listened to my commandments! Then your peace would have been like a river and your righteousness like the waves of the sea.

hausa: Wawaye makafi! Wanne ya fi girma, zinariyar, ko haikalin da yake tsarkake zinariyar?
english: You blind fools! For which is greater, the gold or the temple that sanctifies the gold?

hausa: ɗansa na fari kuwa shi ne Abdon, sai Zur, Kish, Ba’al, Ner, Nadab,
english: with his firstborn son Abdon, Zur, Kish, Baal, Nadab,

hausa: Bari masu ƙaunar Ubangiji su ƙi mugunta, gama yana tsaron rayukan amintattunsa yana kuma kuɓutar da su daga hannun mugaye.
english: You who love Yahweh, hate evil! He preserves the souls of his saints. He delivers them out of the hand of the wicked.

hausa: Amma in Ubangiji ya kawo wani abu sabo, ya sa ƙasa ta buɗe bakinta, ta haɗiye su da dukan abin da suke da shi, suka gangara cikin kabari a raye, ta haka za ku sani mutanen nan sun rena Ubangiji.”
english: But if Yahweh makes a new thing, and the ground opens its mouth, and swallows them up with all that belong to them, and they go down alive into Sheol, then you shall understand that these men have despised Yahweh.”

hausa: A ranan nan ƙafafunsa za su tsaya a kan Dutsen Zaitun, gabas da Urushalima, za a kuma tsage Dutsen Zaitun kashi biyu daga gabas zuwa yamma, yă zama babban kwari, rabin dutsen zai matsa zuwa wajen arewa, rabi kuma zai matsa zuwa wajen kudu.
english: His feet will stand in that day on the Mount of Olives, which is before Jerusalem on the east; and the Mount of Olives will be split in two from east to west, making a very great valley. Half of the mountain will move toward the north, and half of it toward the south.

hausa: Dawuda yana da shekara talatin ɗaya sa’ad da ya zama sarki, ya kuma yi mulki shekara arba’in.
english: David was thirty years old when he began to reign, and he reigned forty years.

hausa: Ni ba kome ba ne sai dai fata da ƙashi, da ƙyar na tsira.
english: My bones stick to my skin and to my flesh. I have escaped by the skin of my teeth.

hausa: Sai mutuniyar Samariyar ta ce masa, “Kai mutumin Yahuda ne, ni kuwa mutuniyar Samariya ce. Yaya za ka roƙe ni ruwan sha?” (Don Yahudawa ba sa hulɗa da Samariyawa.)
english: The Samaritan woman therefore said to him, “How is it that you, being a Jew, ask for a drink from me, a Samaritan woman?” (For Jews have no dealings with Samaritans.)

hausa: Ku kanku kun san cewa hannuwan nan nawa sun biya mini bukatuna da kuma na abokan aikina.
english: You yourselves know that these hands served my necessities, and those who were with me.

hausa: Ko kuma don me ba a ɓoye ni a cikin ƙasa kamar jaririn da aka haifa ba rai ba, kamar jaririn da bai taɓa ganin hasken rana ba.
english: or as a hidden untimely birth I had not been, as infants who never saw light.

hausa: Da shekara ta kewaye, mayaƙan Aram suka yi gāba da Yowash suka kai hari wa Yahuda da Urushalima suka kuma kashe dukan shugabannin mutane, suka aika da dukan ganima zuwa ga sarkinsu a Damaskus.
english: At the end of the year, the army of the Syrians came up against him. They came to Judah and Jerusalem, and destroyed all the princes of the people from among the people, and sent all their plunder to the king of Damascus.

hausa: A can, a bakin rafin Ahawa, na sa mu yi azumi, domin mu ƙasƙantar da kanmu a gaban Allah, mu kuma roƙe shi yă kiyaye mana hanya, da mu da ’ya’yanmu da kayanmu duka.
english: Then I proclaimed a fast there at the river Ahava, that we might humble ourselves before our God, to seek from him a straight way for us, for our little ones, and for all our possessions.

hausa: Saboda haka Yaƙub ya aika a ce wa Rahila da Liyatu su zo jeji inda garkunan suke.
english: Jacob sent and called Rachel and Leah to the field to his flock,

hausa: Ba za mu koma gidajenmu ba sai kowane mutumin Isra’ila ya sami gādonsa.
english: We will not return to our houses until the children of Israel have all received their inheritance.

hausa: An fi son suna mai kyau fiye da wadata mai yawa; tagomashi kuma ya fi azurfa ko zinariya.
english: A good name is more desirable than great riches, and loving favor is better than silver and gold.

hausa: Mordekai ya yi rubutu da sunan Sarki Zerzes, ya hatimce saƙonin da zoben hatimin sarki, ya kuma aika da su ta hannun masu ’yan aika a kan dawakai, waɗanda sukan hau dawakai masu gudu sosai, da aka yi kiwonsu musamman saboda sarki.
english: He wrote in the name of King Ahasuerus, and sealed it with the king’s ring, and sent letters by courier on horseback, riding on royal horses that were bred from swift steeds.

hausa: Game da Ishmayel kuwa, na ji ka. Tabbatacce zan albarkace shi, zan sa yă azurta, zai kuma ƙaru ƙwarai. Zai zama mahaifin masu mulki goma sha biyu, zan kuma maishe shi babban al’umma!
english: As for Ishmael, I have heard you. Behold, I have blessed him, and will make him fruitful, and will multiply him exceedingly. He will become the father of twelve princes, and I will make him a great nation.

hausa: “Duk da haka kun ce, ‘Hanyar Ubangiji ba daidai ba ce.’ Ka ji, ya gidan Isra’ila. Hanyata ba daidai ba ce?
english: “Yet you say, ‘The way of the Lord is not equal.’ Hear now, house of Israel: Is my way not equal? Aren’t your ways unequal?

hausa: Za ku ba su nunan fari na hatsinku, da sabon ruwan inabinku, da manku, da kuma gashi na fari daga askin da kuka yi na tumakinku.
english: You shall give him the first fruits of your grain, of your new wine, and of your oil, and the first of the fleece of your sheep.

hausa: “ ‘A rana ta bakwai a miƙa bijimai bakwai, raguna biyu da ’yan raguna goma sha huɗu, bana ɗaya-ɗaya, dukansu marasa lahani.
english: “‘On the seventh day: seven bulls, two rams, fourteen male lambs a year old without defect;

hausa: Sai Yahudawa suka ce, “Dubi yadda yake ƙaunarsa!”
english: The Jews therefore said, “See how much affection he had for him!”

hausa: Yayel ta fito ta taryi Sisera ta ce masa, “Ranka yă daɗe, ka shigo, ka shigo ciki. Kada ka ji tsoro.” Saboda haka ya shiga cikin tentinta, sai ta rufe shi da bargo.
english: Jael went out to meet Sisera, and said to him, “Turn in, my lord, turn in to me; don’t be afraid.” He came in to her into the tent, and she covered him with a rug.

hausa: “Amma in firist ya zo ya bincika gidan kuma cutar fatar jiki da take ta rigar ba tă bazu ba bayan an yi wa gidan shafe, zai furta gidan tsarkakakke, domin cutar ta tafi.
english: “If the priest shall come in, and examine it, and behold, the plague hasn’t spread in the house, after the house was plastered, then the priest shall pronounce the house clean, because the plague is healed.

hausa: Zai kuma aiko mala’ikunsa su tattaro zaɓaɓɓunsa daga kusurwoyi huɗun nan, daga iyakar duniya har yă zuwa iyakar sama.
english: Then he will send out his angels, and will gather together his chosen ones from the four winds, from the ends of the earth to the ends of the sky.

hausa: Suka firfito daga kaburbura, sa’an nan bayan tashin Yesu daga matattu, suka shiga birni mai tsarki, suka bayyana ga mutane da yawa.
english: and coming out of the tombs after his resurrection, they entered into the holy city and appeared to many.

hausa: amma ina nuna ƙauna ga tsara dubbai na waɗanda suke ƙaunata, suke kuma kiyaye umarnaina.
english: and showing loving kindness to thousands of those who love me and keep my commandments.

hausa: Waɗannan ne rayayyun halittun da na gani a ƙarƙashin Allah na Isra’ila kusa da Kogin Kebar, na kuma gane cewa su kerubobi ne.
english: This is the living creature that I saw under the God of Israel by the river Chebar; and I knew that they were cherubim.

hausa: Sa’an nan kaina zai ɗaukaka a bisa abokan gābana waɗanda suka kewaye ni; a tabanakul nasa zan miƙa hadaya da sowa ta farin ciki; zan rera in kuma yi kiɗi ga Ubangiji.
english: Now my head will be lifted up above my enemies around me. I will offer sacrifices of joy in his tent. I will sing, yes, I will sing praises to Yahweh.

hausa: sai ya aiki manzanni zuwa Yabesh Gileyad a ce musu, “Ubangiji yă albarkace ku saboda alherin da kuka nuna wa Shawulu ta wurin binne shi.
english: David sent messengers to the men of Jabesh Gilead, and said to them, “Blessed are you by Yahweh, that you have shown this kindness to your lord, even to Saul, and have buried him.

hausa: Yanzu kuwa ’yata kada ki ji tsoro. Zan yi miki dukan abin da kika roƙa. Dukan ’yan’uwana na gari sun san cewa ke mace ce mai halin kirki.
english: Now, my daughter, don’t be afraid. I will do to you all that you say; for all the city of my people knows that you are a worthy woman.

hausa: Sarkin Ammonawa ya ce wa jakadu, “Sa’ad da Isra’ilawa suka fito daga Masar, sun ƙwace mini ƙasa tun daga Arnon zuwa Yabbok, har zuwa Urdun. Yanzu ka mayar mini ita cikin salama.”
english: The king of the children of Ammon answered the messengers of Jephthah, “Because Israel took away my land when he came up out of Egypt, from the Arnon even to the Jabbok, and to the Jordan. Now therefore restore that territory again peaceably.”

hausa: Duk birnin ya ruɗe, mutane suka zaburo da gudu daga kowane gefe. Suka kama Bulus, suka ja shi daga haikali, nan da nan aka rurrufe ƙofofi.
english: All the city was moved and the people ran together. They seized Paul and dragged him out of the temple. Immediately the doors were shut.

hausa: Abin da na faɗa muku, na faɗa wa kowa. ‘Ku yi tsaro!’ ”
english: What I tell you, I tell all: Watch!”

hausa: Ubangiji ya ce wa Yoshuwa, “Kada ka ji tsoronsu; na ba ka su a hannunka. Ba waninsu da zai iya tsayayya da kai.”
english: Yahweh said to Joshua, “Don’t fear them, for I have delivered them into your hands. Not a man of them will stand before you.”

hausa: Bari su yi godiya ga Ubangiji saboda ƙaunarsa marar ƙarewa da kuma ayyukansa masu banmamaki saboda mutane,
english: Let them praise Yahweh for his loving kindness, for his wonderful deeds to the children of men!

hausa: “Ga abin da za ka miƙa a bisa bagaden kowace rana. ’Yan raguna biyu masu shekara ɗaya-ɗaya.
english: “Now this is that which you shall offer on the altar: two lambs a year old day by day continually.

hausa: Gama in da niyyar bayarwa, za a karɓi bayarwa bisa ga abin da mutum yake da shi, ba bisa ga abin da ba shi da shi ba.
english: For if the readiness is there, it is acceptable according to what you have, not according to what you don’t have.

hausa: Kakannin-kakanninmu sun ci Manna a hamada; kamar yadda yake a rubuce, ‘Ya ba su burodi daga sama su ci.’”
english: Our fathers ate the manna in the wilderness. As it is written, ‘He gave them bread out of heaven to eat.’”

hausa: “ ‘Ba za a ci naman da ya taɓa wani abu marar tsarki ba; dole a ƙone shi. Game da sauran nama, kowa da yake mai tsarki zai iya ci.
english: “‘The meat that touches any unclean thing shall not be eaten. It shall be burned with fire. As for the meat, everyone who is clean may eat it;

hausa: Duk wanda yake wa maƙwabcinsa daɗin baki yana sa wa ƙafafunsa tarko ne.
english: A man who flatters his neighbor spreads a net for his feet.

hausa: Sa’ad da sarki ya zauna kan kujerarsa don yă yi shari’a, yakan ga dukan mugunta da idanunsa.
english: A king who sits on the throne of judgment scatters away all evil with his eyes.

hausa: Zai ci kwanakinsa a wadace, kuma zuriyarsa za su gāji ƙasar.
english: His soul will dwell at ease. His offspring will inherit the land.

hausa: “ ‘Mutanen Aram sun yi ciniki da ke saboda yawan kayanki; suka sayi kayan cinikinki da zumurrudu, da shunayya, da kayan ado, da lilin mai taushi, da murjani, da yakutu.
english: “‘“Syria was your merchant by reason of the multitude of your handiworks. They traded for your wares with emeralds, purple, embroidered work, fine linen, coral, and rubies.

hausa: Gama kafin girbi, sa’ad da furanni suka karkaɗe furanni kuma suka zama ’ya’yan inabin da suka nuna, zai faffalle rassan kuringar inabi da wuƙa, ya yanke ya kuma kwashe rassan da suka bazu.
english: For before the harvest, when the blossom is over, and the flower becomes a ripening grape, he will cut off the sprigs with pruning hooks, and he will cut down and take away the spreading branches.

hausa: A hannunsa na dama ƙuri’a don Urushalima za tă fito, inda zai kafa dundurusai, ya ba da umarni kisa, a yi kururuwar yaƙi, a kafa dundurusai a kan ƙofofi, a gina mahaurai a kuma yi ƙawanya.
english: In his right hand was the lot for Jerusalem, to set battering rams, to open the mouth in the slaughter, to lift up the voice with shouting, to set battering rams against the gates, to cast up mounds, and to build forts.

hausa: Ni, Bulus, nake rubuta wannan da hannuna. Zan biya ka, kada ma a yi zancen ranka da kake riƙe mini bashi.
english: I, Paul, write this with my own hand: I will repay it (not to mention to you that you owe to me even your own self besides).

hausa: gama Ubangiji ya rufe kowace mahaifa a gidan Abimelek saboda Saratu, matar Ibrahim.
english: For Yahweh had closed up tight all the wombs of the house of Abimelech, because of Sarah, Abraham’s wife.

hausa: Kashegari da sassafe Yoshuwa ya tattara mutanensa, sai shi da shugabannin Isra’ilawa suka sha gaba suka taka zuwa Ai.
english: Joshua rose up early in the morning, mustered the people, and went up, he and the elders of Israel, before the people to Ai.

hausa: Amma masu adalci za su hukunta su irin da akan yi wa matan da suka yi zina suka kuma yi kisa, domin su mazinata ne kuma jini yana a hannuwansu.
english: Righteous men will judge them with the judgment of adulteresses and with the judgment of women who shed blood, because they are adulteresses, and blood is in their hands.

hausa: Bayan kwana uku, yayinda dukansu suna cikin zafi mikin kaciya, sai biyu daga cikin ’ya’yan Yaƙub maza, Simeyon da Lawi, ’yan’uwan Dina, suka ɗauki takubansu suka fāɗa wa birnin ba labari, suka kashe kowane namiji.
english: On the third day, when they were sore, two of Jacob’s sons, Simeon and Levi, Dinah’s brothers, each took his sword, came upon the unsuspecting city, and killed all the males.

hausa: “Kai, Allahna, ka bayyana ga bawanka cewa za ka gina gida dominsa. Ta haka bawanka ya sami ƙarfin gwiwa ya yi addu’a gare ka.
english: For you, my God, have revealed to your servant that you will build him a house. Therefore your servant has found courage to pray before you.

hausa: Sai Ubangiji ya ce wa Musa, “Zan yi yadda ka faɗa, gama ka sami tagomashi a wurina, na san ka, na kuma san sunanka.”
english: Yahweh said to Moses, “I will do this thing also that you have spoken; for you have found favor in my sight, and I know you by name.”

hausa: ta wurin ɗaukaka da ƙasƙanci, da cikin ɓata suna, da kuma cikin yabo. Cikin faɗin gaskiya, an ɗauke mu masu ƙarya,
english: by glory and dishonor, by evil report and good report, as deceivers and yet true,

hausa: Ya kawar da baƙin bagade da masujadai bisa tudu, ya farfashe keɓaɓɓun duwatsu, ya kuma sassare ginshiƙan Ashera.
english: for he took away the foreign altars and the high places, broke down the pillars, cut down the Asherah poles,

hausa: Ga abin da Allah Ubangiji ya ce, shi da ya halicci sammai ya kuma miƙe su, wanda ya shimfiɗa duniya da dukan abin da ya fito cikinta, wanda ya ba wa mutanenta numfashi, da rai ga waɗanda suke tafiya a kanta.
english: God Yahweh, he who created the heavens and stretched them out, he who spread out the earth and that which comes out of it, he who gives breath to its people and spirit to those who walk in it, says:

hausa: “Allahn da ya halicci duniya da kome da yake cikinta shi ne Ubangijin sama da ƙasa, ba ya kuma zama a haikalin da aka gina da hannuwa.
english: The God who made the world and all things in it, he, being Lord of heaven and earth, doesn’t dwell in temples made with hands.

hausa: da yamma kuwa, kafin a rufe ƙofar gari sai mutanen suka tafi. Ban san hanyar da suka bi ba, ku yi sauri ku bi su. Mai yiwuwa ku same su.”
english: About the time of the shutting of the gate, when it was dark, the men went out. Where the men went, I don’t know. Pursue them quickly. You may catch up with them.”

hausa: Saboda haka suka tattara su suka kuma cika kwanduna goma sha biyu na gutsattsarin burodin sha’ir biyar nan da suka ragu bayan kowa ya ci.
english: So they gathered them up, and filled twelve baskets with broken pieces from the five barley loaves, which were left over by those who had eaten.

hausa: “Ku tambayi ’yan ƙasar Shekem, ‘Wanne ya fi muku, a sa dukan ’ya’yan Yerub-Ba’al saba’in maza su yi mulkinku, ko dai mutum guda kawai yă yi mulkinku?’ Ku tuna, ni jininku ne.”
english: “Please speak in the ears of all the men of Shechem, ‘Is it better for you that all the sons of Jerubbaal, who are seventy persons, rule over you, or that one rule over you?’ Remember also that I am your bone and your flesh.”

hausa: Amma macijin nan ba shi da isashen ƙarfi, har suka rasa matsayinsu a sama.
english: They didn’t prevail. No place was found for them any more in heaven.

hausa: Da ya fara ƙididdigar, sai aka kawo masa wani wanda yake bin bashin talenti dubu goma.
english: When he had begun to settle, one was brought to him who owed him ten thousand talents.

hausa: sai yă biya mahaifin yarinyar shekel hamsin na azurfa. Dole yă auri yarinyar, gama ya yi lalata da ita. Ba zai taɓa sake ta ba muddin ransa.
english: then the man who lay with her shall give to the lady’s father fifty shekels of silver. She shall be his wife, because he has humbled her. He may not put her away all his days.

english: Those on the rock are they who, when they hear, receive the word with joy; but these have no root. They believe for a while, then fall away in time of temptation.

english: and, ‘On their hands they will bear you up, lest perhaps you dash your foot against a stone.’”

hausa: masu cin amana, marasa hankali, waɗanda sun cika da ɗaga kai, masu son jin daɗi a maimakon ƙaunar Allah
english: traitors, headstrong, conceited, lovers of pleasure rather than lovers of God,

hausa: Gomer ta sāke ɗauki ciki ta kuma haifi ’ya mace. Sai Ubangiji ya ce wa Hosiya, “Ka ba ta suna, Lo-Ruhama, gama ba zan ƙara nuna wa gidan Isra’ila ƙauna ba, har da zan gafarta musu.
english: She conceived again, and bore a daughter. Then he said to him, “Call her name Lo-Ruhamah, for I will no longer have mercy on the house of Israel, that I should in any way pardon them.

hausa: Abram yana da shekaru 86 sa’ad da Hagar ta haifa masa Ishmayel.
english: Abram was eighty-six years old when Hagar bore Ishmael to Abram.

hausa: Tsuntsu mai farauta bai san hanyarta ba, ba shahon da ya taɓa ganin ta.
english: That path no bird of prey knows, neither has the falcon’s eye seen it.

hausa: Za a kashe mutanenku a cikinku, za ku kuwa sani ni ne Ubangiji.
english: The slain will fall among you, and you will know that I am Yahweh.

hausa: Wannan ya sa sarki ya fusata ƙwarai, ya ba da umarni a tafi da dukan masu hikima na Babilon a kashe su.
english: Because of this, the king was angry and very furious, and commanded that all the wise men of Babylon be destroyed.

hausa: Suka auri ’ya’yansu mata, su ma suka bar ’ya’yansu maza suka auri ’ya’yansu mata, suka kuma yi wa gumakansu sujada.
english: They took their daughters to be their wives, and gave their own daughters to their sons and served their gods.

hausa: shi ne mutumin da zai zauna a bisa, wanda mafakarsa za tă zama kagarar dutse. Za a tanada abincinsa, kuma ruwa ba zai kāsa masa ba.
english: he will dwell on high. His place of defense will be the fortress of rocks. His bread will be supplied. His waters will be sure.

hausa: Amma in mijin ya warware su sa’ad da ya ji, to, ba wani alkawari ko rantsuwar da ya fito daga leɓunanta da zai tabbata. Mijinta ya warware su, Ubangiji kuma zai gafarce ta.
english: But if her husband made them null and void in the day that he heard them, then whatever proceeded out of her lips concerning her vows, or concerning the bond of her soul, shall not stand. Her husband has made them void. Yahweh will forgive her.

hausa: Nufinsa shi ne, yanzu, ta wurin ikkilisiya, a sanar da hikima iri dabam-dabam na Allah ga masu mulki, da masu iko a samaniya.
english: to the intent that now through the assembly the manifold wisdom of God might be made known to the principalities and the powers in the heavenly places,

hausa: Waɗannan su ne ƙa’idodi a kan wanda yake ɗiga, da wanda yake zubar da maniyyi,
english: This is the law of him who has a discharge, and of him who has an emission of semen, so that he is unclean by it;

hausa: Duk da haka, Allah bai ji daɗin yawancinsu ba; gawawwakinsu kuwa suka bazu ko’ina a cikin hamada.
english: However with most of them, God was not well pleased, for they were overthrown in the wilderness.

hausa: “ ‘Mahaifiyarku kamar kuringa ce a cikin gonar inabi da aka shuka kusa da ruwa; ta ba da ’ya’ya da kuma cikakkun rassa saboda yalwan ruwa.
english: “‘Your mother was like a vine in your blood, planted by the waters. It was fruitful and full of branches by reason of many waters.

hausa: Isra’ila suka ci dukan biranen Amoriyawa, suka kuma zauna a cikinsu, haɗe da babban birnin Heshbon da dukan ƙauyukanta.
english: Israel took all these cities. Israel lived in all the cities of the Amorites, in Heshbon, and in all its villages.

hausa: Yaƙub ya dawo gida wurin mahaifinsa Ishaku a Mamre, kusa da Kiriyat Arba (wato, Hebron), inda Ibrahim da Ishaku suka zauna.
english: Jacob came to Isaac his father, to Mamre, to Kiriath Arba (which is Hebron), where Abraham and Isaac lived as foreigners.

hausa: Sai Yesu ya tambayi Sha Biyun, “Ku ma za ku tafi ne?”
english: Jesus said therefore to the twelve, “You don’t also want to go away, do you?”

hausa: Idan ƙasar mallakarku ƙazantacciya ce, sai ku haye zuwa ƙasar Ubangiji, inda tabanakul yake, mu zauna tare. Amma kada ku yi wa Ubangiji, ko kuma ku yi mana tawaye ta wurin gina wa kanku bagade wanda ba na Ubangiji Allahnmu ba.
english: However, if the land of your possession is unclean, then pass over to the land of the possession of Yahweh, in which Yahweh’s tabernacle dwells, and take possession among us; but don’t rebel against Yahweh, nor rebel against us, in building an altar other than Yahweh our God’s altar.

hausa: “Kome a Isra’ila da aka keɓe wa Ubangiji, zai zama naka.
english: “Everything devoted in Israel shall be yours.

hausa: Gefen Urdun shi ne iyakar mutanen Ruben. Waɗannan garuruwa da ƙauyukansu su ne gādon mutanen Ruben, bisa ga iyalansu.
english: The border of the children of Reuben was the bank of the Jordan. This was the inheritance of the children of Reuben according to their families, the cities and its villages.

hausa: “Ɗan mutum, na mai da kai mai tsaro bisa gidan Isra’ila; saboda haka ka ji abin da zan faɗa ka kuma gargaɗe su.
english: “So you, son of man, I have set you a watchman to the house of Israel. Therefore hear the word from my mouth, and give them warnings from me.

hausa: Daga kursiyin hasken walƙiya yana ta fitowa, da ƙararraki da kuma tsawa. A gaban kursiyin, fitilu bakwai suna ci. Waɗannan ne ruhohi bakwai na Allah.
english: Out of the throne proceed lightnings, sounds, and thunders. There were seven lamps of fire burning before his throne, which are the seven Spirits of God.

hausa: “Abin da kalmomin nan suke nufi shi ne, “Mene, Allah ya ƙayyade yawan kwanakin mulkinka ya kuma kawo su ga ƙarshe.
english: “This is the interpretation of the thing: MENE: God has counted your kingdom, and brought it to an end.

hausa: Jariri zai yi wasa kurkusa da ramin gamsheƙa, ɗan yaro kuma zai sa hannunsa a ramin maciji mai mugun dafi.
english: The nursing child will play near a cobra’s hole, and the weaned child will put his hand on the viper’s den.

hausa: Game da jakunan da suka ɓace kwana uku kuwa, kada ka damu, an same su. Ga wane ne Isra’ila ta sa dukan zuciya, in ba ga kai da kuma dukan iyalin mahaifinka ba?”
english: As for your donkeys who were lost three days ago, don’t set your mind on them, for they have been found. For whom does all Israel desire? Is it not you and all your father’s house?”

hausa: Iliya ya je gaban mutane ya ce, “Har yaushe za ku yi ta yawo tsakanin ra’ayoyi biyu? In Ubangiji ne Allah, ku bi shi; amma in Ba’al Allah ne, ku bi shi.” Mutane dai ba su ce uffam ba.
english: Elijah came near to all the people, and said, “How long will you waver between the two sides? If Yahweh is God, follow him; but if Baal, then follow him.” The people didn’t say a word.

hausa: Na zo wurin masu zaman bautan da suke zama a Tel Abib kusa da Kogin Kebar, A can kuwa, inda suke zama, na zauna a cikinsu kwana bakwai, ina mamaki.
english: Then I came to them of the captivity at Tel Aviv who lived by the river Chebar, and to where they lived; and I sat there overwhelmed among them seven days.

hausa: “Amma ke, Betlehem ta Efrata, ko da yake ke ƙarama ce daga cikin zuriyarki a Yahuda, daga cikinki wani zai zo domina wanda zai yi mulkin Isra’ila, wanda asalinsa tun fil azal ne.”
english: But you, Bethlehem Ephrathah, being small among the clans of Judah, out of you one will come out to me who is to be ruler in Israel; whose goings out are from of old, from ancient times.

hausa: “Mutum zai iya karye ƙarfe ƙarfe daga arewa, ko tagulla?
english: Can one break iron, even iron from the north, and bronze?

hausa: Yanzu ka tafi ka yaƙi Amalekawa, ka hallaka kome da yake nasu, kada ka bar su da rai, ka kashe maza, da mata, da yara, da jarirai, da dabbobi, da tumaki, da raƙuma, da kuma jakuna.’ ”
english: Now go and strike Amalek, and utterly destroy all that they have, and don’t spare them; but kill both man and woman, infant and nursing baby, ox and sheep, camel and donkey.’”

hausa: Kuma ta yaya za su yi wa’azi in ba an aike su ba? Kamar yadda yake a rubuce cewa, “Isowar masu kawo labari mai daɗi abu mai kyau ne ƙwarai!”
english: And how will they preach unless they are sent? As it is written: “How beautiful are the feet of those who preach the Good News of peace, who bring glad tidings of good things!”

hausa: Game da mutumin da ya aikata wannan, ko wane ne shi, bari Ubangiji yă yanke shi daga tentunan Yaƙub, ko da ma ya kawo hadayu ga Ubangiji Maɗaukaki.
english: Yahweh will cut off the man who does this, him who wakes and him who answers, out of the tents of Jacob and him who offers an offering to Yahweh of Armies.

hausa: Sai shugabannin gidajen iyalan Gileyad ɗan Makir, ɗan Manasse, waɗanda suka fito daga kabilar zuriyar Yusuf, suka zo, suka yi magana a gaban Musa da shugabanni, shugabannin iyalan Isra’ilawa.
english: The heads of the fathers’ households of the family of the children of Gilead, the son of Machir, the son of Manasseh, of the families of the sons of Joseph, came near and spoke before Moses and before the princes, the heads of the fathers’ households of the children of Israel.

hausa: Firistoci suka yarda cewa ba za su sāke karɓan kuɗi daga mutane ba, kuma ba za su yi gyaran haikalin da kansu ba.
english: The priests consented that they should take no more money from the people, and not repair the damage to the house.

hausa: Amma sa’ad da kana azumi, ka shafa wa kanka mai, ka wanke fuskarka,
english: But you, when you fast, anoint your head and wash your face,

hausa: Yau sai ku mayar musu da gonakinsu, da gonakin inabinsu, da na zaitunsu, da gidajensu, da kashi ɗaya bisa ɗari na kuɗi, da na hatsi, da na ruwan inabi, da na mai, waɗanda kuka karɓa a wurinsu.”
english: Please restore to them, even today, their fields, their vineyards, their olive groves, and their houses, also the hundredth part of the money, and of the grain, the new wine, and the oil, that you are charging them.”

hausa: na kuma sunkuya na yi wa Ubangiji sujada. Na yabi Ubangiji Allah na maigidana Ibrahim wanda ya bi da ni a hanyar da take daidai, don in samo wa ɗan maigidana jikanyar ɗan’uwansa.
english: I bowed my head, and worshiped Yahweh, and blessed Yahweh, the God of my master Abraham, who had led me in the right way to take my master’s brother’s daughter for his son.

hausa: sun jawo miki wannan, domin ki yi ta kai da kawowa cikin ƙasashe kina ƙazantar da kanki da gumakansu.
english: These things will be done to you because you have played the prostitute after the nations, and because you are polluted with their idols.

hausa: Ke lambu ne da aka kulle, ’yar’uwata, amaryata; ke maɓulɓula ce da aka kewaye, maɓulɓular da aka rufe.
english: My sister, my bride, is a locked up garden; a locked up spring, a sealed fountain.

hausa: “Ɗaukaka ga Allah a can cikin sama, a duniya kuma salama ga mutane waɗanda tagomashinsa yake bisansu.”
english: “Glory to God in the highest, on earth peace, good will toward men.”

hausa: Saboda haka Yaƙub ya yi bauta shekaru bakwai domin a ba shi Rahila, amma shekarun suka zama kamar ’yan kwanaki ne kawai gare shi saboda ƙaunar da yake mata.
english: Jacob served seven years for Rachel. They seemed to him but a few days, for the love he had for her.

hausa: Saboda haka Elifaz mutumin Teman, Bildad mutumin Shuwa da Zofar mutumin Na’ama, suka yi abin da Ubangiji ya gaya masu; Ubangiji kuma ya karɓi addu’ar Ayuba.
english: So Eliphaz the Temanite and Bildad the Shuhite and Zophar the Naamathite went and did what Yahweh commanded them, and Yahweh accepted Job.

hausa: Amma bai kamata a sami matalauci a cikinku ba, gama Ubangiji Allahnku zai albarkace ku a ƙasar da yake ba ku, ku mallaka a matsayin gādo,
english: However there will be no poor with you (for Yahweh will surely bless you in the land which Yahweh your God gives you for an inheritance to possess)

hausa: Manyan da ƙanana suna a can, bawa kuma ya sami ’yanci daga wurin maigidansa.
english: The small and the great are there. The servant is free from his master.

hausa: Manzon ya ce wa Dawuda, “Mutanen sun sha kanmu suka fito suka yaƙe mu a fili, amma muka kore su har ƙofar birni.
english: The messenger said to David, “The men prevailed against us, and came out to us into the field; and we were on them even to the entrance of the gate.

hausa: “Ka yi ’yan wandunan ciki na lilin don su rufe tsiraicinsu, tsayinsu zai kama daga kwankwaso zuwa cinya.
english: You shall make them linen pants to cover their naked flesh. They shall reach from the waist even to the thighs.

hausa: Sai wani mutum ya ce wa Shawulu, “Duba, ga mutane suna zunubi ga Ubangiji, suna cin nama da jini.” Shawulu ya ce, “Kun ci amana. Ku mirgino babban dutse zuwa wurina nan da nan.”
english: Then they told Saul, saying, “Behold, the people are sinning against Yahweh, in that they eat meat with the blood.” He said, “You have dealt treacherously. Roll a large stone to me today!”

hausa: Wannan shi ne zuriyar Isuwa, kakan mutanen Edom, a ƙasar tuddai na Seyir.
english: This is the history of the generations of Esau the father of the Edomites in the hill country of Seir:

hausa: In mutum ya haƙa rami, shi zai fāɗi a ciki; in mutum ya mirgino dutse, dutsen zai mirgine a kansa.
english: Whoever digs a pit shall fall into it. Whoever rolls a stone, it will come back on him.

hausa: Amma ina gaya muku, za a fi jin tausayin Taya da Sidon a ranar shari’a, fiye da ku.
english: But I tell you, it will be more tolerable for Tyre and Sidon on the day of judgment than for you.

hausa: In ba itace wuta takan mutu; haka kuma in ba mai gulma ba za a yi faɗa ba.
english: For lack of wood a fire goes out. Without gossip, a quarrel dies down.

hausa: Kakanninku ba su yi irin waɗannan abubuwa ba, har Allahnmu ya kawo dukan masifun nan a kanmu da kuma a kan wannan birni? Yanzu kuna tsokanar fushi mai yawa a kan Isra’ila ta wurin ƙazantar da Asabbaci.”
english: Didn’t your fathers do this, and didn’t our God bring all this evil on us and on this city? Yet you bring more wrath on Israel by profaning the Sabbath.”

hausa: Sun yi wa Ubangiji sujada, amma kuma suka zaɓi mutanensu su yi musu hidima a matsayin firistoci a masujadan da suke kan tuddai.
english: So they feared Yahweh, and also made from among themselves priests of the high places for themselves, who sacrificed for them in the houses of the high places.

hausa: Haske na gaskiya da yake ba da haske ga kowane mutum mai shigowa duniya.
english: The true light that enlightens everyone was coming into the world.

hausa: sai da na shiga wuri mai tsarki na Allah; sa’an nan na gane abin da ƙarshensu zai zama.
english: until I entered God’s sanctuary, and considered their latter end.

hausa: bisa mutanen Yahuda shi ne, Elihu, ɗan’uwan Dawuda; bisa mutanen Issakar shi ne, Omri ɗan Mika’ilu;
english: of Judah, Elihu, one of the brothers of David; of Issachar, Omri the son of Michael;

hausa: Manyan Isra’ilawa waɗanda shugabannin gandun Fir’auna suka naɗa, suka sha dūka, aka kuma yi musu tambayoyi ana cewa, “Don me ba ku cika yawan tubula na jiya da na yau kamar yadda kuka saba ba?”
english: The officers of the children of Israel, whom Pharaoh’s taskmasters had set over them, were beaten, and were asked, “Why haven’t you fulfilled your quota both yesterday and today, in making brick as before?”

hausa: To, in mun mutu tare da Kiristi, mun gaskata cewa za mu rayu tare da shi kuma.
english: But if we died with Christ, we believe that we will also live with him,

hausa: Ruhohin annabawa kuwa suna ƙarƙashin sarrafawar annabawa.
english: The spirits of the prophets are subject to the prophets,

hausa: Daga yanzu, za a iske mutum biyar a gida ɗaya sun rabu, suna gāba da juna, uku suna gāba da biyu, biyun suna gāba da ukun.
english: For from now on, there will be five in one house divided, three against two, and two against three.

hausa: Na sa jeji yă zama gidansa ƙasar gishiri kuma ta zama wurin zamansa.
english: whose home I have made the wilderness, and the salt land his dwelling place?

hausa: Abu guda na roƙi Ubangiji, wannan shi ne na nema, cewa in zauna a gidan Ubangiji dukan kwanakin raina, in dubi kyan Ubangiji in kuma neme shi a cikin haikalinsa.
english: One thing I have asked of Yahweh, that I will seek after: that I may dwell in Yahweh’s house all the days of my life, to see Yahweh’s beauty, and to inquire in his temple.

hausa: Za a ba da kofi na rubutacciyar dokar a matsayin ƙa’ida a kowane lardi, a kuma sanar wa mutanen kowace ƙasa, domin Yahudawa su zauna da shiri a ranar, domin su ɗau fansa a kan maƙiyansu.
english: A copy of the letter, that the decree should be given out in every province, was published to all the peoples, that the Jews should be ready for that day to avenge themselves on their enemies.

hausa: Suna kama da yaran da suke zama a bakin kasuwa, suna kiran juna, suna cewa, “ ‘Mun busa muku sarewa, amma ba ku yi rawa ba, Mun kuma yi muku waƙar makoki, ba ku kuma yi kuka ba.’
english: They are like children who sit in the marketplace and call to one another, saying, ‘We piped to you, and you didn’t dance. We mourned, and you didn’t weep.’

hausa: Shawulu ya ce, “Ba wanda zai mutu yau, gama Ubangiji ya kuɓutar da Isra’ila a wannan rana.”
english: Saul said, “No man shall be put to death today; for today Yahweh has rescued Israel.”

hausa: ’Yar’uwar Tafenes ta haifi masa ɗa wanda ya kira Genubat, wanda Tafenes ta yi renonsa a fadan sarki. A can, Genubat ya yi zama da ’ya’yan Fir’auna.
english: The sister of Tahpenes bore him Genubath his son, whom Tahpenes weaned in Pharaoh’s house; and Genubath was in Pharaoh’s house among the sons of Pharaoh.

hausa: sam, ba zai taɓa fahimci abin da Allah yake yi ba. Iyakar ƙoƙarin da ka yi duk ba za ka iya ganewa ba. Masu hikima suna iya cewa sun sani, amma kuwa ba su sani ba.
english: then I saw all the work of God, that man can’t find out the work that is done under the sun, because however much a man labors to seek it out, yet he won’t find it. Yes even though a wise man thinks he can comprehend it, he won’t be able to find it.

hausa: Duk wanda yake ji magana ne kawai, bai kuwa aikata abin da ta ce ba, yana kama da mutumin da ya kalli fuskarsa a madubi
english: For if anyone is a hearer of the word and not a doer, he is like a man looking at his natural face in a mirror;

hausa: Zakoki suna mutuwa domin ba dabbar da za su kashe su ci, ’ya’yan zakanya kuma sun watse.
english: The old lion perishes for lack of prey. The cubs of the lioness are scattered abroad.

hausa: ya kuma hana kowa yă ratsa da a filin haikali ɗauke da kayan ciniki.
english: He would not allow anyone to carry a container through the temple.

hausa: Kashegari, sai masu mulki, dattawa da kuma malaman dokoki suka taru a Urushalima.
english: In the morning, their rulers, elders, and scribes were gathered together in Jerusalem.

hausa: Sai Shadrak, Meshak da Abednego suka amsa wa sarki suka ce, “Ya Nebukadnezzar, ba mu bukata mu kāre kanmu a gabanka a kan wannan batu.
english: Shadrach, Meshach, and Abednego answered the king, “Nebuchadnezzar, we have no need to answer you in this matter.

hausa: Ina rubuta muku, ’ya’yana ƙaunatattu, domin kun san Uba. Ina rubuta muku, ubanni, domin kun san shi wanda yake tun farko. Ina rubuta muku, samari, domin kuna da ƙarfi, maganar Allah kuwa tana zaune a cikinku, kun kuma ci nasara a kan mugun nan.
english: I have written to you, fathers, because you know him who is from the beginning. I have written to you, young men, because you are strong, and the word of God remains in you, and you have overcome the evil one.

hausa: Tsoron da ka sa ake ji da kuma girman kan zuciyarka ya ruɗe ka, kai da kake zama a kogon dutse, kai da kake kan tudu. Ko da yake ka gina wa kanka sheƙa can bisa kamar na gaggafa, daga can zan sauko da kai ƙasa,” in ji Ubangiji.
english: As for your terror, the pride of your heart has deceived you, O you who dwell in the clefts of the rock, who hold the height of the hill, though you should make your nest as high as the eagle, I will bring you down from there,” says Yahweh.

hausa: Hannun Ubangiji kuwa ya yi nauyi a bisa Ashdod da kewayenta. Ya kawo hallaka ga dukansu, ya kuma buga su da marurai.
english: But Yahweh’s hand was heavy on the people of Ashdod, and he destroyed them and struck them with tumors, even Ashdod and its borders.

hausa: Za tă ci gaba da roƙonka ka yi mata jinƙai? Ko za tă yi maka magana a hankali?
english: Will he make many petitions to you, or will he speak soft words to you?

hausa: Sai Babiloniyawan suka zo wurinta, zuwa gadon soyayya, cikin kai da kawowarsu suka ƙazantar da ita. Bayan sun ƙazantar da ita, sai ta ji ƙyamarsu, ta rabu da su.
english: The Babylonians came to her into the bed of love, and they defiled her with their prostitution. She was polluted with them, and her soul was alienated from them.

hausa: Ku ce wa Allah, “Ayyukanka da banmamaki suke! Ikonka da girma yake har abokan gābanka suna durƙusa a gabanka.
english: Tell God, “How awesome are your deeds! Through the greatness of your power, your enemies submit themselves to you.

hausa: in kuka kuma ƙi farillaina, kuka yi ƙyamar dokokina, kuka kuma kāsa kiyaye umarnaina, har kuka karya alkawarina,
english: and if you shall reject my statutes, and if your soul abhors my ordinances, so that you will not do all my commandments, but break my covenant,

hausa: “Ku kuma, ya mutanen Yahuda, na shirya muku ranar girbi. “A duk sa’ad da zan mayar da dukiya wa mutanena,
english: “Also, Judah, there is a harvest appointed for you, when I restore the fortunes of my people.

hausa: Saboda haka na tafi na ɓoye shi a Fera, yadda Ubangiji ya ce mini.
english: So I went and hid it by the Euphrates, as Yahweh commanded me.

hausa: Ya tuttuɓe rigunarsa, ya kuma yi annabci a gaban Sama’ila. Ya kwanta tsirara dukan yini da dukan dare. Abin da ya sa ke nan mutane suke cewa, “Shawulu ma yana cikin annabawa ne?”
english: He also stripped off his clothes. He also prophesied before Samuel and lay down naked all that day and all that night. Therefore they say, “Is Saul also among the prophets?”

hausa: “Kada a faɗe shi a Gat, kada a yi shelarsa a titunan Ashkelon, don kada ’yan matan Filistiyawa su yi murna don kada ’yan matan marasa kaciya su yi farin ciki.
english: Don’t tell it in Gath. Don’t publish it in the streets of Ashkelon, lest the daughters of the Philistines rejoice, lest the daughters of the uncircumcised triumph.

hausa: Amma kai, ya Ubangiji, ka yi mini jinƙai, ka tā da ni, don in sāka musu.
english: But you, Yahweh, have mercy on me, and raise me up, that I may repay them.

hausa: Sa’ad da Samla ya mutu, Sha’ul daga Rehobot na kogi ya gāje shi a matsayin sarki.
english: Samlah died, and Shaul of Rehoboth by the River reigned in his place.

hausa: “ ‘Kada ka yi jima’i da matar mahaifinka, wannan zai ƙasƙantar da mahaifinka.
english: “‘You shall not uncover the nakedness of your father’s wife. It is your father’s nakedness.

hausa: Ka sāke mai da mu, ya Allah Mai Cetonmu, ka kau da rashin jin daɗinka daga gare mu.
english: Turn us, God of our salvation, and cause your indignation toward us to cease.

hausa: gama za a yi wa duk wanda bai nuna jinƙai ba hukunci babu jinƙai. Jinƙai yakan yi nasara a kan hukunci!
english: For judgment is without mercy to him who has shown no mercy. Mercy triumphs over judgment.

hausa: Hallaka da mutuwa suna cewa, ‘Jita-jitarta kaɗai muke ji.’
english: Destruction and Death say, ‘We have heard a rumor of it with our ears.’

hausa: suka tsokane Ubangiji ya yi fushi ta wurin mugayen ayyukansu, sai annoba ta ɓarke a cikinsu.
english: Thus they provoked him to anger with their deeds. The plague broke in on them.

hausa: Saboda haka Allah ya halicci mutum cikin siffarsa. Cikin kamannin Allah, Allah ya halicci mutum. Miji da mace ya halicce su.
english: God created man in his own image. In God’s image he created him; male and female he created them.

hausa: Nan da nan da Yusuf ya ga ’yan’uwansa, sai ya gane su, amma ya yi kamar baƙo, ya kuma yi musu magana da tsawa. Ya tambaya, “Daga ina kuka fito?” Suka amsa, “Daga ƙasar Kan’ana, don mu saya abinci.”
english: Joseph saw his brothers, and he recognized them, but acted like a stranger to them, and spoke roughly with them. He said to them, “Where did you come from?” They said, “From the land of Canaan, to buy food.”

hausa: Sai dukan jarumawansu suka tashi cikin dare suka tafi Bet-Shan suka saukar da gawar Shawulu da na ’ya’yansa daga kan katangan Bet-Shan suka tafi Yabesh inda suka ƙone su.
english: all the valiant men arose, went all night, and took the body of Saul and the bodies of his sons from the wall of Beth Shan; and they came to Jabesh and burned them there.

hausa: Ga wani, an ba shi saƙon hikima ta wurin Ruhu, ga wani baiwar saƙon sani ta wurin wannan Ruhu guda.
english: For to one is given through the Spirit the word of wisdom, and to another the word of knowledge according to the same Spirit,

hausa: “Ka sauko a kan Dutsen Sinai; ka yi musu magana daga sama. Ka ba su ƙa’idodi da dokokin da suke masu adalci da kuma daidai, ka ba su farillai da umarnai da suke da kyau.
english: “You also came down on Mount Sinai, and spoke with them from heaven, and gave them right ordinances and true laws, good statutes and commandments,

hausa: Haka ma, ka koya wa tsofaffin mata su zama masu bangirma cikin rayuwarsu, ba masu ɓata suna ko masu jarrabar shan giya ba, sai dai su zama masu koyar da abin da yake nagari.
english: and that older women likewise be reverent in behavior, not slanderers nor enslaved to much wine, teachers of that which is good,

hausa: Bayan haka, Ubangiji ya naɗa waɗansu mutum saba’in da biyu, ya aike su biyu-biyu, su riga shi yin gaba zuwa kowane gari da kowane wuri da zai shiga.
english: Now after these things, the Lord also appointed seventy others, and sent them two by two ahead of him into every city and place where he was about to come.

hausa: Bafilistin ya dubi Dawuda daga sama har ƙasa, ya gan dai ɗan yaro ne kawai, kyakkyawa kuma mai ƙoshin lafiya, sai ya rena shi.
english: When the Philistine looked around and saw David, he disdained him; for he was but a youth, and ruddy, and had a good looking face.

hausa: Ka nemi hikima, ka nemi fahimi; kada ka manta da kalmomina ko ka kauce daga gare su.
english: Get wisdom. Get understanding. Don’t forget, and don’t deviate from the words of my mouth.

hausa: Da mutanen suka iso wurin Yesu, sai suka ce, “Yohanna Mai Baftisma ne ya aike mu wurinka, mu yi tambaya, ‘Ko kai ne wanda zai zo, ko kuma mu saurari wani dabam?’ ”
english: When the men had come to him, they said, “John the Baptizer has sent us to you, saying, ‘Are you he who comes, or should we look for another?’”

hausa: Ka sa dukan waɗannan a hannun Haruna da ’ya’yansa maza, su kaɗa su a gaban Ubangiji a matsayin hadaya ta kaɗawa.
english: You shall put all of this in Aaron’s hands, and in his sons’ hands, and shall wave them for a wave offering before Yahweh.

hausa: Wanda ya kai harin zai yi yadda ya ga dama, ba wanda zai iya ja da shi. Zai kafa kansa a Kyakkyawar Ƙasa zai kuma sami ikon da zai hallaka ta.
english: But he who comes against him will do according to his own will, and no one will stand before him. He will stand in the glorious land, and destruction will be in his hand.

hausa: Amma Yesu ya yi shiru, bai kuwa amsa ba. Babban firist ya sāke tambayarsa ya ce, “Kai ne Kiristi, Ɗan Mai Albarka?”
english: But he stayed quiet, and answered nothing. Again the high priest asked him, “Are you the Christ, the Son of the Blessed?”

hausa: idan dai kun lura, kuka kiyaye umarnin da nake ba ku a yau, wato, ta wurin ƙaunar Ubangiji Allahnku, kuka kuma yi tafiya kullum cikin hanyoyinsa, to, sai ku keɓe ƙarin birane uku.
english: and if you keep all this commandment to do it, which I command you today, to love Yahweh your God, and to walk ever in his ways, then you shall add three cities more for yourselves, in addition to these three.

hausa: “Ai, ni ba a bakin kome nake ba ne, ta yaya zan iya amsa maka? Na rufe bakina da hannuna.
english: “Behold, I am of small account. What will I answer you? I lay my hand on my mouth.

hausa: Kafinta yakan gwada katako yă kuma zāna siffar da alli; yă goge shi da kayan aiki yă kuma zāna shi da alƙalami. Yă siffanta shi a kamannin mutum, mutum cikin dukan darajarsa, don yă ajiye shi a cikin masujada.
english: The carpenter stretches out a line. He marks it out with a pencil. He shapes it with planes. He marks it out with compasses, and shapes it like the figure of a man, with the beauty of a man, to reside in a house.

hausa: Da ya ɗaga idanu, sai ya ga ɗan’uwansa Benyamin, ɗan mahaifiyarsa, sai ya yi tambaya, “Wannan ne ƙaramin ɗan’uwanku, wanda kuka faɗa mini a kai?” Ya kuma ce, “Allah yă yi maka albarka, ɗana.”
english: He lifted up his eyes, and saw Benjamin, his brother, his mother’s son, and said, “Is this your youngest brother, of whom you spoke to me?” He said, “God be gracious to you, my son.”

hausa: Zan albarkaci duk wanda ya albarkace ka, in kuma la’anci duk wanda ya la’anta ka, dukan mutanen duniya za su sami albarka ta wurinka.”
english: I will bless those who bless you, and I will curse him who treats you with contempt. All the families of the earth will be blessed through you.”

hausa: Ga duk cikakke na ga kāsawa; amma umarnanka ba su da iyaka.
english: I have seen a limit to all perfection, but your commands are boundless. MEM

hausa: Yaƙub da dukan mutanen da suke tare da shi suka zo Luz (wato, Betel) a ƙasar Kan’ana.
english: So Jacob came to Luz (that is, Bethel), which is in the land of Canaan, he and all the people who were with him.

hausa: Sa’an nan a rana ta takwas, tilas yă kawo wa firist ’yan kurciyoyi biyu, ko kuma ’yan tattabarai biyu a bakin ƙofar Tentin Sujada.
english: On the eighth day he shall bring two turtledoves or two young pigeons to the priest, to the door of the Tent of Meeting.

hausa: Na ƙi jinin dukan abubuwan da na yi wahala ina yi a duniya, gama dole in bar su wa na bayana.
english: I hated all my labor in which I labored under the sun, because I must leave it to the man who comes after me.

hausa: “Yanzu, ɗan mutum, ka ɗauki tubalin yumɓu, ka ajiye shi a gabanka ka kuma zāna birnin Urushalima a kansa.
english: “You also, son of man, take a tile, and lay it before yourself, and portray on it a city, even Jerusalem.

hausa: Fitilar Ubangiji kan bincika zuciyar mutum takan bincika lamirinsa.
english: The spirit of man is Yahweh’s lamp, searching all his innermost parts.

hausa: Kuna tsaye a nan don ku yi alkawari da Ubangiji Allahnku, alkawarin da Ubangiji yake yi ta wurin rantsuwa da ku a wannan rana,
english: that you may enter into the covenant of Yahweh your God, and into his oath, which Yahweh your God makes with you today,

hausa: “Za ku yi kuka kuna cewa, ‘Wayyo, takobin Ubangiji sai yaushe za ka huta? Ka koma kubenka; ka huta, ka yi shiru.’
english: “‘You sword of Yahweh, how long will it be before you are quiet? Put yourself back into your scabbard; rest, and be still.’

hausa: A cikin ganimar, na ga doguwar riga mai kyau irin ta Babilon, da shekel ɗari biyu na azurfa, da kuma sandan zinariya mai nauyin shekel hamsin, sai raina ya so su, na kuwa kwashe su. Na tona rami a cikin ƙasa a tentina; na ɓoye.”
english: When I saw among the plunder a beautiful Babylonian robe, two hundred shekels of silver, and a wedge of gold weighing fifty shekels, then I coveted them and took them. Behold, they are hidden in the ground in the middle of my tent, with the silver under it.”

hausa: “Ya ku mutane, don me kuke yin haka? Ai, mu ma mutane ne kawai, ’yan adam ne kamar ku. Mun kawo muku labari mai daɗi ne, muna gaya muku ku juya daga waɗannan abubuwa banza, ku juyo ga Allah mai rai, wanda ya yi sama da ƙasa da teku da kuma dukan abin da yake cikinsu.
english: “Men, why are you doing these things? We also are men of the same nature as you, and bring you good news, that you should turn from these vain things to the living God, who made the sky, the earth, the sea, and all that is in them;

hausa: Saboda haka ya ba da su ga aiki mai wuya; suka yi tuntuɓe, kuma ba mai taimako.
english: Therefore he brought down their heart with labor. They fell down, and there was no one to help.

hausa: Yosiya yana da shekara takwas sa’ad da ya zama sarki, ya kuma yi mulki shekara talatin da ɗaya a Urushalima. Sunan mahaifiyarsa Yedida ’yar Adahiya; mutuniyar Bozkat.
english: Josiah was eight years old when he began to reign, and he reigned thirty-one years in Jerusalem. His mother’s name was Jedidah the daughter of Adaiah of Bozkath.

hausa: Har yă zuwa yau ba su ƙasƙantar da kansu ko su nuna bangirma, ko su kiyaye dokata da ƙa’idodin da na sa a gabanku da kakanninku ba.
english: They are not humbled even to this day, neither have they feared, nor walked in my law, nor in my statutes, that I set before you and before your fathers.’

hausa: Shekara-shekara Sama’ila yakan fita rangadi zuwa Betel, da Gilgal da Mizfa inda yakan yi musu shari’a.
english: He went from year to year in a circuit to Bethel, Gilgal, and Mizpah; and he judged Israel in all those places.

hausa: Ya umarci Yahuda su nemi Ubangiji Allah na kakanninsu, su kuma yi biyayya da dokoki da kuma umarnansa.
english: and commanded Judah to seek Yahweh, the God of their fathers, and to obey his law and command.

hausa: Suka kawo kan Ish-Boshet wa Dawuda a Hebron, suka ce wa sarki, “Ga kan Ish-Boshet ɗan Shawulu, maƙiyinka, wanda ya nemi yă kashe ka. A yau Ubangiji ya rama wa ranka yă daɗe sarki, a kan Shawulu da zuriyarsa.”
english: They brought the head of Ishbosheth to David to Hebron, and said to the king, “Behold, the head of Ishbosheth, the son of Saul, your enemy, who sought your life! Yahweh has avenged my lord the king today of Saul and of his offspring.”

hausa: Mutuncin masu aikata gaskiya takan bi da su, amma marasa aminci sukan hallaka ta wurin cin amanar da suke yi.
english: The integrity of the upright shall guide them, but the perverseness of the treacherous shall destroy them.

hausa: Amma Efraim ya yi muguwar tsokana da ta sa ya yi fushi; shugabansa zai ɗora musu hakkin jini a kansa kuma zai sāka masa saboda wulaƙancinsa.
english: Ephraim has bitterly provoked anger. Therefore his blood will be left on him, and his Lord will repay his contempt.

hausa: Amma suna ihu, suna nacewa, suna cewa, dole a gicciye shi, har ihunsu ya rinjaye shi.
english: But they were urgent with loud voices, asking that he might be crucified. Their voices and the voices of the chief priests prevailed.

hausa: Bilatus ya yi tambaya ya ce, “Don me? Wane laifi ya yi?” Amma suka ƙara yin ihu suna cewa, “A gicciye shi!”
english: Pilate said to them, “Why, what evil has he done?” But they cried out exceedingly, “Crucify him!”

hausa: Abin da mutum yake sha’awa shi ne ƙauna marar ƙarewa; gara ka zama matalauci da ka zama maƙaryaci.
english: That which makes a man to be desired is his kindness. A poor man is better than a liar.

hausa: Kada ka zama mini abin razana; kai ne mafakata a ranar masifa.
english: Don’t be a terror to me. You are my refuge in the day of evil.

hausa: Girma da iko da ɗaukaka, da daraja da kuma nasara naka ne, ya Ubangiji, gama kome a sama da ƙasa naka ne. Mulki kuma naka ne, ya Ubangiji; an kuma ɗaukaka ka a matsayin kai a bisa duka.
english: Yours, Yahweh, is the greatness, the power, the glory, the victory, and the majesty! For all that is in the heavens and on the earth is yours. Yours is the kingdom, Yahweh, and you are exalted as head above all.

hausa: Sai suka zo Elim inda akwai maɓulɓulan ruwa goma sha biyu da itatuwan dabino saba’in, suka sauka a can, kusa da ruwa.
english: They came to Elim, where there were twelve springs of water and seventy palm trees. They encamped there by the waters.

hausa: Zan hallaka Diyar Sihiyona, kyakkyawa da kuma mai laulayi.
english: I will cut off the beautiful and delicate one, the daughter of Zion.

hausa: Dukanku jiki ɗaya ne, kuna kuma da Ruhu guda. An ba ku bege guda sa’ad da aka kira ku.
english: There is one body and one Spirit, even as you also were called in one hope of your calling,

hausa: Amma da yawa da suke na farko, za su zama na ƙarshe, da yawa kuma da suke na ƙarshe, za su zama na farko.
english: But many will be last who are first, and first who are last.

hausa: “Halinki da ayyukanki sun kawo wannan a kanki. Hukuncinki ke nan. Yana da ɗaci! Ya soke ki har zuciyarki!”
english: “Your way and your doings have brought these things to you. This is your wickedness, for it is bitter, for it reaches to your heart.”

hausa: Dawuda ya ce, “Dukan wannan, ina da shi a rubuce daga hannun Ubangiji zuwa gare ni, ya kuma ba ni ganewa cikin dukan tsarin fasalin, filla-filla.”
english: “All this”, David said, “I have been made to understand in writing from Yahweh’s hand, even all the works of this pattern.”

hausa: ’Ya’yan Hebron maza su ne, Yeriya na fari, Amariya na biyu, Yahaziyel na uku da Yekameyam na huɗu.
english: The sons of Hebron: Jeriah the chief, Amariah the second, Jahaziel the third, and Jekameam the fourth.

hausa: “Abincin Asher zai zama a wadace, zai yi tanadin abinci iri-iri da suka dace don sarki.
english: “Asher’s food will be rich. He will produce royal dainties.

hausa: Don mai bi da kaɗe-kaɗe. Ta Dawuda bawan Ubangiji. Ya rera ta ga Ubangiji kalmomin wannan waƙa sa’ad da Ubangiji ya cece shi daga hannun dukan abokan gābansa da kuma daga hannun Shawulu, ya ce, Ina ƙaunarka, ya Ubangiji, ƙarfina.
english: For the Chief Musician. By David the servant of Yahweh, who spoke to Yahweh the words of this song in the day that Yahweh delivered him from the hand of all his enemies, and from the hand of Saul. He said, I love you, Yahweh, my strength.

hausa: Maguji yana biye da maguji a guje, jakada yana biye da jakada, don su faɗa wa sarkin Babilon, cewa an ci birninsa a kowane gefe.
english: One runner will run to meet another, and one messenger to meet another, to show the king of Babylon that his city is taken on every quarter.

hausa: “Babu wani kamar ka, ya Ubangiji, babu kuma Allah sai kai, kamar yadda muka ji da kunnuwanmu.
english: Yahweh, there is no one like you, neither is there any God besides you, according to all that we have heard with our ears.

hausa: Wanda yake lura da sashe na fari, na wata na farko, shi ne Yashobeyam ɗan Zabdiyel. Akwai mutane 24,000 a sashensa.
english: Over the first division for the first month was Jashobeam the son of Zabdiel. In his division were twenty-four thousand.

hausa: Sai Balawen, mijin matar da aka kashe ya ce, “Ni da ƙwarƙwarata mun zo Gibeya a Benyamin don mu kwana.
english: The Levite, the husband of the woman who was murdered, answered, “I came into Gibeah that belongs to Benjamin, I and my concubine, to spend the night.

hausa: “Urushalima, ayya Urushalima, ke da kika kashe annabawa, kuma kika jefa wa waɗanda aka aika gare ki da duwatsu. Sau da yawa na yi kewan in tattara ’ya’yanki wuri ɗaya, kamar yadda kaza takan tattara ’ya’yanta cikin fikafikanta, amma ba ki yarda ba!
english: “Jerusalem, Jerusalem, you who kills the prophets and stones those who are sent to her! How often I wanted to gather your children together, like a hen gathers her own brood under her wings, and you refused!

hausa: Amma za a ciyar da ku da alkama mafi kyau; da zuma daga dutsen da zai ƙosar da ku.”
english: But he would have also fed them with the finest of the wheat. I will satisfy you with honey out of the rock.”

hausa: Sai suka tafi, suka shiga cikin tuddai, suka yi zamansu a can kwana uku har masu nemansu suka koma, gama masu nemansu suka yi ta nema ko’ina a hanyar, amma ba su sami kowa ba.
english: They went and came to the mountain, and stayed there three days, until the pursuers had returned. The pursuers sought them all along the way, but didn’t find them.

hausa: Yanzu za ka zama bebe, ba za ka ƙara iya magana ba sai ranar da wannan magana ta cika, saboda ba ka gaskata da kalmomina waɗanda za su zama gaskiya a daidai lokacinsu ba.”
english: Behold, you will be silent and not able to speak until the day that these things will happen, because you didn’t believe my words, which will be fulfilled in their proper time.”

hausa: “ ‘Kada ku juyo ga gumaka, ko ku yi wa kanku allolin da aka yi zubi da ƙarfe. Ni ne Ubangiji Allahnku.
english: “‘Don’t turn to idols, nor make molten gods for yourselves. I am Yahweh your God.

hausa: amma ina ganin wata doka tana aiki a gaɓoɓin jikina, tana yaƙi da dokar hankalina, tana kuma sa in zama ɗaurarren dokar zunubin da take aiki a gaɓoɓin jikina.
english: but I see a different law in my members, warring against the law of my mind, and bringing me into captivity under the law of sin which is in my members.

hausa: To, Yehoshafat ya gina jerin jiragen ruwan kasuwanci don su je Ofir saboda zinariya, amma ba su yi tafiya ba, gama sun farfashe a Eziyon Geber.
english: Jehoshaphat made ships of Tarshish to go to Ophir for gold, but they didn’t go, for the ships wrecked at Ezion Geber.

hausa: Daga can, ya ci gaba zuwa wajen tuddai a gabashin Betel ya kafa tentinsa, Betel yana yamma, Ai, kuma a gabas. A can ya gina bagade ga Ubangiji ya kuma kira bisa sunan Ubangiji.
english: He left from there to go to the mountain on the east of Bethel and pitched his tent, having Bethel on the west, and Ai on the east. There he built an altar to Yahweh and called on Yahweh’s name.

hausa: Ya Yaƙub, ya Isra’ila, me ya sa kake ce kana kuma gunaguni cewa, “Hanyata tana a ɓoye daga Ubangiji; Allah bai kula da abin da yake damuna ba”?
english: Why do you say, Jacob, and speak, Israel, “My way is hidden from Yahweh, and the justice due me is disregarded by my God”?

hausa: Ya kāre muradin matalauta da mabukata, ta haka kome ya tafi masa daidai. Ba abin da ake nufi da ba san ni ke nan ba?” In ji Ubangiji.
english: He judged the cause of the poor and needy; so then it was well. Wasn’t this to know me?” says Yahweh.

hausa: “A ranar da zan hukunta Isra’ila saboda zunubanta, zan hallaka bagadan Betel; za a yayyanka ƙahonin bagadan za su fāɗa ƙasa
english: “For in the day that I visit the transgressions of Israel on him, I will also visit the altars of Bethel; and the horns of the altar will be cut off, and fall to the ground.

hausa: ’Ya’yan Lotan maza su ne, Hori da Homam. Timna ita ce ’yar’uwar Lotan.
english: The sons of Lotan: Hori and Homam; and Timna was Lotan’s sister.

hausa: Saboda fushin Ubangiji ne dukan waɗannan abubuwa suka faru da Urushalima, da kuma Yahuda, a ƙarshe kuma ya kawar da su daga fuskarsa. To, sai Zedekiya ya yi wa sarkin Babilon tawaye.
english: For through the anger of Yahweh, this happened in Jerusalem and Judah, until he had cast them out from his presence. Then Zedekiah rebelled against the king of Babylon.

hausa: Ya kuwa yi mamaki ƙwarai don rashin bangaskiyarsu. Sai ya Yesu zazzaga ƙauyuka yana koyarwa.
english: He marveled because of their unbelief. He went around the villages teaching.

hausa: Bari idanunka su buɗe, su fuskanci wannan haikali dare da rana, wannan wurin da ka ce, ‘Sunana zai kasance a can,’ saboda ka ji addu’ar bawanka in yana fuskantar wannan wuri.
english: that your eyes may be open toward this house night and day, even toward the place of which you have said, ‘My name shall be there;’ to listen to the prayer which your servant prays toward this place.

hausa: Na yi mafarkin da ya ba ni tsoro. A sa’ad da nake kwance a gadona, siffofi da wahayoyi da suka bi ta cikin tunanina sun firgita ni.
english: I saw a dream which made me afraid; and the thoughts on my bed and the visions of my head troubled me.

hausa: firist ɗin zai bincike shi, in kuma ƙaiƙayin ya yaɗu a fatar jikin, firist ɗin ba ya bukatar neman ganin rawayan gashi; mutumin marar tsarki ne.
english: then the priest shall examine him; and behold, if the itch has spread in the skin, the priest shall not look for the yellow hair; he is unclean.

hausa: Ƙauna, ita ce mu yi biyayya ga umarnansa. Kamar yadda kuka ji tun da fari, umarninsa shi ne ku yi zaman ƙauna.
english: This is love, that we should walk according to his commandments. This is the commandment, even as you heard from the beginning, that you should walk in it.

hausa: Zilla ma ta haifi ɗa, Tubal-Kayinu, shi ne wanda ya ƙera kowane iri kayan aiki daga tagulla da kuma ƙarfe. ’Yar’uwar Tubal-Kayinu ita ce Na’ama.
english: Zillah also gave birth to Tubal Cain, the forger of every cutting instrument of bronze and iron. Tubal Cain’s sister was Naamah.

hausa: Zan sa shi a bisa gidana da mulkina har abada; kujerar sarautarsa za tă kahu har abada.’ ”
english: but I will settle him in my house and in my kingdom forever. His throne will be established forever.”’”

hausa: Amma taron jama’a suka ce za su jajjefe su da duwatsu. Sai ɗaukakar Ubangiji ta bayyana a Tentin Sujada ga dukan Isra’ilawa.
english: But all the congregation threatened to stone them with stones. Yahweh’s glory appeared in the Tent of Meeting to all the children of Israel.

hausa: Bisa ga umarnin Ubangiji, sai wani mutumin Allah ya zo daga Yahuda zuwa Betel, yayinda Yerobowam yake tsaye kusa da bagade don yă miƙa hadaya.
english: Behold, a man of God came out of Judah by Yahweh’s word to Bethel; and Jeroboam was standing by the altar to burn incense.

hausa: Cikin hannuwanka na miƙa ruhuna; ka cece ni, ya Ubangiji Allah na gaskiya.
english: Into your hand I commend my spirit. You redeem me, Yahweh, God of truth.

hausa: Wa yake wayyo? Wa yake baƙin ciki? Wa yake neman fada? Wa yake gunaguni? Wa yake da raunuka ba dalili? Wa yake da jan idanu?
english: Who has woe? Who has sorrow? Who has strife? Who has complaints? Who has needless bruises? Who has bloodshot eyes?

hausa: Sai mutane suka ce wa Sama’ila, “Su wa suka ce, ‘Shawulu zai yi mulkinmu?’ A kawo mana su mu kashe.”
english: The people said to Samuel, “Who is he who said, ‘Shall Saul reign over us?’ Bring those men, that we may put them to death!”

hausa: Sai dai kowa da lokacinsa. Kiristi ne nunan fari; sa’an nan sa’ad da ya dawo; za a tā da waɗanda suke nasa.
english: But each in his own order: Christ the first fruits, then those who are Christ’s at his coming.

hausa: Ya ce musu, “Ga abin da Ubangiji, Allah na Isra’ila, wanda kuka aike ni gare shi don in gabatar da kukanku, yana cewa,
english: and said to them, “Yahweh, the God of Israel, to whom you sent me to present your supplication before him, says:

hausa: “Game da Yezebel kuwa Ubangiji ya ce, ‘Karnuka za su cinye Yezebel a katangar Yezireyel.’
english: Yahweh also spoke of Jezebel, saying, “The dogs will eat Jezebel by the rampart of Jezreel.

hausa: Ubangiji ya ce wa Musa,
english: Yahweh spoke to Moses, saying,

hausa: Ko an martaba ’ya’yansa maza, ba zai sani ba; Ko an wulaƙanta su, ba zai gani ba.
english: His sons come to honor, and he doesn’t know it. They are brought low, but he doesn’t perceive it of them.

hausa: Mun yi wannan, ba don ba mu da ’yancin karɓar irin taimakon nan ba ne, sai dai domin mu zama gurbin da za ku bi.
english: This was not because we don’t have the right, but to make ourselves an example to you, that you should imitate us.

hausa: Mutanen Isra’ila sun riga sun yi rantsuwa a Mizfa cewa, “Ba ɗayanmu da zai ba da ’yarsa aure ga mutumin Benyamin.”
english: Now the men of Israel had sworn in Mizpah, saying, “None of us will give his daughter to Benjamin as a wife.”

hausa: ya ce, “Tsirara na fito daga cikin mahaifiyata, tsirara kuma zan koma. Ubangiji ya bayar, Ubangiji kuma ya karɓa; yabo ya tabbata ga Ubangiji.”
