english: He said, “Naked I came out of my mother’s womb, and naked will I return there. Yahweh gave, and Yahweh has taken away. Blessed be Yahweh’s name.”

hausa: Sa’ad da almajiran suka ji haka, sai suka fāɗi ƙasa rubda ciki, a firgice.
english: When the disciples heard it, they fell on their faces, and were very afraid.

hausa: Yehohiyada firist ya ɗauki akwatin ya huda rami a murfinsa. Ya ajiye shi kusa da bagade a hannun dama na haikalin Ubangiji. Firistocin da suke tsaron ƙofar suka zuba dukan kuɗin da aka kawo a haikalin Ubangiji a cikin akwatin.
english: But Jehoiada the priest took a chest and bored a hole in its lid, and set it beside the altar, on the right side as one comes into Yahweh’s house; and the priests who kept the threshold put all the money that was brought into Yahweh’s house into it.

hausa: Sai mai tsaron ya ce, “A ganina gudu na farin, ya yi kama da gudun Ahimawaz, ɗan Zadok.” Sarki ya ce, “Shi mutumin kirki ne, yana zuwa da saƙo mai kyau.”
english: The watchman said, “I think the running of the first one is like the running of Ahimaaz the son of Zadok.” The king said, “He is a good man, and comes with good news.”

hausa: In kuma ya ba wa ɗaya daga cikin bayinsa kyauta daga gadonsa, bawan zai iya riƙe shi sai shekarar ’yantarwa; sa’an nan ya mayar wa sarkin. Gādon sarki na ’ya’yansa maza ne kaɗai; na su ne.
english: But if he gives of his inheritance a gift to one of his servants, it shall be his to the year of liberty; then it shall return to the prince; but as for his inheritance, it shall be for his sons.

hausa: Firist kuwa zai miƙa ɗaya don hadaya ta zunubi, ɗayan kuma don hadaya ta ƙonawa, yă yi kafara dominsa, gama ya yi zunubi ta dalilin gawar. A wannan rana zai sāke keɓe kansa.
english: The priest shall offer one for a sin offering, and the other for a burnt offering, and make atonement for him, because he sinned by reason of the dead, and shall make his head holy that same day.

hausa: Sai manyan firistoci da ’yan majalisa duka suka yi ta neman shaidar ƙarya a kan Yesu, don su sami dama su kashe shi.
english: Now the chief priests, the elders, and the whole council sought false testimony against Jesus, that they might put him to death,

hausa: Saboda haka Dawuda da dukan mutanen da suke tare da shi suka tashi suka ƙetare Urdun. Kafin wayewar gari, babu wanda ya rage da bai haye ba.
english: Then David arose, and all the people who were with him, and they passed over the Jordan. By the morning light there lacked not one of them who had not gone over the Jordan.

hausa: “Ku tuna da wannan, ku sa shi a zuciya, ku riƙe shi a zuciya, ku ’yan tawaye.
english: “Remember this, and show yourselves men. Bring it to mind again, you transgressors.

hausa: Isra’ilawa suka zauna tare da Kan’aniyawa da Hittiyawa, Amoriyawa, Ferizziyawa, Hiwiyawa da kuma Yebusiyawa.
english: The children of Israel lived among the Canaanites, the Hittites, the Amorites, the Perizzites, the Hivites, and the Jebusites.

hausa: Kada ka bari a kai mu cikin jarraba, amma ka cece mu daga mugun nan.’
english: Bring us not into temptation, but deliver us from the evil one. For yours is the Kingdom, the power, and the glory forever. Amen.’

hausa: Saboda girman kai ya zama musu abin wuya; tā da hankali ya zama musu riga.
english: Therefore pride is like a chain around their neck. Violence covers them like a garment.

hausa: Ya yi tambaya ya ce, “Mene ne kike so?” Ta ce, “Ka sa daga cikin ’ya’yan nan nawa biyu, ɗaya yă zauna a damarka, ɗaya kuma a hagunka, a mulkinka.”
english: He said to her, “What do you want?” She said to him, “Command that these, my two sons, may sit, one on your right hand and one on your left hand, in your Kingdom.”

hausa: Sai suka tuna, akwai bikin Ubangiji da sukan yi shekara-shekara a Shilo ya yi kusa. Shilo yana arewancin Betel, kudu da Lebona, gabas da hanyar da take tsakanin Betel da Shekem.”
english: They said, “Behold, there is a feast of Yahweh from year to year in Shiloh, which is on the north of Bethel, on the east side of the highway that goes up from Bethel to Shechem, and on the south of Lebonah.”

hausa: Ana gwajin azurfa da kuma zinariya da wuta, amma akan gwada mutum ta wurin yabon da ya samu.
english: The crucible is for silver, and the furnace for gold; but man is refined by his praise.

hausa: Gaddi ɗan Susi, daga kabilar Manasse (wata kabilar Yusuf);
english: Of the tribe of Joseph, of the tribe of Manasseh, Gaddi the son of Susi.

hausa: Haka za ku biya Ubangiji, Ya ku wawaye da kuma mutane marasa hikima? Shi ba Ubanku ba ne, Mahaliccinku, wanda ya yi ku, ya kuma siffanta ku?
english: Is this the way you repay Yahweh, foolish and unwise people? Isn’t he your father who has bought you? He has made you and established you.

hausa: Zan ƙuna wuta wa Masar; Felusiyum za tă sha azaba mai zafi. Za a tayar wa Tebes da hankali; Memfis za tă riƙa kasance cikin ɓacin rai.
english: I will set a fire in Egypt Sin will be in great anguish. No will be broken up. Memphis will have adversaries in the daytime.

hausa: Ba ka yi mini sumba ba, amma tun shigowata a nan, macen nan ba tă daina sumbar ƙafafuna ba.
english: You gave me no kiss, but she, since the time I came in, has not ceased to kiss my feet.

hausa: “A ganinka, a cikin waɗannan mutane uku, wane ne maƙwabcin mutumin da ya fāɗi a hannun mafasa?”
english: Now which of these three do you think seemed to be a neighbor to him who fell among the robbers?”

hausa: Mai yiwuwa zai bar su su zauna cikin kwanciyar hankali, amma idanunsa suna kansu.
english: God gives them security, and they rest in it. His eyes are on their ways.

hausa: Sai ka ce musu, ‘Ga abin da Ubangiji yana cewa, zan cika dukan waɗanda suke zama a ƙasar da buguwa, har ma da sarakunan da suke zama a kursiyin Dawuda, firistoci, annabawa da dukan waɗanda suke zaune a Urushalima.
english: Then tell them, ‘Yahweh says, “Behold, I will fill all the inhabitants of this land, even the kings who sit on David’s throne, the priests, the prophets, and all the inhabitants of Jerusalem, with drunkenness.

hausa: Sai dattawan garin da suke kurkusa da gawar su ɗauki karsanar da ba a taɓa yin aiki da ita ba, ba a kuma taɓa sa mata karkiya ba,
english: It shall be that the elders of the city which is nearest to the slain man shall take a heifer of the herd, which hasn’t been worked with and which has not drawn in the yoke.

hausa: da na hanzarta na tafi wurin mafakata, nesa da muguwar iska da hadiri.”
english: “I would hurry to a shelter from the stormy wind and storm.”

hausa: Ba za su bishe ka su kuma gaya maka abin da za ka yi ba? Ba za su yi magana daga cikin hikimar da suke da ita ba?
english: Shall they not teach you, tell you, and utter words out of their heart?

hausa: Ga Saratu kuwa ya ce, “Ina ba wa ɗan’uwanki shekel dubu na azurfa, shaida ce ta tabbatarwa a idanun dukan waɗanda suke tare da ke, da kuma a gaban kowa cewa ba ki da laifi.”
english: To Sarah he said, “Behold, I have given your brother a thousand pieces of silver. Behold, it is for you a covering of the eyes to all that are with you. In front of all you are vindicated.”

hausa: Sai Sarki Nebukadnezzar ya miƙe tsaye, cike da mamaki ya tambayi mashawartansa, “Shin ba mutum uku ba ne muka daure muka jefa cikin wutar?” Suka amsa, “Tabbatacce haka yake ya sarki.”
english: Then Nebuchadnezzar the king was astonished and rose up in haste. He spoke and said to his counselors, “Didn’t we cast three men bound into the middle of the fire?” They answered the king, “True, O king.”

hausa: Za ka zama itacen wuta, za a zub da jininka a ƙasarka, ba za a ƙara tuna da kai ba; gama Ni Ubangiji na faɗa.’ ”
english: You will be for fuel to the fire. Your blood will be in the middle of the land. You will be remembered no more; for I, Yahweh, have spoken it.”’”

hausa: Yayinda Galliyo yake muƙaddas Akayya, Yahudawa suka haɗa kai suka tasar wa Bulus, suka kuwa kawo shi cikin kotu.
english: But when Gallio was proconsul of Achaia, the Jews with one accord rose up against Paul and brought him before the judgment seat,

hausa: Amma suka matsa masa har ya ji ba ya iya hana su. Saboda haka ya ce, “Ku aike su.” Sai suka aiki mutane hamsin, suka yi ta nema har kwana uku amma ba su same Iliya ba.
english: When they urged him until he was ashamed, he said, “Send them.” Therefore they sent fifty men; and they searched for three days, but didn’t find him.

hausa: Ubangiji ya ce wa Musa,
english: Yahweh spoke to Moses, saying,

hausa: Ya Ubangiji, ba tun fil azal kake ba? Ya Allahna, Mai Tsarkina, ba za mu mutu ba. Ya Ubangiji ka sanya su su tabbatar da hukunci; Ya Dutse, ka naɗa su don su yi hukunci.
english: Aren’t you from everlasting, Yahweh my God, my Holy One? We will not die. Yahweh, you have appointed them for judgment. You, Rock, have established him to punish.

hausa: Ya amsa ya ce, “Saboda kuna da ƙarancin bangaskiya sosai. Gaskiya nake gaya muku, in kuna da bangaskiyar da take ƙanƙanuwa kamar ƙwayar mustad, za ku iya ce wa wannan dutse, ‘Matsa daga nan zuwa can,’ zai kuwa matsa. Babu abin da zai gagare ku.”
english: He said to them, “Because of your unbelief. For most certainly I tell you, if you have faith as a grain of mustard seed, you will tell this mountain, ‘Move from here to there,’ and it will move; and nothing will be impossible for you.

hausa: Siman Bitrus ya tambaye shi ya ce, “Ubangiji ina za ka?” Yesu ya amsa ya ce, “Wurin da za ni, ba za ka iya zuwa yanzu ba, amma za ka bi ni daga baya.”
english: Simon Peter said to him, “Lord, where are you going?” Jesus answered, “Where I am going, you can’t follow now, but you will follow afterwards.”

hausa: Sai suka ɗau kururuwa suna cewa, “Kai, ba shi ba! A ba mu Barabbas!” To, Barabbas ɗin nan yana da hannu dumu-dumu a wani tawaye.
english: Then they all shouted again, saying, “Not this man, but Barabbas!” Now Barabbas was a robber.

hausa: Ni ne idon makafi kuma ƙafa ga guragu.
english: I was eyes to the blind, and feet to the lame.

hausa: Farillan da ka shimfiɗa masu adalci ne; su kuma abin dogara ne ƙwarai.
english: You have commanded your statutes in righteousness. They are fully trustworthy.

hausa: Yehohiyada ɗan Benahiya da Abiyatar ne suka gāji Ahitofel. Yowab shi ne shugaban mayaƙan masarauta.
english: After Ahithophel was Jehoiada the son of Benaiah, and Abiathar. Joab was the captain of the king’s army.

hausa: Ina sarkin Hamat, da sarkin Arfad, da sarkin birnin Sefarfayim, ko na Hena da kuma na Iffa?”
english: Where is the king of Hamath, the king of Arpad, and the king of the city of Sepharvaim, of Hena, and Ivvah?’”

hausa: Kai munafuki, fara cire gungumen da yake idonka, a sa’an nan ne za ka iya gani sosai yadda za ka cire ɗan tsinken da yake a idon ɗan’uwanka.
english: You hypocrite! First remove the beam out of your own eye, and then you can see clearly to remove the speck out of your brother’s eye.

hausa: “Ranakun suna zuwa,” in ji Ubangiji Mai Iko Duka, “sa’ad da zan aika da yunwa cikin ƙasar, ba yunwar abinci ko ta ƙishirwa ba, sai dai yunwa ta jin maganar Ubangiji.
english: Behold, the days come,” says the Lord Yahweh, “that I will send a famine in the land, not a famine of bread, nor a thirst for water, but of hearing Yahweh’s words.

hausa: Lokacin da suka kwanta cikin kogunansu, ko kuma lokacin da suke a wurin ɓuyansu?
english: when they crouch in their dens, and lie in wait in the thicket?

hausa: Sarki yana da jerin jiragen ruwan kasuwanci a teku, tare da jiragen ruwan Hiram. Sau ɗaya kowace shekara uku jerin jiragen yakan dawo ɗauke da zinariya, da azurfa, da hauren giwa, da birai marasa wutsiya, da kuma gogon biri.
english: For the king had a fleet of ships of Tarshish at sea with Hiram’s fleet. Once every three years the fleet of Tarshish came bringing gold, silver, ivory, apes, and peacocks.

hausa: Gaba ɗaya dai, Yared ya yi shekara 962, sa’an nan ya mutu.
english: All of the days of Jared were nine hundred sixty-two years, then he died.

hausa: Ka sa akwatin Alkawari a cikinsa, sa’an nan ka rufe shi da labule.
english: You shall put the ark of the covenant in it, and you shall screen the ark with the veil.

hausa: Wannan shi ne labarin Shem, Ham da Yafet, ’ya’yan Nuhu maza, waɗanda su ma sun haifi ’ya’ya maza bayan ambaliyar.
english: Now this is the history of the generations of the sons of Noah and of Shem, Ham, and Japheth. Sons were born to them after the flood.

hausa: sai ya ce, “Zan ji batunka lokacin da masu zarginka suka iso.” Sa’an nan ya ba da umarni a kai Bulus a tsare shi a fadar Hiridus.
english: “I will hear you fully when your accusers also arrive.” He commanded that he be kept in Herod’s palace.

hausa: “Ka ce musu, ‘Ga abin da Ubangiji Mai Iko Duka yana cewa wannan abin da Allah ya yi magana a kai ya shafi sarki a Urushalima da kuma dukan gidan Isra’ila waɗanda suke a can.’
english: “Say to them, ‘The Lord Yahweh says: “This burden concerns the prince in Jerusalem, and all the house of Israel among whom they are.”’

hausa: In don a tara jama’a ne, sai a busa kakaki, amma ba da irin alama ɗaya ba.
english: But when the assembly is to be gathered together, you shall blow, but you shall not sound an alarm.

hausa: Ka ragargaza Rahab kamar waɗanda aka kashe; da hannunka mai ƙarfi ka watsar da abokan gābanka.
english: You have broken Rahab in pieces, like one of the slain. You have scattered your enemies with your mighty arm.

hausa: Hezekiya ya haifi Manasse, Manasse ya haifi Amon, Amon ya haifi Yosiya,
english: Hezekiah became the father of Manasseh. Manasseh became the father of Amon. Amon became the father of Josiah.

hausa: shi ne mai ikon kawo dukan abubuwa ƙarƙashin mulkinsa. Ta wurin ikon nan nasa zai sāke jikin nan namu na ƙasƙanci, yă mai da shi kamar jikin nan nasa na ɗaukaka.
english: who will change the body of our humiliation to be conformed to the body of his glory, according to the working by which he is able even to subject all things to himself.

hausa: waɗanda suka kashe Ubangiji Yesu da annabawa suka kuma kore mu. Ba sa yin aikin da Allah yake so, masu gāba ne kuwa da dukan mutane
english: who killed both the Lord Jesus and their own prophets, and drove us out, and don’t please God, and are contrary to all men,

hausa: Baƙin da suka miƙa kansu ga Ubangiji don su bauta masa, su kuma ƙaunaci sunan Ubangiji, waɗanda kuma suke yin masa sujada, duk waɗanda suka kiyaye Asabbaci ba tare da ƙazantar da shi ba suka kuma riƙe alkawarina kankan,
english: Also the foreigners who join themselves to Yahweh to serve him, and to love Yahweh’s name, to be his servants, everyone who keeps the Sabbath from profaning it, and holds fast my covenant,

hausa: “Ka faɗa musu wannan, ‘Waɗannan alloli, waɗanda ba su yi sammai da ƙasa ba, za su hallaka daga duniya da kuma daga ƙarƙashin sammai.’ ”
english: “You shall say this to them: ‘The gods that have not made the heavens and the earth will perish from the earth, and from under the heavens.’”

hausa: Kuna da azanci sosai a bin masoya! Kai, ko mafiya muni cikin mata tana iya koya daga hanyoyinku.
english: How well you prepare your way to seek love! Therefore you have even taught the wicked women your ways.

hausa: Sun komo tare da Zerubbabel, da Yeshuwa, da Nehemiya, da Serahiya, da Re’elaya, da Mordekai, da Bilshan, da Misfar, da Bigwai, da Rehum, da Ba’ana). Ga jerin mazan mutanen Isra’ila.
english: who came with Zerubbabel, Jeshua, Nehemiah, Seraiah, Reelaiah, Mordecai, Bilshan, Mispar, Bigvai, Rehum, and Baanah. The number of the men of the people of Israel:

hausa: Saboda ina ƙaunar umarnanka fiye da zinariya, kai, fiye da zinariya zalla,
english: Therefore I love your commandments more than gold, yes, more than pure gold.

hausa: Sam, a zuciyarku kuna ƙirƙiro rashin adalci, da hannuwanku kuma kuna tā da hargitsi a duniya.
english: No, in your heart you plot injustice. You measure out the violence of your hands on the earth.

hausa: Ga lissafin kayan. Manyan kwanonin zinariya guda 30 Manyan kwanonin azurfa guda 1,000 Wuƙaƙe guda 29
english: This is the number of them: thirty platters of gold, one thousand platters of silver, twenty-nine knives,

hausa: Zai ƙone dukan kitse a kan bagade kamar yadda ya ƙone kitsen hadaya ta salama. Ta haka firist zai yi kafara saboda zunubin mutumin, za a kuwa gafarta masa.
english: All its fat he shall burn on the altar, like the fat of the sacrifice of peace offerings; and the priest shall make atonement for him concerning his sin, and he will be forgiven.

hausa: Amma ya bar waɗansu matalauta na gaske a ƙasar don su yi aiki a gonakin inabi, da sauran gonaki.
english: But Nebuzaradan the captain of the guard left of the poorest of the land to be vineyard keepers and farmers.

hausa: Sa’ad da kuka nemi taimako, bari tarin gumakanku su cece ku! Iska za tă kwashe dukansu tă tafi, ɗan numfashi kawai zai hura su. Amma mutumin da ya mai da ni mafakarsa zai gāji ƙasar ya kuma mallaki dutsena mai tsarki.”
english: When you cry, let those whom you have gathered deliver you, but the wind will take them. A breath will carry them all away, but he who takes refuge in me will possess the land, and will inherit my holy mountain.”

hausa: Ibrahim ya ce, “Na rantse.”
english: Abraham said, “I will swear.”

hausa: Jinin zai zama alama a gare ku, a gidajen da kuke; sa’ad da kuwa na ga jinin, zan ƙetare ku. Ba wata annoba mai hallakarwa da za tă taɓa ku yayinda na bugi Masar.
english: The blood shall be to you for a token on the houses where you are. When I see the blood, I will pass over you, and no plague will be on you to destroy you when I strike the land of Egypt.

hausa: Bala’am ya ce wa Balak, “Tsaya nan kusa da hadayarka, ni kuwa in je in sadu da Ubangiji a can.”
english: He said to Balak, “Stand here by your burnt offering, while I meet God over there.”

hausa: Ba ku haura don ku rushe katanga don ku gyara gidan Isra’ila saboda ya tsaya daram a yaƙi a ranar Ubangiji ba.
english: You have not gone up into the gaps or built up the wall for the house of Israel, to stand in the battle in Yahweh’s day.

hausa: bakina ba zai faɗi mugun abu ba, harshena kuma ba zai yi ƙarya ba.
english: surely my lips will not speak unrighteousness, neither will my tongue utter deceit.

hausa: zalɓe, kowane irin jinjimi, katutu, da kuma jamage.
english: the stork, the heron after its kind, the hoopoe, and the bat.

hausa: ’Ya’yan Rahila maza su ne, Yusuf da Benyamin.
english: The sons of Rachel: Joseph and Benjamin.

hausa: Na rasa yadda zan bincike irin abubuwan nan; saboda haka na yi tambaya ko zai yarda ya tafi Urushalima a yi masa shari’a a can game da waɗannan zargi.
english: Being perplexed how to inquire concerning these things, I asked whether he was willing to go to Jerusalem and there be judged concerning these matters.

hausa: Ba zan mutu ba amma zan rayu, zan kuwa yi shelar abin da Ubangiji ya yi.
english: I will not die, but live, and declare Yah’s works.

hausa: sarkin Kedesh, ɗaya sarkin Yokneyam a Karmel, ɗaya
english: the king of Kedesh, one; the king of Jokneam in Carmel, one;

hausa: Sai ya aiki biyu daga cikin almajiransa ya ce, “Ku shiga cikin birni, za ku sadu da wani ɗauke da tulun ruwa. Ku bi shi.
english: He sent two of his disciples and said to them, “Go into the city, and there a man carrying a pitcher of water will meet you. Follow him,

hausa: Sa’ad da Ubangiji Allahnku ya hallakar da al’ummai waɗanda yake ba ku ƙasarsu, sa’ad da kuka kore su, kuka kuma zauna a birane da gidajensu,
english: When Yahweh your God cuts off the nations whose land Yahweh your God gives you, and you succeed them and dwell in their cities and in their houses,

hausa: Dattawan Gileyad suka ce, “Ubangiji ne shaidanmu; za mu yi duk abin da ka ce.”
english: The elders of Gilead said to Jephthah, “Yahweh will be witness between us. Surely we will do what you say.”

hausa: Can gaba da su, Benyamin da Hasshub ne suka yi gyare-gyaren a gaban gidansu, biye da su kuwa, Azariya ɗan Ma’asehiya, ɗan Ananiya ne ya yi gyare-gyaren kusa da gidansa.
english: After them, Benjamin and Hasshub made repairs across from their house. After them, Azariah the son of Maaseiah the son of Ananiah made repairs beside his own house.

hausa: Daga cikinki, ya Ninebe wani ya fito wanda ya ƙulla wa Ubangiji makirci yana ba da mugayen shawarwari.
english: One has gone out of you who devises evil against Yahweh, who counsels wickedness.

hausa: Saboda haka suka yayyanka bijiman, firistoci suka karɓi jinin suka yayyafa a kan bagade. Suka kuma yanka ragunan suka yayyafa jinin a bagaden. Haka kuma suka yanka ’yan ragunan suka yayyafa jinin a bagaden.
english: So they killed the bulls, and the priests received the blood and sprinkled it on the altar. They killed the rams and sprinkled the blood on the altar. They also killed the lambs and sprinkled the blood on the altar.

hausa: Ina kuma gaya muku da yawa za su zo daga gabas da kuma yamma, su ɗauki wuraren zamansu a biki tare da Ibrahim, Ishaku, da Yaƙub a cikin mulkin sama.
english: I tell you that many will come from the east and the west, and will sit down with Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob in the Kingdom of Heaven,

hausa: Saboda haka aka tsare Bitrus a kurkuku, amma ikkilisiya ta nace da addu’a ga Allah dominsa.
english: Peter therefore was kept in the prison, but constant prayer was made by the assembly to God for him.

hausa: Ka yi iyakacin ƙoƙarinka ka taimaki Zenas lauyan nan da Afollos a hanyarsu ka kuma tabbata ba su rasa kome ba.
english: Send Zenas the lawyer and Apollos on their journey speedily, that nothing may be lacking for them.

hausa: Tabbatacce, garkuwarmu ta Ubangiji ce, ta sarkinmu ce, da kuma ta Mai Tsarki na Isra’ila ce.
english: For our shield belongs to Yahweh, our king to the Holy One of Israel.

hausa: don yin zāne-zāne na aikin zinariya, azurfa da tagulla,
english: to devise skillful works, to work in gold, and in silver, and in bronze,

hausa: Za ku kuma yi yadda na yi. Ba za ku rufe sashe ƙasa na fuskarku ko ku ci abinci da masu kuka sukan ci ba.
english: You will do as I have done. You won’t cover your lips or eat mourner’s bread.

hausa: Suka ga wani abin da ya yi kama da harsunan wuta, suka rarrabu suna kuma sassauka a kan kowannensu.
english: Tongues like fire appeared and were distributed to them, and one sat on each of them.

hausa: Ba za ka karɓi abin da allahnka Kemosh ya ba ka ba? Haka mu ma, duk abin da Ubangiji Allahnmu ya riga ya ba mu, za mu mallake shi.
english: Won’t you possess that which Chemosh your god gives you to possess? So whoever Yahweh our God has dispossessed from before us, them will we possess.

hausa: Sa’ad da ’yan’uwa suka sami labarin wannan, sai suka ɗauke shi zuwa Kaisariya suka aika da shi Tarshish.
english: When the brothers knew it, they brought him down to Caesarea and sent him off to Tarsus.

hausa: “A ce mutum ya ce wa Allah, ‘Na yi laifi, amma ba zan sāke saɓa wa wani ba.
english: “For has any said to God, ‘I am guilty, but I will not offend any more.

hausa: Ya amsa ya ce, “Sa’ad da kuka shiga cikin gari, za ku sadu da wani mutum yana ɗauke da tulun ruwa. Ku bi shi zuwa gidan da zai shiga.
english: He said to them, “Behold, when you have entered into the city, a man carrying a pitcher of water will meet you. Follow him into the house which he enters.

hausa: Ya ce musu, “A rubuce yake, ‘Za a ce da gidana, gidan addu’a,’amma kuna mai da shi ‘kogon ’yan fashi.’ ”
english: He said to them, “It is written, ‘My house shall be called a house of prayer,’ but you have made it a den of robbers!”

hausa: Ku ceci marasa ƙarfi da masu bukata; ku kuɓutar da su daga hannun mugaye.
english: Rescue the weak and needy. Deliver them out of the hand of the wicked.”

hausa: Duk lokacin da za ku tafi yaƙi a ƙasarku, in akwai waɗansu da suke matsa muku, za ku yi amfani da waɗannan kakaki ta wurin hura su, alama ce, cewa za a je yaƙi. Sa’an nan Ubangiji Allahnku zai tuna da ku, yă cece ku daga maƙiyanku.
english: When you go to war in your land against the adversary who oppresses you, then you shall sound an alarm with the trumpets. Then you will be remembered before Yahweh your God, and you will be saved from your enemies.

hausa: Ka mai da su kamar ɗan tsiron da kan karye, iska ta yi ta turawa, ya Allahna, kamar yayin da iska take hurawa,
english: My God, make them like tumbleweed, like chaff before the wind.

hausa: Duk annabawa sun yi shaida game da shi cewa duk wanda ya ba da gaskiya gare shi zai sami gafarar zunubai ta wurin sunansa.”
english: All the prophets testify about him, that through his name everyone who believes in him will receive remission of sins.”

hausa: Gama kun ɓata lokaci sosai a dā kuna yin abubuwan da masu bauta gumaka suka zaɓa su yi, kuna rayuwa cikin lalata, sha’awace-sha’awace, buguwa, shashanci, shaye-shaye da kuma bautar gumaka masu banƙyama.
english: For we have spent enough of our past time doing the desire of the Gentiles, and having walked in lewdness, lusts, drunken binges, orgies, carousings, and abominable idolatries.

hausa: Me zai sa ɗan’uwa yă kai ƙarar ɗan’uwa, a gaban marasa bi?
english: But brother goes to law with brother, and that before unbelievers!

hausa: Yoshuwa da Isra’ilawa duka suka juya suka kai wa Debir hari,
english: Joshua returned, and all Israel with him, to Debir, and fought against it.

hausa: zuwa Heshbon, da dukan garuruwan kan tudu, haɗe da Dibon, Bamot Ba’al, Bet-Ba’al-Meyon,
english: Heshbon, and all its cities that are in the plain; Dibon, Bamoth Baal, Beth Baal Meon,

hausa: Sai Hiridus da sojojinsa suka wulaƙanta shi, suka yi masa ba’a. Sa’an nan, suka sa masa babban riga, suka mai da shi wurin Bilatus.
english: Herod with his soldiers humiliated him and mocked him. Dressing him in luxurious clothing, they sent him back to Pilate.

hausa: Ya ce, “Ranka yă daɗe, in na sami tagomashi daga gare ku kada ku wuce bawanku.
english: and said, “My lord, if now I have found favor in your sight, please don’t go away from your servant.

hausa: Lokacin ƙauna da lokacin ƙiyayya, lokacin yaƙi da lokacin salama.
english: a time to love, and a time to hate; a time for war, and a time for peace.

hausa: Sai maganar Ubangiji ta zo wa Yehu ɗan Hanani game da Ba’asha,
english: Yahweh’s word came to Jehu the son of Hanani against Baasha, saying,

hausa: ya tumɓuke ƙasashe bakwai a Kan’ana ya kuma ba da ƙasarsu gādo ga mutanensa.
english: When he had destroyed seven nations in the land of Canaan, he gave them their land for an inheritance for about four hundred fifty years.

hausa: Ga abin da Ubangiji Maɗaukaki ya ce, “Ku da yanzu kuke jin maganan nan da annabawa suka faɗi, waɗanda suke a nan lokacin da aka kafa harsashin haikalin Ubangiji Maɗaukaki, bari hannuwanku su zama da ƙarfi don a gama gina haikalin.
english: Yahweh of Armies says: “Let your hands be strong, you who hear in these days these words from the mouth of the prophets who were in the day that the foundation of the house of Yahweh of Armies was laid, even the temple, that it might be built.

hausa: don ku ci naman sarakuna, jarumawa, da kuma manyan mutane, na dawakai da mahayansu, da kuma naman dukan mutane, ’yantacce da bawa, babba da yaro.”
english: that you may eat the flesh of kings, the flesh of captains, the flesh of mighty men, and the flesh of horses and of those who sit on them, and the flesh of all men, both free and slave, small and great.”

hausa: Ga abin da Ubangiji yana cewa, “Ku tsaya kan hanyoyi, ku duba; ku nemi hanyoyin dā, ku tambaya inda hanyar mai kyau take, ku yi tafiya a kanta, za ku kuwa sami hutu wa rayukanku. Amma kun ce, ‘Ba za mu bi ta ba.’
english: Yahweh says, “Stand in the ways and see, and ask for the old paths, ‘Where is the good way?’ and walk in it, and you will find rest for your souls. But they said, ‘We will not walk in it.’

hausa: A rana ta uku, Dawuda da mutanensa suka isa Ziklag, sai suka tarar Amalekawa sun riga sun kawo wa Negeb da Ziklag hari. Suka cinye Ziklag, suka ƙone ta,
english: When David and his men had come to Ziklag on the third day, the Amalekites had made a raid on the South and on Ziklag, and had struck Ziklag and burned it with fire,

hausa: Waɗannan su ne ’ya’yan Ham maza bisa ga zuriyarsu da yarurrukansu, cikin ƙasashensu da kuma al’ummominsu.
english: These are the sons of Ham, after their families, according to their languages, in their lands and their nations.

hausa: Ku yi rawar jiki, ku mata masu jin daɗi, ku sha wahala, ku ’yan matan da kuke tsammani kuna da kāriya! Ku tuɓe rigunanku, ku ɗaura tsummoki a kwankwasonku.
english: Tremble, you women who are at ease! Be troubled, you careless ones! Strip yourselves, make yourselves naked, and put sackcloth on your waist.

hausa: Saboda haka Shawulu ya ce wa ma’aikatansa, “Ku nemo wanda ya iya kiɗan molo sosai ku kawo mini.”
english: Saul said to his servants, “Provide me now a man who can play well, and bring him to me.”

hausa: In tana cikin dabbobin da suke marasa tsarki, zai iya saye ta a darajar da aka kimanta, yă ƙara da kashi ɗaya bisa biyar na darajarta. In bai fanshe ta ba, sai a sayar da ita a darajar da aka kimanta.
english: If it is an unclean animal, then he shall buy it back according to your valuation, and shall add to it the fifth part of it; or if it isn’t redeemed, then it shall be sold according to your valuation.

hausa: Zan watsar da ke cikin al’ummai in warwatsa ke cikin ƙasashe; zan kuma kawo ƙarshen rashin tsarkinki.
english: I will scatter you among the nations, and disperse you through the countries. I will purge your filthiness out of you.

hausa: Aka yi babbar hayaniya. Waɗansu daga cikin malaman dokokin da suke Farisiyawa suka miƙe tsaye suka yi gardama mai ƙarfi suna cewa, “Ba mu sami wani laifi a wurin mutumin nan ba. A ce wani ruhu ko mala’ika ne ya yi masa magana fa?”
english: A great clamor arose, and some of the scribes of the Pharisees’ part stood up, and contended, saying, “We find no evil in this man. But if a spirit or angel has spoken to him, let’s not fight against God!”

hausa: Sa’an nan Musa ya umarce su ya ce, “A ƙarshen kowace shekara bakwai, a shekara ta yafe basusuwa, a lokacin Bikin Tabanakul,
english: Moses commanded them, saying, “At the end of every seven years, in the set time of the year of release, in the feast of booths,

hausa: sai dattawa ashirin da huɗun nan su fāɗi a ƙasa a gaban wannan wanda yake zaune a kursiyin, su yi sujada wa wannan wanda yake da rai har abada abadin. Sukan ajiye rawaninsu a gaban kursiyin suna cewa,
english: the twenty-four elders fall down before him who sits on the throne and worship him who lives forever and ever, and throw their crowns before the throne, saying,

hausa: Ya kira wannan wuri Betel ko da yake dā ana kiran birnin Luz ne.
english: He called the name of that place Bethel, but the name of the city was Luz at the first.

hausa: Domin ba abubuwan da ido yake gani ne muke dubawa ba, sai dai marasa ganuwa. Gama abubuwan da ake gani masu saurin wucewa ne, marasa ganuwa kuwa, madawwama ne.
english: while we don’t look at the things which are seen, but at the things which are not seen. For the things which are seen are temporal, but the things which are not seen are eternal.

hausa: Zaki ya fito daga ruƙuƙinsa; mai hallakarwar al’ummai ya kama hanya. Ya bar wurinsa don yă lalace ƙasarku. Garuruwanku za su zama kufai babu mazauna.
english: A lion has gone up from his thicket, and a destroyer of nations. He is on his way. He has gone out from his place, to make your land desolate, that your cities be laid waste, without inhabitant.

hausa: A cikin mafarki, cikin wahayi da dare, sa’ad da barci mai zurfi ya fāɗo a kan mutane lokacin da suke cikin barci kan gadajensu,
english: In a dream, in a vision of the night, when deep sleep falls on men, in slumbering on the bed,

hausa: ya saki hankaka. Hankaka ya yi ta kai da kawowa har sai da ruwa ya shanye a duniya.
english: and he sent out a raven. It went back and forth, until the waters were dried up from the earth.

hausa: Da ka yi abin da yake daidai, ai, da ka sami karɓuwa. Amma tun da ba ka yi abin da ba daidai ba, zunubi zai yi fakonka don yă rinjaye ka kamar naman jeji. Yana so yă mallake ka, amma tilas ka rinjaye shi.”
english: If you do well, won’t it be lifted up? If you don’t do well, sin crouches at the door. Its desire is for you, but you are to rule over it.”

hausa: Wane ne yake da hikimar iya ƙirga gizagizai? Wane ne zai iya karkato bakunan tulunan sammai
english: Who can count the clouds by wisdom? Or who can pour out the containers of the sky,

hausa: ‘Azurfarka da zinariyarka nawa ne. Mafi kyau cikin matanka da ’ya’yanka nawa ne.’ ”
english: ‘Your silver and your gold are mine. Your wives also and your children, even the best, are mine.’”

hausa: Wane ne a cikinku yake tsoron Ubangiji yana kuma yin biyayya ga maganar bawansa? Bari wanda yake tafiya cikin duhu, wanda ba shi da haske, ya dogara a sunan Ubangiji ya kuma dogara ga Allahnsa.
english: Who among you fears Yahweh and obeys the voice of his servant? He who walks in darkness and has no light, let him trust in Yahweh’s name, and rely on his God.

hausa: Mugun mutum kan sami albashin ƙarya amma shi da ya shuka adalci zai girbe lada tabbatacce.
english: Wicked people earn deceitful wages, but one who sows righteousness reaps a sure reward.

hausa: Kada ku manta da alkawarin da na ƙulla da ku, kada ku yi sujada ga waɗansu alloli.
english: You shall not forget the covenant that I have made with you. You shall not fear other gods.

hausa: Gama ba ya shiga cikin zuciyarsa, sai dai cikin tumbinsa, sa’an nan kuma yă fita daga jikinsa.” (Da faɗin haka, Yesu ya nuna tsabtar kowane irin abinci.)
english: because it doesn’t go into his heart, but into his stomach, then into the latrine, making all foods clean?”

hausa: Ka ɗauki rigar ka sa wa Haruna, ka sa masa doguwar rigar, da rigar efod, da efod kanta, da ƙyallen maƙalawa a ƙirji. Ka ɗaura masa efod da ɗamarar da aka yi mata ado.
english: You shall take the garments, and put on Aaron the tunic, the robe of the ephod, the ephod, and the breastplate, and clothe him with the skillfully woven band of the ephod.

hausa: Sai ya ce mini, “Ka san abin da ya kawo ni gare ka? Ba da jimawa ba zan koma in yi yaƙi da mai mulkin Farisa, kuma idan na tafi, mai mulkin Hellenawa zai taso;
english: Then he said, “Do you know why I have come to you? Now I will return to fight with the prince of Persia. When I go out, behold, the prince of Greece will come.

hausa: Ku miƙa ’yar dabba daga cikin garkenku na tumaki, ko na shanu a matsayin Bikin Ƙetarewa ga Ubangiji Allahnku a wurin da Ubangiji zai zaɓa a matsayin mazauni don Sunansa.
english: You shall sacrifice the Passover to Yahweh your God, of the flock and the herd, in the place which Yahweh shall choose to cause his name to dwell there.

hausa: Sai Ubangiji ya ce wa Ishaya, “Fita, kai da ɗanka Sheyar-Yashub, don ku sadu da Ahaz a ƙarshen wuriyar da take kawo ruwa daga Tafkin Tudu, a hanyar Filin Mai Wanki.
english: Then Yahweh said to Isaiah, “Go out now to meet Ahaz, you, and Shearjashub your son, at the end of the conduit of the upper pool, on the highway of the fuller’s field.

hausa: Na saurara sosai, amma ba su faɗi wata maganar kirki ba. Ba wanda ya tuba daga muguntarsa, sai ma cewa yake, “Me na yi?” Kowa ta kai-ta-kai yake kamar dokin da ya kutsa kai a fagen fama.
english: I listened and heard, but they didn’t say what is right. No one repents of his wickedness, saying, “What have I done?” Everyone turns to his course, as a horse that rushes headlong in the battle.

hausa: da masu hidimar haikali da suke zama a tudun Ofel ne suka yi gyare-gyaren har zuwa wani wuri ɗaura da Ƙofar Ruwa wajen gabas da kuma doguwar hasumiya.
english: (Now the temple servants lived in Ophel, to the place opposite the water gate toward the east, and the tower that stands out.)

hausa: Muna da tabbaci cikin Ubangiji cewa kuna bin umarnai da muka yi muku, za ku kuma ci gaba da yin abubuwan da muka umarta.
english: We have confidence in the Lord concerning you, that you both do and will do the things we command.

hausa: Dukan ƙasar Kan’ana inda kake baƙo a yanzu, zan ba da ita a matsayin madawwamiyar mallaka gare ka da kuma zuriyarka a bayanka, zan kuma zama Allahnsu.”
english: I will give to you, and to your offspring after you, the land where you are traveling, all the land of Canaan, for an everlasting possession. I will be their God.”

hausa: Ka ɗibi jinin da yake a kan bagade, da man shafewa, ka yafa a kan Haruna da rigunansa, da kuma a kan ’ya’yansa maza da rigunansu. Sa’an nan shi da ’ya’yansa maza da rigunansu za su tsarkake.
english: You shall take of the blood that is on the altar, and of the anointing oil, and sprinkle it on Aaron, and on his garments, and on his sons, and on the garments of his sons with him: and he shall be made holy, and his garments, and his sons, and his sons’ garments with him.

hausa: Domin zuciyarka mai tuba ce, ka kuma ƙasƙantar da kanka a gaban Ubangiji sa’ad da ka ji abin da na faɗa game da wannan wuri da mutanen wurin, cewa za su zama la’antattu da kuma kango, domin kuma ka kece tufafinka, ka kuma yi kuka a gabana, na ji ka, in ji Ubangiji.
english: because your heart was tender, and you humbled yourself before Yahweh when you heard what I spoke against this place and against its inhabitants, that they should become a desolation and a curse, and have torn your clothes and wept before me, I also have heard you,’ says Yahweh.

hausa: “Saboda haka fa, ba ku ba ne kuka aiko ni nan, Allah ne. Ya mai da ni mahaifi ga Fir’auna, shugaban dukan gidansa da kuma mai mulkin dukan Masar.
english: So now it wasn’t you who sent me here, but God, and he has made me a father to Pharaoh, lord of all his house, and ruler over all the land of Egypt.

hausa: Da Ubangiji ya ji ƙanshi mai daɗi, sai ya ce a zuciyarsa, “Ba zan ƙara la’anta ƙasa saboda mutum ba, ko da yake dukan tunanin zuciyar mutum mugu ne tun yana ƙarami. Ba kuwa zan ƙara hallaka dukan halittu masu rai, kamar yadda na yi ba.
english: Yahweh smelled the pleasant aroma. Yahweh said in his heart, “I will not again curse the ground any more for man’s sake because the imagination of man’s heart is evil from his youth. I will never again strike every living thing, as I have done.

hausa: Ya tafi tare da Bitrus, Yaƙub da kuma Yohanna. Sai ya fara baƙin ciki da damuwa ƙwarai.
english: He took with him Peter, James, and John, and began to be greatly troubled and distressed.

hausa: Za tă zama ƙura bisa dukan ƙasar Masar, sai marurai masu zafi su fiffito bisa mutane da dabbobi a dukan ƙasar.”
english: It shall become small dust over all the land of Egypt, and shall be boils and blisters breaking out on man and on animal, throughout all the land of Egypt.”

hausa: Zan ɗauke raguwar Yahuda waɗanda suka ƙudurta su je Masar su zauna a can. Duk za su hallaka a Masar; za su mutu ta wurin takobi ko su mutu da yunwa. Daga ƙarami zuwa babba, za su mutu ta wurin takobi ko yunwa. Za su zama abin zarge da abin tsoro, abin la’ana da abin ba’a.
english: I will take the remnant of Judah that have set their faces to go into the land of Egypt to live there, and they will all be consumed. They will fall in the land of Egypt. They will be consumed by the sword and by the famine. They will die, from the least even to the greatest, by the sword and by the famine. They will be an object of horror, an astonishment, a curse, and a reproach.

hausa: Sai suka zo wurin Musa, suka ce, “Muna so mu gina katangar dutse don dabbobinmu, da kuma birane don matanmu da ’ya’yanmu a nan.
english: They came near to him, and said, “We will build sheepfolds here for our livestock, and cities for our little ones;

hausa: Yaron ya yi girma, aka kuma yaye shi, a ranar da aka yaye shi kuwa, Ibrahim ya yi babban biki.
english: The child grew and was weaned. Abraham made a great feast on the day that Isaac was weaned.

hausa: Suka tambaye shi suka ce, “Malam, yaushe waɗannan za su faru? Kuma wace alama za tă nuna cewa suna dab da faruwa?”
english: They asked him, “Teacher, so when will these things be? What is the sign that these things are about to happen?”

hausa: Babu wanda yakan tuna da kai sa’ad da ya mutu. Wa ke yabonka daga kabari?
english: For in death there is no memory of you. In Sheol, who shall give you thanks?

hausa: Cikin kishina da hasalata mai zafi zan furta cewa a wannan lokaci za a yi babbar girgizar ƙasa a ƙasar Isra’ila.
english: For in my jealousy and in the fire of my wrath I have spoken. Surely in that day there will be a great shaking in the land of Israel,

hausa: Sai Ahiya ya kama sabuwar rigar da yake saye da ita ya yage ta gida goma sha biyu.
english: Ahijah took the new garment that was on him, and tore it in twelve pieces.

hausa: “A ƙarshe sai dukan itatuwa suka ce wa itacen ƙaya, ‘Ka zo ka zama sarkinmu.’
english: “Then all the trees said to the bramble, ‘Come and reign over us.’

hausa: “In na yi murna domin mugun abu ya faru da maƙiyina; ko kuma domin wahala ta same shi,
english: “If I have rejoiced at the destruction of him who hated me, or lifted up myself when evil found him

hausa: Muna da wannan bege kamar anka na rai, kafaffe da kuma tabbatacce. Yana shiga tsattsarkan wuri na can ciki a bayan labule,
english: This hope we have as an anchor of the soul, a hope both sure and steadfast and entering into that which is within the veil,

hausa: Da kalmomi masu yawa Yohanna ya yi wa mutane gargaɗi, ya kuma yi musu wa’azin bishara.
english: Then with many other exhortations he preached good news to the people,

hausa: Ka ba su abin da ya dace su samu, ya Ubangiji, domin abin da hannuwansu suka yi.
english: You will pay them back, Yahweh, according to the work of their hands.

hausa: Abishai, ɗan’uwan Yowab, ɗan Zeruhiya shi shugaban Ukun nan. Ya ɗauki māshinsa ya kashe mutane ɗari uku, ta haka ya zama sananne kamar Ukun nan.
english: Abishai, the brother of Joab, the son of Zeruiah, was chief of the three. He lifted up his spear against three hundred and killed them, and had a name among the three.

hausa: Suka ce, “Ranka yă daɗe, mun tuna, mai ruɗin nan tun yana da rai ya ce, ‘Bayan kwana uku, zan tashi daga matattu.’
english: saying, “Sir, we remember what that deceiver said while he was still alive: ‘After three days I will rise again.’

hausa: To, da Samariyawa suka zo wurinsa, sai suka roƙe shi yă zauna da su, ya kuwa zauna kwana biyu.
english: So when the Samaritans came to him, they begged him to stay with them. He stayed there two days.

hausa: Gama ina cike da magana, kuma ruhun da yake cikina yana iza ni;
english: For I am full of words. The spirit within me constrains me.

hausa: Ƙaunataccena kamar tarin furanni jeji ne gare ni daga gonakin inabin En Gedi.
english: My beloved is to me a cluster of henna blossoms from the vineyards of En Gedi.

hausa: Saboda haka kada ku zama wawaye, sai dai ku fahimci ko mene ne nufin Ubangiji.
english: Therefore, don’t be foolish, but understand what the will of the Lord is.

hausa: Bayan haka sai ka kawo Haruna da ’ya’yansa a ƙofar Tentin Sujada ka yi musu wanka.
english: You shall bring Aaron and his sons to the door of the Tent of Meeting, and shall wash them with water.

hausa: Wannan shi ne rubutaccen tarihin zuriyar Adamu. Sa’ad da Allah ya halicci mutum, ya yi shi cikin kamannin Allah.
english: This is the book of the generations of Adam. In the day that God created man, he made him in God’s likeness.

hausa: Sai na yi kira, na ce, “Ubangiji Mai Iko Duka, ina roƙonka ka dakata! Ta yaya Yaƙub zai tsira? Ga shi ɗan ƙarami ne!”
english: Then I said, “Lord Yahweh, stop, I beg you! How could Jacob stand? For he is small.”

hausa: A rana ta tara ga watan huɗu a shekara ta goma sha ɗaya ta mulkin Zedekiya, sai aka huda katanga.
english: In the eleventh year of Zedekiah, in the fourth month, the ninth day of the month, a breach was made in the city.

hausa: A maimakon ƙauna sun sāka mini da zargi, amma ni mutum ne mai addu’a.
english: In return for my love, they are my adversaries; but I am in prayer.

hausa: Kada ku dogara a kan ƙwace ko yin fariya a kayan sata; ko arzikinku ya ƙaru, kada ku sa zuciyarku a kansu.
english: Don’t trust in oppression. Don’t become vain in robbery. If riches increase, don’t set your heart on them.

hausa: Kowannen da ya ƙetare zuwa wurin waɗanda aka riga aka ƙidaya, dole yă ba da rabin shekel, bisa ga ma’aunin shekel na tsattsarkan wuri, wanda nauyinsa garwa ashirin ne. Wannan rabin shekel hadaya ce ga Ubangiji.
english: They shall give this, everyone who passes over to those who are counted, half a shekel according to the shekel of the sanctuary (the shekel is twenty gerahs); half a shekel for an offering to Yahweh.

hausa: Ku tuna a yau, cewa ’ya’yanku ba su ne suka gani suka kuma ɗanɗana horon Ubangiji Allahnku ba; ba su suka gani girmansa, hannunsa mai ƙarfi, hannunsa mai iko;
english: Know this day—for I don’t speak with your children who have not known, and who have not seen the chastisement of Yahweh your God, his greatness, his mighty hand, his outstretched arm,

hausa: Ka ce musu, ‘Ga abin da Ubangiji Mai Iko Duka yana cewa zan kawo ƙarshen wannan karin magana, ba za su ƙara faɗar wannan karin magana a Isra’ila ba.’ Ka ce musu, ‘Kwanaki sun gabato da za a tabbatar da kowane wahayi.
english: Tell them therefore, ‘The Lord Yahweh says: “I will make this proverb to cease, and they will no more use it as a proverb in Israel;”’ but tell them, ‘“The days are at hand, and the fulfillment of every vision.

hausa: A kan mugaye zai zuba garwashin wuta mai zafi da kuma kibiritu; iska mai zafi zai zama rabonsu.
english: On the wicked he will rain blazing coals; fire, sulfur, and scorching wind shall be the portion of their cup.

hausa: Ka dube ni ka amsa mini, ya Ubangiji Allahna. Ka ba da haske ga fuskata, ko in yi barci cikin mutuwa;
english: Behold, and answer me, Yahweh, my God. Give light to my eyes, lest I sleep in death;

hausa: Ku furta ɗaukakarsa a cikin al’ummai, manyan ayyukansa a cikin dukan mutane.
english: Declare his glory among the nations, his marvelous works among all the peoples.

hausa: Amma ya ci gaba da cewa, “Ku daga ƙasa kuke; ni kuwa daga bisa ne. Ku na duniyan nan ne; ni kuwa ba na duniyan nan ba ne.
english: He said to them, “You are from beneath. I am from above. You are of this world. I am not of this world.

hausa: Yanzu ne za a yi wa duniyan nan shari’a, yanzu ne za a tumɓuke mai mulkin duniyan nan.
english: Now is the judgment of this world. Now the prince of this world will be cast out.

hausa: Na ji ana kiran da’irorin “da’irorin guguwa.”
english: As for the wheels, they were called in my hearing, “the whirling wheels”.

hausa: Na san kullum kakan saurare ni, na dai faɗa haka ne saboda amfanin mutanen nan da suke tsaitsaye, don su gaskata cewa kai ka aiko ni.”
english: I know that you always listen to me, but because of the multitude standing around I said this, that they may believe that you sent me.”

hausa: Yayinda suke cin abinci, sai ya ce, “Gaskiya nake gaya muku, ɗayanku zai bashe ni.”
english: As they were eating, he said, “Most certainly I tell you that one of you will betray me.”

hausa: Duk mai son jin daɗi zai zama matalauci; duk mai son ruwan inabi da mai ba zai taɓa zama mai arziki ba.
english: He who loves pleasure will be a poor man. He who loves wine and oil won’t be rich.

hausa: “Yayinda nake cikin tunani game da ƙahonin nan, a gabana kuwa ga wani ƙaho, ɗan ƙanƙani, wanda ya fito daga cikinsu; kuma an tumɓuke uku daga cikin ƙahonin farko kafin wannan. Wannan ƙaho yana da idanu kamar na mutum da kuma bakin da yake maganganun fariya.
english: “I considered the horns, and behold, there came up among them another horn, a little one, before which three of the first horns were plucked up by the roots; and behold, in this horn were eyes like the eyes of a man, and a mouth speaking arrogantly.

hausa: Sai Musa ya tafi yă taryi surukinsa, ya sunkuya ya yi masa sumba. Suka gai da juna, sa’an nan suka shiga tenti.
english: Moses went out to meet his father-in-law, and bowed and kissed him. They asked each other of their welfare, and they came into the tent.

hausa: Zan ragargazar da wannan birni in mai da shi abin reni, duk wanda ya wuce zai yi mamaki ya kuma yi tsaki saboda dukan masifunsa.
english: I will make this city an astonishment and a hissing. Everyone who passes by it will be astonished and hiss because of all its plagues.

hausa: Yowash ya huta da kakanninsa, Yerobowam kuwa ya gāje shi. Aka binne Yehowash a Samariya tare da sarakunan Isra’ila.
english: Joash slept with his fathers; and Jeroboam sat on his throne. Joash was buried in Samaria with the kings of Israel.

hausa: Tun yana cikin magana, sai Yonatan ɗan Abiyatar ya iso. Adoniya ya ce, “Shigo! Ai, mutumin kirki irinka, lalle ka kawo labari mai daɗi ne.”
english: While he yet spoke, behold, Jonathan the son of Abiathar the priest came; and Adonijah said, “Come in; for you are a worthy man, and bring good news.”

hausa: Allah kuwa ya sadu da Bala’am. Bala’am ya ce, “Na shirya bagadai bakwai, na kuma miƙa bijimi guda da rago guda, a kan kowane bagade.”
english: God met Balaam, and he said to him, “I have prepared the seven altars, and I have offered up a bull and a ram on every altar.”

hausa: sai Falal ɗan Uzai ya yi aiki ɗaura da kusurwa da kuma doguwar hasumiya daga fadar da take bisa kusa da shirayin masu tsaro. Biye da shi, Fedahiya ɗan Farosh
english: Palal the son of Uzai made repairs opposite the turning of the wall, and the tower that stands out from the upper house of the king, which is by the court of the guard. After him Pedaiah the son of Parosh made repairs.

hausa: Sun ragargaje dukan sassaƙar katako da gatura da kuma gudumarsu.
english: Now they break all its carved work down with hatchet and hammers.

hausa: Rayuwarka za tă fi hasken rana haske, duhu kuma zai zama kamar safiya.
english: Life will be clearer than the noonday. Though there is darkness, it will be as the morning.

hausa: Saboda tawaye, sai aka ba da rundunar tsarkaka da kuma hadayar ƙonawa ta kowace rana ga ƙahon. Sai ya yi watsi da gaskiya, ya yi abin da ya ga dama, ya kuwa yi nasara.
english: The army was given over to it together with the continual burnt offering through disobedience. It cast down truth to the ground, and it did its pleasure and prospered.

hausa: Kabari a ƙarƙashi duk ya shirya don yă sadu da kai a zuwanka; yana tā da ruhohin da suka rasu don su gaishe ka, dukan waɗanda sun taɓa zama shugabanni a duniya; ya sa suka tashi daga kujerun sarauta, dukan waɗanda suke sarakuna a kan al’ummai.
english: Sheol from beneath has moved for you to meet you at your coming. It stirs up the departed spirits for you, even all the rulers of the earth. It has raised up from their thrones all the kings of the nations.

hausa: ya kuma sa su a kurkuku a cikin gidan shugaban masu tsaro, a wannan kurkukun da aka sa Yusuf.
english: He put them in custody in the house of the captain of the guard, into the prison, the place where Joseph was bound.

hausa: Ta haka muka sani, muke kuma dogara ga ƙaunar da Allah yake mana. Allah ƙauna ne. Duk wanda yake rayuwa cikin ƙauna, yana rayuwa a cikin Allah ne, Allah kuma a cikinsa.
english: We know and have believed the love which God has for us. God is love, and he who remains in love remains in God, and God remains in him.

hausa: Ko kuwa in ya roƙe shi kifi, sai yă ba shi maciji?
english: Or if he asks for a fish, who will give him a serpent?

hausa: In kuwa suka ƙi salamar, suka fāɗa muku da yaƙi, sai ku yi wa wannan birni ƙawanya.
english: If it will make no peace with you, but will make war against you, then you shall besiege it.

hausa: Saboda haka annabin ya ce masa, “Zo gida tare da ni ka ci abinci.”
english: Then he said to him, “Come home with me and eat bread.”

hausa: Har yanzu, waɗansu kamar irin da aka shuka cikin ƙaya, sukan ji maganar,
english: Others are those who are sown among the thorns. These are those who have heard the word,

hausa: Wane ne ya fi girma? Wanda yake zaune a tebur ne, ko kuma shi da yake yin hidima? Ashe, ba wanda yake zaune a tebur ba ne? Amma ga ni, ni mai yin hidima ne a cikinku.
english: For who is greater, one who sits at the table, or one who serves? Isn’t it he who sits at the table? But I am among you as one who serves.

hausa: Da sassafe ya sāke bayyana a filin haikali, inda dukan mutane suka taru kewaye da shi, sai ya zauna don yă koya musu.
english: Now very early in the morning, he came again into the temple, and all the people came to him. He sat down and taught them.

hausa: Za a soke alkawarinku da mutuwa; yarjejjeniyarku da kabari ba zai zaunu ba. Sa’ad da zafi mai ɓarna ya ratsa, zai hallaka ku.
english: Your covenant with death shall be annulled, and your agreement with Sheol shall not stand. When the overflowing scourge passes through, then you will be trampled down by it.

hausa: Gama in ba a tā da matattu ba, to, Kiristi ma ba a tashe shi ba ke nan.
english: For if the dead aren’t raised, neither has Christ been raised.

hausa: Iska mai ƙarfi kuwa tana bugowa, ruwaye kuma suka fara hauka.
english: The sea was tossed by a great wind blowing.

hausa: da take bisa ga bishara mai ɗaukaka ta Allah mai albarka, wadda ya danƙa mini.
english: according to the Good News of the glory of the blessed God, which was committed to my trust.

hausa: A fadar da zai zauna kuwa, wadda aka gina a can baya, ya yi ta da irin fasali guda. Solomon ya kuma yi wata fada kamar wannan zaure domin ’yar Fir’auna, wadda ya auro.
english: His house where he was to dwell, the other court within the porch, was of the same construction. He made also a house for Pharaoh’s daughter (whom Solomon had taken as wife), like this porch.

hausa: Da iska ta fara busowa daga kudu a hankali, sai suka yi tsammani sun sami abin da suke nema; saboda haka suka janye ƙugiyar jirgin ruwa suka bi ta gefen tsibirin Kirit.
english: When the south wind blew softly, supposing that they had obtained their purpose, they weighed anchor and sailed along Crete, close to shore.

hausa: Sa’an nan ku yi shagalin Bikin Makoni ga Ubangiji Allahnku, ta wurin ba da hadaya ta yardar rai daidai da albarkun da Ubangiji Allahnku ya yi muku.
english: You shall keep the feast of weeks to Yahweh your God with a tribute of a free will offering of your hand, which you shall give according to how Yahweh your God blesses you.

hausa: bisa mutanen Lawi shi ne, Hashabiya ɗan Kemuwel; bisa mutanen Haruna shi ne, Zadok;
english: of Levi, Hashabiah the son of Kemuel; of Aaron, Zadok;

hausa: A duk tsararraki masu zuwa, za ku miƙa wannan hadaya daga nunan fari na ɓarzajjen hatsinku ga Ubangiji.
english: Of the first of your dough, you shall give to Yahweh a wave offering throughout your generations.

hausa: Ku tuna yadda na rarraba wa kabilanku ƙasashen nan su zama naku na gādo, dukan ƙasashen da suka rage, ƙasashen da na ci da yaƙi, tsakanin Urdun da Bahar Rum a yamma.
english: Behold, I have allotted to you these nations that remain, to be an inheritance for your tribes, from the Jordan, with all the nations that I have cut off, even to the great sea toward the going down of the sun.

hausa: Sa’ad da ya kwanta, ki lura da inda yake kwance. Sa’an nan ki tafi ki buɗe ƙafafunsa ki kwanta. Zai faɗa miki abin da za ki yi.”
english: It shall be, when he lies down, that you shall note the place where he is lying. Then you shall go in, uncover his feet, and lie down. Then he will tell you what to do.”

hausa: Sai Yesu ya tambayi masanan dokoki da Farisiyawa ya ce, “Daidai ne bisa ga doka, a yi warkarwa a ranar Asabbaci, ko babu?”
english: Jesus, answering, spoke to the lawyers and Pharisees, saying, “Is it lawful to heal on the Sabbath?”

hausa: Harshen mai hikima kan yi zance mai kyau a kan sani, amma bakin wawa kan fitar da wauta.
english: The tongue of the wise commends knowledge, but the mouths of fools gush out folly.

hausa: To, in ban gane ma’anar abin da wani yake faɗi ba, ni baƙo ne ga mai maganar, shi kuma baƙo ne a gare ni.
english: If then I don’t know the meaning of the language, I would be to him who speaks a foreigner, and he who speaks would be a foreigner to me.

hausa: Yehohiyada da ’ya’yansa maza suka fitar da ɗan sarki suka sa rawani a kansa; suka miƙa masa alkawarin, suka kuma yi shelarsa a matsayin sarki. Suka shafe shi suka kuma tā da murya suna cewa, “Ran sarki yă daɗe!”
english: Then they brought out the king’s son, put the crown on him, gave him the covenant, and made him king. Jehoiada and his sons anointed him, and they said, “Long live the king!”

hausa: Sai Amalekawa da Kan’aniyawa mazaunan ƙasar tudu, suka gangaro suka auka musu, suka bubbuge su suka kokkore su har Horma.
english: Then the Amalekites came down, and the Canaanites who lived in that mountain, and struck them and beat them down even to Hormah.

hausa: Da lokacin girbi ya yi kusa, sai ya aiki bayinsa wajen ’yan hayan, su karɓo masa ’ya’yan inabi.
english: When the season for the fruit came near, he sent his servants to the farmers to receive his fruit.

hausa: Manzanni da ’yan’uwa ko’ina a Yahudiya suka ji cewa Al’ummai ma sun karɓi maganar Allah.
english: Now the apostles and the brothers who were in Judea heard that the Gentiles had also received the word of God.

hausa: “Saboda haka mutum yakan bar mahaifinsa da mahaifiyarsa, yă manne wa matarsa, su biyun su zama jiki ɗaya.”
english: “For this cause a man will leave his father and mother and will be joined to his wife. Then the two will become one flesh.”

hausa: Sai Elisha ya aika ’yan saƙo su ce masa, “Je, ka nutse sau bakwai a Urdun, fatar jikinka za tă koma daidai, ka kuma tsarkaka.”
english: Elisha sent a messenger to him, saying, “Go and wash in the Jordan seven times, and your flesh shall come again to you, and you shall be clean.”

hausa: Saboda haka na tashi da tafi fili. Ɗaukakar Ubangiji kuwa ta tsaya a can, kamar ɗaukakar da na gani kusa da Kogin Kebar, sai na fāɗi rubda ciki.
english: Then I arose, and went out into the plain, and behold, Yahweh’s glory stood there, like the glory which I saw by the river Chebar. Then I fell on my face.

hausa: Ina kawo adalcina kusa, ba shi da nisa; kuma cetona ba zai jinkirta ba. Zan yi wa Sihiyona ceto, darajata ga Isra’ila.
english: I bring my righteousness near. It is not far off, and my salvation will not wait. I will grant salvation to Zion, my glory to Israel.

hausa: Kada ku yi yarjejjeniyar abuta da su, muddin kuna da rai.
english: You shall not seek their peace nor their prosperity all your days forever.

hausa: Cikin fushi da hasala, Nebukadnezzar ya aika a kira Shadrak, Meshak da Abednego. Aka kawo waɗannan mutane a gaban sarki,
english: Then Nebuchadnezzar in rage and fury commanded that Shadrach, Meshach, and Abednego be brought. Then these men were brought before the king.

hausa: Sun rufe zukatansu marar tausayi, da bakunansu suna magana da fariya.
english: They close up their callous hearts. With their mouth they speak proudly.

hausa: Allah ya albarkace su, ya kuma ce musu, “Ku yi ta haihuwa ku ƙaru da yawa, ku mamaye duniya, ku mallake ta. Ku yi mulki a bisa kifin teku, da tsuntsayen sararin sama, da kuma bisa kowace halitta mai rai wadda take rarrafe a ƙasa.”
english: God blessed them. God said to them, “Be fruitful, multiply, fill the earth, and subdue it. Have dominion over the fish of the sea, over the birds of the sky, and over every living thing that moves on the earth.”

hausa: da kai ne na ragargaza makiyayi da garke, da kai ne na ragargaza manoma da dawakan noma, da kai ne na ragargaza masu mulki da shugabanni.
english: With you I will break in pieces the shepherd and his flock. With you I will break in pieces the farmer and his yoke. With you I will break in pieces governors and deputies.

hausa: Ina so ku san cewa an saki ɗan’uwanmu Timoti. In ya iso da wuri, zan zo tare da shi in gan ku.
english: Know that our brother Timothy has been freed, with whom, if he comes shortly, I will see you.

hausa: Ka rufe zuciyarsu yadda ba za su iya ganewa ba, saboda haka ba za ka bari su yi nasara ba.
english: For you have hidden their heart from understanding, therefore you will not exalt them.

hausa: Zan ba ka mabuɗan mulkin sama; kome ka daure a duniya zai zama a daure a sama, kome kuma ka kunce a duniya zai zama a kunce a sama.”
english: I will give to you the keys of the Kingdom of Heaven, and whatever you bind on earth will have been bound in heaven; and whatever you release on earth will have been released in heaven.”

hausa: Sai suka ce, “Wace shaida kuma muke nema? Ai, mun ji abin da ya ce da bakinsa.”
english: They said, “Why do we need any more witness? For we ourselves have heard from his own mouth!”

hausa: Ga abin da Ubangiji yana cewa, “Ina takardar shaida na saki mahaifiyarka daga aure wadda na kora? Ko kuwa ga wanda mutumin da nake bin bashi ne na sayar da kai? Saboda zunubanka aka sayar da kai; saboda laifofinka ne ya sa aka kori mahaifiyarka.
english: Yahweh says, “Where is the bill of your mother’s divorce, with which I have put her away? Or to which of my creditors have I sold you? Behold, you were sold for your iniquities, and your mother was put away for your transgressions.

hausa: “Ka shirya ƙyallen da za a manna a ƙirji don neman nufin Allah. Sai a saƙa shi da gwaninta kamar yadda aka saƙa efod ɗin. A saƙa shi da zinariya, da shuɗi, da shunayya, da mulufi, da lallausan zaren lilin.
english: “You shall make a breastplate of judgment, the work of the skillful workman; like the work of the ephod you shall make it; of gold, of blue, and purple, and scarlet, and fine twined linen, you shall make it.

hausa: ’Ya’yan Lawi maza su ne, Gershom, Kohat da Merari.
english: The sons of Levi: Gershom, Kohath, and Merari.

hausa: Amma na ce, “Ya kamata mutum kamar ni yă gudu? Ko kuwa ya kamata wani kamar ni yă shiga cikin haikali don yă ceci ransa? Ba zan tafi ba!”
english: I said, “Should a man like me flee? Who is there that, being such as I, would go into the temple to save his life? I will not go in.”

hausa: Dawuda da dukan Isra’ilawa suka yi shagali da dukan ƙarfinsu a gaban Allah, tare da waƙoƙi da garayu, molaye, ganguna, kuge da ƙahoni.
english: David and all Israel played before God with all their might, even with songs, with harps, with stringed instruments, with tambourines, with cymbals, and with trumpets.

hausa: Mutum yakan tafi aikinsa, zuwa wurin aikinsa har yamma.
english: Man goes out to his work, to his labor until the evening.

hausa: Saboda haka ko’ina muka tafi, muna shela, muna gargaɗi, muna kuma koyar da kowa da dukan hikima, don mu miƙa kowa cikakke a cikin Kiristi.
english: We proclaim him, admonishing every man and teaching every man in all wisdom, that we may present every man perfect in Christ Jesus;

hausa: Gaskiya nake gaya muku, duk wannan zai auko wa wannan zamani.
english: Most certainly I tell you, all these things will come upon this generation.

hausa: “Sa’ad da na kulle sammai don kada a yi ruwan sama ko na umarci fāri su cinye amfanin ƙasar ko kuwa na aika da annoba a cikin mutanena,
english: “If I shut up the sky so that there is no rain, or if I command the locust to devour the land, or if I send pestilence among my people,

hausa: Zan ragargaza Elam a gaban maƙiyansu, a gaban waɗanda suke neman ransu; zan kawo masifa a kansu, da zafin fushina,” in ji Ubangiji. “Zan runtume su da takobi sai na kawo ƙarshensu.
english: I will cause Elam to be dismayed before their enemies, and before those who seek their life. I will bring evil on them, even my fierce anger,’ says Yahweh; ‘and I will send the sword after them, until I have consumed them.

hausa: Laban ya amsa wa Yaƙub, “Matan, ’ya’yana ne, ’ya’yansu, ’ya’yana ne, garkunan kuma garkunana ne. Dukan abin da kake gani, nawa ne. Duk da haka me zan yi a rana ta yau ga waɗannan ’ya’yana mata, ko kuma ga ’ya’yan da suka haifa?
english: Laban answered Jacob, “The daughters are my daughters, the children are my children, the flocks are my flocks, and all that you see is mine! What can I do today to these my daughters, or to their children whom they have borne?

hausa: in ba ku zalunci baƙo, maraya ko gwauruwa ba kuma in ba ku zub da jinin marar laifi a wannan wuri ba, in kuma ba ku bi waɗansu alloli da za su cuce ku ba,
english: if you don’t oppress the foreigner, the fatherless, and the widow, and don’t shed innocent blood in this place, and don’t walk after other gods to your own hurt,

hausa: (Yowab da ɗan’uwansa Abishai suka kashe Abner don yă kashe ɗan’uwansu Asahel a yaƙin Gibeyon.)
english: So Joab and Abishai his brother killed Abner, because he had killed their brother Asahel at Gibeon in the battle.

hausa: Haka ma a Yahuda, hannun Allah yana a kan mutane don yă ba su zuciya ɗaya su yi abin da sarki da fadawansa suka umarta, suna bin maganar Ubangiji.
english: Also the hand of God came on Judah to give them one heart, to do the commandment of the king and of the princes by Yahweh’s word.

hausa: Sa’an nan ya auna filin, murabba’i ne, tsawonsa kamu ɗari, fāɗinsa kuma kamu ɗari. Bagaden kuwa yana a gaba a cikin haikalin.
english: He measured the court, one hundred cubits long and one hundred cubits wide, square. The altar was before the house.

hausa: da bijimi da rago don hadayun salama, a yi hadaya da su ga Ubangiji, da hadaya ta gari da aka kwaɓa da mai, gama yau Ubangiji zai bayyana a gare ku.’ ”
english: and a bull and a ram for peace offerings, to sacrifice before Yahweh; and a meal offering mixed with oil: for today Yahweh appears to you.’”

hausa: Ba ma tallar maganar Allah don riba yadda waɗansu mutane da yawa suke yi. A maimakon haka, muna magana cikin Kiristi a gaban Allah da gaskiya, kamar mutanen da aka aika daga Allah.
english: For we are not as so many, peddling the word of God. But as of sincerity, but as of God, in the sight of God, we speak in Christ.

hausa: Ka dai san cewa irin mutumin nan ya taurare kuma mai zunubi ne; ya yanke wa kansa hukunci.
english: knowing that such a one is perverted and sinful, being self-condemned.

hausa: “An yi shelar Doka da Annabawa har zuwa lokacin Yohanna. Tun daga lokacin nan, bisharar mulkin Allah ne ake wa’azinta, kowa kuma yana ƙoƙarin kutsa kai ya shiga.
english: “The law and the prophets were until John. From that time the Good News of God’s Kingdom is preached, and everyone is forcing his way into it.

hausa: Kaitonku sa’ad da dukan mutane suna magana mai kyau a kanku, gama haka kakanninsu suka yi da annabawan ƙarya.
english: Woe, when men speak well of you, for their fathers did the same thing to the false prophets.

hausa: Aka ji abin da Dawuda ya ce, aka kuwa gaya wa Shawulu, Shawulu kuma ya aika a kawo shi.
english: When the words were heard which David spoke, they rehearsed them before Saul; and he sent for him.

hausa: Sai mala’ikan Ubangiji ya ce mata, “Koma wurin uwargijiyarki Saira, ki yi mata biyayya.”
english: Yahweh’s angel said to her, “Return to your mistress, and submit yourself under her hands.”

hausa: Sai suka ce masa, “Ina Saratu matarka?” Ibrahim ya ce, “Tana can cikin tenti.”
english: They asked him, “Where is Sarah, your wife?” He said, “There, in the tent.”

hausa: Saboda haka, ga abin da Mai Tsarkin nan na Isra’ila yake cewa, “Saboda haka kun ƙi wannan saƙo, kuka dogara ga aikin kama-karya kuka kuma dogara ga yin ruɗu,
english: Therefore the Holy One of Israel says, “Because you despise this word, and trust in oppression and perverseness, and rely on it,

hausa: Ya ce musu, “In kuna so in binne mataccena, sai ku ji ni, ku roƙi Efron ɗan Zohar a madadina
english: He talked with them, saying, “If you agree that I should bury my dead out of my sight, hear me, and entreat for me to Ephron the son of Zohar,

hausa: Sa’an nan suka juya suka tafi En Mishfat (wato, Kadesh), suka cinye dukan ƙasar Amalekawa, da kuma Amoriyawa waɗanda suke zaune a Hazazon Tamar.
english: They returned, and came to En Mishpat (also called Kadesh), and struck all the country of the Amalekites, and also the Amorites, that lived in Hazazon Tamar.

hausa: Dokar, inuwa ce kawai ta kyawawan abubuwa masu zuwa, wannan inuwar ba ita ce ainihin abubuwan ba ne. Saboda haka ba za tă taɓa mai da masu matsowa kusa don yin sujada cikakku ta wurin irin hadayun da ake maimaitawa ba fasawa shekara-shekara ba.
english: For the law, having a shadow of the good to come, not the very image of the things, can never with the same sacrifices year by year, which they offer continually, make perfect those who draw near.

hausa: Kash, da a ce hanyoyina tsayayyu ne a yin biyayya da ƙa’idodinka mana!
english: Oh that my ways were steadfast to obey your statutes!

hausa: Ku dai gane wannan, da maigida ya san ko a wane lokaci ne da dare, ɓarawo zai zo, da sai yă zauna a faɗake yă kuma hana a shiga masa gida.
english: But know this, that if the master of the house had known in what watch of the night the thief was coming, he would have watched, and would not have allowed his house to be broken into.

hausa: Kada ku yi aiki na kullum, amma ku miƙa hadaya ta ƙonawa ga Ubangiji.’ ”
english: You shall do no regular work. You shall offer an offering made by fire to Yahweh.’”

hausa: Annabci, maganar Ubangiji game da Isra’ila. Ubangiji, wanda ya shimfiɗa sammai, wanda ya kafa harsashin duniya, wanda kuma ya yi ruhun mutum a cikinsa ya ce,
english: A revelation of Yahweh’s word concerning Israel: Yahweh, who stretches out the heavens and lays the foundation of the earth, and forms the spirit of man within him says:

hausa: Da cikin tsarki, da fahimta, da haƙuri, da kirki, da cikin Ruhu Mai Tsarki, da cikin ƙauna mai gaskiya,
english: in pureness, in knowledge, in perseverance, in kindness, in the Holy Spirit, in sincere love,

hausa: Ka ba da yayyafi a yalwace, ya Allah; ka rayar da gādonka da ya gāji.
english: You, God, sent a plentiful rain. You confirmed your inheritance when it was weary.

hausa: Sarki da mutanensa suka tafi Urushalima don su kai wa Yebusiyawan da suke zaune a can hari, Yebusiyawa suka ce wa Dawuda, “Ba za ka shiga nan ba; ko makafi da guragu kaɗai ma za su kore ka.” Suka yi tsammani suna cewa, “Dawuda ba zai iya shiga can ba.”
english: The king and his men went to Jerusalem against the Jebusites, the inhabitants of the land, who spoke to David, saying, “The blind and the lame will keep you out of here,” thinking, “David can’t come in here.”

hausa: Dukan waɗanda suka tafi Masar tare da Yaƙub, waɗanda suke zuriyarsa kai tsaye ban da matan ’ya’yansa maza, su mutum sittin da shida ne.
english: All the souls who came with Jacob into Egypt, who were his direct offspring, in addition to Jacob’s sons’ wives, all the souls were sixty-six.

hausa: Lokacin da raɓar ta watse, sai ga wani abu kamar tsaki, falle-falle kuma da laushi, fari, kamar hazo, a ƙasa.
english: When the dew that lay had gone, behold, on the surface of the wilderness was a small round thing, small as the frost on the ground.

hausa: Ga wani bangaskiya ta wurin wannan Ruhu, ga wani kuma baiwar warkarwa ta wurin wannan Ruhu guda.
english: to another faith by the same Spirit, and to another gifts of healings by the same Spirit,

hausa: Gama da wuta da kuma takobi Ubangiji zai yi hukunci a kan dukan mutane, kuma yawanci za su kasance waɗanda Ubangiji zai kashe.
english: For Yahweh will execute judgment by fire and by his sword on all flesh; and those slain by Yahweh will be many.

hausa: Sa’an nan firistoci suka kawo akwatin alkawarin Ubangiji inda aka shirya masa, can ciki cikin haikali, a Wuri Mafi Tsarki, aka kuma sa shi a ƙarƙashin fikafikan kerubobin.
english: The priests brought in the ark of Yahweh’s covenant to its place, into the inner sanctuary of the house, to the most holy place, even under the cherubim’s wings.

hausa: Yehoshafat yana da shekara talatin da biyar sa’ad da ya zama sarki, ya kuma yi mulki a Urushalima shekaru ashirin da biyar. Sunan mahaifiyarsa, Azuba ’yar Shilhi.
english: Jehoshaphat was thirty-five years old when he began to reign; and he reigned twenty-five years in Jerusalem. His mother’s name was Azubah the daughter of Shilhi.

hausa: Yanzu da na shirya ƙarata, na san za a ce ba ni da laifi.
english: See now, I have set my cause in order. I know that I am righteous.

hausa: Ya fi kowane mutum hikima, har da Etan dangin Ezra ma. Yana da hikima fiye da Heman, Kalkol da Darda, ’ya’yan Mahol maza. Sunansa ya bazu ko’ina a ƙasashen da suke kewaye.
english: For he was wiser than all men—wiser than Ethan the Ezrahite, Heman, Calcol, and Darda, the sons of Mahol; and his fame was in all the nations all around.

hausa: “muryar mai kira a hamada tana cewa, ‘Ku shirya wa Ubangiji hanya, ku miƙe hanyoyi dominsa.’ ”
english: the voice of one crying in the wilderness, ‘Make ready the way of the Lord! Make his paths straight!’”

hausa: domin ba za ka yashe ni a kabari ba, ba kuwa za ka bar Mai Tsarkinka yă ruɓa ba.
english: For you will not leave my soul in Sheol, neither will you allow your holy one to see corruption.

hausa: Muna da bagade inda firistocin da suka yi hidima a tabanakul ba su da izini su ci.
english: We have an altar from which those who serve the holy tabernacle have no right to eat.

hausa: Wanda kuma ke ba da abinci ga kowace halitta. Ƙaunarsa madawwamiya ce.
english: who gives food to every creature, for his loving kindness endures forever.

hausa: Gare shi bari iko yă tabbata har abada abadin. Amin.
english: To him be the glory and the power forever and ever. Amen.

hausa: Gama ya san wanda zai bashe shi, shi ya sa ya ce, “Ba kowa ba ne yake da tsabta.”
english: For he knew him who would betray him; therefore he said, “You are not all clean.”

hausa: zan sa wuta a gidan Hazayel, da za tă ƙona kagarun Ben-Hadad.
english: but I will send a fire into the house of Hazael, and it will devour the palaces of Ben Hadad.

hausa: Tabbatacce kana son gaskiya a sassan ciki; ka koya mini hikima a wuri can ciki.
english: Behold, you desire truth in the inward parts. You teach me wisdom in the inmost place.

hausa: da Yoyela da Zebadiya ’ya’yan Yeroham maza daga Gedor.
english: and Joelah and Zebadiah, the sons of Jeroham of Gedor.

hausa: Gara a zauna a kusurwar rufin ɗaki da a zauna a gida ɗaya da mace mai fitina.
english: It is better to dwell in the corner of the housetop than to share a house with a contentious woman.

hausa: Ba kuwa yana gaba da teku ba, da za ku ce, “Wa zai haye tekun don yă kawo mana, yă kuma furta mana, don mu yi biyayya?”
english: Neither is it beyond the sea, that you should say, “Who will go over the sea for us, bring it to us, and proclaim it to us, that we may do it?”

hausa: Sai Shekem ya ce wa mahaifinsa Hamor, “Ka auro mini wannan yarinya ta zama matata.”
english: Shechem spoke to his father, Hamor, saying, “Get me this young lady as a wife.”

hausa: Mutanen Gad sun zauna kusa da mutanen Ruben a Bashan, har zuwa Saleka.
english: The sons of Gad lived beside them in the land of Bashan to Salecah:

hausa: “Amma ya amsa wa ɗayansu ya ce, ‘Aboki, ban cuce ka ba. Ba ka yarda ka yi aiki a kan dinari guda ba?
english: “But he answered one of them, ‘Friend, I am doing you no wrong. Didn’t you agree with me for a denarius?

hausa: Suka yi wa ƙofar tenti labulen shuɗi, shunayya, jan zare, da kuma lallausan lilin, aikin gwaninta;
english: He made a screen for the door of the tent, of blue, purple, scarlet, and fine twined linen, the work of an embroiderer;

hausa: Hannuwan masu aiki tuƙuru za su yi mulki, amma ragwanci kan ƙarasa a aikin bauta.
english: The hands of the diligent ones shall rule, but laziness ends in slave labor.

hausa: Suka kuwa yi murna, suka yarda su ba shi kuɗi.
english: They were glad, and agreed to give him money.

hausa: ’Ya’yan da aka haifa a lokacin baƙin cikinki za su ce a kunnenki, ‘Wannan wuri ya yi mana kaɗan ƙwarai; ki ƙara mana wurin zama.’
english: The children of your bereavement will say in your ears, ‘This place is too small for me. Give me a place to live in.’

hausa: Gama kunne yana rarrabe magana kamar yadda harshe yake ɗanɗana abinci.
english: For the ear tries words, as the palate tastes food.

hausa: Saye da tufafin makoki kewaye a gindinsu, da kuma igiyoyi kewaye da kawunansu, suka tafi wurin sarkin Isra’ila, suka ce, “Bawanka Ben-Hadad ya ce, ‘Ina roƙonka bari in rayu.’ ” Sarki ya amsa, “Har yanzu yana da rai? Shi ɗan’uwana ne.”
english: So they put sackcloth on their bodies and ropes on their heads, and came to the king of Israel, and said, “Your servant Ben Hadad says, ‘Please let me live.’” He said, “Is he still alive? He is my brother.”

hausa: Waɗanda aka daure za su sami jin daɗin; an sake su ba za su sāke jin ana tsawata masu ba.
english: There the prisoners are at ease together. They don’t hear the voice of the taskmaster.

hausa: “Ka shigar da gumakanka don su faɗa mana abin da zai faru. Faɗa mana abubuwan da suka riga suka faru, domin mu lura da su mu kuma san abin da zai faru a ƙarshe. Ko kuwa ku furta mana abubuwan da za su faru,
english: “Let them announce and declare to us what will happen! Declare the former things, what they are, that we may consider them, and know the latter end of them; or show us things to come.

hausa: Dabbobi da kowane abu mai rai da suka shiga ciki, namiji ne da ta mace, yadda Allah ya umarci Nuhu. Sa’an nan Ubangiji ya kulle jirgin daga baya.
english: Those who went in, went in male and female of all flesh, as God commanded him; then Yahweh shut him in.

hausa: Babu wanda zai yi roƙo saboda damuwarku, ba magani domin mikinku babu warkarwa dominku.
english: There is no one to plead your cause, that you may be bound up. You have no healing medicines.

hausa: Kai, ba dama mu saɓa wa gaskiya, sai dai mu bi bayan gaskiyar.
english: For we can do nothing against the truth, but for the truth.

hausa: Sai mala’ikan Ubangiji ya fita ya kuma karkashe mutane dubu ɗari da dubu tamanin da dubu biyar a sansanin Assuriya. Sa’ad da mutane suka farka kashegari, sai ga gawawwaki duk a kwance!
english: Then Yahweh’s angel went out and struck one hundred and eighty-five thousand men in the camp of the Assyrians. When men arose early in the morning, behold, these were all dead bodies.

hausa: Ya miƙa hadayun shanu, da shanun da ake kiwo a gida, da tumaki masu yawa, ya kuma gayyaci dukan ’ya’yan sarki maza, da Abiyatar firist, da Yowab shugaban mayaƙa, amma bai gayyaci Solomon bawanka ba.
english: He has slain cattle and fatlings and sheep in abundance, and has called all the sons of the king, Abiathar the priest, and Joab the captain of the army; but he hasn’t called Solomon your servant.

hausa: Mutum mai haƙuri yana da fahimi mai yawa, amma mai saurin fushi yakan nuna wautarsa a fili.
english: He who is slow to anger has great understanding, but he who has a quick temper displays folly.

hausa: Ku tafi, mutanena, ku shiga ɗakunanku ku kuma kulle ƙofofi; ku ɓoye kanku na ɗan lokaci sai ya huce fushinsa.
english: Come, my people, enter into your rooms, and shut your doors behind you. Hide yourself for a little moment, until the indignation is past.

hausa: Da ikon mai ƙarfi da kuma hannuna da na miƙa na yi duniya da mutanenta da kuma dabbobin da suke ciki, na ba da ita ga duk wanda na ga dama.
english: ‘I have made the earth, the men, and the animals that are on the surface of the earth by my great power and by my outstretched arm. I give it to whom it seems right to me.

hausa: Shawulu ya ce wa fadawansa, “Ku nemo mini wata mace mai duba domin in tafi wurinta in yi tambaya.” Suka ce, “Akwai guda a En Dor.”
english: Then Saul said to his servants, “Seek for me a woman who has a familiar spirit, that I may go to her and inquire of her.” His servants said to him, “Behold, there is a woman who has a familiar spirit at Endor.”

hausa: A lokacin, Isra’ilawa sun bar wurin suka tafi gida zuwa ga kabilansu da zuriyoyinsu, kowane zuwa gādonsa.
english: The children of Israel departed from there at that time, every man to his tribe and to his family, and they each went out from there to his own inheritance.

hausa: tentunan Edom da na mutanen Ishmayel, na Mowab da kuma na Hagirawa,
english: The tents of Edom and the Ishmaelites; Moab, and the Hagrites;
