hausa: Yawan waɗanda suka ci, sun yi wajen maza dubu biyar, ban da mata da yara.
english: Those who ate were about five thousand men, in addition to women and children.

hausa: Amma na sami taimakon Allah har yă zuwa yau. Yanzu ga ni a tsaye a nan, ina shaida ga babba da yaro. Ba na faɗin kome fiye da abin da annabawa da Musa suka ce zai faru,
english: Having therefore obtained the help that is from God, I stand to this day testifying both to small and great, saying nothing but what the prophets and Moses said would happen,

hausa: Za tă zama rana ce ta musamman, ba yini ko dare, rana da take sananne ga Ubangiji. Sa’ad da yamma ta yi, za a yi haske.
english: It will be a unique day which is known to Yahweh—not day, and not night; but it will come to pass that at evening time there will be light.

hausa: Saboda haka sojoji suka ba da ’yan kurkukun da ganima a gaban hafsoshi da dukan taron.
english: So the armed men left the captives and the plunder before the princes and all the assembly.

hausa: Wane ne zai raba mu da ƙaunar Kiristi? Masifa ce ko wahala ko tsanani ko yunwa ko tsiraici ko hatsari ko takobi?
english: Who shall separate us from the love of Christ? Could oppression, or anguish, or persecution, or famine, or nakedness, or peril, or sword?

hausa: Sa’an nan Irmiya ya ce wa Zedekiya, “Ga abin da Ubangiji Allah Maɗaukaki, Allah na Isra’ila, yana cewa, ‘In ka miƙa wuya ga hafsoshin sarkin Babilon, za a bar ka da rai ba za a kuma ƙone wannan birni ba; da kai da iyalinka za ku rayu.
english: Then Jeremiah said to Zedekiah, “Yahweh, the God of Armies, the God of Israel, says: ‘If you will go out to the king of Babylon’s princes, then your soul will live, and this city will not be burned with fire. You will live, along with your house.

hausa: Ta haka abokan gābana za su juya da baya sa’ad da na nemi taimako. Ta haka zan san cewa Allah yana tare da ni.
english: Then my enemies shall turn back in the day that I call. I know this: that God is for me.

hausa: Suka ba shi haushi da masujadansu na kan tudu; suka tayar da kishinsa da gumakansu.
english: For they provoked him to anger with their high places, and moved him to jealousy with their engraved images.

hausa: Sai ya haura zuwa cikin haikalin Ubangiji tare da mutanen Yahuda, da na Urushalima, da firistoci, da annabawa, dukan mutane, manya da ƙanana. Ya karanta musu duk kalmomin Littafin Alkawari, wanda aka samu a haikalin Ubangiji.
english: The king went up to Yahweh’s house, and all the men of Judah and all the inhabitants of Jerusalem with him—with the priests, the prophets, and all the people, both small and great; and he read in their hearing all the words of the book of the covenant which was found in Yahweh’s house.

hausa: “Ka tsaya a ƙofar gidan Ubangiji, a can kuwa ka yi shelar wannan saƙo. “ ‘Ku ji maganar Ubangiji, dukanku mutanen Yahuda waɗanda suke shiga ta waɗannan ƙofofi don yin sujada ga Ubangiji.
english: “Stand in the gate of Yahweh’s house, and proclaim this word there, and say, ‘Hear Yahweh’s word, all you of Judah, who enter in at these gates to worship Yahweh.’”

hausa: “Daga baya kuma, zan zuba Ruhuna a bisan dukan mutane. ’Ya’yanku maza da mata za su yi annabci, tsofaffinku za su yi mafarkai, matasanku za su ga wahayoyi.
english: “It will happen afterward, that I will pour out my Spirit on all flesh; and your sons and your daughters will prophesy. Your old men will dream dreams. Your young men will see visions.

hausa: “Wajen tsakar rana da na yi kusa da Damaskus, ba zato ba tsammani sai wani babban haske daga sama ya haskaka kewaye da ni.
english: “As I made my journey and came close to Damascus, about noon suddenly a great light shone around me from the sky.

hausa: Duk wanda ya zauna a wannan birni zai mutu ta takobi, yunwa ko annoba. Amma duk wanda ya fita ya miƙa kansa ga Babiloniyawa waɗanda suka kewaye ku zai rayu; zai kuɓutar da ransa.
english: He who remains in this city will die by the sword, by the famine, and by the pestilence, but he who goes out and passes over to the Chaldeans who besiege you, he will live, and he will escape with his life.

hausa: Kamar mafarki haka zai ɓace, ba za a ƙara ganinsa ba zai ɓace kamar wahayi da dare.
english: He will fly away as a dream, and will not be found. Yes, he will be chased away like a vision of the night.

hausa: Ba ta wani tunanin rayuwa; hanyoyinta karkatacce ne, amma ba tă sani ba.
english: She gives no thought to the way of life. Her ways are crooked, and she doesn’t know it.

hausa: Amma bayan shekaru uku, biyu daga cikin bayin Shimeyi suka gudu zuwa wurin Akish ɗan Ma’aka, sarkin Gat. Aka faɗa wa Shimeyi cewa, “Bayinka suna a Gat.”
english: At the end of three years, two of Shimei’s slaves ran away to Achish, son of Maacah, king of Gath. They told Shimei, saying, “Behold, your slaves are in Gath.”

hausa: Mahaifinsu ya ba su kyautai masu yawa na azurfa da zinariya da kayayyaki masu daraja, tare da birane masu katanga a Yahuda, amma ya ba da mulki ga Yehoram domin shi ne ɗan farinsa.
english: Their father gave them great gifts of silver, of gold, and of precious things, with fortified cities in Judah; but he gave the kingdom to Jehoram, because he was the firstborn.

hausa: Abin da nake tsoro ya faru da ni; abin da ba na so ya same ni.
english: For the thing which I fear comes on me, that which I am afraid of comes to me.

hausa: Shawulu ya ce, “Amma na bi umarnin Ubangiji. Na bi saƙon da Ubangiji ya ba ni. Na hallaka Amalekawa, na kuma kamo Agag sarkinsu.
english: Saul said to Samuel, “But I have obeyed Yahweh’s voice, and have gone the way which Yahweh sent me, and have brought Agag the king of Amalek, and have utterly destroyed the Amalekites.

hausa: Bari mu zo gabansa da godiya mu rera gare shi da kiɗi da waƙa.
english: Let’s come before his presence with thanksgiving. Let’s extol him with songs!

hausa: Duk da haka, in aka shuka ƙwayar, sai tă yi girma, tă zama mafi girma a itatuwan lambu. Har itacen yă kasance da manyan rassa, inda tsuntsayen sararin sama sukan iya huta a inuwarsa.”
english: yet when it is sown, grows up and becomes greater than all the herbs, and puts out great branches, so that the birds of the sky can lodge under its shadow.”

hausa: “Edom za tă zama abin tsoro; dukan wanda ya wuce zai giggice ya yi tsaki saboda dukan mikinta.
english: “Edom will become an astonishment. Everyone who passes by it will be astonished, and will hiss at all its plagues.

hausa: Dole a niƙa hatsi don a yi burodi; saboda haka mutum ba zai yi ta bugun alkama, har yă ɓata tsabar ba. Ya san yadda zai sussuke alkamarsa, ba tare da ya ɓata tsabarta ba.
english: Bread flour must be ground; so he will not always be threshing it. Although he drives the wheel of his threshing cart over it, his horses don’t grind it.

hausa: “Ki haura Gileyad ki samo magani, Ya Budurwa ’Yar Masar. Amma kin riɓanya magani a banza; ba magani dominki.
english: Go up into Gilead, and take balm, virgin daughter of Egypt. You use many medicines in vain. There is no healing for you.

hausa: Dawuda da mutanensa suka fita suka kashe Filistiyawa ɗari biyu, suka kawo loɓar suka miƙa wa sarki, domin yă zama surukin sarki. Sai Shawulu ya ba da ’yarsa Mikal aure ga Dawuda.
english: David arose and went, he and his men, and killed two hundred men of the Philistines. Then David brought their foreskins, and they gave them in full number to the king, that he might be the king’s son-in-law. Then Saul gave him Michal his daughter as wife.

hausa: Ba ku sani ba cewa sa’ad da kuka miƙa kanku ga wani don ku yi masa biyayya a matsayin bayi, ko ku bayi ne ga zunubi, wanda yake kai ga mutuwa, ko kuwa ga biyayya, wadda take kai ga adalci, ashe, ba kun zama bayi ga wannan da kuke yi wa biyayya ba ke nan?
english: Don’t you know that when you present yourselves as servants and obey someone, you are the servants of whomever you obey, whether of sin to death, or of obedience to righteousness?

hausa: “Ga wani yaro da ƙananan burodin sha’ir guda biyar da ƙananan kifi biyu, amma me wannan zai yi wa yawan mutanen nan.”
english: “There is a boy here who has five barley loaves and two fish, but what are these among so many?”

hausa: Biye da su, mutanen Gibeyon da Mizfa Melatiya na Gibeyon da Yadon Meronot waɗanda suke ƙarƙashin ikon gwamnan Kewayen Kogin Yuferites ne suka yi gyare-gyaren.
english: Next to them, Melatiah the Gibeonite and Jadon the Meronothite, the men of Gibeon and of Mizpah, repaired the residence of the governor beyond the River.

hausa: amma sai ya bi ta tsakiyar taron ya yi tafiyarsa.
english: But he, passing through the middle of them, went his way.

hausa: Gama ba su zo sun tarye ku da burodi da ruwa a hanyarku, sa’ad da kuka fito daga Masar ba, sai ma suka yi haya Bala’am ɗan Beyor daga Fetor a Aram-Naharayim yă furta la’ana a kanku.
english: because they didn’t meet you with bread and with water on the way when you came out of Egypt, and because they hired against you Balaam the son of Beor from Pethor of Mesopotamia, to curse you.

hausa: Ina ne zan sami nama in waɗannan mutane? Sun dinga yin mini kuka suna cewa ‘Ka ba mu nama mu ci!’
english: Where could I get meat to give all these people? For they weep before me, saying, ‘Give us meat, that we may eat.’

english: Her princes within it are like wolves ravening the prey, to shed blood and to destroy souls, that they may get dishonest gain.

hausa: saboda haka ya dawo Yezireyel don yă yi jinyar raunin da suka yi masa a Rama cikin yaƙinsa da Hazayel sarkin Aram. Sa’an nan Azariya ɗan Yehoram sarkin Yahuda ya gangara zuwa Yezireyel don yă ga Yoram ɗan Ahab domin ya ji rauni.
english: He returned to be healed in Jezreel of the wounds which they had given him at Ramah, when he fought against Hazael king of Syria. Azariah the son of Jehoram, king of Judah, went down to see Jehoram the son of Ahab in Jezreel, because he was sick.

hausa: Sa’ad bala’i ya auku, mugaye kan fāɗi, amma ko a mutuwa masu adalci suna da mafaka.
english: The wicked is brought down in his calamity, but in death, the righteous has a refuge.

hausa: “ ‘Bayan wannan zan koma in kuma sāke gina tentin Dawuda da ya rushe. Kufansa zan sāke gina, in kuma mai da shi,
english: ‘After these things I will return. I will again build the tabernacle of David, which has fallen. I will again build its ruins. I will set it up

hausa: A kan gicciye, Kiristi ya kawar da ƙiyayyar da take tsakaninmu da juna. Ya kuma kawo sulhu tsakaninmu da Allah.
english: and might reconcile them both in one body to God through the cross, having killed the hostility through it.

hausa: Ta haka za a ƙasƙantar da mutum kuma za a ƙasƙantar da ’yan adam, za a ƙasƙanta da masu girman kai.
english: So man is brought low, mankind is humbled, and the eyes of the arrogant ones are humbled;

hausa: Yau na mai da kai birni mai katanga, ginshiƙin ƙarfe da bangon tagulla don ka tsaya gāba da dukan ƙasar, ya kuma yi gāba da sarakunan Yahuda da fadawan, da firistoci da kuma mutanenta.
english: For behold, I have made you today a fortified city, an iron pillar, and bronze walls against the whole land—against the kings of Judah, against its princes, against its priests, and against the people of the land.

hausa: Gama ba wa’azin kanmu muke yi ba, sai dai na Yesu Kiristi, a kan shi ne Ubangiji, mu kuma bayinku saboda Yesu.
english: For we don’t preach ourselves, but Christ Jesus as Lord, and ourselves as your servants for Jesus’ sake,

hausa: Sa’ad da ni da dukan waɗanda suke tare da ni muka busa ƙahoninmu, to, ko’ina a kewayen sansanin sai ku busa naku ku kuma yi ihu, ku ce, ‘Don Ubangiji da kuma domin Gideyon.’ ”
english: When I blow the trumpet, I and all who are with me, then blow the trumpets also on every side of all the camp, and shout, ‘For Yahweh and for Gideon!’”

hausa: A Tafanes maganar Ubangiji ta zo wa Irmiya cewa,
english: Then Yahweh’s word came to Jeremiah in Tahpanhes, saying,

hausa: Amma ka ma rena Allah ka hana a yi addu’a gare shi.
english: Yes, you do away with fear, and hinder devotion before God.

hausa: Sa’an nan ku miƙa bunsuru ɗaya na hadaya don zunubi, da ’yan raguna biyu, kowanne bana ɗaya-ɗaya, don hadaya ta salama.
english: You shall offer one male goat for a sin offering, and two male lambs a year old for a sacrifice of peace offerings.

hausa: Rubutun Hezekiya sarkin Yahuda bayan ciwonsa da kuma warkarwarsa.
english: The writing of Hezekiah king of Judah, when he had been sick, and had recovered of his sickness:

hausa: “Bayan Ubangiji ya kawo ku cikin ƙasar Kan’aniyawa, ya kuma ba da ita yadda ya alkawarta muku da rantsuwa, ku da kakanninku,
english: “It shall be, when Yahweh brings you into the land of the Canaanite, as he swore to you and to your fathers, and will give it to you,

hausa: “ ‘Jiragen ruwan Tarshish sun zama masu jigilar kayanki. Kin cika da kaya masu nauyi a tsakiyar teku.
english: “‘“The ships of Tarshish were your caravans for your merchandise. You were replenished and made very glorious in the heart of the seas.

hausa: Aka kashe dukan waɗanda ba su nemi Ubangiji, Allah na Isra’ila ba, ko ƙarami ko babba, namiji ko ta mace.
english: and that whoever would not seek Yahweh, the God of Israel, should be put to death, whether small or great, whether man or woman.

hausa: Horam sarkin Gezer kuwa ya zo don yă taimaki Lakish, amma Yoshuwa ya haɗa duk da shi da rundunarsa ya ci su da yaƙi, har bai bar waninsu da rai ba.
english: Then Horam king of Gezer came up to help Lachish; and Joshua struck him and his people, until he had left him no one remaining.

hausa: “Mun yi nazarin wannan, kuma gaskiya ne. Saboda haka ka ji, ka kuma yi amfani da shi.”
english: Behold, we have researched it. It is so. Hear it, and know it for your good.”

hausa: Zai zama murabba’i, tsawonsa kamu ɗaya, fāɗinsa kuma kamu ɗaya, a naɗe shi biyu.
english: It shall be square and folded double; a span shall be its length, and a span its width.

hausa: ’Ya’yan Ezer maza su ne, Bilhan, Za’aban da Ya’akan. ’Ya’yan Dishan maza su ne, Uz da Aran.
english: The sons of Ezer: Bilhan, Zaavan, and Jaakan. The sons of Dishan: Uz and Aran.

hausa: In abin da kowane mutum ya gina ya tsaya, zai sami lada.
english: If any man’s work remains which he built on it, he will receive a reward.

hausa: Za a jajjefe shi da duwatsu, ko a harbe shi da kibiyoyi, ba hannun da zai taɓa shi. Mutum ko dabbar da ya taɓa, ba za a bar shi da rai ba.’ Lokacin da aka ji muryar ƙaho ne kawai za su iya taru a gindin dutsen.”
english: No hand shall touch him, but he shall surely be stoned or shot through; whether it is animal or man, he shall not live.’ When the trumpet sounds long, they shall come up to the mountain.”

hausa: Ya saki iskar gabas daga sammai ya kuma saki iskar yamma ta wurin ikonsa.
english: He caused the east wind to blow in the sky. By his power he guided the south wind.

hausa: Ka yi iyakacin ƙoƙarinka ka iso nan kafin damina. Yubulus yana gaishe ka, haka ma Fuden, Lainus, Kalaudiya da kuma dukan ’yan’uwa.
english: Be diligent to come before winter. Eubulus salutes you, as do Pudens, Linus, Claudia, and all the brothers.

hausa: Sai Gideyon ya ce, “Haka ko? To, sa’ad da Ubangiji ya ba da Zeba da Zalmunna a hannuna, zan tsattsaga jikinku da ƙayayyuwan jeji.”
english: Gideon said, “Therefore when Yahweh has delivered Zebah and Zalmunna into my hand, then I will tear your flesh with the thorns of the wilderness and with briers.”

hausa: Suka tashi daga Dutsen Hor, suka yi sansani a Zalmona.
english: They traveled from Mount Hor, and encamped in Zalmonah.

hausa: Bayan Yaƙub ya komo daga Faddan Aram, sai Allah ya bayyana gare shi, ya kuma albarkace shi.
english: God appeared to Jacob again, when he came from Paddan Aram, and blessed him.

hausa: Ya mai da ruwan samansu ya zama ƙanƙara, da walƙiya ko’ina a ƙasarsu;
english: He gave them hail for rain, with lightning in their land.

hausa: amma mu, muna wa’azin Kiristi wanda aka gicciye ne, wanda ya zama dutsen tuntuɓe ga Yahudawa, wauta kuma ga Al’ummai,
english: but we preach Christ crucified, a stumbling block to Jews and foolishness to Greeks,

hausa: Ira, mutumin Itra. Gareb, mutumin Itra,
english: Ira the Ithrite, Gareb the Ithrite,

hausa: saboda sun yi tayarwa a kan Ruhun Allah, har mugayen kalmomi suka fito daga leɓunan Musa.
english: because they were rebellious against his spirit, he spoke rashly with his lips.

hausa: Zan tā da Babiloniyawa, waɗannan marasa hankali da kuma marasa tausayi; masu gajeren haƙuri, waɗanda suke ratsa ko’ina a duniya don su ƙwace wuraren zaman da ba nasu ba.
english: For, behold, I am raising up the Chaldeans, that bitter and hasty nation who march through the width of the earth, to possess dwelling places that are not theirs.

hausa: Har tsada ma ta sami gida, tsatsewa kuma ta yi wa kanta sheƙa, inda za tă ƙyanƙyashe ’ya’yanta, wuri kusa da bagadenka, Ya Ubangiji Maɗaukaki, Sarkina da kuma Allahna.
english: Yes, the sparrow has found a home, and the swallow a nest for herself, where she may have her young, near your altars, Yahweh of Armies, my King, and my God.

hausa: ’Yan’uwa, ban iya yi muku magana kamar masu ruhaniya ba, sai dai kamar masu halin mutuntaka, jarirai cikin bin Kiristi kawai.
english: Brothers, I couldn’t speak to you as to spiritual, but as to fleshly, as to babies in Christ.

hausa: Azariya ya haifi Yotam, Yotam ya haifi Ahaz, Ahaz ya haifi Hezekiya,
english: Uzziah became the father of Jotham. Jotham became the father of Ahaz. Ahaz became the father of Hezekiah.

hausa: “Masu albarka ne waɗanda suke matalauta a ruhu, gama mulkin sama nasu ne.
english: “Blessed are the poor in spirit, for theirs is the Kingdom of Heaven.

hausa: Ya Ubangiji, idanunka ba sa ganin gaskiya? Ka buge su, amma ba su ji zafi ba; ka ragargaza su, amma suka ƙi su gyara. Fuskarsu ta ƙeƙashe fiye da dutse suka ƙi su tuba.
english: O Yahweh, don’t your eyes look on truth? You have stricken them, but they were not grieved. You have consumed them, but they have refused to receive correction. They have made their faces harder than a rock. They have refused to return.

hausa: Sai Belshazar ya umarta, aka sa wa Daniyel riga mai shunayya, aka sa sarƙar zinariya a wuyansa, aka kuma yi shela, cewa yanzu shi ne na uku a cikin masu mulkin ƙasar.
english: Then Belshazzar commanded, and they clothed Daniel with purple, and put a chain of gold about his neck, and made proclamation concerning him, that he should be the third ruler in the kingdom.

hausa: Bikin Miƙawa a Urushalima ya kewayo, lokacin sanyin hunturu ne kuwa.
english: It was the Feast of the Dedication at Jerusalem.

hausa: Ya wanke kayan cikin da ƙafafun a ruwa, ya kuma ƙone dukan ragon a bisa bagade kamar hadaya ta ƙonawa, mai daɗin ƙanshi, hadaya ce da aka ƙone da wuta ga Ubangiji, yadda Ubangiji ya umarce shi.
english: He washed the innards and the legs with water; and Moses burned the whole ram on the altar. It was a burnt offering for a pleasant aroma. It was an offering made by fire to Yahweh, as Yahweh commanded Moses.

hausa: Sai Shawulu ya tashi ya gangara zuwa Jejin Zif, tare da zaɓaɓɓun mutane dubu uku na Isra’ila. Suka fita neman Dawuda a can.
english: Then Saul arose and went down to the wilderness of Ziph, having three thousand chosen men of Israel with him, to seek David in the wilderness of Ziph.

hausa: Saboda haka Musa ya yi magana da Isra’ilawa, sai shugabanninsu suka ba shi sanduna goma sha biyu, sanda ɗaya don shugaba, bisa ga gidajen kakanninsu, sandan Haruna kuma yana a cikinsu.
english: Moses spoke to the children of Israel; and all their princes gave him rods, for each prince one, according to their fathers’ houses, a total of twelve rods. Aaron’s rod was among their rods.

hausa: Aka yi shekaru uku ba a yi yaƙi tsakanin Aram da Isra’ila ba.
english: They continued three years without war between Syria and Israel.

hausa: Suka mamaye duk fāɗin duniya suka kuma kewaye sansanin mutanen Allah, birnin da yake ƙauna. Amma wuta ta fito daga sama ta cinye su.
english: They went up over the width of the earth and surrounded the camp of the saints and the beloved city. Fire came down out of heaven from God and devoured them.

hausa: Zan taurare zukatan Masarawa su shiga don su bi su. Ta haka zan ci nasara bisa Fir’auna da rundunansa, da keken yaƙinsa, da mahayan dawakansa.
english: Behold, I myself will harden the hearts of the Egyptians, and they will go in after them. I will get myself honor over Pharaoh, and over all his armies, over his chariots, and over his horsemen.

hausa: “ ‘Saboda haka ga abin da Ubangiji Mai Iko Duka yana cewa a cikin hasalata zan saki babbar iska, kuma cikin fushina zan tura ƙanƙara kuma rigyawan ruwan sama zai sauko da fushin hallaka.
english: “‘Therefore the Lord Yahweh says: “I will even tear it with a stormy wind in my wrath. There will be an overflowing shower in my anger, and great hailstones in wrath to consume it.

hausa: Sa’an nan Musa ya ce musu, “Kada wani yă bar saura har safe.”
english: Moses said to them, “Let no one leave of it until the morning.”

hausa: Waɗansu kuwa suka ce, “Saboda yunwa mun jinginar da gonakinmu, da gonakin inabinmu, da gidajenmu don mu sami hatsi.”
english: There were also some who said, “We are mortgaging our fields, our vineyards, and our houses. Let us get grain, because of the famine.”

hausa: Na dai san cewa a kowace birni Ruhu Mai Tsarki yakan gargaɗe ni cewa kurkuku da shan wuya suna jirana.
english: except that the Holy Spirit testifies in every city, saying that bonds and afflictions wait for me.

hausa: Amma duk wata hadaya don zunubi wadda aka kawo jininta cikin Tentin Sujada don a yi kafara a Wuri Mai Tsarki, ba za a ci ba. A maimako haka za a ƙone ta ɗungum.
english: No sin offering, of which any of the blood is brought into the Tent of Meeting to make atonement in the Holy Place, shall be eaten. It shall be burned with fire.

hausa: Saboda haka, duk wanda ya san abu mai kyan da ya kamata yă yi, bai kuwa yi ba, ya yi zunubi ke nan.
english: To him therefore who knows to do good and doesn’t do it, to him it is sin.

hausa: Dole daurewa ta kammala aikinta don ku zama balagaggu da kuma cikakku, ba ku kuma rasa kome ba.
english: Let endurance have its perfect work, that you may be perfect and complete, lacking in nothing.

hausa: Sa’an nan Musa ya kawo Haruna da ’ya’yansa maza gaba, ya kuma wanke su da ruwa.
english: Moses brought Aaron and his sons, and washed them with water.

hausa: Sa’ad da muka koma wurin bawanka mahaifinmu, sai muka faɗa masa abin da ranka yă daɗe ya ce.
english: When we came up to your servant my father, we told him the words of my lord.

hausa: Saboda haka Yehoram ya tafi Zayir da dukan kekunan yaƙinsa. Sojojin Edom suka kewaye shi a can, amma da dare sai Yoram ya ɓarke ya gudu, sojojinsa kuma suka watse zuwa gidajensu.
english: Then Joram crossed over to Zair, and all his chariots with him; and he rose up by night and struck the Edomites who surrounded him with the captains of the chariots; and the people fled to their tents.

hausa: Farka, iskar arewa, ki kuma zo, iskar kudu! Hura a kan lambuna, don ƙanshinsa yă bazu har waje. Bari ƙaunataccena yă zo cikin lambunsa yă ɗanɗana ’ya’yan itacensa mafi kyau.
english: Awake, north wind, and come, you south! Blow on my garden, that its spices may flow out. Let my beloved come into his garden, and taste his precious fruits.

hausa: Ya tabbatar da shi ga Yaƙub kamar ƙa’ida, ga Isra’ila kamar madawwamin alkawari.
english: He confirmed it to Jacob for a statute, and to Israel for an everlasting covenant,

hausa: Yanzu kuma, uwargida ƙaunatacciya, ba sabon umarni nake rubuta miki ba sai dai wanda muke da shi tun farko. Ina roƙo cewa mu ƙaunaci juna.
english: Now I beg you, dear lady, not as though I wrote to you a new commandment, but that which we had from the beginning, that we love one another.

hausa: suka kira dukan al’umma wuri ɗaya a rana ta fari ga wata na biyu. Aka kuwa rubuta mutanen bisa ga asalin kabilansu da iyalansu. Aka kuma rubuta sunayen maza ɗaya-ɗaya da suka kai shekaru ashirin ko fiye,
english: They assembled all the congregation together on the first day of the second month; and they declared their ancestry by their families, by their fathers’ houses, according to the number of the names, from twenty years old and upward, one by one.

hausa: Amma Yesu sau da yawa, yakan keɓe kansa zuwa wuraren da ba kowa, yă yi addu’a.
english: But he withdrew himself into the desert and prayed.

hausa: Idanunsa sun yi kamar harshen wuta, a kansa kuwa akwai rawani masu yawa. Yana da suna rubuce a kansa da babu wanda ya sani sai dai shi.
english: His eyes are a flame of fire, and on his head are many crowns. He has names written and a name written which no one knows but he himself.

hausa: saboda haka ni ma zan aukar musu da masifa mai zafi in kuma kawo musu abin da suke tsoro. Gama sa’ad da na yi kira, ba wanda ya amsa, sa’ad da na yi magana, ba wanda ya saurara, Sun aikata mugunta a idona suka kuma zaɓa abin da ba na jin daɗi.”
english: I also will choose their delusions, and will bring their fears on them, because when I called, no one answered; when I spoke, they didn’t listen, but they did that which was evil in my eyes, and chose that in which I didn’t delight.”

hausa: Da mutanen wurin suka gane da Yesu, sai suka kai labari a ko’ina a ƙauyukan da suke kewaye. Mutane suka kawo masa dukan marasa lafiyarsu
english: When the people of that place recognized him, they sent into all that surrounding region and brought to him all who were sick;

hausa: Sa’ad da ki ƙazantu a idanun al’umma, za ki san cewa ni ne Ubangiji.’ ”
english: You will be profaned in yourself in the sight of the nations. Then you will know that I am Yahweh.”’”

hausa: Yusuf kuwa ya rasu yana da shekara ɗari da goma. Bayan an shafe shi da maganin hana ruɓa, sai aka sa shi a akwatin gawa a Masar.
english: So Joseph died, being one hundred ten years old, and they embalmed him, and he was put in a coffin in Egypt.

hausa: Ku riƙa farin ciki kullum;
english: Always rejoice.

hausa: A shekara ta ashirin da shida ta Asa sarkin Yahuda, Ela ɗan Ba’asha ya zama sarkin Isra’ila, ya kuma yi mulki a Tirza shekaru biyu.
english: In the twenty-sixth year of Asa king of Judah, Elah the son of Baasha began to reign over Israel in Tirzah for two years.

hausa: Gari yana wayewa, sai sarki ya tashi ya hanzarta zuwa ramin zakoki.
english: Then the king arose very early in the morning, and went in haste to the den of lions.

hausa: “ ‘In hadaya ta ƙonawar daga garke ne, ko na tumaki, ko na awaki, zai miƙa namiji ne marar lahani.
english: “‘If his offering is from the flock, from the sheep or from the goats, for a burnt offering, he shall offer a male without defect.

hausa: ’Ya’yansa maza za su yi shirin yaƙi za su kuma tattara babbar rundunar sojoji, waɗanda za su yi ta mamayewa kamar rigyawar da ba iya tarewa, kuma za su kai yaƙin har kagararsa.
english: His sons will wage war, and will assemble a multitude of great forces which will come on, and overflow, and pass through. They will return and wage war, even to his fortress.

hausa: “Saboda haka halittun hamada da kuraye za su zauna a can, a can kuma mujiya za tă zauna. Ba za a ƙara zauna ko a yi zama a cikinta ba daga tsara zuwa tsara.
english: Therefore the wild animals of the desert with the wolves will dwell there. The ostriches will dwell therein. It will be inhabited no more forever, neither will it be lived in from generation to generation.

hausa: baftismar Yohanna, daga sama ne ta fito, ko kuwa daga wurin mutane ne?”
english: the baptism of John, was it from heaven, or from men?”

hausa: Sai Asa ya ɗauki dukan azurfa da kuma zinariyar da suka rage a ma’ajin haikalin Ubangiji da kuma nasa fadan, ya ba da su ga wani shugabansa, ya kuma aika da su zuwa ga Ben-Hadad ɗan Tabrimmon, ɗan Heziyon, sarkin Aram, wanda yake mulki a Damaskus.
english: Then Asa took all the silver and the gold that was left in the treasures of Yahweh’s house, and the treasures of the king’s house, and delivered it into the hand of his servants. Then King Asa sent them to Ben Hadad, the son of Tabrimmon, the son of Hezion, king of Syria, who lived at Damascus, saying,

hausa: Gama Ubangiji Allahnku ya zaɓe su da zuriyarsu daga cikin dukan kabilanku don su tsaya su yi hidima a cikin sunan Ubangiji har abada.
english: For Yahweh your God has chosen him out of all your tribes to stand to minister in Yahweh’s name, him and his sons forever.

hausa: da mujiya, da babbar mujiya, ɗuskwi,
english: the little owl, the great owl, the horned owl,

hausa: Hasken yana haskakawa cikin duhu, amma duhun bai rinjaye shi ba.
english: The light shines in the darkness, and the darkness hasn’t overcome it.

hausa: Ta haka, ta wurin aikinsu za ku gane su.”
english: Therefore by their fruits you will know them.

hausa: Ya ce wa duka mutanen, “Ku gani! Wannan dutse zai zama mana shaida, ya ji duk maganar da Ubangiji ya yi mana, zai zama muku shaida in ba ku yi wa Allahnku gaskiya ba.”
english: Joshua said to all the people, “Behold, this stone shall be a witness against us, for it has heard all Yahweh’s words which he spoke to us. It shall be therefore a witness against you, lest you deny your God.”

hausa: Sai Zedekiya ɗan Kena’ana ya haura ya mari Mikahiya a fuska. Ya ce, “Ta wace hanya ce ruhun Ubangiji ya fita daga gare ni ya zo ya yi magana da kai?”
english: Then Zedekiah the son of Chenaanah came near, and struck Micaiah on the cheek, and said, “Which way did Yahweh’s Spirit go from me to speak to you?”

hausa: Duk wanda ya karɓe shi yana tarayya da mugun aikinsa ke nan.
english: for he who welcomes him participates in his evil deeds.

hausa: Raɗar mai hikima da aka saurara cikin natsuwa ta fi ihun mai mulkin wawaye.
english: The words of the wise heard in quiet are better than the cry of him who rules among fools.

hausa: Yayinda yake a Betani, a gidan wani mutumin da ake kira Siman Kuturu, yana cin abinci, sai wata mace ta zo da wani ɗan tulu na turaren alabasta da aka yi da nardi zalla, mai tsadan gaske. Ta fasa tulun, ta kuma zuba turaren a kansa.
english: While he was at Bethany, in the house of Simon the leper, as he sat at the table, a woman came having an alabaster jar of ointment of pure nard—very costly. She broke the jar and poured it over his head.

hausa: don ba da ruwa a ƙasar da ba kowa a wurin jeji inda ba mai zama ciki
english: to cause it to rain on a land where there is no man, on the wilderness, in which there is no man,

hausa: Ka yi biyayya da umarnin sarki, na ce, saboda alkawarin da ka yi a gaban Allah.
english: I say, “Keep the king’s command!” because of the oath to God.

hausa: Wannan zai faru a ranar da Allah ta wurin Yesu Kiristi zai shari’anta ɓoyayyun abubuwan da mutane suka yi, yadda bisharata ta furta.
english: in the day when God will judge the secrets of men, according to my Good News, by Jesus Christ.

hausa: Kada ka kauce dama ko hagu; ka kiyaye ƙafarka daga mugunta.
english: Don’t turn to the right hand nor to the left. Remove your foot from evil.

hausa: Kashegari da yake shugaban ƙungiyar sojan ya so yă tabbatar da ainihin abin da ya sa Yahudawa suke zargin Bulus, sai ya sake shi ya kuwa umarci manyan firistoci da dukan Majalisar su taru. Sa’an nan ya kawo Bulus ya sa ya tsaya a gabansu.
english: But on the next day, desiring to know the truth about why he was accused by the Jews, he freed him from the bonds and commanded the chief priests and all the council to come together, and brought Paul down and set him before them.

hausa: Allah ya ce, ‘Ka bar ƙasarka da kuma mutanenka, ka tafi ƙasar da zan nuna maka.’
english: and said to him, ‘Get out of your land and away from your relatives, and come into a land which I will show you.’

hausa: yana cewa, “Ga abin da Yefta yake faɗi, Isra’ila ba tă ƙwace ƙasar Mowab ko ta Ammonawa ba.
english: and he said to him, “Jephthah says: Israel didn’t take away the land of Moab, nor the land of the children of Ammon;

hausa: Don mai bi da kaɗe-kaɗe. Zabura ta Dawuda. A gare ka, ya Ubangiji, na nemi mafaka; kada ka bari in taɓa shan kunya; ka cece ni cikin rahamarka.
english: For the Chief Musician. A Psalm by David. In you, Yahweh, I take refuge. Let me never be disappointed. Deliver me in your righteousness.

hausa: Amma ina tsoron tsokanar abokin gāba, don kada abokan gāba su kāsa ganewa har su ce, ‘Hannunmu ne ya yi nasara; ba Ubangiji ne ya aikata dukan wannan ba.’ ”
english: were it not that I feared the provocation of the enemy, lest their adversaries should judge wrongly, lest they should say, ‘Our hand is exalted; Yahweh has not done all this.’”

hausa: Amma Bafarisiyen ya lura cewa, Yesu bai wanke hannu kafin ya ci abinci ba, sai mamaki ya kama shi.
english: When the Pharisee saw it, he marveled that he had not first washed himself before dinner.

hausa: ku kawo ruwa don ƙishirwa; ku da kuke zama a Tema, ku kawo abinci don masu gudun hijira.
english: They brought water to him who was thirsty. The inhabitants of the land of Tema met the fugitives with their bread.

hausa: Ba ina aikan ka wurin mutanen da suke da baƙon harshe da kuma yare mai wuya ba ne, amma zuwa ga gidan Isra’ila ne,
english: For you are not sent to a people of a strange speech and of a hard language, but to the house of Israel—

hausa: Ranka yă daɗe, muna so ka ba mu izini mu tafi, mu nemo wanda ya iya kiɗan molo, domin duk sa’ad da mugun ruhun nan daga Allah ya tashi, sai yă kaɗa molon don hankalinka yă kwanta.”
english: Let our lord now command your servants who are in front of you to seek out a man who is a skillful player on the harp. Then when the evil spirit from God is on you, he will play with his hand, and you will be well.”

hausa: Gama ta wurin kalmominka za a kuɓutar da kai, kuma ta wurin kalmominka za a hukunta ka.”
english: For by your words you will be justified, and by your words you will be condemned.”

hausa: Zan miƙa kitsen dabbobi gare ka da kuma baye-baye na raguna; zan miƙa bijimai da awaki. Sela
english: I will offer to you burnt offerings of fat animals, with the offering of rams, I will offer bulls with goats. Selah.

hausa: Gama yana a rubuce a cikin Dokar Musa cewa, “Kada ka sa wa saniya takunkumi sa’ad da yake sussukar hatsi.” Kuna tsammani a kan shanu ne Allah ya damu sa’ad da ya ce haka?
english: For it is written in the law of Moses, “You shall not muzzle an ox while it treads out the grain.” Is it for the oxen that God cares,

hausa: Ruben, Simeyon, Lawi da Yahuda;
english: Reuben, Simeon, Levi, and Judah,

hausa: Suka ce masa, “Hezekiya ya ce, yau ranar wahala ce, da ta cin mutunci, da ta shan kunya, ga shi, ’ya’ya suna gab da a haife su, amma ba ƙarfin da za a yi yunƙuri a haife su.
english: They said to him, “Hezekiah says, ‘Today is a day of trouble, of rebuke, and of rejection; for the children have come to the point of birth, and there is no strength to deliver them.

hausa: Ƙiyayya kan haddasa wahala, amma ƙauna kan rufe dukan laifofi.
english: Hatred stirs up strife, but love covers all wrongs.

hausa: Maganar Ubangiji Maɗaukaki ta sāke zuwa wurina.
english: The word of Yahweh of Armies came to me.

hausa: Sa’ad da na dubi sammai, aikin yatsotsinka, wata da taurari waɗanda ka ajiye a wurarensu,
english: When I consider your heavens, the work of your fingers, the moon and the stars, which you have ordained,

hausa: Za ka yi amai ɗan abin da ka ci dukan daɗin bakinka kuwa zai tafi a banza.
english: You will vomit up the morsel which you have eaten and waste your pleasant words.

hausa: Sa’an nan Yaƙub ya yi addu’a, “Ya Allah na mahaifina Ibrahim, Allah na mahaifina Ishaku. Ya Ubangiji kai da ka ce mini, ‘Koma ƙasarka zuwa wurin danginka, zan kuma sa ka yi albarka.’
english: Jacob said, “God of my father Abraham, and God of my father Isaac, Yahweh, who said to me, ‘Return to your country, and to your relatives, and I will do you good,’

hausa: Ibrahim ya ce, “Na ce a raina, ‘Tabbatacce babu tsoron Allah a wannan wuri, za su kuwa kashe ni saboda matata.’
english: Abraham said, “Because I thought, ‘Surely the fear of God is not in this place. They will kill me for my wife’s sake.’

hausa: Zai zama kamar itacen inabi wanda ’ya’yansa suka kakkaɓe kafin su nuna, kamar itacen zaitun zai zubar da furensa.
english: He will shake off his unripe grape as the vine, and will cast off his flower as the olive tree.

hausa: A cikin tsoro, matan suka fāɗi da fuskokinsu a ƙasa, amma mutanen suka ce musu, “Me ya sa kuke neman mai rai a cikin matattu?
english: Becoming terrified, they bowed their faces down to the earth. The men said to them, “Why do you seek the living among the dead?

hausa: Alhakin jininsu, wanda ban gafarta ba, zan gafarta.”
english: I will cleanse their blood that I have not cleansed, for Yahweh dwells in Zion.”

hausa: Mutanen fa suka yi aiki da aminci. Shugabanninsu, su ne Yahat da Obadiya, Lawiyawa zuriyar Merari da Zakariya da Meshullam, zuriyar Kohat. Dukan Lawiyawa waɗanda suke gwanaye a kayan kiɗi,
english: The men did the work faithfully. Their overseers were Jahath and Obadiah the Levites, of the sons of Merari; and Zechariah and Meshullam, of the sons of the Kohathites, to give direction; and others of the Levites, who were all skillful with musical instruments.

hausa: Isra’ilawa suka yi shekaru arba’in suna cin Manna, har sai da suka shiga cikin ƙasar da take da mutane, suka ci Manna har zuwa kan iyakar ƙasar Kan’ana.
english: The children of Israel ate the manna forty years, until they came to an inhabited land. They ate the manna until they came to the borders of the land of Canaan.

hausa: Saboda wannan ne nake a durƙushe a gaban Uba,
english: For this cause, I bow my knees to the Father of our Lord Jesus Christ,

hausa: Sa’ad da ya ɗibiya musu hannuwansa, sai ya tafi abinsa.
english: He laid his hands on them, and departed from there.

hausa: “ ‘ “Ubangiji yă albarkace ku, yă kuma kiyaye ku;
english: ‘Yahweh bless you, and keep you.

hausa: Yana cika hannuwansa da walƙiya kuma yana ba ta umarni tă fāɗi a inda ya yi nufi.
english: He covers his hands with the lightning, and commands it to strike the mark.

hausa: Sai mutumin ya kai ni wajen arewa zuwa cikin filin da yake waje ya kuma kawo ni ɗakunan da suke ɗaura da filin haikalin da yake a gefen arewa.
english: Then he brought me out into the outer court, the way toward the north. Then he brought me into the room that was opposite the separate place, and which was opposite the building toward the north.

hausa: Sai ta kuma ce, “Sai dai, ka biya mini wannan bukata guda. Ka ba ni wata biyu in yi ta yawo da ni da ƙawayena a kan duwatsu mu yi makoki, domin ba zan yi aure ba.”
english: Then she said to her father, “Let this thing be done for me. Leave me alone two months, that I may depart and go down on the mountains, and bewail my virginity, I and my companions.”

hausa: Zan yabi Ubangiji, wanda yake ba ni shawara; ko da dare ma zuciyata kan koya mini.
english: I will bless Yahweh, who has given me counsel. Yes, my heart instructs me in the night seasons.

hausa: Yaya za mu ba wa waɗanda suka rage mata, da yake mun riga mun yi rantsuwa a gaban Ubangiji, ba za mu ba su ɗaya daga ’ya’yanmu su aura ba?”
english: How shall we provide wives for those who remain, since we have sworn by Yahweh that we will not give them of our daughters to wives?”

hausa: Sai almajiransa suka ce, “Kana ganin mutane suna matsinka, duk da haka kana tambaya, ‘Wa ya taɓa ni?’ ”
english: His disciples said to him, “You see the multitude pressing against you, and you say, ‘Who touched me?’”

hausa: “Mutum zai iya yi wa Allah fashi ne? Duk da haka kun yi mini fashi. “Amma sai kuka ce, ‘Yaya muka yi maka fashi?’ “A wajen zakka da hadayu.
english: Will a man rob God? Yet you rob me! But you say, ‘How have we robbed you?’ In tithes and offerings.

hausa: Bayan da muka kai bakin tekun lafiya, sai muka tarar cewa sunan tsibirin Malta ne.
english: When we had escaped, then they learned that the island was called Malta.

hausa: Nan da take, zub da jininta ya tsaya, sai ta ji a jikinta ta rabu da shan wahalarta.
english: Immediately the flow of her blood was dried up, and she felt in her body that she was healed of her affliction.

hausa: Musa ya kasa kunne ga surukinsa, ya kuma aikata duk abin da ya faɗa.
english: So Moses listened to the voice of his father-in-law, and did all that he had said.

hausa: Da kai da Haruna za ku lissafta dukan mazan Isra’ila bisa ga sashensu, waɗanda suka kai shekaru ashirin ko fiye, da za su iya shiga soja.
english: from twenty years old and upward, all who are able to go out to war in Israel. You and Aaron shall count them by their divisions.

hausa: “Faɗin ƙarshen filin a yamma zai zama kamu hamsin. A kuma sa labule tare da rammuka goma da kuma katakai goma.
english: For the width of the court on the west side shall be hangings of fifty cubits; their pillars ten, and their sockets ten.

hausa: Bari maganarku kullum ta zama da ladabi da kuma daɗin ji, domin ku san amsar da ta dace ku ba wa kowa.
english: Let your speech always be with grace, seasoned with salt, that you may know how you ought to answer each one.

hausa: Ka yi tufafi masu tsarki domin ɗan’uwanka Haruna, domin a girmama, a kuma ɗaukaka shi.
english: You shall make holy garments for Aaron your brother, for glory and for beauty.

hausa: ‘ni mai tsarki ne marar zunubi; ina da tsabta kuma ba ni da laifi.
english: ‘I am clean, without disobedience. I am innocent, neither is there iniquity in me.

hausa: Mordekai ya faɗa masa duk abin da ya faru da shi, haɗe da yawan kuɗin da Haman ya yi alkawari zai zuba a ma’ajin fada don a hallaka Yahudawa.
english: Mordecai told him of all that had happened to him, and the exact sum of the money that Haman had promised to pay to the king’s treasuries for the destruction of the Jews.

hausa: Kada ku yi wa yarinyar kome, ba tă yi zunubin da ya cancanci mutuwa ba. Wannan batu ya yi kamar da na mutumin da ya fāɗa wa maƙwabcinsa ya kuma kashe shi.
english: but to the lady you shall do nothing. There is in the lady no sin worthy of death; for as when a man rises against his neighbor and kills him, even so is this matter;

hausa: Ga abin da Ubangiji Maɗaukaki ya ce, “A kwanakin nan, mutane goma daga kabilu da al’ummai za su riƙe rigar mutumin Yahuda guda su ce, ‘Bari mu tafi tare da kai, domin mun ji cewa Allah yana tare da ku.’ ”
english: Yahweh of Armies says: “In those days, ten men out of all the languages of the nations will take hold of the skirt of him who is a Jew, saying, ‘We will go with you, for we have heard that God is with you.’”

hausa: Sa’ad da waɗannan mutane suka shiga gidan Mika suka ɗauke gunkin da aka sassaƙa, efod, sauran allolin gida da kuma gunki na zubi, sai firist ya ce musu, “Me kuke yi?”
english: When these went into Micah’s house, and took the engraved image, the ephod, the teraphim, and the molten image, the priest said to them, “What are you doing?”

hausa: Ƙuri’a ta huɗu ta fāɗa a kan kabilar Issakar, bisa ga iyalansu.
english: The fourth lot came out for Issachar, even for the children of Issachar according to their families.

hausa: Sa’an nan Ubangiji ya faɗa mini, “Sauka daga nan da sauri, domin mutanenka waɗanda ka fitar da su daga Masar sun lalace. Sun juye da sauri daga abin da na umarce su, suka kuma yi zubin gunki wa kansu.”
english: Yahweh said to me, “Arise, get down quickly from here; for your people whom you have brought out of Egypt have corrupted themselves. They have quickly turned away from the way which I commanded them. They have made a molten image for themselves!”

hausa: Sa’an nan Sadukiyawa da suke cewa, babu tashin matattu, suka zo masa da tambaya.
english: Some Sadducees, who say that there is no resurrection, came to him. They asked him, saying,

hausa: Ya hau kerubobi ya kuma yi firiya; ya yi shawagi a fikafikan iska.
english: He rode on a cherub, and flew. Yes, he soared on the wings of the wind.

hausa: Kada ku cuci juna, amma ku ji tsoron Allahnku. Ni ne Ubangiji Allahnku.
english: You shall not wrong one another, but you shall fear your God; for I am Yahweh your God.

hausa: Igiyoyin mutuwa sun nannaɗe kewaye da ni; tarkon mutuwa ya yi mini arangama.
english: The cords of Sheol were around me. The snares of death came on me.

hausa: In mutum bai tuba ba, Allah zai wasa takobinsa; zai tanƙware yă kuma ɗaura bakansa.
english: If a man doesn’t repent, he will sharpen his sword; he has bent and strung his bow.

hausa: Isra’ilawa suka yi duk waɗannan kamar dai yadda Ubangiji ya umarci Musa.
english: Thus the children of Israel did. According to all that Yahweh commanded Moses, so they did.

hausa: Sai ya fara bayyana musu daga Musa da dukan Annabawa, abin da dukan Nassi ya faɗa a kansa.”
english: Beginning from Moses and from all the prophets, he explained to them in all the Scriptures the things concerning himself.

hausa: Sarauniyoyi sittin za su iya kasance a can, da ƙwarƙwarai tamanin da kuma budurwai da suka wuce ƙirge;
english: There are sixty queens, eighty concubines, and virgins without number.

hausa: Wata rana lokacin da ’ya’yan Ayuba suke cikin biki a gidan babban ɗansa,
english: It fell on a day when his sons and his daughters were eating and drinking wine in their oldest brother’s house,

hausa: “Ɗan mutum, sa’ad da mutanen Isra’ila suke zama a ƙasarsu, sun ƙazantar da ita ta wurin halinsu da kuma ayyukansu. Halinsu ya yi kamar rashin tsarkin mace a lokacin al’adarta a gabana.
english: “Son of man, when the house of Israel lived in their own land, they defiled it by their ways and by their deeds. Their way before me was as the uncleanness of a woman in her impurity.

hausa: Jawabin da annabi Irmiya ya ba Serahiya, ɗan Neriya, wato, jikan Ma’asehiya, lokacin da ya tafi tare da Zedekiya, Sarkin Yahuda, zuwa Babilon a shekara ta huɗu ta mulkinsa. Serahiya shi ne shugaba mai lura da gidajen saukar baƙi.
english: The word which Jeremiah the prophet commanded Seraiah the son of Neriah, the son of Mahseiah, when he went with Zedekiah the king of Judah to Babylon in the fourth year of his reign. Now Seraiah was chief quartermaster.

hausa: Kada ku firgita kada kuma ku ji tsoro. Ban furta wannan na kuma yi faɗar haka tuntuni ba? Ku ne shaiduna. Akwai wani Allah in ban da ni? A’a, babu wani Dutse; ban san da wani ba.”
english: Don’t fear, neither be afraid. Haven’t I declared it to you long ago, and shown it? You are my witnesses. Is there a God besides me? Indeed, there is not. I don’t know any other Rock.”

hausa: a ba mu zuriyarsa maza bakwai, mu kashe su, mu kuma rataye jikunansu a gaban Ubangiji a Gibeya na Shawulu wannan zaɓaɓɓen Ubangiji.” Sai sarki ya ce, “Zan ba ku su.”
english: let seven men of his sons be delivered to us, and we will hang them up to Yahweh in Gibeah of Saul, the chosen of Yahweh.” The king said, “I will give them.”

hausa: Sai Musa ya ɗauki matarsa da ’ya’yansa maza, ya sa su a kan jaki, suka kama hanya zuwa Masar. Ya kuma ɗauki sandan Allah a hannunsa.
english: Moses took his wife and his sons, and set them on a donkey, and he returned to the land of Egypt. Moses took God’s rod in his hand.

hausa: Saboda na zaɓe shi don yă umarci ’ya’yansa da iyalinsa a bayansa su kiyaye hanyoyin Ubangiji, ta wurin yin abin da yake daidai da kuma yin adalci, domin Ubangiji ya aikata abin da ya yi wa Ibrahim alkawari.”
english: For I have known him, to the end that he may command his children and his household after him, that they may keep the way of Yahweh, to do righteousness and justice; to the end that Yahweh may bring on Abraham that which he has spoken of him.”

hausa: Amma wannan rana ta Ubangiji, Ubangiji Maɗaukaki ranar ɗaukar fansa, gama ɗaukar fansa a kan maƙiyansa. Takobi zai yi ta ci sai ya gamsu, sai ya kashe ƙishirwansa da jini. Gama Ubangiji, Ubangiji Maɗaukaki, zai miƙa hadaya a ƙasar arewa kusa da Kogin Yuferites.
english: For that day is of the Lord, Yahweh of Armies, a day of vengeance, that he may avenge himself of his adversaries. The sword will devour and be satiated, and will drink its fill of their blood; for the Lord, Yahweh of Armies, has a sacrifice in the north country by the river Euphrates.

hausa: Sa’an nan Isra’ilawa suka yi kuka ga Ubangiji, suka ce, “Mun yi maka zunubi, mun bar Allahnmu muka shiga bautar Ba’al.”
english: The children of Israel cried to Yahweh, saying, “We have sinned against you, even because we have forsaken our God, and have served the Baals.”

hausa: “Ibrahim ya amsa ya ce, ‘Suna da Musa da Annabawa, ai, sai su saurare su.’
english: “But Abraham said to him, ‘They have Moses and the prophets. Let them listen to them.’

hausa: “ ‘Ga abin da Ubangiji Mai Iko Duka yana cewa ni kaina zan cire toho a kan itacen al’ul da yake can bisa in shuka; zan kuma karya ƙanƙanin reshe daga can bisan tohon in shuka a dutse mai tsayi.
english: “The Lord Yahweh says: ‘I will also take some of the lofty top of the cedar, and will plant it. I will crop off from the topmost of its young twigs a tender one, and I will plant it on a high and lofty mountain.

hausa: Me za mu ce ke nan game da wannan abu? In Allah yana goyon bayanmu, wa kuwa zai iya gāba da mu?
english: What then shall we say about these things? If God is for us, who can be against us?

hausa: Bayan wata uku sai muka tashi a wani jirgin ruwan da ya ci damina a tsibirin. Jirgin ruwa kuwa na Alekzandariya ne yana da siffar tagwayen allolin Kasto da Follus.
english: After three months, we set sail in a ship of Alexandria which had wintered in the island, whose figurehead was “The Twin Brothers.”

hausa: Da suka ji dukan maganar, sai suka dubi juna a firgice suka ce wa Baruk, “Dole mu sanar da dukan maganan nan ga sarki.”
english: Now when they had heard all the words, they turned in fear one toward another, and said to Baruch, “We will surely tell the king of all these words.”

hausa: Sa’an nan Yehu da Yehonadab ɗan Rekab, suka shiga haikalin Ba’al. Yehu ya ce wa masu yi wa Ba’al sujada, “Ku dudduba ku tabbatar cewa babu wani bawan Ubangiji a nan tare da ku, sai masu hidimar Ba’al kawai.”
english: Jehu went with Jehonadab the son of Rechab into the house of Baal. Then he said to the worshipers of Baal, “Search, and see that none of the servants of Yahweh are here with you, but only the worshipers of Baal.”

hausa: Waɗansu suka ce, “Ai, Iliya ne.” Har wa yau waɗansu suka ce, “Ai, annabi ne, kamar ɗaya daga cikin annabawan dā.”
english: But others said, “He is Elijah.” Others said, “He is a prophet, or like one of the prophets.”

hausa: Wace amsa ce Allah ya ba shi? “Na keɓe wa kaina dubu bakwai waɗanda ba su yi wa Ba’al sujada ba.”
english: But how does God answer him? “I have reserved for myself seven thousand men who have not bowed the knee to Baal.”

hausa: Duk kuma wanda ya rantse da sama, ya rantse ne da kursiyin Allah da kuma wanda yake zaune a kansa.
english: He who swears by heaven, swears by the throne of God and by him who sits on it.

hausa: Kamanninsa yana kama da walƙiya, tufafinsa kuma fari fat kamar dusan ƙanƙara.
english: His appearance was like lightning, and his clothing white as snow.

hausa: Kada ka ƙwace maganarka daga bakina, gama na sa zuciyata a dokokinka.
english: Don’t snatch the word of truth out of my mouth, for I put my hope in your ordinances.

hausa: Kyarketai da ’yan raguna za su ci abinci tare, zaki kuma zai ci buɗu kamar yadda shanu suke yi, amma ƙura ce za tă zama abincin maciji. Ba za su ƙara cuci ko su yi ɓarna a kan dukan dutsena mai tsarki ba,” in ji Ubangiji.
english: The wolf and the lamb will feed together. The lion will eat straw like the ox. Dust will be the serpent’s food. They will not hurt nor destroy in all my holy mountain,” says Yahweh.

hausa: Amma Yoshuwa ya ce wa mutanen Ruben, mutanen Gad da kuma rabin mutanen kabilar Manasse,
english: Joshua spoke to the Reubenites, and to the Gadites, and to the half-tribe of Manasseh, saying,

hausa: Kowace rana tana yin jawabi; kowane dare yana nuna sani.
english: Day after day they pour out speech, and night after night they display knowledge.

hausa: Gama ga abin da Ubangiji yana cewa, “Kada ka shiga gidan da akwai abincin makoki; kada ka tafi ka yi makoki ko ka nuna juyayi, domin na janye albarkata, ƙaunata da tausayina daga wannan mutane,” in ji Ubangiji.
english: For Yahweh says, “Don’t enter into the house of mourning. Don’t go to lament. Don’t bemoan them, for I have taken away my peace from this people,” says Yahweh, “even loving kindness and tender mercies.

hausa: Sa’an nan Yusuf ya ɗauke su daga gwiwoyin Isra’ila ya rusuna da fuskarsa har ƙasa.
english: Joseph brought them out from between his knees, and he bowed himself with his face to the earth.

hausa: A wani fanni yana sa rai cewa Bulus zai ba shi toshiyar baki, saboda haka ya yi ta aika a kira masa Bulus yă yi magana da shi.
english: Meanwhile, he also hoped that money would be given to him by Paul, that he might release him. Therefore also he sent for him more often and talked with him.

hausa: Da suna cikin gida kuma, sai almajiran suka tambayi Yesu game da wannan.
english: In the house, his disciples asked him again about the same matter.

hausa: Sa’ad da ’yan’uwan Yusuf suka ga cewa mahaifinsu ya mutu, sai suka ce, “Mai yiwuwa Yusuf yana riƙe da mu a zuciya, wataƙila zai rama dukan abubuwa marasa kyau da muka yi masa?”
english: When Joseph’s brothers saw that their father was dead, they said, “It may be that Joseph will hate us, and will fully pay us back for all the evil which we did to him.”

hausa: Babban hafsan matsaran sarkin ya kwashe har da kwanoni na kwashe garwashin wuta da sauran kwanoni, dukansu kuwa ƙeran zinariya ko azurfa tsatsa ne.
english: The captain of the guard took away the fire pans, the basins, that which was of gold, for gold, and that which was of silver, for silver.

hausa: Da māshinsa ka soki kansa sa’ad da jarumawansa suka fito don su tarwatse mu, suna farin ciki sai ka ce masu shirin cinye matalautan da suke a ɓoye.
english: You pierced the heads of his warriors with their own spears. They came as a whirlwind to scatter me, gloating as if to devour the wretched in secret.

hausa: Ubangiji ya riga ya gaya wa Musa a Midiyan, “Koma Masar, domin dukan mutanen da suke neman su kashe ka sun mutu.”
english: Yahweh said to Moses in Midian, “Go, return into Egypt; for all the men who sought your life are dead.”

hausa: Masu kamun kifi za su yi nishi su kuma yi makoki, dukan waɗanda suke jefan ƙugiyoyi a Nilu; waɗanda suke jefan abin kamun kifi a ruwa abin kamun kifin za su zama marasa amfani.
english: The fishermen will lament, and all those who fish in the Nile will mourn, and those who spread nets on the waters will languish.

hausa: Obed shi ne mahaifin Yehu, Yehu shi ne mahaifin Azariya,
english: and Obed became the father of Jehu, and Jehu became the father of Azariah,

hausa: Ko da yake ba su same shi da wani dalilin da ya kai ga hukuncin kisa ba, suka roƙi Bilatus yă sa a kashe shi.
english: Though they found no cause for death, they still asked Pilate to have him killed.

hausa: Yehu mai duba, ɗan Hanani, ya fita don yă tarye shi, ya kuma ce wa sarki, “Ya yi kyau ke nan da ka taimaki mugu ka kuma ƙaunaci waɗanda suke ƙin Ubangiji? Da yake ka yi haka fushin Ubangiji yana a kanka
english: Jehu the son of Hanani the seer went out to meet him, and said to King Jehoshaphat, “Should you help the wicked, and love those who hate Yahweh? Because of this, wrath is on you from before Yahweh.

hausa: Duk garin ya taru a ƙofar gidan.
english: All the city was gathered together at the door.

hausa: Ku yi murna, ya ku mutanen Sihiyona, ku yi farin ciki cikin Ubangiji Allahnku, gama ya ba ku ruwan bazara cikin adalci. Yakan aika muku yayyafi a yalwace, na bazara da na kaka, kamar dā.
english: “Be glad then, you children of Zion, and rejoice in Yahweh, your God; for he gives you the early rain in just measure, and he causes the rain to come down for you, the early rain and the latter rain, as before.

hausa: Akwai baye-baye iri dabam-dabam, amma Ruhu ɗaya ne.
english: Now there are various kinds of gifts, but the same Spirit.

hausa: Zan tayar musu da wani annabi kamar ka daga cikin ’yan’uwansu; zan sa kalmomina a cikin bakinsa, zai kuma faɗa musu kome da na umarce shi.
english: I will raise them up a prophet from among their brothers, like you. I will put my words in his mouth, and he shall speak to them all that I shall command him.

hausa: Da gari yana wayewa, sai Yesu ya je inda ba kowa. Mutane suka yi ta nemansa, da suka zo inda yake, sai suka yi ƙoƙari su hana shi barinsu.
english: When it was day, he departed and went into an uninhabited place and the multitudes looked for him, and came to him, and held on to him, so that he wouldn’t go away from them.

hausa: domin dukiya ba ta dawwama har abada, ba a kuma kasance da rawani daga tsara zuwa tsara.
english: for riches are not forever, nor does the crown endure to all generations.

hausa: Hezekiya ya ce, “Maganar Ubangiji da ka faɗa ta yi kyau.” Gama ya yi tunani cewa, “Ai, ba ni da damuwa, tun da yake za a yi zaman lafiya da salama a kwanakina.”
english: Then Hezekiah said to Isaiah, “Yahweh’s word which you have spoken is good.” He said moreover, “Isn’t it so, if peace and truth will be in my days?”

hausa: Gama ka cece ni daga mutuwa da kuma ƙafafun daga tuntuɓe, don in yi tafiya a gaban Allah cikin hasken rai.
english: For you have delivered my soul from death, and prevented my feet from falling, that I may walk before God in the light of the living.

hausa: Kakan ji, ya Ubangiji sha’awar mai shan wahala; kakan ƙarfafa su, ka kuma saurari kukansu,
english: Yahweh, you have heard the desire of the humble. You will prepare their heart. You will cause your ear to hear,

hausa: Sa’ad da jakar ta ga mala’ikan Ubangiji, sai ta matse a jikin bango, ta goge ƙafar Bala’am da bangon. Saboda haka sai Bala’am ya sāke bugunta.
english: The donkey saw Yahweh’s angel, and she thrust herself to the wall, and crushed Balaam’s foot against the wall. He struck her again.

hausa: Akan kuwa ya amsa ya ce, “Gaskiya ne! Na yi wa Ubangiji, Allah na Isra’ila zunubi. Ga abin da na yi.
english: Achan answered Joshua, and said, “I have truly sinned against Yahweh, the God of Israel, and this is what I have done.

hausa: Da yawa ne masu gāba da ni da ƙarfi; waɗanda suke kina ba dalili sun yi yawa.
english: But my enemies are vigorous and many. Those who hate me without reason are numerous.

hausa: Maɓuɓɓuga ko tafki na tarin ruwa zai ci gaba da zauna mai tsabta, amma duk wanda ya taɓa ɗaya daga cikin waɗannan gawawwakin ya haramtu.
english: Nevertheless a spring or a cistern in which water is gathered shall be clean, but that which touches their carcass shall be unclean.

hausa: Suka kuma kwashe dukan maza, mata da yara da ’ya’yan sarki mata waɗanda Nebuzaradan shugaban matsaran sarki ya bari tare da Gedaliya ɗan Ahikam, ɗan Shafan, da Irmiya annabi da kuma Baruk ɗan Neriya.
english: the men, the women, the children, the king’s daughters, and every person who Nebuzaradan the captain of the guard had left with Gedaliah the son of Ahikam, the son of Shaphan; and Jeremiah the prophet, and Baruch the son of Neriah.

hausa: Amma Barzillai ya ce wa sarki, “Shekara nawa ya rage mini har da zan tafi Urushalima da sarki?
english: Barzillai said to the king, “How many are the days of the years of my life, that I should go up with the king to Jerusalem?

hausa: sai su ce, “To, ka ce, ‘Shibbolet.’ ” In ya ce, “Sibbolet,” saboda ba sa iya faɗin kalmar daidai, sai su kama shi su kashe a mashigan Urdun. Aka kashe mutanen Efraim dubu arba’in da biyu a ta haka.
english: then they said to him, “Now say ‘Shibboleth;’” and he said “Sibboleth”; for he couldn’t manage to pronounce it correctly, then they seized him and killed him at the fords of the Jordan. At that time, forty-two thousand of Ephraim fell.

hausa: Da Siman Bitrus yana nan tsaye yana jin ɗumin wuta, sai aka tambaye shi, “Kai, kai ma ba ɗaya daga cikin almajiransa ba ne?” Sai ya yi mūsu, yana cewa, “Sam, ba na ciki.”
english: Now Simon Peter was standing and warming himself. They said therefore to him, “You aren’t also one of his disciples, are you?” He denied it and said, “I am not.”

hausa: Duk da haka, saboda Dawuda Ubangiji Allahnsa ya ba shi fitila a Urushalima ta wurin ta da wani da ya gāje shi, ta wurinsa kuma Urushalima ta yi ƙarfi.
english: Nevertheless for David’s sake, Yahweh his God gave him a lamp in Jerusalem, to set up his son after him and to establish Jerusalem;

hausa: Kaiton duniya saboda abubuwan da suke sa mutane su yi zunubi! Dole irin waɗannan abubuwa su zo, sai dai kaiton mutumin da ya zama sanadin kawo su!
english: “Woe to the world because of occasions of stumbling! For it must be that the occasions come, but woe to that person through whom the occasion comes!

hausa: Sai ya amince da haka ya kuma gwada su har kwana goma.
english: So he listened to them in this matter, and tested them for ten days.

hausa: Ku dogara ga hasken yayinda kuke da shi, don ku zama ’ya’yan haske.” Da Yesu ya gama magana, sai ya tafi ya ɓuya daga gare su.
english: While you have the light, believe in the light, that you may become children of light.” Jesus said these things, and he departed and hid himself from them.

hausa: Gaskiya nake gaya muku, ba bawan da ya fi maigidansa, ko ɗan saƙon da ya fi wanda ya aike shi.
english: Most certainly I tell you, a servant is not greater than his lord, neither is one who is sent greater than he who sent him.

hausa: Ya tattara ruwan teku cikin tuluna; ya sa zurfafa cikin gidajen ajiya.
english: He gathers the waters of the sea together as a heap. He lays up the deeps in storehouses.

hausa: Dukan mazan da aka ba su aiki a sansanin Efraim, bisa ga sashensu su kai 108,100 ne. Su ne za su zama na uku sa’ad da za a tashi.
english: “All who were counted of the camp of Ephraim were one hundred eight thousand one hundred, according to their divisions. They shall set out third.

hausa: Da Yesu yake cikin faɗin waɗannan abubuwa, sai wata mace daga cikin taron ta ɗaga murya ta ce masa, “Mai albarka ce uwar da ta haife ka, wadda ka sha mamanta.”
english: It came to pass, as he said these things, a certain woman out of the multitude lifted up her voice and said to him, “Blessed is the womb that bore you, and the breasts which nursed you!”

hausa: Kada ka zagi sarki ko da a cikin tunaninka ne, ko ka zagi mai arziki ko da a ɗakin kwananka ne, gama tsuntsun sararin sama zai iya ɗauki maganarka, tsuntsu mai fikafikai zai sanar da abin da ka ce.
english: Don’t curse the king, no, not in your thoughts; and don’t curse the rich in your bedroom, for a bird of the sky may carry your voice, and that which has wings may tell the matter.

hausa: dattawa da manyan mutane su ne kai, annabawa waɗanda suke koyar da ƙarairayi su ne wutsiya.
english: The elder and the honorable man is the head, and the prophet who teaches lies is the tail.

hausa: Waɗansu suka ce, “Shi ne Kiristi.” Waɗansu har wa yau suka ce, “Yaya Kiristi zai fito daga Galili?
english: Others said, “This is the Christ.” But some said, “What, does the Christ come out of Galilee?

hausa: Ka ɗaga māshi da kuma abin da ake jefa a kan waɗanda suke fafarata. Ka ce wa raina, “Ni ne cetonka.”
english: Brandish the spear and block those who pursue me. Tell my soul, “I am your salvation.”

hausa: Kada ku ƙazantar da kanku ta wurin wani daga waɗannan halittu. Kada ku ƙazantar da kanku ta dalilinsu, ko a mai da ku haramtattu ta wurinsu.
english: You shall not make yourselves abominable with any creeping thing that creeps. You shall not make yourselves unclean with them, that you should be defiled by them.

hausa: Duk suka yi mamakin girman Allah. Yayinda kowa yana cikin mamakin dukan abubuwan da Yesu ya yi, sai ya ce wa almajiransa,
english: They were all astonished at the majesty of God. But while all were marveling at all the things which Jesus did, he said to his disciples,

hausa: “Saboda haka, ina gaya muku cewa za a karɓe mulkin Allah daga gare ku, a ba wa mutanen da za su ba da amfani.
english: “Therefore I tell you, God’s Kingdom will be taken away from you and will be given to a nation producing its fruit.

hausa: ya kuma kawo bunsuru ɗaya domin hadaya don zunubi;
english: one male goat for a sin offering;
